\- Lead the development of portfolio, asset, and project strategies across Qiddiya’s Culture portfolio.  
\- Develop strategy briefs, project plans, and strategic recommendations to support projects and decision-making.  
\- Build financial models, P&Ls, forecasts, and scenario analyses to assess strategic opportunities and risks.  
\- Conduct market research, benchmarking, trend analysis, and competitive assessments.  
\- Generate data-driven strategic insights and recommendations to inform executive decision-making and portfolio planning.  
\- Support portfolio planning, prioritization, and decision-making across the Culture portfolio.  
\- Lead strategic projects and cross-functional initiatives, ensuring high-quality delivery against objectives and timelines.  
\- Prepare executive-level presentations, reports, and materials for committees and senior stakeholders.  
\- Build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, consultants, and partners to drive alignment and outcomes.

**Requirements**

\- Bachelor's in Business Administration, Engineering or realted fields.

\- 7+ years of experience in real estate and culture projects.

SUMMARY OF THE ROLE

As a Technical Advisor, you will be responsible for supervising ongoing painting works of decorative projects to ensure the right product and correct usage of the finished coating to achieve the performance as recommended in Jotun's technical data sheets and method of statement.  
  
This position is based in Riyadh and reports to the Senior Technical Advisor.

**Responsibilities:**

* Supervise and advise applicators on proper product applications, on-site assessment, Inspect and prepare concrete with correct surface preparation for coating application and reporting on painting activities for Decorative as well as Floor coating products to ensure that painting jobs are carried out according to specifications and procedures.

  

* Conduct quality control tests, including film thickness checks, adhesion tests, and visual assessments to verify application quality and troubleshoot any surface or performance issues proactively. Ensure on-site testing according to specifications to meet the required quality.

  

* Engaging with contractors and applicators to develop and expand a qualified applicator network by training and certifying them as authorized Jotun applicators.

  

* Liaise with Quality Control Lab on product troubleshooting to ensure proper recommendations are provided to customers.

  

* Delivering product training sessions for internal teams and customers to enhance their knowledge, skills, and overall competency in product application and performance, and adhere to Jotun’s HSEQ (Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality) standards, ensuring consistent use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and safe handling of all hazardous materials, in full compliance with workplace and environmental safety regulations.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR AND WHAT WE OFFER

**We are looking for:  
Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree. In Paint Technology is preferred.

* 3-4 years of relevant experience in technical service for Decorative Paint.

* Fluency in English, both verbal and written, speaking Arabic will be an advantage

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Outlook platform.

  

**Location** : Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

* Acts on own initiative, makes things happen, and accepts responsibility for the results.
* Focuses on bottom-line results, identifies potential risks, and monitors the financial impact of its own activities.

* Quickly understands and analyzes complex issues and problems; comes up with sound and rational judgments.

description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Associate Consultant, Launch Program 2027 – Saudi Arabia

Associate Consultant, Launch Program – 2027- Riyadh, Saudi Arabia  
  
   
  
Why join Mastercard’s Launch Program?   
  
Over the course of this 18-month program, you'll build specialized expertise through hands-on experience, structured learning, and mentorship from industry leaders. You'll work on real business challenges, applying your skills to projects that create meaningful impact.   
  
   
  
Along the way, you'll deepen your knowledge of Mastercard's business, collaborate with teams across the organization, and develop the technical, analytical, and professional capabilities needed to accelerate your career. By the end of the program, you’ll have a strong foundation in your chosen field and the confidence to continue to grow here at Mastercard.    
  
About the team   
  
Mastercard’s Advisors & Consulting Services (A&CS) team helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities.   
  
   
  
What you’ll do   
  
As an Associate Consultant, you will:   
  
collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions.    
  
create meaningful contributions through ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality, and more.   
  
   
  
Specialization Tracks   
  
We are looking for passionate and talented professionals who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs. We are recruiting five specialization tracks that make up our team. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences.   
   
  
Business Experimentation   
  
Leverage Mastercard's industry-leading predictive analytics platform, Test & Learn®, and SQL to run data-backed business experiments for our clients. Consultants focus on data science-based solutions to provide insights on various business initiatives, including product launches, marketing campaigns, customer loyalty, and pricing across various industries that touch many Fortune 500 companies. Partner directly with clients to share findings and help determine which ideas are effective, as well as where, when, and how to implement them.   
  
   
  
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:   
  
Where should a retailer open new stores to maximize profitability and minimize the cannibalization of nearby omnichannel sales?   
  
What bonus should be provided to someone opening a credit card account to entice them to use the card regularly?   
  
Team members will typically support 2-4 clients concurrently and develop a deep understanding of client business challenges through longer term engagements (typically lasting 1-2 years).      
  
   
  
   
  
Strategy & Transformation   
  
Guide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms.   
  
   
  
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:   
  
How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market?   
  
How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial, and strategic goals?   
  
Team members typically support 1-3 projects concurrently, with each project lasting for approximately 8-16 weeks.     
  
   
  
Performance Analytics   
  
Use quantitative and qualitative skills and enterprise applications (e.g., Business Intelligence Platforms, SQL, Python, and more) to drive data-led consulting solutions for customers. Weave together vast amounts of Mastercard, client & 3rd party data assets to investigate trends, build propensity models, develop data visualizations, and synthesize millions of data points into a cohesive story. Engage with client stakeholders through virtual and in-person meetings, leveraging insights to inform strategic recommendations.   
  
   
  
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:   
  
How does a financial institution fraud/authorization metrics fare against competitors, and what are strategies that can help it be best-in-class?   
  
How is a technology customer’s market share changing over time, and are there any segments where the client is relatively under penetrated?   
  
Team members support typically support several customers concurrently and include both short- and long-term projects that can last anywhere from 4 weeks up to 1 year.   
  
   
  
Marketing   
  
Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. description:

# **A Day in the Life**

The Sr. Business Manager, ICT EMEA Region-led markets is responsible for driving business growth, commercial execution, and strategic marketing initiatives across RLMs ACEE and TURMECA. This role partners closely with regional/ country commercial leaders and teams, and global ICT OU to accelerate the adoption of SH, Coronary, and Renal Denervation therapies in the region.  
Key responsibilities include strategic business planning and forecasting, product launch planning & execution, market development, physician engagement, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver sustainable growth and achieve the ICT business’s regional financial objectives. The role also helps expand access to our therapies for more physicians and patients across the EMEA RLM while supporting consistent, high-quality, and safe patient outcomes.  
  
This position is required to support the continued growth of the Interventional Cardiology Therapies (ICT) business across Region-Led Markets (RLMs). As ICT expands across Structural Heart, Coronary, and Renal Denervation therapies, dedicated regional resources are needed to drive commercial execution, business planning, market development, and alignment between country teams and global operating units.  
The role will help accelerate growth opportunities, improve visibility to business performance, support new product launches, and ensure consistent execution of regional priorities, ultimately contributing to the achievement of financial and strategic objectives across the region.

  
  

**Primary Responsibilities:**

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

* Partner with regional and country leadership to identify growth opportunities, market-development priorities, investment needs, and business risks. Develop and execute the EMEA RLM ICT business strategy across Structural Heart, Coronary, and Renal Denervation
* Translate global portfolio and therapy strategies into actionable regional and country-level plans by partnering closely with the EMEA RLM SME team and commercial teams
* Monitor business performance, market dynamics, competitive activity, and key performance indicators, lead and support ICT related planning and forecasting, performance reviews in collaboration with commercial and finance teams
* Drive commercial excellence across product launches, therapy-development initiatives, market-access programs, and customer-engagement strategies
* Coordinate cross-functional teams—including marketing, sales, medical affairs, clinical, market access, finance, regulatory, supply chain, and operations—to advance regional priorities
* Build strong relationships with key regional advocates and internal stakeholders to understand unmet needs and identify opportunities for growth
* Support the development and engagement of regional key opinion leaders and centers of excellence
* Partner closely with business leaders from other Cardiovascular OUs across the EMEA RLM to align strategies, share market insights, and identify opportunities for collaboration
* Promote coordinated execution and mutual value across Cardiovascular businesses while maintaining clear accountability for ICT priorities and performance
* Facilitate best-practice sharing and collaboration across TURMECA, ACEE, other Region-Led Markets, and global OU
* Develop business cases and resource-allocation recommendations for strategic investments and new growth initiatives
* Lead, coach, and develop a geographically dispersed team, fostering accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and high performance
* Represent the EMEA RLM perspective in global ICT forums and ensure regional customer and business needs are incorporated into global strategies.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years of people-management experience; or an advanced degree with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years of people-management experience
* Demonstrated experience in business management, marketing, commercial strategy, or market development within the medical devices and healthcare industry
* Experience leading cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in a complex matrix organization
* Strong business and financial acumen, with experience in strategic planning, forecasting, business-case development, resource allocation, and performance management
* Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Arabic is preferred
* Ability to travel internationally as required.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proven ability to translate strategy into execution and influence stakeholders across different functions, businesses, geographies, and cultures
* Strong analytical, communication, and executive presentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple portfolios and priorities across complex and diverse markets.

The Assistant Horticulturist – Outdoor Gardens supports the day-to-day maintenance, care, and presentation of outdoor gardens, landscapes, and living plant collections. The position also supports plant identification, collection records, Integrated Pest Management (IPM), and the safe use and routine maintenance of horticultural tools and equipment. The role contributes to maintaining safe, healthy, attractive, and high-quality outdoor garden environments.

* Support planting, pruning, watering, weeding, mulching, fertilisation, deadheading, staking, and general garden maintenance.
* Assist with the establishment, replacement, and maintenance of trees, shrubs, groundcovers, herbaceous plants, and seasonal displays.
* Monitor plant health and identify signs of pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies, water stress, and other environmental issues.
* Support the implementation of Integrated Pest Management (IPM), including monitoring, preventative measures, and appropriate control activities.
* Assist with soil preparation, amendments, mulching, fertilisation, and other plant-health activities.
* Support irrigation and watering activities and report signs of over- or under-watering.
* Assist with plant identification, labelling, inventory, and accurate maintenance of plant collection records and databases.
* Maintain high horticultural, aesthetic, and presentation standards across outdoor garden areas.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Horticulture, Botany, Plant Sciences, or a related discipline.
* Additional training or certification in horticulture, plant identification, IPM, irrigation, or related areas is advantageous.

Experience

* Minimum **3 years of relevant professional experience** in outdoor horticulture, garden management, or landscape maintenance.
* Practical experience in planting, pruning, plant establishment, irrigation, soil preparation, fertilisation, mulching, and general plant care.
* Experience maintaining a range of trees, shrubs, groundcovers, herbaceous plants, and seasonal displays.
* Experience identifying common plants, pests, diseases, and environmental or plant-health issues.
* Experience supporting IPM programmes and routine plant-health monitoring.
* Experience with plant labelling, inventory, collection records, and basic horticultural databases is desirable.
* Practical experience using and maintaining common horticultural tools and equipment.
* Previous experience in a botanic garden, public garden, arboretum, nursery, major landscape, or comparable horticultural environment is preferred.

Core Competencies

* Practical horticultural and plant-care skills
* Plant identification and basic plant-health assessment
* Understanding of Integrated Pest Management principles
* Safe use and care of horticultural tools and equipment
* Attention to detail and horticultural presentation standards
* Accurate record-keeping and organisational skills

job_title: Subject Matter Expert - Gear Pump (Polymer Processing) - Short Term 3 Months
description:
We are seeking an experienced Gear Pump Subject Matter Expert (SME) with more than 20 years of experience in polymer processing plants and polymer equipment. The successful candidate will provide specialized technical expertise in the removal, installation, overhauling, troubleshooting, commissioning, and operation of MAAG Vacorex VX450/560 gear pumps and associated polymer processing equipment.

The candidate must have hands-on experience with DOW solution technology and back-end systems, including pelletizers, extruders, and gearboxes.

* Lead and provide technical guidance for the removal, lifting, dismantling, cleaning, inspection, and reinstallation of gear pumps.

* Carry out packing/seal replacement and timing gear adjustments.
* Diagnose and resolve gear pump and gearbox operational issues.
* Support commissioning, start-up, and normal operation using DOW solution technology.
* Provide technical support for associated back-end systems, including pelletizers and extruders.
* Ensure proper installation, alignment, equipment integrity, and safe execution of maintenance activities.
* Provide specialist recommendations and practical guidance to the maintenance and turnaround teams.

### Mandatory Qualifications and Experience

* More than 15 years of experience in polymer processing plants and polymer equipment.
* Proven hands-on experience in gear pump removal, installation, troubleshooting, lifting, cleaning, and testing.
* Direct experience with MAAG Vacorex VX450/560 gear pump overhauling.
* Experience with DOW solution technology for commissioning, start-up, and normal operation.
* Experience with packing replacement and timing gear adjustment.
* Working knowledge of gearboxes, extruders, pelletizers, and polymer plant back-end systems.

BIM Model Development & Management:
• Create, manage, and update detailed 3D building models (architectural and structural) using Autodesk Revit and other BIM tools.

• Conduct clash detection using Navisworks or similar software, identifying and resolving conflicts between various building systems.
• Proactively address design issues and provide BIM-based solutions to avoid construction delays and maintain high-quality outcomes.
Documentation & Deliverables:
• Generate detailed architectural and structural drawings, schedules, and reports directly from the BIM model.
• Ensure that all deliverables comply with the project’s luxury standards, local regulations, and international building codes.

• Monitor and enforce compliance with BIM execution plans and industry standards (e.g., ISO 19650).
Risk Management & Problem Solving:
• Identify potential design risks or constructability issues early in the project lifecycle, particularly in relation to luxury-specific design features.
• Work closely with the project management team to mitigate risks through model adjustments and informed decision-making.
Training & Development:
• Provide training and technical support to project teams, ensuring that all stakeholders understand and utilize BIM processes effectively.
• Stay updated with the latest BIM technologies, tools, and workflows, incorporating new innovations relevant to luxury building projects.

Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Structural Engineering, or related field.

Minimum 13-15 years of experience in BIM management, with at least 10 years working on high-end luxury building projects in the construction industry.

## Position Summary

The Software Production Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, stability, performance, and reliability of software solutions deployed within the NPHIES ecosystem. The role serves as the quality gatekeeper between development, implementation, and production operations, ensuring that all releases meet functional, technical, security, and business requirements before deployment and continue to perform effectively in production environments.

This position requires a strong background in software quality assurance, healthcare systems, production support, and healthcare interoperability standards, particularly FHIR and HL7. The engineer will collaborate closely with development, business, operations, and client teams to validate system functionality, identify defects, improve software quality processes, and support continuous delivery initiatives aligned with NPHIES standards and regulatory requirements.

## Key Responsibilities

### Production Release Validation & Quality Assurance

* Verify and validate software releases prior to and following production deployment.
* Execute production readiness assessments and quality gate reviews.

Job Description

A Technical Project Manager (TPM), is responsible for managing projects to make sure the proposed plan adheres to the timeline, budget, and scope. This includes acquiring resources and coordinating the efforts of team members and third-party contractors or consultants to deliver projects according to plan. The Technical Project Manager will also define the technical project’s objectives and oversee quality control throughout its life cycle.

Project Scope and Objectives:

• Define technical project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders

• Ensure alignment of project goals with business objectives and stakeholder expectations

• Develop detailed project charters and obtain formal sign-off from stakeholders

Project Planning:

• Develop comprehensive project plans, including schedules, budgets, and resource allocation

• Identify and document project dependencies, critical paths, and key milestones

• Utilize project management tools to create and maintain project schedules, ensuring all tasks are assigned and deadlines are met

• Conduct post-project reviews to identify lessons learned and areas for improvement

• Document and share best practices and lessons learned with the broader organization

• Implement changes based on review findings to improve future project outcomes

Technical Problem Solving:

• Coordinate between different stakeholders and teams to help solve technical problems

• Provide technical guidance and support to team members as needed

• Ensure technical challenges are addressed promptly to avoid project delays

Monitoring and Reporting:

• Monitor and report project progress and performance against established goals and milestones

• Prepare and present regular status reports to stakeholders, highlighting progress, risks, and issues

• Implement mechanisms for tracking project metrics and KPIs

Team Coordination and Task Management:

• Drive project-related team ceremonies

• Ensure all team members have their tasks documented with clear estimates and delivery dates

• Facilitate communication and collaboration among project team members to ensure alignment and accountability

Task Documentation and Assignment:

• Ensure that all project tasks are captured, documented, and assigned to the right individual in the project management tool used by the team

• Maintain an up-to-date project backlog and ensure tasks are prioritized according to project needs

• Review and approve task completion to ensure quality and adherence to project standards

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of project tasks

• Align project activities with other ongoing initiatives to avoid conflicts and maximize resource utilization

• Foster collaboration and synergy among different teams to achieve project goals

• Report project progress to stakeholders on a daily and weekly basis

• Maintain open and transparent communication with all stakeholders to ensure expectations are managed effectively

• Ensure that project documentation is accurate, complete, and up-to-date

• Solicit feedback from team members and stakeholders to identify areas for process improvement.

Enforce, incorporate, and comply with all necessary controls and related information security (EIS) policies, procedures, practices, training, reporting, personal due diligence and vigilance, within departmental/unit activities and operations.

A tertiary-level qualification from an internationally recognized institution

Proven track record of successfully delivering projects on time and within budget

Problem-solving skills

Attention to details

leadership and team management skills

## Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented ICT/ELV Inspector to join our team in **Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.** In this critical role, you will be responsible for ensuring the safety, quality, and compliance of ICT/ELV installations.

The ICT Inspector will be responsible for overseeing the inspection, testing, and commissioning of information and communication technology (ICT) systems to ensure compliance with project specifications, standards, and regulations. As an ICT Inspector, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the seamless integration and functionality of ICT systems within the airport infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
• Conduct daily inspections of ICT and ELV installations, including structured cabling, racks, termination panels, and active/passive components.  
• Verify compliance with approved shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements.  
• Ensure proper installation of systems such as CCTV, access control, public address, fire alarm, intrusion systems, A/V, IPTV, SAS and BMS/ SCADA interfaces.  
• Monitor workmanship and adherence to safety and quality standards.  
• Witness and document testing and commissioning activities for ICT systems.  
• Prepare detailed inspection reports, highlight non-conformances, and recommend corrective actions.  
• Liaise with contractors, consultants, and project teams to resolve site issues promptly.  
• Maintain accurate records of inspections, approvals, and compliance checks.  
• Coordinate and participate in the testing and commissioning activities of ICT systems, including conducting functional tests, troubleshooting technical issues, and ensuring proper system integration.  
• Collaborate closely with project stakeholders, including engineers, contractors, vendors, and clients, to address technical concerns, resolve issues, and ensure timely completion of ICT-related activities.  
• Raise non-conformance reports (NCRs) and ensure timely resolution.  
• Maintain detailed inspection reports, logs, and records for quality assurance and compliance tracking  
• Participate in site coordination and progress meetings with contractors and stakeholders to resolve technical issues on-site.  
• Perform other duties as assigned by the line manager/supervisor.  
• Collaborate with other inspectors to resolve integration issues.  
• Stay updated on local and international codes, standards, and regulations  
• Participate in site coordination and progress meetings with contractors and stakeholders to resolve technical issues on-site.

## Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Communications Engineering or related field.
* **Minimum 10 years of experience** in ICT/ELV systems inspection within large-scale property or infrastructure projects.
* Aviation experience is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of structured cabling, networking, and integrated systems.
* Familiarity with international ICT standards and local regulations.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to enforce quality standards.
* Familiarity with industry standards and regulations governing ICT installations in airport facilities (e.g., ICAO, ACI, IEEE, ISO).
* Professional certifications related to ICT systems would be an advantage.
* Experience with airport infrastructure projects or similar large-scale construction projects is highly desirable.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are a plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant inspection software.
* Meticulous attention to detail with a strong commitment to safety and quality.
* In-depth knowledge of construction industry regulations and safety standards.

description:

نبحث عن أخصائي مبيعات عقارية يساهم في دعم نمو المبيعات وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء المهتمين بشراء الوحدات السكنية الجاهزة. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم تجربة بيع احترافية، وفهم احتياجات العملاء، وتحويل الفرص البيعية إلى صفقات ناجحة من خلال المتابعة المستمرة والتنسيق الفعال مع الجهات الداخلية.

* استقبال ومتابعة العملاء المهتمين بشراء الوحدات العقارية.

* شرح تفاصيل المشاريع والوحدات للعملاء من حيث المساحات والأسعار والمميزات.

* إعداد تقارير دورية عن العملاء والزيارات والصفقات ونسب التحويل.
* المحافظة على علاقة احترافية مع العملاء قبل وبعد البيع.

### Required Qualifications

Salla is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to take ownership of product quality across our platform. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that every release meets our quality standards, and you will be accountable for making informed go/no-go release decisions based on risk and test results.

You will be expected to define the most suitable QA approach for our product and teams, including the testing strategy, tools, standards, and workflows. This approach should be flexible, not rigid: you will adapt the depth, type, and process of testing to fit each situation, whether it's an urgent hotfix, a major feature launch, or a high-risk change.

This is a hands-on role covering both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to review requirements, define test strategies, perform manual and exploratory testing, and build reliable test automation using Playwright.

Beyond identifying and resolving defects, you will analyze their root causes and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues.

### Responsibilities

* Own quality end to end, building it in early through requirement reviews, design discussions, and test strategy, through to the final go/no-go call on releases
* Define and continuously refine the QA approach, including testing standards, workflows, tools, and quality metrics. Adapt testing depth, process, and priorities to risk, timeline, and context rather than applying a one-size-fits-all process
* Decide what needs testing, how deeply, and with which approach (functional, regression, API, UI, performance, security, usability). Decide what stays manual and what gets automated, and know when enough is enough
* Perform thorough manual and exploratory testing on new features, finding what scripts miss: edge cases, unexpected user behavior, UX problems, and the UI details users notice (layout, states, responsiveness)
* Build and maintain Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) automation that runs in CI, catches real issues instead of just adding to a test count, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback
* Review code and pull requests properly: read them, question them, and push back when something isn't right
* Triage defects and investigate them in depth using browser DevTools (network, console, performance, storage) to find root causes, not just symptoms, and help the team prioritize what matters most
* Prevent recurring issues by identifying the pattern behind bugs, analyzing defect trends, and putting safeguards in place (tests, checks, process changes). Think ahead about how new features, scale, and changes will affect quality
* Use AI tools thoughtfully to speed up test creation, analysis, and debugging, and build AI-assisted workflows where they add value, while always validating the output
* Communicate risks clearly to developers, product managers, and leadership, with a recommendation rather than just a report
* Take initiative to spot gaps in our processes, tools, or product and drive improvements, while mentoring other QA engineers and raising the quality mindset across the team

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of QA experience with real ownership of releases and quality decisions
* Strong experience in both manual and automated testing, and the judgment to balance the two
* Solid JavaScript and TypeScript skills, enough to write clean, maintainable Playwright automation and read application code with confidence
* Hands-on experience with Playwright (or strong experience with a similar framework plus a willingness to go deep on Playwright)
* Strong command of Git and GitHub: branching, pull requests, code reviews, and working within CI pipelines
* Deep understanding of testing types, techniques, and test design, and the judgment to choose the right one
* Flexibility to adjust your approach to different situations, avoiding rigid processes while keeping quality standards high
* Experience testing web, mobile, and APIs
* Comfort with browser DevTools for debugging and investigation
* Practical experience using AI in your work, and the critical thinking to know when to trust it and when not to
* A preventive mindset: you've fixed problems at their root, not just patched symptoms, and can give examples

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute planned field visits to pharmacies, pharmacists, and designated healthcare professionals in line with territory coverage plans and segmentation targets.
* Build and maintain strong long-term relationships with pharmacists, pharmacy chains, and key retail stakeholders to drive product recommendation, business growth, and customer loyalty.
* Strengthen engagement and loyalty toward Galderma brands through consistent scientific promotion, professional customer service, and effective relationship management.
* Ensure excellent visibility and positioning of Galderma products across assigned pharmacy accounts, maintaining the company image as a leader in dermatology and skincare.
* Monitor product availability and stock levels across all target pharmacies and key accounts to ensure optimum inventory levels and avoid stock shortages or supply disruptions.
* Implement company commercial and marketing plans, including in-store activations, promotional campaigns, merchandising activities, and pharmacy education initiatives.
* Conduct product detailing, presentations, and educational sessions for pharmacists and pharmacy staff to effectively communicate product benefits, marketing messages, and campaign objectives.
* Organize and support pharmacy-focused meetings, activation programs, and promotional events in alignment with business objectives.
* Educate pharmacists on Galderma’s Integrated Dermatology Strategy (IDS) by promoting complete skincare and treatment solutions that improve consumer outcomes and maximize cross-selling opportunities across the portfolio.
* Optimize utilization of company resources, including time, samples, and promotional investments, in alignment with territory priorities and manager direction.
* Monitor territory sales performance and market trends, while developing and implementing action plans to achieve assigned targets.
* Prepare and submit accurate business reports, including daily activities, weekly plans, monthly updates, and territory performance analyses.
* Monitor competitor activities, pricing strategies, new launches, and market dynamics to identify opportunities and potential business risks.
* Handle pharmacy and customer complaints professionally by investigating issues, proposing solutions, and escalating where necessary.
* Collect and report pharmacovigilance cases in full compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure full compliance with company legal, ethical, and compliance standards, as well as local laws and regulations, in all interactions and activities.
* Maintain up-to-date product, market, and category knowledge to ensure high-quality customer engagement and effective communication of scientific and commercial messages.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s Degree (science/ pharmacy) or equivalent experience/qualification
* At least 2 –3 years of working experience in the sales field, ideally in the beauty/ dermatology/ skin care industry.
* Solid sales experience with a track record of developing, engaging customers and delivering on company targets.
* Must be analytical, detailed, passionate, organized and systematic.
* Experience in territory and distributor management is an added advantage

  

**Why Join Galderma**

At Galderma, we are shaping the future of dermatology and Injectable Aesthetics through science-led innovation and customer partnership. You will join a high-performing team, work on a strategic growth brand, and play a key role in building long-term success in Saudi Arabia.

  
  

Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

For more information go to [www.galderma.com/careers](https://www.galderma.com/careers)

Jasara Program Management Company (Jasara PMC) is a leading Joint Venture between Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jacobs, and Saudi Aramco, established to deliver world-class program management services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Jasara plays a key role in supporting the realization of Saudi Vision 2030, particularly in delivering giga-projects and large-scale infrastructure developments.

We are seeking a Senior Design Manager - MEP (Electrical) to join JASARA PMC. The Senior Design Manager – MEP (Electrical) oversees consultant-led electrical and power system design activities across all project stages, ensuring compliance with requirements, approved design briefs, Scopes of Work (SOW), applicable electrical standards, and authority regulations.

The role provides technical leadership and design governance for all electrical engineering disciplines, including power distribution, low voltage (LV) systems, medium voltage (MV) interfaces, substations, switchgear, emergency power systems, ELV integration, and smart city infrastructure. The position ensures electrical designs are coordinated with architectural, structural, mechanical, infrastructure, and specialist disciplines to deliver safe, reliable, efficient, and construction-ready solutions.

The Senior Design Manager does not undertake detailed design production but is responsible for reviewing, guiding, and assuring the quality, coordination, compliance, and deliverability of consultant design outputs while supporting the Design Director in technical assurance, cost alignment, value engineering, and delivery readiness.

### Design Leadership & Governance

* Oversee, coordinate, and monitor all electrical and power system design activities throughout concept, schematic, detailed design, and construction documentation stages.
* Lead design governance processes related to electrical engineering, including design reviews, technical compliance reviews, change management, and stage-gate approvals.
* Ensure all electrical designs comply with standards, Saudi Building Code, SEC requirements, IEC standards, NFPA standards, and applicable international best practices.
* Establish and maintain electrical design standards, specifications, and technical guidelines across the project portfolio.

### Consultant Management

* Manage electrical, MEP, and multidisciplinary consultants, ensuring compliance with approved design briefs, SOWs, project requirements, and quality standards.
* Review and challenge consultant submissions to ensure optimum technical solutions, operational efficiency, maintainability, and lifecycle value.
* Monitor consultant performance, deliverable quality, programme adherence, and technical compliance.
* Participate in consultant selection, technical evaluations, and procurement activities.

### Electrical Systems Oversight

* Provide technical oversight for the design and integration of:

* Medium Voltage (MV) Infrastructure
* Low Voltage (LV) Distribution Systems
* LV Switchgear and Main Distribution Boards
* Substations and Electrical Rooms
* Emergency and Backup Power Systems
* UPS Systems
* Generator Systems
* Earthing and Lightning Protection
* External Power Networks
* Street Lighting Systems
* Smart City Electrical Infrastructure
* ELV Interfaces and Building Technologies

### Multidisciplinary Coordination

* Act as the primary electrical design interface across all disciplines.
* Ensure electrical requirements are fully integrated with architectural, structural, mechanical, ICT, security, transportation, and utility infrastructure designs.
* Lead coordination workshops to identify and resolve design clashes, interface risks, and operational concerns.
* Ensure electrical systems support overall project functionality, resilience, sustainability, and operational objectives.

### Technical Assurance & Design Review

* Review engineering calculations, electrical studies, and design reports including:

* Load Demand Assessments
* Load Flow Studies
* Short Circuit Analysis
* Protection Coordination Studies
* Arc Flash Studies
* Power Quality Assessments
* Reliability and Redundancy Analysis

* Verify design compliance, constructability, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Ensure design solutions support long-term asset management strategies and operational requirements.

### Cost, Value Engineering & Risk Management

* Work closely with Development, Commercial, and Cost Management teams to align electrical designs with approved budgets and project objectives.
* Lead value engineering reviews without compromising safety, performance, reliability, or operational requirements.
* Identify technical risks, programme impacts, and cost implications and recommend mitigation measures.
* Support lifecycle cost assessments and whole-life asset value optimization.

### Construction & Delivery Support

* Apply strong construction and execution knowledge to ensure electrical design packages are practical, coordinated, and ready for implementation.
* Support design-to-construction transitions, technical queries, shop drawing reviews, and site coordination activities.
* Participate in testing, commissioning, and handover readiness reviews.
* Support Operational Readiness and Transition (ORT) activities.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 15 years of experience in electrical engineering design and project delivery.
* Minimum 7 years in senior design management or leadership roles.
* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or Engineering Management preferred.
* Proven experience managing consultant-led design teams on large-scale mixed-use developments, cities, infrastructure, airports, metros, utilities, theme parks, or giga-projects.
* Extensive experience with power distribution systems, LV/MV infrastructure, substations, switchgear, and critical electrical systems.
* Experience in Saudi Arabia or GCC mega-project developments preferred

Job Title: Platform Engineer
Employment Type: Contractual 3 to 5 month
Experienced Required: 5 to 10 years
Work Location: KSA
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Platform Engineer to support the installation, configuration, integration, and operationalization of an on-premises modern data platform. The role will focus on infrastructure setup, platform administration, security integration, environment management, and platform reliability across Development, QA, and Production environments.
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience deploying enterprise data platforms in highly secured environments, with strong troubleshooting, operational support, and infrastructure management capabilities.
Key Responsibilities

• Install, configure, and administer data platform components in an on-premises environment.

• Deploy and manage MinIO Object Storage and Apache Iceberg -based data lakehouse architecture.

• Install, configure, and optimize Starburst and/or Dremio platforms for data virtualization and querying.

• Deploy, administer, and support Apache Spark clusters and processing services.

• Install, configure, and manage Informatica components and ensure seamless integration with the platform ecosystem.

• Configure and maintain Development, QA, and Production environments.

• Integrate platform components with enterprise security services, including:
• Identity & Access Management (IAM)

Careerflow Human Data Labs partners with AI companies to bring real-world professional expertise into their products.

About the role

We are seeking Computational Life Sciences experts with strong scientific programming skills to develop complex, realistic tasks for Agentic Life Sciences. You will design tasks where AI agents must independently navigate scientific data, write and execute code,

use computational tools, troubleshoot intermediate results, and produce scientifically valid final outputs. The goal is to evaluate whether AI systems can perform authentic multi-step scientific work — not simply answer scientific questions.

Environment

Tasks are executed in controlled computational environments and should be self-contained and reproducible.

Depending on the scientific workflow, tasks may use Python, command-line tools, scientific libraries, or domain-specific software. Experts should design tasks whose required dependencies, data, and computational resources can be reliably packaged and evaluated in the project environment.

Key Responsibilities

Design challenging, realistic agentic scientific workflows across the life sciences.

Create tasks requiring multiple computational steps rather than single-script or simple question-answer solutions.

Develop realistic input files, scientific datasets, instructions, constraints, and expected deliverables.

Build tasks requiring agents to inspect data, select appropriate methods, execute analyses, troubleshoot problems, and synthesize results.

Create reproducible expert solutions and objectively verifiable ground truths that run in the sandbox described above.

Design robust automated or semi-automated grading criteria.

Ensure tasks measure scientific reasoning and execution rather than memorization.

Validate scientific assumptions, calculations, code, intermediate outputs, and final answers.

Ensure tasks are self-contained and executable in controlled, network-isolated computational environments.

Maintain high quality and throughput while responding effectively to reviewer feedback.

Qualifications Required

Ph.D., postdoctoral, or equivalent research experience in the life sciences, with strong demonstrated computational and scientific-programming experience.

Strong scientific programming experience, particularly in Python.

Experience performing multi-step computational scientific analyses.

Ability to independently validate both scientific reasoning and computational outputs.

Preferred

Expertise in one or more areas including bioinformatics, computational genomics, systems biology, computational neuroscience, biostatistics, computational drug discovery, computational biochemistry, structural biology, protein engineering, or computational microbiology.

Experience with scientific libraries and command-line tools.

Experience creating reproducible research pipelines.

Ability to translate authentic research workflows into bounded, objectively gradable tasks.

Bonus Points For

Experience with AI agents, coding agents, or scientific AI systems.

Experience building automated evaluation environments.

Familiarity with Docker/Linux environments.

Publications involving computational or data-intensive life sciences research.

**Medical Science Liaison – Biologics**

  

**  
ABOUT ASTRAZENECA**

  

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialisation of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

  

***SITE DESCRIPTION***

  

***AstraZeneca is experiencing a significant transformation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, driven by a commitment to advancing healthcare, innovation, and sustainable growth. Building on our global legacy, AZ KSA is rapidly evolving its operations to better serve patients, collaborate with healthcare stakeholders, and contribute to the ambitious goals outlined in the Saudi Vision 2030. We are investing in talent, digital solutions, and new ways of working; all designed to enhance our impact on patient outcomes and reinforce our leadership in therapeutic areas. This dynamic environment calls for visionary, agile professionals who thrive in change and are motivated to help shape the future of healthcare in KSA.*** 

  

**ROLE SUMMARY**

  

  

Medical Science Liaison (MSL) possesses extensive scientific expertise in respective therapeutic area and engages in scientific discussions and presentations with KEEs about the disease area, and clinical data in a non-promotional context.

  

This role is accountable for generating actionable insights from KEEs and communicating these to the brand team to shape the Medical and Brand strategy.

  

This role is responsible for a highly strategic product and disease area that involves working extensively with external stakeholders to forge strong relations and foster scientific and strategic partnerships within major hospitals and institutions/ authorities in their assigned territory and non-traditional stakeholders (E.g. policy and decision makers, payer groups, government, researchers, and others to help bridge the gaps and provide health system solutions.

  

  

**What you’ll do**

  

**Build, enhance, maintain advocacy of Key External Experts (KEEs)**

  

* Identify, prioritize, and expand KEEs to include non-traditional stakeholders (E.g. policy and decision makers, payer groups, government, researchers, and others) based on scientific/clinical expertise and practice change influence within a specific hospital and institution/ authorities, and engage in robust scientific discussions and medical advancements in a balanced, objective, and accurate way.
* Identify, and prioritize accounts based on patient care pathway and map the multidisciplinary team and maturity.
* Provide AZ with an understanding of the local medical community, clinical practice trends, HCP insight and real or perceived gaps in current scientific knowledge, patient journey, and disease management.
* Foster scientific partnerships with KEEs to help advance disease understanding and to achieve evidence-based changes in medical practice that are consistent with Medical Affairs strategy & objectives, such as:

  

                             i.     Interact in the field with the medical community in the context of various medical projects such as clinical trials, Non-Interventional Studies, Investigator Sponsored Studies (ISSs), scientific exchange.

  

                            ii.      Identify potential speakers and train speakers as appropriate for local events.

  

                           iii.     Provide recommendations for advisory board / round table discussion participants and serve as faculty/facilitators for advisory board meetings.

  

                           iv.     Present scientific data to HCPs in both group (Medically led meetings) and one on one setting.

  

                            v.     Facilitate continuing medical education events for HCPs.

  

                           vi.     Support evidence generation in the region aligned with the medical strategy of disease area and product.

  

**Build and implement scientific programs to address unmet medical needs in priority disease area(s)**

  

* Collect and share actionable insights that enhance the value and appropriate use of AZ products and disease management to internal stakeholders.
* Engage in strategic planning meetings and medical-scientific presentations with medication access stakeholders, institutional decision makers and other external stakeholders to drive better clinical decisions and enhance medication accessibility within the assigned hospital or institution.  These discussions are scientific in nature and must be clearly separated from promotional and/ or other business discussions.
* Organize and facilitate scientific events on healthcare institutions and their multi-disciplinary teams related to the therapeutic area to ensure holistic approach to patient care within their hospital and institution.
* Embed a comprehensive healthcare system and patient experience understanding in prioritized hospitals and institutions to transform care and improve patient outcomes.

  

**Act as scientific expert in priority disease area for internal stakeholders.**

  

* Demonstrate expertise and knowledge of AZ products, emerging therapies, competitors, patient and treatment trends, clinical trials, and scientific activities within the disease area and continuously updates this expertise and knowledge.
* Provide the AZ internal stakeholders with an understanding of the local medical community, clinical practice, trends and real or perceived gaps in current scientific knowledge and medical treatment options/ guidelines through periodic therapeutic area and product trainings.
* Provide scientific support at AZ sponsored educational events.
* Plan and execute regional medical activities during the product launch processes.

  

**Medical Information**

  

* Respond to unsolicited requests for information about unapproved AZ products or unapproved uses of approved products, presenting such information in an objective, well balanced, substantiated manner that is scientific in tone and content, free of promotional messages, truthful, and is not misleading.
* Demonstrate appropriate response and documents the provision of accurate, scientific data in response to unsolicited scientific questions posed by healthcare providers with Company Policies, and applicable laws, regulations, and ethical standards.

  

**Only Applications in KSA will be considered.**

  

  

**Essential for the role**

  

**For Internal Candidates:**

  

* A minimum of 1 year of experience within AstraZeneca with a solid performance track record.
* Experience with the healthcare environment and related dynamics in Saudi Arabia is necessary.
* Experience in Respiratory/Biologics therapy area is preferable.

  

**For External Candidates:**

  

* Minimum of 1 year of experience in a Medical Affairs role in the pharmaceutical industry in Saudi Arabia.
* Experience in the Respiratory/Biologics therapy area.
* Experience with the healthcare environment, including opinion leaders, the medical community, and related dynamics in Saudi Arabia.
* An established track record of driving clinical practice shaping and impactful stakeholder mobilization.

  

  

**Desirable for the role**

  

·       Demonstrated business acumen and track record of end -to-end project management.

  

·       Full understanding of the medical role in driving innovative value strategies and supporting patient access to evidence-based treatment is an advance.

  

·       Established track record of basic or clinical research.

  

  

**Why AstraZeneca?**

  

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

  

**  
So, what’s next?**

  

* Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
* Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available, and we hope it’s yours.

  

**Where can I find out more?**

  

Our Social Media, Follow AstraZeneca on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/1603/)

  

Follow AstraZeneca on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/astrazenecacareers/)

description:
Barceló Group is a family-owned company founded in 1931 by Simón Barceló in Mallorca (Spain). Our expansion to the world's major destinations, along with our clear growth strategy, has allowed us to position ourselves as the 2nd largest chain in Spain and one of the top 30 in the world in terms of the number of rooms.

Our commitment to ensuring the satisfaction of our visiting guests and the well-being of our entire team has been rewarded with the "Best Hotel Management Company in the World" award at the latest edition of the World Travel Awards, considered the Oscars of the international tourism sector.

Currently, Barceló Hotel Group has 270 urban and resort hotels with 4 and 5 stars, totaling over 60,000 rooms distributed in 24 countries. These hotels are marketed under four brands that allow us to provide our guests with a clear differentiating value in terms of both quality and service:

* ### Royal Hideaway Luxury Hotels & Resorts
    
* ### Barceló Hotels & Resorts
    
* ### Occidental Hotels & Resorts
    
* ### Allegro Hotels
    

All of the above, combined with a clear spirit of sustainable improvement, enables us to look towards the future with optimism, always backed by the strength and international presence that have characterized the Barceló Group throughout its more than 90 years of business trajectory. Do you want to be part of our story? Join our team!

# **¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?**

Job Summary\*\*  
  
The Hotel General Manager for Barceló Riyadh Olaya is responsible for the overall operational management, financial performance, and guest satisfaction of the hotel, ensuring alignment with Barceló Gestiôn Hotelera's brand standards and strategic objectives.  
  
Job Responsibilities\*\*  
  
\* Oversee all hotel departments, including Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, and Human Resources, to ensure efficient and effective operations.  
\* Develop and implement strategic business plans to achieve revenue goals, optimize profitability, and enhance market share.  
\* Manage the hotel's budget, financial reporting, and cost control measures, ensuring adherence to financial targets.  
\* Cultivate and maintain high levels of guest satisfaction through exceptional service delivery, prompt resolution of guest issues, and continuous improvement initiatives.  
\* Lead, mentor, and motivate a diverse team of hotel professionals, fostering a positive work environment and promoting professional development.  
\* Ensure compliance with all local regulations, health and safety standards, and company policies.  
\* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including owners, suppliers, and local community representatives.  
\* Implement and monitor quality control programs to uphold Barceló's brand standards and guest experience.  
\* Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and guest feedback to identify opportunities for growth and improvement.  
\* Oversee the maintenance and upkeep of the hotel's facilities and assets.  
\* Represent the hotel and company at industry events and within the local community.  
  


# **What are we looking for?**

  
\* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.  
\* Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in hotel management, with at least 5 years in a General Manager role of a full-service hotel.  
\* Proven track record of successful financial performance, revenue growth, and guest satisfaction.  
\* Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.  
\* Excellent understanding of hotel operations, financial management, sales & marketing, and human resources.  
\* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and demanding environment.  
\* Proficiency in hotel management software (PMS) and Microsoft Office Suite.  
\* Fluency in English is essential; knowledge of Arabic is highly advantageous.  
\* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.  
\* Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing teams.  
\* Knowledge of the Riyadh hospitality market is a plus.

\* Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en un entorno de trabajo flexible, colaborativo y responsable, rodeado de los mejores colegas.

\*Tendrás acceso a los mejores programas de capacitación del mercado, adaptados a tu posición dentro de la empresa. Además, porque creemos firmemente en el desarrollo personal, ofrecemos una amplia gama de actividades de formación abierta a través de nuestra plataforma de e-learning Barceló Campus.

\* Te invitamos a explorar Barceló ReGen, nuestra estrategia de sostenibilidad. Esta iniciativa abarca numerosas acciones relacionadas con el desarrollo social, económico y medioambiental en todos los lugares donde nuestra empresa opera. ¡Queremos que te unas a nosotros en nuestro compromiso de construir un futuro mejor!  
  
Como uno de nuestros mayores desafíos es asegurar tu felicidad, formar parte del equipo del Grupo de Hoteles de Barceló ofrece ventajas y beneficios adicionales, entre ellos:  
  
1\. Descuentos exclusivos en hoteles y viajes para ti, tu familia y amigos.  
2\. Acceso a una póliza de seguro de salud con numerosas ventajas y condiciones especiales para el grupo Barceló.  
3\. Descuentos con diversas empresas relacionadas con el ocio y el tiempo libre.  
4\. Ofertas especiales con empresas de productos y servicios.  
5\. Acuerdos exclusivos con diferentes escuelas de formación y negocios.

Regular  

Únete a una compañía de referencia, tanto en el ámbito nacional como internacional, en continua expansión. En Barceló Hotel Group, lo que verdaderamente importa son las personas. Súmate a formar parte de un equipo que crea en ti y apueste por tu desarrollo profesional.

En Barceló creemos en el talento en todas sus formas. Si hoy no encuentras la vacante ideal, nos gustaría recibir igualmente tu currículum e incorporarte a nuestro pool de candidatos.

Nos encantará conocerte y contar contigo cuando surja la oportunidad perfecta.

Gracias por querer formar parte de Barceló.

The successful candidate will drive strategic customer engagements, develop new business opportunities, and expand Oracle's technology footprint by positioning integrated cloud, database, multicloud, and AI solutions that address customers' business and technology transformation priorities.

Territory & Account Management: Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans, identify whitespace opportunities, and drive new customer acquisition and existing account expansion.

Integrated Technology Selling: Position Oracle's cloud infrastructure, database platforms, Exadata, multicloud, AI, and modernization solutions to address enterprise business challenges.

Executive Engagement: Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and senior business leaders, translating technology capabilities into measurable business outcomes.

Pipeline & Revenue Growth: Own sales targets, generate qualified pipeline, drive competitive opportunities, and deliver predictable bookings, subscriptions, and cloud consumption growth.

Value-Based Selling: Develop compelling business cases, demonstrate ROI and TCO advantages, and lead complex enterprise sales cycles from qualification through negotiation and closure.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with solution engineers, cloud architects, consulting teams, customer success, and ecosystem partners to deliver integrated customer solutions.

Sales Excellence: Maintain accurate forecasts, execute disciplined opportunity management, and proactively manage deal risks, stakeholder alignment, and commercial execution.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of successful enterprise technology sales experience, preferably in cloud infrastructure, databases, enterprise software, or technology transformation.

Strong understanding of cloud computing, database technologies, multicloud architectures, and enterprise IT environments.

Proven track record of achieving sales targets, developing strategic accounts, and closing complex enterprise deals.

Strong executive engagement, consultative selling, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Experience developing account plans, managing sales pipelines, and navigating competitive sales cycles.

Familiarity with the Saudi enterprise technology market and its key industries.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience selling Oracle OCI, Oracle Database, Exadata, or competing hyperscaler and database technologies.

Understanding of enterprise cloud migration, database modernization, AI infrastructure, and consumption-based business models.

Established relationships with enterprise technology decision-makers in Saudi Arabia.

Achievement of assigned sales and revenue targets.

Growth in OCI and DBP bookings, subscriptions, and cloud consumption.

Qualified pipeline generation, conversion, and forecast accuracy.

Strategic account penetration, new customer acquisition, and competitive wins.

Expansion of executive relationships and customer technology adoption.

job_title: Business Development Manager- Processed Food, MENA
description:
**ABOUT SOLENIS**

  

**Solenis is a leading global producer of specialty chemicals focused on partnering with water-intensive operations to solve complex water treatment, process improvement and hygiene challenges with advanced chemical and equipment solutions for consumer, industrial, institutional, food & beverage, and recreational pool and spa water markets.**

**The product portfolio of Solenis includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, and cleaners and disinfectants, as well as state-of-the-art monitoring and control systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments.**

**Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over 23,000 professionals in 160 countries across six continents. Solenis has been recognized as a Best Managed Company for 4 consecutive years and was named as 2024 Best Managed Company Gold Standard Winner.**

  

**Position Name: Business Development Manager- Processed Food, MENA**

Business: F&B

Location - Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Account Management** – Management of existing accounts and organic growth.

**New Business Development** – Developing target prospects and making contact, developing opportunities, preparing & presenting proposals and winning new business.

**Responsible Care,**

**Environment, Health & Safety**

(In accordance with Ashland EHS and Responsible Care policies)

* To follow all EHS policies and procedures
* To follow all environmental policies and procedures
* To report all accidents, incidents and near misses to their supervisor
* Promote Responsible Care principles
* Participate in training as required
* Participate in consultation on all EH&S related matters
* Maintain hygiene at all times

**People**

(Outline the scope with which this position deals with people)

This position requires cooperation and planning with business management, commercial, technical, financial & administration, and equipment as well as account managers and service technicians in the field to ensure that the needs of the business and customers are consistently met.

The incumbent is expected to use his/her experience and industry knowledge to provide day to day leadership of the people working in Africa on commercial and technical functional areas.

**Communications**

(Expected communications that this role should undertake as part of the position)

* One on one inter-relationship and cooperation with all field staff.
* Minimum monthly reports, weekly telecons (Sales Meetings) as required with business managers
* Reports and documentation as required.

**Specific Accountabilities**

(An in depth description of the exact tasks and responsibilities of this position. This may be broken down under sub-headings)

* Identify and qualify new business opportunities across various segments of the Processed Food, including exploration, production, and development.

* Develop & maintain relationships with potential clients, partners, industry stakeholders, including Processed Food companies, service providers, government agencies.

* Conduct market research and analysis to identify emerging trends, opportunities, and challenges within the Processed Food  landscape.
* Prepare compelling proposals and presentations to showcase our company's capabilities and solutions, addressing specific needs and challenges faced by Processed Food  players.
* Negotiate and close contracts with new clients for the provision of Processed Food  services or solutions.
* Manage the sales cycle from lead generation to contract signing, ensuring effective communication and coordination with internal teams.
* Support the execution of Processed Food  projects by collaborating with internal teams (engineering, operations, etc.) and external stakeholders.
* Stay up-to-date on the latest developments & regulations in the Processed Food , incl. technological advancements, market fluctuations, & geopolitical factors.
* Travel as required to meet with clients, attend industry events, and participate in conferences.

* Managing existing accounts as allocated ensuring satisfaction and ongoing profitability by professional and effective account management processes and skills designed to deliver and exceed customer expectations and adding value

* Managing prospects effectively and making contacts within the allocated targets and markets.  Working with support groups to establish, maintain and prioritize an accurate and current prospect list.

* Providing professional on-site service work to customers incl. water analysis and testing as required, ensuring water treatment programs are controlled according to design parameters and that performance criteria is strictly monitored and achieved

* Working with other team members and resource groups as necessary to ensure that customer deliverables are met and maintained

  

**Person Specification**

(The specific and desirable criteria that the person holding this position ideally needs to fulfil e.g. skills, experience, qualifications etc)

* Undergraduate degree in engineering, food science, chemistry or any related sciences
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, ideally in B2B
* Proven track record of identifying and closing new business deals in the B2B environment. Strong understanding of Processed Food , value chain, key players, and market dynamics.
* Should have experience and understanding of Processed Food  industrial processes
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to travel as required.
* Experience working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Ideally bilingual with English and Arabic Proficiencies
* Must be fully computer literate, i.e. MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc

  

At Solenis, we understand that our greatest asset is our people. That is why we offer competitive compensation; comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance and a 401(k) plan; and numerous opportunities for professional growth and development. So, if you are interested in working for a world-class company and enjoy solving complex challenges, whether in the lab or in the field, consider joining our team.

Solenis is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

  

Not seeing a role that best fits your career goals? Introduce yourself to our Talent Acquisition team with a brief note on how you believe you can best apply your skills and bring value to Solenis.

  

Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state-of-the-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. **1\. ROLE DETAILS:**

**Position title: Interior Designer**

**Reports to: Lead Architect**

**Department: Technical Services**

**Function: Design & Engineering**

**2\. ROLE PURPOSE:**

The Interior Designer is responsible for reviewing, commenting on, and following up with external design consultants on interior design (ID) items across URED's residential apartment and hotel projects, reporting to the Lead Architect.

The role ensures ID packages are technically sound, brand-consistent, coordinated with architectural design, and delivered on programme — acting as URED's in-house point of technical judgment on ID matters across multiple concurrent residential and hospitality projects.

**3\. ROLE DIMENSIONS:**

**Working Conditions:**

80% Office based (URED working hours) / 20% Site visits on business needs

**No. of Staff Supervised:**

0 — technical review authority over external ID consultants and designers, no line reports

**4\. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Description**

**Interior Design Review & Coordination**

●       Review and comment on ID consultant submissions (concept, schematic, detailed design, and FF&E packages) for residential apartments and hotel projects.

●       Follow up with designers to close out comments and ensure revisions are incorporated on schedule.

●       Coordinate ID design integration with the architectural design led by the Lead Architect.

●       Check ID drawings and specifications for consistency with URED's brand and quality standards across projects.

●       Flag ID design decisions with cost, programme, or buildability implications before they progress further.

**Multi-Discipline & Multi-Project Coordination**

●       Coordinate ID scope with architectural, MEP, and joinery/fit-out packages to avoid clashes and gaps.

●       Track ID coordination status across multiple concurrent residential and hotel projects.

●       Support clash detection and design coordination reviews on ID-related items.

●       Manage RFI responses from site on ID matters, in coordination with the Lead Architect.

**Consultant & Documentation Management**

●       Direct and follow up with external ID consultants and designers on deliverables, revisions, and quality expectations.

●       Review consultant ID submissions for technical quality, completeness, and compliance with brief.

●       Maintain ID drawing and document registers within Procore.

**Tenant & Operational Coordination**

●       Review tenant and operator ID submissions (e.g. hotel operator fit-out standards) for compliance with URED's design guidelines.

●       Provide technical input on FF&E and fit-out specifications to ensure operational functionality.

**Additional Responsibilities**

●       Support design-stage feasibility input on ID scope, standards, and typical costs for new projects.

●       Execute other design-related tasks assigned by the Lead Architect.

**5\. FRAMEWORKS, BOUNDARIES, & DECISION-MAKING AUTHORITY:**

●       Reports directly to the Lead Architect.

●       Authority to review ID consultant submissions and issue technical comments.

●       Authority to reject ID submissions that do not meet URED design, brand, or compliance standards, subject to Lead Architect confirmation.

●       Escalates ID design issues, consultant non-compliance, and coordination risks to the Lead Architect.

●       Budget-impacting or brand-standard design changes require Lead Architect approval.

**6\. Performance measure:**

●       95% or more of ID review comments issued within agreed turnaround time.

●       90% or higher first-cycle approval rate for ID submissions before onward issue.

●       Zero brand or quality-standard non-compliance findings attributable to ID review.

●       Reduction in ID-related RFIs and change orders during construction and fit-out.

●       100% of ID drawing and document registers current in Procore

●       Construction Services

●       Commercial Manager and Cost Control

●       Leasing and Property Management

●       Interior design and FF&E consultants

●       Hotel operators and tenants

●       Contractors

**8\. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:**

●       Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or related field.

●       Minimum of 7 years' experience in interior design, including hands-on review and coordination of ID consultant packages for residential and/or hospitality projects.

●       International experience required.

●       Interior design review and technical judgment

●       Consultant coordination and follow-up

●       Multi-project, multi-discipline coordination

●       AutoCAD, Revit, and 3D visualisation tools

●       Procore drawing and document registers

* Develop and execute the KSA roads and highways market strategy, aligned with corporate goals.

* Drive annual business growth targets, market positioning initiatives, and competitive differentiation.
