## Overview

The **Electrician** is responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing electrical systems, equipment, and wiring in residential, commercial, and industrial environments. The role ensures all electrical systems operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable electrical codes, safety standards, and regulations.

## Your Role

As an Electrician, you will be responsible for carrying out reactive maintenance and Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) activities for LV/MV systems, low-current systems, and control panels. You will act as a first responder to electrical issues, work closely with supervisors on a daily basis, and ensure compliance with BEC standards and client contractual FMA & FMR requirements.

### Key Responsibilities

* Install, maintain, repair, and troubleshoot electrical systems, including wiring, lighting, power distribution, and control systems within commercial and industrial facilities.
* Perform regular inspections and preventive maintenance activities to identify potential issues and ensure optimal performance of electrical systems.
* Diagnose and rectify faults in electrical systems and equipment, including: Fire Alarm Control Panels (FACP) Building Management Systems (BMS) Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems Public Address and Voice Alarm (PAVA) systems Fan motors and pumps Control panels Lighting panels Distribution panels Circuit breakers Lighting fixtures
* Conduct routine cleaning, servicing, and maintenance of electrical components to ensure operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with maintenance teams to coordinate and prioritize work orders, ensuring timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Maintain accurate records of maintenance and repair activities, including equipment status, work performed, and materials used.
* Diagnose and repair system malfunctions requiring specialized technical knowledge and qualifications.
* Seek technical clarification and support when necessary and escalate issues appropriately.
* Stay informed of industry developments, emerging technologies, and best practices related to electrical systems.
* Ensure strict adherence to company safety procedures, regulations, and electrical standards.
* Provide guidance and support to junior technicians when required.
* Demonstrate working knowledge of building automation and control systems.
* Follow up with supervisors to ensure activities and events are closed within agreed timelines.
* Respond promptly to service requests and emergency callouts, minimizing downtime and operational disruptions.
* Assist in the installation, testing, and commissioning of new electrical systems and equipment.
* Ensure all work complies with relevant electrical codes, standards, and safety regulations.
* Perform any other duties assigned by management.

### Qualifications

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Technical Certification, ITI, or Diploma in Electrical Engineering preferred.
* Valid Electrician License/Certification (where required by local regulations).

* Strong knowledge of electrical systems, circuits, wiring, and safety procedures.

* Project Development Strategy and Feasibility: Assist the Client to manage the SME to produce the business case feasibility reports and assess the deliverables in terms of the SME framework, AlUla vision, the destination strategy, feasibility of the proposed development options considering benchmarking, demand, funding budgets and alternative third party investment options, etc.

* Team Coordination: Assist the Client Development Director, coordinate the PMC resources permitted to be deployed by the Client for the project and oversee the Consultants appointed by the Client such as SMEs, Lead Design Consultants (LDC), Cost Consultant (CC), etc.

* Budget Management: Ensuring the project budgets are established by the appointed Client Cost Consultant and assist with ensuring that the design is developed within the allocated financial constraints.

* Risk Assessment: Manage the risks and challenges throughout the project lifecycle and develop mitigation strategies to address them effectively.

  

* Stakeholder Communication: Assist the Client with Stakeholder management for clear and regular communication with key stakeholders, including client’s functions/management, regulatory authorities, and other relevant parties.

* Governance Compliance and Regulations: Assist the Client to comply with all D&C Governance policies and procedures such as Gateways, etc., ensure that the project adheres to all Client related governance, regulations, work instructions, safety standards, and legal requirements.

* Quality Assurance: Monitor and maintain high-quality standards throughout the project, ensuring that all deliverables meet established criteria.

* Progress Tracking and Reporting: Regularly track project progress, analyse performance metrics, and provide status reports to stakeholders, in conjunction with the Excellence Controls Reporting Team.

* Procurement: Assist the Client in producing the Procurement Strategies in accordance with approved Delivery Strategy. Produce TRFQ Tender enquiries for Consultancy Services and manage Consultants to produce Tender RFP Documents for Construction.

* Change Management: Manage the changes in project scope, schedule, or resources and ensure that any modifications are documented and communicated appropriately.

## About you

   

* Education: A bachelor’s degree in engineering/ urban planning, or a related field qualification is required. PMP in project management and MBA are advantageous.
* Experience: Project Management at pre-contract stage with overall 15+ years’ experience for Mixed-Use Asset types.

* Industry Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of various Asset types (Mixed-Use), including its regulations, best practices, emerging trends, business case & feasibility assessments, analytics and executive level reporting.

* Leadership Skills: Strong leadership abilities with the capability to motivate and manage a diverse team effectively.

* Project Management Expertise: Proficiency in project management methodologies, tools, and techniques, with a proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects.

* Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with various stakeholders, both technical and non-technical, producing executive level presentation reports and present project updates and proposals effectively.

* Time Management: Exceptional time management skills to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and unforeseen challenges, ensuring successful project completion.

* Safety Focus: A deep commitment to maintaining project safety standards and prioritizing safety in all aspects of the project.

* Values: Our values are the essence of our company’s identity. They represent how we act, speak and behave together, and how we engage with our clients and stakeholders. Selected candidates are required to commit to the AtkinsRéalis values of Safety, Integrity, Collaboration, Innovation and Excellence.

## Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Tax-free salary.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.
* Annual leave balance.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation & housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, familycare, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
* Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene.  
  
Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector.  
  
Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities.

**About LIONS Riyadh**

LIONS Riyadh marks a bold new chapter for the world’s most prestigious platform for creative marketing. Launched by Tahaluf in partnership with LIONS and Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Media, it is a distinct Festival within the global LIONS community, home to the renowned Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. Designed to amplify Middle Eastern creativity on the global stage, LIONS Riyadh will showcase the region’s talent, ideas and storytelling while connecting its creative industries with the world’s leading networks, brands and decision-makers. The inaugural three-day Festival takes place at KAFD, Riyadh, from 6–8 December 2027. It will bring together regional and global CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands and emerging talent around creative excellence, effectiveness, culture and the future of the industry.

## Job Description

The team is looking for a Senior Conference Producer who can demonstrate they have their finger on the pulse of a fast-paced and ever-changing industry.

The Senior Conference Producer will play a key role in shaping and delivering the content programme for LIONS Riyadh, developing original, relevant and culturally resonant sessions that reflect the conversations shaping creativity, marketing, media, technology and culture.

The successful candidate will be confident speaking to expert speakers from around the world and presenting the unique opportunity to showcase their knowledge and expertise at the Festival.

The role requires strong editorial judgement, curiosity and a deep understanding of the creative and marketing industries, combined with the organisational discipline needed to manage multiple sessions, speakers and programme deadlines.

Working closely with the Head of Content, the Senior Conference Producer will identify emerging themes, secure high-calibre speakers, develop compelling session formats and ensure every part of the programme delivers genuine value to the LIONS Riyadh audience.

With meticulous organisational skills, the successful candidate will be responsible for managing speakers and the order of show onsite at the Festival.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Conference Production**

* Produce high-level, relevant industry conference programmes.
    

* Research, develop and write compelling sessions across creativity, marketing, media, technology, culture and emerging industry trends.
    

* Liaise with key professionals, institutions and companies in the development of conference programmes.
    

* Engage with recommended speakers and confirm their attendance.
    

* Identify and secure high-quality global, Saudi and regional speakers who bring strong ideas, credibility and relevance to LIONS Riyadh.
    

* Ensure the speaker database is updated with accurate speaker information and status.
    

* Prepare and communicate creative briefs to the Marketing team.
    

* Develop detailed speaker briefs, session narratives and moderator guidance to ensure strong content quality.
    

* Assist in providing relevant leads and opportunities to the Commercial and Partnerships teams where appropriate.
    

* Mentor other conference producers within the team.
    

* Work closely with the Head of Content to maintain editorial quality, consistency and LIONS Riyadh standards across all programme stages.
    

* Conduct post-Festival analysis, including session performance, audience feedback and programme learning.
    

**Market Research and Industry Networks**

* Effectively research topics with relevant industry professionals and target audiences.
    

* Develop new programme ideas and content through meetings, interviews and industry research.
    

* Stay closely connected to developments across advertising, marketing, media, technology, entertainment, culture and the creator economy.
    

* Identify emerging ideas, talent and trends that can create fresh and distinctive programme opportunities for LIONS Riyadh.
    

* Identify key opinion leaders, organisations and companies relevant to the Festival.
    

* Maintain existing relationships and build new industry relationships to support programme development.
    

* Build and maintain a strong network across brands, agencies, media companies, creators, cultural organisations and creative leaders.
    

* Develop new content formats including masterclasses, debates, workshops, live case studies, creative demonstrations and other Festival experiences.
    

* Ensure a strong balance of global, Saudi and regional voices across the programme.
    

**Speaker & Delegate Liaison**

* Liaise and network with speakers, partners and delegates onsite to maintain strong service standards, resolve queries and gather feedback.
    

* Assist with onsite duties throughout the Festival, including extended working hours where required.
    

* Manage speaker preparation, briefing and onsite experience to ensure speakers are confident, well prepared and aligned with session objectives.
    

* Support stage delivery and order of show, working closely with production and operations teams.
    

* Build long-term relationships with priority speakers and industry contributors for future editions of LIONS Riyadh. 
    

## Qualifications

* Educated to degree level or equivalent
    

* Degree or professional background in media, marketing, communications, journalism, creative industries or a related field is advantageous.
    

* Relevant content or editorial experience may be considered in place of formal qualifications.
    

**Background Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

**Essential**

* Minimum five years of experience in conference production.
    

* Speaks and writes clearly and fluently in English to both individuals and groups.
    
* Arabic Speaker.
    

* Computer literate and proficient in the use of Microsoft Word and Excel.
    

* Commercial awareness.
    

* Research based role.
    

* Copywriting skills.
    

* Strong understanding of the creative, advertising, marketing, media and communications industries.
    

* Excellent editorial judgement and ability to identify compelling ideas, speakers and stories.
    

* Experience securing and managing senior or high-profile speakers.
    

* Ability to turn research and complex industry topics into engaging session concepts.
    

* Strong organisational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple speakers and deadlines simultaneously.
    

* Confident communicator with strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills.
    

* Curious, culturally aware and able to spot emerging trends and new voices.
    

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative Festival environment.
    

**Desirable**

* Experience within advertising, media, marketing, entertainment or the wider creative industries.
    

* Experience working on a major international Festival, conference, media platform or cultural event.
    

* Existing network across brands, agencies, creators, media or creative-industry leaders.
    

* Saudi Arabia or GCC market experience.
    

* Experience working with international speakers and senior industry figures.
    

## Additional Information

**Core Benefits:**

* Medical Insurance for individual and family
* Annual leave – 28 days
* Remote working on Sundays
* Working anywhere – 2 months every year
* School fees contribution, 40,000 SAR per child per year (up to a max of three children)
* Wellbeing Benefits
* Residency visa including yearly dependent fees
* Individual annual flight allowance for expats

* Paid flight to Riyadh – individual and family

* Up to SAR 2,500 reimbursement of shipping goods/excess baggage costs

\*If eligible

* Attend/participate in Tahalufs and industry relevant seminars, associations, events, conference and competitor events where appropriate
    
* Contribute market intelligence and client feedback to help shape future commercial products and Festival opportunities.

* Number of net, new logos and new subsidiaries of existing logos.

* Value and quality of strategic accounts secured.
    
* Revenue generated across new commercial products and bespoke opportunities.
    
* Strength of relationships with priority brands, agencies, media and creative-industry clients.

* Experience within media, advertising, marketing, creative industries, technology, major events or premium B2B platforms is highly desirable.

* Build positive relationships with internal colleagues, agencies, partners and external stakeholders.
    

* Work closely with Marketing, Content, PR, Creative and Commercial teams to support joined-up campaign delivery.
    

* Maintain strong consistency across LIONS Riyadh messaging, tone of voice and campaign assets.
    

* Support social media and community engagement activity before, during and after the Festival.
    

* Assist with onsite marketing activity and real-time content during LIONS Riyadh where required.

job_title: Local Talent and Community Programming Manager
description:
We are recruiting a Local Talent and Community Programming Manager to join a dedicated, full-time team embedded in our client’s Festival Programming function in Riyadh. The team will support two major events in Saudi Arabia: a flagship event in summer 2027 (July to August) and a further event in November 2027.

You will lead the festival’s local and regional programming, working alongside the international clubs and creators lead. You will bring in:

* Saudi and regional clubs
* Arabic-speaking creators
* Universities
* Grassroots and community tournaments
* Cultural and national moments

You will build this local content into the main programme rather than running it as a side show, so it feels like part of the festival from day one. You will also make sure all local content meets cultural and regulatory requirements.

This is a hands-on producing role. The grade reflects your seniority and judgement, not the size of a team you supervise. We are looking for a programmer who personally builds the local and regional programme.  

**Key Responsibilities**

Local and Regional Programming

* Lead local and regional programming, including Saudi and regional clubs, creators, grassroots and community competitions, Arabic-language and cultural moments, and local talent.
* Build a prioritised list of local content opportunities from national moments, the host-city calendar and community activity.

Programme Integration

* Integrate local content with the international programme rather than running it alongside.
* Work with the international clubs and creators lead so that local and international content feel like one festival.

Partner Coordination

* Coordinate day to day with Saudi and regional clubs, creators, universities, grassroots organisations and agencies.
* Maintain the local partner log so every relationship and commitment is tracked.

Cultural and Regulatory Compliance

* Make sure all local content meets cultural and regulatory requirements.
* Flag and resolve compliance issues early in the planning process.

Audience Insight

* Capture local audience response to inform the programme across both events.

**Requirements**

* At least 8 years of experience in gaming, esports, entertainment or major live events in Saudi Arabia or the region, at Senior Manager level.
* Experience across at least two live event seasons.
* A proven record of personally producing local and regional programming. Only experience where you personally produced the work counts towards the requirement.

**Ideal Background**

* An entertainment, community or live events programmer with strong, existing contacts across Saudi and regional clubs, creators and grassroots communities.
* Established relationships with Saudi and regional clubs, creators, communities and grassroots organisations are a strong advantage.

**Languages**

* Fluent Arabic and English are required.

**Working Conditions**

* Full-time and exclusive: you will be dedicated to the client for the full contract term, with no other clients or projects.
* Working options: work remotely on Riyadh hours (Sunday to Thursday), with travel to Riyadh and event locations as directed, or be based at the client’s office in Riyadh.
* On site in Riyadh: you must be in Riyadh for the full operating periods of the summer 2027 event (July to August) and the November 2027 event, whichever working option you choose.

**Benefits**

* A competitive package for the duration of a 14-month contract, with the potential to extend by up to 3 months
* Flexible working, with a remote option during the planning phase
* A senior, hands-on role in a dedicated specialist team embedded with a major client
* Valuable experience on one of the region’s most high-profile live events programmes

job_title: Senior Security Engineer (NCA, DLP, Network Security)
description:
Senior Security Architect (NCA, DLP, Network Security)

Location: Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia (KSA)
Experience: 5+ years in Cybersecurity

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Architect to design, implement, and govern enterprise security architectures, with strong expertise in NCA compliance, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and Network Security. The role involves developing security frameworks, conducting architecture reviews, and ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and enterprise security standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and review enterprise security architectures aligned with NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) and other applicable regulatory frameworks.

• Architect and oversee network security solutions, including firewalls, WAF, VPN, network segmentation, Zero Trust, and intrusion prevention systems.

• Design and implement DLP strategies to protect sensitive information across endpoints, networks, email, and cloud environments.

• Conduct security architecture reviews, threat modelling, risk assessments, and security gap analyses.

• Define security policies, technical standards, and reference architectures aligned with business and compliance requirements.

• Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application security, and SOC teams to integrate security controls into enterprise environments.

• Evaluate security technologies, lead proof-of-concept exercises, and provide technical guidance on solution implementation.

• Support security audits, compliance assessments, remediation activities, and risk reporting.

Required Skills and Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with significant experience in enterprise security architecture.

• Strong knowledge of NCA ECC requirements and experience implementing or assessing cybersecurity controls.

• Hands-on experience or architecture-level expertise in DLP solutions such as Digital Guardian, Forcepoint, Symantec, or Microsoft Purview.

• Strong understanding of network security technologies, including firewalls, WAF, IDS/IPS, VPN, and network segmentation.

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture, IAM, vulnerability management, SIEM, and incident response.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or vendor-specific security certifications are preferred.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.

Preferred: Experience working in regulated enterprise environments in Saudi Arabia, with knowledge of applicable NCA cybersecurity requirements.

Position Objective:
The objective of the Cluster Manager role is to oversee the operations and financial performance of a smaller group of retail stores for a particular brand within a designated area in a country. This includes driving sales growth, ensuring exceptional customer service, managing and developing store teams, and maintaining compliance with company standards. The role requires market analysis, financial oversight, and effective communication with the Area Sales Manager and brand teams to optimize store performance, manage inventory, and execute promotional and marketing campaigns in stores to achieve business objectives.
Key Responsibility:
Operations Management
Oversee the daily operations of a smaller group of retail stores within a designated area for a specific brand, ensuring smooth and efficient functioning.
Audit store operations and facilities regularly to ensure compliance with company standards, policies, and procedures, focusing on productivity, efficiency, safety, and security.
Direct the opening of new stores within the cluster by coordinating resources such as staff, merchandise, and logistics; manage the closing of existing stores as necessary.
Adhere to and enforce Company SOPs, policies, procedures, and loss prevention audit guidelines in all assigned stores. Implement corrective actions to address any non-compliance issues.
Oversee the implementation and consistent execution of Visual Merchandising guidelines across all stores in the cluster.

Sales & Financial Management
Monitor and analyze sales performance by comparing actual sales against weekly targets, previous year’s performance, and projections. Take corrective actions in coordination with other departments.
Set sales targets for stores within the cluster to maximize profitability, taking into account market conditions and store-specific factors.
Review and monitor stock level reports, coordinating with the brand team to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained.
Monitor inventory movement and take necessary actions to minimize shrinkage and optimize stock turnover.

Customer Experience
Ensure exceptional customer service across all stores by coaching store teams and setting high service standards.
Maintain and enhance the standards of customer service within the cluster, regularly assessing and improving the customer experience.
Address customer inquiries and concerns promptly, striving to exceed customer expectations.

Team Management & Development
Recruit, train, and develop staff on sales techniques, customer service, teamwork, and brand-specific requirements.
Evaluate the performance of store employees annually, promoting open communication through regular coaching and motivation.
Schedule and conduct regular staff meetings to communicate goals, performance expectations, and provide constructive feedback.
Monitor and manage staff scheduling and leave approvals for store managers, ensuring adequate coverage and efficient operation.

Market Analysis & Strategy
Utilize market insights to identify opportunities for growth and adapt store strategies accordingly within the cluster.
Stay informed about market trends, consumer behavior, and competitor activities specific to the assigned brand and area.

Communication & Reporting
Communicate business drivers, merchandise issues, and other relevant information to the Area Sales Manager, Retail Operations Manager, and other key stakeholders.
Prepare and present regular reports on store performance, including successes, challenges, and recommendations for improvement.

Desired Experience:
The ideal candidate should have 4-5 years of experience in retail management, with at least 2-3 years in a multi-store management role, such as multi-unit store manager. Proven track record of successfully overseeing multiple retail stores, particularly in the fashion or related industries.

“Apparel Group is a global fashion and lifestyle retail conglomerate residing at the crossroads of the modern economy – Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Today, the Apparel Group caters to thousands of eager shoppers through its more than 1750+ stores and 75+ brands across all platforms employing 17,000 multicultural staff covering four continents.

Apparel group has carved its strong presence not only in the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and Saudi Arabia but opened thriving gateways to market in India, South Africa, Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand and Malaysia. Additionally, clear strategies are in place to enter emerging markets such as Hungary, Pakistan, Egypt and Philippines. Also, Apparel Group provides customers the experience of shopping from the comfort of their own home with ease and convenience via our E-Commerce site 6thStreet.com

Apparel Group Operates Brands from around the world, originating from USA, Canada, Europe, Australia, Asia and include leading names in Fashion, Footwear & Lifestyle such as Tommy Hilfiger, Charles & Keith, Skechers, Aldo, Nine West, Aeropostale, Jamie’s Italian to name a few and other key brands include Tim Hortons, Cold Stone Creamery, Inglot, Rituals etc..

The Apparel Group owes its amazing growth to the vision and guidance of its dynamic Chairman, Nilesh Ved, who has taken the company from strength to strength since its inception in the last two decades.”

### **Job Description**

**Overview**

## AtkinsRéalis is looking for a Risk Manager, in Riyadh, KSA.

## The Risk Manager will be responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining effective project risk management processes across major roads, highways, bridges, and associated infrastructure projects. Working within a PMC environment, the role will support project delivery teams and clients in identifying, assessing, mitigating, and monitoring risks throughout the project lifecycle to ensure successful delivery of program objectives related to cost, schedule, quality, safety, and stakeholder requirements.

**Your role**

## **Risk Management**

* ## Develop and implement project risk management frameworks, methodologies, and procedures in line with international best practices.
    
* ## Lead risk identification workshops with project stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and client representatives.
    
* ## Establish and maintain project and program risk registers.
    
* ## Conduct qualitative and quantitative risk assessments for infrastructure projects.
    
* ## Evaluate project risks related to design, construction, procurement, permitting, utilities, traffic management, environmental constraints, and stakeholder interfaces.
    
* ## Develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans to reduce project exposure.
    
* ## Monitor emerging risks and opportunities and recommend proactive actions.
    

## **Quantitative Risk Analysis & Monte Carlo Simulation**

* ## Lead quantitative risk assessments (QRA) for major infrastructure projects.
    
* ## Develop and maintain risk-adjusted schedules and cost models.
    
* ## Perform Monte Carlo simulations to assess schedule and cost uncertainty.
    
* ## Analyze confidence levels (P50, P80, P90) for project completion dates and budget forecasts.
    
* ## Identify critical risk drivers affecting project outcomes and provide recommendations to reduce exposure.
    
* ## Support contingency planning through probabilistic forecasting and scenario analysis.
    
* ## Produce Schedule Risk Analysis (SRA) and Cost Risk Analysis (CRA) reports for executive management and clients.
    
* ## Interpret simulation outputs and communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    

## **Project Controls & Reporting**

* ## Integrate risk management activities with project controls, planning, scheduling, and cost management functions.
    
* ## Support schedule risk analysis and cost risk assessments.
    
* ## Prepare risk dashboards, reports, and presentations for project leadership and client teams.
    
* ## Provide regular updates on key project risks, trends, and mitigation effectiveness.
    
* ## Track risk action owners and ensure timely closure of mitigation measures.
    

## **Stakeholder Management**

* ## Facilitate risk review meetings with project teams and external stakeholders.
    
* ## Engage with client representatives to ensure risk management objectives are achieved.
    
* ## Coordinate with engineering, commercial, construction, HSE, and contract management teams to assess project risks comprehensively.
    
* ## Support senior management in strategic decision-making through risk-based analysis.
    

## **Governance & Compliance**

* ## Ensure compliance with client requirements, project governance frameworks, and contractual obligations.
    
* ## Promote a risk-aware culture across the project organization.
    
* ## Participate in project audits and assurance reviews.
    
* ## Contribute to lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives.
    

**About you**

* ## Minimum 20 years of experience in project controls, risk management, or project management.
    
* ## At least 10 years of experience in a dedicated risk management role.
    
* ## Proven experience working within a PMC or engineering consultancy environment.
    
* ## Demonstrated experience on **large-scale roads, highways, bridges, and transportation infrastructure projects.**
    
* ## Proven experience conducting Monte Carlo simulations and quantitative risk assessments on major capital projects.
    
* ## Experience supporting government authorities, transport agencies, and large-scale infrastructure programs in the Middle East is highly desirable.
    
* ## Strong understanding of: Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA), Monte Carlo Simulation, Schedule Risk Analysis (SRA), Cost Risk Analysis (CRA), Confidence Level Forecasting (P50/P80/P90), Earned Value Management (EVM)
    

**Rewards & benefits**

## Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

## This includes:

* ## Tax-free salary.
    
* ## Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
    
* ## Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
    
* ## Generous annual leave balance.
    
* ## Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
    
* ## Remote work opportunities outside of country.
    
* ## Company gratuity scheme.
    
* ## Discretionary bonus program.
    
* ## Annual flight contribution.
    
* ## Relocation assistance.
    
* ## Transportation & housing allowances (available for remote work locations).
    
* ## Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
    

## Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

## Overview

The PMC Design Manager shall be project based in AlUla KSA, assigned to support and assist the PMC Senior Project Managers to oversee the Client appointed Lead Design Consultants (LDC) on various development projects (RIBA Stages 1 – 4), in accordance with the PMC Development Framework scope of services. ## Your role

* Tender for LDC / Consultancy Services: Produce scope of works services for tender documentation considering the Clients existing Framework Agreements with various Consultants and the Project Brief to be developed by the appointed LDC.

* Oversight of Design and Approval Phase: DM shall oversee the Client appointed LDC activities and coordinate the designs for various stages and elements of each Project to align with the project objectives (brief), monitor the status of design progress & LDC deliverables, Client approvals and statutory approvals/permits.

* Design Review: PMC Services exclude all technical review obligations (no PI cover for technical reviews), technical reviews shall be undertaken by the LDA appointed separately by the Client. DM shall manage, document, co-ordinate, stage design reviews and audit the designs for compliance with the design briefs, risk and value analyses, and production of deliverables in accordance with the design brief, Quality Management Plan and HSE Plans and in accordance with procedures agreed with Client. Manage the Stakeholder design review and reporting process. Compile the Stage Gateway report at the end of each RIBA Stage.

* Change Management: DM shall review design documents to ensure that they are in general accordance with the versions of those documents previously approved by Client and do not contain unauthorized changes that may impact on each Projects’ time and cost. Any changes instructed by the Client shall be administered by the Client appointed Cost Consultant, register of design changes to maintained and agreed between Client and LDC. DM shall evaluate the necessity and feasibility of all potential design changes and compile / review the impact ofAtkinsRéalis - Baseline / Référence design changes in terms of time, cost, and quality, and make a recommendation for Client’s consideration.

* Cost Management / Cost Estimate Review: LDC obligations include Cost Management to design to approved budget. DM shall assist PMC to ensure that the LDC Cost Manager assist, cooperate, meet and review with Client, PMC, Cost consultant and other parties to participate in any cost estimates, value engineering studies or constructability studies, so as to aid in construction direction, analysis and overall economies in the Works.

* Design Coordination: DM shall assist PMC to manage the design processes in accordance with procedures agreed with Client. PMC shall control the planning and scheduling of the design processes and forecast the dates by which design deliverables shall be required. DM shall review and monitor design progress and any independent checking and inform Client on the issues, so the approvals are facilitated, and the overall process is expedited.

* Value Management & Value Engineering: DM shall oversee the LDC obligation to comply with the Value Management requirements and where instructed, to implement the Value Engineering exercise in collaboration with the Client’s Cost Consultant.

* Design Workshops & Progress Meetings: DM shall coordinate with the client and LDC to establish routine design workshops and progress meetings. Minutes of Meetings shall be produced in accordance with PMC obligations.

* Completeness of Scope of Work for RFP Bidding: DM shall assist PMC to ensure that Scope of work for RFP are 100% complete before bidding. PMC shall ensure that LDC prepare, from the approved Project Brief, the Drawings, Specifications, finish schedules, product/equipment descriptions and other construction information (i.e., the “Contract Documents”) to form a robust scope of work.

This report shall include the activities of all Sub-consultants of the Consultant, irrespective of any contractual relationship between them. * Design Risk Assessment: Collaborate with the LDC to identify, list, monitor and eliminate all design risks through the various design stages.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

  

AtkinsRealis is looking for an experienced **Risk Engineer** (ideally Saudi National), who will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating operational, technical, safety, and business risks across projects and assets.

  

The role involves conducting risk assessments, recommending preventive measures, and supporting the organization in achieving safe, compliant, and reliable operations.

  

## Your role

* Conduct comprehensive risk assessments across infrastructure projects, assets, facilities, and operations to identify potential threats and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identify, assess, and evaluate strategic, technical, operational, commercial, safety, schedule, and cost-related risks that may impact project delivery and performance.
* Facilitate risk identification workshops and stakeholder sessions to proactively capture project risks, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies.
* Perform qualitative and quantitative risk analyses utilizing recognized methodologies, including HAZOP, FMEA, Bow-Tie Analysis, Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA), sensitivity analysis, and Monte Carlo simulations.
* Develop, maintain, and regularly update project risk registers, ensuring risks are appropriately categorized, assigned, monitored, and closed.
* Establish risk mitigation, contingency, and response plans to reduce project exposure and improve delivery certainty.
* Evaluate engineering designs, construction methodologies, and operational processes to ensure risk management principles are embedded during planning and execution stages.
* Monitor and assess risks associated with design development, procurement, supply chain management, construction activities, stakeholder interfaces, regulatory approvals, and operational readiness.
* Analyze incident investigations, audit findings, near misses, and failure reports to identify root causes, lessons learned, and preventive actions.
* Support project controls and planning teams by assessing the impact of risks on project schedules, budgets, resources, and key milestones.
* Review compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, client specifications, and corporate risk management frameworks.
* Participate in design reviews, constructability reviews, value engineering workshops, and project stage-gate reviews to provide risk-based insights and recommendations.
* Prepare and present risk dashboards, heat maps, trend analyses, and executive risk reports to project leadership, clients, and governance committees.
* Support insurance risk assessments and coordinate with insurers, contractors, consultants, auditors, and regulatory authorities on risk-related matters.
* Assess contractor and consultant risk management practices to ensure alignment with project objectives and contractual requirements.
* Provide recommendations to enhance asset integrity, operational reliability, process safety, business continuity, and project resilience.
* Monitor emerging project risks, market conditions, regulatory changes, and industry best practices to strengthen risk management effectiveness.
* Establish Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and performance metrics to measure risk exposure and mitigation effectiveness.
* Support change management processes by evaluating the potential risk and opportunity impacts of project changes and variations.
* Promote a proactive risk management culture by providing guidance, training, and risk awareness sessions across project teams and stakeholders

  

## About you

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related disciplie
* With at least 5 years of experience in Risk Management and has been involved in the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of project-specific Risk Management Frameworks
* Establish and maintain comprehensive risk registers, ensuring all strategic, technical, commercial, operational, schedule, and stakeholder risks are effectively identified, assessed, monitored, and mitigated.
* Facilitate risk identification workshops, brainstorming sessions, and stakeholder engagement meetings to proactively capture emerging threats and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Conduct qualitative and quantitative risk assessments, including probability-impact analysis, risk scoring, scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and Monte Carlo simulations.
* Develop risk mitigation, avoidance, transfer, acceptance, and contingency strategies to minimize project exposure and enhance project delivery certainty.

We are seeking a Static Mechanical Engineer to join Jafurah Gas Plant Engineering Division (JGPED) within Jafurah Gas Plant Department (JGPD).

Jafurah Gas Plant Department is responsible for Processing Feed gas and producing Sales Gas, Condensate, and C2+NGL.

Your primary role is to Handle static and piping activities such as studies and design modification in the operating facilities.

## Overview

Engineering Services are seeking a Greenhouse Gas Management and Decarbonization Specialist to join the GHG Emissions Management Division (GEMD) of Green Energy and Environmental Policy Department.

The GEMD is responsible for providing the Corporate GHG emissions inventory with the aim to account, report and track accurately GHG emissions from Company’s operations, supporting Company’s sustainability reporting to internal and external stakeholders and is use to inform public reporting, aid participation in mandatory and voluntary GHG programs.  GEMD is responsible in leading Company’s decarbonization efforts in achieving GHG reduction targets, Company’s ambition to reduce GHG emissions from our operations, and achieve a net zero GHG emissions footprint by 2050 across our wholly-owned operated assets.

The Greenhouse Gas Management and Decarbonization Specialist will provide consultations to support Company strategies and policies in Greenhouse Gas (GHG) and Climate related aspects. Candidate shall oversee the development and implementation of the Corporate GHG protocol, and lead new technologies or research initiatives in the field of GHG reduction and challenges related to climate changes aspects. Engineer will also be supporting facility operations, assessing new environmental technologies for Saudi Aramco applications, updating Saudi Aramco engineering standards and procedures, leading environmental audits, reviewing project designs. Furthermore, the candidate will be working on the corporate Methane Program to drive company methane performance. In addition, work on Product Carbon Footprint assessment for company products and support related activities.

## Key Responsibilities

Provide high level consultations to support Company strategies and policies in Greenhouse Gas (GHG) management and Decarbonization.

Oversee the development and implementation of the Corporate GHG protocol, and lead new technologies or research initiatives in the field of GHG emissions reduction, including methane.

Support the professional development of young Saudi engineers in areas related to environmental assessment, management, and technologies.

Develop business goals and identify GHG reduction opportunities,

Evaluate climate change GHGs emissions pathways and energy outlooks.

Perform research tasks of significant technical complexity, as well as developing and implementing innovative and creative technical solutions.

Interact with government and international entities pertaining to climate change reporting mechanisms.

Support facility operations in GHG minimization efforts.

Assess and deploy new GHG emissions mitigation technologies for Saudi Aramco operations.

Update Saudi Aramco engineering standards and procedures, leading environmental audits.

Review project designs and decarbonization impact assessments studies and roadmaps.

## Minimum Requirements

As the successful candidate you will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, or degree in Environmental Science, from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.

15+ years of experience in GHG management including at least 5 years in GHG accounting, reporting, and assurance engagements in the Energy sector, preferable in the Oil and Gas Industry.

The knowledge and expertise of the following are required:

World Resources Institute (WRI) GHG Gas Protocol (accounting and reporting standard)

ISO 14064-1

IPIECA/API/OGP Petroleum industry guidelines for reporting greenhouse gas emissions

Participation in mandatory or voluntary GHG reporting programs (i.e. EU ETS, US EPA GHGRP, CDP).

Proven experience in establishing and managing GHG emissions management programs at a corporate level, and support reporting requirements related to Climate Change and GHG emissions for Corporate Sustainability reports.

Excellent English communication skills to produce technically-sound reports and presentations.

Experience in Saudi Arabia is highly desirable.

Fundamentals of Engineering, Professional Engineering, Chartered Engineer, or equivalent certification is highly desirable.

Participation in International or National committees related to GHG and Climate Change (i.e.: IPCC, UNFCC) and relevant publications is desirable.

The Director, Parking is the asset owner and accountable business lead for all municipal parking assets across Qiddiya. The role establishes the commercial and operating model, governance and performance framework to secure sustainable commercial returns while ensuring parking assets are safe, well maintained, customer-focused and operationally ready for business-as-usual and major-event demand. The position leads parking operator procurement and oversight, revenue and yield optimisation, lifecycle planning, asset assurance and stakeholder integration. It requires a strategic and commercially astute parking leader with substantial operating experience in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the ability to build and lead a high-performing team.

Key Responsabilities

Asset Ownership and Strategy

• Act as the accountable asset owner for Qiddiya municipal parking, including applicable on-street, off-street, structured, surface, remote, park-and-ride and shared parking assets.

• Develop and implement the city-wide parking strategy, operating model, governance framework, service standards and investment priorities aligned with Qiddiya’s growth and visitor proposition.

• Assess and recommend the optimal delivery model for the parking portfolio, including in-house operations, commercial partnerships with proven operators and future design, develop, build and operate arrangements.

• Maintain clear ownership, operating and commercial boundaries between City Asset Management, Transportation Operations, O&M, districts, venues, developers and contracted parking operators.

• Provide strategic advice and concise executive reporting on portfolio performance, risks, commercial opportunities, investment requirements and key decisions.

Commercial Performance and Revenue Optimisation

• Own the parking business plan, revenue strategy, pricing principles, demand assumptions, budgets, forecasts and approved commercial targets.

• Optimise sustainable returns through appropriate tariff structures, yield management, permits, subscriptions, validations, event pricing, partnerships and ancillary revenue opportunities.

• Evaluate and recommend management, concession, revenue-share and hybrid operating models, protecting revenue integrity and whole-life asset value.

• Monitor income, operating costs, leakage, utilisation, margin and return on investment, and lead corrective action where performance is below plan.

• Work with Finance & Controls, Legal and Procurement to establish transparent commercial controls, audit requirements, contractual protections and reporting.

Operator Procurement and Performance

• Lead the definition of operator requirements, procurement scopes, evaluation criteria, mobilisation plans and performance specifications for parking operations and associated services.

• Manage senior relationships with parking operators and commercial partners, ensuring clear accountability for safety, service, revenue, compliance and continuous improvement.

• Set and govern contractual KPIs, service levels, incentives, deductions, audit rights and escalation arrangements.

• Ensure operators maintain capable leadership, trained resources, robust operating procedures and effective Saudi workforce development plans.

Asset Lifecycle, Maintenance and Assurance

• Set asset standards and lifecycle plans covering condition, availability, maintenance, cleanliness, lighting, signage, equipment, systems, accessibility and customer facilities.

• Assure operability, maintainability and commercial functionality through design reviews, stage gates, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance.

• Coordinate with O&M and specialist service functions to ensure maintenance delivery meets approved standards, while retaining asset-owner oversight rather than day-to-day contractor management.

• Prioritise renewals and capital investment using asset condition, operational risk, customer impact, revenue potential and whole-life cost.

• Strong understanding of traditional trade, distributors and the supplier-to-retailer value chain .

• Strong Arabic and English communication skills.

• Qualified pipeline generated

• Partner meetings held

• Qualified opportunities progressed

• Signed partnerships

• Expected and activated GMV from signed partners

• Sales-cycle duration

• Pipeline-to-close conversion rate

### **Job Summary**

The Branch Manager at Luca Park is responsible for overseeing daily operations, ensuring excellent customer service, maintaining brand standards, and leading the branch team to deliver a fun, safe, and engaging experience for all visitors — both humans and their furry friends. A genuine love for dogs and comfort around them is essential for this role.

* Ensure compliance with company policies, health, and safety regulations.

* 2-4 years experience in a retail environment (eg. pet-store, veterinarian practice etc).
* Relevant diploma in management.
* Knowledge of pet safety, dog behavior, or dog park operations.
* Familiarity with POS systems, inventory management tools, or operations software.
* Passionate about pets, especially dogs.
* Energetic, proactive, and hands-on.
* Responsible and dependable.
* Team player with a service-oriented mindset.

### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership, communication, and people management skills.
* Fluent in **English and Arabic** (spoken and written).
* Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities with a customer-first attitude.
* Able to multitask, prioritize, and remain calm in fast-paced environments.
* Skilled in managing schedules, budgets, inventory, and vendor relations.
* Passionate about guest satisfaction and enhancing the overall **pet and family experience**.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

**Benefits**

At LucaLand, we believe in creating more than just a workplace — we offer a purpose-driven, pet-loving environment where passion meets opportunity. Our team members enjoy a range of benefits designed to support their lifestyle, growth, and well-being.

You will write, review, and help develop proposals for projects big and small, in multiple states, using word, excel, and Ajera accounting/PM software; while also managing client expectations, project staffing, budgets, schedule of deliverables, and assisting accounting prepare invoices for principal review.

This role will be responsible managing projects across Riyadh region of Saudi Arabia

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and direct engineering activities, managing the overall framework of projects on behalf of Jensen Hughes, overseeing multiple scopes of work while developing and monitoring project execution plans, ensuring overall financial management
* Prepare and present technical reports and presentations, managing all contractual discussions with the client.
* Be a key player in technical decision making and business development activities. 
* Arrange and chair regular scheduled internal coordination meetings across multiple scopes of work ensuring smooth coordination between the key stakeholders from the client’s side, and the Jensen Hughes internal staff.
* Maintain and control risk register, recording, monitoring and communication on the project’s risks

 **Requirements and Qualifications**

* 7-9 years of relevant experience managing complex projects related to Fire & Life Safety, preferably within KSA.
* Postgraduate qualification in Architecture, Mechanical Engineering or other related subjects
* Strong task management and project management skills and experienced in developing project estimates proposals
* Broad knowledge of building codes, fire codes, or accessibility regulations along with a deep knowledge of Architectural, Engineering, Construction & Design process

* Excellent communication and training skills and ability to work collaboratively with consultants, fellow QA managers and other stakeholders along with strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.

Job Description

The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program

Voyage: Training tomorrow’s leaders today

Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. Our global leadership development program, Voyage, propels participants on a mentored, learning-inspired journey to prepare you for a successful career. Voyage is a full-time, paid development program. As an associate and trainee, you’ll build upon the skills you developed in school by participating in real world assignments.

Ready to embark?

To become a Voyage participant, you must have graduated with a degree from a university or hotel school within the last 2 years ie. on or after March 2025. If you are currently enrolled in a college/university with an expected graduation date within 12 months of the date of application may also be considered.

Other qualifications/requirements include:

Bachelors or Masters degree required (Associates degree acceptable for Culinary). Your application confirms you meet the above degree requirement.

Superior critical-thinking & interpersonal communication skills

The ability to foster relationships & work collaboratively

The ability to self-manage & be a self-starter

A real desire for personal & professional growth

Fluency in local language may be required

All candidates need to have the right to work in the country to which they are applying for with the exception of the United Arab Emirates (work visa provided)

About the journey

Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in 50+ countries.

Voyage is a leadership development programme, but we do expect you to show you are ready to take on those added responsibilities. Proactivity, open communication and teamwork are all crucial in performing and showcasing you are ready for your next step.

When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Each individual’s Voyage journey is unique, spanning 12-18 months dependent upon your career interests, passions, goals, and location. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.

The experience you’ll gain

Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:

Cultivate customer relationships

Be a champion for innovation within the organization

Get exposure to managing projects & people

Improve processes & pitch new initiatives through your Voyage project

Take on special projects that will draw upon all your training

Destination: Marriott leadership

You’ll participate in management meetings and collaborate with Voyage participants worldwide. You’ll be expected to solve challenges, as well as offer ideas and innovative solutions. You will also have an opportunity to provide feedback on your curriculum and have an impact on future Voyage hires’ experiences. After graduation, you’ll be well-prepared to pursue your passion and take on new challenges. Many program graduates are ready to step into a Marriott supervisory or entry-level management role right away, because the program has provided a foundation for future leadership.

Application Process

Online Application (closes 1st December)

Paradox Video Interview

Management Assessment

Recruiter Screen

Final Interview with hotel

Marriott Associates

Previous Interns at Marriott, Current Interns, Part Time Associates, Dual students are encouraged to apply provided they meet the above-mentioned criteria. If you are currently a full-time associate at Marriott International, please speak to your HR Team or email voyageemea@marriott.com

Want to learn more? Visit Early Careers at Marriott International | Find Job & Career Opportunities

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

#LI-Onsite

Marriott International is the world’s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

## Company Description

***Statistics show that women and underrepresented groups tend to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Sobi encourages you to change that statistic and apply. Rarely do candidates meet 100% of the qualifications. We look forward to your application!***

At Sobi, each person brings their unique talents to work as a team and make a difference. We are dedicated to developing and delivering innovative therapies to improve the lives of people who live with a rare disease. Our edge comes from our team of people and our commitment to patients.

Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

* Competitive compensation for your work
* Emphasis on work/life balance
* Collaborative and team-oriented environment
* Opportunities for professional growth
* Diversity and Inclusion
* Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

## Job Description

The Key Account Manager is accountable for the assigned product portfolio within their territory and is responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with key opinion leaders, physicians, and other healthcare professionals. The role focuses on driving patient identification, supporting reimbursement processes, and ensuring patients have timely access to treatment. In addition, the Key Account Manager works closely with medical and allied healthcare professionals to promote the optimal use of Sobi's therapies, providing ongoing scientific and product support while contributing to the achievement of sales objectives and improved patient outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Communicate to HCPs Disease state knowledge and awareness
* Act as credible field-based reference in order to effectively introduce and build product and disease awareness
* Key Account Manager (KAM) will partner with and ensure the long-term success of customers.
* KAM will be responsible for developing long-term relationships with a portfolio of assigned customers/accounts including Physicians & Payors, connecting with key business executives and stakeholders.
* Assists in the identification and resolution of issues and opportunities, and communicates proactively to sales and marketing management
* KAM should be focused on a customer centricity approach, being able to deliver the best value proposition for each customer and be able to identify key business questions and define priorities from each account, through the development of account plans.
* KAM should be able to design and implement specific projects at account level and interact with hospital Pharmacies, purchasing departments and management boards.
* Analyse performance for all products in the portfolio, identify growth opportunities and provide solutions to management to face all challenges
* Provide, update, and analyse data related to Sobi portfolio in all accounts at area level such as monthly consumption, forecasted orders, phasing of orders, stocks, etc
* Assure that Sobi products are used in the most effective and efficacious manner
* Liaise with cross functions to develop tactical plans for scaling up products’ access and ensure products’ availability
* Liaise with HCPs in order to conduct scientific exchange and support earlier patient identification
* Provide support for evidence-based treatment protocols and pathways
* Identify customers and manage sales promotion of assigned registered products to the target doctors to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual targets in line with company strategy
* Conduct regular visits and participate in symposiums, congresses, and meetings in order to increase market presence for the company products
* Carry out business related actions in line with the industry code of ethics and in compliance with company policies and procedures
* Develop weekly and monthly visit plans in consultation with the line manager and in compliance with internal sales systems and procedures
* Maintain and update product and competition knowledge to represent Sobi as the leader in rare disease area • Implement ongoing targeting and profiling of customers
* Liaise with key opinion leaders, get market feedback, and report any relevant information to line manager in line with company procedures and best practice
* Proper reporting and monitoring competition activities & market dynamics
* Enrich continuous collaboration & alignment with Cross-functions in all activities
* Proper planning & time management and high sense of urgency & fast execution of the assigned tasks in our daily work.
* Making decisions in the proper time and taking the lead in initiating the efficient action Plans whenever needed.
* Caring about patients and working together to make Sobi a global leader in getting transformational treatments to people with rare disease and improving their quality of life and saving their lives whenever possible.

## Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in a medical field (Pharmacy, Medicine)
* 2–5 years of sales experience within the assigned territory, ideally in the pharmaceutical industry; experience in other healthcare sectors will also be considered.
* Experience in rare diseases field, Hematology, Nephrology, Oncology preferred.
* Microsoft office (Excel, PowerPoint & Word…etc.)
* Ability to Manage diversified portfolio and business complexity.
* Proven track record of achievements & demonstrated ability to consistently meet and exceed sales Budget.
* Knowledge of the local health systems and decision-making processes
* Personal Attributes Demonstration of Sobi values (Care, Ownership, Urgency, Partnership, Ambition)
* Languages Fluency in written and spoken English & Arabic

## Additional Information

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

**Why Join Us?**  
  
We are a global company with over 1,700 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.  
  
We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.  
  
**Sobi Culture**  
  
At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.  
  
As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

**An Equal Opportunity Employer**  
  
Sobi is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at Sobi are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veterans and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status or protected groups by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

Job Description

Senior Consultant, Program Management - AI Infrastructure Services
Today, every organization needs to be digital, powered by data, operating in a multi-cloud world and ready to adapt to whatever comes next. Our Consulting team assesses customers' strategic, organizational and business challenges, applying deep industry expertise to deliver technical solutions that enable business transformation, operational excellence and measurable outcomes.
Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Senior Consultant on our Professional Services team in Saudi Arabia.
What You'll Achieve
As a Senior Consultant, Program Manager within AI Infrastructure Services, you will lead the delivery of large-scale AI and Data Center transformation programs for some of Dell Technologies' most strategic customers globally. You will help customers optimize Data Center design, accelerate AI infrastructure deployments and realize business value through complex multi-site implementation programs.
Working across Dell Technologies' products, services and partner ecosystem, you will be accountable for the successful delivery of our most complex programs. You will define program governance, establish delivery frameworks, manage interdependencies across multiple workstreams and ensure alignment to customer objectives and business outcomes.

description:
Position Summary

The Head, Career Development & Experiential Learning is responsible for developing and leading KAUST’s comprehensive career development, internship, and industry engagement strategy to enhance student employability and strengthen pathways from education to meaningful career opportunities.

The role provides strategic leadership for career development services supporting Saudi and international students across KAUST’s graduate and academic programs, ensuring students are equipped with the skills, networks, and experiences required to successfully transition into industry, academia, entrepreneurship, and other professional pathways.

The Head will build and manage strategic relationships with Saudi industry, government entities, and key ecosystem partners to create opportunities for internships, experiential learning, and (working alongside the Office of Alumni and Graduate Employment) full-time employment for KAUST graduates. The role will also oversee visiting student engagement pathways, ensuring visiting students and participants have a high-quality KAUST experience and meaningful connections with the University.

Working collaboratively with Academic Divisions, Faculty, Student Affairs, Alumni Affairs and Graduate Employment, KAUST National Transformation Institute (NTI), and external partners, this role will position KAUST as a leading institution for developing STEM talent aligned with Kingdom priorities and Vision 2030.

Major Responsibilities

• Develop and implement a comprehensive career development strategy aligned with KAUST’s institutional priorities, Vision 2030, and workforce development needs in Saudi Arabia.

• Lead the design and delivery of career development programs, resources, and initiatives that support Saudi and international students throughout their KAUST journey.

• Establish a structured career development framework including career coaching, professional skills development, industry preparation, networking, interview preparation, and employment readiness.

• Work with the Office of Alumni Affairs and Graduate Employment to develop and continuously improve career programming, including workshops, employer events, career academies, and professional development initiatives.

• Use data, student feedback, employer insights, and employment outcomes to measure impact and enhance career services.

• Alongside Alumni Affairs and Graduate Employment, develop and maintain strategic relationships with Saudi industries, corporations, government entities, research organizations, and innovation ecosystems to expand career and internship opportunities for KAUST students and graduates.

• Build a strong employer engagement strategy to increase internship placements, graduate recruitment pipelines, and industry collaboration.

• Identify emerging workforce needs and collaborate with academic leaders to ensure students develop relevant skills aligned with industry expectations.

• Create and manage partnerships that support graduate employment opportunities, including internships, research placements, and full-time career pathways.

• Develop and oversee a comprehensive internship and experiential learning strategy for KAUST students.

• Establish processes, partnerships, and systems to increase access to high-quality internship opportunities in Saudi Arabia and internationally.

• Partner with faculty and and industry organizations to create meaningful applied learning experiences.

• Track internship participation, outcomes, employer satisfaction, and student career progression.

• Working with Recruitment and Admissions, lead the strategic development and management of visiting student engagement pathways, supporting both Saudi and international visiting students.

• Collaborate with academic divisions, admissions, student services, and external partners to ensure effective onboarding, engagement, and transition support.

• Work with Education & Advancement Operations Systems Team to establish career services metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to monitor engagement, internship outcomes, employment results, and employer partnerships.

• Prepare regular reports and recommendations for leadership regarding career outcomes and industry trends.

• Represent KAUST at external events, industry forums, and professional networks.

• Support student recruitment, orientation, commencement, and other major University activities as needed.

• Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned by leadership.

Competencies

• Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic career development and employability programs within a higher education environment.

• Strong knowledge of STEM career pathways, workforce trends, and industry talent needs.

• Strong understanding of the Saudi higher education, industry, and innovation ecosystem.

• Proven experience building and managing relationships with corporate, government, and institutional partners.

• Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to operate strategically while managing complex programs and initiatives.

• Experience working with culturally diverse student populations and international environments.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to drive decision-making and measure impact.

Qualifications / Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree preferred.

• 10+ years of experience in career services, higher education, industry partnerships, talent development, employer relations, alumni engagement, or a related field.

• Fluency in Arabic and English; familiar with the Saudi education ecosystem

• Demonstrated success developing partnerships with employers, industry organizations, or external stakeholders.

• Experience creating internship, professional development, or graduate employment programs.

• Experience working in a research-intensive university, STEM-focused institution, or innovation ecosystem preferred.
