**About Mahally:**

Mahally is Saudi Arabia’s home for local commerce. We bring thousands of Saudi stores — across beauty, fashion, home, food, gifting, electronics, and more — into one marketplace and one app, making it easier for customers to discover and buy from local brands.

We’re more than a catalogue. Mahally is a demand engine for Saudi merchants — helping great products get discovered and connecting shoppers with local businesses they may not have found otherwise.

**About the Role:**

We’re looking for an **SEO Manager** to own Mahally’s organic search strategy end-to-end, covering **technical SEO, content and organic growth, and AI-driven discovery (GEO/AEO).**

This is not a keyword-reporting role.

Mahally is a large, dynamic marketplace with millions of URLs, constantly changing stores and products, and significant opportunities to improve how search engines crawl, index, understand, and rank our content.

You’ll lead the work to strengthen our technical SEO foundation, improve indexation and discoverability, build scalable organic landing-page strategies, and create sustainable organic growth that isn’t dependent on individual merchants or products.

You’ll also help shape how Mahally appears across emerging AI and answer engines, including ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google’s AI-powered search experiences.

Working closely with **Engineering, Product, Content, and Merchant teams**, you’ll turn SEO opportunities into clear priorities and measurable business impact.

Success will be measured not only by rankings and visibility, but by **qualified organic traffic, orders, and GMV.**

**What You'll Do**

**1- Fix the technical foundation**

* Own technical SEO for a marketplace at scale: crawl budget, indexation, canonicalisation, pagination, faceted navigation, internal linking, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals, and JS rendering.
* Diagnose and resolve index bloat — decide which page types deserve to be indexed at all, and enforce it through robots directives, canonical strategy, and sitemap hygiene.
* Solve for churn: define what happens to a store or product URL when it disappears, so we stop leaking equity every time a merchant leaves.
* Partner with Engineering on an SEO backlog that actually ships — with clear specs, acceptance criteria, and measured impact after release.

**2- Build organic surfaces that last**

* Design and grow durable page types — category, collection, brand, city, intent, and comparison pages — that don't depend on any single merchant staying.
* Own the content roadmap for organic: Arabic-first keyword and intent research, briefs, publishing cadence, and refresh cycles.
* Optimise store and product templates: titles, meta, headings, structured data, on-page copy, and merchandising signals.
* Build internal linking as a system, not a one-off project.

**3- Own AI and answer-engine visibility (GEO/AEO)**

* Define and execute Mahally's strategy for generative and answer engines: crawler access policy, structured data, entity clarity, citable content, and brand presence in AI answers.
* Make deliberate decisions about which AI crawlers we allow and why — and be able to defend the trade-off between control and visibility.
* Track and report where Mahally appears in AI answers for commercial Saudi queries, and close the gaps.

**4- Measure honestly**

* Own Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and log-file analysis. Build reporting that ties organic to sessions, orders, and GMV — not just impressions.
* Set up rank, indexation, and coverage monitoring with alerts, so we catch a drop in days rather than a quarter.
* Run structured tests on page templates and title/meta patterns and report the causal read where you can get one.

**5- Work across the business**

* Brief and influence Engineering, Product, and Content without owning their roadmaps.
* Guide merchants on the content and imagery that make their pages rank and convert.
* Present organic performance, risks, and opportunities to leadership with a clear point of view and a clear ask.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You’ll help Mahally build an organic acquisition engine that scales with the marketplace — improving how efficiently our pages are crawled and indexed, increasing qualified organic discovery, creating durable search surfaces, and strengthening Mahally’s presence across both traditional and AI-powered search.
* Ultimately, your work will translate organic visibility into **more customers, more orders, and more growth for Saudi merchants.**

**Requirements**

* **4+ years of hands-on SEO experience**, with proven experience managing SEO for a large-scale **e-commerce platform, marketplace, classifieds site, or other high-volume website**.

* Strong **technical SEO expertise**, with hands-on experience diagnosing and resolving complex issues related to **crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalisation, and site architecture**.
* Proven experience managing SEO for websites with **100K+ indexable URLs/pages**, including solving large-scale challenges such as **index bloat, faceted navigation, duplicate or thin content, and crawl-budget optimisation**.
* Advanced hands-on experience with **Google Search Console, GA4, SEO crawling tools** such as Screaming Frog or Sitebulb, and SEO platforms such as **Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent tools**.
* Practical experience **implementing, auditing, and optimising structured data/schema markup**, particularly for e-commerce, including Product, Offer, Breadcrumb, Organization, or similar schemas.
* **Professional proficiency in both Arabic and English**, with the ability to conduct Arabic keyword and search-intent research and assess the quality and relevance of Arabic SEO content.
* Strong **analytical and commercial mindset**, with the ability to quantify SEO opportunities, prioritise initiatives based on potential impact, and measure results across organic traffic, conversions, and business outcomes.
* Proven experience partnering directly with **Engineering and Product teams** to translate SEO findings into clear technical requirements and successfully deliver SEO improvements at scale.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with **GEO/AEO and AI-powered search discovery**.
* SQL, Python, or scripting experience for log analysis, bulk SEO audits, or automated monitoring.
* Experience with multilingual SEO, including hreflang and Arabic/English content strategies.
* Experience with App Store Optimization (ASO) or web-to-app discovery.
* Experience working in **Saudi Arabia or the GCC**, with an understanding of local search and consumer behaviour.
* Digital PR, authority-building, or regional link-acquisition experience.

The Asst. Lead - Maintenance will provide vital engineering and maintenance support for day-to-day plant activities at the Ornua Saudi AlWazeen plant. In this role, you will deputise the Engineering Lead, focusing entirely on executing day-to-day operations, enhancing equipment reliability, and improving overall facility efficiency and safety.

You will proactively lead a committed, flexible, and efficient team of 4-5 technicians reporting directly to them. All plant activities must be conducted in a manner that ensures strict compliance with relevant legislation, food safety codes of practice, and environmental standards.

KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:

Daily Operations & Scheduling

• Review job orders daily to determine and assign work priorities across shifts.

• Schedule the periodic repair, maintenance, and installation of machines, tools, and equipment to ensure continuous, uninterrupted production operations.

• Plan, organize, and review maintenance schedules, shift working, and related activities to match dynamic production requirements.

• Plan, develop, and implement new methods and procedures designed to improve operations, minimize operating costs, and achieve greater utilization of labor and materials.

Equipment & Utility Maintenance

• Direct maintenance activities on facility utility systems to provide a continuous, stable supply of heat, steam, water, electric power, gas, or air required for plant operations.

• Design, execute, and continually optimize a comprehensive, written Preventative Maintenance (PM) program for all plant equipment and systems.

• Work closely with service technicians and external industry experts to develop regular service plans for specialized company equipment and machinery.

• Coordinate the activities of technicians fabricating or modifying machines, tools, or equipment to manufacture new products or improve existing products.

• Modify programming of equipment, including programmable logic controllers (PLCs), as required to ensure automation synchronization.

Coordination, Safety & Quality

• Coordinate mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other external contractors during complex equipment installations, re-installations, and routine maintenance operations.

• Work closely with operational teams to investigate and resolve maintenance/technical problems, identify root causes of plant underperformance, and recommend measures to improve overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

• Ensure that all company policies are fully implemented and adhered to, with a particular focus on hygiene, food safety (HACCP), and occupational health and safety regulations.

Team Leadership & Inventory Management

• Maintain an effective training and skills-matrix development program that includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating, and process improvement.

• Take full supervisory ownership for subordinate activities, making yourself readily available to staff, mentoring technicians, and fostering a quality-focused mindset.

• Maintain an efficient spare parts inventory and ordering system to prevent operational delays while managing cost targets.

KEY REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (or a closely related engineering discipline).

• Experience: 5–7 years of relevant maintenance or engineering experience.

• Proven experience working within a dairy or food manufacturing environment is required.

• A valid Boiler License or hands-on industrial refrigeration experience is considered a strong plus.

• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think outside the box to resolve complex technical and automation challenges.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in Arabic is an advantage.

• High capacity to work effectively within a collaborative, cross-functional team environment as well as in an individual leadership capacity.

**Engineer, Systems Engineering**

**Location:** Jeddah, Saudi Arabia  
  

**About the Role**

Carrier is seeking an experienced **Systems Engineering Engineer** to support HVAC product development, system optimization, and localization initiatives across the Middle East. Based in Jeddah, this role will focus on adapting globally designed HVAC systems to regional manufacturing capabilities, market requirements, environmental conditions, and applicable regulatory standards.

The successful candidate will contribute to system engineering analysis, thermal simulations, prototyping, product validation, benchmarking, and value engineering initiatives. Working closely with regional and global engineering teams, the role will help deliver high-quality, cost-effective, compliant, and reliable HVAC solutions while maintaining alignment with Carrier’s global engineering standards and best practices.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform HVAC system design simulations, heat transfer calculations, and engineering analyses to assess system performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Support the development, localization, and enhancement of residential and light commercial HVAC products through prototyping, testing, and technical evaluation.
* Contribute to the localization and implementation of globally developed HVAC systems within Middle East manufacturing facilities, ensuring alignment with regional requirements and operational conditions.
* Support Middle East HVAC engineering programs, technical workshops, and cost leadership initiatives.
* Participate in value engineering and cost optimization projects to improve product performance, manufacturability, quality, and cost competitiveness.
* Conduct product benchmarking using catalogue references, physical product comparisons, and teardown activities to identify performance gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Support system integration, verification, validation, testing, and qualification activities throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Evaluate engineering alternatives based on technical performance, cost, risk, reliability, manufacturability, and serviceability.
* Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, and Carrier’s global engineering processes.
* Analyze engineering data, prepare technical reports, and present findings and recommendations to relevant stakeholders.
* Identify potential technical risks, project delays, and cost overruns, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop effective solutions.
* Respond to customer and market requirements by supporting continuous product improvement and the implementation of engineering best practices.

  

**Minimum Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* A minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in the HVAC industry, preferably in Research & Development (R&D), New Product Development (NPD), product engineering, or system engineering.
* Practical experience in HVAC product development, system performance evaluation, testing, or manufacturing support.
* Experience with engineering analysis, thermal calculations, simulation, or product optimization activities.

**Essential Skills and Competencies**

* Knowledge of HVAC and refrigeration systems, including product development, testing, and manufacturing processes.
* Experience with mechanical design and engineering simulation tools such as Creo, CFD software, and AutoCAD.
* Understanding of HVAC system performance, heat transfer principles, and product design fundamentals.
* Ability to analyze technical data, evaluate engineering alternatives, and develop practical solutions to complex problems.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical reporting skills.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple projects and collaborate with regional and global engineering teams.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications and Competencies**

* Exposure to Middle East and Africa HVAC markets, including regional product requirements and operating conditions.
* Familiarity with applicable HVAC industry standards and certification requirements, including AHRI, Eurovent, SASO, and MoIAT.
* Experience leading or contributing to large-scale value engineering, cost reduction, or cost leadership projects.
* Experience in product benchmarking, competitive product analysis, physical benchmarking, and teardown activities.
* Understanding of the complete New Product Development (NPD) lifecycle, from concept development through design, prototyping, testing, validation, and production.
* Ability to adapt quickly to established engineering processes, complex technical environments, and changing business priorities.
* Customer-focused mindset with the ability to understand and respond effectively to technical and product performance issues.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Effective localization of HVAC systems to meet regional market, manufacturing, and compliance requirements.
* Improved product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost competitiveness.
* Successful contribution to engineering development programs and value engineering initiatives.
* Timely delivery of engineering analyses, technical recommendations, and validation activities.
* Consistent application of Carrier’s engineering standards, processes, and best practices.

**Senior Chiller Technician**

**About the Role**

Carrier is seeking a skilled and customer-focused Senior Chiller Technician to perform maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and overhaul of HVAC and chiller systems. The successful candidate will ensure reliable equipment performance, high-quality service delivery, and compliance with company procedures, manufacturer guidelines, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EH&S) requirements.

The role requires strong technical expertise in chiller systems, effective communication with customers, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively to deliver excellent service.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform scheduled preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and overhaul of chillers and associated HVAC equipment in accordance with manufacturer guidelines and industry standards.
* Inspect air-conditioning and chiller systems, diagnose mechanical and electrical faults, and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
* Maintain, adjust, and repair electrical and electronic control systems, motors, pumps, blowers, coils, belts, and other equipment components.
* Repair or replace damaged parts and ensure equipment operates efficiently and reliably.
* Conduct site inspections and prepare technical reports covering site conditions, scope of work, findings, and recommendations.
* Estimate labor hours, materials, and tools required to complete assigned jobs.
* Complete job cards, job completion certificates, daily timesheets, maintenance records, and EH&S site survey documentation accurately and on time.
* Communicate with customers regarding the nature and progress of work, outstanding issues, and recommended corrective actions or improvements.
* Complete assigned tasks within agreed timelines while maintaining service quality, customer satisfaction, and a clean and organized worksite.
* Identify potential safety risks and implement appropriate control measures before and during work activities.
* Safely rig and set up gantries and lifting equipment for handling heavy machinery, including chillers and pumps, in accordance with approved procedures.
* Manage and maintain tools and equipment, including collection, delivery, proper use, and inventory control where applicable.
* Follow company processes, quality management standards, EH&S procedures, and applicable manufacturer requirements.
* Escalate technical issues, safety concerns, and resource requirements to the Supervisor or Manager when necessary.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues and other teams to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Attend technical training sessions, EH&S meetings, and other assigned training programs.
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required.

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Diploma or equivalent qualification in Air Conditioning and Refrigeration or a related technical field.
* 5–7 years of relevant experience in HVAC service, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair.
* Hands-on experience servicing and maintaining chiller systems is essential.
* A valid driving license is an advantage.

  

**Technical Knowledge and Skills**

* Good understanding of HVAC equipment maintenance and repair practices in accordance with industry standards and manufacturer guidelines.
* Practical knowledge of DX systems, airside equipment, and reciprocating, screw, and scroll chillers.
* Knowledge of mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, equipment controls, and basic building automation systems.
* Understanding of EH&S requirements, safe work practices, hazard identification, risk assessment, and Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS/SDS).
* Ability to use and manage tools and equipment appropriately.
* Knowledge of inspection procedures, technical reporting, maintenance documentation, and quality management practices.
* Basic knowledge of sheet metal work, electrical systems, carpentry, and building automation controls.
* Basic computer skills and proficiency in using mobile applications for work orders, service reports, and other operational tasks.

  

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Good English communication skills, including speaking, reading, writing, and listening.
* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and as part of a team.
* Good problem-solving, troubleshooting, and decision-making abilities.
* Strong commitment to quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.
* Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and recognize when technical issues require escalation.
* Good organizational skills and the ability to manage assigned tasks and priorities effectively.

The Senior Chiller Technician is expected to maintain the highest standards of safety, quality, and professionalism while performing all assigned duties. job_title: Sr. Cloud Application Architect, MENAT Professional Services Delivery
description:
Description
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries
Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
-Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
-Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
-Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
-Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
-Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
A day in the life
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
About the team
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Basic Qualifications
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations, or experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems
- Experience leading highly-available and fault-tolerant enterprise and web-scale software deployments
- Experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion
- Experience leading software development organizations in a "DevOps" model
- 5+ years of working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations experience
- Experience in Kubernetes, Docker or containers ecosystem, or experience with virtualization (Hypervisors, VMware, Xen) and experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP
- Experience deploying, managing, and optimizing Microsoft Windows Server, or experience working with REST API based services and experience in any Bigdata architecture
- Experience developing cloud native CI/CD workflows and tools, such as Jenkins, Bamboo, TeamCity, Code Deploy (AWS) or GitLab
- Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
Preferred Qualifications
- 10+ years of database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis) experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience working with partners through account, product or program management and business development engagements
- Experience as a technical account nanager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect or in a similar role
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
- Experience with designing and building applications using container and serverless technologies
- 7+ years of mainframe and legacy systems experience
- Experience with database management systems

The Yoga and Meditation Instructor at Miraval The Red Sea is responsible for leading transformative movement-based experiences that integrate mindful movement, breathwork, meditation, and holistic fitness practices. This role supports guests in achieving physical, mental, and emotional well-being through personalized and group sessions, including yoga, meditation, Pilates, tai chi, Qi Gong, breathwork, and other mindful movement modalities. The instructor will create a safe, inspiring, and engaging environment that promotes inner balance and self-discovery while adhering to Saudi Arabia’s hospitality and wellness industry standards. The ideal candidate will collaborate with the Wellness team to create integrated programs that enhance the guest experience.

Key Responsibilities:

Program Delivery & Guest Experience:

• Lead group and private sessions in yoga, meditation, tai chi, breathwork, Qi Gong, sound healing, pilates, and other mindful movement modalities, tailoring the experience to guest needs.

• Guide guests through personalized movement-based programs, focusing on strength, flexibility, mindfulness, and inner balance.

• Deliver educational workshops on posture, movement awareness, stress reduction, and energy balancing techniques.

• Ensure a welcoming, inclusive, and culturally respectful environment for all guests, addressing diverse backgrounds, physical abilities, and wellness goals.

• Align all movement sessions with Miraval’s mindfulness-based approach to well-being, incorporating elements of self-discovery, emotional health, and transformation.

• Maintain the highest standards of safety, professionalism, and guest service, ensuring that all activities are conducted with care and attention to detail.

• Oversee the proper use, maintenance, and cleanliness of movement spaces and equipment, ensuring a safe and functional environment. Immediately report any issues to the relevant department.

• Ensure all practices comply with Saudi Arabia’s health, wellness, culture and hospitality regulations.

• Collaborate with the Wellness team to integrate movement practices into broader well-being programs, creating an immersive guest experience.

Professional Development & Innovation:

• Stay updated with the latest research, trends, and best practices in mindful movement, fitness, and holistic wellness practices.

• Continuously refine teaching techniques and program offerings to meet the evolving needs of guests, ensuring high-quality experiences and increase in revenue.

• Actively contribute to team meetings, training sessions, and cross-functional collaborations within the resort, ensuring alignment with Miraval’s values and standards.

Guest Engagement & Marketing:

• Actively contribute to marketing initiatives, providing content such as articles, blog posts, and promotional materials to highlight movement-based offerings at Miraval The Red Sea.

Foster strong guest relationships by providing personalized, memorable experiences, and actively contribute to maintaining high guest satisfaction and positive reviews across social media and feedback platforms.

• Certified instructor in Yoga (RYT-200/500), Pilates, Tai Chi, Qi Gong, or other relevant mindful movement disciplines.

• Minimum 2 years of experience teaching at a luxury wellness resort, retreat center, or holistic health setting.

• Strong understanding of movement mechanics, breathwork, mindfulness, and mind-body integration.

• Experience working with diverse guest needs, including beginners, advanced practitioners, and those with physical limitations or specific wellness goals.

• Proficiency in English (knowledge of Arabic is a plus).

• Ability to create a calming, nurturing, and inspiring class environment that promotes relaxation, focus, and personal transformation.

Skills & Abilities:

• Exceptional communication and public speaking skills, with the ability to engage and inspire guests of all backgrounds and experience levels.

• Ability to adapt sessions and classes to meet the individual needs and goals of guests, ensuring a tailored experience.

• Empathetic, patient, and responsive to guest needs, creating a supportive and empowering environment.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, ensuring a smooth, seamless operation of all movement-based offerings.

• Proficiency in digital tools such as email, word processing, and spreadsheets for program management and communication.

• Accommodation provided by the resort.

• Full medical insurance as per Saudi labor laws.

• Flight allowance and paid vacation.

• Career growth within the Hyatt/Miraval brand.

**Mechanical Supervisor**

**Are you looking for an interesting and inspiring opportunity?**   
**Would you like be a part of a successful team?**   
 

**Join our team!**

**Partner with the best**

As a Mechanical Supervisor, you will be responsible for:

* Lead teams of technician's and sub-contractors on a daily basis, motivating and delegating work to ensure daily targets are clearly identified, achieved and that all work is carried out efficiently and effectively in accordance with scheduling, health, safety and quality requirements**.**
    

* Good mechanical background and responsible for the mechanical activities on workshop and the day-to-day supervision and monitoring of all ongoing work on workshop.
    

* Supervise and coordinate on workshop teams and sub-contractors, ensuring they complete tasks on time and safely to required standards.
    

* Allocate work and ensure completion in accordance with the project schedule.
    

* Responsible for daily checks on all plant and equipment so that they work at optimum efficiency.
    

* Create, allocate and control shift requirements for all teams/sub-contractors and maintain relevant records.
    

* Assist teams with resolving matters arising and cover other supervisors, as required
    

* Responsible for ensuring that teams and subcontractors deadlines are met with due care, without undue delay.
    

* Directly accountable for day-to-day requirements of project stakeholders
    

* Keep up to date with and have an awareness of, new products and new improved working methods that can add value by improving quality and reducing costs.
    

* Complete project documentation and reports accurately and concisely.
    

* Identify corrective actions and implementation of countermeasures to maximize productivity
    

* Responsible for all plant and equipment on hires, off hires, breakdowns, corrective actions and counter-measures
    

* Ensure relevant materials and consumables are identified, sourced and delivered in a timely manner to minimize project disruptions maintaining records and controlling stock
    

* Maintain effective health and safety systems, including completion of risk assessments, method statements, toolbox talks, etc
    

* Ability to work within precise limits or standards of accuracy.
    

* Charge hours to project according to manpower utilized.
    

**Fuel your passion**

To be successful in this role, you must:

* Have bachelor's degree in engineering or High School Diploma
    

* Have 3\+ Experience in mechanical activities such as assembly pipes, equipment, welding, testing.
    

* Have knowledge of packaging manufacturing operations.
    

* Fully flexible regarding working hours days / weekends. Compressor Electrical motor gas turbine gear box
    

* Ability to priorities works, accommodate conflicting requests, whilst ensuring the day-to-day functionality of the project.

* Ability to identify faults in project accurately and quickly when under pressure
    

* Have experience of working within "time critical" production environments

* Proficient in English.

**Why join us**

Get ready to Own customer partnerships as Key Account Manager – Livestock at Trouw Nutrition, a Nutreco company. In this influential role, you will combine commercial expertise with strong technical livestock knowledge and build trusted, long-term relationships with key decision-makers.

You will work closely with strategic customers to understand their needs, translate animal nutrition solutions into measurable value and strengthen our presence across Saudi Arabia. Own your relationships. Own your market. Own your success.

**What you’ll do**

* Manage and grow key livestock and ruminant accounts across Saudi Arabia.
* Build trusted relationships with customers, technical experts and key opinion leaders.
* Understand customers’ challenges and translate our solutions into clear commercial value.
* Protect and grow existing business in calf milk replacers and feed additives.
* Develop account plans and manage opportunities, pricing, negotiations and forecasts.
* Work with our regional technical and product marketing specialist to support key accounts across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC).

**Who we’re looking for**

We’re looking for a proactive and open-minded commercial professional who is ready to Own this role. You can build relationships from the ground up and establish credibility with highly knowledgeable customers.

Comfortable working across cultures, you combine commercial drive with the technical expertise needed to understand customers’ livestock challenges. You’ll bring:

* A relevant degree in Veterinary Medicine, Animal Science, Animal Nutrition, Agriculture or a related field.
* Proven B2B sales or key account management experience in animal nutrition, feed additives, animal health or feed.
* Experience managing large or strategic customer accounts and complex commercial negotiations.
* Strong knowledge of ruminant nutrition and production, particularly dairy cattle.
* Confidence engaging with farm managers, veterinarians, nutritionists and other technical specialists.
* A strong network among major livestock or ruminant customers in Saudi Arabia. Experience working with customers in the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman or Bahrain would be an advantage.
* Fluent English and strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills. Arabic is strongly preferred.
* Willingness to travel approximately 40% within Saudi Arabia and occasionally across the GCC.

**What you’ll receive**

As part of Nutreco, you’ll be a member of the SHV family, a diverse group of companies with a global footprint. You’ll gain access to a wide network of expertise and global career paths, backed by a privately owned business with a long-term focus. In addition, you’ll receive:

* A full-time position of 40 hours per week in an international and dynamic environment.
* A competitive remuneration and benefits package aligned with the local market.
* Locally applicable leave and employee benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth within Nutreco and the wider SHV Group.

**How and why to find out more**

This is an opportunity to shape strategic customer partnerships in one of the region’s most important livestock markets, while contributing to our purpose of Feeding the Future. If you’re ready to combine your market network, technical credibility and commercial drive, we’d like to hear from you. #Ownit #trouwnutrition

Responsibilities JOB PURPOSE As part of the sales team the primary role of this position is to maximize our on-shelf presence in all outlets served by the merchandiser. Additionally, when required the merchandiser will conduct in-store sampling sessions and in-store sampling and/or promotions. Planograms must be adhered to for both on and off shelf displays. Any non-compliance to the agreed arrangements must be reported to the pre-seller immediately. In addition to these duties the merchandiser is required to supply the pre-seller with the latest market information in order to take advantage of any selling opportunities. Accountabilities:  Call on specific OT outlets as per daily journey plan provided by your supervisor.  Merchandize SSFL products within your OT stores in the various access points, shelf, stand, floor display.  Place POS material wherever applicable next to our SSFL displays.  Ensure all access points are merchandized as per approved planograms.  Rotate product using FIFO method, and remove sub-standard products.  Maintain clean and fresh stock of SSF products on the shelf at all times.  Monitor and report competitive activities.  Report any deviations from agreed terms with your assigned OT customer / outlet.  Report daily activities of the prior day to your supervisor.  Participate in sampling / redemption campaigns when required.  Maintain appropriate personal appearance, and professional behavior in line with Frito Lay code of conduct. Key Performance Measures:  Execution Standard.  LTA enforcement.  Journey plan adherence. Qualifications EXPERIENCE / COMPETENCIES REQUIRED  Valid driving license.  Service-level oriented.  Strong communication and interpersonal skills

Operating procedures must be followed to ensure that there is continuity of standards across the KSA to support these primary job functions. In addition to these duties the Pre-seller will also provide his supervisor with latest market information in order to develop any sales opportunities. The Pre-seller is required to complete a daily debriefing with his supervisor. PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES  Sell the full range of products to an agreed list of customers. Sales will be measured against previously agreed targets. Levels of stales must be below the agreed target provided by his supervisor.  The customers are to receive the service approved by the supervisor. The call frequencies as well as the daily route plan are key to maintaining the levels of customer satisfaction demanded by the company. The supervisor will review the actual customers visited daily during the daily debriefing sessions.  Carry out the daily and weekly vehicle checks as laid down in the operating procedures. The salesman is responsible for maintaining the sales vehicle in a clean and roadworthy condition and any defects or damage must be reported at the earliest opportunity to the supervisor.  Supply ready to ship customer orders on time. Full details including delivery arrangements to be included  Maintaining individual customer stock levels to the agreed requirements in order to make sure that out of stock problems are kept to a minimum.  The Pre-seller is responsible for the implementation of the agreed in store merchandising communicated by the supervisor. Where there is additional support from a company merchandiser the Pre-seller will agree with the supervisor the arrangements planned in the outlets with the support.  Advise the supervisor of any relevant competitor activity taking place in the area served.  Daily reconciliation of all cheques, cash & credit sales.  Staff are always to be neatly groomed and presentable.  Maintain a high standard of driving and obey the driving regulations.  The following Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s) will be used to measure performance. description:
About this Position
As an On-Site Application Engineer, you will represent Henkel at one of our key customer's manufacturing facilities in Jeddah, providing hands-on technical support and ensuring the optimal performance of Henkel's adhesive solutions throughout the production process.
This role requires a strong technical background, a proactive problem-solving mindset, and the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams to maintain production efficiency, resolve application challenges, and drive continuous process improvements

What you´ll do

• Maintain a full-time presence at the customer's automotive manufacturing facility in Jeddah, serving as Henkel's primary on-site technical representative.

• Provide daily hands-on technical support for Henkel's automotive adhesive and bonding applications, ensuring optimal product performance and smooth integration into manufacturing processes.

• Monitor adhesive application performance and critical process parameters, including temperature, pressure, dispensing accuracy, curing conditions, and bonding quality to ensure stable and efficient production.

• Identify, investigate, and troubleshoot technical challenges related to adhesive applications, bonding performance, equipment functionality, and manufacturing processes.

• Conduct root cause analysis and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with the customer's technical teams and Henkel's internal experts to minimize production disruptions.

• Collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, and Process Engineering teams to ensure consistent application quality, process reliability, and compliance with automotive manufacturing standards.

• Support adhesive product trials, application validations, process improvements, and the introduction of new bonding technologies within the customer's production lines.

• Act as the key technical liaison between Henkel and the customer, ensuring effective communication, timely issue resolution, and alignment on technical requirements.

• Build and maintain strong professional relationships with key customer stakeholders, including engineering teams, production supervisors, quality representatives, and plant management.

• Prepare and maintain technical reports, performance assessments, troubleshooting documentation, corrective action plans, and regular project updates for both Henkel and customer stakeholders.

• Coordinate with Henkel's Application Engineering, Technical Service, Sales, and Product Development teams to provide technical solutions and support continuous improvement initiatives.

• Ensure adherence to applicable health, safety, environmental, and quality requirements while working within the customer's manufacturing environment.

What makes you a good fit

• Minimum of 2–3 years of hands-on experience in automotive manufacturing, preferably within production, process engineering, application engineering, or technical support.

• Experience working in an automotive manufacturing plant, with a good understanding of production processes, quality standards, and operational requirements.

• Knowledge of industrial adhesives, bonding technologies, surface treatments, or automotive assembly processes is highly desirable.

• Strong technical troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, with the ability to identify process deviations and implement effective corrective actions.

• Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, engineering drawings, process parameters, and production performance data.

• Familiarity with automotive quality standards, continuous improvement methodologies, and manufacturing best practices.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer relationship management skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

• Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently in a customer-facing manufacturing environment.

• Willingness to be based full-time at the customer's manufacturing facility in Jeddah, with occasional travel for technical training, meetings, or support at other customer locations.

• Fluent English is required; Arabic is an advantage.

At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We look for a diverse team of individuals who possess different backgrounds, experiences, personalities and mindsets.

You will:

Support problem solving by structuring challenges and exploring solutions    
  
Build an understanding of how consulting engagements are delivered end to end   
  
Participate in volunteer and team building experiences   
  
Gain exposure to our leadership team through networking sessions and speaker series   
  
Begin to build relationships with clients to understand their business needs, seek strategic solutions and guide impactful decisions   
  
Grow by receiving hands-on mentorship from an experienced management team   
   
  
Specialization Tracks   
  
We are looking for passionate and talented professionals who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs. We are recruiting five specialization tracks that make up our team. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences.   
   
  
Business Experimentation   
  
Leverage Mastercard's industry-leading predictive analytics platform, Test & Learn®, and SQL to run data-backed business experiments for our clients. Consultants focus on data science-based solutions to provide insights on various business initiatives, including product launches, marketing campaigns, customer loyalty, and pricing across various industries that touch many Fortune 500 companies. Partner directly with clients to share findings and help determine which ideas are effective, as well as where, when, and how to implement them.   
  
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:   
  
Where should a retailer open new stores to maximize profitability and minimize the cannibalization of nearby omnichannel sales?   
  
What bonus should be provided to someone opening a credit card account to entice them to use the card regularly?   
  
   
  
Strategy & Transformation   
  
Guide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms.   
  
   
  
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:   
  
How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market?   
  
How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial, and strategic goals?   
  
   
  
Performance Analytics   
  
Use quantitative and qualitative skills and enterprise applications (e.g., Business Intelligence Platforms, SQL, Python, and more) to drive data-led consulting solutions for customers. Weave together vast amounts of Mastercard, client & 3rd party data assets to investigate trends, build propensity models, develop data visualizations, and synthesize millions of data points into a cohesive story. Engage with client stakeholders through virtual and in-person meetings, leveraging insights to inform strategic recommendations.   
  
   
  
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:   
  
How does a financial institution fraud/authorization metrics fare against competitors, and what are strategies that can help it be best-in-class?   
  
How is a technology customer’s market share changing over time, and are there any segments where the client is relatively under penetrated?   
  
  
  
Marketing   
  
Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard.   
  
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:   
  
How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications?   
  
How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer?   
  
How can a large financial institution best execute a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more?   
  
  
  
Deploy    
  
Help clients implement, launch, and scale Mastercard products, platforms, and business transformation initiatives. Combine program management, stakeholder engagement, and implementation expertise to guide complex initiatives from strategy into execution.    
  
Work closely with client and Mastercard teams, coordinate cross-functional efforts, manage risks and dependencies, and drive adoption to ensure clients realize value from their investments.   
  
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:   
  
How can a financial institution successfully implement and launch a new payments, fraud, or digital banking solution while minimizing disruption to customers and internal teams?

job_title: Brand Manager - Decorative Coatings, Middle East
description:
**Do you love building brands that customers know, trust and choose?**

We are looking for a Brand Manager to help shape the future of Hempel Paints across the Middle East. You will turn customer insight into compelling campaigns, meaningful experiences and stronger brand preference across digital, retail and professional channels.

  

You do not need to come from the paint and coatings industry. If you have built consumer-facing brands in FMCG, retail, consumer goods, telecom, hospitality, financial services, fashion, beauty, home improvement or another customer-focused sector, we would be excited to hear from you.

  

As Brand Manager, you will lead the execution of the Hempel Paints brand strategy for the Decorative Coatings segment across the Middle East. Working closely with the Head of Brand Marketing and Head of Customer Marketing, you will strengthen brand identity, market positioning, customer awareness and loyalty while supporting the company’s wider business objectives.

**What will your responsibilities include?**

**Customer and market insight:** Lead market research and consumer insight work to understand audiences, cultural and category trends, competitor positioning and changing customer needs. Translate findings into practical brand and business recommendations.

**Brand strategy and positioning:** Execute the Hempel Paints brand strategy across the Decorative Coatings segment and ensure a clear, consistent and relevant brand presence across markets and customer groups.

**Integrated campaigns:** Develop and deliver integrated marketing communication plans across digital, social media, PR, traditional media, retail, trade, events and customer engagement channels.

**Customer engagement and loyalty:** Create brand awareness, customer engagement and loyalty-building initiatives that provide meaningful value to homeowners, professional painters, retailers, contractors, designers and other priority audiences.

**Retail and trade activation:** Partner with the Regional Trade Support Manager on promotions and in-store activations that attract attention, simplify the customer journey and support conversion.

**Content and storytelling:** Oversee content that reflects the brand voice, values, product benefits and sustainability commitments while following corporate brand guidelines.

**Colour and design inspiration:** Help shape seasonal colour trends, colour collections, decorative effects, colour cards, brochures and outlet design standards that inspire customers and differentiate Hempel.

**Portfolio and launches:** Support product positioning, portfolio priorities and new product launches with the Regional Product Manager, including campaign communication, seminars and presentations.

**Agency and partner management:** Manage relationships with creative, media, digital and PR agencies, suppliers and other third-party partners to deliver high-quality work on time and within scope.

**Budget and performance:** Manage branding and communication budgets, prioritise investment and evaluate campaign performance to improve marketing effectiveness and return on investment.

**Brand capability:** Provide employee onboarding and guidance on brand standards, communication best practices and corporate marketing tools, including Templafy.

**Governance:** Ensure marketing activity follows company policies, the Quality Management System, Environmental Management System and relevant communication and sustainability guidelines.

This position will be based either in Dammam (Saudi Arabia) or Bahrain and will report to the Head of Brand Marketing.

  

**Furthermore, we expect that you have**

· A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business with a marketing concentration, Communications or a related discipline

· Around five or more years of experience in brand marketing, consumer marketing, communications, customer experience, trade marketing or a related field

· Strong understanding of brand building, advertising, customer behavior, market research and marketing analytics

· Experience developing and executing campaigns across multiple channels and customer touchpoints

· Confidence managing agencies, external partners, projects and marketing budgets

· Strong written, verbal and presentation skills in English. Arabic capability is highly valued because the role supports Middle Eastern markets

· A customer-first mindset, supported by strong research, analytical and commercial thinking

· Creativity, curiosity and the confidence to bring forward new ideas while remaining hands-on in execution

· The ability to collaborate across functions, cultures and markets, while managing several priorities

· Familiarity with CRM platforms, digital marketing, content production, design and web trends. You do not need to be a designer, but you should know how to brief, assess and improve creative work

**Application and further information**

To apply for this position, please submit your application letter with a CV in English via the link no later than the 10-Nov-2026.

  

Please note that the interviews will take place 1-2 weeks after the application deadline and you may want to pencil this time in your diary to avoid any holiday clashes.

  

**Join Hempel**  
At Hempel, you’re welcomed into a global community of +7000 colleagues around the world. A workplace built on shared trust, mutual respect and support for each other.

  

We’re on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact.

  

At Hempel, we are committed to ensuring everyone feels safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work.  We believe that inclusion is key to innovation, and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents, we can achieve great things, together.

  

We are proud to be majority owned by the Hempel Foundation, a commercial foundation dedicated to making a difference, with our earnings contributing to a multitude of philanthropic activities every year. It means that when working at Hempel, your hard work and dedication contributes to a greater cause, making your career matter twice.

  

Learn more about Hempel and our commitments on [hempel.com/career.](https://www.hempel.com/career/our-people)

job_title: Senior Manager - Fire and Life Safety Operation
description:
The Senior Manager - Fire, Life and Safety is responsible for overseeing all fire prevention, life safety, and emergency preparedness operations across Qiddiya's city assets. This role ensures that fire safety systems, evacuation procedures, and life safety protocols meet the highest international standards, safeguarding guests, employees, and infrastructure.

job_title: Head of Marketing - LIONS Riyadh - Arabic Speaker
description:
## Company Description

Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF).  
  
Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene.  
  
Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector.  
  
Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities.

**About LIONS Riyadh**

LIONS Riyadh marks a bold new chapter for the world’s most prestigious platform for creative marketing. Launched by Tahaluf in partnership with LIONS and Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Media, it is a distinct Festival within the global LIONS community, home to the renowned Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. Designed to amplify Middle Eastern creativity on the global stage, LIONS Riyadh will showcase the region’s talent, ideas and storytelling while connecting its creative industries with the world’s leading networks, brands and decision-makers. The inaugural three-day Festival takes place at KAFD, Riyadh, from 6–8 December 2027. It will bring together regional and global CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands and emerging talent around creative excellence, effectiveness, culture and the future of the industry.

## Job Description

The Head of Marketing, will report into the Marketing Director and will manage a diverse team based in Riyadh.

The Head of Marketing will lead the brand, audience and go-to-market strategy for LIONS Riyadh, establishing the Festival as one of the most important new creative industry platforms in the region and a recognised part of the global LIONS community.

The individual will be a highly motivated, dynamic marketing leader with a track record of commercial collaboration to develop products and positioning reflective of customer demand.

This role requires a distinctive combination of brand thinking, creative judgement, audience insight and commercial marketing expertise. The successful candidate will understand how to build desire around a premium global brand while making it culturally relevant to Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East.

Managing a diverse team of managers, marketing executives and specialist functions the Head of Marketing will be a skilled marketing strategist and be able to drive creativity and enthusiasm in others.

The individual needs to be analytical and data orientated with a history of testing and optimisation, but with creative flair and exceptional attention to detail.

They will be responsible for creating a marketing platform that feels unmistakably LIONS – bold, intelligent, culturally connected and creatively distinctive – while delivering measurable audience, revenue and brand-growth objectives.

 The candidate should have extensive experience of digital marketing, content marketing  and marketing technology and be accustomed to delivering in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

The role will work closely with LIONS, Content, Creative, PR, Commercial and Partnerships to ensure every campaign strengthens the Festival's positioning, builds community and attracts the highest-value regional and international audiences.

The individual must be extremely adaptable, accustomed to working with differing market dynamics and be able to guide marketers and steer campaign strategy accordingly.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Working alongside commercial leads to develop value propositions and go-to-market strategy
    

* Ongoing customer insight and engagement strategies
    

* Overseeing delivery of marketing campaigns in line with business objectives
    

* Adherence to timelines and budgets
    

* Marketing KPI report
    

* To manage a cross functional marketing team which includes marketers from all backgrounds with a diverse range of skills and training
    

* To design and deliver campaigns for specific projects as and where required
    

* Building strong awareness, consideration and demand for LIONS Riyadh across Saudi Arabia, the GCC and priority international markets
    

* Growing the Festival’s reputation as a leading regional platform for creativity, marketing, media and culture
    

* Driving qualified registrations, ticket sales and attendance from priority audience segments
    

* Increasing engagement with senior CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands, creators and emerging talent
    

* Ensuring all campaigns reflect the LIONS brand, tone and creative standards
    

* Maximising the impact of speaker, content and partner announcements across paid, owned and earned channels
    

* Delivering strong digital engagement, conversion and return on marketing investment
    

* Building an active year-round community around the LIONS Riyadh brand via content marketing
    

* Driving effective collaboration across Marketing, Content, PR, Commercial, Creative and LIONS teams
    

* To act as a change management ambassador, demonstrating a positive and constructive attitude towards challenges and change
    

**Key Responsibilities**

**LEADERSHIP**

* Recommend team structures and delivery solutions based on requirements
    

* Line manage senior marketers and specialists working across a range of events
    

* Work with Group Director to ensure right structure, specialisms and level of resources to meet agreed KPI’s
    

* Provide guidance, feedback and inspiration to line reports
    

* Build a high-performing, creatively ambitious marketing team capable of delivering to LIONS brand standards.
    

* Champion bold thinking, strong creative judgement and audience-first marketing across the team.
    

* Champion the adoption and optimisation of marketing technology solutions and digital marketing more broadly
    

* Work with line reports to ensure successful delivery of marketing campaigns in line with agreed KPI’s, event and divisional strategy
    

* Work with line reports to develop skills and competencies and ensure they have a clear development roadmap
    

* Ensure line reports are competent managers and have the skills and training required to manage junior team members or specialists
    

* Ensure adoption and optimisation of marketing technology solutions, identify training needs and ensure line reports are technically proficient
    

* Create strong collaboration across Marketing, Content, Creative, PR, Commercial and the LIONS team.
    

* Reflect the high-performance culture of the marketing team.
    

**ANALYSIS & INSIGHT**

* Monitor campaign performance by supervising the production of relevant and timely reports. Recommend changes to campaign execution based on data insights
    

* Share relevant insights with sales, event team and senior management to drive revenues or pursue new opportunities
    

* Analyse and report trends over time and use these insights to build more effective campaigns
    

* Ensure relevant and timely data is captured (onsite & post show surveys, registration forms, industry research etc)
    

* Work with internal teams to ensure data governance and data management policies are adhered to
    

* Ensure delivery and accuracy of pre-agreed reports during and post campaign to monitor channel effectiveness and ROI
    

* Use recommended campaign analytics dashboards to monitor performance
    

* Build a culture of testing and metrics-driven decision making in the teams
    
* Develop deep understanding of LIONS Riyadh audience segments, motivations and behaviours across Saudi Arabia, the GCC and priority international markets.
* Use audience and market insight to shape messaging, positioning, channel strategy and campaign creative.
    
* Track brand awareness, consideration and perception to understand how LIONS Riyadh is building relevance and desirability in the market.
    

* Monitor cultural, creative and industry trends to identify opportunities for the brand to participate in relevant conversations.
    

* Turn insight into action, ensuring campaign decisions are both data-led and creatively intelligent.
    

**PLANNING & CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT**

* Work with marketing managers/wider team to plan product marketing campaigns to meet strategic objectives – for exhibitions and virtual/hybrid events
    
* Monitor operational implementation plans and ensure adherence to deadlines (including Gantt charts, Time & Action Plans, Content Calendars, Budget Trackers)
    
* Develop and oversee the annual marketing calendar for LIONS Riyadh across launch, speaker announcements, content reveals, partnerships, ticketing and Festival moments.
    
* Build integrated campaign plans across paid, owned, earned, social, CRM, partnerships and community channels.
    
* Monitor engagement with target media, associations, industry partners and social media influencers and help the team determine how they fit within the integrated campaign
    
* Assist marketing managers with the development of marketing budgets in line with plans and ensure budget trackers are kept up to date
    
* Recommend external suppliers and ensure adherence to contractual terms and delivery
    
* Ensure campaigns are tailored by audience segment and market, with clear messaging for Saudi, regional and international audiences.
    
* Work closely with Content, PR, Creative and Commercial teams to turn major Festival announcements into high-impact campaign moments.
    
* Ensure campaign planning protects the premium positioning and creative integrity of the LIONS brand.
    

**MARKETING EXECUTION**

* Together with the marketing managers identify target universe and key segments within target universe
    

* Guide the team in developing personas, value propositions and messaging for each of the key segments
    

* Ensure that timely, relevant communications are sent through full mix of channels and that the team are optimising the effectiveness of these channels
    

* Monitor and recommend adjustments to the digital marketing activity based on performance metrics
    

* Input into the Content Calendar to ensure delivery through the most relevant channels (email marketing, social media, digital marketing, direct mail etc)
    

* Input into the PR plan (internal or external) and liaise with the event manager/event director
    

* Establish relationships with and manage strategically important partners to ensure maximum exposure at lowest cost to show budget
    

* Ensure the maintenance of active social media channels in line with market expectations, monitor engagement and maximise conversion
    

* Oversee the design and production of all marketing collateral to be determined within the marketing plan
    

* Ensure all marketing collateral, email marketing, website content and digital marketing is thoroughly proofed, adheres to brand guidelines and agreed Informa standards
    

* Ensure all LIONS Riyadh marketing is creatively distinctive, premium and consistent with the global LIONS brand.
    

* Translate Festival content, speakers and partnerships into compelling campaigns that build excitement, relevance and demand.
    

* Develop audience-specific messaging for CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands, creators and emerging talent.
    

* Ensure strong localisation for Saudi and regional audiences while maintaining international appeal.
    

* Work closely with Creative and Content teams to turn key Festival moments into standout brand campaigns.
    

* Protect the quality and consistency of the LIONS Riyadh brand across every audience touchpoint.
    
* Ensure campaign planning protects the premium positioning and creative integrity of the LIONS brand.
    

## Qualifications

Degree or professional background in marketing, communications, media, business, creative industries or a related field is advantageous.

Relevant senior-level marketing experience may be considered in place of formal qualifications.

**Experience**

* Significant senior-level marketing experience within major events, media, creative industries, entertainment, culture or premium global brands.
    

* Proven track record of launching, repositioning or scaling brands in competitive markets.
    

* Experience developing and delivering integrated marketing campaigns across paid, owned, earned, digital, social and CRM channels.
    

* Experience building brand awareness, audience demand and commercial growth across multiple audience segments.
    

* Strong experience managing agencies, partners, budgets and cross-functional marketing teams.
    

* Experience in a start-up environment and/or scaling a new business is desirable.
    

* Experience marketing to international as well as regional audiences is highly desirable.
    

* Experience within the creative, advertising, marketing, media or cultural sectors would be a strong advantage.
    

* Middle East experience, particularly Saudi Arabia or the GCC, is desirable.
    

**Skills & qualities**

* Good written and oral communication skills in both Arabic and English is essential
    

* Excellent quantitative skills
    

* Excellent Excel, PowerPoint and financial modelling skills
    

* Strong analytical and presentation skills
    

* Good attention to detail and accuracy.
    

* Self-starter with proactive nature, and ability to work autonomously
    

* Experience using SAP, TM1 (IBM) and/or Oracle would be advantageous
    

* Highly collaborative
    

* Thrives on constant change.
    

* Strong creative judgement with the ability to recognise and develop standout brand ideas.
    

* Excellent understanding of brand positioning, audience development and premium marketing.
    

* Ability to balance creativity with commercial performance and measurable results.
    

* Strong understanding of digital, social, CRM and data-led marketing.
    

* Ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders, global partners, agencies and creative teams.
    

* Strong cultural awareness and sensitivity to both Saudi/regional audiences and international markets.
    

* A genuine interest in creativity, marketing, media, culture and emerging industry trends.
    

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced launch environment with high expectations and evolving priorities.
    

* Middle East experience (desirable)
    

* Relevant sector experience (desirable)

description:

The Senior Resident Quality Engineer is the primary representative at the customer manufacturing plant in Saudi Arabia. Quality Management  
  
Problem Solving & Escalation  
  
Launch & Serial Production Support

Languages

Fluent English (mandatory).  
  
Additional language skills are considered an advantage.  
  
Personal Competencies  
  
Strong customer focus and relationship-building capabilities.  
  
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.  
  
High level of autonomy and accountability.  
  
Strong sense of urgency and responsiveness.  
  
Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and international environment.  
  
Strong coordination, escalation management, and decision-making skills.

* Design, develop, train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
* Build AI solutions across Computer Vision, NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs), Speech-to-Text, and Text-to-Speech.
* Prepare, process, and manage datasets for model training, validation, and evaluation.

* Support AI model deployment across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments.
* Collaborate with AI, Backend, DevOps, and QA teams to move prototypes into production.
* Monitor model performance, troubleshoot issues, and maintain technical documentation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering and model development.
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Knowledge of Computer Vision, NLP, LLMs, and Speech AI.
* Experience with REST APIs, SQL, Pandas, and NumPy.
* Familiarity with Git, Docker, and foundational MLOps practices.
* Understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle, including model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.

### Key Responsibilities

* Draft, review, and maintain Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Software Requirements Specifications (SRS), and functional and non-functional specifications.

* Review UI/UX designs to ensure wireframes align with functional requirements, and coordinate with QA teams on test planning and scenario validation.
* Develop User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans, support clients during test execution, resolve requirement discrepancies, and obtain formal project sign-offs.
* Manage end-to-end requirements throughout the project lifecycle, including gap analysis, validation, and change management.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of business analysis experience, with direct exposure to AI, custom software development, or digital transformation projects.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), Waterfall, and hybrid project delivery frameworks.
* Working knowledge of software architecture, REST APIs, enterprise system integrations, data flow modeling, and database concepts.
* Experience in requirements lifecycle management, gap analysis, risk management, and UAT execution.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process-mapping skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.

job_title: Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing, Senior Engineer
description:
SOOR, a subsidiary of Master Works, helps organizations stay ahead of evolving cyber threats through advanced cybersecurity and secure infrastructure solutions. SOOR delivers resilient, scalable, and regulation-aligned security across governance, cloud, networks, and managed defense.

SOOR is looking for a highly skilled Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing Engineer, Senior to join our dynamic security services team. In this client-facing role, you will be responsible for leading complex security assessments across various industries. You will act as a subject matter expert, not only identifying critical vulnerabilities but also articulating business risks to stakeholders and guiding remediation efforts.

### **Key Responsibilities**

 Penetration Testing: Lead and execute end-to-end penetration tests on:

* Web Applications: (OWASP Top 10, API security, Business Logic flaws).
* Network Infrastructure: (Internal/External, Active Directory, Firewalls, Routers, etc).
* Source Code Review: Conduct manual and tool-assisted secure code reviews (SAST) across languages/frameworks, identify injection flaws, and provide developer-focused remediation guidance.
* Mobile Applications: (iOS and Android - static and dynamic analysis).
* Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct comprehensive vulnerability assessments and configuration reviews against industry standards (CIS, NIST).
* Red Teaming (Optional/Nice to Have): Participate in adversary simulation exercises, social engineering, and physical security assessments.
