job_title: B2C Sales & Business Development Manager - DX
description:
Daikin Middle East & Africa is a subsidiary of Daikin Industries Ltd. and the leading provider of heating, cooling, ventilation, air purification, and refrigeration technology. The company designs, manufactures and brings to market a broad portfolio of equipment, as well as tailor-made solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial purposes in Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). To date, Daikin EMEA has over 12 000 employees across more than 59 consolidated subsidiaries. It has 12 major manufacturing facilities based in Belgium, the Czech Republic, Germany, Italy, Spain, Turkey, Austria, and the UK. Our aim is to drive sustainable and effective solutions, sparking a good climate for the generations to come. And all this can only be achieved because of our People.

About The Role

As a B2C Sales & Business Development Manager – DX , based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, you will play a key role in establishing, developing , and growing the B2C business for DX (RA, SKY, Rooftop, and VRV) across the Saudi Arabian market. You will be responsible for building and expanding a dedicated distribution and dealer network, driving sell-in and sell-out performance, and strengthening the market presence of our residential product portfolio. Working closely with distributors, dealers, Marketing, Supply Chain, and internal sales teams, you will develop and execute commercial strategies to increase market share, enhance brand positioning, and deliver sustainable and profitable business growth.

How You Will Make An Impact

• Develop and execute the B2C residential air conditioning business strategy for Saudi Arabia, with clear sales, profitability, market share, and distribution objectives.

• Build, manage, and continuously develop a dedicated network of B2C distributors, dealers, retailers, installers, and other relevant sales channels.

• Drive sell-in and sell-out performance through structured commercial action plans, dealer development, promotions, incentives, and market activation.

• Develop annual sales budgets and rolling forecasts, monitor performance against targets, and implement corrective actions when required.

• Monitor market trends, competitor activities, product positioning, pricing, promotions, distribution strategies, and consumer dynamics to identify business opportunities and risks.

• Develop and implement competitive pricing and product positioning strategies for the residential air conditioning portfolio.

• Coordinate with Supply Chain and distributors to ensure appropriate stock levels, product availability, demand planning, and inventory management.

• Work closely with Marketing to develop B2C campaigns, dealer activities, product launches, promotions, digital initiatives, and other sell-out activities.

• Monitor distributor and dealer performance through clear KPIs covering sales, sell-out, stock, market coverage, product mix, and commercial execution.

• Identify new business opportunities, channels, geographical areas, and partnerships to expand residential market coverage across Saudi Arabia.

• Develop strong relationships with key distributors, dealers, retailers, installers, and other B2C market stakeholders.

• Provide regular business reviews, market intelligence, forecasts, and performance reporting to local and regional management.

What You Need To Succeed

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 8 years of experience in B2C sales or business development for DX (RA, SKY, Rooftop, and VRV) across the Saudi Arabian market.

• Strong knowledge of the Saudi residential air conditioning market, including distributors, dealers, retailers, installers, pricing structures, competitive landscape, and sell-out dynamics.

• Proven experience in developing and managing distribution and dealer networks, with a strong understanding of both sell-in and sell-out management.

• Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to manage sales targets, profitability, pricing, forecasts, stock levels, and commercial action plans.

• Entrepreneurial and hands-on mindset, with demonstrated ability to build and develop a business or sales channel.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret market data, competitor information, sales performance, inventory levels, and customer trends and translate them into concrete business actions.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills; able to build strong relationships with distributors, dealers, retailers, partners, and internal stakeholders.

• Results-oriented and capable of working with a high level of autonomy and ownership while coordinating effectively with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Service, and regional teams.

• Arabic and English are mandatory for effective communication with customers, partners, HQ, and regional teams.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint, with the ability to prepare sales forecasts, business reviews, market analyses, and management presentations.

Good climate starts with people
Our employees are the beating heart of our company. At Daikin, you get to work in a positive environment backed by trust, creativity and continuous improvement. Together, we create our top-quality solutions by empowering talented teams. You will get plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. We are deeply committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace culture that reflects the communities we serve. Good climate starts with people.

job_title: Finance: Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe
description:
### Job Title

Finance: Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe

### Job Description

Are you a finance professional with a strong background in tax, compliance, and financial governance? Do you enjoy combining technical expertise with team leadership, process improvement, and collaboration across multiple European countries?

  

At Vanderlande, we are looking for a Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe who will lead the regional Tax & Compliance team and help ensure a strong and compliant tax framework across our European operations.

  

In this role, you will contribute to managing tax risks, ensuring regulatory compliance, improving processes and controls, and supporting the business with practical tax solutions in a dynamic international environment.

  

**What will you be doing?**

As Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe, you report to the Team Lead Tax & Compliance EU / LATAM and lead a team of tax and compliance professionals supporting the European organization.

  

You will oversee day-to-day tax compliance activities within Europe and provide guidance on tax matters across multiple countries, working closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders.

You will combine solid tax expertise with people leadership and a continuous improvement mindset, ensuring tax compliance processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and consistently across the region.

  

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you will:

* Lead, coach, and develop the Europe Tax & Compliance team.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution of tax compliance and reporting activities across Europe.
* Coordinate corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and other relevant tax compliance activities in cooperation with Group Tax and local Finance teams.
* Support transfer pricing compliance activities and documentation requirements.
* Act as a key contact for tax authorities, auditors, external advisors, and internal stakeholders on operational tax matters.
* Identify and manage tax risks, ensuring issues are escalated and addressed appropriately.
* Translate changes in tax legislation into practical guidance and actions for the business.
* Maintain and improve tax controls, documentation, and compliance processes.
* Drive standardization and process improvements across European tax and compliance activities.
* Identify recurring issues and implement sustainable solutions.
* Support business projects and operational activities with practical tax advice.
* Contribute to finance transformation, compliance, and process improvement initiatives.
* Build strong relationships with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business teams.
* Support knowledge sharing and consistent application of Group Tax policies across Europe.

  

**What do we ask from you?**

We ask you to bring experience, education, and personality:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Tax, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in tax, tax compliance, or a related finance function within an international environment.
* Experience leading, coaching, or coordinating a team.
* Good knowledge of corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and general tax compliance requirements.
* Experience working with tax authorities, auditors, and external advisors.
* Experience with process improvement and standardization initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* A proactive, pragmatic, and solution-oriented mindset.
* A collaborative leader who combines technical expertise with a strong service-oriented approach.

  

**About the team**

You will join the global FSSC organization and become part of a collaborative international finance community. The Europe Tax & Compliance team supports the region in meeting tax and regulatory obligations while helping the business operate efficiently and compliantly in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment.

  

The team works closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders to strengthen compliance, mitigate risks, and continuously improve ways of working.

  
  

**What we offer**

We offer a position in an international and professional working environment with room for personal development and growth.

  

This position offers a competitive salary range of € 6.500 to € 7.600 gross per month (excluding 8% holiday allowance).

  

On top of your fixed salary, you’ll receive the following secondary benefits:​

  

* 40 vacation days (20 statutory days and a flexible budget worth 20 days)
* Flexible working hours
* A hybrid workplace (40% working from home and 60% in the office)
* A Health & Wellbeing budget worth € 300 per calendar year.
* Commuting allowance, including full reimbursement of travel by public transport
* Working from home allowance
* Collective pension scheme and discount on additional health insurance
* On-site company health centres with a gym, physiotherapists and occupational therapists
* Vanderlande Academy and training facilities to boost your skills
* A variety in Vanderlande Network communities and initiatives

**About Vanderlande**

Vanderlande designs, delivers and supports automation solutions, operational software and lifecycle services for leading airports and parcel operations worldwide. Our solutions help customers improve performance, reliability, and sustainable growth in more than 100 countries. How we work matters just as much as what we deliver. Our values, Every Day Better, We Care, and Team Play, guide how we collaborate, support each other, and create value for our customers.

  

**Ready to apply?**

Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV.

  

Questions about this role? Contact Carlijn Kneepkens (Recruiter) at carlijn.kneepkens@vanderlande.com.

  

**Diversity & inclusion**

Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

  
  

Every day, millions of people rely on Vanderlande without even knowing it. From baggage checked in at the airport to parcels on their way to someone’s doorstep, our automation solutions help keep the world moving.

  

Vanderlande designs, delivers, and supports automation technology, operational software, and lifecycle services for leading airports and parcel operations worldwide. Across more than 100 countries, our customers rely on us to keep their operations moving reliably, efficiently, and sustainably.

  

Behind every solution are the people who make it happen. At Vanderlande, how we work matters just as much as what we deliver. Our values, **Every Day Better**, **We Care**, and **Team Play**, guide how we collaborate, support each other, and create value for our customers.

  

Here, you can work with colleagues across disciplines and cultures, contribute to work that makes a difference, and build your future in an organisation that invites you to grow**.**

  

Explore what is possible at Vanderlande and discover how you can make an impact.

  

**Aspire. Grow. Achieve.** ***Together*****.**

**About Surbana Jurong**

Surbana Jurong (SJ) is a leading global urban, infrastructure, and managed services consulting firm, driven by a vision to build cities and shape lives. Headquartered in Singapore, SJ is a diverse collective of experts delivering sustainable and high-impact solutions across the built environment.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and technically proficient Senior BIM/CAD Specialist – Roads & Civil Infrastructure to provide technical leadership for BIM and CAD delivery across major roads, highways, interchanges, junctions, ramps, and civil infrastructure projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Civil 3D modelling for roads, highways, junctions, interchanges, ramps, and access roads.
    
* Develop surfaces, alignments, profiles, corridors, grading, cross-sections, and quantities.
    
* Prepare coordinated plans, profiles, long sections, setting-out, grading, road marking, and signage drawings.
    
* Coordinate road models with drainage, utilities, traffic, geotechnical, survey, and landscape teams.
    
* Manage model coordination, clash detection, QA/QC, templates, styles, data shortcuts, and BIM workflows.
    
* Mentor BIM/CAD team members and support digital delivery, resource planning, and automation initiatives.
    

**Requirements**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Civil Engineering Technology, Drafting, or related discipline.
    
* 10–15 years of relevant BIM/CAD experience in roads, highways, and civil infrastructure projects.
    
* Proven experience on major UAE and/or KSA infrastructure projects.
    
* Advanced Civil 3D and AutoCAD skills, with strong knowledge of road modelling and drawing production.
    
* Proficiency in Navisworks Manage and experience with ACC, BIM 360, or ProjectWise.
    
* Knowledge of BIM Execution Plans, ISO 19650, QA/QC, multidisciplinary coordination, and CDE procedures.
    

**How to Apply**

Please submit your application through our official careers portal. Click on the “Apply Now” button below and follow the instructions.

**Note:** Recruitment for this role is being managed internally. Unsolicited CVs from agencies will not be considered.

job_title: VP of FP&A and Investor Relations
description:
Who Are We❓

We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also, Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.

The Job in a Nutshell💡

Foodics is looking for a commercially minded, analytical and technology-forward finance leader to own the company's FP&A and Investor Relations . This is not a traditional budgeting and reporting role. The VP of FP&A and Investor Relations will be a strategic partner to the CFO, CEO, Board and leadership team — translating performance into decisions, challenging assumptions, improving forecast quality, managing the company's relationships with investors and stakeholders, and building a scalable, AI-enabled FP&A function across a business operating at the intersection of SaaS, fintech and payments.

### Main Task & Responsibilities 💡

* Own annual budgeting, long-range planning, rolling forecasts and reforecast cycles, with clear full-year landing views and disciplined forecast accuracy.
* Lead monthly performance reviews across revenue, ARR, gross profit, margins, EBITDA, OPEX, cash flow, headcount and key operating metrics.
* Translate results into concise executive insights: what changed, why it changed, what it means, and what management should do next.
* Build driver-based financial models and base / upside / downside scenarios to support strategic and operating decisions.
* Act as senior finance partner to Commercial, Product, Technology, Operations and People teams, challenging assumptions and improving resource allocation.
* Strengthen OPEX, headcount, CAPEX and strategic-investment governance, with clear ownership and accountability across the business.
* Evaluate pricing, new products, geographic expansion, partnerships, major commercial initiatives and M&A opportunities through robust business cases and post-investment reviews.
* Upgrade FP&A systems, reporting and automation so the function scales with Foodics and relies less on manual spreadsheet-heavy processes.
* Serve as a key point of contact for existing and prospective investors, lenders and other external financial stakeholders.
* Prepare Board decks, investor updates, quarterly/annual reporting packages and ad-hoc materials that clearly articulate company performance, strategy and outlook.
* Manage the capital-raise narrative and supporting materials (data rooms, financial models, KPI packs) in partnership with the CFO/CEO during fundraising or strategic transactions.
* Own the investor reporting calendar, ensuring timely, accurate and consistent communication of financial and operating results.
* Track investor sentiment, market trends, comparable company performance and industry benchmarks relevant to SaaS/fintech/payments to inform positioning.
* Coordinate due diligence processes with investors, auditors and advisors, ensuring data integrity and consistency across all external-facing materials.
* Use Claude to accelerate performance analysis, scenario modelling, business cases and management commentary.
* Interrogate large financial / operating datasets and identify drivers, anomalies, trends, risks and opportunities.
* Create repeatable AI workflows or agents for recurring FP&A tasks and ad-hoc executive analysis.
* Combine Claude with Excel / Google Sheets, BI tools, SQL, planning systems or other finance technology.
* Define where AI should automate work, where human judgment remains essential, and how outputs should be validated

**What Are We Looking For❓**

* 12-15+ years of relevant experience in FP&A, commercial finance, business finance or strategic finance, with meaningful
* leadership responsibility.
* Professional qualification is mandatory: active CMA certification or CFA charter.
* Demonstrated strong understanding of both SaaS and Fintech industries, including recurring-revenue economics, retention, churn, unit economics, payments economics, margins and the key operating drivers of technology-enabled financial services.
* Demonstrated current and sophisticated use of Claude in day-to-day finance work; basic AI exposure is not sufficient.
* Direct partnership with senior executives and experience presenting to Executive Committee / Board / investor audiences.
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets; BI, SQL, planning tool and finance automation experience are highly desirable.

**What We Offer You❗**

We believe you will love working at Foodics!

* We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
* We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
* Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
* We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

As a Trader at Thndr, you will play a critical role in supporting our Saudi brokerage dealing-desk capability and ensuring reliable day-to-day trading activity on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul).

You will monitor automated order flow and trading activity, oversee the performance of trading systems, identify unusual activity, spikes, exceptions, or potential issues, and take appropriate action or escalate when required. You will work closely with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure trading activity remains accurate, controlled, and compliant with applicable CMA requirements.

If you have hands-on trading experience in the Saudi market, strong knowledge of Tadawul and trading systems, and the ability to identify and respond to trading issues quickly and accurately, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Trading Monitoring & Oversight:

- Monitor automated client order flow and trading activity throughout the trading session.

- Oversee trading-system performance and identify unusual activity, spikes, anomalies, or potential issues.

- Monitor order status and identify rejected, delayed, or irregular orders.

- Investigate trading exceptions and determine the appropriate action or escalation.

- Escalate trading issues promptly to the relevant teams when intervention is required.

- Monitor market conditions and assess their potential impact on trading activity.

- Maintain accurate and auditable records of trading activity, exceptions, and incidents.

Regulatory & Risk Management:

- Ensure trading activity is conducted in line with applicable CMA regulations, market rules, and internal controls.

- Apply pre-trade controls and trading limits and monitor adherence to established trading parameters.

- Work closely with Risk and Compliance on trade surveillance and the identification and escalation of suspicious or unusual trading activity.

- Support the investigation and documentation of trading incidents, errors, and potential market-abuse concerns.

- Exercise sound judgement and maintain a high level of integrity when monitoring trading activity.

Trade Lifecycle & Operations:

- Maintain a strong understanding of the Saudi trading lifecycle, from order submission through clearing and settlement.

- Coordinate with Operations on trade confirmations, clearing, and settlement through Edaa and Muqassa.

- Communicate with relevant Tadawul teams when resolving trading, system, or operational issues.

- Support the resolution of trading exceptions and ensure issues are appropriately documented and followed through.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

- Work closely with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Product, and Engineering teams to investigate and resolve trading issues.

- Provide trading observations and market insights to the Head of Brokerage.

- Partner with Product and Engineering to identify system issues and improve automated order handling and monitoring.

- Contribute to improving trading controls, monitoring processes, and the overall client trading experience.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- Saudi national (Saudi citizenship is required for this role).

- Hands-on Trader/Dealer experience at a CMA-licensed brokerage or Tadawul member firm.

- Strong practical knowledge of Tadawul trading systems, order types, and market activity.

- Strong understanding of the Saudi trading lifecycle, including order submission, clearing, and settlement.

- Experience monitoring trading activity, identifying exceptions or unusual patterns, and escalating issues appropriately.

- Meets the CMA qualification requirements for the function, including CME-3A and CME-3B, a qualifying previous-series certificate, or a CMA-granted exemption.

- Eligible for CMA Registered Person registration and able to meet the applicable KSA residency requirements.

- Strong attention to detail, sound judgement, and the ability to remain calm and responsive under pressure.

NICE-TO-HAVE:

- Existing working relationships with relevant Tadawul teams.

- Experience with automated trading or electronic brokerage platforms.

- Experience with trade surveillance, transaction monitoring, or trading-system monitoring.

- Experience preparing trading reports or providing market insights.

- Experience working with Product or Engineering teams to improve trading systems, controls, or order handling.

- Previous experience in a fast-growing or technology-driven brokerage environment.

WHO ARE WE?

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.

History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before Thndr, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:

- High barriers to entry — In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.

- Irrelevant experience — Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.

- Fragmented offering — Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.

We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:

- 5.5 million app downloads

- EGP 1B+ average daily traded value across 2025

- #1 digital investing platform in Egypt for the third consecutive year

- 76% of users are first-time investors

- 40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions

At Thndr, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.

* High barriers to entry — In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.
    
* Irrelevant experience — Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.
    
* Fragmented offering — Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.
    

We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:

* **5.5 million** app downloads

* **76% of users are first-time investors**

Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching Rumble, the subscription-based investment recommendations platform.

**Rumble** was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts.

Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns.

At **Thndr**, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.

job_title: Sr Mgr, Solutions Architecture, MENAT AGS SA
description:
Description
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and committed support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
As a Sr. Manager, Solutions Architect you will partner with customers, AWS Sales, and several other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with sales, you should help drive revenue growth across a broad set of customers across industries. As a trusted customer advocate, you should help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions. You should seek out opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broaden the use of the AWS platform across the customer's organization. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Sr. Manager, Solutions Architect you are joining a team that invests in your success by providing a comprehensive learning program. The AWS Solutions Architecture team provides an opportunity to work in an open environment that includes self-paced learning, instructor-led training, hands-on projects, and job shadowing opportunities to develop your knowledge of the AWS ecosystem of services and solutions. The ideal candidate has a curious mind, a thirst for knowledge, and a desire to understand how technology works. By working backwards from defined customer outcomes, you achieve results that delight AWS customers. You enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and develop new ones so you can make meaningful contributions to long-term customer success.
Key job responsibilities
Serve as a leader for the SA team, and a key member of the business development team.
Hire, enable, and develop an industry-leading team of solutions architects
Build deep relationships with customers to become a trusted advisor for their most critical workloads that support their digital transformation and journey to the cloud.
Support achievement of revenue objectives through the adoption and migration of applications, software, and services onto the AWS platform, in partnership with the sales team.
Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud.
Contribute to AWS internal and customer-facing publications such as white-papers and blogs as a means of scaling your knowledge.
Act as a liaison between customers, service engineering teams, and support to address customer needs.
A day in the life
No two days look the same. You might start the morning reviewing a customer architecture with one of your SAs, then join a pipeline review with your Sales counterpart mid-morning. Over lunch you review a reference architecture your team is publishing, and in the afternoon you surface Ent. field patterns to an AWS service team to inform their next release. You close the day interviewing a candidate.
You lead a team of Solutions Architects covering Saudi customers, where needs range from first-cloud migrations to AI-powered architectures. Your stakeholders span Sales, Business Development, AWS service teams, and executive leadership, and your mission is constant: help customers move fast, confidently, and with real business impact
About the team
We operate by tenets that define how we work: deep customer understanding precedes technical recommendations; data drives our priorities; we measure impact over volume; we push boundaries over the status quo; and diverse perspectives make our solutions better. We celebrate customer wins not just as recognition, but as tools for community growth.
We value work-life harmony, continuous learning, and a culture of curiosity and connection, where every team member can do their best work and grow their career.
Basic Qualifications
- 5+ years of management of technical, enterprise customer facing resources or equivalent experience

Description
We are hiring a Solutions Architect to work with Enterprise and Strategic customers in central Saudi Arabia, based in Riyadh. Saudi Arabia is one of the fastest-growing cloud markets in the Middle East, fuelled by Vision 2030 and ambitious national digital transformation programmes across government, healthcare, aviation, retail, and financial services. This role is central to AWS's growth strategy in the Kingdom — you will serve as a key technical advisor for a portfolio of enterprise customers, helping them modernise legacy platforms, adopt AI and cloud-native architectures, and accelerate their digital agendas.
Solutions Architects engage with customers to understand their business drivers, assess application portfolios, and design reliable, cost-effective cloud-native architectures. As a Solutions Architect, you will partner with Account Managers, Business Development representatives, Professional Services, Specialist SAs, and AWS Service Teams to create solutions that address business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. You will also contribute to competitive displacement engagements, helping customers migrate workloads to AWS.
You should enjoy thinking strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. We are looking for candidates who are comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. The Solutions Architect is a technical role — you must be broadly competent across many areas of technology (Generative AI, Agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, security, DevOps, databases, application development, data analytics) and developing depth in at least 1–2 of those areas. On the business side, the ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical for our customers' successful use of AWS. You will spend most of your day interacting with multiple customer stakeholders, including Directors, Architects, Developers, and Engineers.
Key job responsibilities
- In partnership with Account Managers and Business Development, support long-term customer success, satisfaction, and trust through the adoption of AWS services and well-architected solutions.
- Serve as a technical advisor for enterprise customers in the Riyadh and central Saudi Arabia region, building relationships with customer stakeholders and contributing to their technology strategy.
- Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS and participate in architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud, including competitive migration paths from other cloud providers to AWS.
- Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many enablement sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS (e.g., Dev Days, Immersion Days, Workshops, and GameDays).
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS Solutions Architect community; contribute to customer-facing publications such as white papers, blog posts, and reference architectures.
- Act as a technical liaison between customers, AWS Service Teams, and Support — gathering product feedback, driving feature requests, and collaborating with fellow Solutions Architects in the region.
A day in the life
As a Solutions Architect in Riyadh, your day revolves around customer impact. You might start the morning reviewing an architecture proposal for an enterprise customer exploring a migration from on-premises or competing cloud platforms to AWS. Mid-morning, you join a technical session with a customer's engineering team, working through a solution design for their application platform and advising on the right mix of compute, AI/ML, and data services.
After lunch, you collaborate with your Account Manager and the wider account team on a strategy call — contributing to the technical win plan for a competitive opportunity and identifying the right Specialist SAs or ProServe resources to bring in. Later in the afternoon, you might support a workshop or Immersion Day for a group of developers at a customer site, walking them through hands-on labs on Amazon Bedrock, GenAI application patterns, or container modernisation with EKS.
Between customer meetings, you capture feedback on product gaps, contribute to a blog post on a solution pattern, or review an architecture alongside a teammate. Your week also includes internal syncs with the broader KSA SA team, community knowledge-sharing sessions, and preparation for upcoming events. No two days are the same, but the constant is clear: you are a trusted technical partner for your customers, and your work directly drives their success on AWS.
About the team
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
Basic Qualifications
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

job_title: Associate Director, Compliance & Ethics Lead LR MEA
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

  

This **Associate Director, Compliance & Ethics Lead LR MEA** is responsible for leading Compliance & Ethics operations for Local Representative Markets Middle East and Africa and promoting a strong culture of integrity. The role serves as the day-to-day Compliance & Ethics business partner for the supported market(s), providing risk-based guidance and supporting the effective implementation of the BMS global Compliance & Ethics program. The position works closely with market business and functional stakeholders to identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risks associated with business strategies, initiatives, and ongoing market operations. The role partners closely with regional Compliance & Ethics leadership to support governance activities and ensure appropriate escalation of significant compliance matters.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Promote the right tone throughout the organization and, working with market leadership, reinforce a steadfast commitment to integrity, quality, compliance, and uncompromising ethics.
* Support the development of and execute the annual Compliance & Ethics work plan for LR MEA, ensuring that it is responsive to business strategies, initiatives, ongoing operations, and identified compliance risks.
* Serve as the day-to-day Compliance & Ethics business partner for the supported market(s), providing practical, risk-based guidance on business activities and compliance requirements.
* Identify, assess, and escalate potential compliance risks, and recommend appropriate risk-mitigation measures in coordination with relevant business and functional stakeholders.
* Drive local implementation and execution of BMS global Compliance & Ethics programs, initiatives, systems, processes, and controls.

If you like getting out and about, you’ll love being part of our Field Engineering team. We travel to companies and manufacturing facilities all over the world to carry out risk-based inspections and ensure the integrity of existing certiﬁcations — we perform over 3,000 site visits every single day. It could be testing the ﬁre doors at a school, checking a ﬁre truck or even inspecting the New Year’s Eve ball in Times Square. Every day’s different and there’s always a new challenge to face.
As a Field Engineer, you'll play a critical role in maintaining the integrity of our certification programs by conducting safety and non-safety inspections and audits at customer facilities throughout Saudi Arabia. You'll verify that certified products continue to comply with applicable requirements, support customers throughout the certification lifecycle, and help uphold the trust behind the UL Mark.
This is an excellent opportunity for a technically minded professional with an electrical or electronics background who enjoys working independently, building customer relationships, and gaining exposure to a wide range of products and manufacturing environments.

Conducts safety and non-safety inspections and audits at customer facilities in accordance with applicable standards and UL Solutions procedures.
Verifies that certified electrical and electronic products, components, materials, labels, and markings comply with UL Solutions requirements.
Reviews production records, quality documentation, traceability programs, and previous inspection findings.
Evaluates test equipment calibration and witness factory testing activities when required.
Prepares inspection reports and documents non-conformances and corrective actions.
Schedules and manages inspection activities independently while maintaining high levels of quality and customer service.
Acts as a trusted advisor to customers by answering questions and providing guidance on UL Solutions certification services.
Collaborates with Engineering, Sales, Customer Service, Customer Advocacy, Label Center, and other internal teams to support customers throughout the product lifecycle.
Builds strong customer relationships and helps customers navigate product launches, manufacturing changes, and ongoing certification requirements.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Pharmacy, Engineering or another relevant discipline.

• At least 7 years of relevant experience in consumer health, pharmaceutical or FMCG companies.

• At least 3 years in Gross-to-Net or net revenue management, Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Commercial Finance, Trade or Channel Strategy, Business Planning or a closely related area.

• A strong understanding of the gross-to-net and net revenue waterfall, including discounts, rebates, trade investments, accruals, price-volume-mix and net sales drivers.

• Advanced analytical, modelling, forecasting and scenario-planning skills, including advanced Excel and experience with Power BI or a similar visualisation tool.

• Experience leading cross-functional governance, performance-management or forecasting processes and engaging senior stakeholders.

• The ability to influence and lead without formal authority, with excellent communication, facilitation and presentation skills.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

• High integrity, sound judgement, attention to detail and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience in the Saudi retail pharmacy market is highly preferred.

• Arabic proficiency.

• An MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification.

What you’ll do

You will be the owner of Gross-to-Net management in Saudi Arabia, while collaborating with the Commercial Excellence lead for performance analysis, planning and forecasting.

• Own and improve the end-to-end Gross-to-Net governance cycle, including calendar, data inputs, definitions, roles, decision rights, review forums and action tracking.

• Build and maintain one transparent Gross-to-Net waterfall across discounts, rebates, trade investments, marketing funding and other commercial deductions, with visibility by product, customer, channel and investment type.

• Lead regular reviews with Trade, Pricing, Marketing and Finance: reconcile actuals against plan and forecast, challenge assumptions and variances, and track actions to closure.

• Make sure every Gross-to-Net element has a clear objective, eligibility criteria, approval route and measurable outcome, and monitor exceptions, policy adherence and total exposure.

• Identify revenue leakage, over- or under-spend and ineffective investments, and recommend corrective actions, reallocation and performance-based alternatives for leadership reviews, key customer decisions and commercial negotiations.

• With the Commercial Excellence lead, develop dashboards and scorecards, run driver, variance and scenario analyses, and contribute to annual planning, target setting and rolling forecasts that bring volume, price, mix and Gross-to-Net assumptions into one net sales outlook.

• Improve data quality, dashboards and automation, and manage consultancies, agencies and data providers as required, always in line with internal controls, local requirements and business ethics.

Who you’ll work with

Based in Riyadh, you will join the Commercial Excellence department in Saudi Arabia, part of International Operations, and report to the Director, CE & Projects – Saudi Arabia. Y

Day to day, you will work with the Saudi Leadership Team and with colleagues in Commercial excellence, Trade, Marketing, Pricing & Market Access, Finance, Sales and Supply Chain. You will also connect with Regional and International Operations teams in Gross-to-Net, pricing, commercial insights and Analytics, and with external consultancies, agencies and data providers when needed.

Much of this work happens without direct authority. You will bring different functions together, speak up when things stall and keep decisions moving with clear owners and deadlines.

What you can expect here

You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued and your recommendations reach senior leaders. The role gives you the chance to broaden your commercial and financial perspective by working across Trade, Pricing, Marketing, Finance and regional teams.

You will be supported to perform at your best, trusted to take ownership and encouraged to make your voice heard. Expectations are clear, the pace is steady and the culture rewards results.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring clarity and discipline to commercial investment in Saudi Arabia, apply for the Sr. Manager, Gross-to-Net Commercial Excellence role by November 3, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

description:
## **Job Description:**

**Details of the Division and Team:**

Deutsche Bank's Trust and Securities Services (TSS) division, part of the bank's Corporate Banking unit, provides a comprehensive suite of post-trade services to a global client base of institutional investors, financial institutions, and corporations.

  

Global Reach and Scale:

DB is one of the world's largest sub-custodians, offering clients access to over 30 markets through its proprietary network and approximately 60 markets in total via third-party sub-custodians and Financial Market Infrastructures like Euroclear and Clearstream. Our local market knowledge extends across 13 European markets, 16 APAC and MEA locations, the US, and Brazil. As of February 2026.

**What we will offer you:**

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce is better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its center.

**You can expect:**

* Life Insurance
* Accidental Death Insurance
* Permanent Partial Disability Insurance
* Private Medical Insurance for you, your spouse and dependent children
* Flexible working arrangements
* 30 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
* DB contributions to Employee Workplace Savings "Gosi” plan (for Saudi nationals only)

**Role Summary**

Country business head accountable for the Trust and Securities Services (Custody/Clearing and related TSS offerings) franchise in Saudi Arabia, with responsibility for P&L, client strategy, regulatory and market engagement, and delivery of the local business plan aligned to regional and global objectives. Ensures strong governance, operational excellence, risk management, and growth through product development and sales support.

  

**Your key responsibilities:**

* Own the P&L for the local TSS book of accounts and drive delivery of business objectives.
* Lead the local team to execute strategy and ensure alignment with broader bank and TSS goals.
* Manage key client relationships through regular engagement, service reviews, and resolution of day-to-day queries and escalations.
* Deliver monthly/quarterly/annual MIS and executive updates, including strategic materials (market development, business model updates, and thought leadership/white papers).
* Serve as local point of contact with regulators and authorities on custody and post-trade matters; ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulatory standards.
* Maintain relationships with market participants (Exchange, regulator, brokers, and local infrastructure) and manage the brokerage community on exchange connectivity from trading and custody perspectives.
* Partner with TSS Product to develop and enhance the custody/service offering in line with local market requirements and regional/global strategy.
* Act as SME for post-trade settlement, liaising between global product teams and local market needs; maintain knowledge of exchange rules, regulatory requirements, and local post-trade technology platforms.
* Coordinate with Operations/back office to ensure smooth processing, reconciliation, timely settlement, and issue resolution.
* Drive risk management and control environment, including audit readiness, risk assessments, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning; ensure procedures and Key Operating Procedures are maintained and followed.
* Oversee client onboarding and documentation: new client adoptions, account opening support, KYC/periodic reviews, and compliance documentation requirements.
* Support growth through sales enablement: participation in pitches, forums/seminars, client due diligence, and preparation of RFI/RFP responses.

  

**Key Stakeholders**

Clients; Regulators; Exchange; Brokers; TSS Product; Operations; Compliance; Legal; Finance; COO and infrastructure partners.

**Your skills and experience:**

* 15+ years overall experience of which at least 5 years will have been within the securities services, post trade business
* Saudi CME Exam cleared
* In depth knowledge of the clearing and settlement, global custody, fund administration processes, depository receipts, agency services,
* The ability to work to critical deadlines and to manage priorities with internal key stakeholders.
* Possess skill for Relationship management, ability to work as a team member, ability to use IT systems
* Ability to manage complex projects and client demands
* Self-driven and motivated, able to motivate and influence others
* Ability to work with various stakeholders in a collaborative way
* Has the ability to lead by example with a highly proactive self-motivated approach.
* Experience at an international banking institution
* Middle East experience either based within the region or regional coverage would be advantageous
* English with Arabic language skills will be advantageous.
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

**How we’ll support you:**

* Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
* Training and development to help you excel in your career

**About us and our teams:**

Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. [click here](https://www.db.com/what-we-do) to see what we do.

  

**Deutsche Bank & Diversity**  

We strive for a [culture](https://careers.db.com/this-is-db/index?language_id=1) in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

  

For over 150 years, our dedication to being the [Global Hausbank](https://www.db.com/who-we-are/strategy/index?language_id=1&kid=strategy.redirect-en.shortcut) for our clients has been driven by our people – in around 60 countries and across more than 150 nationalities.   
Their deep understanding, insights, expertise, and passion help our clients navigate an increasingly complex world – be it in our [Corporate Bank](https://www.db.com/cb), our [Private Bank](https://www.db.com/pb), our [Investment Bank](https://www.db.com/i-b) or our [Asset Management (DWS)](https://www.db.com/DWS) division.

Together we can make a great impact for our clients at home and abroad, securing their lasting success and financial security.

More information at:  
[Deutsche Bank Careers (db.com)](https://careers.db.com/index?language_id=1&kid=careers.redirect-en.shortcut)

job_title: Tax & Legal Services - ITS/M&A - Deals Tax - Manager (Riyadh)
description:
About Us

With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.

Line of Service Overview

At PwC, our people in tax services focus on providing advice and guidance to clients on tax planning, compliance, and strategy. These individuals help businesses navigate complex tax regulations and optimise their tax positions.

Business Unit Overview

The ITS/M&A unit specializes in advising multinational clients on complex cross-border transactions and tax structuring. Our focus is on delivering strategic solutions that optimize tax efficiency while ensuring compliance with evolving international regulations. The team provides end-to-end support on mergers, acquisitions, and integrations, including due diligence, tax modeling, and post-deal planning. By combining deep technical expertise in international tax with advanced analytics and technology, we help clients navigate intricate deal structures, mitigate risks, and unlock value. Through global collaboration and thought leadership, ITS/M&A drives innovative approaches to meet the demands of today’s dynamic business environment.

How You’ll Contribute

As a Manager in International Tax Services – M&A, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping clients navigate complex cross-border transactions from strategy through execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Deepen and evolve your expertise in international tax structuring, transaction advisory, and post-deal integration.

• Lead end-to-end M&A tax engagements, including due diligence, tax modeling, structuring alternatives, and implementation of roadmaps for regional and multinational clients.

• Translate complex international tax rules and local regulations into practical guidance, controls, and client-specific operating procedures for deal execution.

• Design and operationalize tax-efficient structures, coordinating with finance, legal, and other stakeholders to ensure compliance and optimize outcomes.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, providing timely insights on evolving tax regulations and their implications for transactions and business strategy.

• Lead cross-functional delivery teams, coaching Seniors and Associates, embedding quality standards, and managing ambiguity to keep engagements on track.

• Contribute to internal knowledge assets and client-facing materials, including playbooks, training, and thought leadership tailored to M&A and international tax in the Middle East.

• Monitor global and regional regulatory developments, proactively briefing clients and internal teams on implications for deal structuring and compliance.

• Support business development, including solutioning for RFPs, scoping statements of work, and collaborating across the regional network to build a healthy pipeline.

• Advise on outbound transactions, ensuring tax-efficient structuring for investments and expansions into foreign jurisdictions, while managing associated risks and compliance requirements.

What You’ll Bring

• Demonstrated experience in tax advisory, compliance, and international tax matters, ideally with exposure to Pillar Two regulations.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field; advanced degree preferred.

• Designations & Certifications: Professional qualifications such as CPA, ACCA, CA, or equivalent.

• Technical Skills: strong knowledge of international tax principles, cross-border transaction structuring, and M&A tax considerations and well as proficiency in tax due diligence, deal modeling, and integration planning.

• Soft Skills :

• Leadership and team management capabilities.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Problem-solving and strategic thinking under tight deadlines.

• Language Skills: Fluency in English; Arabic is an advantage.

• Travel Requirements: Your flexibility to travel. This means we may require you to work away from your base office location on a regular basis and frequent overnight stays may be required. Where possible, we will take your preferences into account and strike a balance between meeting your career development/personal needs and those of the business and our clients.

How You’ll Make a Difference

At PwC Midde East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.

Why You’ll Love Working at PwC

At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job - you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here . Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East.

**About Mozn**

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.

If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.

**About the role**

As a Revenue Assurance Officer at MOZN, you will support the accuracy and integrity of our revenue operations by managing Accounts Receivable, supporting revenue recognition, preparing daily financial reports, and owning the end-to-end collection process.

You will work closely with Accounting, Sales, and RevOps to ensure invoices are issued accurately and on time, outstanding balances are actively managed, and revenue is recognized appropriately. This role also involves direct interaction with customers, requiring strong communication skills and a professional approach to managing collections and resolving payment-related matters.

***In line with Saudization requirements, we are currently prioritizing Saudi national candidates for this position.***

**What you'll do**

**Accounts Receivable & Revenue Recognition**

* Prepare and issue customer invoices accurately and on time.
* Monitor outstanding Accounts Receivable balances.
* Coordinate with the Accounting team to ensure accurate revenue recognition in accordance with IFRS 15.
* Maintain revenue recognition schedules for SaaS subscriptions and projects.
* Reconcile customer accounts and resolve invoicing discrepancies.

**Daily Reporting**

**Prepare and maintain daily reports covering:**

* **AR Aging:** Outstanding balances and overdue invoices.
* **Collections:** Daily receipts, collection targets, and expected payments.
* **Revenue Recognition:** Recognized revenue, deferred revenue, and pending recognition.
* **Collection Activities:** Client follow-ups, payment commitments, and escalations.

**Collection Management**

* Own the collection process from invoice issuance through payment receipt.
* Follow up with clients through calls, reminder emails, and meetings.
* Visit clients when necessary to resolve payment delays.
* Maintain professional relationships with clients while ensuring timely collections.
* Track payment commitments and escalate overdue accounts.
* Follow Mozn's approved collection procedures and escalation process.
* Coordinate with Sales, RevOps, and Accounting teams to resolve collection issues.

**Success Indicators**

* Timely and accurate invoice issuance.
* Achievement of monthly collection targets.
* Reduction of overdue Accounts Receivable.
* Accurate and timely daily reporting.
* Accurate revenue recognition tracking and reconciliation.
* Compliance with Mozn's collection procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, collections, or revenue accounting.
* Good understanding of revenue recognition and IFRS 15.
* Strong Excel and financial reporting skills.
* Experience with ERP or accounting systems.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
* SaaS or technology industry experience is an advantage.
* Knowledge of ZATCA and VAT regulations is preferred.
* Polite, presentable, and professional when dealing with clients.
* Confident in handling client calls, meetings, and collection discussions.
* Proactive, persistent, results-oriented, and detail-oriented.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

**Benefits**

* You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space.
* You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best.
* The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best.
* You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI.
* We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves.

At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, our ~18,000 employees shape the future in the field of process automation. We are seeking a dynamic, results-oriented Accounts Manager – Chemical & Petrochemical to strengthen customer relationships and drive sales growth across petrochemical accounts in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Region.

The successful candidate will possess a strong understanding of the Saudi petrochemical market, supported by a well-established and diverse network of industry relationships. This role is responsible for identifying new business opportunities, managing key customer accounts and delivering sustainable revenue growth. The primary focus will be on end-user customers, while also engaging with EPC contractors to support project development and business expansion.

Role and Responsibility:

Account & Area Management:
Own and manage key petrochemical end-user accounts across Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Region with a primary focus on the Jubail industrial area. Develop deep expertise in the SABIC ecosystem and other major private-sector petrochemical accounts, while actively engaging with relevant OEMs and EPC contractors. Serve as the primary customer interface, positioning Endress+Hauser as the preferred instrumentation and automation partner across the full portfolio of solutions, driving sustainable growth and long-term customer relationships.

• Consultative End-User Selling:
Apply a consultative, value-based selling approach by deeply understanding customer operations, challenges and strategic priorities. Position tailored solutions that enhance safety, efficiency, reliability and lifecycle performance, building long-term partnerships.

• Sales Strategy & Growth:
Proactively identify and develop opportunities across both brownfield (installed base, upgrades, services) and greenfield/project business. Build and execute account and territory plans aligned with business objectives and growth targets.

• Project & EPC Engagement:
Actively engage with contractors (Engineering & consultants) and project stakeholders in Jubail, influencing early design stages and specifications. Ensure strong positioning of Endress+Hauser solutions in upcoming projects by aligning with both end-users and EPCs across the project lifecycle.

• Business Development:
Expand market presence by identifying new business opportunities within end-user accounts while leveraging projects to capture early-phase opportunities. Stay informed on market trends, capital projects and competitor activities. Work continuously in developing sales pipeline to have a healthy one.

Utilize strong industry and application knowledge to assess customer needs, provide technical consultation and deliver integrated solutions aligned with operational and project requirements.

• Revenue & Performance Delivery:
Achieve and exceed sales targets through disciplined execution, effectively managing the full sales cycle—from opportunity identification and specification influence to order closure and account development.

• Market Intelligence & Insights:
Act as the voice of the market by providing structured feedback on customer challenges, project pipelines and competitive landscape to internal stakeholders, supporting strategic decisions and product positioning.

• Collaboration & Orchestration:
Lead external customer and project engagement while orchestrating internal collaboration with sales support, product centers, service teams and global factories to deliver competitive and comprehensive solutions.

• Sales Governance & Reporting:
Maintain accurate and up-to-date pipeline, forecasts, and account activities using CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce). Ensure strong pipeline visibility, forecasting discipline and contribution to mid- and long-term business planning.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or technology - Instrumentation/Electronics/Electrical or Industrial Instrumentation.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills, with a commitment to high-quality work and integrity.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into customer-focused solutions.

• Good MS Office tools and operational systems understanding. Experience with SalesForce.com is an advantage.

* **Method Development & Analytical Validation**
    * Analyze complex customer process stream compositions (e.g., natural gas, NGL, LNG, refining cuts, petrochemical matrices) to design custom chromatographic separation methods.
    * Define optimum column stationary phase chemistries, film thicknesses, particle sizes, internal diameters, and column length combinations for target separations.
    * Calculate and optimize physical property calculations (e.g., Calorific Value/BTU, Density, Compressibility, Boiling Point Distributions) within GC software scripts.

* **Column Chemistry & Preparation Oversight**
    * Establish technical recipes and quality control standards for column packing (packed columns) and phase coating/deactivation (capillary columns).
    * Work directly with Lab Technicians to audit column preparation workflows, evaluate baseline bleed profiles, and troubleshoot column batch variations.
    * Conduct root-cause analysis on column degradation, stationary phase stripping, and matrix contamination issues encountered during system testing.

* **Engineering & Application Support**
    * Collaborate with Proposal Engineers during the bidding phase to evaluate challenging stream compositions and confirm theoretical feasibility (cycle time , Detection limits, Peak resolution, etc).
    * Provide specialized analytical support to Tuning Engineers during Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) when handling difficult matrices, non-linear detector responses, or co-eluting peaks.
    * Prepare standard application notes, calibration protocols, chemical safety datasheets (SDS), and analytical technical guides.

* Education: Master’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related physical science.
* Experience: 4–7 years of professional experience in chromatography method development, or application engineering—with specific exposure to gas chromatography (GC).

**Competencies**

* Analytical Problem-Solving: Systematic, scientific approach to resolving complex separation issues, peak co-elutions, baseline drift, and matrix interference.
* Precision & Scientific Rigor: Uncompromising commitment to analytical accuracy, calibration integrity, and precise record-keeping.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to translate complex chemical principles into practical engineering inputs for technicians, tuning engineers, and project managers.

**Skills**

* Deep knowledge of gas chromatography principles: partition/adsorption mechanisms, column phase selection, carrier gas physics, and detector mechanics (FID, TCD, FPD).
* Familiarity with international standard test methods relevant to process industries (e.g., ASTM D1945, ASTM D5504, GPA 2261, ISO 6974).
* Hands-on proficiency with GC data handling systems, peak integration algorithms, calibration routines, and chemical safety management.

SUMMARY OF THE ROLE

The Senior Sales Executive - Projects, you will be responsible to Support the Area Sales Manager in driving B2B sales of Jotun Decorative products to new, existing and targeted project customers by utilizing Jotun’s sales tools and methodologies, building strong customer relationships, identifying business opportunities and executing sales plans to achieve sales targets, gross margin, DSO (Day Sales Outstanding) and market share targets while driving sustainable profitability.  
  
This position is based at Jeddah and will report to the Area Sales Manager – Project.

**Responsibilities:**

* Promote, introduce, and sell Decorative products to construction projects within the assigned geographical territory through regular customer visits, identifying new projects business opportunities, gathering market insights and competitive intelligence, and building strong customer relationships to achieve sales targets and support sustainable business growth.

  

* Conduct systematic ground mapping and regular area audits of ongoing and upcoming construction and infrastructure projects within the assigned territory to identify decorative painting opportunities ahead of the tender/specification stage and assess market potential.

  

* Build, maintain, and continuously update a qualified sales pipeline in CRM, aligned with sales top-line (STP) and budget targets, ensuring accurate opportunity tracking, stage management, and sales forecasting.

  

* Monitor awarded projects throughout execution to maintain Jotun's position, defend the agreed project scope against competitor penetration, and ensure project requirements are met.

  

* Proactively manage assigned accounts through diligent follow-up, reconciliation, and documentation to ensure adherence to credit terms and achievement of DSO targets.

  

* Collaborate with internal departments to ensure timely delivery and excellent customer service, while reading and interpreting project technical documents to provide accurate product recommendations, quotations, and compliance with project specifications, Undertake and regularly update area audits to identify market potential within own designated geographical area together with Supervisor.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR AND WHAT WE OFFER

**We are looking for:**

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree. Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Building Materials is preferred.
* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Project Sales, B2B & Business Development.
* Fluency in Arabic & English – both verbally and written.

**Location: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.**

**Personal Qualities:**

* Identifies and seizes commercial opportunities; has a strong positive impact on business growth and profitability.
* Builds a useful network of contacts and relationships and utilizes it to achieve objectives.
* Uses a methodical and systematic approach; plans ahead, defines clear priorities and allocates resources effectively.
* Co-operates well with others; shares knowledge, experience and information; supports others in the pursuit of team goals.
* Focuses on bottom-line results, identifies potential risks and monitors the financial impact of own activities.
* Adheres to company rules and procedures; executes plans with commitment and determination; achieves high-quality results.

**We are offering:**

* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Continuous learning opportunities and training activities through on-the-job training and our in-house learning Jotun Academy.
* Career development opportunities across multiple disciplines and geographies.
* Leaders who focus on engaging and enabling their team, proven by consistently high employee feedback scores.
* A supportive and inclusive company culture where you can be your authentic self.
* A focus on having fun together through team building and social activities.

You will have the opportunity to work with healthcare professionals, learn about the latest advancements in diabetes, and contribute to patient care. This internship is a great way to start your career in healthcare while making a meaningful impact to people’s lives.

  

**Internship details:**

• Start date: 1st December 2026

• Duration: 6 months

• Working hours: 40h/week with flexibility (exams and holiday period)

• Working model: onsite

• Based in Taif (but could cover Bisha, Al Qunfudhah & Makkah if needed)

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

• Provide support and education to doctors, nurses, and patients on diabetes management and our products, addressing their questions and needs.

• Participate in patient onboarding sessions and educational campaigns to improve diabetes awareness and care.

• Manage consignment inventory in hospitals and ensure timely replenishment of used items.

• Assist the logistics team during deliveries to ensure smooth operations.

• Travel within the local region to extend education and support efforts.

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

• Currently in the final year of studies or recently graduated with a degree in healthcare, nutrition, health education, or a related field

• Fluent in Arabic and at least intermediate (B1) level in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills

• Proficient in MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, and Sharepoint)

• Excellent organizational abilities with a customer-focused mindset

• Eager to learn, develop, and grow professionally

  

**Would be a plus:**

• Experience working with patients

• Interest in Diabetes. Additional training or certifications in diabetes care are a strong plus.

• Driving license

The Power Production Assistant Site Manager is responsible for managing personnel, resources, and activities devoted to the Power Production operation of a 6M (initial load) Power Plant in accordance with the performance work statement. + Must have a current, valid U. S. Passport.
+ Must have a valid U.S. Driver’s License and able to drive with a manual transmission.
+ Must be able to communicate in English.
+ Must be able to pass employment and deployment qualification requirements that include psychological, medical, dental, drug testing, background checks, etc.

+ Must have an excellent understanding of all safety directives and polices regarding the operation of electronic equipment.
Skills:
+ Must be proficient with Microsoft programs such as Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point
+ Fluent in English with good verbal, reading and writing skills.
+ Ability to troubleshoot and solve technical problems.
+ Exercise discretion and good sound judgment.
+ Able and willing to work periods of long hours to meet mission requirements
+ Military experience in a contingency environment and knowledge and experience working with government contracts preferred.
