The MD530 Quality Control Specialist ensures that all aircraft maintenance activities are performed safely, correctly, and in accordance with aviation standards. Your inspections directly influence aircraft readiness, safety, and mission capability for the customer.
Responsibilities
+ Perform scheduled, unscheduled, and random inspections to ensure maintenance work meets aviation standards, technical publications, and safety requirements.
+ Review maintenance performed across all disciplines—including Powertrain, Engines, Avionics, Electrical, Sheet Metal, Welding, Armament, Corrosion Control, Tool Control, and more—to confirm accuracy and compliance.
+ Conduct 100% inspections, monthly inspections, and observation-based quality checks.
+ Verify aircraft logbooks, records, and readiness data for accuracy and completeness.
+ Perform scheduled, unscheduled, and random inspections to ensure maintenance work meets aviation standards, technical publications, and safety requirements.
+ Identify maintenance discrepancies and issue corrective actions.
+ Track and validate corrective actions to ensure timely resolution.
+ Classify findings by severity (major, minor, or observation) and support root-cause analysis when needed.
+ Review readiness and maintenance program records (Tool Control, Corrosion, TMDE, Oil Analysis, etc.) to ensure all requirements are met.
+ Prepare and submit inspection reports, discrepancy reports, and corrective action documentation.
+ Monitor maintenance records, component tracking, and supply documentation to ensure accuracy and proper routing.
+ Verify that on-the-job training (OJT) for maintainers is properly executed and documented. Collaborate with Production Control, Technical Supply, and Maintenance leadership to resolve quality issues.
+ Coordinate with the Government Flight Representative on maintenance test flight documentation requirements.
+ Provide guidance to maintenance teams to promote continuous improvement and reduce rework.
+ Performs all other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
Education / Certifications:
+ Associate degree in Aviation Maintenance, Aerospace Technology, or related field. Bachelor's degree accepted as equivalent.
+ As a condition of employment in Saudi Arabia, all candidates must successfully complete the Saudi Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development’s Qualification Verification Program (QVP) to ensure eligibility for visa processing and employment authorization.
Certification:
+ FAA Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) Certificate
Experience:
+ 5+ years of helicopter/rotary-wing maintenance experience, MD530
+ 2+ years in a Quality Control, Technical Inspector, or similar inspection role
+ Strong ability to interpret technical manuals and maintenance documentation

**Company:**

Boeing Global Services (BGS) is seeking **Electrical** **Modification Mechanics** to support our F-15SA Modifications team. The **Modification Mechanic - Electrical - F‑15SA Modifications** will execute electrical and avionics modification tasks at **King Abdulaziz Air Base, Saudi Arabia**, applying required technical competence to deliver safe, compliant, and timely modification outcomes.

**This is a long-term expatriate position based 100% on-site at King Abdulaziz Air Base, Dharan Saudi Arabia.** **Relocation/assignment benefits to the international location will be provided. Ability to meet international assignment health requirements required. If accompanied, family must also meet international assignment health requirements.**

This role reports to the Operations Manager – F-15SA Modifications.

(The selected candidate will be onboarded in alignment with program start and execution timelines; flexibility in start date and working hours may be required to meet operational demands).

**Position Responsibilities:**

* **Modification Execution & Production Support:** Perform modification tasks on F-15SA electrical systems in support of the statement of work, using aircraft technical orders, engineering instructions, blueprints, and other authorized publications
    
* **Electrical Systems & Avionics:** Install, troubleshoot, repair, and modify electrical and avionics systems, wiring harnesses, circuit protection, sensors, and interfaces; use appropriate test equipment and procedures to validate work carried out and system functionality
    
* **Technical Interpretation & Problem Solving:** Interpret technical documentation (drawings, wiring diagrams, blueprints, technical orders) to diagnose and resolve moderate to complex system faults and restore equipment condition and operation
    
* **Work Sequencing & Coordination:** Coordinate with the maintenance controllers, coordinators, and management to sequence and prioritize work; ensure tooling, materials, and test equipment are available for scheduled and emergent tasks
    
* **Airworthiness & Test Verification:** Perform operational tests, ground checks, and component inspections to verify airworthiness and conformity to modification and safety standards
    
* **Safety, Quality & Compliance:** Adhere to Boeing standards, applicable regulatory requirements, QA, and Safety Management System (SMS) processes; participate in audits and contribute to corrective actions where required
    
* **Documentation & Records:** Complete accurate technical records, modification logs, test reports, and discrepancy documentation in line with program, customer, and regulatory requirements
    
* **Continuous Improvement & Training:** Contribute to LEAN/BPS/CI initiatives to improve throughput and quality and participate in / support training initiatives
    
* **Flexibility & Shift Work:** Support a flexible environment with overtime as required to meet program timelines and execution demands

* Minimum 3 years of fighter aircraft modification or maintenance experience within a depot or MRO facility with demonstrable competence on electrical systems, troubleshooting and repair to include: Wire routing and cable bundles, precision termination experience with Coaxial and fiber optic systems.
    
* Proven ability to read and interpret technical orders, engineering drawings, wiring diagrams, and maintenance publications
    
* Hands-on experience using aircraft test equipment, support equipment and standard aircraft tooling
    
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills; ability to work in a multi-discipline environment supporting modification programs
    

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Formal qualification in an aircraft engineering/technical discipline equivalent combination of education and experience
    
* 5+ years of aircraft maintenance experience or experience on fighter aircraft platforms (F-15 highly desirable) or other military fixed-wing platforms
    
* Prior experience supporting aircraft modification programs, MRO, or production environments
    
* Familiarity with maintenance recording systems and tool control systems

Tencent Cloud Middle East is looking for a Security Operations Specialist based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The role supports the day-to-day operation of Tencent Cloud Middle East's cybersecurity activities: running established security processes, monitoring and triaging security events, maintaining compliance documentation, and coordinating with Tencent Cloud's central security and compliance teams.

This is an individual-contributor role for a candidate in the early stage of their security career who wants to grow into cloud security operations and compliance. It does not carry people-management or strategy-ownership responsibilities.

**Job Responsibilities**

1\. Execute and maintain the security operations processes, procedures and checklists defined by Tencent Cloud's security and compliance teams; track tasks and tickets through to closure.

2\. Monitor security alerts, vulnerabilities and risk items; perform initial triage, escalate to the appropriate owners, and keep risk and issue trackers accurate and up to date.

3\. Support incident response activities under guidance — collect and preserve evidence, maintain incident timelines, coordinate with responders, and draft incident reports and post-incident summaries.

4\. Assist with the periodic review and upkeep of cybersecurity and privacy policies, procedures, guidelines and compliance evidence, so that documentation stays current and audit-ready.

5\. Prepare regular operational reports and dashboards on security posture, open risks, remediation progress and compliance status for internal stakeholders.

6\. Support security awareness activities, internal communications, and the preparation of security documentation and questionnaire responses for customers and partners.

# **Who We Look For**

1\. Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.

2\. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in security operations, IT operations, data security, privacy or compliance support; internships and graduate programmes count.

3\. Working knowledge of common security operations tasks: alert monitoring, vulnerability management, access and entitlement review, log review, and incident documentation.

4\. Familiarity with cloud services and common security technologies (for example IAM, network security controls, encryption, SIEM, endpoint protection); exposure to any major cloud platform is a plus.

5\. Familiarity with information security and privacy standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF or PCI DSS; experience supporting audits or certification activities is a plus.

6\. Basic awareness of information security and personal data protection requirements in Saudi Arabia (for example SAMA Cybersecurity Framework, PDPL, NCA controls) and a willingness to build deeper regulatory knowledge on the job.

7\. Clear written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is a plus.

8\. Detail-oriented, comfortable working with process, documentation and cross-team coordination. Entry-level certifications (Security+, CC, ISO 27001 Foundation) are a plus, not a requirement.

## **Position Overview:**

As **The Logistics & Supply Chain Operations Lead** you will oversee regional fulfillment, fleet dispatch, and supply chain execution across the Western Province. Based in Jeddah, this role bridges local ground operations with central teams in Riyadh HQ—managing high-volume bulk cement logistics, transporter networks, and KSA regulatory compliance

## **What You will do (Responsibilities) :**

### **1\. Operational Leadership**

* Lead daily logistics and dispatch operations for the Jeddah region.
* Lead and supervise the regional operations team (coordinators, helpers), ensuring tasks are completed efficiently and on time.
* Manage warehouse, fleet, and fulfillment activities in the region.
* Act as the key point of contact between the Jeddah ops team and central teams (Riyadh HQ, product, sales, procurement, finance), managing cross-functional collaboration.
* Ensure alignment of regional operational activities with company goals and strategies.

### **2\. Delivery & Fulfillment Management**

* Oversee the full delivery lifecycle on the BRKZ platform (BOB): delivery scheduling,  transporter/vehicle assignment, and on-time closing of deliveries and orders.
* Manage high-volume bulk cement operations, including multi-truck orders, quantity splitting practices, and exceptional-quantity official deliveries specific to the Jeddah region.
* Ensure Fasah permits, delivery notes, and transportation cost entries are accurate, complete, and recorded per company standards.
* Ensure deliveries are assigned to transporters promptly once documents are received, avoiding delays in the delivery-closing process.

### **3\. Process Optimization & Improvement**

* Analyze current regional workflows and identify areas for improvement; drive continuous process improvement and cost control.
* Develop and implement SOPs, best practices, and operational guidelines for the region.
* Champion adoption of new tools and automation (unified delivery schedule, AI-assisted workflows, bulk assignment features) within the regional team.

### **4\. KPIs, Data & Reporting**

* Monitor regional KPIs and generate operational performance reports for senior leadership.
* Use operational data and dashboards (e.g., Metabase) to track deliveries, transporter costs, and team productivity; identify trends and drive data-driven decisions.
* Use analytics to forecast demand, plan resources, and manage regional operational capacity.

### **5\. Team Management & Training**

* Mentor, train, and support coordinators and helpers to develop skills and adhere to operational standards.
* Conduct regular team meetings, providing updates and ensuring clear communication across departments.
* Coordinate schedules, staffing, and resource allocation to meet operational demands and deadlines.

### **6\. Customer, Vendor & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, transporters (including third-party bulker fleets), and service providers in the Western region.
* Ensure operational processes meet customer expectations; resolve issues affecting customer satisfaction such as delivery delays or quality problems.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders to manage expectations and resolve concerns.

### **7\. Risk Management & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and safety standards across regional operations.
* Identify operational risks (supply chain disruptions, regulatory changes, resource shortages) and develop contingency plans.
* Ensure the region is prepared for audits, inspections, or regulatory assessments.

### **8\. Strategic Planning & Budgeting**

* Contribute to operational strategy development, focusing on long-term goals and cost-saving opportunities.
* Assist in creating and managing the regional operational budget, ensuring effective resource allocation.
* Support senior management decision-making with data and analysis on operational expenditures.

## **Who You are (Qualifications) :**

* 8–10 years of experience in operations, preferably in logistics/supply chain; construction/building materials experience strongly preferred.
* Proven leadership and team management skills, ideally managing distributed field teams.
* Analytical and data-driven approach; comfort with dashboards, trackers, and operational reporting tools.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills under pressure.
* Excellent communication in Arabic and English.
* Knowledge of KSA transport regulations, permits (e.g., Fasah), and Western Province logistics landscape.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Jeddah.

The Legal Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and following up on the company's legal matters, managing legal documentation, monitoring cases and claims, and ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations in Saudi Arabia. The role is performed on a part-time basis according to the agreed working schedule.

### Key Duties and Responsibilities

**1\. Legal Cases and Claims**

* Follow up on legal cases, disputes, and claims involving the company.
* Coordinate with external lawyers, legal consultants, and relevant authorities.
* Prepare and organize documents and supporting evidence required for legal proceedings.
* Monitor court hearing dates, legal deadlines, and case updates.
* Maintain updated records of ongoing legal matters.

**2\. Contracts and Agreements**

* Assist in preparing and reviewing contracts and legal agreements.
* Coordinate contract reviews and approvals with the relevant departments.
* Monitor contract expiration dates, renewals, and terminations.
* Maintain organized and confidential records of legal documents.

**3\. Legal Compliance**

* Monitor relevant changes in Saudi laws and regulations.
* Assist in ensuring company compliance with applicable legal requirements.
* Follow up on legal notices, violations, and official correspondence.
* Identify potential legal risks and report them to management.

**4\. Government and Legal Authorities**

* Coordinate legal transactions with government and judicial authorities.
* Follow up on cases and requests through relevant government platforms, including Najiz.
* Prepare official letters and legal correspondence.
* Monitor the implementation of legal decisions and required procedures.

**5\. Employment and Labor Matters**

* Coordinate with the HR Department regarding labor disputes and employee-related legal matters.
* Prepare and organize documents related to employment contracts, warnings, investigations, and terminations.
* Follow up on labor complaints and claims.
* Support the preparation of legal documentation related to disciplinary procedures.

**6\. Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare periodic reports on legal cases, claims, contracts, and pending matters.
* Maintain accurate and updated legal records.
* Ensure confidentiality of all company legal information.
* Complete assigned legal tasks within the required deadlines.
* Perform other related duties assigned by management.

### Qualifications and Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, or a related field.
* **Must have completed legal training or be currently undergoing training at a licensed law firm.**
* Good knowledge of Saudi labor and commercial laws.
* Familiarity with Saudi government and legal platforms.
* Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Ability to handle confidential information professionally.

### Work Schedule

This is a **part-time position**, with working hours determined by mutual agreement based on the company's operational requirements. The employee must ensure timely follow-up on assigned legal matters and meet all applicable deadlines.

### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely follow-up on legal cases and deadlines.
* Accuracy and completeness of legal documentation.
* Regular updates on pending legal matters.
* Effective coordination with lawyers and relevant departments.
* Completion of assigned tasks within agreed timelines.

**Note:** The Legal Coordinator performs administrative and legal coordination duties. Providing independent legal opinions or representing the company before courts is subject to applicable professional licensing requirements and company authorization.

We’re looking for a highly technical Adobe DXP Architect to lead the design and delivery of enterprise digital experience platforms for large, complex organizations.

❏ Produce high-quality architecture artefacts, including solution designs, integration specifications, and decision records.

❏ Collaborate with UX, data, marketing, and delivery leads throughout discovery, design, build, and optimization.

❏ Experience in a consulting or systems integration environment, delivering for enterprise clients in a structured, client-facing delivery model.

❏ Solid integration and cloud architecture skills, including REST APIs, Adobe I/O / App Builder, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

❏ Experience in regulated or public-sector environments, such as financial services, government, or telecoms.

❏ Experience with Adobe Commerce or Workfront.

❏ GCC client experience and/or Arabic language skills.

description:
Job Description

About Us
At Crowne Plaza®, we want our guests to feel able to do their best, achieve their goals and be recognized for their success. We’re Making Business Travel Work by Bringing Humanity to Business Travel. We challenge the old world of business that’s overly formal, rigid and where guests feel like a room number not a person. We embrace the new world of business with caring and flexibility – through hotel colleagues who Dare to Connect!
Dare to Connect is how we describe the Service Style at Crowne Plaza hotels. It shows we’re thinking and acting differently. We’re connecting with guests – and each other – in a more personal way. We’re showing our personalities (and sharing a little of ourselves) and learning more about the other person… as a person, not as a room number or a co-worker. When we Dare to Connect, it means we:
Dare to Make the First Move… we are proactive and positive… we are the first to greet and say hello, and the first to take action and help our guests.
Adapt to the Moment… we might not be mind readers, but we can read our guest’s moods and needs and then change our pace, tone and take action so we can help a guest when they need it.
Relate to Business Needs… we know that Modern Business Travelers need to be productive, so we make sure we prioritize the right things that help our guests do what’s important.
Enable Quality Downtime… we know our guests want more from their trip than just business, so we make an effort to get to know them and give them recommendations that help them make the most out of their free time.
Your day to day

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**About Us**

The Caterpillar Oil & Gas and Marine Division has a diverse and global portfolio encompassing the brands Cat, MaK and SPM. Over 2500 employees in 25 countries deliver excellence in manufacturing, sales, services and operations to our customers.

The products and services of our business units Cat Oil & Gas, SPM Oil & Gas and Marine include engines, transmissions, pumps, flow iron, pressure control, carbon capture as well as systems integration and digital.

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Inventory Planner** to support our SPM Oil & Gas parts business. This role is critical in ensuring optimal inventory availability, minimizing stock shortages, and improving overall inventory control to support revenue generation and customer satisfaction.

The successful candidate will be responsible for inventory planning, forecasting, demand management, stock optimization, and ERP-driven inventory control across multiple customer and operational sites. The position requires close collaboration with sales, operations, supply chain, and customer-facing teams to ensure the right parts are available at the right time.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage inventory levels to ensure optimal stock availability while minimizing excess inventory.
* Monitor, analyze, and maintain inventory accuracy using ERP systems.
* Support parts sales activities by ensuring timely availability of critical SPM Oil & Gas components.
* Develop and maintain forecasting and demand planning models to support business requirements.
* Identify stock shortages, excess inventory, and supply risks, implementing corrective actions where required.
* Generate inventory reports and provide recommendations to improve stock control and inventory performance.
* Coordinate with supply chain, procurement, warehousing, and operations teams to ensure efficient inventory replenishment.
* Investigate inventory discrepancies and drive root cause analyses to prevent recurrence.
* Ensure compliance with internal inventory control procedures and best practices.
* Communicate inventory status, risks, and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Travel to multiple customer and operational sites as required.

Support operational requirements across multiple product lines and assembly areas.

Experience operating valve testing systems and equipment.

Job Description

The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program

Voyage: Training tomorrow’s leaders today

Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. Our global leadership development program, Voyage, propels participants on a mentored, learning-inspired journey to prepare you for a successful career. Voyage is a full-time, paid development program. As an associate and trainee, you’ll build upon the skills you developed in school by participating in real world assignments.

Ready to embark?

To become a Voyage participant, you must have graduated with a degree from a university or hotel school within the last 2 years ie. on or after March 2025. If you are currently enrolled in a college/university with an expected graduation date within 12 months of the date of application may also be considered.

Other qualifications/requirements include:

Bachelors or Masters degree required (Associates degree acceptable for Culinary). Your application confirms you meet the above degree requirement.

Superior critical-thinking & interpersonal communication skills

The ability to foster relationships & work collaboratively

The ability to self-manage & be a self-starter

A real desire for personal & professional growth

Fluency in local language may be required

All candidates need to have the right to work in the country to which they are applying for with the exception of the United Arab Emirates (work visa provided)

About the journey

Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in 50+ countries.

Voyage is a leadership development programme, but we do expect you to show you are ready to take on those added responsibilities. Proactivity, open communication and teamwork are all crucial in performing and showcasing you are ready for your next step.

When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Each individual’s Voyage journey is unique, spanning 12-18 months dependent upon your career interests, passions, goals, and location. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.

The experience you’ll gain

Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:

Cultivate customer relationships

Be a champion for innovation within the organization

Get exposure to managing projects & people

Improve processes & pitch new initiatives through your Voyage project

Take on special projects that will draw upon all your training

Destination: Marriott leadership

You’ll participate in management meetings and collaborate with Voyage participants worldwide. You’ll be expected to solve challenges, as well as offer ideas and innovative solutions. You will also have an opportunity to provide feedback on your curriculum and have an impact on future Voyage hires’ experiences. After graduation, you’ll be well-prepared to pursue your passion and take on new challenges. Many program graduates are ready to step into a Marriott supervisory or entry-level management role right away, because the program has provided a foundation for future leadership.

Application Process

Online Application (closes 1st December)

Paradox Video Interview

Management Assessment

Recruiter Screen

Final Interview with hotel

Marriott Associates

Previous Interns at Marriott, Current Interns, Part Time Associates, Dual students are encouraged to apply provided they meet the above-mentioned criteria. If you are currently a full-time associate at Marriott International, please speak to your HR Team or email voyageemea@marriott.com

Want to learn more? Visit Early Careers at Marriott International | Find Job & Career Opportunities

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

#LI-Onsite

Marriott International is the world’s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

About EnerVenue
EnerVenue is a Silicon Valley-based energy infrastructure company commercializing metal-hydrogen battery technology originally developed by NASA for the Hubble Space Telescope and the International Space Station. Founded in 2020 by Stanford Professor Yi Cui, EnerVenue adapts this proven aerospace chemistry for grid-scale terrestrial energy storage, delivering batteries with 30,000+ cycle lifetimes, inherent fire-safety, and a 30-year design life.
In 2026, EnerVenue closed a $300 million Series B extension and is well capitalized for growth. Funds are being deployed to build a high-volume manufacturing facility in Changzhou, China, targeting 250 MWh capacity by Q3 2026 and 1 GWh by 2027. EnerVenue has been named one of Time magazine's Top 10 US Green Technology Companies of 2025.

The Role
We are seeking a technically rigorous and customer-focused Energy Storage Applications Engineer to bridge the gap between our advanced energy storage technology and real-world deployment. This is a strategic, hands-on role critical to our mission. You will translate customer requirements into optimized system designs, validate performance across diverse use cases, and ensure our solutions deliver measurable value in the field. Acting as the technical backbone of the commercial process, you will support sales, marketing, product, and engineering teams with modeling, integration guidance, technical sales support, and application expertise.
This role covers EnerVenue's Middle East region and is based remotely in Saudi Arabia, working directly with utilities, developers, EPC contractors and industrial customers across the Kingdom and the wider GCC.

Key Responsibilities
Lead the Technical Pre-Sales Process:
Serve as the primary technical partner to Sales throughout the commercial lifecycle—from initial qualification through contract execution. Shape deal strategy by translating customer use cases, financial objectives, and operating constraints into technically optimized, commercially compelling storage solutions.

Translate Market Opportunities into Bankable Proposals:
· Lead technical discovery sessions to define duty cycles, performance guarantees, augmentation strategies, and integration requirements.
· Develop robust energy storage models that quantify lifetime performance, degradation, efficiency, availability, and ROI.
· Produce detailed technical proposals and bid packages, including system sizing, single-line diagrams, performance assumptions, and compliance documentation.

Strengthen Technical Sales Enablement:
· Partner with Sales to respond to RFPs, RFIs, and technical due diligence requests with speed, accuracy, and credibility.
· Support customer meetings, executive presentations, and contract negotiations as the technical authority.
· Develop standardized tools, calculators, and modeling frameworks that improve proposal consistency, cycle time, and win rates.
· Manage customer facing technical documentation and work alongside technical teams to generate documentation as necessary for project proposals.
· Develop and/or review System designs, Single Lines, Layouts, Containerization, Performance guarantees, Availability guarantees, etc.

Amplify Marketing & Market Positioning:
· Collaborate with Marketing to develop application notes, white papers, case studies, and technical content that articulate differentiated value.
· Translate complex engineering advantages into clear, benefit-driven messaging for target segments (utility-scale, C&I, microgrid).
· Provide technical input for product launches, webinars, conference presentations, and thought leadership initiatives.

Accelerate Cross-Functional Alignment:
· Serve as a bridge from the Commercial team to Product and Engineering, ensuring customer requirements and emerging use cases inform the roadmap.
· Support commissioning readiness and early deployment to protect performance assumptions made during the sales process.

Position Requirements:
The ideal candidate likely spent the first part of his or her career building deep technical foundations in power systems, battery engineering, PV + storage integration, or grid-connected infrastructure—either at a leading OEM, EPC, developer, utility, or technology-driven energy company—where he or she developed rigorous analytical skills and a strong safety mindset. He or she has since operated in a fast-paced, customer-facing or scaling environment, applying that technical depth to commercial pursuits and supporting projects from early-stage feasibility through commissioning and field optimization.

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Energy Systems, or a related technical discipline.
· 5+ years of progressive experience in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), including system design, applications engineering, integration, technical sales support, and service.
· Demonstrated expertise designing multi-MW scale energy storage systems, with strong command of both DC and AC electrical design principles.
· High level of technical aptitude spanning from battery cell fundamentals through C&I and utility-scale battery systems.
· Strong working knowledge of secondary battery chemistries, degradation mechanisms, system architectures, and operational limitations across diverse duty cycles.
· Practical experience with balance-of-system (BOS) equipment, including inverters, medium-voltage transformers, combiner boxes, DC/DC converters, EMS, and BMS platforms.
· Strong knowledge of NEC and applicable regulatory codes and standards for PV and energy storage installations, including NFPA 70 (NEC), IEEE 1547, UL 9540, UL 1741, and other relevant global standards.
· Working knowledge of grid connection and product compliance requirements applicable in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC, including Saudi Electricity Company grid connection requirements and SASO / GSO conformity schemes.
· Solid understanding of how energy storage and PV projects are constructed, commissioned, and brought online.
· Experience specifying or validating energy storage equipment for high-ambient-temperature environments.
· Ability to interpret operational data, apply statistical analysis techniques, and produce clear, actionable reports.
· Working knowledge of commercial contracts, performance guarantees, and how technical design and proposal assumptions must support contractual obligations.
· Familiarity with competitive energy storage products in the market and the ability to clearly articulate differentiated technical value.
· Proven ability to operate cross-functionally across engineering, product, sales, marketing, and field teams.
· Demonstrated ability to meet tight deadlines, manage multiple priorities, and maintain accountability for deliverables.
· Professional fluency in Arabic and English, written and spoken, with the ability to run technical discussions and present to customers in both languages.
· Based in Saudi Arabia and working remotely, with the right to work in the Kingdom.
· Willingness and ability to travel 10–20% to support customer engagement, project development, site validation, and industry events.

Mandatory Core Competencies
• Technical Depth & Range:
You are equally comfortable discussing electrochemical behavior at the cell level and reviewing single-line diagrams for multi-MW grid-connected systems. You can move seamlessly between modeling software and a job site.
• Pre-Sales & Commercial Orientation:
You understand that technical precision underpins revenue. Your expertise turns technical jargon into marketing differentiation. You support proposals that stand up to RFP scrutiny, independent engineer review, and contractual performance guarantees.
• Professional & Accountable:
You meet commitments, communicate proactively, and maintain composure and clarity under tight timelines and high-stakes customer interactions.

Ideal Mindset & Competencies
• Bridge Builder (Between Engineering and Revenue):
They see themselves as a strategic enabler of growth. Their technical clarity accelerates deal cycles, increases win rates, and strengthens customer confidence.
• Application-First Thinker:
They design around real operating profiles—capacity firming, arbitrage, peak shaving, resilience, grid services—ensuring systems are optimized for performance and economics. They are also a code master, ensuring all stakeholders are aligned with NEC, IEEE, UL, and applicable global standards.
• Commercially Fluent Engineer:
They understand contracts, guarantees, liquidated damages risk, and bankability requirements—and ensure technical proposals align with those realities.
• Market-Aware Technologist:
They track competitor capabilities and industry standards closely, positioning EnerVenue’s technology with precision and credibility.
• Disciplined Under Pressure:
They thrive under deadlines, balancing technical thoroughness with commercial urgency, and consistently deliver high-quality work on schedule.
• Forward-Thinking & Creative:
They anticipate evolving grid needs, emerging use cases, and new commercial models—bringing fresh thinking to how energy storage is designed, positioned, and deployed.

What EnerVenue Offers

• Unique opportunity to own full end-to-end technical application engineering work of a disruptive long-duration metal-hydrogen energy storage technology in the Middle East, the company’s key strategic growth market

• Direct alignment with EnerVenue’s manufacturing team and joint technical roadmap planning with product engineering team

• Competitive compensation package for mid-level technical leadership role including base salary and project performance bonus tied to successful bid delivery and project win rate

• Mid-level technical management position backed by top-tier global investors, with clear gigawatt-scale production capacity expansion roadmap based out of Changzhou, China to fully support Middle East market supply

• Join a mission-driven team developing 30-year service-life grid infrastructure energy storage equipment

• Full technical training resources, access to global electrochemical R&D data and field test cases, plus funding for regional industry conferences and standard certification upgrades

The Legal Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and following up on the company's legal matters, managing legal documentation, monitoring cases and claims, and ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations in Saudi Arabia. The role is performed on a part-time basis according to the agreed working schedule.

### Key Duties and Responsibilities

**1\. Legal Cases and Claims**

* Follow up on legal cases, disputes, and claims involving the company.
* Coordinate with external lawyers, legal consultants, and relevant authorities.
* Prepare and organize documents and supporting evidence required for legal proceedings.
* Monitor court hearing dates, legal deadlines, and case updates.
* Maintain updated records of ongoing legal matters.

**2\. Contracts and Agreements**

* Assist in preparing and reviewing contracts and legal agreements.
* Coordinate contract reviews and approvals with the relevant departments.
* Monitor contract expiration dates, renewals, and terminations.
* Maintain organized and confidential records of legal documents.

**3\. Legal Compliance**

* Monitor relevant changes in Saudi laws and regulations.
* Assist in ensuring company compliance with applicable legal requirements.
* Follow up on legal notices, violations, and official correspondence.
* Identify potential legal risks and report them to management.

**4\. Government and Legal Authorities**

* Coordinate legal transactions with government and judicial authorities.
* Follow up on cases and requests through relevant government platforms, including Najiz.
* Prepare official letters and legal correspondence.
* Monitor the implementation of legal decisions and required procedures.

**5\. Employment and Labor Matters**

* Coordinate with the HR Department regarding labor disputes and employee-related legal matters.
* Prepare and organize documents related to employment contracts, warnings, investigations, and terminations.
* Follow up on labor complaints and claims.
* Support the preparation of legal documentation related to disciplinary procedures.

**6\. Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare periodic reports on legal cases, claims, contracts, and pending matters.
* Maintain accurate and updated legal records.
* Ensure confidentiality of all company legal information.
* Complete assigned legal tasks within the required deadlines.
* Perform other related duties assigned by management.

### Qualifications and Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, or a related field.
* **Must have completed legal training or be currently undergoing training at a licensed law firm.**
* Good knowledge of Saudi labor and commercial laws.
* Familiarity with Saudi government and legal platforms.
* Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Ability to handle confidential information professionally.

### Work Schedule

This is a **part-time position**, with working hours determined by mutual agreement based on the company's operational requirements. The employee must ensure timely follow-up on assigned legal matters and meet all applicable deadlines.

### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely follow-up on legal cases and deadlines.
* Accuracy and completeness of legal documentation.
* Regular updates on pending legal matters.
* Effective coordination with lawyers and relevant departments.
* Completion of assigned tasks within agreed timelines.

**Note:** The Legal Coordinator performs administrative and legal coordination duties. Providing independent legal opinions or representing the company before courts is subject to applicable professional licensing requirements and company authorization.

## **Position Overview:**

  

The Project-Specific Procurement Manager will manage the delivery phase of an active project where procurement orders have already been placed. This role focuses on developing comprehensive tracking systems, maintaining constant communication with vendors regarding delivery schedules, and ensuring all materials and equipment arrive on time to support project milestones.

  

## **Key Responsibilities:**

### **Tracker Development and Management**

* Design and implement comprehensive tracking systems to monitor all outstanding purchase orders from current status through final delivery
* Create detailed spreadsheets or dashboards capturing order numbers, item descriptions, quantities, vendors, original delivery dates, updated ETAs, shipping status, and receipt confirmation
* Develop status reporting formats that provide at-a-glance visibility of critical deliveries, items at risk, and completed receipts

  

### **Vendor Communication and Follow-Up**

* Contact vendors systematically to obtain and verify delivery dates for all outstanding orders
* Establish regular communication cadence with each supplier based on delivery urgency and item criticality
* Send follow-up emails and make phone calls to confirm shipping schedules, obtain tracking numbers, and secure updated delivery commitments
* Request shipping documentation including bills of lading, air waybills, and delivery confirmations

  

### **Delivery Schedule Management**

* Obtain confirmed delivery dates from all vendors and update project teams on expected arrival timelines
* Compare vendor-committed dates against project schedule requirements and identify gaps or conflicts
* Push vendors to accelerate deliveries when original dates no longer align with project needs
* Negotiate revised delivery schedules when delays are unavoidable and communicate impacts to stakeholders  
      
    

### **Proactive Issue Identification and Escalation**

* Monitor vendor communications and shipping status to identify potential delays before they impact the project
* Flag at-risk deliveries immediately and work with vendors to develop mitigation plans
* Escalate significant delays or vendor performance issues to project leadership with recommended solutions
* Track recurring problems with specific vendors and document patterns for future reference

  

### **Stakeholder Communication and Reporting**

* Provide weekly status reports to project managers showing all deliveries expected in the upcoming period and any items experiencing delays
* Communicate delivery updates promptly when schedules change or new information becomes available
* Participate in project coordination meetings to discuss material status and upcoming deliveries

  

### **Delivery Coordination**

* Confirm site readiness and receiving capacity before materials arrive
* Notify on-site teams of upcoming deliveries with sufficient advance notice for planning
* Coordinate delivery appointments with vendors and receiving personnel to ensure smooth unloading

  

### **Documentation and Record Keeping**

* Maintain organized files of all purchase orders, vendor correspondence, shipping documents, and delivery confirmations
* Update tracking systems immediately when materials are received to reflect actual delivery dates
* Document any discrepancies between ordered quantities and delivered quantities

  

## **Qualifications:**

  

### **Required Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Minimum 7 years of experience in procurement, logistics coordination, or materials management roles
* Proven track record of managing delivery schedules and tracking multiple concurrent orders across diverse suppliers
* Experience working in project environments where timely material delivery is critical to success

  

### **Technical Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including complex formulas, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and dashboard creation
* Experience building tracking spreadsheets and status reporting tools from scratch
* Comfortable with project management software and collaboration platforms
* Ability to work with shipping and logistics tracking systems
* Strong data management skills with attention to accuracy and detail in record-keeping

  

### **Professional Competencies**

* Exceptional organizational skills with ability to manage high volumes of information across numerous vendors and orders
* Persistent follow-up mentality with comfort making repeated vendor contacts to obtain needed information
* Clear and professional communication skills for interacting with vendors, project teams, and stakeholders at all levels
* Proactive problem-solving approach with ability to identify issues before they escalate
* Strong sense of urgency and understanding of how material delays impact project timelines
* Detail-oriented with ability to catch discrepancies and ensure data accuracy
* Adaptability to work in dynamic project environments where priorities shift frequently

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in construction, real estate development, or facilities management procurement
* Familiarity with shipping terminology, logistics processes, and freight tracking
* Prior experience implementing tracking systems or procurement management tools
* Understanding of critical path methodology and project scheduling concepts
* Knowledge of inventory management principles and materials receiving processes

As a member of the Middle East Engineering Support team, this candidate will be expected to work closely with regional and operational managers to ensure H&P’s engineering needs are met for each middle east country that we operate in. * Knowledgeable with hydraulic systems

* Excellent communication and organizational skills
* Strong Ability to work and communicate with office, shop, and oil field personnel.

    and rig locations.

description:
About FlyAkeed

FlyAkeed is a Saudi-based online travel platform that simplifies flight and hotel bookings and provides integrated travel solutions, with a particular focus on business and corporate travel.

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, FlyAkeed is supported by leading investors, including Sanabil Investments, a PIF subsidiary, Elm, Artal Capital, and Alrajhi Partners.

About the Opportunity

As part of the **Wa’ed Program**, FlyAkeed is offering an opportunity for Saudi talent at the beginning of their professional careers to join the company as a **Travel Ambassador**.

This is an **Entry-Level Employment opportunity** designed for candidates who have a strong interest in travel, customer service, and corporate travel and are looking to build a long-term career in the travel industry.

The successful candidate will receive on-the-job exposure and development opportunities in travel booking, corporate travel management, customer service, and VVIP traveler support.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and manage travel itineraries based on traveler preferences, company policies, and budget requirements.
* Assist with booking flights, hotels, car rentals, and other travel-related services.
* Learn and utilize Global Distribution Systems (GDS) and other travel booking platforms and industry tools.
* Provide professional, personalized, and high-quality customer service to corporate and VVIP travelers.
* Serve as a point of contact for assigned customers and assist with their travel-related requests.
* Communicate with travelers through phone, email, and other communication channels in a professional and timely manner.
* Monitor bookings and ensure all travel arrangements are accurate and aligned with company policies and approved travel guidelines.
* Assist travelers with changes, cancellations, delays, and other travel-related issues while minimizing disruption to their journey.
* Anticipate customer needs and recommend appropriate travel solutions to enhance the overall travel experience.
* Coordinate with airlines, hotels, car rental companies, and other travel service providers when required.
* Maintain accurate records of bookings, transactions, and customer communications.
* Handle customer information and travel details with a high level of confidentiality and professionalism.
* Develop knowledge of FlyAkeed’s services, values, and unique offerings and represent the company professionally.
* Stay informed about travel destinations, travel requirements, regulations, and industry trends.
* Collaborate with team members to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction and service quality.
* Continuously develop knowledge and skills in corporate travel, customer service, and travel management.

.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Hospitality, Tourism, Travel & Tourism, Business Administration, or a related field**.
* **Entry-Level position** suitable for candidates at the beginning of their professional careers.
* **Minimum of 1 year of relevant work experience** in travel, tourism, hospitality, customer service, or a related field.

* Good command of English, both written and spoken.

JOB PURPOSE

Carry out field inspections of utility excavation works across Riyadh Region on behalf of the Riyadh Infrastructure Projects Center (RIPC), verifying that sites are reinstated in line with approved checklists and specifications, and documenting findings through the digital inspection platform to support timely and accurate permit closure.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

▪ Conduct daily field visits to completed utility excavation sites assigned through the inspection platform.

▪ Inspect backfilling, asphalt reinstatement, surface restoration, kerbs, pavements and road markings against the approved RIPC checklist.

▪ Take measurements (length, width, levels) and capture clear geo-tagged photos of every inspected item.

▪ Record observations and non-conformities accurately in the mobile inspection application and submit reports on time.

▪ Respond to reviewer comments and re-inspect sites when required.

▪ Maintain the company vehicle, mobile device and measuring tools in good condition and follow the vehicle-use policy.

▪ Comply with site safety requirements and always wear the required

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

▪ Education: Diploma in Civil, Architectural, Surveying, Electrical, Mechanical or Quality Engineering Technology.

▪ Experience: 0–2 years; recent graduates (2025 onwards) are preferred.

▪ Advantage: Co-op training or site exposure in construction, roads or infrastructure.

▪ Licence: Valid Saudi driving licence (mandatory). SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

▪ Technical: Basic knowledge of excavation, backfilling and asphalt works; reading drawings; use of measuring tools; smartphone apps and digital reporting.

▪ Behavioral: Attention to detail, integrity, time discipline, teamwork and clear communication.

## **Job Summary**

The Senior BIM Engineer supports the development, coordination, quality assurance, and delivery of architectural Building Information Models for large-scale and mega projects across the project lifecycle.

The role collaborates with project owners, architects, engineers, contractors, subcontractors, and BIM service providers to improve multidisciplinary coordination, identify design conflicts, strengthen project documentation, and support construction efficiency, cost control, scheduling, and effective project delivery.

The position produces coordinated BIM models and drawings, maintains model and revision controls, performs clash detection, derives quantities, supports project-specific BIM guidelines and close-out documentation, and assists project personnel in the effective use of BIM tools and workflows.

## **Job Responsibilities 1**

**BIM Model Development & Documentation**

Develop, update, and manage schematic, detailed-design, construction, and as-built architectural BIM models in accordance with approved project requirements and delivery schedules.

Use Autodesk Revit for architectural modeling, documentation, schedules, sheets, details, families, and other BIM deliverables.

Prepare coordinated BIM models, shop drawings, drawing sets, model views, schedules, and supporting documentation accurately and on time.

Create and maintain project-specific Revit families and library components.

**Model Coordination & Clash Detection**

Coordinate architectural models with structural, MEP, civil, specialist, and construction models.

Use Navisworks for federated model review, clash detection, issue identification, and coordination tracking.

Identify design conflicts, incomplete or ambiguous information, constructability concerns, and coordination risks.

Develop model views and visualizations to illustrate contractor questions, proposed solutions, and sequencing requirements.

**BIM Standards, Quality & Information Management**

Apply BIM Execution Plans, modeling standards, naming conventions, LOD/LOI requirements, and common data environment workflows.

Perform model-quality reviews covering geometry, information completeness, coordinates, model health, documentation consistency, and compliance.

Maintain BIM revision logs, issue registers, model exchange records, and accurate audit trails.

Support project-specific BIM guidelines, templates, checklists, and procedures.

**Project Delivery & Construction Support**

Support construction coordination, scheduling, quantity derivation, and model-based review of planned activities.

Derive and validate material quantities to support estimation, procurement, cost reporting, and forecasting.

Provide model-based inputs for change orders, notices, design revisions, and project-control requirements.

Produce drawing sets and model outputs for reviews, workshops, site coordination, and stakeholder presentations.

**Stakeholder Coordination, Training & Close-Out**

Coordinate deliverables with consultants, BIM service providers, subcontractors, and internal project disciplines.

Participate in BIM coordination meetings, design reviews, and clash-resolution sessions, tracking actions through closure.

Assist the BIM Manager in training project personnel on BIM tools, standards, and project-specific requirements.

Assist in compiling final coordinated models, as-built information, registers, and contractual BIM close-out documentation.

## **Job Responsibilities 2**

## **Additional Responsibilities 3**

## **Job Knowledge & Skills**

**Architectural BIM Delivery:** Strong knowledge of architectural modeling, construction documentation, model progression, and BIM deliverables.

**BIM Standards & Workflows:** Sound knowledge of BIM Execution Plans, model standards, common data environments, information exchanges, and quality workflows.

**Construction & Coordination Knowledge:** Ability to interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings and identify coordination and constructability issues.

**Communication & Collaboration:** Excellent communication and coordination skills across multidisciplinary, contractor, consultant, and client teams.

**Planning, Accuracy & Independent Delivery:** Ability to organize priorities, meet deadlines, maintain accurate records, and work with minimal supervision.

## **Job Experience**

**Professional Experience:** Minimum 4 years of experience in BIM Architecture, architectural modeling, or BIM coordination.

**Project Scale:** Demonstrated experience supporting large-scale or mega projects.

**Complex Project Environment:** Experience delivering BIM solutions on large-scale, multidisciplinary, and high-value projects involving multiple stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and subcontractors across international or regional markets is preferred.

**BIM Delivery:** Hands-on experience producing models, coordinated drawings, clash reports, quantities, revision records, and close-out deliverables.

**Multidisciplinary Coordination:** Experience collaborating with architects, engineers, contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and BIM service providers

* Ensures compliance with applicable QHSE instructions, requirements, laws, and regulations imposed by customers, regulatory bodies, and statutory authorities.

**About Lucidya**

Lucidya builds an operating system for Agentic customer experience. Our flagship product line is an agentic platform (Agent Studio) where customers build and run AI agents that resolve real customer experience issues across text and voice channels, in Arabic and English.

**Role summary**

The AI Tech Lead is the senior hands-on engineer accountable for the quality, reliability and technical direction of the AI layer of our agentic platform. You will set the technical bar for a team of AI engineers who each own an area, and you will write production code yourself.  You will need to wear 2 hats, one is the AI hat and the other is leadership

**Key responsibilities**

Technical direction

* Own and be accountable for the AI  architecture and harness: model selection, prompting patterns, retrieval design, guardrails and voice pipeline.
* Make and document technical decisions with clear rationale.

Quality, evaluation and reliability

* Define the evaluation standard and move key work from experimentation to production
* Introduce leading testing frameworks for Agentic development
* Ensure production monitoring and online evals catch quality drops, hallucinations and latency spikes before customers report them.

Team leadership and engineering practices

* Lead the AI team in designing, developing, and delivering our Agentic Platform
* Mentor AI engineers, raise the technical bar through pairing and feedback, and contribute to hiring.

Hands-on delivery

* Lead debugging of critical production incidents involving AI behaviour.
* Manage the building of prototypes/experiments  to validate new capabilities (new models, agent patterns, voice features) before the team commits to them.

Cross-functional partnership

* Work with Product to turn customer use cases into technical requirements
* Work with Engineering on shared platform work: tool calling, workflows, deployment and scaling.

Mindset and Behaviors

* Ownership: takes outcomes end to end, including gaps between teams, and follows through without being asked.
* Trade-off judgement: grounds decisions in business needs and can explain the trade-offs between quality, speed and cost.
* Constructive challenge: comfortable questioning existing approaches and proposing better ones.
* Team player: shares credit, helps teammates succeed, and puts team goals ahead of individual wins.
* Creativity and innovation: solve complex challenges with 'out-of-box' thinking and be a champion for innovation

**Requirements**

* Experience: 7+ years in software or ML engineering, including 2+ years building LLM-based applications in production. Not just building AI point solutions, AI platform level experience is required.
* Technical leadership: has led a team of 3+ AI engineers/scientist technically (design reviews, standards, mentoring)
* LLM application engineering: deep hands-on experience with prompting, structured outputs, guardrails, agent patterns/harness development (planning, tool use, multi-step reasoning).
* Ability to work in ambiguous settings: can bring clarity and structure to complex situations
* Evaluation: has built LLM evaluation pipelines (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression suites) and used them to gate releases.
* Production engineering: strong Python; experience with APIs, cloud deployment, observability and debugging distributed systems.
* Communication: fluent written and spoken English; able to write clear design docs and decision records.

Nice-to-have qualifications

* Arabic NLP: experience with Arabic and its dialects, especially Gulf Arabic, in LLM or speech systems.
* Voice AI: experience with ASR, TTS and real-time voice agents, including latency optimisation.
* Production monitoring for LLMs: hands-on use of tracing and online eval tools (for example Langfuse, Arize or similar).
* Model adaptation: fine-tuning or distilling open-weight models, and serving them cost-effectively.

### About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Intelligence platform enabling enterprises to understand, engage, and retain customers at scale. Unlike tools that just surface insights, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary AI capabilities, helping teams take action and improve customer experiences across marketing, support, and research.

As we scale globally, building reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure is a top priority. DevOps is a core pillar of our engineering strategy, and we are investing heavily in deployment pipelines, observability, and operational efficiency across all products.

### Why This Role Matters

Our engineering teams deliver fast-moving, AI-driven products, and the backbone of their speed and reliability is solid infrastructure and automation. As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll ensure our systems scale seamlessly, deployments happen without friction, and incidents are caught before they impact users. You’ll enable our teams to move faster, focus on building features, and trust that the platform is rock-solid.

You’ll be part of shaping the operational culture at Lucidya, where automation, reliability, and proactive problem solving aren’t just buzzwords, they’re outcomes we obsess over every day.

### What You’ll Do

* Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to support reliable and efficient software delivery.
* Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Support cloud infrastructure management and automation using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using tools such as Grafana.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks and support development teams with infrastructure and deployment needs.
* Troubleshoot deployment, application, and infrastructure issues, identifying root causes and implementing solutions.
* Collaborate with engineers to improve system performance, reliability, and release processes.
* Follow security best practices across deployment pipelines, applications, and infrastructure.
* Participate in incident investigation and resolution, escalating complex issues when necessary.
* Contribute to documentation and continuous improvement of infrastructure workflows and operational processes.

### Day-to-Day You’ll:

* Deploy applications and support routine operations within Kubernetes environments.
* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines for new and existing services.
* Monitor system health, investigate alerts, and resolve common deployment and infrastructure issues.
* Support developers with application deployments, environment configurations, and infrastructure requests.
* Write and maintain scripts to automate repetitive operational tasks.
* Assist with infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
* Collaborate with senior engineers to investigate complex incidents and improve system reliability.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation, observability, and operational efficiency.

### Success Looks Like:

* Reliable CI/CD pipelines with fewer deployment failures and smoother releases.
* Successful deployment and operation of containerized applications in Kubernetes.
* Faster identification and resolution of common infrastructure and deployment issues.
* Reduced manual operational effort through automation.
* Improved monitoring, logging, and visibility into application health.
* Effective collaboration with engineering teams and clear documentation of operational processes.

### First 90 Days

* 0–30 Days: Understand Lucidya’s infrastructure, architecture, deployment workflows, tools, and operational practices. Become familiar with existing cloud environments and Kubernetes deployments.
* 30–60 Days: Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, support routine deployments, troubleshoot common issues, and take ownership of smaller infrastructure tasks with guidance from senior engineers.
* 60–90 Days: Successfully onboard 2–3 services onto the existing Kubernetes environment, with appropriate CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and health checks, collaborating with senior engineers where needed.

**Requirements**

### Who You Are

* Experienced: You have 1–3 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or a related role.
* Hands-On: You have practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.
* Proactive Problem Solver: You can investigate common technical issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions while knowing when to escalate complex problems.
* Collaborative: You work closely with developers and other engineers to support deployments and improve infrastructure reliability.
* Curious & Growth-Oriented: You are eager to learn, improve existing systems, and develop your expertise in cloud infrastructure, automation, and observability.
* Quality-Focused: You understand the importance of reliable deployments, infrastructure security, monitoring, and operational documentation.

### Technical Skills You’ll Bring

* CI/CD: Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or improving CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar.
* Containers & Orchestration: Practical experience with Docker and working knowledge of Kubernetes, including application deployments, configurations, and troubleshooting.
* Infrastructure as Code: Familiarity with Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools for provisioning and managing infrastructure.
* Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider, such as AWS or GCP.
* Scripting & Automation: Ability to write basic automation scripts using Bash or Python.
* Monitoring & Observability: Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or similar.
* Configuration Management: Basic knowledge of tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
* Linux & Networking: Working knowledge of Linux systems, networking fundamentals, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
* Version Control: Experience using Git and working with collaborative software development workflows.

### Nice-to-Haves

* Exposure to production Kubernetes environments and container orchestration.
* Familiarity with advanced monitoring, observability, and incident management practices.
* Understanding of cloud security, secrets management, and infrastructure access controls.
* Experience optimizing deployment workflows and improving infrastructure reliability.

About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Intelligence platform that helps organizations understand customer conversations, uncover actionable insights, and improve customer experiences through advanced AI capabilities.

As the platform continues to grow, maintaining reliable, secure, and high-performing data infrastructure is critical to supporting our customers and enabling continuous product innovation.

Our database environment spans multiple cloud platforms and hosting environments, supporting business-critical workloads, high-volume data ingestion, and multi-tenant applications. We are looking for a Database Administrator who can help strengthen our database operations, improve resilience, and ensure our data infrastructure remains reliable as we scale.

Why this role matters

Our database infrastructure is growing in both scale and complexity. With production PostgreSQL and MySQL environments running across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and our in-Kingdom hosting environment, maintaining database availability, performance, and recoverability is essential to the reliability of our platform.

As a Database Administrator, you’ll take ownership of the health and operational reliability of our production databases. You’ll work on challenges that go beyond routine administration, including multi-terabyte database environments, high-availability architecture, disaster recovery, major-version upgrades, and safe database migrations.

You’ll also work closely with engineering, cloud, and reliability teams to help developers make better database decisions, prevent production incidents, and improve the way database changes are designed and delivered.

If you enjoy solving complex database performance challenges, building resilient data infrastructure, and taking ownership of critical production systems, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

What You’ll Do

* Manage and maintain PostgreSQL and MySQL databases across AWS, GCP, and self-managed environments.
* Monitor database performance, availability, and capacity.
* Optimize queries, indexing, and database resource utilization.
* Manage backups, point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery.
* Implement database replication, high availability, and failover strategies.
* Plan database upgrades, migrations, and safe schema changes.
* Maintain database security, access controls, and auditing.
* Automate database operations using Bash, Python, or similar tools.
* Troubleshoot database incidents and perform root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, SRE, and Cloud teams to improve database reliability and scalability.

What success looks like (First 90–120 Days)

First 30 days:

* You’ve developed a clear understanding of the production database estate across AWS, GCP, and SITE.
* You understand the existing database architecture, operational workflows, monitoring, and recovery procedures.
* You’ve built strong working relationships with the database team, Cloud Engineering, SRE, and development teams.
* You’ve identified the most significant risks and improvement opportunities across availability, performance, backup, and recovery.

By day 60:

* You’re independently handling assigned database administration and troubleshooting activities.
* You’ve reviewed backup configurations and started validating recovery procedures for critical databases.
* You’ve identified gaps in database monitoring and alerting, including replication lag, WAL contention, autovacuum, and table bloat.
* You’re contributing to database performance improvements and operational documentation.

By day 90:

* Critical database restore tests have been completed or are progressing against an agreed recovery-testing plan, with gaps documented and corrective actions defined.
* Key database failure scenarios are documented through practical runbooks.
* Database monitoring and alerting improvements have been implemented for prioritized operational risks.
* You’re actively contributing to database reliability, performance, and incident-prevention initiatives.

By day 120:

* A safer database change-management process is in place, including appropriate reviews, DDL auditing, and rollback planning.
* A practical PostgreSQL major-upgrade roadmap has been developed, with compatibility and migration risks assessed.
* The high-availability approach for the SITE database environment has been evaluated and documented.
* Database size and activity metrics are available to support the per-customer cost-allocation initiative.

**Requirements**

Who You Are

You’re an experienced Database Administrator who understands that managing production databases is about more than keeping services running. You know how to prevent data loss, diagnose complex performance problems, plan high-risk changes, and build systems that remain reliable under pressure.

You’re comfortable working with large, business-critical databases and can balance operational stability with the need to improve architecture, automation, and scalability.

### Technically, you likely:

* Have 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration experience in production.
* Have experience with AWS Aurora, Amazon RDS, MySQL, and self-managed Linux databases.
* Understand database performance tuning, replication, high availability, and disaster recovery.
* Have experience managing multi-terabyte databases, upgrades, and migrations.
* Can automate database operations using Bash or Python.

### When it comes to database resilience:

* You have hands-on experience with backups, recovery, replication, and failover.
* You can troubleshoot database incidents and minimize downtime.
* You follow safe change-management practices and maintain rollback plans.

### When it comes to database performance:

* You can troubleshoot slow queries, indexing, locking, and resource utilization.
* You understand PostgreSQL internals and multi-tenant database challenges.

### What sets you apart:

* You take ownership and remain calm under pressure.
* You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
* You document your work and continuously improve database reliability.

Nice to Have (but not required)

* Experience with multi-tenant database architectures, particularly schema-per-tenant environments with thousands of schemas.
* Experience managing databases larger than several terabytes with high write volumes and demanding availability requirements.
* Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL tooling such as Patroni, pgBackRest, or WAL-G.
* Experience supporting cloud migrations or moving customer workloads to in-Kingdom hosting environments.
* Familiarity with database observability, capacity planning, and per-customer database usage or cost allocation.
* Experience working in SaaS, data-platform, fintech, banking, or telecommunications environments.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools and automated database provisioning.
* Relevant certifications, such as EDB PostgreSQL or AWS certifications.

What the hiring process will look like

* Mawhub screening
* Technical screen (45 min) — \[DB Lead\]
* Technical deep-dive (60–90 min) with a practical scenario: diagnosing replication lag and WAL contention, planning a zero-downtime major upgrade — \[DB Lead + SRE Team Lead\]
* Hiring manager interview — Mahmoud Moharam, Cloud Manager
* Culture fit interview - HR Director
