**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Application Security Engineer based in Saudi Arabia.**

Help establish and scale a dedicated application security function within a high-growth technology environment where protecting customers against fraud and abuse is a core priority. As a senior individual contributor, you will combine deep security expertise with hands-on software engineering to identify vulnerabilities, strengthen development workflows, and build practical security tooling. You will design secure software development practices, lead threat modeling and security reviews, and drive vulnerability remediation across complex APIs, SDKs, and cloud-based systems. Working closely with engineering teams and security leadership, you will integrate AI-powered tools into security testing and remediation while maintaining rigorous quality standards. This role offers substantial technical autonomy, opportunities to influence engineering practices across the organization, and the chance to solve challenging security problems at scale. You will help make security an integral part of product development rather than a separate compliance requirement.

### Accountabilities:

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you will serve as the technical foundation of the application security function, translating security strategy into effective engineering practices, tools, and measurable improvements. Your responsibilities will include:

* Design and implement a secure software development lifecycle (SDLC), incorporating security requirements, design-time threat modeling, secure code reviews, and pre-release testing into existing engineering workflows.
    
* Own and improve application security tooling, including static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), dependency scanning, secrets detection, and container and infrastructure-as-code scanning.
    
* Integrate security tools into CI/CD pipelines, reduce false positives, establish clear vulnerability ownership and remediation service-level agreements (SLAs), and ensure findings lead to meaningful action.
    
* Develop an AI-first security engineering approach using AI-assisted vulnerability triage, automated remediation, security review agents, and AI-augmented testing, with evidence-based controls governing what these tools can flag, block, or fix.
    
* Build reusable security patterns, hardened libraries, and secure defaults for authentication, authorization, input validation, secrets management, and cryptographic operations.
    
* Contribute directly to production codebases by implementing security fixes, developing security libraries, and building automation and CI integrations.
    
* Lead threat modeling and architecture security reviews for new products, features, and significant technical changes across APIs, web and mobile SDKs, dashboards, and data pipelines.
    
* Manage vulnerability identification, risk assessment, prioritization, and remediation for findings from security scanners, penetration tests, bug bounty reports, and customer disclosures.
    
* Conduct hands-on security testing, including manual code review and exploitation testing for authentication and authorization weaknesses, API vulnerabilities, injection attacks, server-side request forgery (SSRF), business-logic flaws, and abuse scenarios.
    
* Pay particular attention to adversarial threats involving fraud detection and bot mitigation, identifying weaknesses that could allow attackers to bypass or undermine platform protections.
    
* Collaborate with penetration testing and compliance specialists to scope assessments, validate fixes, retest findings, and translate technical discoveries into actionable engineering work.
    
* Lead technical investigations of application-layer security incidents, coordinating containment, root-cause analysis, remediation, and collaboration with cloud infrastructure teams when necessary.
    
* Define application security logging and alerting requirements and partner with engineering and cloud platform teams to implement effective detection capabilities.
    
* Support engineering teams through security consultations, office hours, secure coding guidance, and a Security Champions program that expands security expertise across the organization.
    
* Develop practical secure coding training based on real application code, vulnerabilities, and lessons learned from security incidents.
    
* Mentor engineers through code reviews and architecture feedback, helping improve security awareness and engineering quality without relying solely on mandates.
    
* Partner with application security leadership to shape technical priorities, communicate findings and risk assessments, and execute initiatives that advance the broader security roadmap.
    
* Provide technical evidence for security controls, contribute to vendor security assessments, and support enterprise customer due diligence, security questionnaires, architecture discussions, and penetration testing summaries.
    

**Requirements:**

The ideal candidate is an accomplished security engineer who combines strong software development skills with extensive practical application security experience. You should be comfortable independently driving complex initiatives, working directly within engineering repositories, and influencing technical decisions across teams. Required qualifications include:

* At least 8 years of experience in software engineering and/or security engineering, including 5 or more years focused on application security.
    
* Experience building or improving application security programs within a product engineering organization, with a strong emphasis on hands-on implementation rather than consulting or auditing alone.
    
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to write production-quality code in TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Python, or a comparable language.
    
* Familiarity with modern web applications, APIs, software architectures, source code repositories, and CI/CD pipelines.
    
* Deep practical application security expertise, including OWASP Top 10 and related vulnerabilities, authentication and authorization design, API security, injection attacks, SSRF, cryptographic misuse, business-logic flaws, and abuse scenarios.
    
* Ability to identify vulnerabilities through manual testing, explain their real-world impact, and propose practical fixes that engineering teams can implement.
    
* Demonstrated experience leading threat modeling and architecture security reviews for complex systems and producing threat models that inform engineering decisions.
    
* Experience deploying, configuring, and tuning SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, and related security tooling within CI/CD workflows.
    
* Practical experience using AI-assisted security tools for code analysis, vulnerability triage, or automated remediation in real-world environments.
    
* Regular use of AI agents in security work, with a clear understanding of their limitations, reliability, false-positive risks, and appropriate level of autonomy.
    
* Experience owning vulnerability management processes, including triage, severity classification, remediation tracking, penetration testing follow-up, and enforcement of remediation SLAs.
    
* Proven ability to influence engineering teams through technical credibility, effective collaboration, well-designed tools, and actionable guidance rather than formal authority alone.
    
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce precise security findings and explain technical risks to engineers, leadership, and customer security teams.
    
* Strong analytical skills, sound technical judgment, and the ability to work independently on ambiguous, multi-quarter initiatives.
    

**Nice-to-have qualifications:**

* Experience in fraud detection, bot mitigation, identity security, or device intelligence.
    
* Strong cloud security knowledge, particularly AWS IAM, network boundaries, secrets management, and workload identity.
    
* Familiarity with cloud security posture management tools such as Wiz or equivalent solutions.
    
* Experience securing client-side applications and mobile SDKs, including browser security, anti-tampering techniques, obfuscation tradeoffs, and iOS or Android SDK hardening.
    
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms and high-volume, latency-sensitive APIs.
    
* Experience operating a bug bounty program through platforms such as HackerOne, Bugcrowd, or equivalent services.
    
* Awareness of AI and machine learning security risks, including prompt injection, LLM-integrated features, agent permissions, and model or data-pipeline vulnerabilities.
    
* Experience with autonomous or AI-augmented penetration testing and attack simulation, including an understanding of how these approaches complement human-led testing.
    
* Relevant security certifications, such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, or CSSLP, or evidence of security research, published CVEs, or open-source security contributions.
    
* Experience implementing or supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls as the engineering owner responsible for making them operational.
    

**Benefits:**

* Annual base salary ranging from $177,000 to $240,000, depending on location, experience, and expertise.
    
* Location-based salary examples include $209,000–$240,000 for New York City and $177,000–$204,000 for Chicago.
    
* Fully remote work environment, subject to geographic and regulatory restrictions.
    
* Significant technical autonomy and the opportunity to shape the application security function from its early stages.
    
* Executive-level support for application security initiatives and collaboration with dedicated security leadership.
    
* Opportunity to focus on hands-on engineering, security tooling, vulnerability discovery, and remediation rather than primarily administrative compliance work.
    
* Access to an established security technology environment that includes tools such as Snyk, Wiz, Cloudflare, and Okta.
    
* Collaboration with cloud platform, engineering, and compliance specialists who treat security as a shared responsibility.
    
* Opportunities to influence enterprise security practices and protect high-volume systems against sophisticated fraud and abuse threats.
    
* An inclusive, globally distributed working environment that values diverse perspectives and professional contributions.

HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineer with a strong irrigation background to join our client-side programme and construction management (PMCM) team on a major government land-development and infrastructure programme in Riyadh. * Review close-out deliverables, including as-built drawings, O&M manuals and plans, warranty certificates, spare-parts lists and commissioning certificates. Witness the contractor’s training of operations staff on the irrigation systems.

* More than 15 years of experience on infrastructure, land-development or large-scale landscape projects, with substantial hands-on experience in irrigation and pumping systems.

* Excellent reporting, communication and coordination skills, and the ability to work with contractors, developers and utility authorities.
* Professional written and spoken English and/or Arabic. Both are an advantage.

description:
This role is being recruited in accordance with the Saudi Nationalization Scheme and as such we require a Saudi National for this opportunity

  

**Who we are looking for**

An experienced Compliance professional and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) to manage the State Street Saudi Arabia Financial Services (SSSAFS) Compliance and Financial Crimes programmes and provide Compliance advisory support to the SSSAFS business units.  The individual will ideally have extensive knowledge of the Capital Market Authority (CMA) regulatory requirements and products offered to clients through SSSAFS.  Experience in working in an international capital market institution is preferred.  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role you will strive for cutting-edge solutions, that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best. Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

  

**What you will be responsible for**

As Chief Compliance Officer and MLRO you will:

* Manage the assessment of Compliance and Financial Crimes risks.
* Execute and deliver on the regulatory compliance oversight programme for SSSAFS, ensuring compliance with the Capital Market Authority (CMA) rules.
* Develop and maintain good working relationships with the SSSAFS business, providing advisory support to assist with regulatory queries, and ensuring closure of any Compliance issues within a timely manner. Consult, advise and support management on compliance and regulatory matters that affect business decisions and the execution of their duties.
* Act as Compliance and Financial Crimes representative in governance committees and forums.
* Produce written reports for Senior Management on the Compliance risk opinion and delivery of the Compliance and Financial Crimes Compliance programmes for SSSAFS, indicating progress achieved and any significant matters requiring attention.  Deliver the reports in governance committees and forums, as required.
* Identify training needs and ensure successful implementation of Compliance and Financial Crimes training and education for all relevant staff within the SSSAFS business.  Coordinate with the other locations to ensure consistency where appropriate.
* Ensure the effective management of the local Compliance policy framework including review and input to regional/global policies, communication of policies and their key requirements to staff as required. This may include developing, implementing, promoting and maintaining compliance standards and procedures that require employees to act in a compliant manner.
* Keep abreast of regulatory and legislative updates or changes, analyse and interpret the regulation and legislation (new and current as required). Provide de-brief and feedback to peers and business stakeholders as required. Contribute to the GRCM process, as required.
* Play an active role in SSSAFS strategic initiatives, providing expertise on specific regulatory and compliance risks linked to specific projects.
* Foster good relationships and manage ongoing interactions with the CMA (e.g. regulatory inspections, regulatory licences, registered individual applications, regulatory reporting, etc.).

  
  

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role

* Risk management
* Influencing others
* Decision making
* Attention to detail
* Teamwork

  

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Educated to degree level
* CMA certificates: CME 1 **and** CME 2 are a must have
* Working knowledge of SSSAFS business products and CMA regulatory requirements
* 8+ years of related experience including previous experience managing staff

job_title: Senior Vice President, POM Product Management (Saudi Arabia)
description:
Job Description

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Regional Product, Data & and Solutions Lead, Middle East & Africa to join our Data & Analytics team, the fintech arm of BNY. This role is located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with responsibility across the broader Middle East and Africa region.
The role will serve as the national & regional representative, product advocate and technical solutions lead for BNY’s Data & Analytics portfolio, including Eagle Accounting, Performance and Data Management, pControl from Milestone Group, Data Vault, and related data and cloud capabilities. The successful candidate will combine product leadership, pre-sales engineering, data expertise, and regulatory awareness to identify opportunities, engage customers, shape solutions, and translate regional requirements into global product priorities.
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
Act as the KSA National regulatory and data representative, maintaining awareness of emerging regulatory, data-residency, security, cloud, and compliance requirements across the Middle East and Africa. Work with Risk, Legal, Compliance, Data Governance, and Technology teams to assess product implications and ensure solutions are appropriate for regional clients and markets.
Serve as the regional product and solutions representative for clients and prospects, engaging directly with customers when opportunities arise, understanding their business and data challenges, and communicating the capabilities, value propositions, and product roadmaps of BNY’s Data & Analytics solutions.
Drive regional product adoption and execution, working entrepreneurially across organizational boundaries to move opportunities forward. This includes supporting the field when necessary, coordinating product and data dependencies, developing reusable solution patterns and documentation, building regional partnerships, and helping convert client feedback into scalable product capabilities.
Own and advocate for the regional product strategy, identifying market opportunities, competitive dynamics, client needs, and regional priorities. Partner with global product managers, engineering teams, Product Solutions, Sales, Services, and Support to influence roadmaps, prioritize execution, and ensure regional requirements are understood and addressed.
Support technical pre-sales activities, including product demonstrations, presentations, Requests for Information, Requests for Proposal, solution design sessions, and proofs of concept. Work hands-on with sample data, SQL, cloud platforms, APIs, and product configurations to demonstrate how BNY solutions can address specific customer requirements.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
Strong technical and data fluency, including experience with SQL, data integration, data modeling, APIs, metadata, data quality, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Snowflake. Python experience and familiarity with data governance, data lineage, semantic models, knowledge graphs, or AI-ready data practices are advantageous.
Significant experience in financial technology, financial services, technical sales, product management, data engineering, or a related field, with demonstrated success working directly with institutional clients and supporting complex enterprise software or data solutions.
A client-focused and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities, communicate a compelling product vision, develop practical solutions, and work hands-on in support of sales pursuits, demonstrations, proofs of concept, implementation planning, and client adoption.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to present to senior client and internal audiences, influence without direct authority, balance regional autonomy with global alignment, and collaborate across Product, Engineering, Sales, Services, Operations, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Data Governance teams. A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and the ability to travel regularly within the region and to BNY’s global offices are required.

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. Director / Head of HSE / Operations Director

The Senior Manager – HSE is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing the organization's Health, Safety, and Environmental management systems to ensure compliance with applicable regulations, industry standards, and company policies. The role drives continuous improvement in safety performance, environmental sustainability, and operational risk management while promoting a proactive safety culture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Develop and implement HSE strategies aligned with organizational objectives.
* Lead the continuous improvement of HSE management systems and programs.
* Establish departmental KPIs and monitor HSE performance across projects and operations.

**Health & Safety Management**

* Ensure compliance with local regulations, international standards, and company policies.
* Lead incident prevention initiatives and promote a zero-harm culture.
* Oversee hazard identification, risk assessments, and implementation of control measures.
* Review and approve safety plans, method statements, and risk assessments.
* Lead investigations into incidents, near misses, and occupational illnesses.

**Environmental Management**

* Develop and monitor environmental management programs.
* Ensure compliance with environmental permits and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor waste management, pollution prevention, energy efficiency, and sustainability initiatives.
* Support ESG and sustainability objectives.

**Compliance & Audit**

* Conduct periodic HSE audits, inspections, and compliance assessments.
* Manage external audits and regulatory inspections.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are effectively implemented and tracked.
* Maintain readiness for ISO certifications and regulatory requirements.

**Training & Culture**

* Develop HSE training strategies and competency programs.

* Promote awareness campaigns and employee engagement initiatives.
* Mentor HSE teams and operational leaders on safety best practices.
* Foster a strong reporting and learning culture.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Liaise with regulatory authorities, clients, contractors, and consultants.
* Represent the organization in HSE meetings and industry forums.
* Collaborate with project, operations, and HR teams to achieve HSE objectives.

**Emergency Preparedness**

* Develop and maintain emergency response plans and business continuity procedures.
* Lead emergency drills and crisis management activities.
* Ensure adequate preparedness for workplace emergencies.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Professional certifications such as:

* NEBOSH Diploma
* CSP (Certified Safety Professional)
* CMIOSH
* ISO 45001 Lead Auditor
* ISO 14001 Lead Auditor

### Experience

* **15+ years of progressive HSE experience.**
* 5+ years in a leadership or managerial role.
* Experience in construction, buildings, mixed-use, or large-scale project environments.
* Demonstrated success in implementing HSE management systems and leading organizational safety initiatives.

### Key Competencies

* Strategic leadership
* Risk management
* Regulatory compliance
* Incident investigation
* Environmental management
* Emergency response planning
* Stakeholder management
* Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Communication and presentation skills
* Coaching and team development

### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR)
* Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR)
* HSE audit scores
* Regulatory compliance performance
* Closure rate of corrective actions
* Environmental performance metrics
* Training completion rates
* Safety observation and reporting levels

**Job Description:**

Manages one or several larger accounts or acts as the account lead for a substantial part of a top account. Understands the customer’s IT and business objectives, priorities, requirements and challenges, and adds value by implementing HPE’s strategy. Drives business performance for all HPE BUs and manages the portfolio mix to optimize profitability of the account. Accountable for pipeline building; accountable for and supportive in deal closing and orchestrating the deal team. Builds and develops relevant customer relationship networks with key influencers and decision makers in IT and business. Develops and engages with the extended partner ecosystem to maximize HPE’s presence in the account. Constantly develops information technology industry knowledge to position HPE’s portfolio in the account. Orchestrates, engages, guides and provides feedback to the extended account team members. Acts as customer’s advocate inside HPE. Plans for accounts to deliver results through the financial year and beyond.

***Management Level Definition:***

Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Frequently contributes to the development of new ideas and methods. Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Acts as an expert providing direction and guidance to process improvements and establishing policies. Frequently represents the organization to external customers/clients. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for accomplishing work and achieving objectives. May provide mentoring and guidance to lower level employees.

***Responsibilities:***

* Articulates a two-way connection between the customer's core KPIs, business priorities and initiatives, and the plan to support the customer with IT solutions. Positions HPE strategy and solutions in such a way that the customer sees that HPE is critically important to their business. When appropriate, understands the innovation agenda and digital journey of the customer, and provides input into them. Builds a business value framework for the customer.

Drives growth in HPE's strategic value portfolio through positioning these solutions with the customer. *Compliance & Reporting*

* Track fuel consumption and report against allocations.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience managing fuel logistics for large events or operations, with references available.
* International experience delivering sports events; multi-sport or major single-sport events count towards this requirement.
* Strong safety awareness and accurate record keeping.

Position Summary:

Procurements Manager is responsible for planning, directing, guiding and monitoring all procurement processes, including vendor selection and vendor contracts and warehouse management. This will achieved by establishing effective strategies, plans, policies, procedures and standards that ensure that all consulting, contracting and material requirements for all projects are available as needed, within agreed project budgets and to expected standards. The role will support the aggressive growth and expansion of Retal Group in line with the Company’s overall strategic objectives.

The role will include the following:

Management of all RFP and tendering processes on behalf of Retal’s Group

Designing and implementing standard terms and conditions related to all purchasing activity, be that professional services, contractor and materials

The design and execution of clear and commercially based vendor contracts that ensure that the obligations of all parties, their rights and their rewards are clearly defined within

The application of the “trilemma”, balancing the choices of Cost Time Quality such that all contractors and materials are the best outcome possible for a given budget

Management of the supply chain for material delivery, such that all projects have the required materials on-site as required to support the contractor delivery schedules

Management of any variation orders attached to any contractor attached to an existing project, such that the variation is both a valid claim and within the terms of existing contracts

This will be achieved by proactively:

Working with all Managers to ensure that their needs are fully understood and that Supply Chain Manager is seen as an supportive internal business partner

Working with the Operations to ensure that all projects are fully supported with the required professional services, contractors, materials and other project related inputs delivered on time, to the expected standards, at acceptable levels of profitability

Delivering all materials on time, within budget and to expected standards of quality

Working with the New Products Manager, to identify new material/product supply chain benefits and design the required contracts and supply chain requirements.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

Articulates the Retal mission, vision, objectives within Procurements Function, to align all procurement activity to the requirements of the overall business plan

Proactively strategic sourcing needs for Retal by reviewing the material requirements of the various projects; establish policies for strategic sourcing of such items

Oversees and reviews the development and monitoring of Procurements Function annual plan, its budget and resources ensuring alignment with Retal’s overall strategy and direction

Design and oversees the development of required policies, procedures and processes within Supply Chain Director

Proactively manage the various aspects of procurement function to ensure professional and timely provision of such services in line with Corporate Procurement Strategy, Policies and Procedures.

Liaises with all managers to ensure smooth flow of information, provide support and ensure timely delivery of all contracted services or materials for both new and existing projects

Oversees and controls the complete procurement cycle from identifying requirements through to receiving and distribution of goods and services

Leads the development and execution of innovative sourcing strategies and programs to meet present and future materials/ services requirements for Retal’s operations by applying advanced knowledge of supply chain principles, negotiation strategies and vendor relationship management

Develops a robust vendor base and enters into purchase agreements with the vendors for supplying Retal’s needs based on individual project requirements

Pre-qualifies and develops the preferred/ approved vendor list for different key materials and services across different geographies, in consultation with the respective vendors and in coordination with all Operations Department Managers

Coordinates with all concerned Managers during the preferred/ approved vendor list development, in order to utilize their experiences with a concerned supplier

Collects and shares supplier qualification and performance information from/ within respective projects for future preference and consideration

Sets procurement sourcing strategies for various types of supplies/ materials involving major high volume materials and systems, and monitor adherence of companies to set strategies

Establishes and manages strong business relationships with all Subcontractors and Suppliers

Reviews the consolidation, where applicable, of major materials demand (i.e. steel, cement, concrete, etc.) for greater negotiating power and lower costs (economies of scale), and coordinates with concerned companies the supplier awarding and delivery of materials

Participates with Operational Managers in the technical and commercial evaluation, negotiations and selection of the contractors and vendors, as appropriate

Reviews the minimum and maximum levels of stocked materials and determines the reorder point for standard and critical materials.

Articulate and develop the warehouse management policy and procedures.

Manage the warehouse and its activity and ensure smooth and controlled operations in the warehouses.

Provide the required reports for Procurement, Contracts Management, and the warehouse to Management.

Provides guidance, support, leadership and management to Supply Chain Manager Function Management and Staff to ensure effective and efficient flow of work and to ensure that all staff recognize their fundamental roles in their respective functions to achieve Retal 's overall organizational objectives

Directs all activities related to sourcing and procurement including vendor identification, vendor quality certification and price negotiations

Leads negotiation of prices, terms and conditions of contracts to minimize potential risk and maximize discounts on procured material and parts, hence increasing marginal profits

Negotiates payment terms and discounts with the most important suppliers to secure the most advantageous price and service performance

Reviews and approves tender documentation in relation to pricing including instructions, general and special conditions and requirements, measurements, Bills of Quantity, specifications, and drawings

Becomes directly involved in direct purchasing when the values (or volumes) dictate as per the Delegation of Authority levels identified within the Delegation of Authority Matrix

Oversees the stock receipt and control process to confirm compliance with the Departments policies and procedures.

Conducts annual performance appraisal to review employees’ performance, carries out disciplinary meetings when needed, recommends salary adjustments, rewards and promotions based on employee performance result

Monitor the adherence of staff to the company’s guidelines, policies and procedures

Ensure effective departmental performance through the selection, development, deployment and motivation of competent staff

Reports and provides statistical and analytical consolidated reports to General Manager on the Departments performance

Participates in hiring department’s positions.

Communicates and discusses the function’s guidelines and procedures with employees to ensure responsibilities, authorities and accountabilities are defined and understood

As member of the Retal management team, active participation in the relevant operational and executive meetings is expected

Undertaking other tasks as assigned by the CEO or the Operations Managers from time to time.

collaboration

Self-motivate

Professional Procurement and negotiation qualification

Minimum of 7 years of related and relevant experience.

## **The Company:**

[impact.com](http://impact.com/) is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, [impact.com](http://impact.com/) empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products—**Performance** (affiliate), **Creator** (influencer), and **Advocate** (customer referral)—unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, [impact.com](http://impact.com/) helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands, including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics, rely on [impact.com](http://impact.com/) to power more than 225,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

## **Your Role at impact.com:**

Quality at impact.com is an engineering problem: the platforms, frameworks and AI agents that let teams test well at speed. Today that work is spread across a team, with promising prototypes and no dedicated owner. As our Principal Software Engineer for the QA Platform, you'll be that owner. You’ll build our CLIs, MCPs, and full-stack web apps used by hundreds of users and thousands of agents. The ideal candidate would be one of the founders or principal engineers at Playwright, Browserstack, Checksum, SauceLabs or similar dev tools companies. You'll set the technical direction for the QA platform: the frameworks, shared standards, quality context and AI agents that QA engineers and developers across our product groups rely on. You'll decide which prototypes become platforms and which are retired. This is a software engineering role, not a testing role: you'll build for QA the way a platform team builds for developers, as a multiplier for teams rather than a release gate. At this level you lead by doing. You're a hands-on individual contributor with no direct reports, trusted to take on ambiguous problems, make consequential technical decisions, and bring people along through influence rather than authority.

## **What You'll Do:**

### **1\. Set the direction**

* Own the multi-quarter technical vision, architecture and roadmap for the QA platform.
* Turn ambiguous, cross-team quality problems into clear technical direction, including ones nobody has fully defined yet.
* Decide what to build, buy, adopt or retire, and when a problem deserves something purpose-built.

### **2\. Build, hands-on**

* Write code and prototype the hardest parts yourself, especially where the problem is new or the risk is high.
* Own what you ship in production: its reliability, security and cost.
* Bring AI into how we test where it measurably helps, and show the evidence when it doesn't.

### **3\. Raise the bar and bring people with you**

* Define what good looks like for quality engineering at impact.com, including for AI-assisted work, and hold that line across teams.
* Lead technically without authority: set standards, review designs and code, and mentor engineers across QA Enablement and the QA chapter.
* Partner with engineering leadership, and with the Engineering Enablement PM, who owns rollout and adoption. You own technical readiness and the evidence that the platform helps.

## **Essential requirements:**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 10+ years of professional software engineering, including designing and delivering complex systems.
* A track record of setting technical direction across several teams, whatever your title.
* You've built platforms, frameworks or developer tools that other engineers adopted and relied on.
* Deep, hands-on backend and infrastructure engineering: you design, build and run distributed, highly available production systems, and you still write code.
* Expert in at least one backend language, and able to work across others.
* You've built and shipped LLM- or agent-based tools, and can show how you measured whether their output was good enough to trust. You use AI coding tools every day.
* Experience in test infrastructure, developer productivity or CI/CD at scale. You don't need a testing background, but you understand what makes tests fast and trusted.
* Clear technical writing: design docs and decisions that other teams act on, and explanations non-technical audiences can follow.

## **Nice-to-have requirements:**

* Building eval infrastructure for LLM or agent output, or testing other non-deterministic systems.
* Giving AI agents the context they need, for example through MCP's and CLI's.
* Moving teams from fragmented tooling onto a shared standard.
* Enough front-end skill to ship usable internal tools.

Our stack includes Java and Python services on GCP and Kubernetes, with TypeScript and Playwright for test and UI work. Experience with them helps, but isn't required. The years are a guide, not a gate: what you've built and the scope you've owned matter more. If you've done most of this at a comparable level, apply.

## Benefits and Perks

At impact.com, we believe that when you're happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That's why we've built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

* **Flexible Working:** Our **Responsible PTO policy** means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.
* **Health and Wellness:** Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to **12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year**, with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a **monthly gym reimbursement** policy to support your physical health.
* **A Stake in Our Growth:** We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.
* **Investing in Your Growth:** We're committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.
* **Parental Support:** We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.
* **Technology Financial Support:** We provide a technology stipend to help you set up your home office and a monthly allowance to cover your internet expenses.

A symbol of Saudi Arabia’s heritage, The Red Palace stands as an extraordinary landmark in Riyadh, now reimagined as an ultra-luxury boutique hotel. Originally built in 1943, this historic Palace has been transformed into a masterpiece of refined hospitality, blending timeless elegance with contemporary sophistication.
Nestled in the heart of the capital, The Red Palace offers an exclusive glimpse into the Kingdom’s storied past, featuring meticulously restored architecture, curated cultural experiences, and unparalleled service. Every detail has been thoughtfully designed to honor its legacy while delivering a modern interpretation of luxury. At The Red Palace, we invite guests to step into a world of history, prestige, and indulgence, where tradition and innovation seamlessly come together.
THE POSITION
The Chief Accountant is responsible for overseeing the company's accounting operations, ensuring accurate financial reporting, regulatory compliance, and effective management of accounting staff. This role plays a key part in financial planning, analysis, and safeguarding the company’s assets.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Leadership & Team Development: Lead, mentor, and inspire the accounting team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous professional growth.
Financial Reporting & Compliance: Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant preparation of financial statements, statutory filings, and management reports in line with local regulations and accounting standards.
Accounting Operations Management: Oversee all accounting functions, including Credit Manager, Accounts Payable, General Cashier cum Paymaster, Income Auditor, Cost Controller, Fixed Assets, and balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring timely month-end closing and accurate ledgers.
Budgeting & Financial Analysis: Monitor cash flow, budgets, and forecasts; provide actionable insights and recommendations to optimize financial performance and support strategic objectives.
Process Improvement & Controls: Develop, implement, and maintain robust accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and risk management.
Audit & Risk Management: Coordinate and support internal and external audits, liaise with tax authorities and other local government departments, ensure timely resolution and proactive follow-up on audit findings, and continuously strengthen financial governance and risk management.
Strategic Collaboration: Partner with department heads and leadership to provide financial guidance, cost management, and resource allocation strategies.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Maintain effective internal communication with the management team and all colleagues within the Palace, finance teams across other Palaces/Hotels, and Regional/Corporate functions; and manage external communication with internal/external auditors, tax authorities and other local government authorities, suppliers, and key customers.
Values & Legacy Competencies: The ability to embrace and practice our legacy values and competencies.
Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, encourage adoption of best practices, and leverage technology and analytics to enhance the accounting function.

MAIN DUTIES
Perform any other duties as may reasonably be requested by management.

Act as second-in-command to the Director of Finance to support the achievement of hotel objectives.
Ensure the capital replacement and disposal policy is enforced as per company directives and in line with the management agreement.
Ensure a detailed understanding of local accounting and tax rules and ensure all reporting complies with company directives.
Maintain a strong business relationship with the owner/owner’s representative to align business objectives and facilitate approvals on relevant activities (CAPEX, etc.).
Lead, support, and coordinate all internal and external audit visits and maintain strong relationships with key audit stakeholders, with proactive follow-up on audit issues raised.
Provide value-added business performance reporting to give Operations the tools to identify areas for improvement.
Provide accurate forecasting of the business to determine the correct allocation of resources and maximize business performance.
Lead the Finance team to drive improved performance and develop talent, creating solid succession planning within the Palace and beyond for the Group.
Support the Director of Finance in driving the annual budgeting and forecasting process to ensure all departments deliver according to approved targets and timelines.
Responsible for all aspects of the financial management of the property, including administering accounting policies and procedures, adhering to procurement practices and procedures, preparing and interpreting financial statements and management reports, budgetary control, and ensuring compliance with Boutique Group and Red Palace standards and all applicable legal/contractual requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field; professional certification (CPA, CMA, ACCA) preferred.

5–8 years of progressive accounting experience, including 2–3 years in a senior accounting or supervisory role.

Hotel pre-opening experience is strongly preferred.

Deep knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting standards, and regulatory requirements.

Proficiency in accounting software, ERP systems, and MS Office applications.

Strong leadership, analytical, organizational, and strategic thinking skills.

Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and ethical standards.

KEY COMPETENCIES
Leadership and people management.

Strategic financial planning and analytical thinking.

Integrity, professionalism, and ethical conduct.

Effective communication and collaboration.

Problem-solving, decision-making, and risk management.

Commitment to continuous learning, innovation, and process improvement.

Strong alignment with the Company’s legacy competencies and values, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.

ZainTECH is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect – AWS (Presales) to join its KSA presales team in Riyadh. The role will serve as a senior technical lead, working directly with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, and other senior stakeholders across large enterprises and government organizations. The successful candidate will own the technical lifecycle of AWS opportunities, from initial discovery and architecture through RFP/RFQ responses, commercial support, solution presentation, and handover to delivery.

This is an AWS-first presales role requiring strong hands-on architecture expertise, commercial awareness, and the ability to communicate complex technical solutions to executive audiences. The architect will be expected to challenge requirements where appropriate, develop compelling business cases and TCO models, address security and regulatory considerations, and design scalable AWS solutions across migration, modernization, containers, disaster recovery, data, and GenAI.

**Requirements**

AWS Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership:

* Own the technical solution for AWS opportunities from discovery through proposal and handover to delivery.
* Design secure, scalable, highly available AWS architectures across migration, modernization, networking, security, databases, containers, DR, data, and GenAI.
* Lead architecture discussions and technical decision-making with senior customer stakeholders.

Presales, RFP & Proposal Management:

* Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFQs, tenders, and customer requirements.
* Interpret requirements, identify gaps, raise clarification questions, and develop solution narratives and compliance matrices.
* Prepare Bills of Materials (BoMs), sizing, pricing inputs, and technical content while coordinating with AWS, partners, sales, and delivery teams.
* Ensure high-quality technical submissions are delivered within demanding deadlines.

Customer Workshops & Executive Engagement:

* Lead technical workshops, discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and solution presentations.
* Engage confidently with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and technical decision-makers.
* Present complex AWS concepts in a clear business-oriented manner and challenge customer assumptions when required.
* Handle technical and commercial objections, including AWS vs. Azure/Oracle/on-premises and solution cost concerns.

Cloud Migration, Containers & Modernization:

* Design AWS migration and modernization strategies, including VM migration, application modernization, and container adoption.
* Develop Amazon EKS and/or ECS architectures covering cluster design, networking, security, scalability, and CI/CD integration.
* Define Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform, AWS CDK, and/or CloudFormation.
* Demonstrate the business and technical value of moving workloads from traditional infrastructure to cloud-native platforms.

Security, Compliance, DR & Cost Optimization:

* Design resilient AWS architectures using multi-AZ and multi-region patterns aligned with business RTO/RPO requirements.
* Develop DR solutions using services such as AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery and AWS Backup, including backup and restore, pilot light, warm standby, and active-active approaches.
* Address KSA regulatory and compliance requirements, including NCA ECC/CCC, SAMA CSF, and PDPL considerations.
* Develop credible AWS cost estimates, TCO models, and DR cost-versus-RTO/RPO trade-offs for customer approval.

AWS Partnership & Deal Collaboration:

* Work closely with AWS account teams, ZainTECH sales leaders, delivery engineers, and technology partners to develop and win opportunities.
* Leverage AWS partner programs such as Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), funding programs, and ACE co-sell to accelerate opportunities.
* Support commercial negotiations by providing technical justification, sizing, architecture assumptions, and cost models.
* Ensure successful transition of won opportunities from presales into delivery.

*Our Culture & Code of Conduct:*

*At ZainTECH, we take pride in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and uncompromising integrity. We are looking for individuals who share these values and are committed to customer-centricity and ethical excellence. All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from how we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally.*

**Benefits**

* 8+ years of experience in infrastructure, cloud, software engineering, solutions architecture, or related technology roles.
* Proven experience in AWS presales, consulting, solution architecture, RFP/RFQ responses, and executive-level presentations.
* Strong expertise across core AWS services, including AWS networking, IAM and security, AWS Control Tower and landing zones, AWS databases, Migration and modernization services
* Strong hands-on experience withAmazon EKS and/or ECS, including cluster architecture, networking, security, scaling, and CI/CD integration.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code capabilities using Terraform and/or AWS CDK/CloudFormation.
* Proven experience designing AWS disaster recovery solutions using AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, AWS Backup, Multi-AZ and multi-region architectures, Backup and restore, Pilot light, Warm standby, Active-active architectures
* Strong understanding of defining and defending RTO/RPO requirements with business and technical stakeholders.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to defend architecture decisions under pressure.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock and Generative AI solutions.
* Familiarity with KSA regulatory frameworks, including NCA ECC/CCC, SAMA CSF, and PDPL.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) for multi-cloud discussions.
* Experience working with large enterprises and/or government organizations in the GCC.
* Fluent Arabic and English, both written and spoken, with the ability to conduct presentations, workshops, negotiations, and proposal writing in both languages.
* Active AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional certification.
* Additional AWS Professional or Specialty certifications, such as:

* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty
* AWS Certified Data or Machine Learning certifications

The Development Senior Manager is responsible for leading development of retail, public realm and special-use components across both precincts. Leading the planning, development, and delivery of commercial office assets within the Commercial Office Business Unit. The role will manage projects from concept through design, procurement, construction, and handover, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya's strategic objectives, business plans, commercial targets, and development standards.

### Key Responsibilities

* Act as the principal interface with Place, Culture, Retail and Hospitality, translating their requirements into commercially supported briefs, operating models and coordinated delivery scopes.
* Manage assigned components in coordination with the respective Project Leads, clarifying funding, approvals, delivery and operational responsibilities.
* Prepare and manage development briefs, project execution plans, budgets, schedules, and business cases.
* Coordinate and manage multidisciplinary consultants, ensuring design solutions meet business, operational, and commercial objectives.
* Drive project governance, approvals, and stakeholder alignment across internal and external parties.
* Oversee project budgets, forecasts, and financial performance to achieve approved business objectives.
* Support procurement activities, including tender strategies, bid evaluations, and contract awards.
* Manage consultant and contractor performance, contractual obligations, variations, claims, and commercial matters.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks while ensuring compliance with company policies and development processes.
* Coordinate with Delivery, Commercial, Leasing, Operations, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
* Ensure timely project delivery, quality assurance, operational readiness, and smooth asset handover to end users and operators.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in **Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Real Estate Development, Urban Planning, Quantity Surveying, Project Management, or a related**
* Master's degree in **Real Estate Development, Business Administration (MBA), Construction Management, Project Management, Urban Development, or a related field** is preferred.

* 7+ years of experience in real estate development, project management, design management, or construction.
* Experience delivering commercial office, mixed-use, or large-scale real estate developments.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary consultants and contractors.
* Middle East/GCC experience and exposure to giga-project environments is preferred.

**About the role**

At Qiddiya Investment Company, we are shaping a landmark destination redefining entertainment, culture and hospitality in the Kingdom. The Hospitality Business Unit is developing a portfolio of hotel assets central to this vision. As these assets progress, we are seeking experienced professionals to help deliver them to the highest standards of design quality, guest experience and commercial performance.

In this role, you will lead and manage the design of complex hospitality assets from initial briefs through to delivery. You will translate Qiddiya’s vision into distinctive, commercially viable and buildable design outcomes, driving quality, guiding key decisions and ensuring alignment with guest experience, positioning and Operator requirements. Working across consultants and internal stakeholders, you will oversee design interfaces and ensure coordination and compliance and drive projects towards fully integrated and executable solutions. 

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design management of hospitality assets from early-stage briefs through to delivery, ensuring alignment with guest experience, asset positioning and Qiddiya’s vision and objectives
* Direct and coordinate design decision-making across projects, guiding key decisions to ensure high-quality outcomes aligned with operational functionality, guest experience requirements and long-term asset value
* Lead and manage consultant teams and Operator design coordination, delivering integrated, buildable, operational and commercially viable design solutions
* Oversee design development across all project stages, ensuring adherence to scope, deliverables, programme and approval requirements
* Drive design quality and integrity across architecture, interiors, landscape and guest touchpoints, including mock-up rooms, materials, FF&E and OS&E
* Ensure compliance with Operator standards, technical requirements, authority regulations and Qiddiya design standards
* Lead and manage design risks and governance, influencing decisions through senior forums and clear recommendations
* Champion innovation and continuous design improvement, benchmarking designs against global best-in-class hospitality standards
* Mentor and develop internal design management teams, fostering collaboration, accountability and high standards of delivery
* Lead the development and refinement of design management processes, systems, standards and best practices across the hospitality portfolio
* Drive knowledge sharing across assets and contribute to building institutional capability

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Design or related discipline
* Professional membership or recognised certification preferred (e.g. RIBA, AIA, RICS or equivalent)
* 15+ years’ experience in design management, architecture or interior design
* Proven track record delivering projects from concept through construction, with strong understanding of technical design and execution
* Strong experience on hospitality, complex, luxury or mixed-use developments
* Experience managing multi-disciplinary consultants across complex projects
* Experience with hotel Operators and brand standards
* Experience in KSA / GCC or similar large-scale development environments preferred

**Benefits**

* The opportunity to **be part of one of Saudi Arabia’s most ambitious city developments**.

The SME will bring deep operational, language and local-market expertise to complex cases and escalations, while continuously transferring knowledge back into the wider support organisation.

**Operational Expertise & Escalations**

The SME should make the organisation **less dependent on SMEs over time, not more**.

Success will be demonstrated through faster resolution of complex cases, fewer repeat escalations, stronger L1 capability, reduced operational dependency on Account Managers and White Glove resources, and continuous transfer of local-market knowledge into the Global Support organisation.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Protection & Control Engineer to join the Technical Services Division.

The Technical Services Division is responsible for providing and managing highly technical and specialized engineering services to support safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Saudi Aramco’s electrical transmission and distribution networks. The Division also provides services in power system protection, control, and advanced system studies to ensure asset integrity, personnel safety, and continuity of power supply.

Your primary role is to provide specialized technical support services related to protection system design, relay settings, system modeling, and power system studies. Your role also includes ownership and governance of power system models, supporting standardization, data integrity, and continuous improvement across projects and operations.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

• Conduct protection relay settings calculations, coordination reviews, and verification for transmission, distribution, and industrial power systems.

• Lead or support power system disturbance and interruption investigations, including relay event analysis, fault reconstruction, and root cause analysis.

• Provide technical review for protection philosophies, relay settings files, system study reports, and engineering deliverables.

• Review, support development, and update company standards, guidelines, and procedures related to protection, control, and power system studies.

• Perform and validate load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, and transient stability studies using Electrical Transient Analyzer Program (ETAP).

• Perform arc flash hazard analyses and support mitigation strategies in accordance with IEEE, NFPA, and Saudi Aramco standards.

We are seeking a Downstream Pricing Analyst to join our Global Optimizer Development Department (GOD).

The (GOD) charter is to optimize crude allocation and the operations of global manufacturing facilities in order to maximize revenue, increase profitability, and capture international market opportunities.

Your primary role is to be responsible for developing and enhancing price forecast visualization tool, compute and issue transfer prices and coordinate with stakeholders to validate price implementation. In that capacity the incumbent shall be the primary source for refined products, crude, chemicals and freights forecast needed by Global Optimizer team and Affiliates Affairs organization. Continuously assess transfer prices implementation.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Minimum of 8+ years of relevant professional experience (preferable in oil & gas downstream business), including 3+ years in field as data analytics including market research, corporate planning, business development).

Overview

We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join our Tanajib Gas Plant Department.

Tanajib Gas Plant Department current processing capacity is 3 billion standard cubic feet per day (BSCFD) of associated and non-associated gas. The plant products are NGL, Sales Gas and Liquid sulfur.

Your primary role is to implement, support and continually improve Tanajib Gas Plant Department inspection corrosion management programs as well as to provide consolatory advice in materials ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all Tanajib Gas Plant Department assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

• Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring

• Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology

• Review and approve recommend solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection.

• Validate corrosion controls, corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.

• Assess feed composition changes and approve recommend solution to assure assets integrity.

• Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.

• Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, CP, corrosion inhibitors and othercorrosion controls and best practices.

• Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies.

• Troubleshoot corrosion problems and address their root causes.

• Review design packages for plant changes and modifications to address corrosion and material challenges.

• Explore new materials development and deploy advanced material application to address plant corrosion challenges.

• Perform the regular review and update on the plants units Corrosion Control Documents (CCD’s) reflecting the any change that resulted from plant changes either in plant operation or facility modifications.
Conduct the evergreening RBI studies of the plant unit, including revising the inventory grouping limits and reflect that on related drawings, tracking generated RBI recommendations and coordinate their implementations.
Review existing inspection programs reports to monitor the corrosion activities in the plant.

Minimum Requirements:

• As the successful candidate you will hold a Bachelor or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or Corrosion Science from a recognized and approved program.

• You will have 10 years of experience in Gas processing in Oil/Gas Industry, material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.

• You must have working experience in running asset integrity programs in petroleum or petrochemical operating facility.

• Capability to write clear technical reports to address any technical issue. The candidate shall also have excellent presentation skills to share knowledge with others and present business cases to managements to take decisions.

• Strong knowledge of the international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-579, API-580, API-570 and API-510 . And He should hold a valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

Overview

We are seeking a Risk Analyst to join the Risk Oversight & Compliance Division of the Financial Risk Management Division at Saudi Aramco.

The Risk Oversight & Compliance Division is responsible for providing an independent and forward-looking assessment of financial risks across the Group, including liquidity, financing, credit, market, pension-related, operational, and other relevant risk areas. The division also provides a comprehensive, aggregated view of the Group’s financial risk profile by quantifying risks and clearly articulating the Group’s financial risk appetite.

The division is tasked with identifying, assessing, monitoring, and reporting on key financial risks, including adherence to risk limits, thresholds, and internal controls, to senior management and the Board Audit Committee. This includes ensuring compliance with internal risk management policies and frameworks, as well as supporting informed decision-making through transparent and timely risk reporting.

Your primary role will be to provide expert risk analysis and consultancy to support data-driven, risk-informed decision-making, deliver strategic management advice, and contribute to the effective execution of the division’s mandate.

Duties and Responsibilities

You will be required to:

• Work as part of the Group Treasury function to analyze, oversee, advise on, and report Group-level financial risk activities.

• Provide expertise in financial risk-reward analysis, supporting risk-based decisions and proposals for management review.

• Enhance transparency on Treasury-related risks by developing and improving Group-level dashboards and reports for regular updates to senior management.

• Establish and maintain risk profiles and thresholds for various Group entities and risk exposures, while actively monitoring key risk indicators (KRIs).

• Develop and document procedures related to risk monitoring and reporting responsibilities, as needed.

Minimum Requirements

As the successful candidate, you will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Analytics, or Accounting from a recognized and accredited institution. An advanced degree or professional certification such as a Master’s, CFA, or FRM is preferred.

• You will have a minimum of seven years of experience in Corporate Treasury risk functions, specifically in Credit and Market risk.

• Experience in developing risk metrics, including Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, and scenario analysis, as well as familiarity with risk appetite frameworks, is required.

• A strong understanding of data analytics and experience with risk systems and tools, such as MATLAB, Tableau, MSCI RiskMetrics, or Power BI, is essential.

• You must possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a collaborative attitude, and the ability to work effectively across a diverse portfolio of companies as part of a global risk team.

• Demonstrated intellectual curiosity, accountability, and initiative are essential traits for success in this role.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.

We are seeking an experienced Process Simulation Twin (PST) and Optimization Engineer to join our Reliability Solutions Department (RSD) within our Global Manufacturing Excellence Center.

Global Manufacturing Excellence (GME) is the recognized Center of Excellence driving value across Saudi Aramco’s Downstream Global manufacturing portfolio.

Your primary role is to deploy and sustain online process simulations (process digital twins), perform process optimization activities to identify opportunities, monitor process performance KPIs and develop advanced process optimization data-enabled solutions. This role sits at the boundary of process engineering and digitalization beyond traditional process simulation roles. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between rigorous thermodynamic models, process digital twins, real-time process data and hybrid analytics through AI.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

• Lead the development, deployment, and sustainment of PST that integrate real-time process data with rigorous equation-oriented or sequential simulation engines in alignment with corporate objectives.

• Configure and troubleshoot the connectivity between plant historians, laboratory information systems, and simulation software to ensure seamless data ingestion and reconciliation.

• Utilize PST to perform automated monitoring of facility health, detecting deviations between ideal performance and actual plant operations to identify opportunity gaps.

• Develop and maintain thermodynamic models and mathematical equations that accurately represent the behavior of various processes ensuring the PST accurately reflects the current state of the facility (including heat exchanger fouling, catalyst decay, etc.).

• Perform offline engineering studies using PST to analyze complex operational problems, debottleneck constraints, and conduct "what-if" scenarios based on current operating conditions.

• Act as the technical liaison between data teams and Operations/Process Engineering teams, leading technical sessions on model architecture, data quality, and commissioning.

• Lead process optimization sessions to de-bottleneck key process units such as CDU/VDU, Hydrocrackers, Catalytic crackers, Diesel Hydrotreaters, Isomerization.

• Benchmark process optimization KPIs with 15+ operating facilities and provide development of programs, processes, guidelines and best practices.

Overview

We are seeking a Power Service Technician to join our Power Operations Departments.

Power Operation Departments deliver electrical energy to customers in the safest, most reliable and economical manner through a competent workforce committed to excellence and customer satisfaction.

Your primary role is to do installations or diagnosis and repair on all types of electrical systems and support in commissioning, fault diagnosis, testing, repairing, preventive maintenance and routine maintenance on transformers, large circuit breakers and ancillary equipment for substations, switching stations, power plants and large motor controls and underground power cable including fault locating. Frequently provides work direction to lower-classified Power Services Unit personnel.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:
• Perform preventive maintenance, installation, commissioning, testing, repairs and troubleshooting on equipment including 480 voltages through 230 kilo volts switchgear, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnect switches, reclosers, cooling fans, and substation systems.
• Use various testing equipment like transformer turns ration, insulation resistance, and dielectric testers. Installs and maintains high voltage cables (e.g., solid dielectric, paper insulated lead covered (PILCA) cables, low pressure oil filled (LPOF) cables, and submarine cables and testing of high-pressure oil filled (HPOF) cables) and performs splicing, terminations, and testing. Repairs electrical and mechanical components of oil circuit breakers, including compressors, pumps, springs, and linkages.
• Performs commissioning tests on new equipment, recommends final acceptance by Power Distribution Department and lists exception items, if any.
• Performs high-skilled diagnostic tasks, as required.
• Diagnose and locate equipment, system, and cable faults through tests and analysis, determining necessary repairs and parts. Install, repairs, and maintains specialized power distribution equipment, including line wash equipment, lifts & digger-derricks.
• Supervise cable excavation, ensure de-energization and safety grounding, and oversees cable laying for high and medium voltage cables.
• Performs potential testing, High-Potential testing on Power Cables.
• Revises existing equipment and systems to conform to verbal instructions, revised drawings, and work orders; then makes operational test runs for satisfactory repair and acceptance.
• Coordinates and schedules power outages with affected organizations as required to perform routine maintenance or make repairs on power distribution facilities.
• Acquires clearances, performs switching, receives work permits, and restores equipment to service; when such activities are required to perform work in a timely manner.

Minimum Requirements

As the successful candidate, you will need to have the following:

• Diploma/industrial degree in electrical field. B.s degree in Electrical Engineering is preferred.

• Minimum of 12 years of experience in power system construction, commissioning, maintenance and operation with emphasis on transmission and distribution.

• Preferably Certified for Basic Life Support/FA, Fire Protection, Work Permit Receiver, cable splicing & potential test.

• Fluent command of the English language, oral and written.

• Has thorough knowledge of equipment and underground cable safety requirements including U.S. & Saudi Electrical Codes.

• Ability to read work orders, work permits, vendors’ manuals, and schematic diagrams and to communicate with fellow workers on technical aspects of the job.

• Good knowledge of Safety Management System
