Overview

We are seeking a Crisis and Business Continuity Advisor to join our Corporate Emergency Management and Continuity (CEMAC) Organization.

CEMAC is responsible for implementing, maintaining and enhancing business continuity, crisis management and resilience programs in Saudi Aramco and its group of companies. Its objective to ensure sustainable resiliency that protects SA interests, minimizes business disruption, and reduces reputational risks. It also ensures that incidents involving Saudi Aramco interests having the potential to cause significant loss of life, property, reputation, or business interruptions are managed adequately.

Your primary role is to contribute to the corporate frameworks of governing, developing, executing, maintaining, reviewing, enhancing, exercising, assessing, corporate emergency management and continuity plans addressing industrial (i.e hydrocarbon) and nonindustrial (i.e. non-hydrocarbon) incidents to assure Saudi Aramco’s ability to operate optimally during a crisis.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

• Provide expert advices to help implementing, maintaining & enhancing business continuity, crisis management and resilience in Company’s operations and ensuring plans and strategies are appropriately managed.

• Develop, maintain, and continually improve business continuity and crisis management policies, strategies, plans, procedures, and manuals.

• Initiate, review and assess proposals related to corporate initiatives for business continuity and crisis management requirements.

• Implement and maintain business continuity and crisis management frameworks, systems, and processes at company and corporate/group level.

• Plan and conduct frequent site visit to review and assess organizations and Affiliates crisis & business continuity compliance and maturity.

• Advance implementation of designate analytical and digital tools to support decision analysis and information gathering as related to business continuity, and crisis management.

• Assess effectiveness of assigned risk management programs and risk management frameworks.

• Develop and maintain corporate communication plans for crisis management.

• Establish and test crisis communication protocols with stakeholders, including joint ventures and government agencies.

• Assume assigned responsibilities to facilitate and support Emergency Monitoring Room (EMR) during an elevated incident.

• Conduct training needs assessments for crisis management, including executive training and field training.

Minimum Requirements

• You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in a recognized field of engineering. Advanced degree is preferred.

• Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience (preferably within the Oil and Gas industry). Including 5 years minimum in a leading role in Business Continuity or Crisis Management.

• Professional qualification in Crisis Management or Business Continuity Management such as Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP) or equivalent.

• Strong knowledge of business continuity and crisis management best practices, including ISO 22301.

• Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills with advanced digital skills to conduct data analysis.

• Experience with emergency management, safety and health, project management, IT, risk management, and continuity of operations procedures, and governance practices.

• Ability to work with senior management, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams while maintaining effective working relationships.

• Ability to work with minimum supervision on relatively unstructured tasks.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle crisis situations.

Description
Are you passionate about the intersection of cloud technology and the energy industry? Do you want to help some of the world's largest energy companies modernize their operations and accelerate digital transformation across the Middle East?
The Middle East is home to some of the world's most ambitious energy companies: national oil companies operating mega-scale upstream assets, integrated refining and petrochemical complexes, LNG export terminals, and pipeline networks that span entire countries. These organizations are investing billions in digital transformation, and require partners who understand their business from the wellhead to the fuel terminal. AWS is building deep capability across the full energy value chain in this region, and this role sits at the heart of that effort.
As a Technical Business Developer on the AWS Energy team, you will own the regional strategy for energy in the Middle East, identifying where data and AI can generate insights and acceleration across the value chain. You will draw on your own background and that of the strong team around you to help upstream operators accelerate seismic interpretation and reservoir modelling, enable a refinery to optimize throughput using real-time analytics and digital twins, or support a pipeline operator modernize SCADA infrastructure and emissions monitoring. You will need to understand the full energy landscape, from exploration, drilling, and production through to refining, petrochemicals, pipelines, and LNG, because the customers you serve often operate across all of it.
You will work across AWS account teams, ISVs, and systems integrators to shape solutions that fit how these operators actually run, bridging IT/OT convergence, industrial data platforms, subsurface data management, and advanced analytics with the commercial models that make adoption real. You will develop reference architectures and technical content grounded in real operational use cases, whether that is reservoir simulation workflows, turnaround planning, advanced process control, or pipeline integrity management, and build relationships with VP-level engineering and digital leaders at major operators who are making build-vs-buy decisions right now.
You will operate with full autonomy, identifying untapped opportunities, building your own pipeline, and driving complex pursuits from first conversation to signed deal. You will use your guile, industry credibility, and personal network to open doors that cold outreach cannot, seeking out and working with the best minds in the business, whether inside AWS, across our partner ecosystem, or within the customer's own organization, to deliver real outcomes.
You will raise the bar for those around you, mentoring teammates, elevating partner capabilities, and sharing the domain knowledge that helps the broader AWS Energy team win. You will be measured on pipeline generated, solutions adopted, and customer outcomes delivered, not slide decks produced.
This role suits someone who has spent real time in the energy industry, whether that is on a drilling rig, in a control room, on a plant floor, or embedded in an operator's digital transformation programme. You should understand a DCS from a historian, know why OSDU matters, and be able to hold your own in a conversation about reservoir management just as comfortably as turnaround planning or pipeline SCADA modernization. If you have the operational credibility, the commercial instincts, and the drive to help the Middle East's most important energy companies succeed with AWS, we want to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
Develop and own a global go-to-market strategy for the midstream and downstream energy segment, identifying priority use cases and customer targets across regions.
Engage VP and C-level leaders at major mid/downstream companies, building trusted advisory relationships and connecting their operational challenges with AWS solutions.
Create and deliver technical content such as whitepapers, reference architectures, and solution briefs for use cases including digital twins and carbon management.
Build jointly with partners, customer account teams, and industry deployment and systems integrators to co-develop solutions for refining and pipeline operations.
A day in the life
Identify and qualify new business opportunities with energy customers in the Middle East, independently developing and executing strategies that align with regional priorities.
Leverage your network and industry expertise to build trusted relationships with C-suite executives, VPs of Technology, and engineering leaders, positioning AWS as the platform of choice.
Build and deliver technical presentations, workshops, and proof-of-concept demonstrations tailored to energy industry use cases such as OSDU, reservoir simulation, industrial IoT, digital twins, and advanced process control
Collaborate with and develop those around you, mentoring teammates, elevating partner capabilities, and sharing best practices that raise the bar for the entire team.
Proactively connect customers with the right AWS specialists, partners, and resources to accelerate their cloud journey and deliver tangible business results.
Develop and maintain a robust pipeline, tracking progress and providing accurate forecasts to leadership
Represent AWS Energy at regional industry events, conferences, and executive briefings across the Middle East.
About the team
The AWS Energy team works with some of the world's most complex and impactful companies to bring cloud computing to the energy industry. Our mission is to accelerate digital transformation across the energy value chain. We build alongside partners, customer account teams, and industry systems integrators to deliver real outcomes for our customers. The midstream and downstream segment represents a significant growth opportunity, and this role is central to building our presence with global refining, chemicals, and pipeline operators. We value curiosity and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to delivering results together.
Basic Qualifications
- 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Energy & Utilities industries experience
- 5+ years of professional or military experience, with 5+ years in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting.
- Experience working with and presenting complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executives, and developing strategies that influence organizational-level leadership decisions.

Description
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.
This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.
This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.
Who Should Apply
We welcome applications from:
- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar. It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.
As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.
You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.
What You Will Do
You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).
In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.
Your day-to-day duties include:
- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians
- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets
- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills
- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance
- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians
- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site
Internship Structure
Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.
Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.
Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity
At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.
From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.
Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.
Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.
Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.
Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.
About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.
You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.
Basic Qualifications
- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar, graduating in 2027 – before the internship´s end date.
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills
Preferred Qualifications
- Basic knowledge of Linux and networking
- Basic knowledge of computer hardware components
- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager.

Description
Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.
This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.
Who Should Apply
We welcome applications from:
- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.
It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.
About the Role
As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.
You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.
What You Will Do
The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:
- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear
- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)
- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers
- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
- Building automation systems
Your day-to-day duties include:
- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment
- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment
- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows
- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site
Internship Structure
Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.
Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.
Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity
At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.
From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.
Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.
Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.
Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.
Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.
About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.
You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

About the role We are seeking a Senior Associate to manage end‑to‑end post‑trade custody operations for the Saudi Arabia (KSA) market , covering securities settlement, cash & FX operational support, corporate actions and income, reconciliations, and onboarding/account setup – Sunday to Thursday . This role requires strong familiarity with local market practices and a solid understanding of the KSA post‑trade ecosystem: trading on Saudi Exchange , clearing via Muqassa (CCP) , and depository/settlement via Edaa , with settlement cash movements supported through SAMA . Why this role is important to us State Street is one of the world’s largest global custodians, with over USD 51.7 trillion in AUC/A , and is executing a growth strategy that includes expanding direct market presence. As part of this strategy, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) is a priority market , supported by Vision 2030 reforms , increasing foreign participation, and strong institutional demand. This role is critical to: Enabling scalable market entry and growth by delivering strong, controlled post‑trade operations aligned to local market infrastructure and rules. Ensuring a high-quality client experience through timely settlement, strong exception management, and robust controls as KSA market activity expands. Supporting the firm’s ability to deepen relationships with key institutional clients as the market evolves. Key responsibilities (KSA-specific) 1) Clearing & settlement operations (Cash Market – Equities / ETFs / Sukuk & Bonds as applicable) Manage settlement processing for Saudi Exchange transactions settling at Edaa , ensuring accurate, timely completion across relevant cycles (e.g., T+2 for normal exchange trades; negotiated deals T+0–T+5 ; buy‑ins T+0 , as applicable). Reconcile and validate trade/settlement obligations by aligning client instructions and broker confirmations with clearing outcomes (Muqassa) and settlement processing (Edaa); investigate and resolve exceptions promptly. Monitor settlement status proactively, manage potential fails, and follow KSA fails workflows noting that fails management procedures are defined and conducted by Muqassa , with Edaa rollover/cancellation and market-claim handling where applicable. Manage lifecycle of settlement instructions (including amendments/cancellations/partial settlement where permitted) in line with Edaa procedures and local cut‑offs. 2) Cash settlement & funding (SAMA) Ensure funding readiness for DvP settlement , understanding that KSA settlement is gross on the securities leg and netted on the cash leg , with cash settlement executed via SAMA settlement member accounts. Perform cash reconciliations linked to settlement activity; investigate breaks and drive timely resolution within cut‑offs. 3) FX operations (operational support) Process FX-related operational activities supporting settlement and client cash requirements (settlement-linked and standalone requests per operating model), validating confirmations and ensuring correct value dating and SSI usage. 4) Corporate actions, dividends & income Manage corporate actions and income events, ensuring accurate entitlements, timely postings, and robust reconciliations; coordinate vendor feeds and security setup with internal market data/static data teams as required. 5) Client onboarding & investor identification Support onboarding/account setup and documentation in line with Edaa account structures and membership rules; ensure correct capture/validation of investor identification in Edaa’s framework (Investor Identification Number / Investor ID ). Support QFI onboarding requirements within the local custody/account operating model to ensure settlement readiness. 6) Messaging, controls & stakeholder management Use SWIFT ISO 15022 (MT) and exposure to ISO 20022 (MX) standards for settlement/reconciliation/corporate actions messaging with clients/custodians and market counterparts, supporting high STP and clean exception handling. Execute daily controls and checklists on time; ensure adherence to local cut‑offs and internal policies; escalate high‑risk/time‑sensitive issues with clear impact articulation. Partner with internal teams (Operations, Risk, Client Services) and external stakeholders (brokers, clearing/settlement participants, custodians, relevant market entities) to resolve issues and improve outcomes. Experience & preferred qualifications Bachelor’s degree (or above) in Finance, Accounting, or related field. 3–5 years’ experience in custody/post‑trade operations (KSA market experience strongly preferred). Strong understanding of KSA post‑trade flow across Muqassa (clearing/CCP) and Edaa (CSD/settlement) , and the implications of T+2 and DvP cash settlement via SAMA . Strong analytical/problem-solving skills, attention to detail, ability to work under strict cut-offs, and strong stakeholder management. JOB SUMMARY

Working on both projects and bid proposals, the Automation Engineer is responsible for the execution of automation systems, or parts thereof. The Automation Engineer is responsible for:

• developing an automation solution which meets the requirements of the proposal or project

• ensuring design and execution outputs are delivered in line with the time schedule and quality requirements

• providing technical support regarding automation design aspects throughout project and bid lifecycles

• undertaking other technical tasks as required (e.g. site surveys, feasibility studies, support to sales, etc)

• providing aftermarket support for customers with on 24/7 support up to 1 week per month (possible travel)

• basic understanding of English language – written and spoken

• additional languages a benefit

In general, the Automation Engineer will work as part of a team and will collaborate closely with other team members and functional disciplines to ensure successful delivery of the project or bid scope.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The Automation Engineer’s duties include, but are not limited to the following:

Automation Engineer

The primary role will be to undertake automation engineering design and execution tasks on projects or proposals, including:

• Safety & Environment

• Ensuring that automation solutions are safe

• Ensuring that e-stop, isolation & maintenance aspects of solutions have been considered appropriately

• Participating in relevant reviews, as defined in SPX Flow procedures and, additionally, customer contracts, and ensuring that her/his resultant actions have been completed. (Example reviews include: Design Reviews, Risk Assessments)

• Ensuring compliance with local legislation and regulations (for the locality of the plant/process) which apply to engineering design (e.g. EU Machinery Directive)

• Acting in a safe fashion, particularly when operating outside of the known office environment (e.g. on customer and supplier sites)

• Automation Design & Execution Tasks

• Generating automation solutions and defining and implementing their characteristics by means of (for example):

• Automation architecture diagrams

• Hardware and software selection and specification

• Control philosophy

• Software structure

• Functional design descriptions (e.g. FDS)

• Detailed design specifications (e.g. DDS)

• PLC software code (e.g. device logic, equipment modules, control modules, etc)

• Network and comms configuration

• Design and configuration of HMI applications

• Design and configuration of SCADA applications

• Interface with SCADA systems, I/O servers, etc

• Interface with MIS/MES systems and databases, where applicable

• Interface with ERP systems, where applicable

• Signal exchange / interfaces with other systems

• Adhering to SPX Flow procedures, and utilising applicable tools and design standards, during the development of automation solutions

• Completing design calculations (e.g. estimating number of tags) to support automation design and equipment selection

• Undertaking software simulation / Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Customer Acceptance Testing (CAT)

• Ensuring that tasks are completed in accordance with the project schedule, to the required quality and within the allocated budget.

• Solution Ownership

• Ensuring that the solution, for which they are responsible, is functional, and is executed in line with:

• Applicable legislation and regulation

• Customer contractual requirements (or, in case of proposal, RFQ/URS requirements)

• SPX references, standards and best practices, where applicable

• Ensuring that design output is complete and of a consistent standard. Examples include ensuring that:

• Documentation (e.g. FDS, DDS, SFC) utilises common standards across the project/proposal and that it is delivered to a consistent level in terms of content and quality

• Ensuring that S88 based software structures are maintained and applied consistently across an installation

• Ensuring all scope elements/sub-systems for which they are responsible integrate coherently and that external interfaces are clearly understood and defined

• Considering economic factors with a view to ensuring that the overall project is delivered on budget

• Communication & Team Working

• Undertaking technical discussions with customers and suppliers

• Attending relevant project or proposal meetings e.g.:

• Launch/“kick-off” meetings

• Progress reviews

• Design reviews

• Communicating information to stakeholders in a timely fashion

• Supporting other disciplines, during the design phase, to achieve project or proposal deliverables e.g.

• Supply Chain (e.g. initial specification, review of supplier quotes, purchase requisitions, etc)

• Process design (e.g. liaising re functional requirements)

• Electrical design (e.g. sharing I/O lists to allow allocation to panel, agreeing tagging and addressing standard)

• Supporting Installation & Commissioning team during the site execution phase e.g.:

• communicating design intent

• assisting with planning of commissioning activities

• undertaking automation commissioning

• owning resolution of automation snags

• Assisting with hand-over of records (e.g. source files) to Aftermarket team

• Documentation

• Ensuring that all design information is captured, stored and maintained, in the allocated location, in a structured and accessible fashion

• Preparing User Manuals

• Compiling Operating & Maintenance Manuals, including preparation of spares lists

• Assisting in compilation of Technical Files, or equivalent, as defined by relevant legislation (e.g. EU Machinery Directive)

• Additional Sales Support & Proposals Tasks

• Attending pre-contact customer meetings to provide technical support to the sales team

• Undertaking pre-contract studies (e.g. feasibility, site surveys)

• Reviewing technical aspects of quotation text

Lead Engineer

On a given project or proposal, the Automation Engineer may be allocated the role of “Lead Engineer”. In this capacity, the they will be expected to lead a multi-disciplinary team to deliver the overall design outputs for the scope package for which they are responsible. In this capacity, they will be responsible for additional tasks such as:

• Establishing and leading engineering team meetings/discussions

• Generating and maintaining time schedule for the engineering phase

• Identifying and communicating resource needs

• Actively managing team members to meet schedule demands and target on-budget execution (in terms of hours), whilst still ensuring delivery of a thoroughly engineered, complete design.

• Establishing and communicating consistent design and documentation standards for the project/proposal (e.g. building project “equipment catalogue”, setting P&ID symbol sets, setting auto HW standards, etc)

• Ensuring that required reviews and meetings (e.g. design reviews) are completed and that resultant actions are closed out by the team.

• Ensuring team compliance with SPX Flow processes and procedures

Engineering Community Member

As a member of the global engineering team, the Automation Engineer will be expected to actively participate in the wider technical community and provide support to colleagues, including:

• General Technical Support

• Acting as a “subject matter expert” in areas where they have appropriate experience and partake in knowledge sharing as required

• Supporting other staff in areas where they are inexperienced

• Providing general technical support outside of the specific projects/proposals for which they are responsible. Examples include:

• Conceptual design guidance during proposal stage

• Technical review of quotation text prior to bid submission

• Participating in design reviews as an “external” expert

• Continuous Improvement

• Providing input into continuous improvement initiatives (e.g. tools development, standardisation)

• Documenting and communicating “lessons learned”

• Involvement in knowledge sharing initiatives (e.g. documenting best practices)

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

• Additional language(s) an advantage

• Good communication skills

• Ability and willingness to work and build relationships with colleagues across multiple functions and geographically diverse sites

• Good analytical/problem-solving skills and attention to detail

Proactively identify, investigate, and resolve document management issues that could impact project delivery.

Liaise effectively with project teams, clients, vendors, subcontractors, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth document flow and communication.

Manage large volumes of multidisciplinary project documentation while maintaining accuracy and data integrity.

Work autonomously to achieve agreed project deliverables and document control objectives.

Significant experience in a Lead Document Control role on major EPC projects.

Strong knowledge of engineering, procurement, construction, and project document management processes.

Strong organisational, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

Familiarity with Saudi Aramco document control procedures and project requirements.

It works closely with academic, administrative, and technical partners to ensure that Registrar operations are accurate, auditable, service-oriented, and aligned with approved academic policy.

Major Responsibilities

• Registrar Operations and Service Delivery:

• Manage the day-to-day execution of Registrar services, including academic records, registration, scheduling, enrollment verification, instructional space coordination, graduation documentation, and related student lifecycle transactions.

• Ensure operational continuity, accuracy, timeliness, service quality, escalation management, and effective prioritization during peak academic cycles.

• SIS-Enabled Business Ownership and Functional Controls

• Serve as the functional business owner for Registrar-related SIS processes, data, rules, and workflows.

• Define Registrar business requirements, data standards, controls, acceptance criteria, and readiness needs for SIS-supported processes.

• Set up Registrar-owned functional requirements for SIS-supported operations, including semester setup, academic calendar configuration, curriculum/course setup, registration rules, degree audit rules, graduation processing, records processes, and other Registrar-controlled academic and student lifecycle functions.

• Ensure SIS-supported processes reflect approved policy, documented procedures, auditability, exception handling, and service standards.

• Lead business change management for Registrar-impacting system changes.

• Academic Information, Data Stewardship, and Reporting:

• Oversee the accuracy and currency of official academic information, including the Registrar website, Program Guide, Course Catalog, Academic Calendar, and student-facing materials.

• Maintain strong stewardship over Registrar-owned data elements, including definitions, validation, correction processes, quality checks, documentation, and reporting readiness for operations, analytics, accreditation, program review, and compliance needs.

• Policy Implementation, Compliance, and Records Governance:

• Support consistent implementation of academic and administrative policies related to registration, records, enrollment, academic standing, graduation, scheduling, and official academic information.

• Strengthen process documentation, approval pathways, controls, privacy and confidentiality compliance, academic integrity safeguards, records management, and escalation of policy or control risks to the University Registrar.

• Stakeholder Alignment and Student Lifecycle Coordination:

• Work closely with Admissions, Graduate Operations, Alumni Affairs, KAUST Academy, academic divisions, Associate Deans, GPSAs, administrative teams, and System Team to support coordinated student lifecycle operations.

• Represent Registrar operational requirements in working groups, readiness discussions, process improvement initiatives, and cross-functional forums as assigned.

• Performance, Continuous Improvement, and Team Support:

• Monitor service metrics, operational KPIs, workflow efficiency, backlog trends, data quality, cycle times, and stakeholder experience.

• Use evidence to identify bottlenecks, risks, training needs, and improvement opportunities.

• Support process standardization, automation readiness, knowledge management, staff supervision where assigned, and a service culture focused on accuracy, accountability, and institutional integrity.

Competencies

• Strong understanding of Registrar operations, student records, registration, scheduling, graduation, academic standing, and student lifecycle services.

• Ability to translate academic policy into clear procedures, controls, data rules, service standards, and SIS-supported workflows.

• Functional understanding of SIS-enabled operations, including data stewardship, workflow design, reporting, testing, and user acceptance.

• Strong knowledge of data governance, records management, privacy, confidentiality, auditability, academic integrity, and accreditation support.

• Strong analytical, documentation, problem-solving, stakeholder management, communication, and service leadership skills.

• Ability to support continuous improvement, operational change, KPI monitoring, quality assurance, and service coordination.

Qualifications/Experience

• Minimum 7–10 years of experience in Registrar operations, postgraduate academic administration, student services, or a comparable higher education environment.

• Experience with academic policy implementation, student records, registration, graduation, academic calendars, catalogues, and cross-functional student lifecycle operations.

• Experience with Banner or a comparable enterprise SIS is preferred.

+ Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word for analysis and technical reporting.
+ Good written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to prepare concise technical material.

+ Exposure to corridor studies, traffic impact studies, signal timing, road-safety assessments, public transport priority, parking, or construction traffic management.

+ Interest in smart mobility, ITS, data-driven traffic management, and innovative operational treatments.

job_title: Clinical Application specialist , Southern Region (Point of Care)
description:
Role Purpose  
  
The Clinical Application Specialist will be responsible for providing clinical, technical, and application support for Radiometer solutions across the full customer journey, from pre-sales engagement and product demonstrations through installation, validation, user training, troubleshooting, and post-go-live follow-up.  
  
This role will act as a key partner to the sales, service, IT, and business teams to ensure successful customer adoption, high-quality implementation, and strong customer satisfaction. The position will also support business growth by strengthening customer confidence, demonstrating clinical value, and positioning Radiometer as the partner of choice.  
  
Product Scope  
  
The role covers Radiometer Diagnostics solutions, including but not limited to:  
  
Blood Gas Analyzers  
  

* ABL90 FLEX
* ABL90 FLEX PLUS
* ABL800  
      
    

Immunoassay  
  

* AQT  
    

Sampling Devices  
  

* Syringes and capillaries  
    

Data Management System  
  

* AQURE Middleware  
    

Key Responsibilities  
  
Pre-Sales and Commercial Support  
  

* Support the sales team during customer meetings, opportunity development, product demonstrations, evaluations, and trials.
* Present Radiometer solutions, clinical value, workflow benefits, and technical differentiation to customers.
* Address customer clinical and technical questions during the sales process.
* Support competitive analysis, product positioning, and customized customer solutions.
* Work closely with business and sales managers to align the right solution with customer needs.
* Contribute to customer confidence and strengthen Radiometer’s position as a preferred partner.  
    

Product Training and User Enablement  
  

* Assess customer knowledge levels and identify training needs.
* Deliver structured training on product operation, maintenance, sampling, workflow usage, and clinical interpretation.
* Provide training materials, presentations, quick guides, and practical demonstrations.
* Validate user competency and ensure proper end-user understanding of Radiometer platforms.
* Reduce user errors through effective training, coaching, and continuous education.  
    

Installation Verification and Validation Support  
  

* Support customers during installation verification, validation, and go-live preparation.
* Prepare and guide customers through validation plans and protocols.
* Ensure quality control and compliance requirements are followed.
* Review validation results and support documentation completion.
* Obtain customer sign-off confirming system readiness and successful validation.  
    

Troubleshooting and Application Support  
  

* Respond to customer inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
* Identify and troubleshoot application-related issues, including instrument, sampling, user error, middleware, and workflow-related challenges.
* Perform root cause analysis and provide corrective actions.
* Escalate service-related issues to the service team when required.
* Work closely with service and IT teams to ensure proper installation, configuration, and issue resolution.
* Educate customers to prevent issue recurrence and maintain quality of results.  
    

Post-Go-Live Follow-Up and Customer Retention  
  

* Conduct follow-up visits or calls after installation and go-live.
* Review system performance, usage, and customer feedback.
* Identify gaps requiring retraining or additional support.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with end users, laboratory managers, clinicians, biomedical teams, IT teams, and key decision makers.
* Support customer retention and identify future opportunities within existing accounts.  
    

Regional Product and Marketing Support  
  

* Lead or support product application and marketing activities in the region.
* Develop strong partnerships with key decision makers in major accounts.
* Identify market opportunities and support business growth initiatives.
* Capture customer feedback and share insights with relevant internal teams.  
    

Key Stakeholders  
  
Internal Stakeholders  
  

* Sales Team
* Business Managers
* Service Team
* IT Team
* Marketing Team
* Regional Leadership
* Cross-functional Support Teams  
    

External Stakeholders  
  

* Laboratory Managers
* Clinicians
* End Users
* Biomedical Teams
* Hospital IT Teams
* Tender and Contract Departments
* Key Decision Makers in major accounts  
    

**Required Qualifications And Experience  
  
**

* Bachelor’s degree in clinical laboratory science, Biomedical Science, Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in clinical application, product application, diagnostics, laboratory, POCT, or IVD-related roles.
* Previous experience in sales support or product application support is required.
* Strong experience in Diagnostics, Laboratory, or Point-of-Care Testing is a must.
* Strong understanding of the sales process, from lead generation and opportunity development to deal closure and customer retention.
* Fluent in English and Arabic.  
    

**Required Technical Skills  
  
**

* Strong knowledge of laboratory workflows and diagnostic testing environments.
* Experience with POCT, blood gas, immunoassay, or related IVD platforms.
* Good understanding of validation, verification, quality control, troubleshooting, and user training processes.
* Ability to support customers from pre-sales stage through implementation and post-go-live support.
* Ability to work closely with service and IT teams on installation, middleware, and workflow-related topics.  
    

Required Behavioral Competencies  
  

* Excellent customer relationship management skills.
* Strong ability to engage key decision makers at different levels within the IVD industry.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain clinical and technical concepts clearly.
* Team player with strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage priorities and customize solutions for large and complex accounts.
* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting mindset.
* Commercial awareness and ability to identify market opportunities.
* Ownership, responsiveness, and customer-focused approach.  
    

KPIs / Success Measures  
  

* Successful validation and customer sign-off.
* High customer satisfaction.
* Reduction in user errors.
* Fast and effective issue resolution.
* Minimized customer downtime.
* Positive impact on pre-sales opportunities.
* Effective training delivery and user competency.
* Strong collaboration with sales, service, IT, and business teams.
* Contribution to customer retention and account growth.

Job Description

OVERVIEW

Job Title

Senior Engineer

Job Code

641944

Grade

I2

Group

Corporate Planning & Enablement

Division

Corporate Technology

Department

Corporate IT Operations

Unit

Enterprise Applications

ROLE PURPOSE

The aim is to state the overall significance of the job from the organization’s perspective.

The role exists to support the implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems by translating business requirements into technical solutions, configuring and integrating applications, and resolving complex technical issues. The role contributes to ERP availability, reliability, and continuity through testing, controlled deployments, technical coordination, and effective documentation in alignment with business objectives and IT architecture standards.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & ACTIVITIES

This section describes the principal outputs required from the job.

Key Accountabilities

Key Activities

• ERP Implementation & Deployment

• Support the implementation and deployment of ERP systems and modules in line with approved business and technical requirements.

• Configure ERP application components and coordinate release activities, deployment readiness, and rollback arrangements with relevant teams.

• Track assigned technical deliverables, timelines, and dependencies, and report risks and issues to relevant stakeholders.

• Business Requirements & Technical Solutions

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document ERP functional and technical requirements.

• Translate approved requirements into technical specifications, configurations, and enhancements aligned with IT architecture standards.

• Assess proposed ERP changes for technical feasibility, integration impacts, and alignment with business processes.

• ERP Technical Support & Service Management

• Provide Level 3 (L3) technical support for escalated ERP incidents and service requests.

• Investigate root causes, implement approved corrective actions, and coordinate complex issue resolution with technical teams and vendors.

• Perform assigned incident, problem, and change management activities in line with applicable ITIL practices and service procedures.

• ERP Integration & Access Enablement

• Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot interfaces between ERP systems and other enterprise applications, platforms, and services.

• Validate data exchanges and coordinate resolution of integration failures with relevant application and infrastructure teams.

• Support Single Sign-On (SSO) integration requests and access configurations in coordination with identity and information security teams.

• ERP Availability & Technical Operations

• Monitor ERP availability, performance, and scheduled processing, and investigate issues affecting business-critical services.

• Coordinate server, system, database, and network dependencies with infrastructure teams to maintain ERP stability and availability.

• Maintain ERP configuration records and provide application asset and software license usage information to relevant owners.

• ERP Backup, Recovery & Continuity

• Support ERP backup and recovery activities in coordination with infrastructure and database teams.

• Participate in disaster recovery planning and testing, validate application recovery, and document results and corrective actions.

• Identify application continuity risks and support recovery readiness in line with approved business continuity requirements.

• ERP Testing & Solution Validation

• Conduct technical, system, integration, and regression testing for ERP implementations, changes, and enhancements.

• Support user acceptance testing (UAT) with business stakeholders and validate solutions against approved requirements.

• Document test results, track defects, and verify corrective actions before production deployment.

• ERP Enhancement & Technical Coordination

• Support ERP enhancements and enterprise digital transformation initiatives based on business priorities and operational needs.

• Coordinate vendor support and maintenance activities, including patches, upgrades, and resolution of technical issues.

• Maintain documentation of ERP configurations, technical solutions, interfaces, integrations, and operational procedures, and support knowledge transfer.

• Policies, Processes & Procedures

• Follow all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.

• Comply with all relevant safety, quality, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls to ensure a healthy and safe work environment.

• Information Security

• Comply with all relevant information security practices and standards to ensure data integrity and confidentiality.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Academic and professional qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.

• Relevant certifications in ERP platforms, systems integration, or IT service management are considered an advantage.

Years and Nature of Experience

• 2–4 years of relevant experience in ERP implementation, configuration, technical support, development, or systems integration.

Job Description

OVERVIEW

Job Title

Consultant

Job Code

591284

Grade

I3

Group

-

Division

Corporate Development

Department

Corporate Performance Management

Unit

Performance Management

ROLE PURPOSE

The aim is to state the overall significance of the job from the organization’s perspective.

To contribute to the management and measurement of Elm's corporate performance by translating strategic objectives into measurable indicators, maintaining Balanced Scorecards (BSC) and KPIs, coordinating performance targets and data validation with business units, and supporting quarterly and annual performance reviews and reporting. The role supports evidence-based decision-making and continuous improvement in accordance with Elm's policies, procedures, and strategic objectives.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & ACTIVITIES

This section describes the principal outputs required from the job.

Key Accountabilities

Key Activities

1.  Strategic Alignment & Performance Objectives

•  Support the translation of Elm’s strategy and strategic objectives into measurable performance objectives and indicators.

•  Contribute to aligning departmental performance objectives and indicators with corporate strategic priorities.

•  Assist in documenting measurement approaches and expected outcomes for assigned objectives.

2.  Balanced Scorecard Development & Maintenance

•  Prepare, update, and maintain Balanced Scorecards (BSC) for relevant organizational levels.

•  Support the annual scorecard development cycle, including draft preparation, reviews, revisions, and approvals.

•  Coordinate scorecard updates with relevant departments to reflect approved objectives and measures.

3.  KPI Definition & Target Setting

•  Support business units in defining KPIs, performance targets, measurement methods, and supporting evidence requirements.

•  Coordinate discussions and follow-up concerning proposed targets and the alignment of measures with strategic objectives.

•  Maintain accurate documentation of approved indicators, targets, and methodologies.

4.  Performance Data Collection & Validation

•  Collect performance results and evidence from business units, and verify submissions for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

•  Clarify data gaps and follow up with data owners before using information for evaluation and reporting.

5.  Performance Measurement & Analysis

•  Analyze KPI results and performance trends to assess progress against approved objectives and targets.

•  Identify performance variances, emerging gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

•  Prepare evidence-based findings and recommendations to support performance discussions and corrective action.

6.  Quarterly & Annual Performance Reviews

•  Coordinate and support quarterly and annual corporate performance review cycles.

•  Track required submissions, validation activities, review milestones, and approvals against agreed timelines.

•  Prepare performance review materials and follow up on outstanding actions with relevant stakeholders.

7.  Corporate Performance Reporting

•  Prepare periodic corporate performance reports covering KPI results, target achievement, and key performance observations.

•  Contribute to quarterly and annual performance outputs used in management and Board of Directors reporting.

•  Present data and findings in clear, consistent tables, visuals, and executive-ready summaries.

8.  Stakeholder Coordination & Performance Improvement

•  Maintain regular coordination with internal stakeholders to obtain performance data, evidence, and required approvals.

•  Track stakeholder commitments and follow up on performance-related actions and deadlines.

•  Contribute to improving performance management methods and practices based on review findings and analysis.

9.  Policies, Processes & Procedures

•  Follow all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.

•  Comply with all relevant safety, quality, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls to ensure a healthy and safe work environment.

10.  Information Security

•  Comply with all relevant information security practices and standards to ensure data integrity and confidentiality.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Academic and professional qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Strategic Management, Industrial Engineering, Finance, Management Information Systems, or a related field.

Professional certifications in Balanced Scorecard (BSC), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Performance Management, or Strategic Planning are preferred.

 

Years and Nature of Experience

4–6 years of relevant experience in corporate performance management, strategic planning, performance measurement, KPI development, or a related field.

 

Experience in developing and monitoring Balanced Scorecards (BSC), managing KPIs, analyzing performance results, conducting quarterly and annual performance reviews, and preparing corporate performance reports for senior management.

 

Experience in stakeholder coordination, data validation, target setting, and identifying performance improvement opportunities.

Information Security

•  Bachelor degree a Computer Science and/or Master Degree in Business, Finance, IT.

•  Successfully IT audit related certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CGEIT, CISM.

Years and Nature of Experience

•  6 -8 years of relevant experience in a related industry

This role is responsible for supporting the sourcing, procurement, and contract management of engineering,

technology, and indirect service categories to ensure the timely, cost-effective, and compliant acquisition of

goods and services. The role coordinates procurement activities, analyses spending and supplier

performance, facilitates sourcing initiatives, and helps optimize procurement processes and commercial

outcomes. The role also supports stakeholder engagement, supplier relationship management, and

compliance with procurement policies, contractual obligations, and organizational objectives.

Job Role:

• Facilitate sourcing and procurement activities for engineering, IT services, software, hardware,

maintenance, consulting, and other indirect spend categories.

•
Coordinate with stakeholders to gather, clarify, and document procurement requirements,

specifications, delivery schedules, and commercial expectations.

•
Prepare and organize RFQs, RFPs, tender documentation, bid evaluations, and procurement

recommendations in accordance with approved procurement procedures.

•
Analyse supplier proposals, commercial offers, pricing structures, and total cost of ownership to

support sourcing and supplier selection decisions.

•
Perform end-to-end procurement activities, including sourcing, supplier evaluation, negotiation

support, contracting, and purchase order execution.

•
Track sourcing initiatives, purchase orders, contracts, supplier deliverables, and procurement

milestones to ensure timely completion and compliance.

•
Develop spend analyses, procurement reports, supplier performance assessments, and market

intelligence to support decision-making and category management activities.

•
Gather market information, pricing benchmarks, supplier capabilities, and industry trends to identify

cost optimization and value creation opportunities.

•
Apply procurement policies, procedures, governance requirements, and delegated authority limits

throughout procurement activities.

•
Check procurement records, supplier quotations, contracts, and purchasing transactions to ensure

accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

•
Coordinate supplier qualification, onboarding, performance review, and relationship management

activities to maintain reliable supply sources.

•
Analyse procurement data and spending patterns to identify savings opportunities, demand

aggregation initiatives, and process improvement recommendations.

•
Prepare commercial evaluations, negotiation inputs, and business cases that support procurement

recommendations and contract award decisions.

•
Keep procurement documentation, contract records, supplier databases, and sourcing files

accurate, complete, and up to date.

•
Lead assigned sourcing initiatives and procurement improvement activities to enhance commercial

value, operational efficiency, supplier performance, and stakeholder satisfaction.

•

Coordinate the development, review, execution, and administration of Master Service Agreements

(MSAs), Framework Agreements, Statements of Work (SOWs), and service contracts to ensure

compliance, commercial effectiveness, and continuity of services.

Job Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or Equivalent

Experience: 3 years minimum in a relevant field

Job Purpose

The PTS Machining Centre Senior Specialist is a hands-on technical joining specialist within the department who is responsible for the execution of activities involving prototype vehicle build, manufacture and modification of prototype parts, jigs and fixtures. The individual is responsible for providing technical direction and expertise to the department, and specialists on the processes, techniques and materials required for the manufacture of low volume prototype parts, jigs and fixtures and support prototype vehicle build whilst ensuring the output meets all engineering specifications and requirements.

Job Role

Key Functional Responsibilities

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and CAD data.

• Skilled in the practical operation of joining technology such as welding (CMT, MIG, TIG, spot, stud), riveting and gluing on ferrous and non-ferrous materials.

• Skilled in the practical operation of fabrication technology such metal forming, bending, rolling, drilling, cutting and grinding.

• Skilled in the practical operation of CNC laser cutting machine.

• Skilled In car body repair methods.

• Skilled in vehicle assembly/disassembly

• Previous experience working within prototype vehicle build programmes, including Mule vehicles, Product and Process Validation (PPV) builds, and Production Trial (PT) phases

• Previous experience working in a prototype manufacturing facility

• Knowledge of weld testing (destructive, non-destructing, ultrasonic)

• Support the implementation of quality management system policies in line with business requirements.

• Support the Implementation of health and safety policies in line with business requirements

• Support the Implementation of manufacturing processes and control plans

job_title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for AI and GenAI Inference Optimization
description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

  
  
  

**Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for AI and GenAI Inference Optimization**

### About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Member of Technical Staff to join our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team. In this customer-facing role, you will work directly with strategic partners and customers to enable, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art GenAI inference workloads on AMD data center CPUs and GPUs (Instinct™ family). You will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI models and AMD hardware, driving competitive performance across the full inference stack.

### Responsibilities

* Partner directly with customers to enable and optimize large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models on AMD Instinct GPUs, meeting committed performance and accuracy targets.
* Optimize GenAI inference pipelines on vLLM and SGLang, including PD disaggregation, expert parallelism (EP/wide-EP), tensor/data parallelism, speculative decoding, and KV cache management.
* Develop and tune low-level GPU kernels (Triton, HIP, composable kernels) for attention, MoE, GEMM, quantization, and normalization operations.
* Profile end-to-end workloads, identify bottlenecks across GPU/CPU boundaries, and deliver measurable throughput and latency improvements versus competitive targets.
* Enable advanced data types and techniques (FP8, MXFP4, sparse attention) with a focus on both performance and numerical accuracy.
* Debug complex runtime, stability, and accuracy issues in production environments; partner with core engineering teams to identify root causes and contribute fixes.
* Contribute optimizations back to open-source frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, ATOM, AITER) and internal libraries; document best practices and deliver production-ready artifacts to customers.
* Leverage **AI-assisted coding tools and agentic workflows** to accelerate development, debugging, optimization, and code review across the inference stack.

### What You'll Bring

* BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, along with 8+ years of relevant experience.
* Deep expertise in GPU architecture and performance optimization, including hands-on experience with AMD ROCm (or CUDA) and GPU kernel development.
* Strong proficiency in Python and C++, with experience developing and optimizing kernels using Triton, HIP, or CUDA.
* **Experience with AI-assisted coding** and agentic development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) to enhance productivity in kernel development, large-scale codebase navigation, debugging, and framework integration.
* Experience working with LLM inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, or equivalent) and serving optimization techniques.
* Solid understanding of transformer and MoE architectures, quantization, and distributed inference strategies (TP, DP, EP, and related parallelism techniques).
* Proficiency with profiling and debugging tools (e.g., rocProfiler, ROCdebug-agent).

### Nice to Have

* Experience optimizing frontier models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, GLM, etc.) in production environments.
* Track record of contributing to open-source AI inference frameworks.
* Experience integrating AI-driven automation into engineering workflows and developer tooling.
* Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to manage technical deliverables against committed timelines.

AMD is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates to apply even if their experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed. If you are excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we would welcome your application.

As Sr. Manager, Brand Marketing, you will own the integrated brand and portfolio strategy for our diabetes business in Saudi Arabia. You will turn affiliate priorities into clear growth, market-share and return-on-investment objectives, and lead a team that connects strategy, market development and field execution. From launch readiness to new channels and partnerships, your decisions will shape how our treatments reach healthcare professionals and people living with diabetes across KSA.

What you’ll bring

You are a commercial leader who sets direction, makes clear choices and delivers through others. You will bring:

• A relevant academic degree in medicine, pharmacy, science or business.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

• Strong brand, portfolio, lifecycle, go-to-market and omnichannel / multichannel engagement capability.

• Strong business, commercial and financial acumen, and a data-driven approach to decisions.

• The ability to translate strategy into clear priorities and deliver results through others.

• Strong communication, influencing, stakeholder management and executive presentation skills.

• A high patient and science orientation, with sound judgement across growth, evidence, access and compliance.

What you’ll do

You will set the strategic direction for the brand and portfolio plan, lead the team that brings it to life, and expand the market, channels and partnerships that drive sustainable growth.

• Lead in-depth analysis of market dynamics, prescribing habits, the competitive and access landscape and how patients and customers move through care – then define the annual and long-term brand and portfolio strategy, priority segments and go-to-market approach.

• Own the marketing budget and resource allocation, investing in the highest-impact initiatives. Set KPIs and governance to track forecasts, sales, market share, share of growth, customer engagement and campaign ROI, and act quickly when performance deviates.

• Integrate HCP, KOL/DOL, consumer, pharmacy and e-health touchpoints into coordinated omnichannel plans with clear content calendars, KPIs and owners – and make sure Sales and other execution teams understand the strategy, with training and feedback loops.

• Spend at least 20% of your time with target customers, working alongside the sales force on a regular visit plan.

• Identify growth whitespace, strategic accounts, new channels and partnerships; lead counterstrategies, lifecycle actions and launch readiness, including future indications and formulations.

• Direct external agencies, vendors and partners with clear briefs, governance, performance measures and budget discipline, so execution is high quality and compliant with Novo Nordisk policies and local regulations.

Minimum requirements

• 3-4 years of brand management experience.

• Experience in diabetes therapy area is preferred.

• Portfolio management is an advantage.

• Previous track record with a team of direct reports is a plus.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Marketing team in the KSA affiliate, part of International Operations, where colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale. You will report to the Cardiometabolic Associate Director for HCP Marketing

Your closest partners will be Sales, Medical, Market Access & Public Affairs, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Procurement and People & Organisation, as well as Business Area and Region leadership. You will represent Commercial Marketing in cross-functional governance, bringing these teams together so decisions are aligned across the product life cycle.

Outside Novo Nordisk, you will build relationships with key and digital opinion leaders, healthcare professionals, scientific societies, hospitals, patient advocacy groups and strategic commercial partners across KSA.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to own decisions. Within agreed objectives and budget governance, you will set direction, allocate resources and approve or recommend priorities and investments – and you will see the results of those choices in the market.

You will work with advanced analytics, market intelligence and AI-enabled tools, and lead experiments with new channels, digital health and omnichannel engagement, scaling what delivers measurable value. Clear performance expectations, honest feedback and a culture that rewards results will support you to grow as a leader while your team grows with you.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead brand strategy that turns insight into progress for people living with diabetes in Saudi Arabia, apply for the Sr. Manager, Brand Marketing role by 21 October 2026.
