description:
Decima International is a professional services company, providing project management and controls services to clients in the United States and the Middle East. Our mission is to become the premier professional services provider across all industry sectors we are engaged in. To accomplish this, Decima International’s founders established a simple yet powerful formula:

Approach each client engagement as a **partnership**, create an environment that attracts the **most talented professionals** and allows them to flourish, and regulate **growth** to maintain **excellence** in our service standards.

We are seeking an experienced Procurement & Contracts Lead to lead the procurement and contracts function on large-scale data center, mission-critical, and infrastructure programs in KSA.

The role sits within Decima’s Project Management Consultancy (PMC) teams, acting as the Owner’s onsite representative and leading the full procurement and contract lifecycle for EPC contractors and major project packages on the Client’s behalf.

The successful candidate will support procurement and contracting strategy, lead tendering and award activities, manage post-award contract administration, variations, claims, payments, and close-out, and protect the Client’s commercial and contractual position throughout project delivery.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Support the Client in developing procurement and contracting strategies and lead their implementation across project packages.
* Develop procurement package plans, tender schedules, bidder lists, and procurement governance processes.
* Lead contractor and supplier prequalification, capability assessments, RFQs, RFPs, and tendering activities.
* Prepare and coordinate scopes of work, pricing schedules, contract exhibits, clarification logs, and tender addenda.
* Lead technical and commercial bid evaluations, including review of bidder qualifications, assumptions, exclusions, pricing, schedules, delivery methodology, and contractual deviations.
* Prepare bid comparison sheets, evaluation reports, negotiation strategies, and award recommendations for Client approval.
* Lead tender clarification meetings, bidder interviews, commercial alignment discussions, and negotiations.
* Coordinate with cost teams to benchmark pricing and validate project budgets.
* Lead post-award administration of EPC and major project contracts.
* Review and interpret contractual terms, scope provisions, payment mechanisms, warranties, liabilities, indemnities, and termination provisions.
* Refer matters requiring formal legal interpretation to the Client’s legal function.
* Own and maintain contract registers for notices, bonds, guarantees, insurance, payments, variations, claims, and contractual key dates.
* Ensure contractual notices and responses are issued accurately and within required timeframes.
* Lead variation, change order, and change-control processes.
* Review contractor claims, including extension-of-time and cost claims, and prepare recommended Owner positions.
* Support assessment and certification of interim payments, milestone payments, retention, provisional sums, and final accounts.
* Monitor contractor contractual performance and compliance.
* Support dispute avoidance and development of contractual and commercial positions.
* Own OFCI / CFCI and long-lead equipment tracking, including responsibility splits between the Client and contractor.
* Chair periodic long-lead equipment and procurement coordination meetings.
* Identify and escalate delivery or procurement risks that could affect the project program.
* Lead contract and commercial close-out, including final account settlement, warranties, securities, outstanding claims, and completion documentation.
* Maintain warranty and defects registers throughout the applicable defects liability period.
* Identify procurement, contractual, commercial, technical, and schedule risks and ensure appropriate mitigation actions are assigned and tracked.
* Prepare procurement and contracts dashboards, claims reports, variation reports, risk reports, and executive updates for the Client’s PMO.
* Provide guidance to project teams on tender governance, contract interpretation, change management, claims avoidance, and commercial risk.
* Lead and develop the procurement and contracts team, including contract administrators, procurement engineers, and tendering support staff.
* Manage team resourcing, package allocation, quality review, and technical development.
* Coordinate closely with project management, engineering, cost, planning, commercial, commissioning, document control, and Client teams.
* Escalate matters outside the PMC’s delegated authority to the Project / Site Director for referral to the Client.
* Maintain confidentiality of contractual, commercial, pricing, and tender information and ensure integrity of the procurement process.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Law, or a related discipline.
* 12–15 years of procurement and contracts experience\*\* on major construction or infrastructure projects.
* Minimum \*\*5 years of experience leading a procurement, contracts, or commercial function\*\*.
* Strong experience managing the full procurement lifecycle from strategy and tendering through award, administration, and close-out.
* Strong contractor prequalification and tender management experience.
* Extensive experience with technical and commercial bid evaluation.
* Strong knowledge of EPC contract administration under FIDIC or equivalent contract forms.
* Experience administering EPC lump-sum contracts.
* Strong contract interpretation skills, including risk allocation, liabilities, indemnities, warranties, and termination provisions.
* Strong commercial management and change-control experience.
* Experience managing variations, change orders, claims, and extension-of-time assessments.
* Experience supporting payment certification against contractual payment mechanisms.
* Strong final account management and contract close-out experience.
* Experience managing contractors and suppliers.
* Experience administering bonds, guarantees, insurance, and contractual securities.
* Strong procurement and contractual risk-management capabilities.
* Experience managing long-lead equipment and OFCI / CFCI arrangements.
* Experience preparing procurement and contracts reports for executive and Client audiences.
* Proven team leadership experience, including resourcing, package allocation, and review of team output.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong skills in Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Experience with SAP, Oracle, or equivalent ERP / procurement / contract management systems.
* Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to prepare, communicate, and defend contractual positions clearly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience on data center or mission-critical projects.
* Experience on at least two data center or comparable projects with individual project values exceeding \*\*USD 500 million\*\*.
* Strong PMC or Owner’s Representative experience.
* Experience working with major hyperscale, government-linked, or PIF-affiliated clients.
* Strong knowledge of the KSA procurement market, including regional contractors, vendors, local content requirements, and procurement regulations.
* Professional accreditation such as \*\*CIPS, MRICS / RICS, PMP, AACE, CIArb\*\*, or equivalent.
* Master’s degree in a relevant discipline.
* Arabic language capability.
* Experience with both single-EPC and multi-package project delivery models.
* Experience managing OFCI / CFCI arrangements where the Owner directly procured major equipment.
* Exposure to dispute resolution processes, including DAB / DAAB, adjudication, or arbitration support.
* Strong working knowledge of ERP, procurement, and contract management platforms.

**PRODUCTIVITY TOOLS**

* Microsoft Excel
* Microsoft Word
* Microsoft PowerPoint
* Microsoft Outlook
* SAP
* Oracle
* ERP / Procurement Platforms
* Contract Management Systems
* EDMS / PMIS Platforms
* Procurement and Tender Trackers
* Claims and Variation Trackers
* Risk and Executive Reporting Dashboards

You will lead the presales engagement from discovery and requirements gathering through solution positioning, demonstrations, RFPs and POCs, engaging business and technical stakeholders including CIOs, CDOs and IT leaders.

WHAT IT TAKES

• 8+ years in enterprise software / technology, with significant experience in presales, solution consulting or solution architecture.

Job Summary

The Site HSE Specialist is responsible for implementing and monitoring health, safety, and environmental requirements for earthworks, deep excavation, and associated construction activities for a project in Makkah. The role ensures compliance with approved HSE plans, project specifications, applicable Saudi regulations, and client requirements, with particular emphasis on excavation safety, ground stability, heavy equipment operations, and prevention of workplace incidents.

Key Responsibilities

• Implement and monitor project HSE plans, procedures, risk assessments, and method statements for earthworks and deep excavation activities.

• Conduct daily site inspections to identify unsafe conditions, hazardous practices, and potential risks associated with excavation and construction operations.

• Monitor excavation safety, including trench protection, shoring, slope stability, access and egress, edge protection, and ground movement.

• Ensure excavation permits, work permits, utility clearances, and required approvals are in place before work commences.

• Monitor heavy equipment operations, including excavators, dump trucks, bulldozers, loaders, and other earthmoving machinery, ensuring safe movement and segregation of personnel and equipment.

• Verify implementation of controls for underground utilities, falling materials, falling into excavations, dust, noise, vibration, and potential water ingress.

• Ensure compliance with requirements for working near excavation edges, lifting operations, temporary works, and confined spaces where applicable.

• Conduct toolbox talks, safety inductions, and regular workforce awareness sessions on excavation hazards and safe work practices.

• Monitor the correct use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and compliance with site safety rules.

• Report and investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe acts, and follow up on corrective and preventive actions.

• Coordinate with construction teams, subcontractors, engineers, and HSE management to resolve safety concerns and ensure compliance with approved procedures.

• Maintain HSE inspection records, incident reports, permit documentation, safety observations, and daily and weekly reports.

• Monitor emergency preparedness, including excavation rescue arrangements, emergency access, evacuation procedures, and first-aid provisions.

• Ensure proper housekeeping, waste management, dust suppression, and environmental protection measures are implemented.

• Immediately report critical hazards and stop unsafe work in accordance with project procedures and delegated authority.

Qualification, Technical Skills and Competencies

• Diploma or bachelor's degree or relevant degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC) is required.

• Additional certifications in first aid, incident investigation, or construction safety are an advantage.

• Minimum 5 years of relevant HSE experience in construction, earthworks, and excavation projects.

• Demonstrated experience in deep excavation, trenching, shoring, ground support, and heavy equipment operations.

• Experience working on large-scale infrastructure, urban development, or construction projects.

• Familiarity with Saudi HSE regulations, client requirements, permit-to-work systems, and construction safety procedures.

• Experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC is preferred.

• Strong knowledge of excavation hazards, ground stability, shoring systems, and construction risk controls.

• Ability to conduct site inspections, risk assessments, toolbox talks, and incident investigations.

• Good understanding of heavy equipment safety, traffic management, lifting operations, and emergency response.

• Ability to identify hazards, enforce safe working practices, and coordinate effectively with construction teams and subcontractors.

• Strong communication, reporting, observation, and problem-solving skills.

• Proficiency in preparing HSE reports, maintaining safety records, and monitoring corrective actions.

• Ability to work in a demanding construction environment and respond effectively to high-risk activities.

Job Description

Jeddah Hilton and Waldorf Astoria Jeddah are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Accounts Payable Clerk to support the Finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for processing supplier invoices, maintaining vendor records, preparing payment runs, and ensuring accurate financial reporting and compliance. The role requires strong analytical skills, sound accounting knowledge, and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal departments and external vendors.
The ideal candidate will possess experience in accounts payable, preferably within the hospitality industry, and demonstrate a commitment to accuracy, integrity, and service excellence.

• Process supplier invoices accurately and ensure timely posting into the accounting system.

• Perform three-way matching between Purchase Orders (PO), Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), and supplier invoices.

• Prepare payment runs in accordance with company policies and approved payment schedules.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date vendor master data.

• Reconcile supplier statements and investigate discrepancies.

• Reconcile the Accounts Payable subledger with the General Ledger.

• Support month-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and AP aging reports.

• Respond to vendor inquiries and resolve payment-related issues professionally and promptly.

• Ensure compliance with Saudi VAT regulations, withholding tax requirements, and ZATCA guidelines.

• Maintain proper documentation and filing of financial records for audit purposes.

• Collaborate with Purchasing, Receiving, Cost Control, and other departments to ensure smooth financial operations.

• Follow Hilton policies, financial controls, and audit requirements at all times.

Qualifications & Technical Skills:

• Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Valid SOCPA Membership is required.

• 2–4 years of Accounts Payable experience, preferably within the hospitality industry.

• Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting the AIR6500 software development lifecycle.

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of CI/CD and DevSecOps infrastructure supporting automated testing and deployment activities.

• Assist with automating software builds, build verification activities and internal business processes.

• Assist with implementing best practices for source control, continuous integration and release management.

• Support the deployment, maintenance and evolution of the 1LMX tool suite.

We're looking for an engineer with strong technical foundations, a passion for automation, and an interest in improving software delivery and engineering processes.

• Experience with version and artifact management tools such as GitLab and Nexus.

• Experience with build and continuous integration tools, particularly GitLab.

• Experience with issue tracking and workflow management tools such as Jira.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Ansible, Terraform and Packer.

• Experience or exposure to containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

• Review system designs, architecture and technical changes to assess security impacts and ensure compliance.

• Conduct threat modelling, threat hunting and vulnerability assessments to identify and mitigate cyber risks.

• Provide technical cyber security expertise, troubleshooting support and guidance to engineering, architecture, operations and program stakeholders.

• Proven experience in security architecture, security requirements analysis, assurance, accreditation and risk management.

• Expertise in Linux administration, VMware environments, system hardening and platform sustainment.

• Experience with Elastic Security, SIEM technologies, security event monitoring and incident response.

• Strong understanding of network architecture, identity and access management, ASD-approved cryptographic requirements and secure system design.

• Demonstrated capability in vulnerability management, threat analysis and developing effective remediation strategies.

• Proficient in AI as it applies to this

F5 is seeking a driven and strategically minded Senior Regional Business Manager to lead our growth in AI-driven opportunities across META (Middle East, Turkey and Africa) region.

This role is at the intersection of cutting-edge AI infrastructure, national strategic programs, and F5’s evolving full [AI portfolio](https://www.f5.com/ai), including [AI Infrastructure](https://www.f5.com/solutions/ai-infrastructure#overview)  and [AI Security](https://www.f5.com/solutions/ai-security) solutions. We’re looking for someone who’s not only a strong strategic sales hunter but also a connector. Someone with established relationships across AI alliances, strategic partners, national AI programs, and infrastructure vendors, who can open doors and help position F5 as a long-term AI enabler in the region.

Key Responsibilities:

* Drive AI-related sales for F5 across the META region, focusing on organizations deploying or planning investments in NVIDIA or similar DPU/GPU-based AI infrastructure.
* Identify and develop opportunities where F5’s AI portfolio, can play a critical role in securing and scaling AI workloads in modern environments.
* Target strategic AI initiatives across the region, especially in sectors such as government, defense, telecom, smart cities, and national data infrastructure
* Build and expand strategic relationships with ecosystem players, including cloud service providers, AI hardware vendors (e.g., NVIDIA), national AI bodies, and AI-focused partners.
* Leverage your existing network to open doors and position F5 in early-stage AI projects where our solutions can add value.
* Work closely with internal teams, including Sales Engineering, Product, Partner, and Marketing, to develop strategic account plans and value-driven proposals.
* Maintain a strong pipeline of AI-related opportunities across the region and deliver on ambitious sales goals aligned with F5’s AI growth strategy.
* Represent F5 at key AI summits, partner forums, and national digital transformation events, acting as the regional face of F5’s AI strategy.

What We’re Looking For:

* 8–10+ years of enterprise sales experience, ideally with a mix of infrastructure, AI, or security solutions, with a clear record of hunting and closing large, strategic deals.
* Strong understanding of AI infrastructure, including LLMs, GPUs/DPUs, Kubernetes, and AI/ML security challenges.
* Proven experience working with or alongside AI ecosystem players such as cloud providers, chipset vendors (NVIDIA or similar), and national AI or digital transformation entities.
* A robust network across META-based AI alliances, infrastructure leaders, or government innovation programs.
* Experience in engaging C-level stakeholders, including CIOs, Chief AI/Data Officers, and transformation leaders.
* Familiarity with F5 products is a plus, especially BIG-IP Next, NGINX, XC, BNK, and AI Gateway.
* Fluent in English and Arabic preferred

The Retail Agent is a multi-skilled team member responsible for delivering an exceptional guest experience across all Miraval retail outlets. This position combines guest-facing sales responsibilities with inventory, warehouse, administrative, and merchandising duties. The Retail Agent supports every aspect of the retail operation from assisting guests on the sales floor to receiving, processing, and stocking merchandise ensuring seamless daily operations and a consistently high level of service and presentation.
Retail Agents embody Miraval’s commitment to wellness, balance, and meaningful guest connections. Professionalism, accuracy, and exceptional service are essential qualities for success in this role.
Guest Service & Sales
- Welcome, engage, and assist guests upon entering the boutique.
- Assess guest needs and make knowledgeable product recommendations.
- Actively engage guests in conversation to support product education and selection.
- Use upselling and suggestive selling techniques to achieve sales goals.

Point-of-Sale Operations

- Complete returns, exchanges, and voids accurately.
- Manage and reconcile daily sales reports.
- Execute phone, online, and special orders.
Merchandising & Store Presentation
- Maintain store appearance to the highest visual presentation standards.
- Restock sales floors throughout the day and during opening/closing shifts.
- Organize stockrooms and ensure accurate merchandise labeling and pricing.
- Assist in merchandising displays and product placement to optimize sales.
Inventory, Receiving & Warehouse Support
- Receive, check in, price, and process all retail merchandise.
- Enter merchandise data into the inventory system.
- Input future orders as directed and maintain accuracy in the Retail Checkbook.
- Handle returns of damaged items and coordinate backorders and credits.
- Organize and maintain the retail warehouse, including recycling and stocking packing materials.
- Deliver “ready” stock to all retail outlets via golf cart.
- Ensure retail outlets are consistently stocked with supplies and inventory.
- Lead or assist with physical inventory counts and regular audits.
- Support retail leadership with inventory accuracy and administrative inventory tasks.
Teamwork & Professional Conduct
- Attend staff meetings and mandatory trainings.
- Support Retail Manager and Retail Supervisor with operational priorities and assigned projects.
- Maintain confidentiality, professionalism, and a positive work environment.
- Act as back-up Retail Sales Associate when needed.

Required Qualifications:
Skills & Abilities
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong professionalism and the ability to uphold guest comfort and confidentiality.
- Patience and strong customer-service skills, including handling difficult interactions.
- Proficiency with basic math and cash-handling procedures.
- Ability to use cash registers and POS systems (training provided).
- High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and efficiency in all inventory and sales tasks.
- Ability to execute multiple tasks independently and prioritize effectively.
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel (preferred).
Education & Experience
- High school diploma or equivalent required.
- Minimum 1 year of retail experience preferred.
- Experience in inventory management or warehouse operations is a plus.
- Speaking English and Arabic languages
Physical Demands
- Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
- Ability to stand and walk for 95% of the shift.
- Ability to push, pull, bend, reach, and climb ladders or step ladders.
- Ability to work an 8-hour shift performing both sales-floor and warehouse duties.
Miraval Commitment
The Retail Agent plays a vital role in upholding Miraval’s mission of wellness, balance, and meaningful connection. Every task whether assisting a guest or organizing inventory contributes to a seamless, supportive, and enriching experience for both guests and colleagues.

job_title: Information Security Third Party Risk Management Specialist
description:
Who we are is what we do.
Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.
Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?
As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.
Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.
Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Key Areas of Expertise

• Third-Party Risk Assessment & Vendor Evaluation: Deep experience conducting security questionnaires, reviewing certifications (SOC2, ISO 27001, etc.), and scoring vendor risk profiles.

• Hands on experience and AI automation: This role includes a responsibility of automation the processes that you are working on

• Compliance & Contract Governance: Expertise in translating security and compliance requirements into vendor contracts, SLAs, and audit requirements.

• SaaS Security Posture & AI Risk Management: Understanding of cloud service security, SaaS-specific vulnerabilities, and emerging AI vendor risks.

• Working with TPRM software like Panorays, OneTrust etc.

• Providing security requirements for implementations of new systems.

Responsibilities

• Vendor Risk Assessment & Intake: Design and manage vendor security assessment workflows. Integrate security questionnaires (Panorays, etc.) into standardized evaluation processes. Conduct deep-dive security reviews of third-party SaaS providers, cloud vendors, and AI services to determine risk profiles.

• Risk Scoring & Metrics: Develop and maintain vendor risk scoring models aligned with organizational risk appetite. Track key risk indicators (KRIs) for active vendors and escalate material changes in vendor security posture.

• Compliance Questionnaire Management: Own the questionnaire lifecycle—intake, response validation, remediation tracking, and integration into risk decision workflows. Ensure vendor responses are accurate and evidence-backed.

• Contract & SLA Negotiation: Partner with procurement and legal to embed security requirements in vendor contracts. Negotiate security clauses, data protection terms, audit rights, and incident notification obligations.

• Vendor Incident & Breach Management: Monitor and respond to third-party security incidents. Lead investigation into vendor breaches affecting organizational data. Coordinate remediation and assess impact on compliance posture.

• Continuous Vendor Monitoring: Establish ongoing monitoring of active vendors through automated tools, re-assessments, and public breach intelligence. Maintain audit trails for all vendor risk decisions and remediation activities.

• TPRM Policy & Governance: Author and maintain vendor risk management policies, vendor tiering frameworks, and assessment standards. Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, etc.).

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with DevSecOps, procurement, legal, compliance, and business teams to translate vendor risk findings into business decisions. Drive adoption of vendor risk assessments across the organization.

• Vendor Risk Reporting & Insights: Produce executive reporting on vendor risk trends, concentration risk, and remediation progress. Identify patterns in vendor vulnerabilities to inform procurement strategy.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in Information Security, with at least 3 years focused on Third-Party Risk Management, vendor assessments, or supply chain security.

• Technical Literacy: Working knowledge of AI automation (Gemini & Claude) SaaS architecture, and common vendor security controls.

• Assessment & Questionnaire Expertise: Proven experience with security questionnaire frameworks (Panorays, OneTrust, Archer, etc.) and vendor risk scoring methodologies.

• Compliance Knowledge: Strong understanding of compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, etc.) and ability to translate requirements into vendor terms.

• Contract & Legal Acumen: Familiarity with vendor contracts, SLAs, data processing agreements, and security clauses. Comfortable negotiating with legal and procurement.

• Analytical Mindset: Ability to assess complex vendor security postures, identify gaps, and recommend risk mitigation strategies.

Nice to Haves

• Experience with high-tech or SaaS companies managing large vendor ecosystems.

• Experience with remote-first or distributed organizations.

• Experience working asynchronously across different time zones and cultures.

• Hands-on experience building or scaling vendor risk management processes from scratch.

• Background in procurement, contract management, or vendor management.

• Familiarity with TPRM tools or GRC platforms (OneTrust, Archer etc.).

• Experience with Panorays as a TPRM tool.

Total Rewards
Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

• Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.

• Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.

• Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.

• We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.

Some things you'll enjoy

• Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

• Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

• Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @deel.com and other acquired company emails like @payspace.com and @paygroup.com. You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page.

Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation.

This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. 🌀 THE COMPANY

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

🎯 THE ROLE

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success Team and help us guide and grow relationships with our customers across Middle East. Based in Saudi Arabia and working remotely, you will play a key role in ensuring the success and satisfaction of our users throughout their journey with Filigran. You will collaborate closely with support, engineering, and product teams to align technical delivery with business goals, while acting as a trusted advisor to our customers.

💼 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own and manage the full customer journey: onboarding, adoption, training, and renewal

- Deliver training and carry out missions for customers

- Build strong, proactive relationships with customers across Middle East

- Identify and support opportunities for upsell and cross-sell in partnership with Sales

- Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer issues quickly and effectively

- Collect and share customer feedback to improve product and service quality

- Track success metrics and use data to inform customer strategy and engagement

🤝 WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

- You will report to the VP of Customer Success EMEA

- Work closely with Customer Support Engineers (CSEs), Customer Platform Architects (CPAs), Sales, Product, and Engineering

- Partner with regional teams to serve a diverse Middle East customer base

- Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure high customer satisfaction and retention

🧬 PROFILE WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role in SaaS or tech

- 3+ years of experience in the cybersecurity sector, especially threat intelligence

- Fluent in Arabic and English

- Based in Saudi Arabia with experience supporting regional customers in Middle East

- Strong technical aptitude and ability to work with tools like OpenCTI or OpenAEV (training available)

- Excellent communication skills and comfort working in English-first environments

- Comfortable in a remote, async-first culture

- Experience with CRM/CSM tools, customer journey tracking, and success metrics

🌱 WHY JOIN FILIGRAN? MORE THAN JUST A JOB.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

- Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

- Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

- 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

- Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

- Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

- Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 READY TO JOIN US?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

Mövenpick Hotel & Residences Riyadh

## Job Description

Our Vision, we make moments

Mövenpick Hotels & Residences (MH&R) is in the “moments” business. We’re intimately involved in important times in our guests lives. And you never know when a moment can be made. A simple smile in the lobby can create the positivity that turns a business trip into a new business celebration. An insider tip on the best way to spend a day can make an entire holiday. A romantic dinner for two can lead to a longer-term partnership.

It doesn’t take much to create a moment — just be genuine, human, and warm. Take small steps to turn the ordinary into something extraordinary

We understand that this vision cannot be achieved without great people who create and support work environments designed to produce exceptional results. 

The Role

1.    To oversee and lead the Banquet department of the Hotel.   
2.    Banquet Manager is responsible for the smooth operation of his/her specific Event as governed by contract and deemed by operational requirements.  
3.    He or she must be fully responsible for the daily operation and maintenance of banquet FF&E and OSE, as well as for organizing storage areas and ensuring cleanliness.  
4.    He/she is responsible in linking all facets of cuisine and entertainment and then delivering these to guests.  
5.    He/she must be able to control and coordinate a labour pool of many and varied backgrounds.  
6.    He/she will have a majority of casual labour and hence it is essential to have quality staff management skills.  
7.    Should be creative and confident and be prepared to step outside of the confines of comfort.  
8.    He/she should take the time to get to know the guests and be committed to service excellence.  
9.    Team play is imperative and having the time to invest in self-development is mandatory.  
10.    Being entrepreneurial, thinking beyond the boundaries and leading by example are expected and not requested.  
Key Deliverables and Responsibilities

Planning & Organizing:  
1.    Ensure that all Mövenpick Hotels & Residences standards are adhered.   
2.    He/she must check the daily casual staff's grooming standards and verify their Ajeer permits and iqamas on a daily basis without fail (if the Ajeer permits and iqamas are not available, the concerned casual staff must be sent back to the company immediately without fail).    
3.    Be innovative at all the time.   
4.    Keep ahead of industry trends (you should set the trends rather than follow)   
5.    Develop ideas on increasing guest satisfaction.   
6.    The role is to uphold the Movenpick service standard and manage daily in-house and ODC events.  
Operations:  
1.    Leads the daily and weekly meeting.  
2.    Train and develop the Banquet team in the departmental operating standards.  
3.    Maintains a presence during events including outside catering events.  
4.    Maintain a consistent focus on improving the overall flow of Banquet operations.   
5.    To lead and support employees in the achievement of financial, operational and service delivery targets via effective organizational policy and procedural development and appropriate employee training activities.  
6.    Foster a winning, solution-oriented work environment, motivating and engaging employees to continuously deliver the best possible service and to provide feedback and suggestions.  
7.    Source and audition entertainment and decorative options suitable for Banquets and Events.  
8.    Maintain awareness of industry trends and share with the team.  
9.    Review, analyse market and competition changes and implement proactive action plans to meet these changes in cooperation with Banquet manager and approved by Director of F&B.  
10.    Ensure organizers are communicated with and assisted in an efficient, warm and professional manner by all team members.  
11.    Actively review organizer and guest comments and feedback, communicate this with the team members and implement procedures to enhance guest satisfaction  
12.    To ensure a consistently high standard of grooming is followed and the team.   
13.    To have a complete understanding of and to adhere to Mövenpick Hotels & Residences policy relating to Fire, Hygiene, Health and Safety.  
14.    To drive the performance of the Banquet team members, including completion of performance appraisals, coaching counselling and performance management in conjunction with Human Resources.   
15.    Have full knowledge of all products and services provided by the property and in the local area.   
16.    Assume the responsibility of daily banquet operations.  
17.    Maintain appropriate staffing levels on the banquet floor.   
18.    Following up on opening and closing checklists on daily basis.   
19.    Ensure all appropriate equipment is on hand for each service period.  
20.    Ensure all the storages are well maintain and organize.   
21.    Ensures that the correct ordering and billing procedures are in place and that all cash handling is carried out correctly. This includes overseeing and checking the cashier and floats at the conclusion of the event and all banking done (specially banquet event order must be carefully monitored prier closing the bills)     
22.    All the banquet event orders (BEO) must be clearly studied and communicate with entire banquet team and concern departments.   
23.    Conducts daily briefings and training for all staff prior to commencement of shift, providing such information as service requirements, sequence and preparation for the day  
24.    Must be capable of handling security incidents, guest complaints or queries with confidence and in a professional manner.   
25.    Directly work with F&B director and all banquet employees to create a flow of new and ‘improved’ ideas.   
26.    Ensure awareness and deliver the optimum levels of service and guest satisfaction  
27.    Attaining and maintaining the sanitation (HACCP or similar) certificates as required by the regional governing body.   
28.    Ensure all hotel property and facilities are maintained an in an optimal working order.   
29.    Take full ownership and responsibility for any issues that may occur in the department.  
30.    Ensure rooms/events is set prior to the commencement of service.   
31.    Master all POS systems  
32.    To carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Administration:  
1.    Establish and maintain effective employee relationships.  
2.    Implement training plans to further develop self and subordinate outlet employees.  
3.    Lead by example through a passionate, hands on approach.  
4.    Maintaining all outlet records.  
5.    Maintain and submit the month-end banquet operations report, including casual and permanent attendance, AV rental details.  
6.    Evaluate an employee’s performance in staff appraisals, with a focus on adherence to procedures and departmental standards.

Entrepreneurship:     We fully understand the business and market context, identifying and seizing opportunities for continuous improvement and supporting change.

## Job Description

Reporting to the General Manager, the Director of Commercial is responsible for leading the overall commercial strategy of Sofitel Jabal Omar Makkah, driving sustainable revenue growth, market share, profitability and brand positioning across all business segments.

As a key member of the Executive Committee, this role provides strategic leadership across Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing, Digital & Communications, Distribution, Reservations and Business Development, ensuring all commercial disciplines operate under one integrated strategy.

Working closely with Operations, Finance and Regional Commercial teams, the Director of Commercial develops and executes revenue-generating initiatives that maximize performance across Rooms, Restaurants, Wellness, Meetings & Events and ancillary revenue streams, while strengthening the hotel's position as one of the leading luxury hospitality destinations in Makkah.

Acting as both a commercial strategist and brand ambassador, the Director ensures that every commercial initiative reflects the elegance of the Sofitel brand while respecting the cultural and religious significance of the destination.

* Develop and execute the hotel's overall commercial strategy aligned with business objectives, market conditions and brand standards.

* Identify new revenue opportunities across all business segments and distribution channels.
* Establish short, medium and long-term commercial priorities to maximise profitability and market share.
* Collaborate closely with Operations and Finance to align commercial initiatives with operational capabilities and financial objectives.

**Sales Leadership:**

* Lead the Sales function across all market segments including Corporate, Leisure, Wholesale, Government, Luxury Travel, Groups and MICE.
* Develop strategic sales plans to maximise business from domestic, regional and international markets.
* Strengthen relationships with key corporate accounts, travel partners, luxury consortia, government entities and tourism stakeholders.
* Drive proactive business development and account acquisition strategies.

## Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Facility Management Engineer to join our organization in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will oversee the planning, coordination, and execution of landscape and green infrastructure operations and maintenance activities across our properties. You will lead a team of maintenance professionals while ensuring optimal facility performance, safety compliance, and cost-effectiveness. This position requires a detail-oriented professional with strong analytical capabilities and expertise in landscape and irrigation systems management.

* Oversee daily landscape and green infrastructure operations, including irrigation systems, pumping stations, and mechanical equipment to ensure optimal performance and reliability
* Manage tree care and arboriculture maintenance programs, including pruning, health monitoring, pest management, and seasonal treatments to ensure tree vitality and safety
* Develop and implement preventive maintenance programs and schedules for landscape features, irrigation networks, and pumping stations to minimize downtime and extend equipment lifespan
* Manage facility budgets, analyze operational costs, and identify opportunities for cost optimization and water efficiency improvements across landscape operations
* Lead, supervise, and mentor a team of landscape maintenance technicians and contractors, ensuring adherence to safety standards and quality benchmarks
* Conduct regular landscape and irrigation system inspections and assessments to identify maintenance needs, safety hazards, and compliances issues
* Coordinate with vendors and specialized contractors for landscape maintenance, tree services, pumping station repairs, and capital improvement projects
* Ensure compliance with local Saudi regulations, environmental standards, and safety protocols for landscape and irrigation operations
* Utilize facility management software and systems to track maintenance activities, equipment performance, and work orders for landscape operations
* Develop and execute water management and sustainability strategies to reduce consumption and operational expenses
* Prepare detailed reports on landscape performance, maintenance activities, tree health assessments, and recommendations for senior management
* Respond to emergency situations and coordinate rapid resolution of critical landscape and irrigations issues
* Collaborate with other departments to support organizational goals and landscape-related initiatives

## Qualifications

10 to 15+ years of landscape O&M management or grounds operations experience, with at least 8 years in a senior or supervisory role.

Skills / Competencies:

* Comprehensive knowledge of irrigation systems, pumping stations, water distribution networks, and landscape mechanical equipment
* Expertise in arboriculture, tree care, plant health management, and horticultural maintenance practices
* Proficiency with facility management software and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS)
* Strong project management capabilities with experience overseeing landscape capital improvement projects
* Demonstrated expertise in budget management, cost analysis, and financial planning for landscape operations
* Proven leadership and team management experience with landscape maintenance technicians and contractors
* Advanced knowledge of safety protocols, environmental compliance standards, and Saudi Arabian landscape and irrigation regulations
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
* Strong organizational and time management abilities
* Knowledge of landscape design principles and water management systems
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Arabic
* Proficient in dashboard creation and presentations of O&M-related reporting.
* Familiarity in trouble-shooting site issues including root-cause analysis and investigations.
* Able to conduct snagging, site inspections and assist in projects’ transition to operation.

## Additional Information

Preferred Skills / Competencies :

* Strong leadership and team-building abilities, with the capacity to drive innovation and influence change.
* Experience in working within large-scale environmental or urban development projects is preferred.

Job Description The Product Specialist – PureWick is accountable for accelerating the adoption, utilization, and commercial growth of the PureWick portfolio across Saudi Arabia.

As the clinical and commercial champion for the brand, the role drives market development, stakeholder engagement, clinical practice transformation, and account expansion to establish Pure Wick as the standard of care for non-invasive urinary management.

Job location – Al Madinah, KSA

Main responsibilities will include:
Increase assigned portfolio share and achieve area annual budget in the assigned accounts.
Create new sales opportunities in all HCO with different sectors in the assigned territory through direct orders as well as tenders.
Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans to maximize market penetration and product utilization.
Lead account boarding, stakeholder mapping, and customer engagement strategies.
Assist in clarifying any timely disrupted issues that might affect the delivery process in the assigned area.
Monitor the inventory levels and ensure hospitals are aware of the availability of the goods through the sales team communication.
Manage relationship with Clinical and non-clinical stakeholders in strategic accounts.
Identify the list of all KOL's with respected opinion within the incontinence community.
Make sure that the appropriate level of promotion and product awareness is delivered to the right HCP in a complaint & ethical way.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Material Engineer** - **Electrical** to join our team!

  

The  Materials Engineer, Electrical will be responsible for managing and providing technical oversight of all mechanical, electrical, and plumbing construction materials, equipment, components, systems approvals, factory testing, and compliance activities across the project lifecycle. The role will ensure that MEP materials and specialized equipment proposed and installed by contractors comply fully with project technical specifications, design drawings, international MEP standards, local codes, and client requirements.

  

The MEP Materials Engineer will coordinate closely with Engineering, Quality, Construction Management, Procurement Engineering, Testing Laboratories, Independent Third-Party Inspection Agencies, Consultants, Contractors, and MEP Equipment Manufacturers, Suppliers, and Fabricators to ensure timely technical review, approval, inspection, factory testing, site handling, preservation, and full traceability of all MEP materials and assets.

Dedicated to overseeing all material-related workflows and compliance processes.

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Strategic Procurement Review & Tracking: Approved Materials List (AML), Project Approved Materials List (PAML), and Long-Lead Items (LLI) tracking for major MEP equipment and packages (e.g., chillers, transformers, switchgear, generators, pumps, air handling units, piping systems).
* Materials Governance (MQG) Submittals & Planning: Materials Management Plans (MMPs), Quality Plans, Inspection Assignment Packages (IAP), Pre-Inspection Meetings (PIM), Supplier/Manufacturer Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), Third-Party Inspector (TPI) CVs, and Contractor’s MEP Materials Staff CV reviews.
* Vendors, Third-Party Testing & Technical Approvals: Prequalification Submittals (PQDs), Material Technical Submittals (MATs), Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) Witnessing Plans, and FAT Procedures (FATPs) for critical electrical and mechanical apparatus.
* Physical Evaluations & Field Verification: Material Samples (SMPs), Equipment Mockups, Bench Testing, Cable/Piping Sample Testing, and Site Mockup Assessments.
* Inspections, Testing & Certification: Material Inspection Requests (MIRs), Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Material Receiving Inspections, and Independent Laboratory / Third-Party Agency Assessments for specialized MEP components.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of relevant experience in construction materials engineering, materials testing, quality control, or project quality management.
* Proven experience in major airport, infrastructure, civil, roads, utilities, or large-scale construction projects.
* Strong knowledge of construction materials, testing methodologies, specifications, and material approval processes.
* Experience working with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and accredited testing laboratories.
* Good understanding of material quality requirements and construction specifications.
* Professional Engineering certification is preferred.
* ACI, NICET, ASQ, or equivalent materials/testing certification is an advantage.
* Relevant laboratory or materials testing certifications are preferred.
* ISO 9001 / Quality Management certification is an advantage.
* Relevant pavement, concrete, asphalt, or geotechnical materials certifications are advantageous.
* Construction Materials Engineering
* Material Submittal & Approval
* Material Testing & Inspection
* Material Compliance & Verification
* Material Traceability
* Material Testing Plans
* Material Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs)
* Concrete & Cementitious Materials
* Aggregates & Soils
* Asphalt & Pavement Materials
* Reinforcement & Structural Steel
* Pipes & Utility Materials
* Geotextiles & Geosynthetics
* Geotechnical Materials
* Laboratory Testing & Test Results Review
* Mix Design Review
* Concrete Testing
* Asphalt Testing
* Soil & Compaction Testing
* CBR & Field Density Testing
* NCR & Corrective Action Management
* Material Quality Auditing
* Supplier & Manufacturer Evaluation
* Factory / Source Inspection
* Material Storage & Preservation
* Technical Submittal Review
* ASTM / AASHTO / BS / EN / ISO Standards
* Material Documentation & Handover Dossiers
* MS Excel & Technical Reporting

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* MEP & Aviation/Infrastructure Standards: Deep technical working knowledge to interpret and enforce international standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, NFPA, ASHRAE, ASME, ASTM, CIBSE, SMACNA) as well as aviation-specific or regional authority specifications for airside and landside MEP infrastructure (e.g., Airfield Ground Lighting systems, specialized HVAC for critical facilities, power distribution, substations, and life safety systems).
* Design Development & Specification Review: Proven ability to critically review MEP technical specifications, single-line diagrams (SLDs), piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), design drawings, and technical submittals during early design and pre-construction stages to eliminate engineering gaps.
* Regulatory Compliance & AHJ Coordination: Extensive experience liaising with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), civil defense, municipal power and water utilities, and civil aviation regulators to secure material/equipment approvals and ensure strict adherence to local electrical, mechanical, plumbing, and fire-life-safety codes.
* Quality Management & Technical Process Control: Expertise in implementing quality assurance protocols, manufacturing quality control oversight, vendor quality audits, process control during equipment assembly, and site handling/preservation procedures to maintain defect-free supply chains.
* Specialized MEP Materials & Equipment Testing: Demonstrated ability to define test protocols, review factory test reports, and oversee site/laboratory testing for electrical insulation, high/medium voltage equipment, hydrostatic pipe testing, duct leakage testing, acoustic/vibration performance, thermal insulation, and anti-corrosion protection.
* Procurement Engineering & Vendor Assessment: Hands-on capability to conduct technical audits of MEP equipment manufacturers and fabricators, review Technical Data Sheets (TDS), Mill Test Report/Certificates (MTR/MTC), Type Test Certificates, and execute technical compliance evaluations during the procurement stage.

## Description:

# **Vice President – Reinsurance Actuary**

  

**Location: Saudi Arabia – Riyadh or Khobar**

  

**About the role**

Guy Carpenter is seeking a high-performing, technically adept Senior Actuary to join our Actuarial Analytics team in **Saudi Arabia**, based in **Riyadh or Khobar**. The role will support clients across the IMEA region.  

This commercially relevant position combines rigorous actuarial analysis with practical business insight. You will work closely with reinsurance brokers and senior stakeholders to deliver analytics that inform reinsurance strategy, client decisions and regional growth.

**  
Key responsibilities**

* Partner with reinsurance brokers to support portfolio strategy, client engagement and business-growth initiatives.
* Perform technical assessments of general insurance portfolios, including pricing adequacy, volatility analysis, retention optimisation and reinsurance structuring.
* Develop, validate and interpret analytical outputs using sound actuarial judgement and first-principles thinking.
* Build and review loss projections, stress scenarios and portfolio performance metrics to support reinsurance decisions.
* Translate technical analysis into commercially relevant insight and clear, market-facing narratives.
* Support the structuring and optimisation of proportional and non-proportional reinsurance solutions, including quota share, excess of loss and hybrid arrangements.
* Collaborate with brokers and regional stakeholders on client presentations, strategic discussions and renewal negotiations.
* Use internal tools, including MetaRisk and portfolio models, as well as bespoke analytical frameworks, to develop practical reinsurance solutions.
* Challenge assumptions, validate methodologies and ensure outputs are technically robust, commercially relevant and aligned with governance standards.
* Take ownership of deliverables within established peer-review and oversight frameworks.
* Contribute to analytics-framework development, process improvement and knowledge-sharing across regional teams.
* Build strong working relationships with brokers, clients, reinsurers and internal stakeholders across IMEA.

**  
Why this role**

* Based in Saudi Arabia, with exposure to multi-market IMEA portfolios.
* Opportunity to support high-impact reinsurance and portfolio decisions.
* Strong development opportunity across technical, commercial and client-facing dimensions.
* A role with meaningful regional visibility and stakeholder engagement.

**  
What you need to have**

* Qualified or near-qualified actuary (FIAI, FIA, FCAS or equivalent).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Data Science or another quantitative discipline.
* Eight or more years of relevant actuarial, insurance or reinsurance analytics experience.
* Strong technical understanding of actuarial principles, portfolio analytics and reinsurance structures.
* Ability to independently assess analytical reasonableness, validate outputs and identify inconsistencies or flawed assumptions.
* Strong commercial awareness and the ability to connect technical findings to practical market outcomes.
* Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset and accountability for quality.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver to tight timelines.
* Collaborative working style with strong stakeholder-management skills.

**  
What makes you stand out**

* Experience with a reinsurance broker, reinsurer or insurer.
* Exposure to client-facing discussions, renewal support or reinsurance-placement strategy.
* Experience across multiple markets and product lines in a regional setting.
* Familiarity with R, Python, SQL, Alteryx, Power BI or similar analytical and visualisation tools.
* Ability to balance technical depth with commercial practicality and clear communication.

**  
Why join Guy Carpenter**

* Professional development opportunities, engaging work and supportive leadership.
* A vibrant, inclusive culture that fosters collaboration and innovation.
* A broad range of career opportunities and benefits designed to support wellbeing.

  
Join our team in Saudi Arabia and help create impactful solutions for clients and communities across the IMEA region.

Leading from the floor, you will oversee the day-to-day operation of one of our signature venues, inspiring a high-performing team while ensuring exceptional service, operational excellence, and commercial performance. Working closely with F&B leadership and key hotel departments, you will shape memorable dining experiences, drive profitability, and continuously evolve the outlet to remain fresh, relevant, and unmistakably SLS.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the outlet team in delivering consistently elevated, engaging, and dynamic guest experiences in line with SLS brand standards and service philosophy.
* Act as the face of the outlet, maintaining a strong presence during service and building meaningful relationships with guests, regular patrons, and VIPs.
* Handle guest feedback and concerns effectively, turning service challenges into opportunities to exceed expectations.
* Oversee all daily restaurant operations, ensuring seamless coordination across the floor, bar, and supporting areas.
* Maintain exceptional standards of outlet ambiance, service delivery, product presentation, cleanliness, hygiene, and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Housekeeping, and other hotel departments to maintain the venue to luxury lifestyle standards.
* Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of supervisors, waitstaff, hosts, bartenders, and other outlet colleagues.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management, employee engagement, and development of the outlet team.
* Ensure team members are fully trained in service standards, menu and product knowledge, guest interaction, and compliance requirements.
* Plan staffing levels, schedules, and team allocation in line with business demand, operational requirements, and budget targets.
* Drive revenue performance through effective upselling, menu engineering, seat utilization, and other commercial opportunities.
* Manage operational costs through effective inventory control, ordering, labor scheduling, and wastage management.
* Monitor sales, labor costs, cost of goods, and other key performance indicators, ensuring accurate reporting and alignment with departmental budgets.
* Support annual business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and ongoing performance reviews.
* Partner with Marketing to activate promotional events, seasonal concepts, and brand campaigns that increase outlet awareness and guest traffic.
* Build relationships with hotel concierges, external partners, and local tastemakers to strengthen the outlet’s visibility and guest flow.
* Identify and support in-outlet events, private dining experiences, themed activations, sponsorships, product placements, and other revenue-generating opportunities.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activity to support the continued evolution and positioning of the venue.
* Drive creative initiatives that elevate the dining experience, strengthen profitability, and connect with the SLS guest lifestyle.
* Stay current with emerging trends across dining, mixology, and experiential hospitality to maintain the outlet’s competitive edge.
* Ensure full compliance with health, safety, hygiene, company policies, and applicable local regulations.

## Qualifications

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3 years of senior leadership experience within luxury restaurant operations.
* Strong experience managing large teams within high-volume, high-profile restaurant or hospitality environments.
* Proven ability to lead and develop dynamic teams while maintaining exceptional brand standards and guest satisfaction.
* Strong understanding of food and beverage operations, including menu development, beverage programs, guest flow, and restaurant performance.
* Demonstrated commercial awareness with experience in revenue generation, cost control, budgeting, and operational performance.
* Experience with POS, reservation, and workforce management systems.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Fluent in English; knowledge of Arabic is an advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant operational platforms.

job_title: Receiving Clerk - Fairmont The Red Sea (Saudi National)
description:

Raffles & Fairmont the Red Sea, positioned in the kingdom's groundbreaking Red Sea Project, will provide visitors access to two nature-focused resorts. With 361 rooms, 11 distinct dining concepts, including overwater restaurant with views of the Red Sea and the mangroves, and a Spa.

## Job Description

The Receiving clerk is responsible for accepting delivery of goods on behalf of the hotel. This involves ensuring that all shipments are verified against purchase order specifications and standards. To be performing any additional duties assigned by the Cost Controller.

Key Responsibilities

* Receive and inspect all incoming goods against purchase orders and delivery notes.

* Coordinate with Purchasing, Stores, and other departments regarding deliveries.
* Ensure all received goods are transferred to the appropriate storage areas promptly.
* Maintain cleanliness, organization, and hygiene in the receiving area.
* Follow hotel policies, health and safety regulations, and food safety standards.
* Maintain accurate receiving records and supporting documents for audit purposes.

## Qualifications

* Previous experience in receiving, stores, or inventory operations is an advantage.
* Basic computer skills and knowledge of inventory systems.
* Good attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to check quantities, product quality, and documentation accurately.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Honest, reliable, and able to work under pressure.

## Additional Information

* Strong understanding of ultra-luxury wellness concepts and brand alignment.
* Experience in pre-opening operations, project coordination, and setup of wellness facilities is highly preferred.

job_title: Assistant Director of Finance – Saudi National
description:
## Company Description

Located adjacent to the residential tower, expert service and world-class luxury combine in the Raffles Hotel Jeddah, which is ready to welcome you and your guests at any moment. corporate, and group business within assigned territories and market segments, while   
building strategic relationships that position Faena The Red Sea as one of the region’s most   
sought-after ultra-luxury destinations.

Senior Sales Executive role.

resorts preferred.

international source markets.   
• Pre-opening experience is highly desirable.   
• Strong understanding of sales strategy, account management, contracting, and   
revenue fundamentals.

• Proficient in hotel systems including Opera, Delphi, Salesforce, Lanyon / Cvent, and   
Microsoft Office Suite.

Description
At the International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

Through its Transaction Advisory – PPP practice, IFC provides transaction advisory to client governments on Public Private Partnerships (PPPs). IFC also provides Corporate Finance Services (CFS) to private clients. IFC’s work on PPPs involves advice to governments (national and sub-national) in designing and bringing to market commercially robust PPP projects that provide high quality, affordable and efficient infrastructure and social services to the public. Drawing on more than 25 years of experience in implementing projects in over 100 countries, the global team has over 120 staff, with technical, financial, contractual and procurement expertise. IFC is also able to draw on the World Bank’s expertise in institutional reforms, sector structuring, legal and regulatory frameworks, tariff structures and regulation, and international best practice to strengthen and complement IFC’s transaction-oriented approach. IFC’s CFS unit provides corporate advisory services to private sector clients, focusing on Mergers and Acquisition (M&A) advisory solutions and providing structuring advice. Through M&A advisory, CFS provides buy side and sell side services, helping clients create opportunities and enter new markets or identify and attract new partners and investors. CFS focuses on cross-border transactions, mobilizes third party capital and brings clients into new markets.

IFC is now seeking to recruit a Manager for Corporate Transaction Advisory - PPP covering the Middle East, Turkiye, Central Asia, Afghanistan and Pakistan (collectively, the CMA region), reporting to regional Division Directors, based in Riyadh or Dubai. The Manager must have proven market and industry experience to grow IFC’s PPP business across the CMA region, leading the regional PPP team, overseeing the implementation of PPP strategy, and developing key client and government relationships, as well as supporting the regional development of IFC’s Corporate Finance Services business. The Manager will coordinate as needed with global transaction advisory teams in terms of global expertise, quality assurance, and business development support in accordance with the agreed Accountability and Decision-Making framework, while collaborating with other regional teams on knowledge sharing. The Manager will be an integral part of the MCA’s management team.

Duties and Accountabilities
Lead and manage a specialized transaction team based across the regions and ensure the team is high-performing, highly-motivated, innovative, has clear deliverables and is committed to the success of our clients. The Transaction Advisory - PPP Manager will be accountable for achieving PPP Private Capital Mobilization (PCM) targets and other KPIs. Specifically, the Manager will:

• Develop and implement MCA’s strategy for advisory business, in partnership with Division Directors, Country Managers, and where applicable, the World Bank, focusing on strategic country priorities, FCS, high impact projects and scaling PCM;
• Lead the team to originate, execute, and manage a pipeline of mandates and programs in PPPs across the region in the infrastructure and public services sectors balancing strategic priorities, geographic distribution and country mix.
• Oversee the preparation of key transaction reports and project documents, including due diligence and transaction structuring reports, prequalification and bidding terms of reference, and transaction contracts and agreements.
• Foster strong relationships with World Bank Group counterparts to identify collaboration opportunities and to enhance business delivery at the country level;
• Be part of and actively contribute to MCA Management Team;
• Manage the financial and operational risks in the regional PPP portfolio;
• Develop IFC’s “brand” in the PPP sector, building on IFC’s regional brand and overall communications strategy. In coordination with IFC advisory teams, country offices and the WBG’s Infrastructure Finance department, as well as relevant WB Global Practice Groups, build relationships with key regional stakeholders across the PPP sector, including government counterparts, sponsors, investors, regulators, donors and NGOs;
