About the Role

You will own one of Client's core treasury and capital markets products, from discovery and product definition through to production. The product connects banks' treasury systems with market infrastructure, so that transactions settle through a shared ledger.

This role sits between bank treasury desks and our engineering team. You bring the treasury view: how a transaction is priced, booked, settled and managed through its life. You turn that into product decisions, and you challenge our assumptions wherever they diverge from treasury practice.

Responsibilities

Product ownership

Own the product roadmap, requirements and backlog, in line with company priorities set by the CEO and Head of Product.

Write product requirements and user stories for each transaction flow, covering the full life cycle from execution to maturity, including margining, early termination and default handling.

Define acceptance criteria with engineering and sign off on releases.

Treasury and market expertise

Validate product designs against real treasury, operations and settlement practice in Saudi banks.

Translate Shariah-compliant structures and their documentation into product rules.

Keep the team current on SAMA and CMA developments that affect treasury products and settlement.

Integration and technical direction

Lead the integration design between Client and treasury systems, the securities depository, the clearing house and payment rails.

Define API requirements, event flows and data mappings with engineering, and review API documentation before it goes to partners.

Coordinate testing and reconciliation with partner banks and market infrastructure.

Partners and stakeholders

Act as the day-to-day product contact for banks, market infrastructure and technology vendors in Riyadh.

Run working sessions, prepare product materials and track actions to closure.

Report progress, risks and decisions to the CEO and Head of Product.

Required Qualifications

At least five years in bank treasury, money markets or treasury operations, with direct exposure to fixed income and money market instruments, including sukuk. Experience in a Saudi bank is required.

Working knowledge of Islamic finance structures used in treasury.

At least three years in product management, product ownership or a business analyst role on financial systems, with a track record of shipping products used by institutions.

Clear understanding of the trade life cycle: execution, booking, confirmation, settlement and post-trade.

Hands-on software development experience at API level: building or integrating APIs, reading and writing API specifications, and working directly in code with engineers.

Professional fluency in Arabic and English, written and spoken.

Based in Riyadh and able to work from the Client office and meet partners on site.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with treasury and trading platforms, ideally on implementation or integration projects.

Experience with integration patterns used in treasury and market infrastructure, such as financial messaging standards and event-driven integrations.

Familiarity with market infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, including the securities depository, central clearing and RTGS payments.

Understanding of blockchain, tokenisation or distributed ledger concepts.

Exposure to SAMA and CMA requirements for treasury products and capital markets.

Relevant certifications, such as the ACI Dealing Certificate, CFA or a recognised Islamic finance qualification.

Job Description

ABOUT CAMBLY

Cambly is a global language learning platform that connects learners with tutors for real conversation practice, supported by AI-powered learning tools. We help students around the world build confidence and fluency in English.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a CRM Program Manager to lead Cambly's customer relationship management strategy and execution — delivering the right message to the right customer at the right time, via the right channel. This is a global role covering Cambly's markets across Latin America, Europe/Middle East, and Asia. You will run one CRM strategy with market-specific channel and messaging execution. You'll own CRM across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, including expansion into local chat platforms such as WhatsApp, WeChat, and KakaoTalk.

This role combines strategic program management, cross-functional leadership, and CRM platform expertise to drive acquisition, engagement, and retention based on deep analysis of user behavior. You'll own the CRM roadmap, platform strategy, audience strategy, deliverability health, major CRM initiatives (including AI integrations), and performance measurement across regions. You'll partner with creative, growth, product, data, engineering, and regional teams, and work closely with operational specialists who execute day-to-day campaign setup.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

CRM STRATEGY & PROGRAM LEADERSHIP

- Own the end-to-end CRM strategy across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, aligned to acquisition, engagement, and retention KPIs.

- Build and maintain the CRM roadmap, balancing evergreen lifecycle programs, promotional campaigns, and strategic initiatives.

- Own the messaging-app channel strategy by market: WhatsApp (e.g., Brazil, Turkey, Arabic-speaking markets), WeChat (China), KakaoTalk (Korea), and other local platforms as markets warrant. Lead each from evaluation and pilot through rollout.

- Set the global CRM framework and define what can be localized by market (channel mix, timing, offers, tone) and what stays standard.

- Serve as the single point of accountability for CRM outcomes and leadership reporting.

CRM PLATFORM & VENDOR MANAGEMENT

- Evaluate and manage messaging providers and official business account setups per platform (e.g., WhatsApp Business API providers, WeChat Official Accounts, KakaoTalk business channels), including template approvals and platform policy compliance.

- Own platform relationships (e.g., Iterable), including contracts, roadmap alignment, feature adoption, and renewals.

- Drive strategic CRM innovation projects, such as AI/LLM integrations with the CRM stack, from discovery through rollout and measurement.

- Identify gaps across the CRM stack and champion investments that reduce cost, improve efficiency, or unlock new capabilities.

AUDIENCES & LIFECYCLE JOURNEYS

- Partner with PMs and engineers to co-design lifecycle programs, in-product messaging surfaces, event instrumentation, and journey delivery mechanics.

- Define audience segmentation and lead qualification frameworks — who we reach, via which channel, and at which lifecycle stage.

- Own audiences and lists across markets: segmentation, hygiene, suppression, and ongoing maintenance.

- Develop customer journey and audience insights that improve profitability, delivery, and engagement.

- Design and oversee automated journeys, personalization, and experimentation standards (subject lines, send times, cohorts, journey structures), including promotional updates.

ANALYTICS, MEASUREMENT & OPTIMIZATION

- Own CRM KPIs, dashboards, and reporting across all channels.

- Report CRM performance by market and channel, with cross-market comparisons in the WBR.

- Own email deliverability health (bounces, spam complaints, warming, IP/domain reputation), partnering with engineering and ESPs.

- Design and lead CRM experiments and turn learnings into durable program improvements.

- Tie CRM performance to business outcomes (LTV, retention, activation, payback) with actionable recommendations.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PROGRAM MANAGEMENT

- Lead planning, execution, and retros for major campaigns (promotions, product launches, regional initiatives).

- Partner with product and data teams to make every initiative measurable end-to-end — event tracking, data pipelines, attribution, and metric integrity.

- Coordinate workstreams across marketing, product, engineering, data, and regional stakeholders.

- Document CRM processes, playbooks, and standards so execution is repeatable.

- Secure creative resourcing before committing to timelines; write clear creative briefs, and step in on messaging and copy when needed.

AI, AUTOMATION & INNOVATION

- Automate reporting, monitoring, and manual workflows using AI, scripts, and no-code/low-code tools.

- Use AI to deliver high-quality, culturally accurate localization and scale content without sacrificing brand voice.

- Lead AI adoption within CRM — personalization, copy generation, segmentation, and journey optimization — and share learnings across marketing.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, ideally at a consumer subscription, mobile, or edtech company.

- Hands-on expertise with a modern CRM/ESP platform (e.g., Iterable, Braze, Customer.io http://Customer.io), including journey building and segmentation.

- Proven track record owning CRM strategy and roadmap with measurable impact on acquisition, engagement, and retention.

- Strong analytical skills — comfortable with dashboards, experimentation, and SQL or similar tools.

- Working knowledge of email deliverability best practices.

- Experience running multi-market or international CRM programs; familiarity with messaging apps like WhatsApp, WeChat, or KakaoTalk is a plus.

- Excellent cross-functional program management and stakeholder communication skills.

- Strong writing skills and the ability to brief creative teams or draft copy directly.

- Curiosity and hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve marketing workflows.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- CRM is a clearly defined, strategically led function with a published roadmap and measurable impact.

- Audiences are well segmented and maintained; deliverability is strong and proactively managed.

- CRM is meaningfully expanded onto local chat platforms, driving incremental engagement and revenue.

- Journey and audience insights drive higher-profitability segments and better engagement — not just more sends.

- CRM results are clearly and consistently represented in the Weekly Business Review.

- Product, data, and engineering see CRM as a true technical partner — every initiative is instrumented from day one.

- The CRM stack is used to its full potential, and major initiatives are delivered end-to-end.

- Manual workflows are increasingly automated, and AI powers high-quality localization and content at scale.

## **Position Overview:**

The **Treasury & Banking Accountant** keeps bank accounts accurate every day and makes sure every Letter of Credit (LC) and cheque is followed until the money reaches our account. You will upload  
and reconcile all bank statements in Zoho Books daily, manage the LC and cheque cycle with our banks, and be the go-to person for any banking transaction across the company.

## **What You will do (Responsibilities) :**

**Bank Statements & Daily Reconciliation**

* Upload all bank statements to Zoho Books every day for every company bank account.
* Reconcile all bank accounts daily and clear unmatched items within 48 hours.
* Investigate unidentified receipts, bank charges, and differences, posting or requesting the correct  
    entries.
* Prepare the daily cash position by bank for the Finance team.

**Letters of Credit (LCs)**

* Follow up on all new LCs from receipt until proceeds are deposited in our account.
* Check LC terms and ensure required documents (invoice, delivery note, certificate of origin, etc.)  
    match before submission.
* Submit documents to the banks, follow up on bank review, and resolve any discrepancies before the  
    LC expires.
* Coordinate with Sales, Operations, and AR on LC status and expected collection dates.

**Cheque Management**

* Deposit customer cheques at the banks and track them until cleared.
* Handle returned cheques: record the reversal, inform AR and Sales, and follow up.
* Maintain a cheque register with status for every cheque received and deposited.

**Tracking & Banking Support**

* Keep one up-to-date tracker of all open LCs, cheques, and pending bank transactions, with status  
    and expected dates.
* Support all teams and the company with banking requests: transfers, bank letters, guarantees,  
    account queries, and bank portal access.
* Act as day-to-day contact with bank relationship managers.
* Support month-end close and audit requests with bank reconciliations and confirmations.

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in treasury, banking operations, or bank reconciliation.
* Hands-on experience reconciling bank accounts daily.
* Practical experience handling Letters of Credit (documents, bank submission, discrepancies).
* Experience depositing and tracking cheques, including returned cheques.
* Experience working with an ERP or accounting system.
* Fluent Arabic and good English.

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Our Sustainability Transition Services team across the Middle East, Caspian & Africa (MCA) helps organisations measure, manage, and improve their environmental and social performance, covering carbon and climate, ESG reporting and assurance, green buildings, supply chain, and industrial sustainability.

ROLE PURPOSE

As a Sustainability Professional within Bureau Veritas MCA, you will support client projects and internal initiatives that enable organisations to measure, manage, and improve their environmental and social performance. You will contribute to the delivery of sustainability services while developing your technical expertise and advisory capabilities under the guidance of experienced professionals and Bureau Veritas Global Sustainability Programme tutors.

ROLE CONTEXT & RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Sustainability Associate (Certification) within Bureau Veritas MCA's CER product line, you will be embedded in your local area team and support the delivery of sustainability report assurance, GHG verification, CBAM advisory, ESG reporting and related certification services for clients in your area. You will report to the Area CER Product Line Manager and receive structured mentorship and training from the MCA regional sustainability team as part of BV's Global Sustainability Programme.

• Support delivery of sustainability report assurance engagements (ISAE 3000 / ISAE 3410) for listed and private companies in the area

• Assist in GHG verification and carbon footprint assessments (ISO 14064, GHG Protocol) for industrial, energy and corporate clients

• Contribute to ESG reporting advisory and IFRS S1/S2 readiness gap assessments for area clients

• Support CBAM pre-verification advisory for EU-bound exporters in the area — particularly relevant in Morocco and South Africa (phosphates, steel, cement, aluminium)

• Collect, organise and review sustainability data from clients as part of assurance and verification engagements

• Draft sections of assurance reports, verification statements and client deliverables under the supervision of a senior reviewer

• Prepare proposals, capability presentations and client-facing materials for CER sustainability services in the area

• Contribute to the ESG Assurance Technical Tribe and regional knowledge-sharing initiatives

PROGRAMME RESPONSIBILITIES (ALL ACADEMY HIRES)

• Project Delivery — Enable the simplification of sustainability complexity across carbon accounting, climate change adaptation, product circularity, renewable energy, supply chain resilience, and ESG reporting — giving clients the confidence to make more sustainable choices.

• Support project delivery through research, data analysis, and client material preparation, leveraging Bureau Veritas proprietary tools, methodologies, and AI-driven solutions.

• Collaborate across teams to engage with clients, assess risks, ensure compliance, and solve critical sustainability challenges that help organisations transform and operationalise their transition journey.

• Technical Learning & Application — Understand sustainability standards and frameworks (ISO 14064, GHG Protocol, SBTi, LCA, IFRS S1/S2) as well as regulations (EU CBAM, ETS) applicable to the role and area.

• Apply technical knowledge to real projects under supervision, demonstrating attention to detail and analytical rigour.

• Continuous Learning — Actively participate in Bureau Veritas's Global Sustainability Programme throughout the programme duration.

EDUCATION

Master's or Bachelor's degree (university, engineering school, business school, or equivalent) in one of the following or related areas:

• Preferred — STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics)*

• Environmental Science or Sustainability Management

• Chemical, Civil, Industrial or Environmental Engineering

• Energy Systems, Climate Science or Renewable Energy

• Business, Economics or Data Analytics with a strong sustainability focus

EXPERIENCE

• Recent graduate OR up to 2 years of professional experience — this is an entry-level programme role

• Previous experience in ESG or sustainability is appreciated but not required (e.g. internship, dissertation or academic project in sustainability)

• Desirable familiarity with one or more of the following: carbon footprinting, LCA, energy audits, ESG reporting, or supply chain sustainability

• Knowledge of or exposure to the local regulatory sustainability landscape in the area (e.g. Morocco CSRD readiness, South Africa JSE ESG, QSE ISSB, ADX/Tadawul disclosure) is an advantage

CORE SKILLS

• Analytical and problem-solving skills — structured thinking and data-driven decision making

• Effective communication, collaboration and stakeholder engagement abilities

• English B2+ — Upper Intermediate level minimum (additional languages are a plus)

• Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint) and willingness to learn BV digital tools

• Strong writing skills for report preparation and client communication

• Arabic and English required for this position.

CORE COMPETENCIES

• Passion for sustainability and climate transition — genuine desire to drive transformational change

• Curious, proactive learner with attention to detail and analytical rigour

• Dynamic approach to work with sensitivity to sustainable development issues

• Strong interpersonal skills and team collaboration abilities

• Adaptability to work on innovative topics with diverse, international stakeholders

• Professional mindset with a quality focus and project management aptitude

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Passion for Sustainability & Climate Transition — commitment to building a sustainability career, not just seeking a job; motivated by purpose and creating lasting environmental impact

• Analytical & Problem-Solving — structured thinking and data-driven decision making; ability to tackle complex sustainability challenges

• Communication — clear written and verbal communication across cultures; ability to translate and simplify technical concepts for diverse stakeholders

• Learning Agility & Curiosity — rapid adaptation to evolving sustainability frameworks; proactive learning in a constantly changing market

WHY JOIN BUREAU VERITAS

• Global Network & Exposure — Work within a truly international organization serving clients across industries and geographies. Collaborate with sustainability experts and teams around the world.

• Depth & Breadth of Services — Our services span carbon and climate, ESG, supply chains, human rights, biodiversity, circularity and more — offering exposure to the full sustainability landscape.

• Immediate Real-World Impact — From day one, you contribute to real client projects shaping sustainable practices across industries.

• Balanced Technical & Advisory Pathways — Develop both deep technical expertise and advisory capabilities, opening the door to multiple sustainability career paths.

• Trust & Purpose — Through our role in verification, assurance and certification, we help build trust in sustainability. Our mission — Shaping a World of Trust — connects with purpose-driven professionals who want to contribute to a more sustainable future.

WHAT WE OFFER

• Enrolment in Bureau Veritas's Global Sustainability Programme — structured mentorship, training and development from day one

• Exposure to real client mandates across carbon accounting, ESG assurance, green buildings, supply chain and more — from your first week

• Competitive early-career salary benchmarked to local market

• Access to Bureau Veritas's global sustainability methodologies, tools and AI-driven solutions

• Clear career development pathway: Consultant → Senior Consultant → Expert within 2–3 years

• Part of a growing regional sustainability team spanning 35+ countries across MCA

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **BIM Coordinator – MEP** to join our team! The BIM Coordinator – MEP Specialist will be responsible for reviewing and overseeing all Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Firefighting (MEP/FF) components of the models delivered by external design consultants and contractors. Operating in strict alignment with client requirements and the PMC BIM Management Plan, this role ensures seamless cross-discipline collaboration across all asset packages—specifically managing the intricate technical interfaces where MEP systems connect with architectural, structural, and civil infrastructure layouts—to uphold the high-quality technical standards, delivery timelines, and project specifications required across the masterplan.

  

**What You'll Be Doing:  
**

* **MEP Technical Review & Quality Assurance (QA/QC)**  
    **MEP Model Deliverable Review:** Audit incoming MEP BIM models submitted by external consultants and contractors to verify compliance with the client Exchange Information Requirements (EIR) and the project **BIM Execution Plan (BEP)**.
* **Information & Asset Data Validation:** Review and validate MEP asset metadata, equipment parameter completeness, and **Level of Information Need (LOIN)** to guarantee data integrity for future Asset Management handovers (AIM).
* **Compliance Reporting:** Track and document the design/modeling progress of all appointed MEP supply chain parties, escalating non-compliance issues or data gaps directly to the PMC BIM Manager.  
    • Ensure that the MEP models align with luxury design standards, integrating high-end materials, finishes, and bespoke elements.  
    • Collaborate with other BIM specialists (architectural and structural/civil) to ensure a fully coordinated building model that addresses luxury project specifications.
* **Cross-Asset Coordination & Interface Management:** Facilitate coordination between architecture, structure, MEP, civil, and interior design teams, ensuring that all building elements are harmonized.
* **Lead Coordination Meetings:** Chair and lead multi-party BIM coordination workshops, driving accountability among MEP design consultants and contractors to resolve spatial and asset interfaces.  
    • Attend regular coordination meetings with consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to review design progress and resolve any model conflicts.  
    • Ensure that the building model is aligned with the aesthetic goals of the client and complies with luxury design expectations.  
    **Clash Detection & Resolution:**  
    • Conduct clash detection using Navisworks or similar software, identifying and resolving conflicts between various building systems.  
    • Proactively address design issues and provide BIM-based solutions to avoid construction delays and maintain high-quality outcomes.  
    **Quality Control & Compliance:**  
    • Implement BIM quality control procedures to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of the building models.  
    • Ensure that the design meets high-end luxury standards while adhering to the PMC’s quality management protocols.  
    • Monitor and enforce compliance with BIM execution plans and industry standards (e.g., ISO 19650).  
    **Risk Management & Problem Solving:**  
    • Identify potential design risks or constructability issues early in the project lifecycle, particularly in relation to luxury-specific design features.  
    • Work closely with the project management team to mitigate risks through model adjustments and informed decision-making.  
    **Training & Development**:  
    • Provide training and technical support to project teams, ensuring that all stakeholders understand and utilize BIM processes effectively.  
    • Stay updated with the latest BIM technologies, tools, and workflows, incorporating new innovations relevant to luxury building projects.
* **BIM Software & Technical Tool Ecosystem**The candidate must possess strong proficiency and direct experience reviewing, navigating, and auditing models within the following toolsets:
* **MEP & Buildings Modeling and Coordination:** Autodesk Revit (Advanced MEP modeling, systems allocation, and lookup tables), Navisworks Manage for model coordination and clash coordination and other BIM-related software.
* **Infrastructure Utilities:** Autodesk Civil 3D is mandatory, Bentley OpenRoads (for reviewing wet/dry infrastructure interfaces)
* **Review & Clash Detection:** Autodesk Navisworks Manage (Advanced use of Clash Detective, Search Sets, and Appearance Profiler) and/or Solibri Model Checker
* **Collaboration & Issue Tracking:** ACC/Forma Model Coordination Revizto, BIMtrack or any similar collaboration tool

  
**What required skills you'll bring:  
**  
Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical engineering or related field.  
Minimum 12-15 years of experience in BIM management, with at least 10 years working on high-end luxury building projects in the construction industry. including a minimum of **2 years working within a PMC, Client, or Lead Consultant role on mega-projects / master-planned developments** with a heavy emphasis on complex MEP coordination.  
Highly organized with commanding communication skills. Ability to lead technical alignment workshops and confidently enforce compliance with international Tier-1 consultants and contractors. **Framework Standards:** Strong practical knowledge of the **ISO 19650** framework and information management delivery cycles.  
  
**What desired skills you'll bring:**

  
Certification in BIM management or Autodesk Revit (e.g., Autodesk Certified Professional).  
Experience in PMC environments, working on large-scale luxury residential or hospitality projects.  
Knowledge of sustainable building practices and integration of green technologies, tools and workflows, incorporating new innovations relevant to luxury building projects.

**Job Description**

**Contract:** Permanent

**The role**

The Senior Learning & Advisory Specialist will contribute to the delivery and continued development of knowledge management, business advisory and government advisory work across the MENA region. This role will involve delivering consulting and advisory services and facilitating both internal and external knowledge-sharing sessions.

  

The role covers the entire Middle East and North Africa region. You will work closely with Subject Matter Experts across Fragomen to obtain, provide and validate information, particularly in relation to the practical implementation of immigration, labour and other relevant regulations. You will also collaborate with other internal teams, external stakeholders and, where appropriate, government authorities to ensure that the information and advice provided by the firm is accurate, practical and timely.

  

In addition to knowledge management responsibilities, you will draft thought-leadership and other content, contribute to business and government advisory projects, support business development and marketing initiatives, and represent the team at selected conferences, meetings and other external engagements. The role will also include administrative responsibilities associated with the effective operation of the team.

**What your day will look like**

· Draft, edit, update and publish content on immigration, mobility and other areas of regional regulatory framework and practice.

· Research applicable regulatory frameworks and monitor legislative, policy and procedural developments across the MENA region.

· Work closely with Subject Matter Experts to obtain, provide and validate information, particularly regarding the practical implementation of regulatory requirements and government processes.

·  Conduct regular quality-control reviews of content, products and processes to maintain accuracy, consistency and operational efficiency.

· Conduct strategic analysis of regulatory frameworks across the MENA region, including preparing international benchmarking studies, current-state assessments, topic-specific reports, policy papers and white papers.

·  Contribute to business advisory projects, including compliance reviews and audits, policy drafting and review, multijurisdictional assessments, workforce mobility projects and client training.

· Contribute to government advisory projects, including legislative and policy analysis, international benchmarking, stakeholder engagement, procedural assessments and the preparation of recommendations and supporting reports.

·Work with digital tools and proprietary systems to update, review, manage and store information efficiently in support of Fragomen and its clients.

· Assist with the preparation and delivery of client and internal presentations, training programmes and knowledge-sharing sessions, both virtually and in person.

· Draft thought-leadership materials, client communications, articles, blogs, presentations and other content, as required.

· Support business development activities, including identifying opportunities, contributing to proposals and responding to requests for information or tender submissions.

·  Participate in marketing initiatives and represent the team at selected conferences, client meetings, government meetings and other external engagements.

· Coordinate with internal and external teams across different workstreams, ensuring that dependencies, responsibilities and deadlines are clearly understood and managed.

· Prepare meeting agendas and minutes, document agreed actions, and contribute to the development and maintenance of project plans and implementation roadmaps.

·  Support the successful delivery of projects by coordinating activities, monitoring progress, identifying potential issues and helping ensure that agreed deliverables and deadlines are met.

·  Maintain accurate time records and up-to-date project, matter and activity tracking.

· Undertake administrative responsibilities required for the effective operation of the team.

·  Carry out other responsibilities consistent with the role and the evolving needs of the MENA Learning & Advisory team and the Fragomen Knowledge Group.

  

**The team**

The MENA Learning & Advisory Hub is a specialized, regionally based team operating as part of the broader Fragomen Knowledge Group. The team works closely with Fragomen’s practices and Subject Matter Experts across the MENA region, as well as with colleagues from the Knowledge Group, on shared initiatives, content development and cross-regional projects. At the same time, it has the flexibility to respond directly to regional priorities and provide tailored support to internal teams, clients and government stakeholders.

  

The team’s work is organized around three principal areas:

·  **Knowledge Management and Awareness:** Monitoring regulatory and procedural developments, preparing client notifications and thought-leadership content, and maintaining knowledge resources, data tools and other products that help Fragomen and its clients remain informed and compliant.

· **Business Advisory:** Providing tailored advice on immigration compliance and mobility strategy, including immigration audits and health checks, policy drafting and review, customized training, multijurisdictional analysis, corporate restructuring support and crisis-related guidance.

·  **Government Advisory:** Supporting public-sector stakeholders through legislative and policy analysis, international benchmarking, current-state and procedural assessments, stakeholder engagement, policy development and strategic advice on immigration, labour mobility and workforce nationalization.

  

The team combines regional knowledge, practical experience and strategic analysis to translate complex regulatory developments into clear, actionable information and advice.

description:

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

**Job Description**

Sponsorships are a significant contributor of our annual Marketing Services revenue and remain a core strategic asset for both the Visa Brand and Visa Clients. As we work towards delivering our 2030 growth strategy and achieving our future aspirations, there is a need to further evolve how sponsorship assets are structured, commercialized, and scaled to drive consistent client value and revenue. Therefore, we are searching for a highly strategic Senior Manager of CEMEA Marketing Services to lead the strategy, commercialization, and performance management of Sponsorships within CEMEA Marketing Services. The Senior Manager will be responsible for developing a robust sponsorship commercialization strategy, creating set plays and playbooks, setting pricing and commercial guardrails, proactively managing asset inventory, and partnering with the regions and markets to successfully commercialize Sponsorship programs with clients across CEMEA. Additionally, the Senior Manager will help support the exploration of net-new sponsorship and partnership opportunities across CEMEA or in specific sub-regions, in close collaboration with the CEMEA Sponsorship Team, Regional Marketing Services Partners, and Finance. The selected candidate will play a critical role in shaping Marketing Services into a scaled, disciplined, and high-performing revenue engine across CEMEA. This position will report directly to the Senior Director of Commercialization and Go-to-Market of CEMEA Marketing Services.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Key responsibilities:

Sponsorship Commercialization Strategy:

* Define and drive the sponsorship commercialization strategy aligned to client priorities, issuer needs and CEMEA Sponsorships overall strategy and roadmap
* Represent Marketing Services’ interests in the exploration of new sponsorships and partnership opportunities, ensure alignment to strategy and support assessment of client demand/subsequent revenue potential for new assets
* Contribute to Marketing Services’ 3-year growth strategy and extend to a 2030 view, coupled with robust financial modeling and identification of clear Sponsorship building blocks and revenue streams that drive growth. 
* Strategic Sponsorship Pricing, Activation and GTM
* Set commercial guardrails and design standardized pricing methodologies across sponsorship assets to ensure we are pricing consistently region by region with clear margin targets by project/asset type
* Develop best-in-class Marketing Services sales materials and build client-ready sales plays to support the robust sell-in of sponsorship programs with clients across CEMEA
* Design, implement, and optimize asset resale models for all Sponsorship properties to maximize utilization across regions and clients

Performance Management & Optimization:

* Support the design and implementation of frameworks for Marketing Services target setting, pipeline tracking and revenue reporting across all Sponsorship properties in close partnership with CEMEA Finance
* Proactively report on sponsorships sales pipelines and client activity, and deliver any other custom analyses as required
* Build and maintain a robust tracking mechanism to understand global and regional Sponsorship asset inventories across the Marketing Services business and sell-in status by client
* Review overall performance and identify optimization opportunities to improve sweating of assets across regions and clients
* Support renewal strategies through performance insights and forward-looking recommendations

Cross-Functional Orchestration and Collaboration:

* Partner with sub-regions to ensure effective execution and localization of sponsorship commercialization strategies
* Support ongoing operations across key cross-functional and cross-geography touchpoints, including regular meetings with our Regional Marketing Services Leads, CEMEA and global Sponsorship Team, Finance partners, monthly Sponsorship Council meetings and more
* Develop and maintain a library of case studies and best practices to promote knowledge sharing and enable reapplication across the Marketing Services organization

  
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* 8-10+ years of relevant experience in sponsorships, partnerships, commercialization, management consulting or related fields
* Proven experience developing commercial strategies, pricing models, and go-to-market approaches in marketing
* Strong financial acumen with experience in business case development, revenue modeling, and performance tracking

Preferred Qualifications:

* Demonstrated ability to translate strategic opportunities into scalable, revenue-generating solutions
* Exceptional storytelling and communication skills, with experience building executive-level presentations and sales materials
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels
* Experience operating in a highly matrixed, regional or global organization

We offer our clients a broad range of traditional and alternative investment solutions, as well as comprehensive advice on all aspects of Wealth Management. As a trusted partner of wealthy individuals and entrepreneurs, family offices and foundations, we create lasting value for clients. We specialize in developing bespoke solutions for our clients around the world, for instance wealth planning across successive generations and international borders, asset management with individual risk management, loans and deposits. All this is possible thanks to our global network, our many years of experience and our close collaboration with the Corporate Bank, Investment Bank and DWS. Team Summary

Our marketing services business is a rapidly growing business and part of Visa's overall strategic growth priority to deliver value added services revenue through client engagements.

  

About the role:

Visa is looking for an experienced client leader to support the growth and delivery of Marketing Services in Saudi Arabia. Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing Services KBO, the selected candidate will lead a portfolio of key accounts and partner with Account Executives and client stakeholders to identify, shape and deliver marketing engagements across financial institutions, merchants and fintechs. The role will work closely with Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA), Products, Sales, Finance, Compliance, Sourcing and Controllership to deliver marketing strategy, brand advisory, research and insights, cardholder lifecycle marketing and end-to-end campaign execution.

  

The ideal candidate will combine exceptional client stakeholder management with strong project and commercial discipline. The individual will manage multiple concurrent client engagements, coordinate cross-functional contributors, maintain clear governance and proactively manage scope, dependencies, risks, issues, budget and delivery quality. The role requires a consultative, analytical and collaborative approach, with the ability to translate client requirements into practical marketing programmes and measurable outcomes.

  

The selected individual will contribute to the Saudi Arabia Marketing Services pipeline and financial plan, support opportunity development with Account Executives and ensure disciplined delivery from scoping through close-out. The role will serve as the primary day-to-day Marketing Services contact for assigned key accounts and escalate material commercial, delivery, compliance or reputational risks to the Senior Director.

  

This role will report to the Senior Director, Marketing Services KBO.

  

Essential Functions:

* Leading the Marketing Services relationship for assigned key accounts in Saudi Arabia, building trusted relationships with client stakeholders and maintaining a clear understanding of their business objectives, marketing priorities and success measures.
* Partnering with Account Executives to identify, qualify, scope and progress Marketing Services opportunities, contributing to account plans, proposals, statements of work and pipeline governance.
* Managing multiple client projects simultaneously from initiation through delivery and closure, with clear workplans, milestones, responsibilities, budgets, dependencies and decision points.
* Applying effective project management disciplines, including risk and issue management, change control, status reporting, quality assurance, governance forums and timely escalation.
* Coordinating subject-matter experts and delivery partners across Visa Consulting & Analytics, Products, Marketing, Sales, Finance and other supporting functions to provide a consistent 'One Visa' client experience.
* Ensuring each engagement follows Visa requirements for Compliance, Legal, Sourcing, procurement, information security, privacy, financial controls and third-party governance, with complete and timely documentation.
* Managing agencies, vendors and other external partners where required, including briefing, scope control, sourcing processes, delivery oversight, performance management and budget reconciliation.
* Monitoring project economics, revenue recognition inputs, costs and margin; maintaining accurate forecasts; and providing concise updates on delivery progress, risks, client feedback and required decisions.

  

Visa requires at least 4 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

* Minimum 12 years of work experience with a bachelor's degree or at least 10 years of experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters/MBA/JD/MD)
* Substantial experience in client marketing, consulting, marketing services, account management or another client-facing discipline, preferably in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC
* Exceptional client stakeholder management skills, with a record of building trusted relationships, managing expectations and navigating complex client organizations
* Strong project management capability and experience leading multiple concurrent projects with different stakeholders, timelines, budgets and delivery models
* Demonstrated ability to establish governance, identify and mitigate risks, resolve issues, control scope and maintain delivery quality
* Experience working with Compliance, Legal, Sourcing, procurement, Finance, Controllership, privacy, information security and third-party governance processes

* Fluent spoken and written English and Arabic

**Title:**

Risk Analyst

## **1.1 Purpose:**

To support the implementation and maintenance of project and enterprise risk management (ERM) processes across engineering and project delivery assignments. The Risk Analyst is responsible for maintaining project risk registers, facilitating risk identification and assessment activities, monitoring mitigation actions, and providing accurate risk reporting to support informed decision-making and successful project delivery.

## **1.2 Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the implementation of project and enterprise risk management processes across assigned projects.
* Maintain and update project risk and opportunity registers, ensuring information remains accurate, current, and auditable.
* Assist in facilitating risk identification workshops and risk review meetings with project teams and stakeholders.
* Develop structured risk statements and support qualitative risk assessments using approved methodologies.
* Monitor risk mitigation actions and follow up with risk owners to ensure timely closure of actions.
* Track emerging risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle and escalate significant issues where required.
* Support the evaluation of schedule, cost, technical, commercial, procurement, and execution risks.
* Prepare risk reports, dashboards, heat maps, and management presentations.
* Coordinate risk data collection and maintain consistency across risk management systems and reporting tools.
* Support Project Managers, Project Controls, Engineering Leads, and Commercial teams in risk-related activities.
* Assist with contingency planning and the development of mitigation strategies.
* Ensure risk management activities align with project governance requirements and company procedures.
* Support lessons learned reviews and ensure risk-related knowledge is captured for future projects.

## **1.3 Deliverables:**

* Project Risk Registers
* Opportunity Registers
* Risk Action and Mitigation Tracking Logs
* Monthly Risk Reports and Dashboards
* Risk Heat Maps and Risk Matrices
* Risk Workshop Records and Action Logs
* Management Risk Review Presentations
* Emerging Risk Reports
* Lessons Learned and Risk Closure Reports
* Project Risk Status Updates for Governance Reviews

## **1.4 Compliance & Standards:**

* Company Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework.
* Project Risk Management Plans (RMPs).
* Client project risk management requirements and procedures.
* ISO 31000 Risk Management Principles and Guidelines.
* Company governance, assurance, and reporting requirements.
* Project Controls and Risk Management best practices applicable to engineering and project delivery environments.

## **1.5 Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (any discipline), Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 2-3 years of experience in project support, project controls, planning, document control, junior engineering, or risk management roles within engineering and project delivery organizations.
* Experience within oil & gas, energy, infrastructure, or industrial projects preferred.
* Basic understanding of risk management principles, including risk identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting.
* Familiarity with Project Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and structured risk registers.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong written English skills with the ability to prepare clear and concise risk statements and reports.
* Familiarity with engineering project lifecycles, particularly Pre-FEED, FEED, and Detailed Design phases.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining accuracy, attention to detail, and data integrity.

**Job Description:**

\*\*Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia\*\*

  

Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in operating and maintaining the electrical infrastructure that supports world-class assets, communities, and visitor destinations across the development.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, advanced technologies, and diverse stakeholders. The role is suited to an experienced power operations and facilities leader who can assume ownership of electrical utility operations and ensure reliable, safe, and resilient power supplies to the project’s assets.

**Role Overview**

The Director – Power Operations will be responsible for the operational performance, asset integrity, maintenance, and service continuity of the project’s mains electrical supply network.

The role will primarily focus on sub transmission and power distribution systems operating across approximately , including transformers, primary substations, secondary substations, switchgear, feeders, and associated distribution assets. In this context, “LV” refers to power-system mains voltage and should not be confused with building-services or MEP low-voltage systems, which typically include controls, communications, and DC systems.

The position will also manage limited medium-voltage interfaces and maintain an effective operational relationship with the Saudi Electricity Company and other relevant utility stakeholders in relation to the upstream HV and MV network. HV ownership will remain limited to the project’s transmission interconnectors and substations associated with supply from the SEC grid.

This is an operations- and facilities-oriented leadership role, focused on ensuring that electrical infrastructure is safely maintained, operationally ready, and capable of supporting uninterrupted services across the development.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Assume overall operational ownership for the project’s power distribution and mains electrical supply infrastructure.
* Direct the safe, reliable, and efficient operation and maintenance of transformers, primary substations, secondary substations, switchgear, protection systems, feeders, cables, and associated distribution assets.
* Establish and maintain asset-management and preventative-maintenance strategies to protect service continuity and maximize the reliability and availability of electrical infrastructure.
* Ensure that all electrical assets supporting critical developments, public spaces, commercial areas, residential communities, transport systems, and operational facilities are maintained to the required performance standards.
* Lead the transition of power assets from construction, testing, and commissioning into live operations, ensuring that all operational, maintenance, safety, and documentation requirements are satisfied.
* Develop and implement operational procedures for switching, isolation, energization, emergency response, fault management, planned outages, and restoration of supply.
* Maintain effective relationships with SEC and other external utility stakeholders concerning incoming supplies, upstream network interfaces, planned outages, faults, operational coordination, and supply reliability.
* Coordinate with SEC on HV and MV distribution interfaces while retaining clear accountability for the project’s internal power distribution assets and operational performance.
* Establish resilience, contingency, and business-continuity arrangements for critical power supplies, including alternative supply routes, standby generation interfaces, UPS systems, and emergency restoration procedures where applicable.
* Monitor network performance, asset condition, power quality, outage events, and maintenance effectiveness, ensuring that emerging risks are identified and addressed before they affect services.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of electrical asset registers, criticality assessments, maintenance plans, operational records, single-line diagrams, protection settings, and technical documentation.
* Ensure that maintenance activities are planned and delivered in accordance with approved standards, manufacturer requirements, statutory obligations, and recognized electrical safety practices.
* Lead the investigation of electrical incidents, failures, recurring faults, and service interruptions, ensuring that root-cause analysis and corrective actions are completed.
* Work closely with facilities, asset management, engineering, construction, commissioning, operations, and development teams to ensure that power infrastructure is aligned with operational requirements.
* Support operational readiness and handover processes, including review of commissioning records, test certificates, as-built information, spare-parts requirements, training, and maintenance access.
* Establish performance measures and reporting for availability, reliability, response times, planned and unplanned outages, maintenance completion, safety, and asset condition.
* Manage specialist contractors, service providers, and maintenance partners, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, safety requirements, service levels, and technical standards.
* Provide technical and operational input into capital works, asset replacement, network modifications, capacity upgrades, and future development interfaces.
* Oversee the operational expenditure and maintenance budgets associated with the power distribution network, ensuring efficient use of resources and appropriate lifecycle value.
* Promote a strong safety culture, including compliance with electrical safety rules, permit-to-work systems, isolation procedures, switching protocols, and competency requirements.
* Provide clear operational assurance to senior leadership that electrical systems are capable of supporting project services without unacceptable risk of interruption.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a closely related discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional registration as a Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer, or equivalent is preferred.
* Relevant certification in electrical safety, asset management, facilities management, or operational excellence is advantageous.
* Minimum 20 years of progressive experience in electrical power operations, distribution networks, utility operations, facilities operations, or major infrastructure environments.
* Demonstrated experience operating and maintaining power distribution systems in the approximate range.
* Strong hands-on and leadership experience with transformers, primary and secondary substations, switchgear, protection systems, feeders, cables, and electrical distribution assets.
* Proven experience managing the operational performance and maintenance of electrical networks serving large-scale developments, utilities, industrial facilities, airports, campuses, cities, or comparable critical infrastructure.
* Experience leading the operational handover of electrical infrastructure from construction and commissioning teams into live operations.
* Demonstrated ability to establish maintenance regimes, operational procedures, emergency-response plans, and asset-performance strategies for complex power systems.
* Experience managing relationships with electricity utilities, including SEC or comparable national and regional power providers.
* Understanding of HV and MV utility interfaces, grid connection arrangements, incoming supplies, and the division of responsibilities between the utility provider and the development operator.
* Experience managing specialist contractors, maintenance providers, operational teams, and multidisciplinary facilities stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of electrical safety, switching and isolation procedures, permit-to-work systems, protection coordination, outage management, and emergency restoration.
* Experience managing OPEX, maintenance contracts, lifecycle planning, and asset replacement requirements.
* Familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems and enterprise asset-management platforms, such as SAP or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of SCADA, remote monitoring, metering, alarms, and power-quality systems is desirable.
* Strong understanding of operational readiness, asset documentation, maintenance planning, technical assurance, and service-continuity requirements.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with SEC, contractors, consultants, construction teams, facilities teams, and senior project leadership.
* A practical, service-focused, and operational mindset, with the ability to make timely decisions in a live and complex infrastructure environment.

* Strong knowledge of project management principles covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality, procurement, contracts, construction, commissioning, and stakeholder management.

* Working knowledge of BIM and digital project delivery platforms, together with integrated project controls and reporting systems.

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Interior Design (ID) Manager to join our team. The (ID) Manager will lead the interior design efforts for high-end luxury construction projects, ensuring the highest standards of design, quality, and craftsmanship. The role requires an experienced professional with a strong background in managing luxury interior design projects internationally. The ID Manager will oversee all interior design phases, from concept development through to project completion, ensuring alignment with the client’s vision, luxury standards, and project objectives. This position demands a blend of creativity, leadership, and technical expertise to manage large-scale luxury projects, working closely with clients, consultants, and project teams across global markets.  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**  
  
**Interior Design Leadership & Oversight:**  
• Lead the development of interior design concepts for luxury residential, commercial, and hospitality projects.  
• Ensure that all design elements, including layouts, materials, finishes, and furnishings, meet luxury standards and reflect the client’s vision.  
• Provide strategic leadership to the interior design team, ensuring the seamless delivery of all design phases from concept through construction.

**Project Coordination & Collaboration:**  
• Collaborate with architects, MEP teams, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that interior design elements integrate smoothly with the overall project design.  
• Lead coordination meetings with internal teams and external consultants to resolve design challenges and ensure alignment with luxury standards.  
• Manage the interface between interior design and other disciplines, ensuring consistency and cohesion across all project elements.  


**Luxury Interior Execution:**  
• Oversee the selection and specification of high-end materials, finishes, fixtures, and custom furnishings, ensuring they align with the luxury project’s design narrative.  
• Ensure that all interior spaces reflect the unique luxury aesthetics required for each project, balancing functionality and elegance.  
• Review detailed interior design documentation, drawings, and specifications, ensuring precision and adherence to luxury standards.  


**Quality Control & Design Integrity:**  
• Implement robust quality control processes to ensure that all interior design elements meet the highest luxury and craftsmanship standards.  
• Regularly review design deliverables, ensuring they comply with the client’s vision, international building codes, and local regulations.  
• Ensure design integrity is maintained throughout construction and fit-out, coordinating closely with contractors and on-site teams to resolve any design-related issues.  


**Client Engagement & Relationship Management:**  
• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients on all interior design matters, understanding their expectations and ensuring the design exceeds them.  
• Present interior design concepts, mood boards, material selections, and progress updates to clients, incorporating their feedback while maintaining the integrity of the luxury design vision.

* Strong English skills (Arabic a plus) to convey technical data to stakeholders.
    
* Independent troubleshooting of GIS data/software issues.
    
* Organized to meet deadlines and document in Aconex.
    
* Team-oriented, aligning with Client IT/governance policies.
    
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and Aconex.
    
* **Systems:** Use ESRI GIS, Aconex, Primavera P6 per Client IT policies.

**Title:**

Reporting Manager

Reporting Manager

### LOCATION

  

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

  

**project description**

The project is a major infrastructure programme for a mixed-use development aiming to be a global landmark recognized for its unique vision and position as an authentic destination in Riyadh. The community will be a distinct, self-sustaining hub for Riyadh offering several iconic assets. KBR will provide PMO services, enterprise – level governance, assurance, integration and performance oversight across all projects and programs.

  

**THE ROLE**

Reporting to the Project Controls Director, the Reporting Manager is responsible for all aspects of reporting for the Development.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Coordinate with PMCs to compile analytical data for the reporting of Development performance in terms of planning  and commercial success for production of executive reports.
* Coordinating with commercial and planning personnel for the preparation of technical reports.
* Application of project management information systems (PMIS) for efficient compiling and interpretation of analytical data.
* Validating the accuracy and relevance of data received from PMCs
* Supporting enhancements to reporting tools consistent with digital transformation objectives.
* Assisting with the development of weightage system that supports progress measurement rollup for project, District, and programme level reporting to maintain an updated P6/EPS change log.
* Verifying the entire programme scope and sitewide packages are included within the IMS with communication upstream and downstream.
* Reporting upon inter-project interfaces, dependencies, and critical paths.
* Supporting scenario analysis, sequencing options, and strategic planning inputs.
* Assist with the production of the IMS Baseline Package documents, including programme narrative, basis of schedule, weightage distribution, cost loading breakdown, resource loading and resource levelling, codes, key interfaces and logistic constraints, assumptions and exclusions.
* Produce reports for update of the IMS including the Baseline BoD completion dates tracker, cash flow calculation and guidelines, resource calculation and guidelines, baseline Change Control Tracker, baseline records and version history, IMS Interface Tracker, programme level key issues, delay analysis, schedule alerts, and mitigation measures tracker.

### ·       Report upon the IMS schedule from initiation to closeout, including any related activities for design approvals, statutory approvals, Infrastructure related works, procurement activities, tenant fit-out and exhibitions duration.

### ·       Assist with the production of a monthly updated IMS pack reflecting the approved monthly progress cut-off date and reporting calendar, including consolidated portfolio / programme-level IMS, Schedule Performance Analysis Report, Baseline and Change Impact Statement, Forecast and Mitigation Status Report, Interfaces and Dependency Log, updated KPIs report, updated IMS cashflow critical path(s) and near-critical path analysis, float consumption and trend analysis, schedule alert monitoring and reporting, updated resource profile Schedule Change Log, and version-controlled IMS tracker with clear revision history.

### ·       Report upon the percent complete at the district, programme and portfolio levels based on the agreed weightage system.

### ·       Report upon the overall, portfolio level integrated ‘Development Master Schedule’ (DMS) that combines and aligns inputs, activities, and milestones from multiple stakeholders.

### ·       Report upon DMS activities including Development Briefs and Feasibility Business Plan approvals, land acquisition and release dates, marketing activities and launch events, tenant fit-outs and exhibitions activities, sales strategies and events, budgeting, and cost information.

### ·       Participating in monthly Programme Review meetings.

### ·       Review PMC progress updates for accuracy, consistency, and substantiation.

### ·       Validating reported progress against approved schedules and supporting evidence.

### ·       Identifying delays, risks, and emerging issues impacting schedule performance.

### ·       Supporting internal and external audits related to schedule and commercial management.

### ·       Support proactive forecast and recovery schedule management by reviewing and validating PMC forecasts and projected completion dates.

### ·       Assessing the credibility of mitigation and recovery plans for delayed projects.

### ·       Reporting upon recovery schedules and acceleration options.

### ·       Evaluating and escalating schedule risks and opportunities in coordination with risk management functions.

### ·       Support long-term programme maturity by capturing lessons learned and best practices in planning and scheduling, and supporting training, guidance, and mentoring for PMCs and internal teams.

### EXPERIENCE, SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE

  

* **Bachelor’s degree**

* Minimum of 12 years total post-graduation experience

* PMI-PMP, GRI Professional, or equivalent

·       Experienced user of MS Office and understanding of project management software

·       Experience in international contracting mechanisms, including FIDIC

·       Strong knowledge of planning, resource and cost loading, and risk management techniques.

·       Ability to effectively monitor and analyse progress, identify trends, and recommend corrective actions.

·       Excellent report writing skills.

·       Fluent in English language both written and spoken

### COMPETENCIES

  

·       Leadership

·       Strong interpersonal and communication skills

·       Commercial awareness

·       Strong client focus

·       Planning & organising skills

·       Accepts responsibility

·       HSE Awareness

  

**KBR — Delivering Solutions, Changing the World.**

KBR brings together the best and brightest to deliver science, technology and engineering solutions that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most critical missions and objectives.

In everything we do, we are guided by our **ONE KBR Values:**

* **We Value Our People –** We create diverse, inclusive environments in which each person can feel safe, respected and valued, and where everyone has opportunities to grow and reach their full potential.
    
* **We Deliver –** We are uncompromising in our commitment to deliver innovative, high-quality, technology-led solutions for our customers and exceptional, sustainable value for all our stakeholders.
    
* **We Are People of Integrity –** We value honesty, trust, courage, fairness, prudence and tenacity. We believe doing what’s right for the planet, the communities where we work, and our people is good for business.
    
* **We Empower –** We empower our people with a shared purpose, the right tools and the supportive culture they need to be proactive decision-makers, to be adaptive to change, and to succeed.
    
* **We Are a Team of Teams –** We have a will to succeed, but we value the achievements of our team of teams over individual accomplishments. Our collective focus makes us a better, stronger, more effective company.
    

We have also embedded environmental, social and governance (ESG) principles in every business operation and corporate function. Not only are we committed to operating safely, sustainably and equitably, but we are also committed to using our capabilities and expertise to help our customers accomplish their sustainability goals.

Worldwide, KBR employs a diverse workforce approximately 29,000 people strong, with customers in more than 80 countries and operations in 40 countries.

**At KBR, We Deliver.**

**Fraud Alert**

Fraud has infiltrated the job placement market via the internet, email and direct phone contact. Attempts have included unauthorized use of KBR’s name and logo to solicit potential job seekers or to extend false job offers. Bad actors may mix in fake job advertisements with legitimate postings. These ads can include contact instructions and require job seekers to send sensitive personal information or money to pay for visa applications, processing fees, etc., in exchange for consideration for a high-paying position.

KBR will never ask for any sort of advance payment as part of the recruiting/hiring process. Candidate profiles are carefully managed to protect personal information.

We are currently looking for a **QHSE Manager** to leads and manage all Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental (QHSE) matters on the Water Pipeline project, ensuring contractors and project teams deliver the works safely, in compliance with statutory, client and contractual requirements, and to the required quality standards, while protecting people, assets and the environment.

  

**What You'll Be Doin**g

  

•Develops, implements and maintains the project QHSE Management Plan, procedures and governance framework, aligned to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 and to client and regulatory requirements.

•Reviews and approves contractor QHSE plans, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, risk assessments and environmental management plans prior to works commencing.

•Provides QHSE oversight of high-risk pipeline activities, including deep excavations, trenching, lifting operations, pipe stringing and welding, hydrotesting, confined space entry, crossings and tie-ins to live infrastructure.

•Leads site inspections, audits and surveillance of contractors, verifying compliance with QHSE requirements and driving the timely close-out of non-conformances (NCRs) and corrective actions.

•Oversees quality assurance and control of pipeline materials and works, including material inspections, welding and coating quality, NDT, pressure testing and as-built verification.

•Leads incident reporting, investigation and root cause analysis, ensuring lessons learned are shared and preventive actions are implemented across the project.

•Manages environmental compliance, including permits, waste management, dust and noise control, dewatering, ecological and archaeological protection, and site reinstatement.

•Drives road safety, fatigue management and journey management across the long linear worksite, including traffic management at road crossings and haul routes.

•Monitors, analyses and reports QHSE performance (leading and lagging KPIs) to the Project Director and senior management, with clear recommendations for improvement.

•Promotes a strong safety and quality culture through leadership engagement, campaigns, toolbox talks, inductions and recognition initiatives.

•Ensures emergency response, medical and evacuation arrangements are in place and tested across remote pipeline locations.

•Supports testing, commissioning and handover, ensuring QHSE and quality documentation is complete and accepted for project close-out

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  

**What Required Skills You'll Brin**g

·Minimum 15 years of experience in QHSE management on major infrastructure projects, including significant experience on water, oil and gas or other large-diameter pipeline projects.

·Proven experience leading QHSE teams and managing multiple contractors on large, remote or linear construction worksites.

·Strong knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems, and of KSA regulatory, environmental and client QHSE requirements.

·Sound understanding of pipeline construction methods and QA/QC requirements, including welding, coating, NDT, hydrotesting and commissioning.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science or a related discipline.

·NEBOSH International Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety (or equivalent).

·ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001 Lead Auditor certification.

·Chartered membership of IOSH, CQI or IEMA (or equivalent) is highly desirable.

  

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**

  

·Experience in incident investigation and root cause analysis (e.g., ICAM, TapRooT), audits and risk management.

·Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence contractors and senior management.

·Strong reporting and analytical skills, with experience in QHSE data management and performance reporting.

·Experience on giga-projects or major programmes in the GCC/Middle East is highly desirable.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an exceptionally talented Irrigation Inspector to join our site-based construction supervision team on the prestigious Green Riyadh Project. The successful candidate will be responsible for inspecting irrigation installation works, monitoring quality and compliance, supporting construction activities, and ensuring that all irrigation systems are executed in accordance with project specifications, approved drawings, and industry standards.

  

### What You'll Be Doing

* Attend and inspect Inspection Requests (IRs) submitted by the contractor and take appropriate action in a timely manner.
* Review irrigation-related shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements against contract requirements, specifications, local regulations, and industry best practices.
* Inspect irrigation pipe networks, valve chambers, pumps, filtration systems, controllers, emitters, sprinklers, and associated infrastructure to ensure compliance with approved drawings and specifications.
* Monitor the quality and progress of irrigation construction works on a daily basis.
* Report any non-compliant work and coordinate with contractors and project stakeholders to ensure timely corrective actions.
* Prepare inspection reports, site observations, surveillance reports, and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) when required.
* Verify testing and commissioning activities for irrigation systems, including pressure testing, flushing, and operational performance testing.
* Ensure proper coordination between irrigation works and other disciplines, including landscape, civil, electrical, and utilities.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, installations, test results, and progress photographs.
* Assist in measuring completed work quantities and verifying contractor payment applications when required.
* Provide technical support and recommendations to resolve irrigation-related issues encountered during construction.
* Monitor material storage, installation practices, and workmanship to ensure compliance with project quality standards.
* Observe and promote compliance with site health, safety, and environmental requirements.

  

### What Required Skills You'll Bring

* Bachelor's Degree in Agricultural Engineering, Irrigation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in irrigation inspection, construction supervision, or landscape infrastructure projects.
* Strong knowledge of irrigation systems, including drip irrigation, sprinkler systems, pumping stations, control systems, and water distribution networks.
* Experience in landscape and irrigation projects within large-scale infrastructure, urban development, or public realm environments.
* Ability to interpret construction drawings, technical specifications, and irrigation schematics.
* Familiarity with testing and commissioning requirements for irrigation systems.
* Strong understanding of construction quality control and inspection procedures.
* Excellent communication, reporting, and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and inspection reporting systems.

  

### What Desired Skills You'll Bring

* Experience working on major landscaping, urban greening, or public realm projects.
* Knowledge of sustainable irrigation practices and water conservation strategies.
* Familiarity with smart irrigation systems, central control systems, and IoT-based irrigation technologies.
* Professional certifications related to landscape or irrigation engineering are an advantage.
* Experience working with government clients and large-scale projects in Saudi Arabia is preferred.

* Extensive experience conducting internal, project, supplier, and subcontractor audits and surveillance activities.
* Experience managing Non-Conformance Reports, Corrective Action Requests, audit ﬁndings, root-cause analyses, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Strong knowledge of applicable quality standards and speciﬁcations, including relevant ISO, ASME, ANSI, ASTM, and client requirements.
* Experience reviewing project quality plans, procedures, inspection and test plans, method statements, technical speciﬁcations, drawings, and inspection records.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and risk-assessment skills.
* Ability to identify quality trends, assess risks, and recommend effective corrective and improvement actions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear technical reports and formal project correspondence.
* Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with clients, contractors, consultants, suppliers, and multidisciplinary project teams.
