**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Transportation Guidelines & Frameworks Lead** to join our team! In this role, you will lead the end-to-end development of the guidelines, procedures, frameworks, and operational SOPs that underpin a key transportation agency’s program. You will translate the agency’s strategic vision into clear, practical, and implementable documentation that guides internal teams and aligns consultants, contractors, O&M providers, and partner agencies around a consistent way of working.

You will be the central point of ownership for the “documentation backbone” of the program — ensuring that standards are technically sound, operationally realistic, and kept current as systems, processes, and policies evolve.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Lead the overall strategy, roadmap, and workplan for developing, harmonizing, and maintaining transportation standards, guidelines, operating procedures, and reference frameworks across the project scope.
    
* Coordinate the preparation of core guidelines and manuals covering traffic management, traffic signal systems, Traffic Control Center (TCC) operations, incident management, ITS systems, congestion and parking management, construction/work zones, freight/heavy vehicles, enforcement support, and multimodal operations.
    
* Translate high-level policy, concept of operations, and system requirements into clear, practical documents (standards, SOPs, playbooks, checklists, templates) that can be readily used by planners, designers, operators, inspectors, and field crews.
    
* Establish and manage a structured documentation architecture, including document hierarchy, version control, naming conventions, and cross-references so that users can easily locate the applicable requirements and procedures.
    
* Facilitate working sessions and technical workshops with various departments of the agency, other government agencies, and external service providers to capture business needs, reconcile conflicting practices, and build consensus on common standards and operating frameworks.
    
* Define and document interfaces between client organization and external entities (consultants, contractors, O&M providers, neighboring agencies), including roles and responsibilities, submittal requirements, approval workflows, coordination procedures, and performance expectations.
    
* Ensure that standards and SOPs align with international best practices, local regulations, and project-specific requirements for safety, resilience, sustainability, and customer experience, while remaining realistic for project’s operational context.
    
* Work closely with ITS, traffic engineering, safety, multimodal, data/analytics, and TCC operations specialists to embed their technical requirements into coherent, integrated guidelines and frameworks.
    
* Develop operational SOPs and playbooks for regular operations, planned events, construction and maintenance activities, emergencies, and severe weather conditions, ensuring clarity of triggers, roles, decision logic, and communication flows.
    
* Establish a formal review and update process for all standards and procedures, including triggers for revision, approval mechanisms, and a controlled change log to keep documentation current as systems and policies evolve.
    
* Define documentation deliverables, outlines, and authoring expectations for subconsultants, and review their submissions for consistency with the overarching agency standards and frameworks.
    
* Support the development of training materials, job aids, and knowledge transfer sessions that help client staff and external partners understand and apply the standards and SOPs in day-to-day operations.
    
* Provide expert input to project plans, risk registers, and performance frameworks to ensure that documentation-related activities, dependencies, and acceptance criteria are clearly captured and managed.
    
* Contribute to monthly, quarterly, and final reports by summarizing documentation progress, key decisions, risks, and upcoming milestones related to standards and frameworks.
    
* Act as a visible champion for structured, documented ways of working, promoting adoption and
    
* reinforcing the importance of consistent application across all participating organizations.
    

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Urban/Transport Planning, Systems Engineering, or a closely related field.
    
* **15–20+ years** of progressive experience working with transportation agencies or major transport owners/operators, with a strong focus on the development and maintenance of technical standards, guidelines, procedures, and operational SOPs.
    
* Demonstrated track record leading multi-disciplinary efforts to author, update, and implement agency documentation that governs planning, design, construction, operations, and maintenance of surface transportation systems.
    
* Deep understanding of how effective standards, frameworks, and SOPs are structured (hierarchy, content, level of detail) to support both internal users (planning, design, construction, operations, IT/ITS, asset management) and external stakeholders (consultants, contractors, O&M service providers, emergency services, adjacent agencies).
    
* Strong familiarity with traffic management, ITS, traffic control centers, and roadway/arterial operations, and how these domains are typically reflected in agency manuals, guidelines, and operational playbooks.
    
* Proven ability to translate complex technical and operational requirements into clear, concise, and user-friendly documentation, with consistent terminology and formatting.
    
* Experience setting up and managing documentation control, including versioning, approvals, and integration with quality management systems.
    
* Excellent facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills, with experience leading working groups and resolving differing viewpoints across multiple departments and partner organizations.
    
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to produce high-quality narrative text, structured outlines, diagrams, and process flows.
    
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-project environment, managing multiple documentation streams and deadlines while maintaining quality and consistency.
    

**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Prior experience supporting Gulf region transportation agencies or large metropolitan transport authorities on standards, guidelines, or operating frameworks.
    
* Familiarity with international best practices and reference standards in traffic management, ITS, road safety, and TMC operations (e.g., AASHTO, MUTCD-style guidance, PIARC, ITS standards), and how they can be contextualized for local application.
    
* Demonstrated experience leading similar standards, guidelines, and SOPs development programs for major metropolitan or national transportation agencies, with proven adoption across internal departments and external partners.
    
* Experience with organizational development, change management, or training related to the rollout of new standards and procedures.
    
* Professional registration/certification (e.g., PE, CEng, PTOE, PMP, or similar) is an advantage.
    
* Arabic language skills are desirable but not required.

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **BIM Coordinator – Structural/Civil** to join our team!

  

**What you'll be doing:**

  

* **MEP Technical Review & Quality Assurance (QA/QC)**  
    **MEP Model Deliverable Review:** Audit incoming Structural/Civil BIM models submitted by external consultants and contractors to verify compliance with the client Exchange Information Requirements (EIR) and the project **BIM Execution Plan (BEP)**.
* **Information & Asset Data Validation:** Review and validate Structural/Civil asset metadata, equipment parameter completeness, and **Level of Information Need (LOIN)** to guarantee data integrity for future Asset Management handovers (AIM).
* **Compliance Reporting:** Track and document the design/modeling progress of all appointed Structural/Civil supply chain parties, escalating non-compliance issues or data gaps directly to the PMC BIM Manager.  
    • Ensure that the Structural/Civil models align with luxury design standards, integrating high-end materials, finishes, and bespoke elements.  
    • Collaborate with other BIM specialists (architectural and MEP ) to ensure a fully coordinated building model that addresses luxury project specifications.  
    **Cross-Asset Coordination & Interface Management:**  
    • Facilitate coordination between architecture, structure, MEP, civil, and interior design teams, ensuring that all building elements are harmonized.
* **Lead Coordination Meetings:** Chair and lead multi-party BIM coordination workshops, driving accountability among Structural/Civil design consultants and contractors to resolve spatial and asset interfaces.  
    • Attend regular coordination meetings with consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to review design progress and resolve any model conflicts.  
    • Ensure that the building model is aligned with the aesthetic goals of the client and complies with luxury design expectations.  
    **Clash Detection & Resolution:**  
    • Conduct clash detection using Navisworks or similar software, identifying and resolving conflicts between various building systems.  
    • Proactively address design issues and provide BIM-based solutions to avoid construction delays and maintain high-quality outcomes.  
    **Quality Control & Compliance:**  
    • Implement BIM quality control procedures to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of the building models.  
    • Ensure that the design meets high-end luxury standards while adhering to the PMC’s quality management protocols.  
    • Monitor and enforce compliance with BIM execution plans and industry standards (e.g., ISO 19650).  
    **Risk Management & Problem Solving:**  
    • Identify potential design risks or constructability issues early in the project lifecycle, particularly in relation to luxury-specific design features.  
    • Work closely with the project management team to mitigate risks through model adjustments and informed decision-making.  
    **Training & Development**:  
    • Provide training and technical support to project teams, ensuring that all stakeholders understand and utilize BIM processes effectively.  
    • Stay updated with the latest BIM technologies, tools, and workflows, incorporating new innovations relevant to luxury building projects.  
    
* **BIM Software & Technical Tool Ecosystem**
* The candidate must possess strong proficiency and direct experience reviewing, navigating, and auditing models within the following toolsets:
* **Structural/Civil & Buildings Modeling and Coordination:** Autodesk Revit (Advanced Structural/Civil modeling, systems allocation, and lookup tables), Navisworks Manage for model coordination and clash coordination and other BIM-related software.
* **Infrastructure Utilities:** Autodesk Civil 3D is mandatory, Bentley OpenRoads (for reviewing wet/dry infrastructure interfaces)
* **Review & Clash Detection:** Autodesk Navisworks Manage (Advanced use of Clash Detective, Search Sets, and Appearance Profiler) and/or Solibri Model Checker
* **Collaboration & Issue Tracking:** ACC/Forma Model Coordination Revizto, BIMtrack or any similar collaboration tool

  

**What required skills you'll bring:  
**  
Bachelor’s Degree in Structural or Civil Engineering, or a related technical engineering or related field.  
Experience: Minimum 12-15 years of experience in BIM management, with at least 10 years working on high-end luxury building projects in the construction industry. including a minimum of **2 years working within a PMC, Client, or Lead Consultant role on mega-projects / master-planned developments** with a heavy emphasis on complex coordination.

Highly organized with commanding communication skills. Ability to lead technical alignment workshops and confidently enforce compliance with international Tier-1 consultants and contractors.

**Framework Standards:** Strong practical knowledge of the **ISO 19650** framework and information management delivery cycles.  
  
**What desired skills you'll bring:**  
Certification in BIM management or Autodesk Revit (e.g., Autodesk Certified Professional).  
Experience in PMC environments, working on large-scale luxury residential or hospitality projects.  
Knowledge of sustainable building practices and integration of green technologies, tools and workflows, incorporating new innovations relevant to luxury building projects.

* Create, maintain, and update digital maps and cartographic products using GIS software.

* Support the use of web services, mobile applications, enterprise portals, and related GIS technologies.
* Provide technical guidance and training to junior staff on GIS software, applications, workflows, and procedures.
* Participate in developing GIS training templates, manuals, videos, and other instructional materials.
* Review GIS deliverables to support quality, accuracy, and compliance with project requirements.
* Assist project teams in responding to client questions, requests, and technical issues.

* Interface with internal departments regarding GIS assignments, data requirements, systems, and deliverables.

* Ability to implement database design elements that support efficient querying, reporting, and analysis.
* Ability to implement data model structures that accurately represent geographic features and spatial relationships.
* Ability to produce scaled maps with effective cartographic design, clear symbology, and accurate annotation.

* Experience with Python, JavaScript, ModelBuilder, or other programming languages and automation tools.
* Experience supporting Feature Manipulation Engine workbenches for data transformation and conversion.

* Experience developing GIS training manuals, templates, videos, or other instructional materials.
* Experience reviewing GIS deliverables and supporting project quality assurance and quality control processes.

**Job Description:**

\*\*Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia\*\*

Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey.

The **Director – Waste Management** is the ultimate technical, financial, and lifecycle authority responsible for the strategic governance of a massive, next-generation solid waste infrastructure portfolio spanning a multi-district smart city footprint.

With a mandate requiring over 20 years of distinguished experience, this executive leader ensures that advanced waste assets—including city-wide automated vacuum waste collection (AVAC) pneumatic networks, smart sorting hubs, material recovery facilities (MRFs), and automated bin systems—are managed as a sustainable, data-driven capital portfolio. Operating at the intersection of urban asset management and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability pillars, this role focuses on maximizing Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), driving automated cross-charge cost recovery models, enforcing data integrity inside the central asset registry, and managing the multi-decade capital replacement lifecycle in an extreme desert climate.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Capital Planning & Asset Lifecycle Strategy (LCP)**

* Formulate and continuously update the 10-to-30-year **Capital Asset Replacement Plan (CARP)** for all solid waste and municipal cleansing infrastructure city-wide.
* Drive advanced asset degradation modeling and predictive performance matrices tailored to the intense heat, dust, pneumatic wear, and heavy-use profiles of the region's waste assets.
* Conduct rigorous Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and financial trade-off analyses to optimize capital expenditure versus operational maintenance (CAPEX vs. OPEX) for large-scale waste machinery and automated networks.
* Partner directly with the Service Charge Director to establish accurate, audited long-term infrastructure sinking funds paid for by commercial entities, mega-entertainment districts, and residential neighborhoods.

**2\. Digital System Integration & Smart Grid Governance**

* Establish and enforce the master asset data hierarchy, naming conventions, and structural classifications for all solid waste infrastructure within the enterprise framework.
* Partner with the SAP-EAMS Director to ensure that automated flow telemetry, mechanical runtime metrics, sensor data, and maintenance histories are flawlessly captured in the central **SAP Enterprise Asset Management** database.
* Oversee the deployment and configuration of smart-city infrastructure technology, including IoT-enabled bin sensor networks, pneumatic pressure tracking arrays, and integrated fleet telemetry systems inside the unified asset management platform.

**3\. Financial Cross-Charging & Vendor Performance Governance**

* Translate raw automated waste-volume and weight-tracking database metrics into equitable cost-allocation and financial cross-charging models for corporate finance teams.
* Deliver audited waste-generation data frameworks to the Service Charge Director to enable automated utility billing and cost recovery across international commercial partners, theme parks, hospitality hubs, and distinct sub-developments.
* Design and enforce strict technical Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and data-logging compliance protocols for Tier-1 external Operations & Maintenance (O&M) contractors and specialized waste management vendors.
* Lead independent operational and technical audits on waste infrastructure to verify that contract partners are completing preventative maintenance according to **ISO 55001 standards**.

**4\. Stage-Gate Assurance & Asset "Vesting" Handover**

* Act as the final technical sign-off authority on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee for all solid waste capital projects transitioning from construction contractors into live operations.
* Oversee the "Digital Vesting" process for waste networks, verifying that all technical manuals, structural as-built documentation, pneumatic safety certifications, and warranty tracking sheets are successfully integrated into the asset platform before formal operational sign-off.

**Job Requirements & Qualifications**

**Education & Professional Credentials**

* **Bachelor’s Degree** in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical asset management discipline from an accredited institution.
* **Master’s Degree** in Engineering Management, Asset Management, Sustainable Infrastructure, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred.
* **Professional Certifications:** Mandatory possession of senior professional credentials, such as Certified Asset Management Assessor (**CAMA**), Institute of Asset Management (**IAM**) Diploma, Chartered Waste Manager, or Chartered/Professional Engineer (**CEng / PE**).

**Experience**

* **Minimum of 20+ years** of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in infrastructure asset management, municipal engineering finance, or large-scale utility operations.
* At least **8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity**, directly managing multi-disciplinary asset portfolios and multi-million-dollar infrastructure operating and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX).
* Proven track record of spearheading the operational handover, technical integration, and lifecycle modeling of giga-scale automated vacuum waste systems, regional recycling hubs, or city-wide smart utility networks.
* Extensive experience aligning physical utility performance metrics with corporate financial structures, enterprise ERP engines, and **ISO 55001 asset governance frameworks**.
* Deep familiarity with Saudi Arabia’s national environmental regulations, localized municipal waste compliance laws, and circular economy targets.

**Technical & Soft Skills**

* Deep technical command over reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), predictive degradation analytics, and advanced fluid/pneumatic mechanical logistics under extreme climate conditions.
* Executive-level fluency in enterprise technology platforms, specifically **SAP (PM and MM modules)**, GIS mapping systems, and IoT smart-city network integrations.
* Exceptional executive presence and stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex mechanical and data engineering concepts into clear, high-level business cases for financial executives and executive steering committees.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior Procurement Manager** to join our team! In this role you will get to manage strategic procurement activities supporting city operations, facilities management, asset operations and other complex operational environments.

  

The role will be responsible for delivering end-to-end procurement activities, including procurement strategy, sourcing, tender management, commercial negotiations, contract award, mobilisation and supplier performance management.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Procurement Strategy and Category Management
    * Develop and implement procurement strategies for operational services, facilities management and asset operations.
    * Manage procurement categories may including:
        * Hard and soft facilities management
        * Building and asset maintenance
        * Engineering services
        * Security and concierge services
        * Cleaning and hygiene services
        * Waste management and recycling
        * Landscaping and grounds maintenance
        * Operational support and recurring service contracts
    * Develop procurement plans, category strategies and sourcing programmes aligned with business and operational requirements.
    * Recommend suitable route-to-market approaches, contract packaging and commercial models.
    * Identify opportunities to improve value for money, service quality, resilience, innovation and operational efficiency.
    * Undertake market analysis, supplier research and benchmarking to inform procurement decisions.
* ### Sourcing and Tender Management
    
    * Lead end-to-end procurement activities from requirements definition and strategy development through to contract award and implementation.
    * Prepare sourcing documentation, requests for proposals, invitations to tender, evaluation criteria and commercial schedules.
    * Manage supplier engagement, tender clarification, bid evaluation, negotiations and recommendation reports.
    * Coordinate cross-functional evaluation teams and ensure consistent, transparent and compliant procurement processes.
    * Develop commercial models suitable for recurring operational services, including fixed-price, performance-based, reimbursable and hybrid arrangements.
    * Support the preparation and execution of contracts in collaboration with legal, finance, technical and operational teams.
    * Lead procurement activities with appropriate levels of independence and escalate material risks or decisions when required.
* ### Contract and Supplier Management
    
    * Manage strategic supplier relationships and support effective contract performance throughout the contract lifecycle.
    * Establish and maintain supplier governance arrangements, including performance reviews and operational meetings.
    * Monitor supplier performance against agreed KPIs, SLAs, service standards and reporting requirements.
    * Support the development and implementation of supplier improvement plans and corrective actions.
    * Manage contract variations, extensions, renewals, claims, disputes and commercial issues.
    * Support contract mobilisation, transition and implementation to ensure continuity of business-as-usual services.
    * Maintain accurate records of contract obligations, pricing, performance, risks and key commercial decisions.
    * Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, cost optimisation and service innovation.
* ### Stakeholder Engagement
    
    * Work closely with operational stakeholders to understand requirements and develop practical procurement solutions.
    * Support business-as-usual service delivery by ensuring procurement activities are timely, commercially sound and aligned with operational priorities.
    * Build effective working relationships with facilities, asset management, operations, finance, legal, risk, technical and project teams.
    * Provide procurement and commercial advice to stakeholders throughout the sourcing and contract management lifecycle.
    * Facilitate stakeholder workshops, requirements reviews, evaluation meetings and supplier discussions.
    * Proactively identify and resolve issues that may affect procurement timelines, service delivery or commercial outcomes.
    * Engage with senior stakeholders and provide clear updates on procurement progress, risks, recommendations and decisions.
* ### Procurement Governance and Risk Management
    
    * Ensure procurement activities comply with approved policies, procedures, delegations and governance requirements.
    * Prepare procurement approval papers, business cases, award recommendations and governance submissions.
    * Maintain oversight of procurement risks, dependencies, supplier exposures and commercial assumptions.
    * Support procurement audits, assurance reviews and compliance activities.
    * Maintain procurement pipelines, contract registers, sourcing reports and savings or value-tracking information.
    * Promote consistency, transparency, competition and integrity across procurement activities.
    * Contribute to the continuous improvement of procurement processes, templates, tools and governance frameworks.
* ### Team Leadership and Delivery
    
    * Provide guidance and support to procurement team members and contribute to capability development.
    * Coordinate procurement resources across multiple concurrent sourcing and contract management activities.
    * Review and quality-assure procurement strategies, tender documentation, evaluation outputs and commercial recommendations.
    * Promote a collaborative, responsive and service-focused procurement culture.
    * Support the Procurement Director or Head of Procurement with reporting, planning and strategic initiatives.
    * Take responsibility for delivering assigned procurement projects within agreed timelines, budgets and governance requirements.

  

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration or Economics (or related field)
* 12+ years of diversified experience in all phases of procurement activities on large global engineering and construction projects, including managerial experience.
* Significant procurement experience within city operations, facilities management, asset operations or similarly complex operational environments.
* Strong experience sourcing and managing contracts across FM, hard and soft services, maintenance, security, cleaning, waste management and operational support services.
* Experience managing supplier performance against KPIs, SLAs and contractual service requirements.
* Strong category management, sourcing and procurement governance experience.
* Demonstrated ability to work with operational stakeholders and support business-as-usual service delivery.
* Experience developing procurement strategies, route-to-market approaches and commercial models for recurring operational services.
* Experience managing multiple end-to-end procurement projects simultaneously.
* Experience engaging with senior stakeholders and cross-functional project teams.
* Experience in large-scale developments, smart cities, airports, giga-projects or complex operational environments is advantageous.
* Degree in procurement, supply chain, business, finance, law, engineering or a related discipline.
* Professional procurement qualification, such as CIPS or equivalent, is preferred.

  

  
**What Skills You'll Bring:**

* Strategic sourcing and category management
* Facilities management and operational services procurement
* Tender and bid process management
* Commercial negotiations
* Contract lifecycle management
* Supplier relationship management
* KPI and SLA management
* Procurement governance and compliance
* Commercial analysis and financial evaluation
* Stakeholder engagement and influencing

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Graphic Designer - Saudi National** to join our team! In this role you will get to work within a new PMO working on major highways / infrastructure projects in the KSA Capital, Riyadh City.

* Study design briefs and determine requirements
* Conceptualize visuals based on requirements
* Prepare rough drafts and present ideas

* A highly creative mind set with experience of using own creative skills for creation of professional documents

* A keen eye for aesthetics and details
* Excellent communication skills

* Experience of working in a highly collaborative environment with multidisciplinary departments

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an experience **Senior Design Manager** to join our team! In this role you will get to Serves as Lead Designer for all phases of a project. Provides technical guidance to project design and drafting personnel, and functions as liaison with client, suppliers, and contractors regarding design issues.

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Coordinates execution of work assignments with respect to design approach, schedules, standards, budgets, and procedures to meet client scope of work requirements. Provides manpower estimates as required.
* Provides technical guidance to project design team in completing the most complex and difficult designs and layouts for complete systems and components of a project. Assignments typically involve design elements for which there may be no clearly established precedents and require anticipation of problems at the outset in order to provide appropriate solutions.
* Ensures compliance with required specifications, tolerances, safety factors, and industry codes, as well as client requirements and company standards.
* Performs specialized design computations and analysis within a given discipline.
* Performs interdisciplinary reviews and provides coordination of data to ensure a compatible design.
* Provides direction to a team of checking personnel, ensuring the mathematical accuracy of the drawings produced. Participates in checking orthographic (2D) and isometric (3D) drawings prepared by others.
* Understands and applies commonly used company design standards and methods. Provides input to the establishment or revision of guidelines and standards.
* Collaborates with Engineers and other engineering disciplines to ensure quality of design.
* Reviews supplier data and supplier/manufacturer drawings, as required.
* May train lower-level Designers in various procedures.

  

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Architectural or Engineering (or related field) with a strong background in managing the technical design process across multiple work packages.
* 10+ years of related work experience, including supervisory/managerial experience
* Robust personality who is able to manage senior stakeholders (internal and external) as well as leading a number of concurrent deliverables and deadlines
* Able to proactively preempt issues as well as being adept in quick problem solving / providing innovative solutions
* Independently taking the lead for all deliverables within their scope of work
* Significant managerial experience across a large team of Engineers, Designers, and technical support personnel - both internal and external - directing work involving complex technical situations
* Experience across multiple disciplines

  
**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Able to thrive in a fast paced environment.
* Professional Engineer registration with active membership in a professional engineering society may be required

* Excellent written and oral communications skills - comfortable presenting technical presentations / solutions to the client
* Thorough knowledge of industry practices and regulations are required
* Must also possess a thorough knowledge of current technology and the capabilities and efficiencies of specific engineering software for use in completing engineering assignments.
* Requirements include knowledge of the capabilities and efficiencies of utilizing specific computer software to complete design assignments.
* Also requires the ability to perform in a lead capacity on a project.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Lead Roads Engineer** to join our team. In this role you will get to work on many amazing and state of the art projects in the Kingdom and GCC.

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

  

* Lead and produce the technical delivery of road design packages on infrastructure and development projects.
* Perform and review engineering calculations, design reports, drawings, and BIM models.
* Guide project teams through concept, preliminary, detailed, and construction design stages.
* Review road safety, operation, constructability, and maintenance requirements.
* Prepare and present technical solutions to clients and stakeholders.
* Support planning of resources and workload across design teams.
* Conduct IDC and IDR reviews and ensure resolution of review comments.
* Mentor junior engineers and support their technical growth.
* Review project submissions before issue to ensure compliance with QA/QC requirements.
* Keep management informed of project progress, challenges, and delivery risks.

  

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

  

* Minimum 14+ years of experience with at least 10 years with Saudi projects.
* Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering or Transportation Engineering. Masters will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of urban road networks, highway design, and transportation infrastructure.
* Ability to independently lead design teams and manage project deliverables.
* Good understanding of grading design, cut and fill balance, and road drainage requirements.
* Strong knowledge of AASHTO, DMRB, MOT, MOMRAH, SHC, Amanah, and RCRC requirements.
* Good understanding of Saudi road approval processes and local authority requirements.
* Advanced experience using Civil 3D for road corridor and roadway design.
* Working knowledge of Auto TURN, Navisworks, InfraWorks, and BIM workflows.
* Experience reviewing BIM models up to LOD 350 and coordinating multidisciplinary models.
* Strong experience producing technical reports, specifications, and construction documents.
* Ability to interpret traffic studies and integrate findings into road designs.
* Proven experience managing clients, authorities, design teams, schedules, and deliverables.

  
**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

  

* Professional Engineer registration or equivalent professional certification.
* Arabic speaker is highly preferrable.
* Experience on major Saudi development, transportation, or infrastructure programs.
* Prior experience working with Riyadh Amanah, RCRC, MOT, and other government authorities.
* Experience leading proposals, project planning activities, and technical bids.
* Strong understanding of digital delivery and BIM execution plans.·        Experience managing multidisciplinary design reviews and stakeholder workshops.
* Knowledge of road safety audits and access management requirements.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality.
* Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project delivery requirements.
* Ability to make sound technical decisions with limited supervision.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Interface Lead - Saudi National** to join our team!

The Interface Lead will be responsible for managing and coordinating technical, organizational, contractual, and physical interfaces between project disciplines, contractors, consultants, authorities, stakeholders, and operational entities.

The role will ensure that interfaces are clearly identified, assigned, tracked, and resolved in a timely manner to prevent design conflicts, construction delays, scope gaps, rework, and impacts to project milestones.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Lead the day-to-day interface management activities across assigned project areas and packages.
* Establish and maintain the project Interface Management Plan, procedures, workflows, and governance requirements.
* Develop and maintain the Interface Register / Interface Control Document (ICD).
* Identify, document, classify, and monitor technical and non-technical interfaces across the project.
* Coordinate interfaces between Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Commissioning, Quality, HSE, Planning, Commercial, and Operations.
* Manage interfaces between different engineering disciplines including Civil, Structural, MEP, ICT, ELV, Utilities, Roads, Airfield, FLS, and specialist systems.
* Coordinate interfaces between multiple contractors, consultants, subcontractors, and project packages.
* Identify interfaces between new works and existing infrastructure / operational facilities.
* Coordinate airport airside / landside and operational interfaces where applicable.
* Identify interface requirements at an early stage and ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned to the relevant parties.
* Develop and maintain Interface Responsibility Matrices (IRM) and interface ownership structures.
* Define interface inputs, outputs, deliverables, responsibilities, dates, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate technical information exchange between interfacing parties.
* Facilitate interface workshops and coordination meetings.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, interface action trackers, and follow-up reports.
* Monitor interface actions and ensure timely closure of outstanding issues.
* Escalate critical or overdue interface issues to Project Management.
* Coordinate resolution of design clashes, scope gaps, technical discrepancies, and construction interface issues.
* Review interface requirements within drawings, specifications, contracts, technical submissions, and project documents.
* Coordinate with BIM / Digital Engineering teams to identify and resolve spatial and technical clashes.
* Support multidisciplinary design coordination and constructability reviews.
* Review interface requirements associated with temporary works, construction sequencing, access, logistics, and work fronts.
* Coordinate interfaces between permanent works and temporary facilities where applicable.
* Manage interfaces between construction activities and testing, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover.
* Coordinate system interfaces and integration requirements during commissioning.
* Ensure interface requirements are incorporated into project schedules and key milestones.
* Coordinate with Planning and Project Controls to monitor interface-related activities and constraints.
* Identify interface dependencies that may affect the critical path or project milestones.
* Support development of mitigation and recovery strategies for interface-related delays.
* Coordinate with Commercial and Contracts teams regarding interface-related scope boundaries, responsibilities, variations, and claims.
* Identify potential scope gaps, overlaps, and responsibility conflicts between contracts and packages.
* Support resolution of contractual interface issues in coordination with Commercial and Contracts teams.
* Maintain records of interface decisions, agreements, approvals, and technical resolutions.
* Ensure interface agreements are formally documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor implementation of agreed interface requirements in design and construction.
* Conduct interface inspections and site walks where required to verify physical interface conditions.
* Coordinate with Quality teams regarding interface-related inspections, NCRs, and corrective actions.
* Support resolution of interface-related RFIs, Technical Queries, NCRs, and site issues.
* Coordinate with HSE teams regarding interfaces that may create safety or operational risks.
* Coordinate with authorities, utility providers, airport operators, and external stakeholders where required.
* Monitor interface risks and maintain an Interface Risk Register where applicable.
* Provide regular interface status reports and dashboards to Project Management.
* Identify trends and recurring interface issues and recommend corrective actions.
* Support project governance meetings by providing interface status, key risks, and outstanding actions.
* Ensure interface information is properly documented and controlled.
* Support project handover by ensuring all outstanding interfaces are closed before completion.
* Capture interface-related lessons learned and best practices for future project phases.
* Provide guidance and support to engineers and coordinators involved in interface management.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in interface management, engineering coordination, construction management, or project delivery.
* Proven experience on major airport, infrastructure, transportation, or large-scale construction projects.
* Strong multidisciplinary coordination experience.
* Experience managing interfaces between contractors, consultants, design teams, and project stakeholders.
* Airport / aviation interface management experience is highly preferred.

* PMP / CAPM certification is an advantage.
* Interface Management / Systems Engineering training is preferred.
* PMI / AACE project controls training is an advantage.
* BIM / Digital Engineering coordination training is beneficial.
* Relevant HSE certification is an advantage.

* Interface Management
* Interface Registers
* Interface Control Documents (ICDs)
* Interface Responsibility Matrix (IRM)
* Technical Interface Management
* Design Coordination
* Multidisciplinary Coordination
* Contractor / Consultant Interface Management
* Package-to-Package Coordination
* Scope Boundary Management
* Scope Gap & Overlap Identification
* Design Clash Management
* BIM / 3D Coordination
* Construction Interface Management
* Existing / New Infrastructure Interfaces
* Airside / Landside Interfaces
* Utility Interfaces
* MEP / ICT / ELV Interfaces
* Commissioning & Systems Integration
* Operational Readiness Interfaces
* Interface Risk Management
* RFI / Technical Query Coordination
* NCR Interface Resolution
* Interface Action Tracking
* Schedule & Milestone Interface Management
* Contractual Interface Awareness
* Technical Reporting & Dashboards
* AutoCAD / BIM Awareness
* MS Office / Advanced Excel

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand complex multidisciplinary interfaces.
* Proactive approach to identifying interface risks before they impact the project.
* Strong follow-up and action management capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and technical teams.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple interfaces and priorities simultaneously.
* Professional and diplomatic approach to resolving conflicts between stakeholders.
* Strong decision-making and escalation judgment.
* Ability to work effectively under demanding project schedules.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.

**Job Description:**

description:
**Title:**

Deputy Controls Director

Deputy Controls Director

### LOCATION

  

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

  

**project description**

The project is a major infrastructure programme for a mixed-use development aiming to be a global landmark recognized for its unique vision and position as an authentic destination in Riyadh. The community will be a distinct, self-sustaining hub for Riyadh offering several iconic assets. KBR will provide PMO services, enterprise – level governance, assurance, integration and performance oversight across all projects and programs.

  

**THE ROLE**

  

Reporting to the Project Controls Director, the Project Controls Manager is responsible to maintain, govern, implement and provide pre and post contract implementation governance for the suite of Project Controls policies, management plans, standards, procedures, and processes, in support of reporting requirements and systems, i.e. Aconex, Unifier, P6 etc. The Project Control Manager is required to perform regular review and update of the existing governance documents on quarterly / annual basis.

  

## MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  

·       Onboarding and training of the PMCs to facilitate the understanding of the Programme, policies, processes and associated project management information systems and applications.

·       Maintain, implement, and administer the PMC onboarding process and welcome pack documents and continuously update the PMC onboarding tracker.

·       Maintain and implement the Project Controls governance structure, including roles and responsibilities (RACI) across all levels downstream.

·       Review the existing structure, propose improvements, and align with on required updates/changes.

·       Maintain, review and update all Reporting Governance Documents, including management plans., manuals, guidelines, templates, etc.

·       Develop, implement, and administer a comprehensive programme meeting and reporting Calendar for assigned District/Master Plan.

·       Manage and maintain the PMIS-driven business intelligence (BI) reporting platform, including preparation and creation of the new required BI dashboards and data entry registers through the approved systems, i.e. SharePoint, Unifier, etc.

·       Compile data from PMCs for standardised weekly, monthly, and executive-level dashboards.

·       Perform project level performance reporting for schedule, cost, risk, procurement, OHSE, change management.

·       Responsible for ensuring consistent data definitions, KPIs, and red-amber-green (RAG) criteria across all reports.

·       Assist with the preparation of training material to provide the required training to PMCs on the use of the implemented systems and population of data/registers.

·       Provide support to the client for Project Controls Team for related PMIS and Data Warehouse (DWH) requirements.

·       Responsible to maintain, implement, and administer a process for tracking and monitoring the PMC's performance against agreed KPI's, and produce a monthly report highlighting each PMC performance with the any required corrective actions.

·       Update the status of corrective actions during the subsequent reporting cycles.

·       Assess existing monitoring system and propose enhancements and improvements to the overall process.

·       Ensure that PMC’s reporting schedules are consistent with the PMO preparation of executive reports.

·       Review and collate the District/Master Plan programmes to produce and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS).

·       Establish and implement Project Controls Compliance Audit Requirements and conduct regular PMC audits to ensure adherence to standards and policies.

·       Implement processes and systems to monitor the timely completion of Stage Gate Reviews and the reporting across assigned District/Master Plan highlighting issues and/or risks that may impact the delivery of the programme.

·       Maintain issue the “KPI's Report” on monthly basis with highlight of key areas of concern with corrective measures and mitigation.

·       Produce a “Key Actions Required” report and escalation process to ensure all required actions are presented to executive management for escalation and action plans.

·       Prepare the monthly Programme Status Report that highlights the overall programme, district and individual project’s status and progress including each project’s status against the approved dates, schedule alerts, and key issues hindering project progress.

·       Managing and updating the existing Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) with updates recorded within the WBS change register.

·       Maintain an updated mapping tracker between WBS, CBS, and SAP projects.

·       Prepare monthly Programme Level Status Report that highlights the overall programme level, District levels, and individual project’s level status and progress.

·       Prepare required inputs for preparation of Executive Reports including programme and commercial update information and programme “asks” requirements from collate information from the client.

·       Develop and implement a Value Engineering Management plan, process, and templates with communication and training provided to PMCs to record savings against the Budget (Total Development Cost)

·       Develop and maintain a standardised Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) across all programmes and projects to ensure consistent cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting with alignment between CBS, WBS, work packages, procurement strategies, and budgeting requirements.

·       Develop maintain a structured Work Package Identification framework to ensure that all projects scope is clearly defined, consistently structured, and effectively aligned with planning, cost, procurement, and delivery.

### EXPERIENCE, SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE

  

### ·       Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, architecture, construction management, planning, management information systems or equivalent.

### ·       Minimum 12 years of post-graduation experience

·       PMI-Project Management Professional, AACE- Certified Cost Professional (CCP) or Planning and Scheduling Professional (PSP), MRICS, CIOB, or equivalent prior experience.

·       Sound knowledge of controls and reporting aspects of major civil, infrastructure and development projects including urban developments, high-rise buildings, roads, bridges, and utilities. 

·       Experienced user of MS Office and understanding of project reporting software including Oracle Unifier, P6, Aconex, etc.

·       Fluency in English language both written and spoken.

### COMPETENCIES

  

·       Leadership

·       Strong interpersonal and communication skills

·       Commercial and planning awareness

·       Strong customer focus

·       Planning & organising

·       Accepts Responsibility

·       HSE Awareness

  

**KBR — Delivering Solutions, Changing the World.**

KBR brings together the best and brightest to deliver science, technology and engineering solutions that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most critical missions and objectives.

In everything we do, we are guided by our **ONE KBR Values:**

* **We Value Our People –** We create diverse, inclusive environments in which each person can feel safe, respected and valued, and where everyone has opportunities to grow and reach their full potential.
    
* **We Deliver –** We are uncompromising in our commitment to deliver innovative, high-quality, technology-led solutions for our customers and exceptional, sustainable value for all our stakeholders.
    
* **We Are People of Integrity –** We value honesty, trust, courage, fairness, prudence and tenacity. We believe doing what’s right for the planet, the communities where we work, and our people is good for business.
    
* **We Empower –** We empower our people with a shared purpose, the right tools and the supportive culture they need to be proactive decision-makers, to be adaptive to change, and to succeed.
    
* **We Are a Team of Teams –** We have a will to succeed, but we value the achievements of our team of teams over individual accomplishments. Our collective focus makes us a better, stronger, more effective company.
    

We have also embedded environmental, social and governance (ESG) principles in every business operation and corporate function. Not only are we committed to operating safely, sustainably and equitably, but we are also committed to using our capabilities and expertise to help our customers accomplish their sustainability goals.

Worldwide, KBR employs a diverse workforce approximately 29,000 people strong, with customers in more than 80 countries and operations in 40 countries.

**At KBR, We Deliver.**

**Fraud Alert**

Fraud has infiltrated the job placement market via the internet, email and direct phone contact. Attempts have included unauthorized use of KBR’s name and logo to solicit potential job seekers or to extend false job offers. Bad actors may mix in fake job advertisements with legitimate postings. These ads can include contact instructions and require job seekers to send sensitive personal information or money to pay for visa applications, processing fees, etc., in exchange for consideration for a high-paying position.

KBR will never ask for any sort of advance payment as part of the recruiting/hiring process. Candidate profiles are carefully managed to protect personal information.

**Job Description:**

  

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Electrical Technician – Saudi National** to join our team! In this role you will get to support the installation, inspection, testing, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical systems and equipment across office and field locations.  

## What You'll Be Doing:  

* Perform routine electrical installation, maintenance, inspection, testing, and repair activities under the supervision of senior technicians and professional staff.
* Assist with the installation, operation, and maintenance of electrical systems, equipment, panels, generators, motors, pumps, lighting systems, and related components.
* Conduct basic inspections and testing of electrical equipment to identify faults, defects, and unsafe conditions.
* Assist with troubleshooting electrical circuits, control systems, wiring, power distribution systems, and equipment.
* Read and interpret basic electrical drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Support the testing, calibration, repair, and modification of electrical control and instrumentation systems.
* Use electrical testing tools and equipment in accordance with approved procedures and safety requirements.
* Maintain accurate records, inspection reports, maintenance logs, test results, and documentation of completed activities.
* Assist in preparing field and office reports related to electrical work, inspections, findings, and equipment status.
* Follow all applicable safety procedures, electrical codes, permit requirements, and project-specific requirements.
* Assist with preventive and corrective maintenance activities at project and field locations.
* Coordinate with higher-level technicians, engineers, and other project team members to complete assigned work.
* Perform routine and occasionally physical tasks in office, industrial, construction, and field environments.
* Travel to and work at field locations as required.
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as appropriate.  
    

## What Required Skills You'll Bring:  

* Must be a **Saudi National**.
* Diploma or Associate degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Technology, Electromechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of **3 years of related professional experience**.
* Basic knowledge of electrical installation, maintenance, inspection, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals.
* Knowledge of electrical tools, testing equipment, control panels, wiring systems, motors, generators, pumps, and power distribution equipment.
* Ability to follow instructions, standard operating procedures, safety requirements, and electrical work practices.
* Ability to maintain accurate records, logs, reports, and technical documentation.
* Ability to work effectively under the supervision of senior technicians, engineers, and professional staff.
* Ability to work in office, industrial, construction, and field environments.
* Willingness to travel and work at project and field locations as required.
* Ability to perform routine physical and occasionally heavy labor activities.
* Basic understanding of electrical health and safety requirements, including lockout/tagout procedures and safe work practices.  
    

## What Desired Skills You'll Bring:  

* Experience working on large infrastructure, construction, industrial, utility, or facilities projects.
* Experience with electrical systems, power distribution equipment, control panels, generators, motors, pumps, lighting systems, and instrumentation.
* Experience performing preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical equipment.
* Experience using multimeters, insulation resistance testers, clamp meters, electrical test equipment, and related tools.
* Familiarity with low-voltage and medium-voltage electrical systems.
* Familiarity with electrical control systems, instrumentation, and automation equipment.
* Knowledge of applicable electrical codes, standards, and safety requirements.
* Experience preparing inspection reports, maintenance records, testing documentation, and equipment logs.
* Relevant electrical or safety certifications are preferred.

job_title: Early in Career Development Programme - Commercial (Roche Pharma)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

### The Position

As part of Roche’s Saudi-based **Early in Career Development Programme – Commercial**, you will embark on a 12-month transformational journey designed for aspiring pharmacists. In this rotational role, you will gain hands-on experience in strategic, patient-centered functions, collaborating across the healthcare ecosystem to solve real challenges around science, technology, and healthcare partnerships.

  

* **Engage in Rotational Learning:** Participate in hands-on rotations across patient care, stakeholder collaboration, and system transformation to build critical skills.
* **Drive Patient-Centered Initiatives:** Work on projects that advance patient outcomes and support our vision of personalized healthcare.
* **Experiment with Innovative Ideas:** Contribute to solving real-world challenges alongside forward-thinking industry professionals in a supportive, dynamic environment.
* **Access Targeted Mentorship & Leadership Development:** Gain exposure to senior leaders, curated learning experiences, and structured mentorship to accelerate your professional growth.
* **Collaborate Across the Ecosystem:** Build impactful partnerships with internal teams and healthcare stakeholders to help shape the future of patient care.

  
  

**Who You Are**

  

You are a passionate, purpose-driven pharmacy graduate at the early stage of your career, eager to make a lasting difference in the healthcare system.

  

* **Educational Background:** Recent degree (Bachelor’s or PharmD) in Pharmacy or equivalent pharmaceutical science qualifications.
* **Curiosity & Learning Agility:** Strong desire to learn, experiment with new ideas, and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for working across diverse teams and cultures.
* **Patient Advocacy Mindset:** Demonstrated enthusiasm for patient outcomes, healthcare leadership, and system transformation.
* **Courage & Initiative:** Proactive approach to problem-solving and a drive to take on challenges with confidence.

  
  

At Roche, you’re empowered to design your own learning path. With access to training, job rotations, and leadership development, we support your unique growth journey.

### Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

  

We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action. And we believe that good business means a better world.

That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

We are proud of who we are, what we do, and how we do it. We are many, working as one across functions, across companies, and across the world.

**We are Roche.**

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Construction Manager – Commercial Zone** to join our team! The Construction Manager (Commercial) will oversee planning, coordination, and execution of commercial works (office, retail, F&B, leisure, podiums, etc.) within a large mixed‑use development project. Operating in a PMC capacity, this role is responsible for managing multiple contractors, ensuring compliance with design intent, codes, contracts, safety, quality, time, and cost objectives on behalf of the client.

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Review and provide input on master construction schedules, phasing plans, and milestones for commercial components.
* Coordinate with design consultants (architectural, structural, MEP, façade, interiors) to ensure construction feasibility and completeness of drawings/specifications.
* Assist in constructability reviews, value engineering options, and buildability assessments.
* Identify construction risks and develop mitigation plans for commercial zones (e.g., retail mall, offices, podium areas).

* Lead day‑to‑day site management of commercial blocks, coordinating with main contractor, specialized subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Monitor construction progress against approved baseline programme and report variances.
* Chair and document regular site coordination meetings:
* Ensure construction is in line with approved drawings, specifications, and client standards.
* Coordinate logistics for commercial areas (access, material delivery, storage, vertical transportation, hoisting).

* Implement and oversee QA/QC procedures for all commercial works.
* Review and approve method statements, ITPs (Inspection & Test Plans), and shop drawings.
* Coordinate inspections with third‑party testing agencies and statutory authorities, as required.
* Manage snagging, de‑snagging, and punch list closure for commercial areas.

* Support the client and QS team in monitoring budgets and cost control for commercial packages.
* Review and recommend contractor interim payment applications, Variation orders, Claims related to time and cost.
* Verify quantities on site and changes arising from design modifications or site conditions.
* Assist in negotiation of commercial terms, settlement of claims, and final account closure.
* Ensure adherence to contract conditions, deliverables, and performance obligations.

* Enforce strict compliance with HSE policies, statutory safety regulations, and project-specific safety plans.
* Conduct and/or participate in safety audits, toolbox talks, and incident investigations.
* Promote a safety culture on site, especially in high‑risk commercial activities (façade works, high‑rise, heavy MEP equipment, public areas).

* Act as the primary PMC interface between client, consultants, and contractors for commercial works.

* Coordinate and Manage interfaces between project parties.

* Manage relationships with tenants’ representative teams during pre‑fit‑out and fit‑out phases.
* Prepare and present progress reports, dashboards, and risk updates to client leadership.

* Oversee testing and commissioning of building systems serving commercial areas.
* Coordinate integrated testing of systems across mixed‑use zones (commercial, retail, podium, parking).
* Ensure documentation completeness: As‑built drawings, Operation & Maintenance manuals, Test certificates, warranties, and statutory approvals.
* Lead snagging, pre‑handover inspections, and progressive handover of commercial spaces to client/tenants.

* Protect client interests by acting as an independent advisor and monitor of contractor performance.
* Ensure that decisions are aligned with client’s project objectives on quality, cost, schedule, and risk.

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Transport & Mobility Engineer** to join our team! In this role, you will **contribute to and support a wide range of traffic engineering, corridor assessment, and mobility-improvement activities across Riyadh, using field observations, traffic data, analytical tools, and engineering judgment to identify practical and innovative transportation solutions.**

  

You will work with experienced traffic engineers, transportation planners, civil engineers, ITS specialists, and RCRC counterparts to assess how the road network is performing, investigate the causes of congestion and safety concerns, and develop implementable improvement concepts. This is a strong development role for an engineer who wants hands-on exposure to large-city traffic management and operational improvement.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

  

* Support traffic engineering and mobility assessments at intersections, corridors, highways, access points, public transport interfaces, and congestion hotspots across Riyadh.
* Review traffic counts, turning-movement data, travel times, queue observations, speed data, crash information, detector data, video, and other field information to identify operational deficiencies.
* Conduct field inspections and document existing traffic operations, geometric constraints, lane-use issues, pedestrian conditions, access conflicts, parking impacts, and other factors affecting network performance.
* Develop and review practical traffic-management and geometric improvement concepts such as lane-use changes, turn-lane modifications, access management, signing and marking improvements, signal-timing changes, intersection channelization, and localized capacity improvements.
* Support corridor assessments by identifying recurring bottlenecks, progression issues, queue spillback, operational conflicts, and opportunities for multimodal improvements.
* Prepare clear technical sketches, exhibits, maps, photographs, calculations, tables, and concise engineering narratives that explain observed issues and recommended treatments.
* Support senior engineers with Synchro, GIS, spreadsheet, or other analytical tasks used to test and compare transportation improvement options.
* Support before-and-after evaluations and development of performance measures for implemented traffic improvements.
* Coordinate with roadway, signal, ITS, public transport, parking, safety, and construction specialists to ensure recommendations account for wider network impacts.
* Assist with preparation of assessment reports, corridor studies, presentations, technical memoranda, guidelines, and implementation recommendations.
* Participate in site meetings, technical workshops, and coordination sessions with RCRC and other project stakeholders.
* Maintain organized engineering records and ensure analysis inputs, assumptions, field observations, and recommendations are traceable.
* Apply current transportation-engineering practices while looking for innovative, data-driven solutions appropriate to Riyadh’s operating environment.
* Support implementation monitoring and field verification to determine whether completed improvements are functioning as intended.
* Develop technical capability through mentoring, structured review, and exposure to traffic operations, transportation planning, ITS, and roadway-design disciplines.

  

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Traffic Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 6-8 years of professional experience in traffic engineering, transportation planning, mobility analysis, roadway operations, or related transportation work.
* Working knowledge of traffic engineering principles including intersection operations, capacity, queues, lane utilization, traffic control, access management, and basic signal operations.
* Experience reviewing traffic data and translating field observations into clear engineering findings and potential improvement concepts.
* Ability and willingness to conduct field investigations in live urban traffic environments and document conditions accurately.
* Familiarity with traffic-analysis software such as Synchro/SimTraffic, Vissim, HCS, or comparable tools is desirable; demonstrated analytical aptitude is required.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD and/or GIS tools for reviewing or preparing engineering exhibits is advantageous.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word for analysis and technical reporting.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to prepare concise technical material.
* Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams, accept technical direction, and manage multiple assignments with attention to quality and schedule.
* Bring international traffic operations and mobility best practice and adapt it to Riyadh’s operating environment.

  

**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring:  
**

* Previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC on urban transportation or traffic-management projects.
* Exposure to corridor studies, traffic impact studies, signal timing, road-safety assessments, public transport priority, parking, or construction traffic management.
* Experience using GIS, Python, Power BI, traffic-video analytics, probe data, or other emerging mobility-data tools.
* Interest in smart mobility, ITS, data-driven traffic management, and innovative operational treatments.
* Engineer-in-Training or equivalent professional-development status is an advantage.
* Arabic language skills are desirable but not required.

description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

### The Position

As part of Roche’s Saudi-based **Early in Career Development Programme – Commercial**, you will embark on a 12-month transformational journey designed for aspiring pharmacists. In this rotational role, you will gain hands-on experience in strategic, patient-centered functions, collaborating across the healthcare ecosystem to solve real challenges around science, technology, and healthcare partnerships.

  

* **Engage in Rotational Learning:** Participate in hands-on rotations across patient care, stakeholder collaboration, and system transformation to build critical skills.
* **Drive Patient-Centered Initiatives:** Work on projects that advance patient outcomes and support our vision of personalized healthcare.
* **Experiment with Innovative Ideas:** Contribute to solving real-world challenges alongside forward-thinking industry professionals in a supportive, dynamic environment.
* **Access Targeted Mentorship & Leadership Development:** Gain exposure to senior leaders, curated learning experiences, and structured mentorship to accelerate your professional growth.
* **Collaborate Across the Ecosystem:** Build impactful partnerships with internal teams and healthcare stakeholders to help shape the future of patient care.

  
  

**Who You Are**

  

You are a passionate, purpose-driven pharmacy graduate at the early stage of your career, eager to make a lasting difference in the healthcare system.

  

* **Educational Background:** Recent degree (Bachelor’s or PharmD) in Pharmacy or equivalent pharmaceutical science qualifications.
* **Curiosity & Learning Agility:** Strong desire to learn, experiment with new ideas, and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for working across diverse teams and cultures.
* **Patient Advocacy Mindset:** Demonstrated enthusiasm for patient outcomes, healthcare leadership, and system transformation.
* **Courage & Initiative:** Proactive approach to problem-solving and a drive to take on challenges with confidence.

  
  

At Roche, you’re empowered to design your own learning path. With access to training, job rotations, and leadership development, we support your unique growth journey.

### Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

  

We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action. And we believe that good business means a better world.

That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

We are proud of who we are, what we do, and how we do it. We are many, working as one across functions, across companies, and across the world.

**We are Roche.**
