# **Location: Jeddah**  
  
  
Join Accenture Security and play a key role in strengthening our clients’ cyber defense capabilities.  

As a **Cybersecurity Service Delivery Manager**, you will lead the delivery of SIEM logging and security monitoring enablement across complex enterprise environments. You will combine strong technical knowledge of SIEM and log management with delivery leadership, ensuring security-relevant data is onboarded, normalized and validated to effectively support threat detection and monitoring use cases.  

You will work closely with security, application, infrastructure and engineering teams to translate detection and monitoring requirements into actionable logging requirements, drive structured onboarding waves, resolve data-quality challenges and provide stakeholders with clear visibility of delivery progress, risks and outcomes.  

## What You’ll Do  

### SIEM & Logging Delivery  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of **log-source assessment, onboarding and validation** into enterprise SIEM platforms, with **Splunk preferred**.
* Define and govern logging requirements aligned with security monitoring, detection and investigation use cases.
* Oversee log onboarding activities including source identification, ingestion, parsing, field extraction, normalization and validation.
* Assess log sources for **quality, completeness, consistency and security value**, identifying gaps and recommending remediation.
* Ensure required security events and fields are captured accurately and made available to monitoring and detection teams.  
      
    

### Technical & Delivery Leadership  

* Provide technical direction and troubleshooting support for complex log ingestion, parsing, mapping and data-quality issues.
* Apply strong knowledge of common logging formats and protocols, including **syslog, JSON, Windows Event Logs and application logs**.
* Drive consistent approaches to data normalization and standardization across diverse technology environments.
* Understand how telemetry supports detection engineering and collaborate with detection teams to ensure logs meet defined use-case requirements.
* Coordinate dependencies across application, infrastructure, platform and cybersecurity teams to enable required logging.
* Lead delivery through **batch-based, wave-based or phased onboarding approaches**, balancing delivery priorities, dependencies and technical readiness.  
    

### Service Management & Governance

* Own delivery planning, progress tracking, risks, issues, dependencies and stakeholder reporting for assigned logging initiatives.
* Establish clear quality criteria and ensure onboarding outputs meet agreed technical and operational requirements.
* Produce high-quality assessments, onboarding documentation, status reporting and management-level updates.
* Facilitate working sessions with technical teams and stakeholders to resolve blockers and maintain delivery momentum.
* Identify opportunities to improve onboarding processes, logging standards, operational efficiency and monitoring coverage.
* Act as a trusted point of coordination between cybersecurity teams and technology stakeholders.

  

## What You’ll Need

* Strong hands-on understanding of **SIEM technologies**, preferably **Splunk**.
* Demonstrated experience with **log onboarding, ingestion pipelines, parsing and field extraction**.
* Strong understanding of security logging across operating systems, applications, network devices and security technologies.
* Knowledge of common log formats and protocols such as **syslog, JSON and Windows events**.
* Experience assessing and improving **log quality, completeness and consistency**.
* Experience defining logging requirements against security monitoring and detection use cases.
* Working knowledge of **detection engineering** and the role telemetry plays in effective security detections.
* Understanding of security-data **normalization, standardization and mapping** practices.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities, particularly for ingestion and data-quality issues.
* Experience coordinating with application, infrastructure, platform and security teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing structured, phased or batch-based technology delivery.
* Strong documentation, reporting and presentation capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into clear business and delivery impacts.  
    

## Bonus Points If You Have

* Experience delivering SIEM or security-monitoring capabilities in **large-scale enterprise environments**.
* Experience with Splunk administration, SPL, data models or Common Information Model concepts.
* Exposure to SOC operations, threat detection, incident investigation or threat hunting.
* Experience working with cloud and hybrid environments.
* Familiarity with **MITRE ATT&CK** and security monitoring frameworks.
* Relevant cybersecurity, SIEM, Splunk or service-management certifications.
* Experience operating within a Managed Security Services environment.

description:
**YOU ARE**

As a Lead or Principal AI Architect, you will serve as the definitive technical authority on AI architecture within client engagements and across the practice. You will own the complete, end-to-end architecture of advanced AI platforms and solutions — spanning classical machine learning, generative AI, and agentic systems — ensuring every domain of the architecture is cohesively designed, technically sound, and purposefully aligned to client business objectives and enterprise-grade standards.    A defining dimension of this role is your ability to operate at the executive level — working closely with CIOs, CTOs, and senior business leaders to help shape and articulate the enterprise AI strategy. You will connect business goals, priorities, and transformation agendas to a coherent technical vision, ensuring AI investments are purposeful, sequenced, and positioned to deliver lasting competitive advantage. This strategic partnership with client leadership distinguishes you as both a trusted advisor and a principal architect.    In this role, you will lead and integrate the work of multiple domain architects and subject matter specialists — across areas such as agentic application design, AI security and trust, AI operations and observability, data and knowledge engineering, and model platforms and inference — providing the architectural vision, technical governance, and cross-domain coherence that binds their contributions into a unified, enterprise-ready system. You will set the architectural direction, resolve cross-domain tensions, and make the critical design decisions that shape the entire AI solution.    Beyond client delivery, you will be recognized as a thought leader and leading authority in AI — staying at the forefront of the latest research, emerging standards, industry innovations, and evolving technology landscapes. You will actively shape the practice's AI architecture point of view, contribute to internal knowledge, frameworks, and reusable assets, and represent the firm externally through publications, conference engagements, and client advisory conversations. Your perspective on where AI is heading will be sought by clients, practice leadership, and peers alike.    You will evaluate and make definitive decisions on design patterns, technical frameworks, reference architectures, and technology selections — balancing innovation with pragmatism to deliver systems that are robust, scalable, and built to last. This includes providing architectural oversight across AI agent ecosystems encompassing multi-agent orchestration, tool use, skills use, and memory systems, as well as foundation model integration, fine-tuning strategies, and classical ML model deployment within cohesive, production-ready platforms.    You will be accountable for ensuring the complete architecture meets the most rigorous non-functional requirements across security, observability, governance, performance, and scalability — and that these concerns are addressed holistically and consistently across all domains. You will produce and govern the authoritative architecture artifacts that guide delivery at scale — including architecture decision records (ADRs), reference architectures, component and data flow diagrams, and integration specifications — and provide the executive-level technical leadership that gives cross-functional engineering teams, domain architects, and client stakeholders the clarity and confidence to execute.    Your work will be instrumental in defining how the most ambitious clients adopt, scale, and lead with AI — setting a standard for what advanced AI architecture can and should look like, and delivering transformational, lasting business value.

**THE WORK**

* Partner with CIOs, CTOs, and business leaders to shape the enterprise AI strategy, connecting business goals to a coherent, sequenced technical vision
    

* Lead enterprise AI assessments and build enterprise AI implementation roadmaps that sequence investments for lasting competitive advantage
    

* Own the complete, end-to-end technical solution for complex AI platforms — ensuring every domain is cohesively designed and aligned to business objectives and enterprise standards
    

* Translate the governing architecture principles into a concrete, defensible technical solution that domain teams build against
    

* Build innovative prototypes and proofs of concept hands-on, using emerging technologies to de-risk decisions and prove value early
    

* Perform technology assessments and comparisons, making definitive, evidence-based recommendations on tools, frameworks, and platforms
    

* Set the architectural direction for model- and tool-agnostic multi-agent ecosystems — orchestration, memory, and tool/skill use — governed through a registry-bound AI Gateway
    

* Establish the agent registry and certification model that mandates no uncertified agent reaches production
    

* Define memory as a first-class abstracted platform service, decoupled from any underlying vendor engine
    

* Define the foundation model and inference strategy — adaptation, fine-tuning, and dynamic cost/quality/latency-aware routing
    

* Set the standards for high-throughput, low-latency inferencing and classical ML deployment within unified, production-ready platforms
    

* Own the architecture of the enterprise context layer — knowledge graphs, ontologies, vector search, and semantic retrieval — grounding the solution in client knowledge
    

* Set the design direction for context assembly and memory that manages prompts, context windows, and conversational state across the platform
    

* Be accountable for security, governance, observability, performance, and scalability addressed holistically and consistently across every domain
    

* Establish the identity and authorization model — per-agent identity, IAM/IAP binding, and defense\-in-depth enforcement
    

* Define the layered guardrail framework applied at every boundary, balancing protection with performance
    

* Govern the MCP control plane — registry, gateway, and risk scoring — across all internal and third-party servers
    

* Mandate adopt-over-build for productized evaluation and observability stacks
    

* Establish FinOps as a first-class concern — usage labelling, gateway-enforced budgets, and cost-per-archetype as a planning input
    

* Make the definitive decisions on design patterns, reference architectures, frameworks, and technology selections, balancing innovation with pragmatism
    

* Lead and integrate the work of domain architects and specialists, resolving cross-domain tensions into a unified, enterprise-ready system
    

* Build the practice's reusable reference architectures, frameworks, and assets, with a deliberate adopt-over-build stance
    

* Conduct deep-dive architecture workshops and working sessions with client executives and engineering teams
    

* Produce and govern the authoritative architecture artifacts — blueprints, reference architectures, ADRs, and integration specifications — that guide delivery at scale
    

* Serve as a recognized thought leader in AI, shaping the practice's point of view and representing the firm externally through publications and conference engagements
    

**BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATION**

* Proven experience in designing & deploying enterprise grade advanced ai solutions using agentic, generative and classical AI/ML using at least one cloud vendor.
    

* Proven experience in the LLM and Generative AI space.
    

* Proven experience architecting and operationalizing LLM driven application architecture patterns.
    

* Proven experience in engineering, machine learning, deep learning and NLP solutions and applications.  Minimum of 6 years of experience as a machine architect in the industry designing big data, machine learning. large scale analytical engineering solutions

As an **AI Architecture Manager**, you will lead the design and evolution of enterprise AI platforms and architecture frameworks that enable scalable adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the organization. You will define the target-state AI architecture, evaluate emerging technologies, and establish secure, governed, and high-performing AI foundations that support Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and advanced AI workloads. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, you will drive the implementation of enterprise AI capabilities that accelerate innovation while ensuring operational excellence and responsible AI practices.

* Design and evolve enterprise AI architecture frameworks, including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and multi-modal AI solutions.
* Define target-state AI platform architectures and develop implementation roadmaps that support enterprise-wide AI adoption and scalability.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, and architectural patterns, providing recommendations on technology selection and investment decisions.
* Design and operationalize end-to-end AI foundations that support model development, deployment, monitoring, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Assess and integrate technologies across data platforms, AI/ML ecosystems, cloud infrastructure, security controls, and governance frameworks.
* Architect and develop custom platform components that address enterprise AI scalability, performance, and operational requirements.
* Optimize compute infrastructure and model-serving environments to improve performance, availability, observability, and cost efficiency.
* Establish AI platform standards, architectural principles, and best practices that support secure and scalable AI delivery.
* Implement Responsible AI, security, compliance, risk management, and governance controls across AI platforms and solutions.
* Collaborate with engineering, data, security, and business teams to ensure AI architecture aligns with enterprise objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance throughout AI transformation and modernization initiatives.

## Job Qualifications

### Basic Qualifications

* **Proven experience** in AI Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Architecture, Data Platforms, or related technology leadership roles.
* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale AI and Machine Learning platforms.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), multi-modal AI models, and modern AI architecture patterns.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI/ML services.
* Expertise in MLOps, AI platform engineering, model deployment, monitoring, and AI operations.
* Experience designing governance, security, compliance, and Responsible AI frameworks for enterprise solutions.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and scalable infrastructure design.
* Experience leading architecture decisions and influencing technology strategy across cross-functional teams.

### Preferred Qualifications

* Experience building enterprise AI foundations, AI Centers of Excellence (CoE), or large-scale AI transformation programs.
* Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and advanced AI platform architectures.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containerization, distributed computing, and high-performance AI infrastructure.
* Expertise in AI observability, model performance optimization, platform reliability, and cost management.
* Strong stakeholder management, consulting, and executive communication skills.
* Relevant certifications in Cloud Architecture, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or Enterprise Architecture are preferred.

·                Lead threat hunting engagements

·                Conduct incident response within various Cloud platforms

**About the Role**  
Support the delivery of OT cybersecurity engagements across consulting, engineering, architecture, design, and implementation. The role combines advisory expertise with hands-on technical delivery, working with clients, OT teams, OEMs, and technology vendors to design and implement practical, secure OT environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end OT cybersecurity engagements across assessment, strategy, architecture, engineering, design, and implementation.
* Conduct OT cybersecurity maturity, gap, risk, and security assessments across industrial environments.
* Design and engineer OT cybersecurity solutions aligned with client requirements and industry best practices.
* Develop detailed OT security architectures, network designs, security controls, technical specifications, and implementation plans.
* Support the implementation and configuration of OT security technologies, including network segmentation, firewalls, secure remote access, asset visibility, monitoring, vulnerability management, and security controls.
* Participate in technical design workshops, solution engineering, system integration, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
* Work directly with OT, engineering, IT, and cybersecurity teams to translate business and operational requirements into secure technical solutions.
* Work with OT OEMs, system integrators, and technology vendors to design, integrate, and validate cybersecurity solutions.
* Apply relevant OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks, including IEC 62443, NIST, NERC CIP, and ISO 27001/27019.
* Develop technical deliverables including HLD/LLD, security architectures, design documents, technical specifications, assessment reports, and implementation documentation.
* Support client workshops, technical presentations, demonstrations, and stakeholder engagements.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, solution development, and new OT cybersecurity offerings.
* Stay current with emerging OT technologies, cybersecurity threats, standards, and engineering practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of cybersecurity experience, with significant exposure to OT/ICS cybersecurity.
* Proven experience in OT cybersecurity consulting, engineering, design, and implementation.
* Practical understanding of OT/ICS architectures, industrial networks, protocols, control systems, and engineering environments.
* Hands-on experience designing or implementing OT security solutions and technologies.
* Experience working with OT OEMs, system integrators, and industrial technology vendors.
* Strong knowledge of IEC 62443, NIST, and other relevant OT cybersecurity standards.
* Experience developing HLD/LLD, network/security architectures, technical designs, and implementation specifications.
* Strong analytical, technical, communication, and client-facing skills.
* Ability to work across both advisory and hands-on engineering environments, translating cybersecurity requirements into implementable solutions.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting system integration, testing, commissioning, and operational handover is highly desirable.
* Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are desirable.
* Experience in energy, oil & gas, utilities, manufacturing, or other critical infrastructure environments is preferred.

## Role Overview

As a **Business Process & AI Transformation Consultant**, you will help organizations reimagine business processes through the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and emerging technologies. You will assess industry trends, identify transformation opportunities, and design future-state operating models that integrate AI at scale. Working closely with business and technology leaders, you will define practical, scalable transformation strategies that drive operational efficiency, innovation, and business value.

## Key Responsibilities

* Assess industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technology developments to identify opportunities for AI-driven business transformation.
* Analyze current business processes and operating models to identify areas for optimization through AI and intelligent automation.
* Design future-state business processes that leverage AI, automation, and digital technologies to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and customer outcomes.
* Define AI integration points across business processes, systems, workflows, data sources, and decision-making activities.
* Develop detailed process transformation designs, including system interactions, data flows, automation requirements, and human-machine collaboration models.
* Recommend operating model changes that support sustainable AI adoption, including governance structures, roles, responsibilities, and performance measures.
* Facilitate alignment between business and technology stakeholders throughout transformation initiatives.
* Provide subject matter expertise on industry- and function-specific requirements, regulations, governance frameworks, and business practices.
* Support the development of transformation roadmaps, implementation strategies, and change management approaches.
* Communicate complex process, technology, and AI design decisions to senior leadership in a clear, business-focused manner.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure AI-enabled solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned with organizational objectives.
* Promote best practices for AI adoption, process excellence, and continuous improvement across transformation programs.

## Job Qualifications

### Basic Qualifications

* **4-7 years of experience** in Business Transformation, Process Consulting, Management Consulting, Digital Transformation, Intelligent Automation, or related fields.
* Experience analyzing and redesigning business processes to improve operational performance and business outcomes.
* Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, process optimization, and digital transformation principles.
* Experience developing target operating models, process frameworks, and transformation roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of business process design methodologies and process improvement techniques.
* Experience facilitating workshops and collaborating with business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

### Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting AI, automation, or enterprise transformation initiatives across one or more business functions or industries.
* Familiarity with process mining, workflow automation, business architecture, and operating model design.
* Knowledge of AI governance, compliance, risk management, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience documenting future-state processes, data flows, and system integration requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive presentation skills.
* Experience working with transformation tools, process modeling frameworks, and enterprise technology platforms.
* Relevant certifications in Business Analysis, Process Excellence, Lean Six Sigma, Change Management, or Digital Transformation are preferred.

Role Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Live Audio Production Engineer to manage sound operations across corporate events, conferences, exhibitions, product launches, and live shows.

The successful candidate will oversee the complete audio production process, from technical planning and equipment preparation to sound checks and live operation. Working closely with event producers, stage managers, lighting and video teams, and external suppliers, you will ensure a seamless, professional audio experience for clients, presenters, performers, and audiences.

Key Responsibilities:

Review event briefs, venue specifications, production schedules, and technical requirements to develop suitable audio plans.

Prepare audio equipment lists, stage layouts, channel lists, and signal-routing plans.

Coordinate the installation, configuration, and testing of PA systems, mixing consoles, microphones, stage monitors, and playback equipment.

Configure and optimize sound systems according to venue acoustics, audience size, and event format.

Conduct sound checks and rehearsals with presenters, performers, and production teams.

Operate digital mixing consoles during live events, ensuring clear speech, balanced music, and consistent audio quality.

Coordinate audio cues and transitions with show callers, stage managers, and lighting and video operators.

Manage wireless microphones, stage monitoring, and audio feeds for recording, streaming, and broadcast when required.

Troubleshoot and resolve feedback, interference, signal loss, and equipment issues quickly during live operations.

Coordinate with clients, venues, rental suppliers, and other production partners to ensure technical requirements are met.

Supervise audio technicians during equipment installation, testing, dismantling, and transportation where required.

Ensure compliance with equipment handling procedures, safe sound levels, and workplace safety standards.

Inspect equipment after events and report faults, maintenance requirements, or potential improvements.

Requirements

At least 3 years of experience in live sound engineering, event audio production, or audiovisual event operations.

Proven experience supporting corporate events, conferences, exhibitions, or live shows.

Strong knowledge of digital mixing consoles, PA systems, wireless microphones, stage monitoring, and audio signal flow.

Practical understanding of gain staging, equalization, dynamics processing, acoustic feedback, and system tuning.

Ability to interpret technical riders, venue specifications, and event production requirements.

Experience coordinating with event producers, stage managers, performers, clients, and technical suppliers.

Familiarity with networked audio protocols such as Dante is an advantage.

Strong troubleshooting, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.

Ability to remain calm and make effective decisions under live event pressure.

Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, and travel when required.

Relevant audio engineering qualifications or manufacturer certifications are an advantage.

Key Success Factors:

Delivering consistently high-quality audio across different event formats and venues.

Ensuring smooth coordination between audio and other production teams.

Resolving technical issues quickly while minimizing disruption to live events.

Maintaining professional standards in client service, equipment handling, and event delivery.

\-Minimum 5 years of relevant hands-on experience in control, automation, security, or integrated site systems.  
\-Demonstrated practical experience with Siemens security, access control, CCTV, or related control systems.  
\-Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding capabilities.  
\-Good understanding of control panels, controllers, I/O systems, communication networks, and system interfaces.  
\-Experience with system commissioning, configuration, testing, and maintenance.  
\-Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, control schematics, and system architecture diagrams.

\-Experience in integrating security and control systems with centralized monitoring or management platforms is preferred.

\-Good command of English, both written and spoken.  
\-Strong technical reporting and documentation skills.  
\-Ability to work independently and effectively under site operating conditions.

**About Us**

Soum is on a mission to revolutionize e-commerce in the MENA region and beyond by building the most convenient and trustworthy re-commerce marketplace in the region. We're reshaping how C2C marketplaces operate, making buying and selling second-hand products seamless and reliable. Since our launch in July 2021, Soum has become one of the fastest-growing startups in the region, achieving rapid expansion in both our team and product offerings. In recognition of our impact and growth, we were proudly named one of the Top 10 LinkedIn Startups in Saudi Arabia for 2024.  
  
**About the Role**

Own and manage the end-to-end car operations, ensuring a smooth and efficient car journey from intake to final handover.

You will lead the Operations team, improve processes, and ensure operational targets and service levels are consistently achieved

### Role & Responsibilities:

**Operational Ownership**

* Own the end-to-end operational car journey and ensure smooth execution across all stages.
    
* Ensure clear ownership, processes, and escalation paths across the operation.
    
* Manage and resolve operational escalations and critical issues.
    
* Ensure operational capacity is aligned with business growth and demand.
    

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and manage the Cars Operations team across different functions and locations.
    
* Develop the team, set clear expectations, and build capability across the operation.
    

**Performance & Process Improvement**

* Set and monitor operational KPIs, SLAs, productivity, and quality standards.
    
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements.
    
* Continuously improve efficiency, turnaround time, quality, and customer experience.
    

**Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Monitor operational performance and provide regular reporting and insights.
    
* Coordinate closely with Sales, Supply, Data, Finance, and other relevant teams.
    

### Requirements & Experience:

* Strong experience in operations management, preferably within automotive, marketplace, logistics, or a similar fast-paced environment.
    
* Proven experience managing and developing operational teams.
    
* Ability to build, improve, and scale operational processes.
    
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
    
* Data-driven, with a good understanding of operational KPIs and performance management.
    
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
    
* Fluent in Arabic and English.
    

**Preferred**

* Automotive industry experience.

## **About Soum**

Soum is a fast-growing B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and used cars across Saudi Arabia through our website and mobile app. Everything we do is built on trust: buyers need confidence in what they are getting, and sellers need confidence they will be paid fairly and quickly. With the recent launch of our subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum is building the go-to recommerce platform in the Kingdom.

## **About the Role**

The Consumer Product Manager owns the experience our customers touch every day: how buyers discover, evaluate, pay for and receive a used phone or car, and how sellers list, price and get paid for what they sell. You will be the voice of the Soum customer inside the product team, turning deep consumer insight into features that grow conversion, repeat purchase and trust in the platform.

You will work across the app and web, partnering with design, engineering, operations and commercial teams to ship quickly and learn from what we ship.

### Key Responsibilities

* Own the roadmap for a core consumer area (such as the buyer journey, the seller journey or subscriptions), prioritising ruthlessly by impact on conversion, retention, GMV and customer trust.
    
* Build a deep, continuous understanding of Soum's customers through user interviews, usability testing, app reviews, customer support tickets and behavioural data.
    
* Optimise the end-to-end marketplace funnel: listing creation, search and discovery, product pages, checkout and payments (Mada, Apple Pay, BNPL), delivery tracking, returns and post-purchase experience.
    
* Design and improve trust features that make buying used feel safe, including device condition grading, car inspection reports, verified sellers, buyer protection, ratings and transparent pricing.
    
* Shape the subscription products for electronics and cars: the value proposition, packaging, onboarding, engagement and retention, working closely with Commercial and Finance on unit economics.
    
* Translate problems into clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and run agile delivery with design and engineering, from discovery through release and iteration.
    
* Champion an Arabic-first, bilingual experience with high-quality RTL design and localisation for Saudi customers.
    
* Run a disciplined experimentation practice: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, define success metrics and make fast, evidence-based decisions on what to scale or kill.
    
* Monitor and report on core consumer KPIs, including conversion rate, listing-to-sale rate, activation, repeat purchase, subscription retention, NPS and customer complaints.
    
* Partner cross-functionally with Operations (inspection, logistics, customer service), Marketing and Growth (acquisition, CRM), and Finance to make sure product changes work end to end, not just on screen.
    
* Keep a close eye on regional and global marketplaces and recommerce players, and bring the best ideas back to Soum, adapted for our customers.
    

### Requirements

* 2–4 years of product management experience on consumer-facing digital products such as marketplaces, e-commerce, fintech or consumer apps.
    
* A proven track record of shipping consumer features that moved measurable business metrics, and the ability to explain exactly how.
    
* Strong consumer intuition backed by data: comfortable with product analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), funnel analysis and A/B testing; working SQL is a strong plus.
    
* Hands-on experience building for mobile (iOS and Android) and web.
    
* Solid understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics, including supply and demand balance, liquidity, trust and pricing.
    
* Experience working closely with designers and engineers in an agile environment, with clear written specs and sharp prioritisation.
    
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management, able to align operations, commercial and tech teams around a decision.
    
* A true owner who moves fast, takes decisions with incomplete information and cares more about outcomes than output.
    
* Fluent English; Arabic is a strong plus.
    

### Nice to Have

* Experience with KSA or GCC consumers, Arabic/RTL products and local payment methods.
    
* Background in used goods, recommerce, automotive or subscription businesses.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We're looking for founding a highly motivated, self-starter Strategic Account Executive who is passionate about voice technology and how it is changing businesses. We don't just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with our strategic enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will:

- Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts in the Saudi Arabia to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

- Identify and develop high-value business opportunities that align with ElevenLabs' product offering and roadmap.

- Generate leads, negotiate complex contracts and close sales in collaboration with the Growth team.

- Be responsible for KPI and sales performance tracking, providing weekly updates to the wider ElevenLabs team.

Who you are
We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You'll strive with us if you:

- Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

- Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

- Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

- Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

- Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

What you bring

- Proven track record of meeting & exceeding sales targets in a fast-paced environment, selling into large and strategic enterprises in the Saudi Arabia

- +10 years of previous experience in sales in a SaaS organisation, with experience managing strategic, complex, deal cycles.

- Extensive experience working in the Saudi Arabia

- Expertise or willingness to learn everything about Voice AI industry and how ElevenLabs' solution can help.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization.

- A hybrid of customer & product-driven mentality that prioritises client impact, satisfaction & scale.

- The role is based in the Saudi Arabia

- Plus: Proficiency in Arabic.

description:
Job Purpose

The Shift Supervisor is responsible for managing staff and overseeing operations on the floor during their assigned shift at the attraction. This role ensures that the attraction operates smoothly and efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of guest service. The Shift Supervisor plays a key role in creating a positive guest experience by leading the team, addressing any operational issues promptly, and ensuring that all activities are carried out according to SEVEN’s standards and policies.

Functional Accountabilities

Key Accountability Areas

Key Activities

Staff Supervision and Management

•

Lead and manage the team during the assigned shift, ensuring that all staff members are performing their duties effectively and adhering to SEVEN’s standards.

•

Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members based on operational needs, ensuring optimal coverage and service delivery.

•

Provide on-the-spot training, guidance, and support to staff, ensuring that they have the knowledge and skills required to perform their roles.

Operational Oversight

•

Monitor and oversee all operational activities on the floor, including guest services, equipment maintenance, and safety protocols.

•

Ensure that the attraction is clean, well-maintained, and fully operational at all times during the shift.

•

Address any operational issues or guest concerns promptly, escalating to the Attractions Manager if necessary.

Guest Service Excellence

•

Ensure that all guests receive high-quality service, with a focus on creating a positive and memorable experience.

•

Handle guest inquiries, complaints, and feedback in a professional and courteous manner, taking appropriate actions to resolve any issues.

•

Promote a culture of guest service excellence among the staff, leading by example and encouraging team members to go above and beyond for guests.

Safety and Compliance

•

Enforce safety protocols and ensure that all staff and guests are adhering to SEVEN’s safety standards and procedures.

•

Conduct regular checks of equipment and facilities to identify any potential safety hazards or maintenance needs.

•

Ensure that all shift activities comply with local regulations and SEVEN’s internal policies.

Reporting and Documentation

•

Maintain accurate records of shift activities, including staff attendance, guest interactions, and any incidents or issues that occur.

•

Prepare shift reports for the Attractions Manager, highlighting key operational outcomes, challenges, and recommendations for improvement.

•

Ensure that all documentation is completed accurately and submitted in a timely manner..

Guest Experience

•

Ensure all guests receive high-quality service, creating a positive and memorable experience during their visit.

•

Address guest inquiries, complaints, and feedback promptly and professionally, resolving any issues to maintain guest satisfaction.

•

Lead by example to promote a culture of guest service excellence, encouraging staff to exceed expectations and deliver exceptional service.

Service Level Standards

•

Adheres to SLS

Communications & Working Relationships

Key Internal Interactions

•

Attractions Manager

•

Operations Team

•

Maintenance Team

•

Guest Services Team

Key External Interactions

•

Guests

•

Vendors (for equipment and supplies)

KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE

KNOWLEDGE

Minimum Qualifications

•

High school diploma or equivalent; additional qualifications in hospitality or management are a plus.

Professional Certifications

•

Certification in Hospitality Management or a related field is a plus.

EXPERIENCE

Required Experience

•

3-5 years of experience in a supervisory role within a guest-facing environment, preferably in the entertainment or hospitality industry.

•

Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage a team and handle multiple operational tasks simultaneously.

•

A proven track record of delivering excellent guest service and managing guest interactions effectively.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Physical Requirements

•

Ability to work independently, perform manual handling tasks, lift up to 5kg, stand for extended periods, bend, reach, push/pull up to 10kg, with full mobility and no visual or auditory impediments.

Together we make the difference We are a leading provider of innovative and high-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe. Be part of our Quality Management team as a Quality Engineer - Mechanical in Jeddah, KSA. What are my responsibilities? Quality Control Management: • Guide and control suppliers, subcontractors, and in-house teams to comply with project quality plans and quality control documentation. Quality Control Documentation: • Develop and Implement project-related documentation including Inspection, Test Plans, Records, Method Statements, Supplier Quality Requirements collation and analysis for supplier approval. • Prepare and submit technical documentation such as Inspection Requests (IR), Material Inspection Requests (MIR), supplier and subcontractor submittals, and End-Project Documentation. • Plan and prepare internal project status meeting data to ensure that it is in line with the planned project schedule. Quality Management System: • Proactively assist in implementing the project quality plan and organizational quality management system, including procedure development, work instructions, forms, etc. • Document & records control, control of nonconformity, corrective action, internal audit, identification and implementation of improvement opportunities. • Comprehensive knowledge of fundamentals of quality and the ability to communicate them to new and existing staff using a quality awareness slide presentation Knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 is a definitive edge. Embedded Quality in Processes and Projects: • Carry out supplier audits, incoming inspections, in-process inspections, installation and commissioning inspections using appropriate documentation and recording of inspection (FAT & SAT) and test results. • Identify and take appropriate action for nonconformity and corrective action. QC Reporting: • Prepare and deliver regular work reports. • Plan and manage work schedules to meet project deadlines. • Ensure the quality inspection status overview and Global List of Open Points (GLOP) are updated regularly. • Follow-ups with the subcontractor/concerned department(s) to close the open snags/non-conformities. Continuous Improvement: • Actively identify improvement opportunities and provide solutions for change. • Apply standard quality control tools such as histograms, control charts, cause and effect diagrams, Pareto analysis, scatter diagrams, and charts to present the case for change and improvement. What do I need to qualify for the role? • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering. • Minimum 6-8 years’ experience in Quality Controls in a Project-based environment. • Knowledge in steel fabrication & installation is a definitive edge. • A good understanding of SCADA/PLC systems is an advantage. • Knowledge of business functions and processes and ability to analyze key operational control requirements for the process. • Clear direction and decision-making to ensure controls are maintained. • Multicultural project teams and understand the values of controlled diplomacy and assertiveness to achieve objectives. • Hands-on experience in conducting data analysis and reporting statistics. • Diligence with great attention to detail, and good organizational skills. • Excellent English communication skills. Diversity & Inclusion Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success Team and help us guide and grow relationships with our customers across Middle East. Based in Saudi Arabia and working remotely, you will play a key role in ensuring the success and satisfaction of our users throughout their journey with Filigran. You will collaborate closely with support, engineering, and product teams to align technical delivery with business goals, while acting as a trusted advisor to our customers. 💼 Your Responsibilities • Own and manage the full customer journey: onboarding, adoption, training, and renewal • Deliver training and carry out missions for customers • Build strong, proactive relationships with customers across Middle East • Identify and support opportunities for upsell and cross-sell in partnership with Sales • Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer issues quickly and effectively • Collect and share customer feedback to improve product and service quality • Track success metrics and use data to inform customer strategy and engagement 🤝 Who You’ll Work With • You will report to the VP of Customer Success EMEA • Work closely with Customer Support Engineers (CSEs), Customer Platform Architects (CPAs), Sales, Product, and Engineering • Partner with regional teams to serve a diverse Middle East customer base • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure high customer satisfaction and retention 🧬 Profile We’re Looking For • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role in SaaS or tech • 3+ years of experience in the cybersecurity sector, especially threat intelligence • Fluent in Arabic and English • Based in Saudi Arabia with experience supporting regional customers in Middle East • Strong technical aptitude and ability to work with tools like OpenCTI or OpenAEV (training available) • Excellent communication skills and comfort working in English-first environments • Comfortable in a remote, async-first culture • Experience with CRM/CSM tools, customer journey tracking, and success metrics 🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company , and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation . You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem. ⭐ Be part of something bigger We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative. 💻 Work at the edge of what’s next We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice. 🌍 Global opportunity without borders Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us. 🧭 A culture grounded in CORE Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching. 💰 What you can expect • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen 🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture. At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status. What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify. 🚀 Ready to Join Us? Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

**About this role:**

The Account Executive is a field sales role responsible for client retention and growth. Account Executives build trust-based relationships with C-Level Executives and their teams. They understand the mission-critical priorities of their clients and ensure clients receive the value from the Gartner relationship that they expect, while also identifying opportunities for stronger value delivery with alternative product offerings.

Account Executives will be given a territory of Large Enterprise clients.

In our Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have ~+$1bil in annual revenue.

**What you will do:**

* Drive value delivery with current Gartner clients, ensuring clients maximize the value they receive from their Gartner services
    
* Identify, cultivate, qualify, and close client growth opportunities through cross-sell and upsell
    
* Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics, ensuring KPI’s are met
    
* Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.
    
* Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.
    
* Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.
    

**What you will need:**

* 5-8+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments
    
* Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives
    
* Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.
    
* Proven ability to own, manage, and forecast a complex sales process.
    
* Willingness to conduct travel as needed.
    
* Bachelor's degree preferred
    

**What you will get:**

* Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!
    
* Uncapped commission structure
    
* World-class sales training programs and skill development programs
    
* Annual "Winners Circle" event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers
    
* Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion
    
* Professional development and career growth opportunities

**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. Tech PMO (KSA, 6 Months)  

Team: Project Management Office

Reporting to: Head of Project Management Office  

  

About 9H

9H is a creative-tech company that builds the systems, brands and digital experiences that power modern businesses. We combine strategy, creativity and technology to turn ideas into real results, helping our clients work faster, smarter and with more confidence as they scale.

Headquartered in Malta (EU), with delivery and commercial teams across Europe, the Middle East and North Africa, we work with ambitious, forward-thinking clients across the region.

We're growing, and as we scale in Saudi Arabia through our partner agency TAYB, we're looking for strong delivery leads to be on the ground with our clients.

  

About the Role

As our Tech PMO, you'll take end-to-end ownership of client projects, from early concept and solution design through to launch and optimisation.

This is a full-time, six-month assignment based in Riyadh, working on site with our TAYB team and clients. You'll be the bridge between clients and production, translating business ambition into clear, executable plans for our development, UI/UX, SEO, content and studio teams, and making sure what we imagine actually gets built properly.

* Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (on site)
* Duration: 6 months, full time
* Start date: November / December 2026  
    

  

What You'll Do  

* Own client projects end to end, from scoping and solution design to launch, scale and optimisation
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients on delivery, scope, timelines and priorities
* Collaborate with central teams (SEO, Content, Development, Studio, UI/UX) to plan and deliver integrated digital solutions
* Translate business requirements into clear, structured tasks and briefs for production teams
* Manage project budgets, timelines, scope and delivery quality
* Identify risks, dependencies and bottlenecks early, and proactively resolve them
* Lead client conversations: advising, negotiating and guiding better outcomes
* Navigate change confidently in a fast-moving, high-contact environment
* Champion the work internally and take ownership of outcomes, not just deliverables
* Represent 9H, TAYB and our clients' brands with integrity and professionalism

  

What We're Looking For

* Minimum 3 years' experience as a Technical Project Owner or Tech Project Manager
* Proven experience in a digital, technology or delivery-focused agency
* Expert knowledge of website development and digital marketing projects
* Strong business and commercial acumen
* Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail
* Experience working in an agile environment
* Proficient in workflow management tools
* Strong presentation, communication and client management skills
* Fluent in English
* Eligible to work in Malta / the EU
* Available to relocate to Riyadh full time for six months

Nice to Have

* Previous experience working in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC
* Experience with CMS platforms, web applications or integrations
* Fluency in Arabic is beneficial

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Manage document control processes from project initiation through to close‑out, ensuring that all project documents are properly received, registered, tracked, updated and archived in accordance with project procedures and client requirements.

* Prepare, register and track documents such as correspondence, reports, payment requisitions, variation orders, site instructions, punch lists and NCRs within ACC or other EDMS, ensuring correct coding and referencing.
* Track and update the status of submittals, safety reports, RFCs, minutes of meetings, progress photographs, contract issues and drawings, ensuring that current approved versions are clearly identifiable and accessible to all authorized project stakeholders.
* Produce regular reports on outstanding actions and responses on correspondence, submittals and other controlled documents through ACC and other EDMS, providing timely information to project management and the client.
* Support project teams in the effective use of EDMS platforms (including ACC) by assisting with user setup, folder structures, permissions, workflows, document numbering and troubleshooting of document control issues.
* Ensure that document control practices comply with Parsons’ procedures, client requirements, contractual obligations and applicable quality management standards throughout the project lifecycle.
* Coordinate with internal project teams, external consultants, contractors and client representatives to manage document flows, resolve document discrepancies and maintain data integrity across all systems.
* Contribute to audits and quality reviews by providing accurate document registers, logs, histories and evidence of approvals, ensuring that records are complete and traceable for all project stages.

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring**

* Diploma or specialized training in document management systems or similar software.
* Minimum of 8 years’ experience in document control, with at least 4 years using EDMS on large‑scale projects.
* Proven **expert‑level experience in Aconex & Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)**, including set‑up and administration of projects, configuration of folders and permissions, management of submittals and RFIs, and control of design and construction documentation.
* Extensive experience in document control throughout the project lifecycle, from initiation to close‑out, using integrated project services functions.
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, with strong technical writing and communication skills.
* Proficient computer skills with experience in managing electronic documentation systems and data management applications.
* Preferably at least 3 years of experience working in the Gulf region.
* Ability to manage concurrent projects and handle large volumes of documentation in a structured and organized manner.
* Experience in producing detailed reports and tracking documents to ensure compliance and timely responses to project deadlines.

**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast‑paced project environment.
* Ability to work under pressure while maintaining high standards of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Problem‑solving skills to address and resolve document management issues promptly, including issues related to EDMS and ACC workflows.
* Experience with project management software and document management systems for seamless project documentation integration, including cloud‑based platforms such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).

Responsibilities

Quality Supervision: Supervise and coordinate QA/QC activities for the fabrication, assembly, inspection, repair, refurbishment, and testing of Top Drive, Catwalk, Casing Drive Systems, and other drilling equipment.

Inspection & Testing Oversight: Ensure receiving, in-process, final inspections, and Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) are performed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), procedures, and applicable industry standards.

QA/QC Team Management: Assign and monitor daily inspection activities, provide technical guidance to QA/QC Inspectors, review inspection results, and ensure timely completion of assigned quality activities.

Welding & Fabrication Quality: Review WPS, PQR, welder qualifications, material certificates, and related welding documentation. Ensure welding, fabrication, NDT, dimensional inspection, and associated activities comply with approved requirements and applicable codes and standards.

Non-Conformance Management: Review and coordinate Non-Conformance Reports (NCR), support root cause investigations and corrective actions, and verify implementation of approved dispositions. Escalate significant or recurring quality issues to Quality Management and Engineering as required.

Supplier & Subcontractor Quality: Coordinate supplier inspections, surveillance, first article inspections, audits, and qualification activities. Monitor supplier quality performance and support supplier development and corrective action activities.

Deviation & Technical Coordination: Coordinate with Engineering on material substitutions, deviations, concessions, repair dispositions, and technical clarifications. Ensure approved dispositions and technical requirements are properly implemented and documented.

Quality Documentation: Review and verify inspection reports, Inspection Release Notes (IRN), FAT records, NDT reports, material certificates, data books, Certificates of Conformance, and other quality documentation prior to product or equipment release.

Calibration Control: Ensure measuring, inspection, and test equipment used by the QA/QC team is suitable for the intended application, available when required, properly maintained, calibrated, and within its valid calibration period.

QMS & API Compliance: Ensure QA/QC activities are performed in accordance with the company Quality Management System, API Q1 requirements, applicable API specifications, internal procedures, engineering requirements, and customer specifications.

Audit Support: Support and participate in internal, customer, supplier, and API audits. Coordinate preparation and verification of relevant quality records, address assigned audit findings, and monitor corrective actions through closure.

Aftermarket & Operations Support: Provide QA/QC support for equipment repair, overhaul, servicing, field activities, aftermarket operations, warranty issues, and other quality-related matters involving drilling equipment and associated components.

Quality Reporting & Performance: Monitor inspection status, NCRs, supplier quality performance, corrective actions, quality issues, and assigned quality KPIs. Provide regular reports and updates to Quality Management.

Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve inspection practices, documentation, supplier performance, product quality, and QA/QC processes. Support lessons learned, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Authority & Escalation: Exercise appropriate authority within the assigned QA/QC scope to accept or reject work based on approved requirements, stop nonconforming work when necessary, initiate NCRs, and escalate unresolved or critical quality issues to the appropriate authority.

Company Policies & Quality Objectives: Perform assigned duties in accordance with the company’s policies, procedures, Quality Management System requirements, and established quality objectives.

Decision-Making & Collaboration: Exercise the necessary authority to make decisions within the defined scope of work, escalate issues as required, and collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Aftermarket, Sales, vendors, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure operational effectiveness.

Accountability: Be accountable for the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of assigned work and for reporting any nonconformities, risks, or concerns that may impact quality, legal or regulatory compliance, safety, environmental performance, or customer satisfaction.

QHSE Objectives: Support and participate in achieving the organization’s Quality, Health, Safety, and Environment (QHSE) objectives and continuous improvement initiatives.

Other Duties: Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Welding Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline.

Relevant certification in Welding Inspection, NDT, Quality Management, or API-related disciplines is preferred.

Knowledge of API Q1, applicable API product specifications, AWS/ASME requirements, and ISO 9001 principles is preferred.

SKILLS REQUIREMENTS
Strong knowledge of fabrication, welding, machining, assembly, inspection, testing, and repair of drilling equipment.

Ability to review engineering drawings, specifications, WPS/PQR, material certificates, NDT reports, ITPs, and quality documentation.

Good understanding of NCR, root cause analysis, corrective actions, supplier quality, and deviation control processes.

Strong leadership and supervisory skills with the ability to guide QA/QC Inspectors and coordinate quality activities.

Good communication and coordination skills for working with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, vendors, customers, and other stakeholders.

Proficient in technical reporting, documentation, and standard Microsoft Office applications.

Ability to make sound quality decisions, prioritize activities, and escalate critical quality issues when required.

EXPERIENCE LEVEL
Minimum 7–10 years of relevant QA/QC experience in manufacturing, fabrication, repair, or servicing of oilfield, drilling, or heavy mechanical equipment.

Minimum 2–3 years of supervisory or team-lead experience in a QA/QC environment is preferred.

Hands-on experience with welding inspection, dimensional inspection, material verification, NDT coordination, FAT, supplier inspection, and quality documentation.

Experience working in an OEM, oilfield equipment manufacturer, drilling equipment, or similar heavy-engineering environment is highly preferred.

Experience supporting API Q1 audits, supplier audits, customer inspections, NCR investigations, and corrective action activities is preferred.

Knowledge of coating systems and quality standards

Equipment operation and basic troubleshooting

Process monitoring and parameter control

Preventive maintenance awareness

Safety and environmental compliance

Attention to detail and quality focus

Problem-solving and analytical skills

Continuous improvement mindset

description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Director, Strategic Partnerships & Partner Sales, Saudi Arabia

Director, Strategic Partnerships & Partner Sales, Saudi Arabia  
  
Build Mastercard's partner-led growth engine in Saudi Arabia and turn strategic relationships into revenue.  
  
About the role  
Saudi Arabia is one of the world's fastest-moving digital economies, and partnerships are central to how Mastercard will grow there. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, commercially driven leader to build and scale our partner-led business in the Kingdom and support opportunities across West Arabia.  
In this market-facing role, you will create new routes to market and design partnership propositions that bring Mastercard capabilities to new customers. You will be responsible for taking opportunities from the first executive conversation to signed business. You will work with a broad ecosystem that includes AI and digital platforms, cloud and cybersecurity providers, telecommunications companies, system integrators, fintechs, data businesses, and marketing and media organizations.  
  
What you will do  
•Own growth: Lead the Saudi partner-sales strategy and deliver a revenue target through partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities.  
•Create opportunities: Identify where Mastercard capabilities can be embedded, co-sold, or distributed through partner platforms and services. Focus areas include AI, cybersecurity, identity, fraud and financial crime, data insights, loyalty, and digital commerce.  
•Shape propositions: Turn strategic discussions into clear use cases, target customers, and commercial models such as embedded, co-sell, reseller, referral, or joint-solution partnerships.  
•Engage at senior levels: Build trusted relationships with founders, C-suite executives, and senior decision-makers across enterprise, technology, and government ecosystems.  
•Drive execution: Lead joint business plans, account mapping, negotiations, and partner enablement to move opportunities from first engagement to first transaction.  
•Collaborate across Mastercard: Work with product, sales, legal, finance, marketing, and delivery teams across the region and globally to bring partnerships to market.  
•Scale what works: Turn successful use cases into repeatable commercial plays that can grow across Saudi Arabia and the wider region.  
  
What you will bring  
•Extensive experience in strategic partnerships, partner sales, business development, platform sales, or enterprise technology.  
•A proven record of originating and closing partner-led business while owning a commercial target.  
•Strong knowledge of the Saudi market and an established network across technology, digital, telecommunications, financial services, government, data, or media ecosystems.  
•Experience structuring partnerships and handling complex enterprise or government sales cycles.  
•An entrepreneurial mindset. You are comfortable with ambiguity and good at shaping an undefined opportunity into a viable proposition.  
•Strong commercial judgment in opportunity qualification, forecasting, negotiation, and partner economics.  
•Excellent communication and presentation skills, with fluency in Arabic and English.  
•A university degree or equivalent professional experience.  
We welcome candidates with non-traditional career paths, such as founders, platform leaders, and ecosystem builders, who can show equivalent commercial impact.  
  
Why join us  
This is a chance to shape how Mastercard grows with Saudi Arabia's technology, AI, data, and digital-transformation ecosystem in a market that is a key investment area for us. You will have the mandate to build new propositions, develop senior relationships, and turn partnerships into lasting business results, with the backing of a global organization.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
    
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
    
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
    
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
