**Title and Summary**

Director - Loyalty Customer Success Lead - West Arabia & Africa

Overview  
Mastercard’s Loyalty Solutions team is seeking a Director, Program Management (EEMEA) to lead post sale customer success delivery for a regional portfolio of issuers, merchants, and partners in the West Arabia and Africa Division. This role is accountable for helping customers realize measurable business outcomes through our loyalty, rewards, and customer engagement solutions—driving platform adoption, customer value, and long term growth.  
  
The Director will lead a team across the region supporting Rewards, Offers, and program operations and implementations, ensuring strong delivery quality and operational excellence across markets with varying levels of loyalty maturity. The role will partner closely with Sales, Product, and Delivery to influence key commercial and customer KPIs—including renewals, retention, ARR expansion, and NPS—and will build senior client relationships to maintain momentum, mitigate risk, and identify new value for customers and Mastercard.  
  
Success in this role requires deep expertise in digital marketing, loyalty best practices, and complex program management. Candidates with superior communication and collaboration skills are a must, as is the ability to align resources and solve complex problems in a matrixed environment.  
  
  
  
Role-Key Responsibilities  
• Drive Regional Adoption & Value: Define and execute customer success plans across the region to drive measurable improvements in engagement, retention, and program performance. Monitor KPIs and trends across the portfolio and coach team members to deliver insights and recommendations to clients.  
• Relationship Management: Serve as a senior point of contact for key accounts and engage as an account sponsor for select strategic clients. Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across Marketing, CRM, Loyalty, and executive teams to ensure alignment on objectives and value realization.  
• Strategic Guidance: Provide thought leadership and data-driven insights to shape client program roadmaps and regional best practices. Build feedback loops to bring market insights to Product, Sales, and Delivery teams to improve offerings and execution.  
• Program Governance: Establish and run portfolio governance, including business reviews, performance reporting, and customer health/risk management. Drive adoption of consistent, data-driven approaches to value tracking, issue escalation, and remediation plans.  
• Growth & Retention: Drive upsells, renewal readiness and retention outcomes across the portfolio. Partner with Sales and Account Management to support renewals and identify expansion/cross-sell opportunities. Contribute to forecasting and pipeline health by surfacing risks and value stories early.  
• Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing regional team through regular 1:1s, coaching plans, and timely performance feedback. Set clear goals and expectations, create growth opportunities, and reinforce consistent delivery standards and ways of working.  
About You  
• Experience  
o 8–10+ years in customer success, account management, program management, or consulting for enterprise SaaS  
o Strong experience with loyalty, CRM, marketing, or customer engagement programs, or related fintech solutions  
o Proven track record of hitting renewal targets, driving incremental value, and retaining long-term contracts  
o Expertise overseeing or closely partnering with operations, delivery, or similar functions in a complex cross-functional environment.  
• Skills  
o Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to link loyalty program success to financial and business outcomes.  
o Excellent executive communication and presentation skills  
o Highly analytical and comfortable using data to inform strategy and recommendations  
o Proven people leadership skills, including leading managers and/or senior individual contributors across multiple markets and influencing in a matrixed environment  
• Technical Knowledge  
o Familiarity with loyalty platforms, rewards ecosystems, CRM tools, and marketing and financial technology (APIs, integrations, etc.)  
o High degree of comfort working with analytics dashboards and translating insights into action  
• Attributes  
o Empathy and a strong ability to understand customer goals and needs  
o Strategic, proactive, outcomes-oriented  
Preferred Qualifications  
• Experience with loyalty program design and optimization.  
• Knowledge of data-driven marketing strategies.  
• Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, loyalty platforms, and analytics solutions.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
    
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
    
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
    
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Basic knowledge in computer codes related to site development design Understanding of the roles played by other departments on projects including basic construction practices and the economics involved. This role is at the heart of Cigna’s claims processing operation in the Middle East.  
Claims are received from both members and providers, and the position holder will be required to organize and track workflow daily to facilitate the consistent attainment of turnaround times and other critical success factors for Claims.  
  
The position holder will also be expected to respond to queries regarding claims and coming from multiple in-house and external sources; thereby freeing the Cigna Claims Team to focus exclusively upon attaining daily targets.  
  
The role will be required to be organized and efficient and accurate with strong interpersonal skills, and preferably an appreciation of medical terms.  


**Responsibilities**

* Take receipt of submitted claim batches from providers, and individual claims direct from members.
* Log and file claims received for tracking and planning and processing purposes.
* Scanning and imaging of hard-copy claims received.
* Operations planning; compiling processing schedules for the Claims Team.
* Assemble processing batches and assign to team members.
* Accepting finalized claims; updating status in systems and trackers as required.
* Reach out to providers and members; source additional information as needed to finalize claims.
* Resolve inbound queries from providers and members; maximize first time contact resolution.
* Regular claims status reporting, as specified.

**Qualification and Skills :**

* 1 years’ experience performing a similar role; combining administration and stakeholder contact.
* Experience of working for an international company, preferred but not essential.
* Previous claims or insurance experience preferred but not essential.
* Broad awareness of medical terminology, advantageous.
* Excellent organizational skills, capable of following and contributing to agreed procedure.
* Strong administration awareness and experience, essential.
* Strong skills in Microsoft Office applications, essential.
* First class written and verbal communication skills, essential.
* Ability to communicate across a diverse population, essential.
* Capable of working independently, or as part of a team.
* Good time management: ability to work to tight deadlines.
* Flexible and adaptable approach, sometimes working in a fast-paced environment.
* Passion for achieving agreed objectives.  
    

**What We Offer :**

* Hybrid mode
    

* Flexibly

## Job Description

\*\*Key Responsibilities:\*\*

* Perform comprehensive QAQC duties on fit-out projects under general supervision, with progressive independence based on experience and project requirements.
* Evaluate, select, and apply standard civil engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria to meet construction specifications and design requirements for fit-out installations, including structural elements, mechanical systems, and attraction-specific components.
* Exercise sound professional judgment in assessing work details, finishes, joinery, themed works, mock-ups, fabrication quality, steelwork, plinths, anchors, embedded items, and all fit-out deliverables against engineering standards.
* Independently conduct comprehensive walk-downs and inspections of installed fit-out commodities and structural elements to ensure conformance with specifications, design standards, and contractual requirements.
* Perform quantity surveys and material tracking for fit-out progress reporting and cost management purposes throughout all project phases.
* Document inspection findings, non-conformances, and corrective actions; prepare detailed quality reports for project stakeholders, design teams, and third-party ride inspectors specific to fit-out work.
* Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and design teams to resolve quality issues and ensure timely remediation of fit-out deficiencies and structural non-conformances.
* Verify testing and certification protocols for structural installations, safety systems, and attraction-specific fit-out components in compliance with applicable codes and standards.
* Oversee fit-out readiness activities and compile technical documentation required for third-party inspections and regulatory approvals.
* Provide technical direction and guidance to drafters, technicians, surveyors, and junior QAQC personnel on fit-out project requirements and civil engineering standards.
* Monitor fit-out project schedules and quality milestones to ensure adherence to timelines and quality benchmarks throughout all phases of the fit-out installation.
* Maintain detailed quality records, photographic documentation, and as-built records for fit-out project closeout and warranty purposes.

## Qualifications

\*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*

* Minimum 10 years of progressive QAQC, quality assurance, or quality control experience in construction, fit-out, or attraction installation projects
* Demonstrated expertise in evaluating and applying engineering techniques, procedures, and construction specifications
* Advanced knowledge of applicable building codes, safety standards, and regulatory requirements for structural installations and attraction-specific systems
* Proven experience conducting comprehensive inspections, walk-downs, and quality assessments of complex construction projects
* Strong proficiency in preparing detailed quality reports, non-conformance documentation, and technical specifications
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate effectively with contractors, consultants, design teams, and third-party inspectors
* Proven experience in quantity surveying, material tracking, and cost management documentation
* Advanced technical writing and documentation skills, including as-built records and photographic documentation
* Minimum 5 years of supervisory or mentoring experience with junior QAQC personnel, technicians, or drafting staff
* Proficiency with project scheduling software and quality management systems
* Strong understanding of testing, certification, and regulatory approval protocols

\*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related field
* Professional Engineer (PE) or Quality Engineer (CQE) certification
* Specialized experience with themed attractions, amusement parks, or hospitality fit-out projects
* Experience with third-party ride inspection and regulatory compliance processes
* Advanced proficiency with CAD software and project management tools
* Experience managing large-scale, multi-phase construction projects

* Proficiency in pressure testing, system flushing, TAB (Testing, Adjusting, and Balancing) procedures, and commissioning protocols
* Strong knowledge of mechanical engineering design standards, construction specifications, and industry best practices

Nalco Saudi Water University (NSWU) is a training program for fresh graduates with a bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering. The program is designed to select top graduates to develop their technical and personal skills necessary to obtain and pursue professional career path. We believe that strengthening our future starts by investing in newly qualified graduates and developing them for critical roles and helping them fulfill their potential. The duration of the program is 6 months: total training period is 12 month 6 month in class taring , 6 month in field training. The program will start in January 2027 at our main office in Dammam. During the Program, You Will: Follow a structured training plan focused on technical lessons, classroom interaction and hands-on field learning. Have significant interaction with subject matter experts in the field. Build key relationships and interact with our leaders. Have a Basic salary, Housing and Transportation Allowance. Medical coverage. What You Will Do: Provide on-site field service Conduct site surveys, product/application audits Inventory management of chemical delivery systems Collect samples for monitoring chemical programs Manage chemical deliveries to customers when and as needed Conduct field evaluation of new products Lead appropriate pre-trial or survey for site visits Interact with appropriate internal and external customers and resources Maintain accurate records based on information gathered during trials, surveys Prepare reports detailing problems and solutions to initiate necessary corrective product modification and/or recommend process changes Create troubleshooting service guides and bulletins on existing products Coordinate and manage sampling and inventory schedules Coordinate implementing solutions with customers Assist sales in preparing business proposals Participate in design reviews, new applications and start-ups evaluations Assist in critiquing products’ serviceability, performance and reliability Provide customers with expert technical service in all major applications Support and be committed to the team’s Quality Improvement Process Follow both company and customer safety regulations Solve a wide range of complex, multi-disciplinary problems which must consider short and intermediate need Position Details: Candidate must initially reside in Dammam area for 6 months near our Headquarters. During the training period the residence must in Dammam area. The candidate will be assigned to the job in the location he/she chose upon applying to the program. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or industrial Engineering is required. Capable of independently support assigned customer. Valid Driver’s License and acceptable Motor Vehicle Record. Required autonomy and self-motivation. Demonstrate a strong work ethic and ability to multi-task. Ability to interact with customer personnel successfully and professionally. Preferred Qualifications: Good Computer skills (including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint) Excellent problem-solving skills. Good verbal and writing skills required. Excellent communication skills required. Able to manage multiple projects. Complete work on time and on budget. About Nalco Water: In a world with increasing water shortage and contamination challenges, Nalco Water, an Ecolab company, helps customers conserve more than 161 billion gallons of water each year. We work with customers across the world in the light industry (institutional, food & beverage, transportation and manufacturing), heavy industry (chemical, power and primary metals industries), paper and mining operations to reduce, reuse, and recycle their water while protecting their systems and equipment. Nalco Water provides the unique opportunity to work with a broad suite of technologies to deliver automated monitoring systems, data analysis and deep technical expertise to increase efficiency, sustainability, and performance for our customers. **Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an exceptionally talented **QA/QC Engineer** to join our site team on a major public realm development in Diriyah, which includes a series of iconic and neighborhood parks, open spaces, and over 55 kilometers of streetscape. The objective of this program is to create a vibrant, inclusive environment that enhances livability, accessibility, and community well-being.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Review the Contractor's material submittals and obtain the required approvals according to the applicable standards and project specifications.
    
* Serves as the focal point for the scheduling and control of construction materials and equipment at the job site
    
* Conducts inspections to determine if work has been done in accordance with contract specifications.
    
* Coordinates work of subconsultants for material testing
    
* Maintains office files related to the project, material inspections and writes daily diaries.
    
* Prepares daily reports and other documentation, as required by the contract
    
* Verifies that only approved materials are incorporated in the work
    
* Recognizes potential conflicts, issues and problems on construction materials, and reports to supervisor with proposed solution
    
* Collects, reviews and files Certificate of Compliance, MSDS, inspection tags and other information relevant to the materials used.
    
* May provide technical guidance to lower-level
    
* Participates in the development of job safety practices and in the preparation of safety reports
    
* Participates in the development of quality control reports and procedures
    
* Capability to perform math calculation in order to prepare engineering calculations, graphs and charts
    
* Observe, check and record works execution is in accordance with approved methods
    
* Check material delivered are as approved and properly stored
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering.
    
* Minimum of 8 years engineering experience and a minimum of 5 years' experience as material engineer in the specific infrastructure projects.
    
* Experience in the operations and maintenance of roads, highway, bridges at domestic and/or foreign locations.
    
* Knowledge of English grammar and composition, the ability to communicate clearly both orally and in writing; to follow oral and written instructions, prepare written messages and simple charts and graphs.

# **LEAD Field Engineer**

**Do you like working in collaborative teams and solving technical problems?**

**Would you like to work in the field with our customers?**

**Join the LEAD Field Engineer Development Program**

The LEAD (Learn, Excel, Achieve, Develop) Field Engineer Development Program is a strategic, accelerated three and half year development program designed for recent engineering graduates seeking a career in Field Engineering. Through structured technical training, field experience, competency-based progression, coaching, and professional development, participants build the skills and experience required to perform in some of the most demanding operating environments in the energy industry. This program combines classroom learning, field execution, mentoring, and real-world customer operations to accelerate readiness for future technical and operational leadership opportunities.

  

# **Partner with the Best**

As a LEAD Field Engineer, you will develop technical expertise by working alongside experienced engineers while supporting critical customer operations around the world. You will progress through defined competency stages that build capability, confidence, leadership skills, and operational readiness.

Over the three-and-a-half-year program, you will:

* Participate in structured technical bootcamps, on-the-job training, and competency-based development
* Execute field operations alongside experienced engineers in live operating environments
* Deploy, operate, troubleshoot, and maintain technical equipment and services
* Apply procedures and make decisions in dynamic, high-pressure situations
* Support customers and field crews during critical operations
* Coordinate with operational teams, service delivery personnel, and customers to ensure successful execution of work
* Develop problem-solving skills through hands-on troubleshooting of mechanical, electrical, and system-level challenges
* Gain experience across multiple operational environments through travel and field assignments
* Participate in mentoring, job shadowing, cross-functional rotations, and developmental projects
* Progress through defined Field Engineer competency levels based on demonstrated capability, performance, and safety leadership
* Complete a capstone project and all required technical and professional milestones required for program graduation
* This role includes significant domestic and international travel, rotational schedules, non-standard work hours, and extended assignments at customer locations. Successful candidates must be comfortable working in unpredictable environments where safety, execution, and customer impact are paramount.

  

# **What You'll Gain**

The LEAD Program provides:

* Structured technical training and field coaching
* Hands-on experience supporting high-intensity customer operations
* Exposure to global operations and diverse working environments
* Mentorship from experienced technical leaders
* Competency-based career progression
* Visibility to senior leaders and cross-functional teams
* Professional development, leadership development, and project experience
* Clear career pathways following program graduation
* Graduation from LEAD signifies successful completion of all required technical, professional, and developmental milestones. Graduates become eligible for advancement opportunities across the organization based on performance, business needs, and available openings.

  

# **Fuel your passion**

To be successful in this role, you will:

* Have graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Engineering (all disciplines) within the previous 12 months
* Have achieved a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 on a scale of 4.0 (or equivalent)
* Be fluent in written and spoken English, with excellent communication skills
* Demonstrate a strong interest in hands-on technical work and field operations
* Be willing to travel extensively and work rotational schedules
* Thrive in dynamic, fast-paced, and sometimes unpredictable environments
* Possess strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills
* Demonstrate leadership potential, learning agility, and a strong safety mindset
* Be motivated to continuously develop technical expertise and professional capabilities
* Be legally entitled to work within the country in which you are applying without sponsorship or time restrictions.

About CSI Global:

At CSI Global, we specialize in delivering advanced electromechanical, testing, and commissioning services across the GCC and Globally. We power infrastructure through technical excellence and engineering innovation. Join a team committed to shaping the future of transmission and energy systems in the region.

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented MEP Procurement Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will lead the sourcing, evaluation, and purchasing of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) materials and equipment for our construction projects. You will act as the vital link between our engineering, estimation, and site management teams, ensuring that all procured materials meet strict technical standards, fit within budget constraints, and are delivered on time to keep our projects moving forward.

Key Responsibilities

• Sourcing & Supplier Management

• Identify, evaluate, and pre-qualify local and international vendors, manufacturers, and subcontractors for MEP materials.

• Maintain and update an active database of reliable suppliers and specialized contractors.

• Technical Evaluation & Submittals

• Review project drawings, Bill of Quantities (BOQs), specifications, and scope of work to understand material requirements.

• Prepare and compile detailed Material Submittal packages for consultant and client approval prior to procurement.

• Coordinate with site engineers and design teams to clarify technical discrepancies or suggest alternative materials.

• Tendering & Negotiation

• Prepare and issue comprehensive Requests for Quotation (RFQs) to shortlisted suppliers.

• Analyze commercial and technical offers, preparing clear cost-comparison sheets.

• Negotiate optimal prices, payment terms, delivery schedules, and warranties with vendors to maximize project profitability.

• Purchasing & Order Management

• Draft, review, and issue Purchase Orders (POs) and material supply contracts in alignment with company policies.

• Monitor and track manufacturing and shipping timelines, proactively resolving supply chain bottlenecks to prevent site delays.

• Oversee material delivery to the site, ensuring proper documentation (delivery notes, inspection certificates) is received and processed.

• Cost Control & Budgeting

• Monitor actual procurement expenses against project budgets and report variances to management.

• Identify opportunities for value engineering to reduce costs without compromising on quality or safety standards.

• Prepare, update, and maintain procurement trackers

• General

• Develop and implement procurement plans aligned with project schedules, budgets, specifications, and material requirements.

• Review BOQs, IFC drawings, specifications, and material take-offs to identify procurement priorities, long-lead items, and potential supply risks.

• Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and contract conditions to achieve cost savings and maximize value for the organization.

• Coordinate with Engineering, Project Management, Planning, QA/QC, Commercial, and Finance teams to ensure timely approvals, procurement execution, and material availability.

• Monitor supplier performance, logistics, and project procurement status, proactively mitigating risks, maintaining supplier evaluations, and providing regular procurement reports and dashboards to management.

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.

• Experience: Minimum of [5] years of proven experience in KSA as an MEP Procurement Engineer or a similar procurement role within the construction industry.

• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of MEP materials and systems (HVAC, Plumbing, Firefighting, Electrical, and Low-Voltage systems). Ability to accurately read and interpret construction drawings and BOQs.

• Soft Skills: Exceptional negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills to manage diverse vendor relationships.

• Software: Proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or MS Dynamics) and advanced MS Excel skills.

• Certifications: Professional supply chain or procurement certifications (e.g., CIPS, CSCP) are a plus but not mandatory.

* Ability to read and understand construction drawings, specifications, and project documents.
* Familiarity with BIM or document control systems is an advantage.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work effectively with multicultural project teams.
* Willingness to visit and work at the project site.
* Proactive attitude and ability to follow up on outstanding actions.
* Ability to work independently while supporting senior planning staff.

Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.

Located just minutes from Masjid Al Haram, Jumeirah Jabal Omar Makkah offers a seamless blend of comfort, connectivity, and Arabian hospitality in the heart of the Holy City. Spread across four towers, the hotel features a range of dining venues, retail outlets, a gym, executive lounge and meeting spaces. An opportunity has arisen for a Procurement Specialist – Procurement to join Jumeirah Jabal Omar.

Manage procurement activities for goods and services in line with operational requirements, approved budgets, and company policies.

The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
Previous experience in Procurement, Purchasing, Supply Chain, or a similar role is preferred.
Strong negotiation, sourcing, and supplier management skills.
Good organisational and analytical skills with strong attention to detail.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Good understanding of procurement compliance, internal controls, and approval procedures.
Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Proficient in English & Arabic (verbal & written).

About the Benefits
We offer an attractive salary, paid in Saudi Riyals (SAR), the local currency of the KSA.
In addition, we offer generous F&B benefits, reduced hotel rates across our properties globally, excellent leave and health care packages, flights home, and other employee benefits making the role attractive to high performers and any applicant looking for a career with one of the most luxurious brands in the hospitality industry.

Job Description

Join Our Engineering Team as an HVAC Technician at the First Vignette Collection in KSA!
We are looking for a skilled, professional, and experienced HVAC Technician to join the Engineering team at the First Vignette Collection in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Carlton Al Moaibed Hotel).
The HVAC Technician is responsible for maintaining, repairing, and troubleshooting air conditioning, ventilation, and refrigeration systems throughout the hotel while ensuring high standards of safety, efficiency, and guest comfort.
If you have strong technical skills and enjoy working in a dynamic hospitality environment, we invite you to join our team.
Primary Responsibilities:
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on HVAC and refrigeration systems.
• Inspect, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair air conditioning and ventilation equipment.
• Maintain and repair split AC units, package units, AHUs, FCUs, exhaust fans, and ventilation systems.
• Check compressors, condensers, evaporators, expansion valves, thermostats, sensors, and other HVAC components.
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration faults in HVAC equipment.
• Check refrigerant levels, pressure, temperature, and overall system performance.
• Perform refrigerant charging, recovery, and leak detection when required.
• Clean and maintain filters, coils, drain pans, air vents, and other HVAC components.
• Check and maintain condensate drainage systems to prevent water leakage and damage.
• Respond to guest room and hotel maintenance requests related to air conditioning and temperature control.
• Carry out emergency repairs and attend HVAC breakdowns as required.
• Ensure all HVAC equipment operates safely and efficiently according to manufacturer specifications.
• Conduct regular inspections of guest rooms, public areas, offices, back-of-house areas, and other hotel facilities.
• Record all maintenance activities, faults, repairs, and equipment conditions.
• Follow the preventive maintenance schedule and complete assigned tasks on time.
• Monitor the condition of HVAC equipment and report major faults or replacement requirements to the Engineering Supervisor or Chief Engineer.
• Maintain proper stock levels of HVAC spare parts, tools, and materials and report shortages when required.
• Use HVAC testing and diagnostic equipment correctly and safely.
• Maintain the HVAC workshop, tools, equipment, and work areas in a clean and organized condition.
• Follow all hotel engineering procedures, health & safety requirements, and environmental standards.
• Support the Engineering team with other maintenance activities when required.
• Assist with energy-saving initiatives and ensure HVAC systems operate efficiently.
• Coordinate with other departments to complete maintenance work with minimum disruption to hotel operations.
• Maintain a professional appearance and wear the hotel uniform correctly at all times.
• Perform any additional duties assigned by the Chief Engineer, Engineering Supervisor, or Engineering Management.
Requirements:
• Previous experience as an HVAC Technician or in a similar technical position is preferred.
• Previous experience in a hotel, commercial building, or facilities management environment is an advantage.
• Good knowledge of HVAC, air conditioning, ventilation, and refrigeration systems.
• Good knowledge of split AC, package units, AHU, FCU, exhaust fans, and ventilation systems.
• Good knowledge of compressors, condensers, evaporators, expansion valves, thermostats, sensors, and refrigerant systems.
• Ability to troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration faults.
• Knowledge of refrigerant charging, recovery, and leak detection.
• Ability to use HVAC tools and testing equipment, including pressure gauges, multimeters, thermometers, and other diagnostic tools.
• Good knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance procedures.
• Basic knowledge of electrical systems related to HVAC equipment.
• Good knowledge of HVAC safety procedures and safe handling of refrigerants.
• Ability to read basic technical drawings, equipment manuals, and HVAC diagrams.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality maintenance.
• Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced hotel environment.
• Good communication and teamwork skills.
• Ability to work under pressure and respond to emergency maintenance requests.
• Flexibility to work shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
• Ability to work in hot, cold, and confined areas and stand for long periods.
• Basic English communication skills are preferred.
• Technical diploma, vocational certificate, or relevant HVAC qualification is an advantage.

R-292443 Senior Managing Consultant, Services Business Development  
  
Marketing Solutions – Saudi Arabia, Riyadh

Our agile, global team develops and delivers end-to-end solutions for a diverse customer base. These capabilities include payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing solutions, Test & Learn experimentation, and data-driven insights and risk management services.

This is a commercial, client-facing role for someone who combines strong marketing expertise with the ability to originate, shape and close opportunities.  
  
The role holder will:  
\-Own and deliver ambitious revenue targets for marketing solutions across a portfolio of markets.  
\-Build and deepen senior relationships with CMOs, Heads of Marketing and wider business leadership at priority clients.  
\-Start from each client's business priorities and design integrated, outcome-led marketing and engagement solutions around them.  
\-Develop compelling value-based narratives, proposals and business cases.  
\-Partner with Product, Marketing & Communications, Account Management and other internal teams to shape and deliver client propositions.  
\-Scope and manage engagements end-to-end, working with Legal, Compliance and delivery partners to ensure high-quality execution.  
\-Use evidence, benchmarks and measurement to demonstrate client impact and return on investment.  
\-Share expertise with account teams to help identify and progress opportunities.  
\-Represent Mastercard Services at client workshops, industry events and market forums.  
\-Travel regularly across markets in the region.  
  
All About You  
  
Experience  
\-Proven commercial track record in client development across marketing, partnerships, media or experiential solutions, gained in an agency, media, partnership or senior in-house marketing role.  
\-Alternatively, a high-performing senior marketing leader from a bank or major consumer brand with a demonstrable record of building high-impact campaigns and partnerships.  
\-Established senior marketing relationships in the region; financial services experience is an advantage.  
\-Demonstrated ability to structure and close deals involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.  
\-Experience managing agencies and third-party partners, including negotiating commercial terms and holding them to delivery.  
\-Track record of delivering against ambitious targets.  
\-Experience of P&L or margin management is an advantage.  
  
Skills & Capabilities  
\-Broad fluency across the marketing mix with real depth in at least one area:  
\-Brand and integrated campaigns  
\-Performance marketing and digital best practice  
\-Customer acquisition and engagement  
\-Partnerships and co-marketing  
\-Campaign measurement and ROI  
\-Working knowledge of financial institutions and payments; deep payments expertise is desirable but not required.  
\-Commercially minded and entrepreneurial, with a strong bias for action.  
\-Outstanding storytelling and executive presence, with the ability to build compelling, value-oriented pitches for senior audiences.  
\-Excellent negotiation and influencing skills across complex stakeholder groups.  
\-Highly collaborative, able to work effectively in a matrix organization without direct authority.  
\-Organized and disciplined on pipeline, forecasting and deadlines.  
\-Fluency in English; Arabic is highly desirable.  
\-Willingness to travel regularly across the region.  
  
What Will Set You Apart  
\-You understand how marketing investment decisions are made in large organizations, ideally in financial services.  
\-You have built and scaled a portfolio, practice or partnership program.  
\-You bring a strong network of senior marketing leaders and partners across the GCC and wider region.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

****About the Job:****

The **Red Hat Consulting** team is looking for a **Cloud Architect** with **strong OpenShift** experience to join us in our Riyadh’s Office, KSA.

In this role, you will work as a **subject-matter expert** in Red Hat’s infrastructure and cloud technology.

You'll answer questions about best practices around **automation, reliability, scalability, maintainability, high availability, and failover setups** and lead the on-site delivery and implementation of Red Hat’s technology that delivers freedom, flexibility, and outstanding performance.

You will gain an understanding of our customers' infrastructures, and business issues and you will make recommendations appropriate to their environments. This is a great opportunity to build on your core base of knowledge and work in a fast-paced environment promoting Red Hat’s solutions.

**This position is open to Saudi nationals only.**

****What you will do:****

* Win the confidence of our customers through the successful delivery of **discovery, analysis and design** workshops that shape and influence the customer’s architecture design decisions to align with the Red Hat solution.

* Work closely with product business units, product engineering, consulting, support, and sales to ensure a world-class customer experience with Red Hat’s products.
    
* Contribute to the development of repeatable methodologies and tools designed to scale Red Hat’s services capabilities, promote repeatable customer engagements, and lower delivery risk.  
    
    

****What you will bring:****

* Prior experience working in **consulting and architecture** roles
    
* Good customer-facing skills; ability to present to customers and lead customer interactions
    
* Excellent knowledge of **infrastructure technologies** on hands-on delivery and architecture levels
    
* Experience implementing **virtualization and container** technologies in an enterprise setting and with enterprise-wide deployments
    
* Knowledge of Red Hat’s infrastructure solutions like **Red Hat OpenShift, Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)**
    
* Experience onboarding applications and application teams onto cloud or container platforms introducing DevOps, continuous delivery (CD) and application lifecycle management
    
* Excellent written and verbal language skills in English
    
* Willingness to **travel across the region up to 100%**
    

****The following is considered a plus:****

* Hand's on AI skills (models onboarding, LLM tunings, NVIDIA GPU and Networking). Architecting is a plus but can be learned on the job
    
* Red Hat Certifications are considered a plus
    
* Experience with **Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization** is considered a big plus
    

**About Red Hat**

[Red Hat](https://www.redhat.com/) is the world’s leading provider of enterprise [open source](https://www.redhat.com/en/about/open-source) software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

**Inclusion at Red Hat**  
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

If you need assistance completing our online job application, email [application-assistance@redhat.com](mailto:application-assistance@redhat.com). General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

  

We’re the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source solutions—including Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes. We deliver hardened solutions that make it easier for enterprises to work across platforms and environments, from the core datacenter to the network edge.

description:
Job Description

Senior Consultant, Program Management - AI Infrastructure Services
Today, every organization needs to be digital, powered by data, operating in a multi-cloud world and ready to adapt to whatever comes next. Our Consulting team assesses customers' strategic, organizational and business challenges, applying deep industry expertise to deliver technical solutions that enable business transformation, operational excellence and measurable outcomes.
Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Senior Consultant on our Professional Services team in Saudi Arabia.
What You'll Achieve
As a Senior Consultant, Program Manager within AI Infrastructure Services, you will lead the delivery of large-scale AI and Data Center transformation programs for some of Dell Technologies' most strategic customers globally. You will help customers optimize Data Center design, accelerate AI infrastructure deployments and realize business value through complex multi-site implementation programs.
Working across Dell Technologies' products, services and partner ecosystem, you will be accountable for the successful delivery of our most complex programs. You will define program governance, establish delivery frameworks, manage interdependencies across multiple workstreams and ensure alignment to customer objectives and business outcomes.
You will provide leadership and oversight throughout the program lifecycle, driving effective decision-making, managing risks and ensuring stakeholder alignment. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging with executive leadership and C-Suite stakeholders, using a data-driven approach to provide transparency, influence outcomes and drive successful program delivery.
This role will lead and manage the Program Office on behalf of Dell Technologies for some of our largest global customers.

You Will
Establish and lead program governance and delivery assurance practices to ensure high-quality project execution and customer outcomes.
Manage large, complex portfolios of projects and programs, ensuring delivery on time, within budget and in line with customer expectations.
Develop and manage RAID logs, change control processes, escalation management and executive reporting.
Act as the primary point of contact for executive and management communications across assigned programs.
Lead cross-functional, globally distributed teams spanning Dell Technologies, customer organizations and third-party partners.
Build trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders and executive sponsors.
Drive alignment across technical, operational and business teams to ensure successful implementation and realization of business value.
Provide coaching, mentoring and leadership to project and program teams.

Essential Requirements
Extensive experience leading large-scale programs and complex project delivery organizations with Program Management certifications (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, MSP or equivalent).
Proven track record delivering complex Data Center infrastructure and IT services programs across multiple customers, sites, geographies and workstreams.
Extensive hands-on Data Center infrastructure experience, including knowledge of: Power and cooling systems
Racks and physical infrastructure
Cabling and connectivity
Compute, storage and networking environments
Data Center operational readiness and deployment activities

Proven experience supporting the design, build, deployment, commissioning or expansion of enterprise, colocation, hyperscale or AI-focused Data Centers.
Strong understanding of AI infrastructure deployment and Data Center modernization initiatives.
Demonstrated success operating within complex matrix organizations and leading globally distributed teams.
Extensive experience presenting complex technical, operational and program delivery updates to C-Suite and senior executive stakeholders.
Strong commercial awareness and ability to manage delivery risks, stakeholder expectations and business outcomes.
Self-motivated, hands-on and capable of operating effectively under pressure while managing competing priorities.
Exceptional communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills across technical, operational and executive audiences.
Proven ability to operate independently while leading high-performing, cross-functional teams.
Experience working within global organizations and multinational customer environments.
Willingness and ability to travel extensively across EMEA during customer deployment and commissioning phases. The successful candidate should be comfortable spending extended periods on customer sites supporting Data Center implementation, operational readiness and infrastructure build activities.

Desirable Requirements
Proficiency in English and at least one additional European language is an advantage.

Who We Are

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.

Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy.

Visit our Culture Code page to learn more about how we work and lead.

The Fitness Instructor – Movement & Dance at Miraval The Red Sea brings rhythm, energy, and mindful movement to life through dynamic fitness and dance-based programming. This role is dedicated to delivering transformative, soul-nourishing guest experiences that fuse fitness and artistic expression. With a strong foundation in movement, the Instructor leads engaging classes and personal sessions that blend cardio, strength, and flexibility with the joy and release of dance.

As a core member of the fitness team, the Instructor contributes to innovative programming, inspires personal growth in guests and peers, and brings vibrant energy to every space they enter.

Key Responsibilities

Dance & Movement Instruction

• Lead a variety of dance-based classes (e.g., Zumba, Ballroom, Latin, contemporary, barre, intuitive dance, cardio dance, and mindful movement) tailored to a wide range of fitness levels and guest interests.

• Infuse each session with creativity, rhythm, and mindful awareness to help guests connect to their bodies and emotions through movement.

• Design dance-inspired fitness programs that enhance cardiovascular health, coordination, strength, and self-expression.

• Offer special classes and workshops that blend dance with mindfulness, cultural celebration, or emotional release.

Personal Training & Guest Connection

• Provide personalized training sessions with a focus on dance conditioning, mobility, and fitness goals.

• Incorporate breathwork, body awareness, and intentional movement into all sessions to support mind-body integration.

• Empower guests through movement, offering compassionate guidance and celebrating progress at every stage.

• Educate guests on safe alignment, injury prevention, and developing a joyful, sustainable movement practice.

Program Development & Wellness Integration

• Collaborate with the wellness, spa, and fitness teams to create integrated experiences (e.g., dance + sound healing, movement meditation, or spa & stretch).

• Contribute to seasonal programming, retreats, and signature Miraval experiences that showcase dance as a pathway to well-being.

• Stay current on global fitness and dance trends, continually refreshing the class schedule with new styles and innovative experiences.

Operational & Cultural Excellence

• Maintain studio cleanliness, music and fitness equipment, and class ambiance to ensure an elevated guest experience.

• Ensure all sessions meet safety standards, cultural sensitivities, and align with Saudi Arabia’s wellness regulations.

• Support guest assessments and progress tracking through mindful consultation and observation.

Revenue Generation & Guest Upselling:

• Actively and mindfully promote paid private sessions, group classes, spa and wellness programs , and exclusive events through outstanding guest engagement and personalized recommendations.

• Collaborate with the spa, wellness and retail teams to cross-sell relevant services and retail items .

• Deliver service with warmth, sincerity, and deep product knowledge, naturally encouraging guests to explore more of what Miraval has to offer.

• Contribute to departmental revenue goals by meeting personal upselling targets in an authentic and guest-centric way.

Safety & Risk Management:

• Conduct routine checks on all Fitness equipment to ensure proper function and cleanliness.

• Immediately report any equipment issues or hazards to management and take appropriate action to remove or replace compromised tools.

• Ensure all sessions follow proper health, safety, and sanitation protocols in line with Saudi Arabia’s regulations and Miraval’s standards .

• Guide guests through movements with careful attention to alignment, form, and modifications to prevent injury.

• Stay certified in CPR, First Aid, or other safety certifications as required by the resort.

Team Collaboration & Professional Growth

• Share expertise with other instructors and mentor team members in movement expression and class design.

• Engage in ongoing training, workshops, and professional development through Miraval’s continuous learning.

• Support resort-wide events and guest engagement through special performances, themed wellness weeks, and fitness showcases.

Marketing & Guest Engagement

• Collaborate with the marketing team to showcase dance programming through content creation, guest stories, and promotional features.

• Represent Miraval’s fitness philosophy at wellness events, online platforms, and within the broader well-being community.

• Gather and respond to guest feedback to evolve class offerings and maintain exceptional guest satisfaction.

• Certification in Group Fitness Instruction, Dance Fitness (e.g., Zumba, Barre, Latin, Ballroom or similar), and/or Personal Training (ACE, AFAA, NASM, ACSM, or equivalent).

• Minimum 1 year experience teaching dance-based fitness classes in a wellness retreat, resort, or studio environment.

• Strong foundation in at least one or more dance styles (e.g., Latin, contemporary, ballet, African, ballroom, hip-hop, or cultural dances).

• Additional certifications in Yoga, Barre, Functional Training, Somatics, or other fitness disciplines are a strong advantage.

• Experience incorporating mindfulness, somatic practices, or breathwork into fitness or dance sessions.

• Fluent in English (Arabic is a plus).

• Passionate, energetic, and committed to inspiring personal transformation through movement.

Skills & Abilities

• Charismatic, confident, and inclusive in leading both private sessions and group classes.

• Sensitive to diverse cultural and physical needs, with the ability to create a welcoming and safe space for all guests.

• Strong interpersonal and storytelling skills, using music and movement to inspire emotional and physical connection.

• Able to curate playlists and class experiences that align with Miraval’s serene yet uplifting atmosphere.

• Organized, dependable, and flexible with scheduling and programming needs.

• Embodies Miraval’s philosophy of mindfulness, presence, and transformative wellness in all interactions.

**Job Description:**

Parsons are looking for an exceptionally talented **Senior Risk Manager** to join their team!

  

The Senior Risk Manager will lead the identification, assessment, quantification, mitigation and monitoring of risks across the Giga Program, with specific responsibility for roads, civil infrastructure and structural works.

  

The role will provide strategic and operational risk leadership across the full program lifecycle, ensuring that risks are effectively managed, quantified, communicated and escalated. The successful candidate will work closely with design, procurement, commercial, construction, engineering, project controls and delivery teams to protect program objectives relating to cost, schedule, scope, quality, safety, compliance and stakeholder outcomes.

  

A key requirement of the role is demonstrated, hands-on experience in **quantitative cost and schedule risk analysis and contingency management** on major infrastructure, construction or capital investment programs.

  

## **What You'll Be Doing**

  

### 1\. Risk Management Leadership

* Develop, implement and maintain the program risk management strategy, framework, procedures and reporting requirements.
* Lead risk management activities across roads, civil infrastructure and structural works packages from concept and design through procurement, construction, testing and handover.
* Establish consistent risk management standards across consultants, contractors, designers and delivery partners.
* Ensure alignment with corporate, program and project-level risk management requirements.
* Provide expert advice to senior leadership on material risks, emerging threats, opportunities and recommended responses.
* Embed risk management into program governance, project controls, commercial management, change control and decision-making processes.
* Promote a proactive, transparent and “no surprises” risk culture across the program.

  

### 2\. Risk Identification and Assessment

* Facilitate risk identification workshops, reviews and interviews with project and functional teams.
* Identify threats and opportunities associated with: Highways, roads, bridges, tunnels and interchanges. Earthworks, retaining structures, drainage and utilities. Foundations, reinforced concrete, steelwork and other structural systems. Design development, constructability and technical interfaces. Land acquisition, permits, approvals and third-party dependencies. Supply chain, logistics, materials, labour and market conditions. Construction methodology, temporary works and site conditions. Interfaces between infrastructure, buildings, utilities, transport systems and other program assets.
* Assess risks using agreed probability, impact, proximity, velocity and confidence criteria.
* Review and challenge risk assessments prepared by project teams, consultants and contractors.
* Identify systemic, cumulative and interdependent risks across the program.
* Ensure risk assumptions, causes, consequences, owners, responses and due dates are clearly documented and maintained.

  

### 3\. Quantitative Cost and Schedule Risk Analysis

* Lead and deliver quantitative cost and schedule risk analysis across the program and relevant project packages.
* Develop, maintain and quality-assure quantitative risk models for cost, schedule and delivery risks.
* Undertake probabilistic cost risk analysis, including: Cost uncertainty and risk modelling. Risk-adjusted cost forecasting. Monte Carlo simulation. Sensitivity analysis. Correlation and risk-interdependency analysis. Confidence-level and percentile reporting. Assessment of estimate maturity and cost exposure.
* Undertake quantitative schedule risk analysis, including: Review of schedule quality, logic, constraints and assumptions. Critical-path and near-critical-path risk analysis. Activity duration and productivity risk assessment. Schedule risk modelling and Monte Carlo simulation. Probabilistic completion-date forecasting. Schedule confidence-level assessment. Identification of schedule contingency requirements.
* Translate quantitative risk results into clear recommendations for cost plans, schedules, funding decisions, delivery strategies and executive governance.
* Review and challenge the assumptions, data quality, correlations and modelling approaches used in quantitative risk analyses.
* Ensure quantitative risk analysis is updated at appropriate program and project milestones.

  

### 4\. Contingency, Reserves and Risk Allowance Management

* Develop, implement and maintain methodologies for cost and schedule contingency, risk allowances and management reserves.
* Establish appropriate contingency and reserve requirements based on quantified risk exposure, confidence levels, estimate maturity and schedule certainty.
* Review and challenge contingency included in estimates, schedules, contracts, delivery plans and contractor submissions.
* Recommend cost contingency, schedule contingency and management reserve requirements for governance and investment approval.
* Monitor contingency drawdown, consumption, transfers, approvals and remaining exposure throughout the program lifecycle.
* Assess whether contingency remains adequate as risks change, materialize, close or are transferred.
* Maintain clear reconciliation between the risk register, quantitative risk models, cost forecasts, schedules, contingency and management reserves.
* Identify emerging exposure that may require additional contingency, reallocation of reserves or management intervention.
* Report contingency position, usage, trends and residual exposure to program leadership and governance committees.
* Support the development of funding, investment and stage-gate submissions through quantified risk and contingency recommendations.

  

### 5\. Risk Response and Mitigation

* Work with risk owners to develop practical, measurable and time-bound mitigation and response plans.
* Monitor the effectiveness of risk responses and challenge overdue or ineffective actions.
* Support the implementation of risk avoidance, reduction, transfer, acceptance and exploitation strategies.
* Ensure risk responses are embedded into: Design decisions. Procurement strategies. Contract requirements. Construction methodologies. Baseline schedules. Cost plans and forecasts. Change control processes. Emergency and contingency plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve value, reduce cost, accelerate delivery and enhance constructability.
* Assess the residual exposure following implementation of mitigation actions.
* Ensure risk responses are reflected in quantitative models, forecasts, schedules and contingency requirements.

  

### 6\. Governance, Reporting and Escalation

* Maintain the program risk register, risk breakdown structure, risk matrix, risk database and risk taxonomy.
* Produce regular risk reports, dashboards and executive-level summaries.
* Prepare risk inputs for program reviews, investment committees, stage-gate approvals and board reporting.
* Report quantitative cost and schedule risk exposure, confidence levels, contingency requirements and reserve position.
* Escalate significant or deteriorating risks in accordance with the program governance framework.
* Track risk trends, exposure, mitigation performance, residual risk and contingency movements.
* Ensure clear ownership and accountability for all material risks.
* Coordinate risk reviews with schedule, cost, change, commercial, quality, health and safety and issue-management processes.
* Support audits, assurance reviews and independent assessments relating to risk management and program controls.
* Ensure risk reporting is accurate, timely, consistent and supported by appropriate evidence.

  

### 7\. Contract and Commercial Risk

* Support procurement and commercial teams in identifying and managing risks during tendering and contract execution.
* Review risk allocation within contracts and advise on appropriate ownership and mitigation.
* Assess contractor and supplier risk registers, assumptions, exclusions, qualifications and contingency provisions.
* Review contractor cost and schedule risk analyses and challenge the basis of submitted allowances.
* Monitor risks associated with claims, disputes, variations, delay, disruption, acceleration and performance.
* Support the development of risk-based commercial strategies and negotiation positions.
* Ensure risks transferred to contractors or suppliers are properly defined, priced, monitored and managed.
* Assess whether transferred risks remain appropriately allocated and whether residual program exposure has been recognized.
* Review the impact of commercial events on cost forecasts, schedules, contingency and management reserves.

  

### 8\. Stakeholder and Interface Management

* Build effective relationships with program directors, project managers, engineering leads, commercial managers, planners, contractors and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate risk management across multiple work packages and delivery organizations.
* Manage risks arising from interfaces between roads, civil works, structures, utilities, buildings and operational systems.
* Facilitate risk escalation and resolution across organizational and contractual boundaries.
* Communicate complex quantitative analysis clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Promote consistent understanding of cost, schedule, contingency and risk exposure across the program.

  

### 9\. Team Leadership and Capability Building

* Lead, coach and develop risk professionals and project team members.
* Establish risk management competency requirements across the program.
* Deliver risk training, guidance and awareness sessions.
* Promote consistent use of risk tools, terminology, processes, quantitative methods and reporting.
* Encourage early identification of risks and constructive challenge of assumptions.
* Build capability in quantitative cost risk analysis, schedule risk analysis and contingency management.
* Establish quality standards for risk models, assumptions, data, outputs and governance submissions.

  

# **What Required Skills You'll Bring;**

  

## Essential Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, project management, risk management, quantity surveying, finance or a related discipline.
* Minimum 15 years Risk Management Experience
* Professional qualification or certification in risk management, such as PMI-RMP, IRM, APM Risk Certificate, RIMS-CRMP or equivalent.
* Recognized project or program management certification, such as PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent, is desirable.
* Membership of a relevant professional body is desirable.

  

## Mandatory Experience

* Significant experience in risk management on major infrastructure, construction or capital investment programs.
* Experience managing risks associated with roads, highways, bridges, tunnels, earthworks, utilities, civil infrastructure and structural works.
* Experience working within complex, multi-project, major capital investment or giga-scale programs.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading and delivering quantitative cost risk analysis.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading and delivering quantitative schedule risk analysis.
* Demonstrated experience developing, reviewing and managing cost and schedule contingency, management reserves and risk allowances**.**
* Experience establishing contingency and reserve requirements based on quantified risk exposure, confidence levels, estimate maturity and schedule certainty.
* Experience monitoring contingency drawdown, consumption, transfers, approvals, remaining exposure and reforecasting requirements.
* Experience integrating risk registers, quantitative risk models, cost forecasts, schedules, contingency and management reserves.
* Experience translating quantified risk exposure into contingency recommendations, management actions, investment decisions and executive-level reporting.
* Experience with design, procurement, contracting and construction delivery risks.
* Experience managing contractor, consultant and supply-chain risk.
* Experience reviewing contractor and supplier risk registers, assumptions, exclusions, risk pricing and contingency provisions.
* Experience in risk governance, executive reporting and senior stakeholder engagement.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary risk workshops.
* Experience using risk management, quantitative risk analysis and reporting tools.

  

## Desirable Experience

* Experience on major transportation, urban development, industrial, tourism, energy or mixed-use infrastructure programs.
* Experience in a client-side, program management consultant or major contractor environment.
* Experience with FIDIC, NEC, EPC, design-and-build or other major infrastructure contracting models.
* Experience designing enterprise-wide or portfolio-level contingency and reserve methodologies.
* Experience integrating risk management with enterprise project controls, investment governance, funding approvals and assurance processes.
* Experience working in a rapidly changing or developing program environment.
* Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, @RISK, Safran, Primavera Risk Analysis, Acumen, Oracle Primavera Cloud, Power BI or equivalent tools.

  

## Knowledge and Technical Skills

* Strong understanding of infrastructure design and construction processes.
* Good knowledge of road, civil and structural engineering interfaces.
* Understanding of geotechnical, environmental, utilities, temporary works and constructability risks.
* Strong knowledge of project controls, including cost, schedule, change, forecasting and earned value principles.
* Advanced ability to perform, review, interpret and communicate quantitative cost and schedule risk analysis.
* Strong understanding of cost and schedule contingency, management reserves and risk allowances.
* Ability to assess the adequacy of risk models, assumptions, data quality and analysis outputs.
* Ability to translate technical and quantitative risk information into clear business and program-level impacts.
* Ability to understand complex technical information and communicate it to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong report-writing, presentation and data-analysis skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, risk management systems, quantitative risk tools and dashboarding platforms.
* Strong understanding of risk governance, escalation, assurance and decision-making principles.
* Ability to build and maintain effective relationships across technical, commercial, delivery and executive teams.
* Commitment to developing a proactive and embedded risk management culture.

In this role, you will oversee the end-to-end supply chain process, working closely with suppliers, co-packers, warehouse teams, and logistics partners to ensure smooth production planning, timely replenishment, and efficient inbound and outbound operations. * Track material consumption against production plans and identify discrepancies, unusual usage patterns, or potential supply risks.
* Maintain accurate inventory and procurement records, ensuring stock movements, purchase orders, and material requirements are properly documented.
* Monitor supply chain performance, identify opportunities to improve forecasting accuracy, inventory efficiency, and procurement processes, and flag potential operational risks.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in supply chain management, procurement and inventory control.
* Previous experience in FMCG, food and beverage (F&B), beverage production, or manufacturing is highly preferred.
* Hands-on experience with demand forecasting, production planning, inventory management, and replenishment.
* Strong understanding of raw material and packaging procurement, supplier management, and purchase order processes.
* Experience monitoring stock levels, material consumption, stock cover, expiry dates, and reorder requirements.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with suppliers, co-packers, warehouse teams, and logistics partners.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret inventory data, identify supply risks, and support data-driven planning decisions.
* Good commercial awareness, including supplier negotiations, cost control, and procurement efficiency.
* Comfortable working with inventory management systems, ERP platforms, spreadsheets, or similar supply chain tools.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills, with strong English proficiency; Arabic is an advantage.
* Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to anticipate material shortages, manage replenishment needs, and maintain continuity of supply.

In this role you will be **responsible for the administration and management of assigned construction contracts throughout the contract lifecycle, including pre-award support, post-award contract administration, contract compliance, contractual correspondence, changes, extensions of time, claims, certifications, contractor performance, and contract closeout.**

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

  

* Administer assigned construction contracts in accordance with the Contract, approved procedures, policies, specifications, and applicable laws and regulations.
* Monitor contractual obligations, milestones, notices, deliverables, key contractual dates, and other requirements throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Review, prepare, and/or coordinate contractual correspondence, notices, letters, instructions, and other contract administration documents.
* Provide contractual advice and recommendations to Project Managers, construction teams, and management regarding contractual rights, obligations, risks, and available contractual actions.
* Review and process Contract Change Orders/Modifications in accordance with applicable procedures, including review of scope changes, quantities, rates, cost implications, supporting documentation, and time impacts.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Finance, Planning, Legal, Procurement, and other stakeholders in the review and processing of contractual changes and related submissions.
* Review and administer Extension of Time requests and related contractual submissions, including coordination with Project Management regarding delay analysis, critical path, and time impacts.
* Review contractor claims and contractual submissions, assess contractual entitlement based on the Contract and available supporting records, and provide recommendations for management consideration.
* Support the administration and resolution of contractual disputes and potential claims, including preparation and maintenance of relevant contractual records and documentation.
* Administer contractual procedures related to Final Acceptance and other contractual certificates, and final contractual obligations, outstanding claims, warranties, guarantees, final account matters, and completion of required contract records.
* Coordinate with Project Management, Engineering, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure contractual requirements for acceptance and completion are satisfied.
* Monitor contractor compliance with contractual obligations and support contractor performance evaluation and related contractual actions.
* Identify and communicate contractual risks, non-compliance, potential exposure, and outstanding contractual obligations to the appropriate management level.
* Maintain accurate and complete contract administration records, registers, correspondence, approvals,change history, claims, certifications, and other contractual documentation.
* Prepare and/or assist in preparing contractual reports, management summaries, presentations, and recommendations relating to assigned contracts.
* Participate in the selection, training, development, and evaluation of personnel, where assigned.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

  

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Law, or another related discipline.
* Minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience in construction contract administration, including administration of large-value infrastructure, building, or other major construction contracts.
* Relevant experience should include construction contract administration, contractual correspondence,Contract Change Orders/Modifications, Extensions of Time, claims, certifications, contractor performance,contract interpretation, and contract closeout.
* Must be fluent in Arabic and English, including writing, reading, and speaking, with the ability to effectively communicate contractual matters.
* Must have strong contractual writing, analytical, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
* Must be computer literate and proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including MS Word, MS Excel, andMS PowerPoint, as well as relevant contract administration, document management, and analytical systems.

  

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

  

* Experience with public-sector or government construction contracts and applicable procurement laws, regulations, policies, and procedures is preferred.
* Experience in tendering, bid evaluation, contract formation, and negotiation is desirable.

Support, maintain, and secure the IT infrastructure of the card personalization facility (servers, network, data center, workstations, and production systems), ensuring high availability and full compliance with PCI Card Production security requirements and Payment Scheme rules.

  

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide first- and second-level support for servers, network devices, workstations, printers, and production\[1\]

* Maintain backups and test restore procedures regularly.

* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers for hardware, warranty, and support.
* Support internal and external audits (PCI, Payment Schemes, ISO) by providing evidence and closing findings.

  

**WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* 3–5 years of experience in IT infrastructure support.
* Experience in a PCI, banking, or secure manufacturing environment is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux, networking (TCP/IP, VLAN, routing), and firewalls.

  

**QUALIFICATION, CERTIFICATION & EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Networking, or equivalent.
* Certifications preferred: CCNA, MCSA/MCSE, CompTIA Security+

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

* Knowledge of PCI CP, or ISO 27001 requirements.
* Familiarity with virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), backup solutions, and monitoring tools.
* Vulnerability management and patching experience.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and attention to detail.
* Good English and Arabic communication skills.
* Integrity, security awareness, and teamwork.
