description:
من نحن
نحن الشريك الرائد في قطاع السلع الكمالية في الشرق الأوسط، إذ نمتلك أكثر من 600 متجرًا بالإضافة إلى 300 علامةً تجارية، ولدينا خبرة تتجاوز 65 عامًا في المنطقة - ممّا جعلنا طرفًا رئيسيًا في قطاعات الجمال والموضة والهدايا من خلال تقديمنا لخدماتٍ مميّزة لشركائنا وتَمَكننا من ابهاج جميع عملائنا. إنّنا نتحوّل بسرعة من مؤسسة توزيع وتجارة تقليدية تبيع السلع الكمالية بالتجزئة في الشرق الأوسط إلى مؤسسة تجارية هجينة للبيع بالتجزئة تجعل تجربة المنتجات الفاخرة في متناول عملائنا في كلّ مكان.
ولدعم المرحلة القادمة من نموّنا، فإنّنا نهدف إلى بناء فريقٍ عمل ذات مواصفاتٍ عالمية، وإلى توظيف التكنولوجيا والبيانات في التطوير المستمر لكلّ جانبٍ من عملياتنا، ابتداءً من التجزئة التقليدية حتّى سلسلة الإمداد وولاء العملاء. ولهذا، فإنّنا نبحث عن أصحاب أفضل المواهب والقدرات للانضمام إلينا في رحلتنا لاستكشاف آفاقٍ جديدةٍ معًا.
مهامك الوظيفية
في شلهوب نحن نُعبّر عن كل ما هو استثنائي ومتفرّد. وستكون مسؤولًا خلال عملك كمستشار للموضة عن تحقيق أهداف المبيعات الفردية والإجمالية مع تقديمك تجربة استثنائية للضيوف وحرصك على تقديم الدعم في إدارة علاقات العملاء وتجارب العملاء وغيرها من المبادرات الرئيسية المتعلّقة بالعملاء والموظفين في المتجر. ومن خلال وظيفتك نتوقع منك أداء المهام التالية:
· العمل على جمع البيانات حول سلوك العملاء وأكثر المنتجات مبيعًا وأقلها مبيعًا، وهو ما سيُشكّل مكوّنًا رئيسيًا في مراجعات سير أمور العمل.
· تعزيز العلاقات مع العملاء من خلال نهج شامل ومتعدّد القنوات.
· تقديم ملاحظات ومعلومات بخصوص المنتج للعميل قبل عملية الشراء.
· تعزيز مؤشر قياس ولاء الموظفين من خلال مبادرات وثقافة وخبرات الموظفين.
· التأكّد من الالتزام بإرشادات التجارة المرئية وإجراءات التشغيل القياسية.
· التأكّد من إجراء عملية الشراء الإلكتروني ثم الاستلام من المتجر طبقًا لاتفاقيات مستوى الخدمة.
· التأكّد من الحصول على بيانات العملاء طبقًا لمتطلبات فريق التسويق.
· الترويج لبرنامج ولاء العملاء (MUSE) والبقاء على اطلاع على عروض التطبيقات الإلكترونية وما إلى ذلك.
· تقديم الدعم فيما يتعلّق بفعاليات التسويق داخل المتجر.
· مواكبة جميع أنشطة وحملات وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي الخاصة بعلامتنا التجارية.
· تعزيز المبيعات داخل المتجر.
· دعم مبادرات تجربة العملاء في المتجر.
· إيصال الملاحظات بخصوص الأمور الناجعة وغير الناجعة داخل المتجر.

مقوّمات نجاحك
· يُفضّل وجود خبرة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء مع علامات تجارية مختصة ببيع السلع الكمالية بالتجزئة.

ما يُمكننا تقديمه لك
ستُحوّل طموحاتك معنا إلى حقيقة. وسنُساعدك على تصميم رحلتك العملية من خلال التجارب الغنيّة وفرص التعلّم والتطوّر والتعامل مع المهام المختلفة في إطار دورك أو من خلال تنقلك الداخلي. حيث توفِّر مجموعتنا كلّ يوم مساراتٍ مهنية متنوعة للأشخاص الاستثنائيين.
إنّنا نُقدّر القيمة التي تُضيفها لنا، ونسعى إلى تقديم حزمة مزايا تنافسية تشمل الرعاية الصحيّة والمساهمة في تعليم الأطفال وسياسات العمل عن بعد وسياسات عمل مرنة، بالإضافة إلى خصومات حصرية للموظفين. لاستعراض جميع مزايانا وخصائصنا اضغط هنا
دعوة لجميع المرشحين للتّقديم!
نؤمن بأن إلهام عملائنا ومنحهم البهجة والسعادة يعتمد في المقام الأول على التنوّع؛ التنوع الفكري والثقافي والاختلاف البنّاء في القدرات ووجهات النظر. وعليه، تلتزم مجموعة شلهوب بمبادئ الشمول والتنوّع في كل ما تقوم به.
نُرحّب بجميع المرشحين لتقديم طلب توظيف ليصبحوا جزءًا من مستقبلنا المشرق. ندرس جميع الطلبات من منظور قائم على الاستحقاق وتكافؤ الفرص، بغض النظر عن الجنس أو العمر أو العرق أو الديانة أو الأصل، مع حرصنا الدائم على الاستفادة من كفاءات أصحاب الهمم.

**INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.  

**What you'll be doing**

At Chalhoub we express the exceptional! As a Fashion Consultant you will be responsible for achieving individual and collective sales targets while delivering exceptional Guest Experience; and ensuring support in the implementation of CRM, CX and other key customer and people initiatives in-store. You will collect data on customer behaviour, top sellers, slow movers which will be key input for business reviews Drive client relationships within an omni-channel approach Provide pre-buying feedback on products Drive eNPS through people experience initiatives and culture Ensure adherence to VM guidelines and Standard operating procedures (SOPs) Ensure click and collect are conducted within SLAs (Service-level agreement) Ensure customer data is properly captured in adherence to marketing team requirements Promote loyalty program (MUSE) and stay up-to-date with app offerings etc.. Support with in-store marketing events and activations Keep abreast of all brand social media activities and campaigns Drive sell-throughs within the store Support in-store CX initiatives Provide input to what’s working well/what’s not working well within the store.

**What you'll be doing**

The role is responsible for managing the organization’s retail property portfolio, including site selection, lease negotiations, budget analysis, store openings, and uploading leasing contracts to government platforms.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

**Organizational:**

Follow all relevant Division policies, processes and standard operating procedures so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.

Operational:

Follow the day-to-day activities related to own job with minimal supervision to ensure continuity of work.

**Planning:**

Prepare and implement leasing plans and leasing tactics to exploit the current market supply (malls) and generate future locations for retail network outlets.

Prepare a target list of prospective locations suitable for the type of outlets required for the business.

Prepare mall profile and perform due diligence on prospective locations as appropriate.

Negotiate and finalize lease terms in line with prevailing business guidelines, budgets, and any other conditions required by the business.

**Legal:**

Ensure that all documentation is correctly prepared and is signed by the authorized stakeholders.

Maintain awareness of local legal procedures and practices, ensuring they are upheld and/or not contradicted in lease terms.

Ensure that lease agreements are renewed in time and changes in terms and condition or rentals are correctly recorded.

**Financial Analysis and Reporting:**

Prepare progress reports on weekly/monthly/annual basis as appropriate, on the current status of the business; provide comments on the assessment of future market trends and prospects and propose measures and strategies to achieve or exceed the projected target.

Evaluate historical performance, and market information on future market trends, to arrive at a rational budget projection both in terms of units and revenue so as to contribute effectively to meeting company's overall objectives set for the year.

Review the actual performance against budget on a regular basis to ensure that projected units and revenue targets are being achieved. In case of a short fall, examine the reasons and take corrective measures to bring it back on target.

**Marketing:**

Undertake Marketing Initiatives as applicable to the portfolio including competition database and new marketing strategy that is within the budget, not exhaustive and reviewed and updated as necessary.

**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**

You as a Category Specialist you will be part of Hitachi Energy business based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. Implement and adhere to Supply Chain SCM) strategies and processes, and follow-ups in factories to ensure material availability, delivery performance, and cost competitiveness. Lead the procurement process for defined material groups, achieving timely availability, cost savings, quality, and service level objectives. Support the development and implementation of regional/global, and manage supplier performance to secure quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability.

  

**How you’ll make an impact**

  

* SCM Practice Implementation and support the implementation, maintenance, and compliance of SCM practices, such as Strategic Sourcing, Process & Excellence, Risk Management, Supply Base Management & Quality.
* Design and implement plans for local sources to reach business targets. Support regional and global sourcing initiatives as required.
* Drive the implementation of global SCM initiatives and monitor performance and global SCM Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Supplier / Material Identification and selection and support the development and implementation of regional/global sourcing strategies in alignment with regional/global Category Managers.
* Develop SCM sourcing concepts, including number and type of suppliers needed, make-or-buy comparisons, cost scenarios, and new materials.
* Share sourcing concepts with relevant stakeholders, agree on actions, responsibilities, and deadlines.
* Work with Category Managers and Supplier Quality Engineers for supplier selection.
* Identify the need for new supplier developments for critical materials.
* Coordinate and implement sourcing strategies to identify, analyze, evaluate, audit, and monitor suppliers.
* Conduct all SCM activities for goods and services in accordance with policies and procedures.
* Contract management and adapt the corporate contractual framework to local business needs.
* Recommend frame agreements to management and execute upon approval.
* Bid and Proposal support bid and proposal teams by providing relevant market information.
* Strategic sourcing activities and Plan, initialize, and monitor strategic sourcing activities for projects, new product developments, early involvement of key suppliers, and design to cost aspects.
* Leverage the Continuous Improvement Process Sourcing (CIPS) process, Initiate and improve operational Excellence & Supplier Performance.
* Manage Supplier Performance Evaluation (SPE) results and cost targets in new developments.
* Supplier Relationship Management and managing relationships with key suppliers to ensure timely delivery, quality, and compliance with contractual terms.
* Oversee supplier performance (on-time delivery, quality, lead time) and resolve performance issues.
* Internal Stakeholder Collaborate with internal stakeholders such as engineering, planning, and fulfillment to secure material availability in production. Apply standards on health, safety, environment, and business ethics within operational work, contract management, and negotiations.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

  

**Your background**

  

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, or Supply Chain Management, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum 10 years of working experience in Engineering, Purchasing, and Supply Chain Management.
* Collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills.
* Results orientation with proven implementation skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to influence and persuade.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently daily.
* Compliance and ethics oriented.
* Flexibility to travel up to 15%.
* Preferred: CPSM or PMP certifications, SAP Experience, Documentation Management Systems, Power BI, and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

description:
Role overview

The Cloud Presales Associate supports and grows InnovationTeam's cloud opportunities in KSA. The role runs discovery and assessments, prepares solution outlines and funding requests, and engages new prospects to build the cloud pipeline. It sits in the Cloud team and works on cloud opportunities across AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Alibaba Cloud.

* Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
* Level: Entry level (1+ year of experience)
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Nationality: Saudi national (Saudization program)
* Languages: Arabic and English, spoken and written

**Requirements**

**Presales and discovery**

* Run discovery sessions to understand the customer's current infrastructure, workloads and cloud plans.
* Deliver cloud assessments and position InnovationTeam's funded assessment offer as the first step with the customer.
* Prepare high-level solution outlines and cost estimates using hyperscaler pricing calculators.
* Support proposals, customer presentations and technical answers in RFPs for Cloud business opportunities.

**Funding programs**

* Identify which opportunities qualify for hyperscaler funding programs, such as AWS MAP, Google Cloud RaMP and Microsoft Azure Migrate and Modernize.
* Prepare the information needed for funding requests and work with the partnership team to submit them.

* Engage target accounts by phone, LinkedIn and email to generate new cloud opportunities.
* Research target accounts to find cloud buying signals, such as data center refresh, digital transformation plans or new regulatory requirements.
* Qualify opportunities by budget, decision maker, need and timeline.
* Book discovery meetings with qualified prospects.
* Support cloud events, webinars and joint campaigns with AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft and Alibaba Cloud, and follow up on attendees.

**Hyperscaler co-sell**

* Register opportunities in partner portals, such as AWS ACE and Google Cloud Partner Advantage.
* Coordinate with hyperscaler account managers and partner sales managers on shared opportunities.

**Reporting**

* Log all activities, contacts and opportunities in the company CRM under the Cloud business line.
* Report weekly on prospects engaged, meetings held, assessments delivered and pipeline created.

Required qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business or a related field.
* At least 1 year of experience in presales, sales, cloud or IT services.
* Trained or previously employed through an AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure program, such as AWS re/Start, Google Cloud training programs, Microsoft training programs, or work at a hyperscaler or one of its partners.

* AWS Accepted certifications (examples): AWS Partner: Sales Accreditation (Business), AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
* Google Cloud Accepted certifications (examples): Google Cloud Digital Leader, Google Cloud partner sales credentials

* Fluent English
* Comfortable reaching out to new prospects by phone, email and LinkedIn.

* Experience using a CRM (such as HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho CRM) and prospecting tools (such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or Lusha).
* Experience with hyperscaler partner portals, such as AWS Partner Central (ACE) or Google Cloud Partner Advantage.

job_title: Manager of Governance & Board Affairs (Healthcare Experience Require) 50013029
description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

The Manager, Governance and Board Affairs acts as QHC’s primary coordinator for board governance, committee administration and governance documentation, working, in coordination with the QIC General Secretariat Office. The, Director role ensures that Board, Board Committees, Medical Advisory Committee (MAC),and other senior leadership governance processes are well planned, properly documented, timely and aligned with applicable governance requirements.

The role establishes and maintains disciplined governance routines, including forward calendars, agendas, board packs, minutes, resolutions, decision logs, action trackers and escalation processes. It supports effective decision-making by ensuring that matters submitted for approval are complete, accurate, appropriately reviewed and supported by the required stakeholder inputs.  The position works closely with the CEO / MD, executive leadership, QIC as shareholder, Legal, Compliance, Finance and other relevant functions to maintain clear governance interfaces, safeguard confidential information and promote consistent reporting to the Board and its committees.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**1.  Board & Committee Secretariat Coordination**

•   Coordinate, in collaboration with the QIC General Secretariat Office, the annual governance calendar, meeting schedules, agendas, board and committee papers and related follow-up for the Board and its committees.

•   Prepare, circulate and safeguard board and committee packs, ensuring timely, high-quality materials for decision-making.

•   Maintain accurate records of key decisions, decision logs and action trackers, ensuring actions are followed up and escalated where required.

•   Proactively develop and maintain the annual plan for the QHC Board and subcommittees, including recurring agenda items, statutory requirements, key approvals and reporting milestones.

**2.  Governance Requirements & Coordination**

•   Support the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of governance frameworks, charters, policies, procedures and related documentation for the Board, subcommittees and QHC leadership governance.

•   Coordinate governance-related approvals and documentation with relevant QHC functions.

•   Support alignment across QHC functions on governance requirements, approvals and stakeholder inputs.

•   Own the coordination, drafting, review cycle and version control of governance policies and procedures.

**3.  Decision Governance**

•   Maintain and routinely update updates QHC Delegation of Authority, decision-rights matrix and approval pathways for the Board and management decision-making.

•   Coordinate governance requirements and approvals supporting the Board, subcommittees and leadership decision-making, ensuring clear ownership, decision status and follow-up actions.

•   Ensure key decisions and approvals are appropriately documented, tracked and followed up, with escalation where required.

•   Support leadership with governance requirements and stakeholder inputs relevant to key decisions.

**4.**  **Board Reporting**

•   Produce clear, concise and decision-ready Board, subcommittees and committee reports, including summaries of matters for noting, discussion, approval and escalation.

•   Ensure decisions and approvals are properly recorded, communicated and followed up, with actions tracked and escalated where required.

•   Maintain confidentiality and information-governance standards for board and sensitive material.

**5.  Shareholder & Stakeholder Governance Interface**

•   Coordinate shareholder, executive and functional inputs into QHC governance processes, ensuring submissions are complete, aligned and ready for the relevant governance forum.

•   Act as a central point of coordination for governance matters between QHC, QIC, executive stakeholders and relevant assurance functions, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and escalation protocols.

**Requirements**

**EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS**

Bachelor's degree in Law, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field is required. A professional governance qualification (e.g. ICSA / CGI Chartered Governance) and / or a Master's degree is preferred.

6+ years of progressive experience in corporate governance, board affairs or a closely related discipline, including direct experience supporting boards, committees and executive governance forums.

Demonstrated experience coordinating governance processes, preparing board and committee materials, maintaining decision and action logs, and supporting board-reporting processes, ideally within healthcare, government / semi-government or large corporate / ecosystem environments.

Strong drafting, documentation, discretion and stakeholder-management capability, with working knowledge of Saudi corporate-governance and regulatory expectations.

job_title: Director - Public Health and Community Engagement (DEL2)
description:
The Director of Public Health and Community Engagement is responsible for establishing and leading the public health function across Qiddiya City.

The role will develop Qiddiya’s five-year public health strategy and establish the policies, standards, and systems required to protect the health of residents, employees, contractors, and visitors.

The position holds accountability for disease surveillance, outbreak management, occupational health standards, disease prevention, and community health engagement. The role also represents Medical Operations on public health matters and works closely with government authorities, healthcare providers, and internal stakeholders.

**Requirements**

### Job responsibilities:

### Public Health Strategy and Policy

* Develop and maintain Qiddiya’s five-year public health plan.
* Establish the public health policy framework, standards, thresholds, and intervention triggers.
* Translate national health priorities and Ministry of Health requirements into practical policies for Qiddiya City.
* Develop population health profiles, risk assessments, and public health data models.
* Advise the Executive Director on long-term strategy, resources, partnerships, and public health priorities.

### **Disease Surveillance and Outbreak Management**

* Design and oversee disease surveillance systems across Qiddiya assets and contracted healthcare provider locations.
* Ensure compliance with notifiable disease reporting requirements.
* Lead outbreak investigations and chair the outbreak control team.
* Oversee contact tracing, disease prevention, and vaccination requirements.
* Provide recommendations regarding the closure of venues or assets during public health incidents.
* Maintain effective reporting and escalation relationships with relevant health authorities.
* Define the environmental health information required from internal and external partners.

### Occupational Health

* Establish occupational health standards for Qiddiya employees, contractors, and service providers.
* Define health surveillance requirements for roles with specific exposure or physical demands.
* Clarify responsibilities across occupational health, public health, and clinical service delivery.
* Include occupational health requirements within contracted healthcare services.
* Monitor and verify that contracted providers deliver services according to agreed standards.

### Community Health Engagement

* Provide strategic oversight of the Qiddiya Life Saver Program and wider lay-responder initiatives.
* Establish program direction, targets, performance measures, and governance requirements.
* Develop the Public Access Defibrillator network plan, including coverage, placement, governance, and expansion.
* Define the community health engagement approach for residents, employees, and visitors.
* Establish measurement frameworks to assess the effectiveness and value of community health programs.

### Leadership and Governance

* Lead, manage, and develop the public health team.
* Represent Medical Operations on public health matters internally and externally.
* Prepare and present reports, business cases, and recommendations to senior management.
* Manage budgets, resources, contracts, and departmental priorities.
* Maintain strong relationships with government authorities, healthcare providers, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and delegated authorities.
* Identify, assess, manage, and escalate public health risks.
* Drive continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.

### Requirements:

### Education

* Master of Public Health, or an equivalent postgraduate qualification in public health, is mandatory.

### Professional Certifications

* Occupational health qualification or recognized equivalent is preferred.
* Field epidemiology training or an equivalent applied epidemiology certification is preferred.

### Experience

* Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience in public health practice.
* Proven experience developing a public health plan, policy framework, or program from the beginning.
* Practical experience in disease surveillance and outbreak investigation.
* Experience leading or making a significant contribution to an outbreak response.
* Experience working across multiple organizations or functions where responsibilities and authority are shared.
* Experience establishing a new public health function is preferred.
* Experience in mass-gathering, events, entertainment destinations, or visitor-focused public health is preferred.
* Experience in occupational health is preferred.
* Familiarity with Saudi Ministry of Health regulations and notifiable disease requirements is preferred.
* General healthcare, hospital, or clinical management experience alone does not replace the required public health experience.[](https://qiddiyaco-my.sharepoint.com/personal/salomair_qiddiya_com/_layouts/15/Doc.aspx?sourcedoc=%7B6F875B44-EF28-4A96-8B00-93C98DF06276%7D&file=Director%20Public%20Health%20Community%20Engagement%20JD%20V1.docx&action=default&mobileredirect=true)

### Skills and Competencies

* Strong strategic and population-level analytical thinking.
* Ability to make informed decisions when information is incomplete.
* Strong policy, planning, and professional writing skills.
* Ability to prepare documents suitable for executive and regulatory review.
* Strong negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Good knowledge of surveillance systems, data models, and public health reporting.
* Leadership and team-development capability.
* Working proficiency in both Arabic and English.

job_title: Future Career Opportunity - Attraction Manager - Taif
description:
Job Purpose:

Responsible for leading the daily operations of the offering within the Attractions department, ensuring that they run smoothly, efficiently, and meet high guest service standards. This role includes managing procurement, inventory, budgeting, scheduling, and business planning. Will be leading the daily operations of the attraction. tasked with ensuring operational compliance, safety, and financial success while leading a team to provide an exceptional guest experience.

Managerial Accountabilities:

Strategy and Planning

•

Develop and implement operational strategies for the offering in alignment with the overall strategy of the Attractions department.

•

Collaborate with Attractions GM to assess the future needs of the attraction, including new offerings, services, and enhancements, and translate these into actionable plans.

•

Conduct market analysis to inform the development of business plans, identifying trends and opportunities to maximize revenue and guest engagement. Monitor and evaluate the performance of the offering, making data-driven decisions to enhance efficiency and guest experience.

Business Planning

•

Set and review long-term plans to align with SEVEN’s strategy and guest needs.

•

Identify process improvements and explore new opportunities to enhance offerings and reduce costs.

Procurement and Inventory Management

•

Oversee the procurement process for all goods and services required for the attraction, ensuring timely delivery and cost-effective sourcing.

•

Manage inventory control processes, including receiving goods, tracking inventory levels, and maintaining accurate records to prevent shortages or overstocking.

•

Establish relationships with vendors and suppliers to ensure the consistent and reliable supply of goods necessary for attraction operations.

Stakeholder Relations

•

Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal stakeholders, including Attractions GM, other department managers, and staff members to ensure effective communication and coordination.

•

Represent the offering in cross-functional meetings, ensuring that the offering’s needs and challenges are addressed.

•

Engage with external stakeholders, such as suppliers and partners, to secure resources and support for operational needs.

Budget and Scheduling Management

•

Oversee the budgeting process for the offering, ensuring alignment with departmental financial goals and SEVEN’s overall budgetary policies.

•

Monitor expenditure throughout the fiscal year, ensuring all spending is in line with the approved budget and identifying opportunities for cost savings.

•

Oversee the scheduling of staff and resources to optimize operational efficiency while controlling costs and maintaining high service standards.

•

Provide regular financial reports to Attractions GM, highlighting any variances and proposing corrective actions where necessary.

Governance and Resilience

•

Develop and implement operational policies and procedures for the offering, ensuring compliance with SEVEN’s standards and regulations.

•

Lead risk management initiatives to identify potential operational challenges and develop contingency plans to mitigate risks.

•

Ensure that all health and safety regulations are strictly adhered to, promoting a safe and secure environment for both guests and staff.

People Management

•

Direct the recruitment, training, and performance management of the team, ensuring that all staff members are equipped to deliver exceptional service.

•

Foster a culture of continuous improvement and professional development within the team, providing coaching and mentorship as needed.

•

Conduct regular performance evaluations, providing constructive feedback and setting clear goals for team members.

•

Cultivate an inclusive work environment where team members are engaged, motivated, and supported in their roles.

Functional Accountabilities:

Daily Operations Management

•

Oversee the day-to-day operations of the offering, ensuring all activities are executed smoothly and efficiently.

•

Coordinate staff schedules to ensure optimal coverage and productivity, addressing any staffing issues promptly.

•

Manage inventory levels, ensuring that all necessary supplies are available to meet operational demands.

Financial Management

•

Manage the financial performance of the attraction, ensuring that revenue targets are met, and costs are controlled within the budget.

•

Prepare detailed financial reports, including budget forecasts, actuals, and variance analyses, for review by senior management.

•

Collaborate with the finance team to ensure the accuracy of financial records and compliance with SEVEN’s financial policies and audit requirements.

Optimization and Innovation

•

Identify and implement opportunities for operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness within the offering.

•

Collaborate with Attractions GM and other managers to innovate and improve the offerings and processes.

•

Stay updated on industry trends and best practices, ensuring that SEVEN’s operations remain competitive and innovative.

Scheduling and Resource Management

•

Develop and maintain efficient scheduling systems for staff, attractions, and events to optimize resources and ensure seamless operations.

•

Work closely with the HR team to ensure that all shifts are adequately staffed, and employee scheduling adheres to labor laws and internal policies.

•

Monitor resource allocation to ensure the attraction operates within the established budget and staffing plan.

Guest Experience

•

Lead efforts to ensure all guest interactions are positive and welcoming.

•

Address and resolve guest complaints promptly, implementing solutions to enhance satisfaction and build loyalty.

•

Monitor guest feedback and performance metrics, using insights to continuously improve the overall guest experience.

KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE:

Minimum Qualifications

•

Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, or a related field.

Professional Certifications

•

Certification in Operations Management or Project Management is preferred.

EXPERIENCE

Required Experience

•

10+ years of relevant experience in operations management within the entertainment or hospitality sectors, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.

•

Proven track record of managing large teams and complex operations in a guest-facing environment.

•

Experience in optimizing operations for efficiency and guest satisfaction, with a strong focus on innovation and continuous improvement.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Physical Requirements

•

Must be able to work independently and perform manual handling tasks, including lifting up to 5kg.

Job Description

We are seeking a **Senior Business Continuity Management (BCM) Specialist** to lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the organization’s Business Continuity Management arrangements.

The role will be responsible for developing and implementing the BCM framework, policy, Business Impact Analysis (BIA), risk assessments, continuity strategies, Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), exercises, awareness programs, and performance reporting.

The successful candidate will ensure that all BCM activities are aligned with **ISO 22301:2019**, including the **2024 climate-action amendment**, ISO 22313 guidance, and applicable local regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements.

**Requirements**

### 1\. BCM Framework & Planning

* Review the organization’s structure, critical services, existing emergency and continuity arrangements, policies, and risk information.
* Identify applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and stakeholder requirements related to business continuity.
* Develop and maintain the **Business Continuity Management Framework**, including governance, roles and responsibilities, scope, lifecycle, reporting, and continual improvement.
* Develop the **Business Continuity Policy** and define BCM objectives, responsibilities, and review requirements.
* Plan and facilitate BCM workshops and interviews with business units, process owners, support functions, and key stakeholders.
* Lead the **Business Impact Analysis (BIA)** to identify critical activities, dependencies, impacts, recovery priorities, and recovery objectives.
* Conduct **Business Continuity Risk Assessments**, identifying disruption scenarios, vulnerabilities, existing controls, and treatment actions.
* Develop the **Business Continuity Strategy**, including recovery options, resource requirements, dependencies, and recommendations.
* Develop, review, and validate **Business Continuity Plans (BCPs)** covering activation, escalation, roles, communication, response, recovery, and return-to-normal activities.
* Develop BCM templates, tools, and supporting documentation.
* Deliver BCM awareness sessions and workshops for relevant stakeholders.
* Present deliverables to management and incorporate stakeholder feedback.
* 2\. BCM Exercises, Monitoring & Reporting

* Develop an annual or periodic **BCM Exercise and Simulation Programme** based on organizational risks, critical activities, and BCPs.
* Design and facilitate tabletop exercises, simulations, and other continuity exercises.
* Prepare **BCM Exercise Reports** covering observations, strengths, gaps, lessons learned, and corrective actions.
* Prepare **BCM Monitoring and Performance Reports** covering implementation progress, BCP status, exercise results, outstanding actions, and improvement priorities.
* Track corrective actions and support business owners in updating BCPs and related documentation.
* Maintain proper document control, version management, and records of workshops, exercises, validations, and management decisions.
* Provide knowledge transfer and coaching to designated client personnel to ensure sustainable BCM capability.

* Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in **Business Continuity, Risk Management, Emergency Management, Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering**, or a related discipline.
* Minimum **7 years of relevant Business Continuity Management experience**.
* Proven experience in developing and implementing **BCM frameworks, policies, and business continuity plans**.
* Strong hands-on experience in:

* Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
* Business Continuity Risk Assessment
* Business Continuity Strategy
* Business Continuity Plans (BCPs)
* BCM exercises and simulations
* Awareness and stakeholder workshops

* Experience preparing executive-level reports and presenting recommendations to senior management.
* Strong knowledge of **ISO 22301:2019**, ISO 22313, and the **2024 amendment to ISO 22301**.
* Experience working within complex, multi-department organizations.
* Experience in **Saudi Arabia or the GCC** is highly preferred.
* Professional BCM certification such as **CBCI, MBCI**, or equivalent is preferred.
* **ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor** certification is an advantage.

* Core Competencies

* Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills.
* Strong interviewing and workshop facilitation capabilities.
* Ability to translate business processes, critical activities, and dependencies into practical recovery requirements.
* Excellent written and verbal **English communication skills**.
* Strong report writing and presentation skills.
* Arabic language capability is an advantage.
* Strong planning, coordination, and document-management skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines.
* Ability to communicate BCM concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Key Deliverables
* The Senior BCM Specialist will be expected to lead or significantly contribute to the delivery of:

1.  Business Continuity Management Framework
2.  Business Continuity Policy
3.  Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
4.  Business Continuity Risk Assessment
5.  Business Continuity Strategy
6.  Business Continuity Plans (BCPs)
7.  BCM Templates and Forms
8.  BCM Awareness Sessions / Workshops
9.  BCM Exercises and Simulations
10.  BCM Exercise Reports
11.  BCM Monitoring and Performance Reports
12.  Corrective Action and Continual Improvement Recommendations

description: Title: AFCAP V Saudi Arabia: PSAB Vector/Pest Controller Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR! Program Summary The KBR PSAB Program provides comprehensive BASE OPERATING SUPPORT-INSTALLATION (BOS-I) services at Prince Sultan Air Base (PSAB) in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA). These services are delivered to support the 378 Air Expeditionary Wing (AEW), mission partners, and tenant units, encompassing a diverse range of personnel including transient, temporary duty (TDY), permanent party, and rotational personnel. Additionally, the program extends its services to encompass five (5) remote Army sites within PSAB. This program ensures the seamless functioning of operations, maintenance, and support activities essential for the sustained mission readiness and operational effectiveness of PSAB and its associated units. Job Summary Vector/ Pe st Controller is responsible for performing integrated pest management functions and conducting pest management surveys as well as determining pest management actions needed to control and prevent infestations of plant and animal pests. The pest controller will also interact and coordinate with medical activities to control health hazards and will complete required reports and tasks in accordance with the established policies, procedures, systems, and requirements approved by the company. RESPONSIBILITIES : This position shall function as an integral team member, cooperating with and supporting U.S. deployed forces, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) and shall share information with other integral team members as required. Inspects buildings, land, and surroundings for infestation. Sprays chemicals, lays poisonous bait, sets mechanical traps, or any other needed treatment to fix pest problems. May clean areas that harbor pests to prepare area for fumigation. Implement/develop Pest Management Plans IAW USAF approved AFIs Provide operational control to OCN personnel escorting during work hours including to and from visitors-controlled area Ensures all work locations have an effective Integrated Pest Management plan in place and adequate inventories. In the event inventories are low, requests will be submitted to USAF. Makes certain that customer satisfaction is achieved with services provided. Under direct supervision, performs routine assigned tasks from instructions, established guidelines, and procedures. Possesses knowledge and skills to use a multitude of different equipment to eliminate pests using QHSE guidelines. May perform light to heavy duties related to treatment, casing, and removal of harmful pests. Performs other duties as assigned Ensure the successful delivery of services to 4,000 personnel, plus or minus 10%. MATERIAL & EQUIPMENT DIRECTLY USED: May be exposed to potentially hazardous conditions that require wear of hard hats, gloves, steel toed boots, hearing protection, safety glasses and other personal protection equipment (PPE); may be required to push, pull and lift heavy equipment. Use of Land Mobile Radios, cell phones, laptop, and other devices to maintain contact and accountability of work activities. WORKING ENVIRONMENT: Work will be indoors and outdoors. Exposure to heat, cold, dust, noise, chemicals may occur. Overtime and shift work may be required depending on contractual needs as well as occasional to frequent travel. Employee must comply with all Federal, State and Local regulations and published Company work rules as well as written instructions. Task specific work environment training maybe provided. Must be prepared to function in a wartime or contingency environment to support U.S. interests. PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES: Physical requirements include lifting up to 35lb, team lifting up to 50lbs, climbing, extended sitting, or standing, stooping, stretching, and bending. Work may require using and wearing personal protective equipment such as, hearing and eye protection, hard hat and steel-toed boots as well as Individual Protective Equipment (IPE) which may include but not limited to Level III plus/IV Individual Body Armor with both front and back ballistic plates, ACH helmet, clothing (undergarments, shirts and pants and/or coveralls), reflective vests/belts, sound suppression devices, etc. Day-to-day physical requirements may involve standard office activities including sitting/standing for extended periods of time, attending meetings, use of keyboard and mouse repetitively, lifting and carrying less than 20 lbs. frequently, etc. Work requires moderate physical exertion including walking to operating areas and walking up stairs BASIC QUALIFICATIONS High School Diploma or equivalent with a minimum 2 years licensed pest control experience required. Preferred USAF AFSC 3E4X3 Pest Management or another similar Military/DOD MOS Completion of USAF AFSC 3E4X3 Pest Management or other equivalent DOD school is highly desired Applicant must have a valid DoD Certification with Categories 6, 7 and 8; or a valid state Certified Applicators License with the DoD equivalent. Must be a U.S. Citizen with a current U. S. Driver's License. Must possess passport book (not passport card) with at least 13 months of remaining validity AND 6 blank visa/stamp pages remaining Must have and maintain a valid U. S. SECRET Security Clearance throughout the duration of the contract Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English fluently Candidate must also meet CENTCOM MOD-15 theater requirements. description:

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.

If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.

We are seeking a highly experienced Sales Director to lead and grow MOZN’s business across the Center of Government, Security and Defense sectors. The Sales Director will be responsible for developing and executing the sector strategy, driving revenue and growth, strengthening strategic customer relationships, and leading high-value opportunities across the Center of Government, Security and Defense Sector ecosystem.

The role will focus on identifying and developing opportunities for AI, analytics, data platforms, cloud and digital transformation within Center of Government, Security and Defense Sector organizations, while building strong relationships with senior decision-makers across government, defense, security and relevant industry organizations.

**What you'll do**

* Lead and execute MOZN’s Center of Government, Security and Defense Sector strategy in alignment with the company’s AI product roadmap and market expansion goals.

* Drive revenue growth and achieve sales targets across the Center of Government, Security and Defense Sector.

* Identify and prioritize strategic opportunities for AI adoption, including intelligent automation, predictive analytics, operational efficiency, situational awareness, and data-driven decision-making.

* Build and nurture executive-level relationships with senior government, defense, security, and relevant industry stakeholders and decision-makers.

* Develop and manage strategic accounts, ensuring strong customer engagement and long-term partnerships.

* Lead complex, high-value sales opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, procurement processes, and extended sales cycles.

* Collaborate closely with marketing, pre-sales, channel, business development, and product teams to ensure cohesive market engagement.

* Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of Center of Government, Security and Defense Sector opportunities and provide accurate sales forecasts and reporting.

* Drive partnerships and alliances with system integrators, consulting firms, technology vendors, and relevant Center of Government, Security and Defense Sector ecosystem partners.

* Support the Business Development team throughout the sales process, ensuring effective collaboration and alignment.

* Negotiate and close large-scale strategic deals within complex stakeholder environments.

* Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement strategies to enhance sales productivity and effectiveness.

* Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing team focused on Center of Government, Security and Defense Sector accounts and opportunities.

* Set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, and foster a culture of accountability and high performance.

* Support career development and succession planning within the team.

* Stay up-to-date with Center of Government, Security and Defense Sector industry trends, emerging technologies, market dynamics, and competitive developments to identify growth opportunities.

* Provide regular reports and strategic analysis to senior management, highlighting business performance, market trends, pipeline health, and areas for growth.

**Requirements**

* Saudi National.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

* 10+ years of experience in sales, business development, or strategic account management, with significant experience in a leadership role.

* Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets within technology, AI, analytics, cloud or digital transformation.

* Strong understanding of government, Security & Defense procurement processes, strategic account management, commercial negotiations, and complex sales methodologies.

* Demonstrated success in leading strategic sales initiatives and managing multimillion-dollar deals.

* Established network and strong relationships with senior stakeholders across government, Security & Defense, and relevant industry organizations.

* Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.

* Deep understanding of AI, analytics, data platforms, cloud or digital transformation solutions.

* Experience selling technology solutions to government, defense, security, or related organizations.

* Strong strategic thinking, business development, and market expansion capabilities.

* Ability to navigate complex organizational structures and build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers.

**Benefits**

* You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space.

* You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best.

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

The Director – Organizational Development provides enterprise-wide leadership on organizational design, workforce planning, and OD foundations across the group and its subsidiaries. The role ensures that organizational structures, roles, governance, and workforce capacity are aligned to business priorities, capital programs, and long-term growth ambitions.

The role owns the organization’s OD frameworks, job architecture, grading standards, and job evaluation governance, ensuring internal equity, role clarity, scalability, and operating effectiveness. The Director leads the setup of OD foundations for new subsidiaries and business verticals, including structures, job frameworks, and workforce models, and provides governance oversight for structural changes across the group.

As a strategic advisor to senior leadership and HR, the Director partners closely with Strategy, Finance, HRBPs, and business leaders to integrate workforce and organizational considerations into enterprise strategy, transformation programs, and growth initiatives. The role contributes to target operating model (TOM) development initiatives.

The Director also builds and leads the Organizational Development function, setting delivery standards, governance processes, and quality controls, and developing OD capability, tools, and knowledge assets to ensure high-impact, analytically rigorous delivery.

**Requirements**

**Scope / Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Organizational Design & TOM Leadership**

* Lead the design and continuous evolution of enterprise and functional target operating models (TOMs) aligned to strategy, growth plans, and operating context.
* Establish and govern organizational design frameworks, principles, and standards to ensure scalability, clarity of accountability, and operational effectiveness.
* Sponsor major restructuring, transformation, and capability-led design initiatives across corporate, business, and development functions.
* Oversee the design of organization structures, reporting lines, role charters, and governance forums to enable decision velocity and execution discipline.
* Guide leadership teams through structural scenario modeling and future-state organization design.

**OD Foundations for Group Companies & Subsidiaries**

* Lead the setup of OD foundations for new subsidiaries and group entities, including structure, grading architecture, job frameworks, and workforce models.
* Ensure consistent application of group-wide OD standards while allowing for contextual flexibility across entities.
* Partner with business and HR leadership to support post-merger integration, spin-offs, and new business vertical launches.
* Provide governance oversight for structural changes across the group to ensure alignment with enterprise design principles.

**Organizational Structure Effectiveness**

* Oversee analysis of spans of control, workforce layering, and reporting lines to optimize leadership bandwidth, cost-effectiveness, and agility.
* Validate alignment between organizational structures, strategy, and operational delivery models.
* Lead enterprise-wide organizational diagnostics and effectiveness assessments.
* Approve and sponsor structural recommendations for leadership decision-making.

**Strategic Workforce Planning Leadership**

* Own the enterprise workforce planning framework and annual/multi-year planning cycles in partnership with HRBPs and Finance.
* Ensure workforce supply–demand alignment to strategic priorities, major programs, and capital plans.
* Review and endorse workforce scenarios, capacity models, and productivity assumptions.
* Escalate material workforce risks and resourcing constraints to executive leadership.

**Job Architecture, Grading & Evaluation Governance**

* Govern enterprise job architecture, grading standards, and job evaluation methodologies.
* Ensure equity, internal consistency, and market alignment across roles and functions.
* Approve complex or sensitive role designs and grading outcomes.
* Ensure role clarity and structural integrity across growth and transformation phases.

**Stakeholder Leadership & Advisory**

* Act as a strategic advisor to ExCo, business unit heads, and HR leadership on organizational effectiveness and structural design.
* Partner closely with Finance, Strategy, and HRBPs to integrate workforce, cost, and operating model considerations.

* Represent OD in enterprise transformation and growth initiatives.

* **People Leadership & OD Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Senior Managers and the broader OD team.
* Build OD capability, tools, and knowledge assets across the function.
* Set delivery standards, quality controls, and governance processes.
* Drive a culture of analytical rigor, partnership, and business impact.

* **Experience & Profile (Indicative)**

* Minimum 12  years’ experience in Organizational Development, Operating Model Design, or Strategic HR roles.
* Proven experience in **target operating model (TOM) design** and enterprise transformation.
* Hands-on experience in **setting up OD foundations for new subsidiaries or business entities**.
* Experience working in **group company environments with multiple subsidiaries**.
* Strong background in **strategic workforce planning, org design, and job evaluation**.
* Exposure to or experience within **development-sector organizations** strongly preferred.
* Executive-level stakeholder engagement and governance leadership experience.

**Testing Supervisor**

Performs routine tests through a lean & flow production line with outstanding performance. That is targeting the best quality, maximum cost saving, and shortest delivery time. Control the quality of GIS / Maintain Test Report Database. Contribute actively to improving manufacturing processes. Maintain a safe and clean work environment.

**Job Description:**

The **Hub Quality and Continuous Improvement Manager** for BU Service will support local Quality teams to effectively execute customer-facing quality activities and quick reaction to Customer Quality issues by running robust problem-solving initiatives (RCAs). Ensure Region & Country alignment to Global Quality & CI strategies and adherence to relevant processes and tools

Quality: Define and implement short-, medium- and long-term strategic actions to improve Quality in the entire value chain. Manages global quality processes in the respective area of responsibility, as well as drives quality related certification activities and audits to maintain the required quality management systems intact. Accountable for delivery of overall Hub quality objectives and targets.

Implement, deploy, and maintain CI culture within entities in the scope of the Hub. Define and implement a structure incl. governance to continuously generate, prioritize and execute improvement ideas.

The Hub Quality and Continuous Improvement Manager will also be the Local Quality and Continuous Improvement Manager in one of the countries in the region, in this function report functionally to the LSU Manager.

**Main Accountabilities:**

**People and Strategy**

Define and implement Hub Quality and CI strategy, including governance of Quality and CI function in line with BU & business needs and directives. Stays up to date on new laws, regulations and industry trends affecting the company in terms of Quality Assurance and Quality Control and assists in developing policies and training as needed. Manage Hub Quality and CI function, including capability development, work force management, footprint, and succession. Contribute to the development and execution of the BU Quality Improvement Plan.

  

**Customer Focus**

Act as an advocate for the Customer by ensuring the Voice of Customer is represented within the Hub quality strategy. Represent the company, in terms of Quality, in front of the customer when needed. Ensure customer satisfaction by evaluating the risks, problems and solutions from a quality and customer/stakeholder point of view.

  

**Quality Management System**

Define and manage Quality Management System and processes across the entities within the Hub. Coordinate process reviews in line with internal and external expectations.

  

**Audit and Certification**

Accountable for maintaining and securing required Certification in all units within the HUB scope. Accountable for organizing and conducting the quality/process audits/assessments and following up the actions identified to the closure.

  

**Process Performance**

Establish process performance indicators, and ensure effective internal controls are in place to verify that processes continue to meet customer and stakeholder expectations. Analyze the process indicators continuously and take actions to address situations where process performance deviates from expectations and manage such deviations to the closure. Ensure full utilization of applicable systems for monitoring, reporting, and following up the process indicators.

  

**Offer Performance (incl. Product/ System/ Solution/ Project and Services)**

Adapt and implement quality assurance methods, monitoring offer performance, and collaborating with regional stakeholders to address market-specific needs and challenges. Coordinate with stakeholders to gather feedback, identify areas for improvement, and implement necessary changes to enhance offer performance. Provide insights and feedback to the global team to support continuous improvement efforts and ensure alignment between global strategies and regional market requirements.

**Non-Conformance Management**

Manage resolution of high-profile NCRs reported. Monitor and control customer interventions triggered by customer dissatisfaction. Protect and strengthen customer trust by effectively addressing the quality issues to eliminate or reduce their impacts and all corrective and preventive actions in place.

**Continuous Improvement**

Deploy and implement sustainably the Continuous Improvement Framework, built upon: Lighthouse, L6S, Ochibo-Hiroi and Lessons Learned / Best Practices. Drives proactively systematic continuous improvement actions to improve business processes and procedures globally. Support prioritization and execution of portfolio of improvement projects aiming to improve quality and operational performance.

**Your Background:**

* *   Engineering degree
    * Advanced English
    * Lean 6Sigma, Green Belt or above.
    * Quality core tools experience
    * Expert into: 8D, Ishikawa, 5W, A3, TQM, PDCA (be able to teach others).

    * Quality Management Systems

At Salla, we are building the digital backbone of commerce in the region, empowering thousands of merchants to start, grow, and scale their businesses. We turn what's complex into something simple, powerful, and scalable.

Every Salla store runs on one storefront. When a buyer searches, opens a product, or reads a review, they decide whether to trust a store they may have never heard of. Every change you ship reaches thousands of stores at once.

We are looking for a Product Manager who builds with curiosity, clarity, and care. You own search, the product page, and reviews: how buyers find what they want, decide, and trust what they read. You work side by side with our data and AI teams and turn their models into decisions buyers feel and merchants see in their sales.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Know Salla's buyers: how they shop across very different stores, and what makes them hesitate, compare, or leave. Bring their voice into every decision, along with the merchants whose sales depend on it.
* Own search, the product page, and reviews end to end, from discovery to iteration, tied to buyer conversion and merchant sales.
* Partner with data and AI teams on ranking, query understanding, and semantic search. Decide what ships, to which stores, and how you measure it.
* Design the product page around the buyer's decision: what they need to see, trust, and confirm before they buy.
* Build reviews that buyers trust and merchants can use, including for stores with few or no reviews.
* Experiment by default and Ship safely across thousands of stores: staged rollouts, experiments, guardrails, and a way back.
* Run continuous discovery: talk to buyers and merchants regularly, watch real sessions, and test ideas with prototypes before committing engineering time.
* Make decisions with data: define the metrics that matter for each surface, read the funnel yourself, and let evidence, not opinion, settle debates.

**Requirements**

* 4–6 years of experience in **Product Management**, preferably owning **Search, Discovery, Product Pages, Conversion, or other customer-facing product experiences** within a live consumer or e-commerce product.

* **AI-native mindset** with hands-on experience using **AI tools** for data analysis, prototyping, research and interpreting product results.

* Demonstrated ownership of **product outcomes**, with the ability to work independently, take initiative, and move quickly in a fast-paced environment.

* Fluent in **Arabic and English**, both written and spoken.
* **Preferred:** Experience building a product, feature, or business from **0-to-1**, either as a founder, early-stage team member, or founding product team member.

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

## Job Description

Is making every moment matter your true passion? Join us At Radisson Hotel Group, where delivering memorable moments is not just a skill but a heartfelt commitment. Ready to turn every check-in and check-out into an unforgettable experience?

We are currently seeking an **Front Office Manager** to join our vibrant team. At Radisson Hotel Group, we are in search of individuals who go beyond the resume – those with character, skills, talents, and a passion for creating memorable experiences.

As the **Front Office Manager**, you bring an unmatched level of dedication, a focus on delivering exceptional service, and a genuine passion for creating positive guest experiences to our dynamic Front Office Team.

Our **Front Office Managers** love the hustle and bustle of life! It’s not just about check-in and check-out. It’s about everything in-between.

* You will manage our front office team and lead by example, ensuring all aspects of the guest journey and experience are delivered to the highest level.

* You will exude patience, empathy and have the personality to host the show, whilst managing budgets and inventory

* As an integral part of the management team, you will work proactively to ensure guest satisfaction and the smooth running of the front office department.

## Qualifications

* **Exceptional customer service:** Experience of driving guest satisfaction and handling complaints with a professional demeanor.
* **Communication skills:** Clear and effective verbal and written communication with guests, staff, and other departments.
* **Leadership abilities:** Exposure to supervising and motivating a team of front desk staff.
* **Organizational skills:** Ability to multi-task and prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.
* **Problem-solving skills:** Identifying and resolving issues that arise at the front desk.
* **Time management:** Exposure to supporting the scheduling staff and managing workflow.
* **Staff training:** Experience of training and development of front desk staff.
* **Knowledge of front desk operations:** Understanding of check-in/check-out procedures, reservation
* management, and guest billing.
* **Adaptability:** Flexibility to handle unexpected situations and changing priorities.

**Live the Magic of Hospitality -** Be part of a team that creates **exceptional experiences and memorable moments** every day. Let your **Yes I Can!** spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

**Lead with Your Ambition -** Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to **make a difference**—in hospitality, your community and beyond.

**Enjoy Global & Local Perks -** No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

Guaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends & Family  
Exclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food & Beverage, Spa and more

**Join us in shaping the future of hospitality!** If you’re ready to **bring your talent, energy, and passion**, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.**

We welcome applicants from all **backgrounds, abilities, and experiences**. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

job_title: Rigger - Turbine Outages & Precision Equipment Handler (Saudi Arabia)
description:
**Job Description**

The **Turbine & Precision Equipment Rigger** is responsible for executing highly critical, heavy, and precision lifting operations during power plant turbine outages and industrial maintenance shutdowns. This role demands exceptional technical expertise to safely handle multi-million dollar rotating equipment, gas/steam turbine components, and delicate machinery within tightly restricted spaces. The successful candidate must strictly adhere to engineered lifting plans, maintain zero-compromise safety standards, and display flawless precision under fast-paced outage timelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Rigging Execution:** Safely attach, lift, guide, and position heavy turbine components and associated mechanical equipment in strict compliance with **approved, engineered lifting plans**.
* **Pre-Lift Assessment:** Thoroughly review critical technical parameters prior to every lift, including total load weight, **exact center of gravity**, designated lifting points, travel path clearances, and final landing arrangements.
* **Equipment Management:** Select, calculate, and inspect specialized rigging hardware such as synthetic/wire-rope slings, shackles, **spreader beams**, chain blocks, and specialized lifting accessories.
* **Compliance & Safety Verification:** Audit all lifting tackle before use to verify valid identification tags, current inspection status, and **Working Load Limits (WLL)**.
* **Precision Maneuvering:** Expertly guide immense structural loads through highly restricted areas and congested plant environments utilizing controlled mechanical methods and precise signaling.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:** Minimum of **3 to 5 years of proven experience** as an industrial rigger, with a strong preference for candidates who have completed major **turbine outages, power plant shutdowns, or heavy mechanical maintenance**.
* **Technical Skills:** Comprehensive knowledge of rigging mathematics, center-of-gravity calculations, crane signals, and rigging hardware capacities.
* **Certifications:** Valid third-party rigging certifications (such as **TUV, Bureau Veritas, Aramco, or equivalents**) are highly preferred.
* **Physical Capability:** Ability to work in confined spaces, at heights, and handle the physical demands of 12-hour shifts typical during emergency or scheduled outages.
* **Soft Skills:** Strong teamwork orientation, high attention to detail, and a strict commitment to safety protocols.

job_title: Procurement Executive – Procurement – Jumeirah Jabal Omar
description:
Job Description

About Jumeirah
Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
About Jumeirah Jabal Omar
Located just minutes from Masjid Al Haram, Jumeirah Jabal Omar Makkah offers a seamless blend of comfort, connectivity, and Arabian hospitality in the heart of the Holy City. Spread across four towers, the hotel features a range of dining venues, retail outlets, a gym, executive lounge and meeting spaces. Guests can enjoy views of the Grand Mosque and a culinary offering that spans Mediterranean, Persian, Middle Eastern and Southeast Asian cuisines.
About the Job
An opportunity has arisen for a Procurement Specialist – Procurement to join Jumeirah Jabal Omar.
The main duties and responsibilities of this role:
Manage procurement activities for goods and services in line with operational requirements, approved budgets, and company policies.
Source and evaluate suppliers, obtain quotations, and support price and commercial negotiations to achieve best value.
Prepare and process purchase orders and ensure all procurement documentation is complete, accurate, and properly approved.
Coordinate with internal departments and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
Monitor open purchase orders, delivery timelines, and pending requirements, and follow up on any delays or discrepancies.
Maintain accurate supplier records, quotations, contracts, and procurement-related documentation.
Support supplier performance reviews and assist in identifying reliable and cost-effective sourcing options.
Ensure all procurement activities are fully compliant with Jumeirah’s internal procurement policies, approval processes, delegated authorities, and applicable procedures.
Maintain proper documentation and audit readiness for procurement transactions in accordance with internal control requirements.

About You
The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
Previous experience in Procurement, Purchasing, Supply Chain, or a similar role is preferred.
Strong negotiation, sourcing, and supplier management skills.
Good organisational and analytical skills with strong attention to detail.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Good understanding of procurement compliance, internal controls, and approval procedures.
Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Proficient in English & Arabic (verbal & written).

About the Benefits
We offer an attractive salary, paid in Saudi Riyals (SAR), the local currency of the KSA.
In addition, we offer generous F&B benefits, reduced hotel rates across our properties globally, excellent leave and health care packages, flights home, and other employee benefits making the role attractive to high performers and any applicant looking for a career with one of the most luxurious brands in the hospitality industry.

# **Make a difference every day**

Dementia Support Australia (DSA) delivers free, nationwide support for people living with dementia whose behaviours impact their care, as well as the families, carers and professionals who support them. Backed by clinical expertise, evidence-based practice and a person-centred approach, DSA helps improve quality of life and care outcomes for people affected by dementia.

  

When it comes to our people, those we support and those who work alongside us, we are committed to fostering a culture of inclusion, respect and belonging. Through innovative programs, education, consultancy services and multidisciplinary clinical support, we empower individuals, care teams and organisations to respond to the complexities of dementia with confidence and compassion.

  

As a service led by HammondCare on behalf of the Australian Government, DSA is making a meaningful difference in communities across Australia every day. So, if you're passionate about improving the lives of people living with dementia, join us and build a career with purpose.

# **The role**

Make a difference every day by supporting people living with dementia and those who care for them, as a trusted **Dementia Consultant**. This role sits within Dementia Support Australia (DSA), which is a national dementia support service, funded by the Australian Government, led by HammondCare.

  

As a professional dementia consultant, you will work in diverse care settings, through the Hospital to Aged Care Dementia Support Program (HACDSP) – a service delivered by Dementia Support Australia.

  

In this wholesome role, you will apply your expertise in assessment and biopsychosocial approaches to support people living with dementia. You will implement practical, innovative and non-pharmacological strategies to prevent, minimise or respond to changes in behaviour related to dementia to improve quality of life outcomes.

  

This role is offered as a Fixed Term Contract until June 2028. This role is based out of our Adelaide office.

  

# **Responsibilities**

* Support families, caregivers and clinical staff to better understand how dementia impacts each individual.
* Equip carers and clinicians to prevent and respond to behaviour changes through modelling, coaching, and development of resources, including personalised behaviour support planning.
* Be able to synthesise information, through observation and written documentation to provide recommendations that are relationship centred and informed by evidence- based best practice.
* Develop reports that are contextualised to individual situations and people, that effect change on the ground and improve quality of life for people living with dementia.
* Undertake a range of assessments that help to understand the holistic experience of the person and their care network.
* Work in partnership with the broader Dementia Support Australia team to build capability and confidence across the acute, home and aged care sectors.
* Contribute to research, projects and programs, and working innovatively to meet the changing needs of the sector
* Work on other projects and assignments as required and in line with areas of skill, expertise and knowledge.
