Job Description – Power BI Developer

Job Title: Power BI Developer
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: KSA
Preferred Experience: Hands-on experience developing and supporting Power BI solutions in large-scale enterprise environments, including Power BI Report Server (PBIRS). 3 to 5 years
Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled Power BI Developer with strong expertise in building, optimizing, and maintaining enterprise dashboards and reports. The ideal candidate will be capable of independently managing end-to-end report development and support activities, preferably within an on-premises Power BI Report Server (PBIRS) environment.
The role requires strong proficiency in Power BI development, DAX, data modeling, report optimization, and enterprise reporting best practices to deliver scalable and business-driven analytics solutions.
Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports using advanced visualizations, bookmarks, drill-throughs, tooltips, conditional formatting, and dynamic navigation.

• Create complex DAX measures, calculated columns, and business calculations to support reporting and analytical requirements.

• Utilize Power Query (M) for data extraction, transformation, cleansing, and integration.

• Develop and manage data models including star schemas, fact and dimension tables, relationships, KPIs, and business logic.

• Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, validation, and reporting purposes.

• Connect and integrate Power BI reports with enterprise databases, data warehouses, and other supported data sources.

• Create and maintain JSON theme files, reusable report templates, and visualization standards.

• Implement Row-Level Security (RLS) and manage report access, permissions, and secure data connectivity.

• Optimize report performance using DAX Studio, Performance Analyzer, and best practices for semantic modeling.

• Publish, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot reports within Power BI Report Server (PBIRS).

• Perform data reconciliation, functional testing, regression testing, and production support activities.

• Troubleshoot report issues and ensure data accuracy, reliability, and performance.

• Support report migration, source connection updates, and modernization initiatives while preserving existing functionality.

• Maintain technical documentation including KPIs, calculations, data mappings, dependencies, and report configurations.

Must-Have Skills

• Power BI Development

• Power BI Report Server (PBIRS)

• DAX (Data Analysis Expressions)

• Power Query (M Language)

• Data Modeling and Data Warehousing Concepts

• SQL Query Development

• Dashboard and Report Design

• Row-Level Security (RLS)

• Report Performance Optimization

• Data Validation and Testing

• Enterprise Reporting and Analytics Development

Good-to-Have Skills

• Tabular Editor

• DAX Studio

• Experience with Enterprise Data Warehouses

• Experience with SAP Data Sources

• Experience with Modern Data Platforms and Lakehouse Architectures

• BI Report Migration and Modernization Initiatives

• JSON Theme Development and Report Standardization

• Data Governance and Reporting Best Practices

Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: On-site / Hybrid, based on project requirements

Job Summary
We are looking for a hands-on Data Platform Engineer with strong experience in the installation, configuration, administration, and support of data platform components in on-premises environments .
The role requires experience with platform administration, VMware-based infrastructure, Git integration, and enterprise security integration involving IAM and PAM . The engineer will be responsible for supporting platform deployment, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational activities across Development, QA, and Production environments .
The ideal candidate should also have a solid understanding of infrastructure, networking, storage, security, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes .
Key Responsibilities

• Install, configure, deploy, and maintain data platform components in on-premises environments .

• Perform day-to-day Data Platform Administration , monitoring, maintenance, upgrades, and operational support.

• Deploy and support data platform components running on VMware-based infrastructure .

• Integrate platform configurations and deployment processes with Git-based version control .

• Integrate data platforms with enterprise security solutions, including IAM and PAM .

• Support platform deployment and operations across Development, QA, and Production environments .

• Monitor platform availability, performance, capacity, resource utilization, and overall platform health.

• Troubleshoot and resolve platform, infrastructure, deployment, configuration, storage, network, and integration issues.

• Support containerized platform components using Docker and/or Kubernetes , where applicable.

• Collaborate with Data Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, Security, Network, and Application teams to maintain a stable, secure, and highly available data platform.

Must-Have Skills

• 3–5 years of relevant experience in Data Platform Engineering, infrastructure, or Platform Administration.

• Strong hands-on experience with installation and configuration of data platform components in on-premises environments .

• Strong understanding and hands-on experience in Platform Administration .

• Experience working with VMware-based infrastructure .

• Hands-on experience integrating platforms and deployment/configuration processes with Git .

• Experience with enterprise security integrations involving IAM and PAM .

• Good knowledge of platform deployment, configuration, maintenance, upgrades, monitoring, and troubleshooting .

• Experience supporting Development, QA, and Production environments .

• Good understanding of infrastructure, networking, storage, backup/recovery, and security concepts relevant to enterprise data platforms.

• Exposure to Docker and/or Kubernetes for containerized platform deployments.

Good-to-Have Skills

• Experience with MinIO and Apache Iceberg .

• Experience with Starburst or Dremio .

• Experience with Apache Spark .

• Experience with Informatica .

• Understanding of modern Data Lake and Data Lakehouse architectures .

job_title: Specialist / Consultant Psychiatrist - South African Board -Private and Govt. UA
description:
We are seeking a qualified Specialist or Consultant Psychiatrist holding a recognized South African specialist qualification in Psychiatry to join a reputable healthcare facility in the UAE. Candidates with internationally recognized specialist qualifications from South Africa, the UK, the USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, or Europe may also be considered, subject to the applicable UAE licensing requirements.

### Key Responsibilities

* Conduct comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental health histories, clinical interviews, and mental status examinations.
    
* Diagnose and manage a wide range of psychiatric conditions, including depression, anxiety disorders, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, psychotic disorders, personality disorders, and trauma-related conditions.
    
* Develop individualized treatment plans incorporating medication management, psychotherapy, and other evidence-based interventions, as appropriate.

* Employment visa and medical insurance, subject to applicable regulations and employer policy.

* Potential relocation assistance, subject to employer policy.

**COGNNA** is redefining modern cybersecurity with Nexus, our Agentic AI SOC platform, and our Smart MDR services. We help organizations across the region and around the world cut alert noise, respond to incidents faster and stay compliant with frameworks such as SAMA, NCA, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS.

Behind it all: AI-driven triage, deep automation and our elite 24/7 Guardians Team, delivering unified visibility and rapid threat containment across endpoint, cloud and network.

As our **DevOps Engineer Intern**, you will learn by doing. You'll work alongside senior engineers to provision multi-cloud infrastructure, keep Kubernetes environments healthy, configure GitOps pipelines and support cloud security operations.

This is not a shadow-only internship. From your first weeks, your automation, documentation and troubleshooting will directly improve the reliability of the platform our customers rely on.

### Responsibilities

### 1\. Cloud operations (GCP & Alibaba Cloud)

* Provision infrastructure: help provision and maintain cloud resources following cost-efficiency and security best practices.
* Keep IAM clean: review access requests, update role definitions and manage service-account hygiene under guidance.
* Watch costs: track utilization, spot unused or over-provisioned resources, filter logs and set up budget alerts.
* Learn the network: navigate VPCs, firewall rules and private connectivity; support routine security patching and Vanta compliance tasks.

### 2\. Kubernetes & containers (GKE)

* Monitor cluster health: track status, resource usage and reliability metrics across development and staging clusters.
* Troubleshoot: help investigate pod scheduling issues, container crashes and resource bottlenecks.
* Partner with developers: learn and share containerization best practices, from Dockerfiles to multi-stage builds.
* Shadow upgrades: join senior engineers during Kubernetes upgrades and maintenance windows.

### 3\. CI/CD (ArgoCD & GitHub Actions)

* Onboard services to GitOps: draft ArgoCD Application manifests, sync policies and environment configurations.
* Catch drift: monitor ArgoCD for out-of-sync applications and flag them to the team.
* Improve pipelines: integrate security scanners, linters and tests into GitHub Actions workflows.

### 4\. Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

* Shadow migrations: learn how complex manual infrastructure is moved into code.
* Write modules: build and maintain modular Terraform that brings unmanaged resources under version control.

### 5\. Security & access operations

* Manage access: handle developer SSH access, VPN profiles and environment credentials with full audit logging.
* Harden the baseline: apply infrastructure hardening guidelines with our Security Engineers and join security reviews.
* Support the Guardians: provide infrastructure logs and environment details during security investigations.

### 6\. Monitoring, alerting & automation

* Build dashboards: create and update Grafana and Cloud Monitoring dashboards for real-time visibility.
* Write runbooks: draft and maintain runbooks and SOPs for common operational tasks, with mentor feedback.
* Automate the toil: spot repetitive manual work and replace it with Bash or Python scripts and automated workflows.

**Requirements**

You don't need to know it all yet. You need solid foundations and a real appetite to learn.

* Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity or a related field.
* A basic understanding of cloud computing concepts (GCP, AWS or Alibaba Cloud).
* Comfort on the Linux command line and basic scripting in Bash or Python.
* Foundational knowledge of containers and Docker.
* A grasp of core networking: IP subnets, DNS, HTTP/S, firewalls and VPNs.
* Eagerness to learn GitOps, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.

description:
The opportunity

Control Risks is strengthening its Advisory & Risk Consulting presence in Saudi Arabia. We are seeking a senior consulting leader who can combine high-quality client delivery with business development, key account leadership and practice building. Based permanently in Riyadh, the Associate Director will be the in-country senior lead for our risk and resilience consulting work and an important bridge between Saudi clients, the Middle East and EMEA team and our wider global network.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate will lead complex engagements, develop trusted senior client relationships, convert opportunities into sustainable mandates and help build a scalable and highly profitable Saudi practice. The role will initially focus on organisational resilience, including enterprise risk management, security management, business continuity and crisis management, while connecting clients to the wider capabilities of Control Risks where relevant.

Success in this role means: excellent delivery on current mandates, strong direct client relationships, a growing and well-managed Saudi business pipeline, and a capable in-country team that can scale with demand.

Role purpose

To lead the origination, sale and delivery of Advisory & Risk Consulting engagements in Saudi Arabia, with primary responsibility for enterprise risk management, business continuity, crisis management and organisational resilience. The Associate Director will own key client relationships and opportunities end-to-end, ensure engagements are commercially and technically successful, develop junior colleagues and help establish Control Risks as the specialist risk and resilience adviser of choice in the Kingdom.

**Client delivery and technical leadership**

* Lead complex consulting engagements from scoping and mobilisation through delivery, quality assurance, closure and follow-on work.
* Act as engagement lead and senior client adviser across organisational resilience, including enterprise risk management, , security management, business continuity, crisis management and emergency preparedness.
* Translate recognised standards and good practice into pragmatic, locally relevant solutions that work in the client’s operating environment.
* Facilitate executive interviews, workshops, simulations and decision-making sessions with boards, C-suite leaders and senior management.
* Maintain strong control of scope, quality, resourcing, budget, schedule, risk and client expectations.
* Remain actively involved in delivery, providing visible senior leadership while enabling consultants to take meaningful responsibility.

**Business development and account growth**

* Lead business development for Advisory & Risk Consulting in Saudi Arabia, working in strong collaboration with the Middle East practice leader and in close partnership with in-country colleagues and other business lines.
* Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and position Control Risks around the client’s strategic, operational and regulatory priorities.
* Own opportunities end-to-end: qualification, solution design, teaming, proposal development, pricing, negotiation, conversion and transition into delivery.
* Develop and execute focused account plans for priority Saudi clients and identify opportunities for repeat, programme-based and multidisciplinary work.
* Maintain accurate and timely pipeline, forecast and client activity information, and contribute to disciplined commercial decision-making.
* Represent Control Risks in relevant client events, roundtables and thought-leadership activities in the Kingdom.

**Practice building and people leadership**

* Help establish a sustainable in-country delivery model and contribute to the growth of the Saudi Advisory & Risk Consulting team.
* Coach, mentor and provide real-time feedback to consultants, strengthening technical capability, consulting skills and commercial judgement.
* Plan resource requirements across the Saudi portfolio and draw effectively on regional and global expertise when specialist support is required.
* Capture and protect Control Risks intellectual property, embed lessons learned and improve the reuse of methods, tools and high-quality deliverables.
* Contribute to recruitment, onboarding, performance management and succession planning as the practice grows.
* Promote a collaborative “one firm” culture across Saudi Arabia, the wider Middle East and global teams.
* Work under the direction of the EMEA Head and the Middle East Leader of Advisory & Risk Consulting, while actively contributing to the EMEA and global Advisory & Risk Consulting teams.

**Innovation, technology and risk management**

* Advance the responsible use of data, automation and emerging technology in our consulting propositions, methods and delivery toolkits.
* Identify opportunities to connect risk and resilience work with cyber, technology, intelligence, security and other Control Risks capabilities.
* Ensure engagements comply with applicable legal, risk, contracting, information-management and professional standards.
* Model sound commercial judgement, professional integrity and disciplined management of sensitive client information.

**Requirements**

**Essential experience**

* A strong track record in a consulting environment, with substantial experience, typically 8-10 years’, leading enterprise risk, security management, business continuity, crisis management or organisational resilience engagements.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple complex client engagements and being accountable for delivery quality and commercial outcomes.
* Proven ability to originate work, grow accounts and convert opportunities through trusted senior relationships and compelling proposals.
* Credibility with executive and senior management stakeholders, including the confidence to challenge constructively and influence decisions.
* GCC experience and a strong understanding of how to deliver consulting work in Saudi Arabia; prior experience working with Saudi clients is essential.
* Experience managing, coaching and developing consultants in a high-performance, collaborative environment.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to produce concise, high-quality executive materials.
* Willingness and ability to be based permanently in Riyadh and travel within the Kingdom and wider region as required.

**Preferred experience**

* Saudi nationals are strongly encouraged to apply. Preference may be given to suitably qualified Saudi nationals in line with applicable localisation requirements and hiring laws.
* Fluent Arabic speaking and writing.
* Experience in one or more priority sectors such as government, sovereign and Vision 2030 entities, technology, entertainment, financial services, energy, critical infrastructure, industrials or logistics.
* Experience delivering multidisciplinary programmes that integrate risk, resilience, technology, intelligence or security expertise.
* Experience building a consulting capability, proposition or team in a growth market.
* Familiarity with technology-enabled risk and resilience solutions, analytics and responsible uses of AI.

**Qualifications and professional standing**

* Relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Capabilities and behaviours**

* Commercial and business intellect

description:
بيوت هي بوابة العقارات الأولى في المملكة، حيث تربط ملايين المستخدمين في جميع أنحاء البلاد. نحن ملتزمون بتقديم أفضل تجربة بحث عبر الإنترنت. كجزء من مجموعة دوبيزل، تعمل بيوت إلى جانب بعض من أقوى العلامات التجارية في سوق الإعلانات المبوبة. مع قوة جماعية تضم 10 علامات تجارية، لدينا أكثر من 200 مليون مستخدم شهريًا يثقون في التزامنا بتقديم أفضل منصة تلبي احتياجاتهم.

نحن نبحث عن استشاري مبيعات متحمس ومتحفز للانضمام إلى فريق العقارات الديناميكي لدينا. يوفر هذا المنصب فرصة ممتازة للأفراد الذين يتطلعون إلى بدء مسيرة مهنية مجزية في قطاع العقارات. سيلعب شاغل الوظيفة دورًا محوريًا في نمو المنظمة من خلال بيع الوحدات العقارية، وفهم متطلبات العملاء، وتقديم العروض التوضيحية، وضمان إتمام الصفقات بنجاح.

### **المهام والمسؤوليات:**

**المبيعات العقارية**

* بيع العقارات السكنية والتجارية من مخزون الشركة.
* إجراء جولات ميدانية للعقارات، وتقديم المعلومات، والتفاوض على العروض نيابة عن العملاء.
* **فهم متطلبات العملاء**
* التفاعل مع العملاء لفهم احتياجاتهم العقارية وتفضيلاتهم.
* تقديم المشورة المهنية والتوجيه بشأن فرص الشراء والبيع والاستثمار العقاري.

**توليد العملاء المحتملين**

* توليد ومتابعة العملاء المحتملين لتوسيع قاعدة العملاء.
* تطوير والحفاظ على شبكة مهنية قوية لتعزيز فرص الأعمال.
* **تحليل السوق**
* البقاء على اطلاع دائم على اتجاهات السوق، وقيم العقارات، والعروض التنافسية.
* تزويد العملاء بمعلومات دقيقة ومحدثة عن السوق.
* **إدارة علاقات العملاء**
* التأكد من أن العملاء على دراية بالوحدات العقارية المتاحة، بما في ذلك ميزاتها وفوائدها وأسعارها.
* بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء لتعزيز الثقة والولاء.
* الحفاظ على التواصل المنتظم مع العملاء لمواكبة أي تغييرات في احتياجاتهم العقارية وتقديم الدعم المستمر.
* **العروض التوضيحية والزيارات الميدانية**
* تقديم العروض التوضيحية وترتيب الزيارات الميدانية للعملاء لمساعدتهم على تصور استثماراتهم المحتملة.
* **إتمام الصفقات**
* تسهيل إتمام الصفقات العقارية في الوقت المناسب، والتأكد من إتمام جميع الوثائق والإجراءات اللازمة.

**Requirements**

### **المؤهلات والمتطلبات:**

* يفضل امتلاك خبرة لا تقل عن سنتين في مجال المبيعات.
* مهارات تواصل وتفاوض ممتازة.
* مهارات تحليلية وحل المشكلات.
* القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل والتعاون ضمن فريق.
* شغف قوي بالمبيعات وتقديم خدمة عملاء استثنائية.

**Benefits**

### **بيئة العمل والمزايا:**

* بيئة عمل عالية الأداء وسريعة الإيقاع.
* تأمين صحي شامل.
* مكافآت وتقدير للإنجازات.
* فرص التعلم والتطوير.

Gymshark is one of the fastest growing and most recognisable fitness apparel and accessories brands, supported by over 22 million highly engaged social media followers and customers in 100’s of countries.
Imagine working in a world of rapid change, where open minded, ambitious, curious, creative and resourceful people exist.

Supervisor & Team Leader–
As a Team Lead & Supervisor at Gymshark, you will be vital in helping to maintain the vibe that our family feel online, IRL. You will ensure excellent customer service through effectively managing the department team; controlling and monitoring department operations including merchandising and stock control in order to achieve the department target.
Sales Advisor & Sales Consultant –
You ensure that our community has the most incredible Gymshark experience. Working with your team, you will bring a welcoming and positive energy to all those who visit. You will build authentic connections with visitors to your store, helping to educate them about conditioning sharing excellent product knowledge, operational best practice you will offer a best-in-class service, helping our community to shop how they want, and when they want.
Visual Merchandiser –
As Visual Merchandiser, you will bring our brand story to life through creative, impactful displays. You will be responsible for ensuring that every corner of the store reflects the Gymshark aesthetic — from window concepts to product presentation — creating a memorable shopping experience for our customers.
Cashier –
As a Cashier at Gymshark, you are the final touchpoint of the customer journey and play a key role in delivering a seamless, elevated in-store experience. You will be responsible for accurate and efficient transaction handling, maintaining cash desk standards, and supporting customers with a warm, professional approach. Attention to detail, speed, and integrity are essential, along with a genuine passion for service. The Cashier represents the brand at checkout, ensuring every customer leaves feeling valued, confident, and excited to return.

Essential Experience & Skills
• Experience in a similar or customer facing role
• Experience managing, leading and developing teams for team lead and supervisory roles)
• A shared passion for community, wellness and fitness
• Experience of working in a fast-paced, high volume, agile environment
• Highly effective communicator, written and verbal
Education/Certification and Continued Education
• High School qualification or higher

Job Description

Job Summary
The Inventory & Business Analyst is responsible for optimizing inventory performance and providing business and operational analysis to support effective decision-making. This role focuses on inventory planning, forecasting, KPI management, business reporting, and process improvement initiatives to drive operational efficiency and improve business performance.
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
Inventory Planning & Analysis
Maintain optimal inventory levels across raw materials, work-in-progress (WIP), and finished goods while minimizing stockouts, excess inventory, and obsolescence.
Analyze inventory trends, aging, slow-moving inventory, excess and obsolete (E&O) stock, and inventory turnover performance.
Identify opportunities to improve inventory efficiency and working capital performance.
Support inventory reconciliation activities and inventory performance reviews.

Business & Financial Analysis
Support inventory-related financial reporting, inventory valuation, provisions, adjustments, and inventory control activities.
Perform variance analysis against budget, forecast, and POR targets to identify performance gaps and business risks.
Investigate operational and financial variances and provide meaningful insights to management.
Collect, validate, and analyze business and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, and improvement areas.
Develop analysis and recommendations to support informed business decisions.

Reporting & KPI Management
Prepare and maintain inventory, operational, and business performance reports.
Monitor key performance indicators including inventory value, inventory turnover (ITO), inventory accuracy, shortages, aging, and E&O inventory.
Develop dashboards and management reports using ERP and business data.
Provide regular updates and business insights to leadership teams.

Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Support
Identify opportunities to improve reporting, data quality, automation, and operational processes.
Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory management and business performance.
Collaborate with Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Sales, Customer Service, and other functions to improve operational effectiveness.
Support business planning, forecasting, and operational review processes.

Who You Are
You use analytical thinking to solve complex business and operational challenges.
You have strong attention to detail and ensure data accuracy.
You proactively identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
You communicate insights effectively and influence data-driven decisions.
You collaborate across functions to achieve business objectives.
You are action-oriented and focused on delivering results.

For This Role, You Will Need
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
2-3 years of experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
Experience in inventory management, business analysis, operational reporting, or supply chain functions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with ERP systems and business reporting tools.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart
Experience with inventory planning, forecasting, and inventory optimization.
Knowledge of inventory accounting principles and financial reporting.
Experience with data visualization and dashboard development tools.
Familiarity with ERP systems, manufacturing operations, and supply chain processes.
Experience supporting process automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Job Purpose**

HanmiGlobal is seeking a highly qualified Telecom Engineer to join our program management and PMCM team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will deliver program-level telecommunications and ICT engineering expertise and technical governance for a mega multi-work package land and infrastructure development program in Riyadh, delivered on behalf of a major government entity.

You will be providing program-level technical expertise, engineering assurance, and collaborative oversight for reviewing and monitoring all telecommunications, ICT, and smart infrastructure designs across the program, ensuring all fiber optic networks, communication systems, and digital infrastructure submissions are fully integrated and compliant with approved standards, service provider requirements, and operational needs under the direction of the Technical Manager, while supporting the successful delivery of the overall development program.

**Reports To: Sr. Telecom Engineer**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review telecommunications engineering reports, ICT strategies, network studies, and design drawings prepared by Lead Developers to verify compliance with approved criteria and Client’s requirements.
* Assess fiber optic backbone networks, telecommunications duct banks, and network architectures for functionality, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Evaluate smart city infrastructure proposals, intelligent systems integration, and digital infrastructure initiatives to ensure future-ready and scalable capabilities.
* Support the implementation of program-level technical governance and engineering assurance processes across all package submissions.
* Coordinate with the Technical Manager, Senior Electrical Engineer, and program technical teams to resolve interface conflicts and integrate multidisciplinary infrastructure designs.
* Evaluate the technical, operational, and lifecycle impacts of design changes and telecommunications-related Value Engineering proposals submitted by Lead Developers.
* Provide specialist engineering expertise during technical workshops, design reviews, and coordination meetings to resolve project implementation issues.
* Collaborate with Lead Developers, consultants, telecom service providers, and regulatory authorities to streamline network connectivity and secure authority approvals.
* Prepare technical review comments, engineering assessments, and executive summaries for the Technical Manager, PMCM Management, and the Client.
* Identify and mitigate telecommunications and ICT-related compliance risks while promoting engineering excellence, digital transformation, and continuous improvement across the program.

**Requirements**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Communications Engineering, ICT Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Chartered Professional membership or equivalent professional accreditation.
* Minimum twelve (12) years of professional experience in telecommunications infrastructure, ICT systems, fiber optic networks, smart city infrastructure, or major capital projects.
* Experience within PMCM, PMC, consultancy, developer, telecommunications operators, or client-side organizations, preferably on large-scale infrastructure and land development projects in Saudi Arabia or the GCC region.

**Core Competencies**

* Telecommunications Engineering Design Review & ICT Infrastructure
* Fiber Optic Networks & Communications Systems Architecture
* Smart City Infrastructure & Digital Infrastructure Planning
* Telecommunications Utility Coordination & Network Capacity Assessment
* Technical Compliance Review & Engineering Assurance Frameworks
* Value Engineering Assessment & Constructability Review
* Technical Risk Assessment & Mitigation
* Technical Reporting & Telecom Service Provider Coordination
* Leadership, Strategic Thinking, Communication, Team Collaboration, and Problem Solving

Job Description
The Senior Planning Manager is responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing project schedules specific to fit-out projects, including interior finishes, MEP coordination, and phased delivery requirements. This role requires expertise in managing complex scheduling across multiple trades and subcontractors while ensuring alignment with main contract milestones and client requirements.
Key Responsibilities:
* Analyzes schedule data to identify critical path issues and potential delays in fit-out delivery phases.
* Develops and maintains comprehensive CPM schedules for fit-out projects, incorporating engineering, procurement, and construction phases with particular attention to trade sequencing and coordination requirements.
* Leads junior planning staff through assignment tasks and provides mentorship on fit-out scheduling best practices.
* Tracks and manages corrective actions to address schedule variances and coordinates schedule input from all organizational departments and subcontractors.
* Identifies, analyzes, and recommends corrective actions for schedule variances specific to fit-out project constraints and dependencies.
* Produces and updates comprehensive scheduling management reports for stakeholder review.
* Develops and maintains the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) for fit-out projects, ensuring effective project coding across all cornerstone applications.
* Utilizes drawings, specifications, and fit-out design documents to develop accurate and detailed schedules.
* Performs resource loading and schedule risk analysis to optimize labor allocation across multiple trades and phased delivery requirements.
* Assembles and manages data for regular schedule updates, reflecting progress on fit-out activities and subcontractor performance.
* Demonstrates knowledge of construction contracting terms and their scheduling implications, particularly as they relate to fit-out subcontracts and purchase orders.
* Monitors contractor progress, reviews invoices, and evaluates subcontract schedule performance to provide management with actionable insights.
* Manages scope control and change management processes, incorporating directed changes into the schedule baseline while maintaining earned value methodology standards.
* Assumes responsibility for baseline schedule maintenance and ensures schedule integrity throughout the fit-out project lifecycle.
* Applies cost analysis and forecasting techniques to support planning and scheduling decisions.
* Conducts performance measurement and analyzes schedule trends to support project forecasting and reporting.
* Supports multiple levels of project reporting to clients, stakeholders, and internal management.
* Leads and participates in project planning and scheduling review meetings, ensuring alignment across all fit-out phases and trade coordination.
* Assists in developing and implementing scheduling procedures and best practices specific to fit-out project delivery.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
+ Minimum 12-15 years of progressive experience in construction project planning and scheduling, with at least 8 years in a senior planning or scheduling management role
+ Extensive experience developing and managing Critical Path Method (CPM) schedules for complex fit-out, interior finishes, and MEP coordination projects
+ Proven expertise in multi-trade coordination and subcontractor scheduling management across phased delivery projects
+ Advanced proficiency with industry-standard scheduling software (Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or equivalent)
+ Demonstrated experience with Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) development and project coding across enterprise applications
+ Strong knowledge of construction contracting terms, subcontract management, and their scheduling implications
+ Proficiency in earned value management (EVM) methodology and schedule performance analysis
+ Proven track record of managing schedule baselines, change management processes, and scope control
+ Experience with resource loading, schedule risk analysis, and labor allocation optimization
+ Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor junior planning staff and cross-functional teams
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify critical path issues and recommend corrective actions
+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce comprehensive reports for multiple stakeholder levels
+ Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Project Management, or related field
Preferred Qualifications:
+ Project Management Professional (PMP) or Certified Scheduling Professional (CSP) certification
+ Experience with Building Information Modeling (BIM) integration in scheduling processes
+ Knowledge of construction accounting software and invoice management systems
+ Experience in commercial interior fit-out or tenant improvement projects
+ Familiarity with multiple scheduling methodologies and best practices development
+ Experience supporting multiple concurrent projects with complex dependencies

# **Practice Group**

  

We are widely regarded as having one of the leading corporate transactional and advisory practices in the world and we continue to act on some of the most prestigious and complex international deals. This is also true in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, where our corporate practice covers M&A (particularly cross border), joint ventures, securities and capital market transactions, regulatory, restructurings and reorganisations as well as more general corporate advisory work.

We act for a variety of organisations including sovereign wealth funds and government investment vehicles, leading regional and international corporates, international and regional banks, some of the most successful regional and international private equity houses, supporting them with their most complex and strategically important transactions.

Our core sectors include financial institutions, energy (especially oil & gas) and utilities, healthcare, retail and consumer and telecommunications within which we advise on outbound investments across the globe as well mandates throughout the region including in the GCC, wider Middle East and North Africa.

Our practice is ranked Band 1 across the Middle East by all of the leading legal research directories.

Our Saudi team, based in Riyadh, comprises of lawyers who are supported by the Freshfields offices in Bahrain, Abu Dhabi and Dubai, as well as the other offices across our international network.  We work together on local and international transactions on a daily basis, providing clients with a seamless service across all aspects of Saudi law.

Our Global M&A and Capital (GMAC) Practice is Freshfields MENA’s largest practice with over 45 lawyers throughout the region, including 9 partners.

   

# **Role Summary**

We have advised clients in the MENA region for over 40 years and have been building a presence in Saudi Arabia for the past 17 years. During this time we have established the firm as a leader in the legal market, acting on many of the best deals and winning over key regional clients.

After another strong year, the MENA Global M&A and Capital practice has a solid pipeline of work for the most high profile and highly sophisticated clients in the region. As a result, we are looking to recruit legal trainees to join the GMAC practice in Riyadh. The successful candidate is a national of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), has completed a bachelor’s degree in law in KSA and is registered or is in the process of registering for a training licence with the Saudi Ministry of Justice as a Legal Trainee. The role will work on a broad mix of transactions and matters.  Most of the work will have a significant international dimension (bringing with it real visibility across our network) and will range from some of the largest and most complex transactions to smaller deals which provide greater responsibility. The legal trainee will gain exposure and experience in many areas of commercial law as well as participating in matters with the MENA Dispute Resolution team, where appropriate and required.

  

# **Key Responsibilities and Deliverables**

·         Working on a wide variety of transactions for a range of clients, supervised by experienced lawyers

·         Involvement in the highest profile transactions in the market and providing legal support where required

·         Contributing to developing and deepening relationships with existing key clients

·         Involvement in research, translations, business development, knowledge management and other tasks as assigned by the MENA GMAC and DR teams as appropriate

  

# **Key Requirements**

 ·         KSA national

·         Completed a bachelor’s degree in law at one of the universities in KSA

·         Completed registration or willingness to comply with the requirements to register for a training licence with the Saudi Ministry of Justice as a Legal Trainee

·         Strong academic record and qualifications

·         Good technical and commercial background

·         Excellent communications in English (oral and written)

·         Able to work effectively as part of a team

·         Confident, self-motivated and committed to providing excellent client service

·         Able to adopt a flexible and proactive approach and retain a professional attitude under pressure

·         Able to manage a high degree of responsibility of work demands

·         Good organisational skills and attention to detail

·         Willingness to learn and broaden experience in legal and related non-legal activities such as business development and knowledge management

·         Preferably has experience working in a legal environment

The BMS Systems Engineer is responsible for operating, configuring, and optimizing the company’s Building Management System (BMS) based on Johnson Controls technology (Metasys or FX) and its integrated subsystems.  
This role ensures the reliability and performance of all automated systems, including HVAC, lighting, fire alarm, access control, and energy metering.  
The engineer acts as the technical authority for BMS operations, leading system improvements, integrations, and vendor coordination to support efficient and smart building performance across company projects.

### Responsibilities

* Operate, configure, and maintain the Johnson Controls BMS to ensure optimal performance and uptime.
* Monitor alarms, graphics, logic sequences, and trend logs for accurate system operation.
* Integrate and maintain connections with HVAC, lighting, fire alarm, access control, and energy systems.
* Plan and implement system upgrades, enhancements, and network reliability improvements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and communication issues.
* Conduct preventive maintenance and maintain updated backups and documentation.
* Lead technical reviews and support commissioning for BMS-related works.
* Evaluate vendor submittals, as-built drawings, and compliance with company standards.
* Analyze data and trends to identify performance issues and energy optimization opportunities.
* Prepare technical reports and KPIs for management review.
* Maintain accurate system records, schematics, and configuration documentation.
* Train and support maintenance and operations teams on BMS functionality and safety procedures.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Mechanical, or Control Systems Engineering.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Building Management Systems with direct Johnson Controls expertise.
* Strong technical skills in BMS configuration, programming, troubleshooting, and optimization.
* Knowledge of HVAC, lighting, fire, and metering system integration.
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and OPC.
* Experience with system architecture, controllers, and field devices.
* Proficiency in Johnson Controls Metasys UI, configuration tools, SCADA or CAFM platforms, and Excel or Power BI.
* Certification in Johnson Controls Metasys or equivalent BMS platforms (preferred).
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent English communication, Arabic is an advantage.

**Benefits**

* Private Health Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Training & Development
* Performance Bonus

Job Description**

Splunk, a Cisco company, is building a safer and more resilient digital world with an end-to-end full stack platform made for a hybrid, multi-cloud world. Leading enterprises use our unified security and observability platform to keep their digital systems secure and reliable. Come help organizations be their best, while you reach new heights with a team that has your back.

Meet the Team

Join Splunk’s regional sales team focused on the Saudi Arabia market, with a primary focus on Large Public Sector accounts. The team helps large organizations adopt enterprise data management software solutions that support IT systems, infrastructure, application management, security, and analytics needs. You will work closely with sales engineering, in-house Splunk teams, partner services resources, alliances, and both international and domestic colleagues. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a growing business, expand customer value, and build success in a fast-moving enterprise software environment.

**Your Impact**

Drive license sales, support, and service revenue across Large Public Sector accounts in Saudi Arabia. Build account plans and manage opportunities to increase account penetration and customer value. Negotiate pricing and business terms with large enterprises by clearly demonstrating value and return on investment. Collaborate with partners, alliances, sales engineering, and internal teams to maximize deal effectiveness and expand deal size. Provide timely market and customer insights to product management, marketing, and other corporate functions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years enterprise software sales experience with large Public Sector accounts in Saudi Arabia.
* Experience selling software in IT systems, enterprise or infrastructure management, application development and management, security, and/or analytics.
* Experience using CRM systems, such as Salesforce.
* Track record of success with prospects and customers in a defined territory.
* Experience applying a structured sales methodology and sales process.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ability to grow and scale with a fast-growing company.
* Strong executive presence and ability to engage senior customer stakeholders.
* Ability to make accurate forecasting commitments.
* Strong written, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable working independently and remotely from team members and corporate offices.

# Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

  

Cisconians power the future. We make impact as a team, innovating fast and fearlessly to create meaningful solutions on a large scale. The depth and breadth of our technology doesn't just benefit our customers – it also means limitless opportunities for us to experiment and learn. We understand the power each of our unique backgrounds bring when we work together. Because of that, we have a global network of thinkers, doers, experts, and curious creators who help one another do their life’s best work.

job_title: SAP Procurement Solutions Analyst - S/4HANA & Ariba (Saudi Arabia)
description:
We are seeking an experienced **SAP Procurement Solutions Analyst – S/4HANA & Ariba** to support and enhance procurement technology solutions across **SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)**.

The role will focus on enabling efficient and integrated **Source-to-Pay / Procure-to-Pay (P2P)** processes, supporting procurement operations, supplier lifecycle management, sourcing, purchasing, and related digital procurement capabilities.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, procurement teams, IT teams, suppliers, and technology partners to analyze business requirements, support solution design, troubleshoot system issues, and drive continuous improvements across SAP procurement platforms.

The work location would be at **Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia.**

Responsibilities

* Support and maintain procurement solutions across **SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, and SAP BTP**.
* Analyze business requirements and translate procurement processes into effective SAP solutions.
* Support **SAP MM / Materials Management** processes, including purchasing, purchase orders, goods/services procurement, and related master data.
* Support end-to-end **Procure-to-Pay (P2P)** processes and ensure effective integration between procurement systems.
* Provide functional support for **SAP Ariba** modules and capabilities, including:

* Ariba Sourcing
* Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP)
* Guided Buying
* Supplier onboarding
* Supplier relationship management
* Procurement and sourcing processes

* Support **supplier lifecycle management**, including supplier onboarding, qualification, maintenance, and integration with enterprise systems.
* Support **service procurement** processes, including Service Entry Sheets and related purchasing activities.
* Support procurement processes within **SAP S/4HANA and ECC**, ensuring alignment with business and operational requirements.
* Analyze and resolve system issues, incidents, and process-related challenges across SAP procurement platforms.
* Support integrations between **SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP**, and other enterprise applications.
* Work with technical teams to investigate integration issues, data flows, interfaces, and system defects.
* Participate in solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support.
* Prepare and maintain functional specifications, process documentation, test scenarios, and user documentation.
* Support **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** and coordinate with business users to validate solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes through automation, system enhancements, and digital procurement capabilities.
* Collaborate with procurement, finance, supply chain, IT, and other business stakeholders to ensure solutions meet operational requirements.
* Support system upgrades, enhancements, releases, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Monitor procurement system performance and ensure timely resolution of business-critical issues.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in **Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems**, or a related discipline.
* **5–7 years of relevant experience** in SAP procurement solutions, SAP functional consulting, business systems analysis, or a related field.
* Strong experience with **SAP S/4HANA Procurement and SAP MM**.
* Hands-on experience with **SAP Ariba** and its procurement and sourcing capabilities.
* Good understanding of **Source-to-Pay (S2P) / Procure-to-Pay (P2P)** business processes.
* Experience with **Ariba Sourcing, Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Guided Buying, and supplier onboarding**.
* Strong understanding of purchasing processes, including **purchase orders, supplier management, material management, and service procurement**.
* Experience with **Service Entry Sheets** and service procurement processes.
* Knowledge of **SAP ECC Procurement** and integration with S/4HANA environments.
* Understanding of **SAP Ariba integrations** with S/4HANA/ECC and other enterprise systems.
* Exposure to **SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)** and its role in enterprise application integration and digital solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technology solutions.
* Good understanding of procurement and supplier management business processes.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working with cross-functional business and IT teams.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

### Preferred

* SAP certification in **SAP S/4HANA Procurement, SAP MM, or SAP Ariba**.
* Experience with SAP Ariba implementation, rollout, enhancement, or integration projects.
* Experience working in large-scale enterprise procurement environments.
* Knowledge of SAP integration technologies and APIs.
* Experience with process optimization, automation, and digital procurement transformation initiatives.

job_title: Workplace Health and Safety Officer, Workplace Health and Safety
description:
Description
The Site WHS Officer will be responsible for partnering with a site operations team in a delivery station to execute company safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates. A successful Site WHS Officer will demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and inspire change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis.
The Site WHS Officer must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will instruct and train Operations Leaders in Amazon WHS policies and assist the operations site teams in incorporating our safety standards at their site. You will work to identify best practices and incorporate these standard methodologies into our standards to continuously improve the safety landscape.
Site WHS officer will possess excellent safety program knowledge as well as environmental and ergonomic knowledge and be able demonstrate this expertise when working with Operations.
The Site WHS officer will be a part of site WHS team and reports to site WHS manager. The WHS officer should be flexible to work in shifts.
Possess a thorough understanding of local/regional regulations and company policy.
Key job responsibilities
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon WHS standards/Policies.
- Measure site performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
- Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
- Analyze safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to rationalize the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
- Ensure proper Incident Investigation and closure of Corrective action and preventive action.
- Perform frequent site safety audits to identify all non-compliance equipment and/or processes at the site.
- Implement solutions to eliminate exposure to these risks and prevent injury.
- Audit record-keeping practices and ensure Austin entries to be aligned with global WHS standards and local regulations.
- Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
- Lead and mentor Safety Associates in your assigned facility during peak.
- Spend time at the delivery station and seek input from Safety teams, Associates and leaders on safety program improvement opportunities. Ensure open communication on status of progress and resolution against these suggestions.
- Ensure site leadership and Associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy. Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required safety training.
- Ensure the PPE’s inventory at site and coordinate with procurement will place order accordingly.
- Ensure site PPE compliance.
- You have to implement the best practices at site.
- Implement PIT (powered industrial truck) safety and yard safety system.
- Ensure standard Work Permit System usage at site.
- Implement and ensure safe contractor management at site.
- Ensure basic safety training calendar for associates and imparting trainings as per the same.
- Work along with facility team and ensure preventive maintenance of all Fire protection and emergency equipment’s
- Ensure basic Fire Fighting training and first aid training requirements.
Basic Qualifications
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Work all days and shifts, including overtime (24 hours a day, 7 days a week operation, including holidays)
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 3+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
Preferred Qualifications
- 3+ years of implementing safety standards experience
- Experience with OSHA regulations
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering
- NEBOSH (National General Certificate)

Job Description
QAQC Mechanical Engineer specializing in fit-out projects with expertise in quality assurance, quality control, and commissioning of mechanical systems during interior finishing phases.
Key Responsibilities:
+ Conduct comprehensive inspections and walk-downs of mechanical fit-out installations including HVAC systems, plumbing, fire protection systems, and equipment to verify conformance with design specifications and construction standards.
+ Perform quality assurance and quality control testing protocols including pressure testing, flushing, and TAB (Testing, Adjusting, and Balancing) records verification for all mechanical systems.
+ Verify proper installation of mechanical supports, hangers, and ancillary services in accordance with engineering drawings and project specifications.
+ Independently evaluate and apply standard engineering techniques and procedures to assess mechanical fit-out work quality and identify non-conformances.
+ Prepare detailed inspection reports, quantity surveys, and compliance documentation for tracking, reporting, and project closeout.
+ Coordinate with fit-out contractors and mechanical installers to ensure adherence to specifications and timely resolution of deficiencies.
+ Exercise sound professional judgment in assessing mechanical systems performance and recommending corrective actions.
+ Provide technical guidance and direction to technicians, inspectors, and support personnel on fit-out mechanical quality standards and testing procedures.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
+ Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline from an ABET-accredited program
+ Minimum 10 years of professional experience in mechanical engineering, with at least 5 years specifically focused on quality assurance, quality control, and commissioning of mechanical systems in fit-out or interior finishing projects
+ Demonstrated expertise in inspecting and testing HVAC systems, plumbing systems, fire protection systems, and mechanical equipment installations
+ Proficiency in pressure testing, system flushing, TAB (Testing, Adjusting, and Balancing) procedures, and commissioning protocols
+ Strong knowledge of mechanical engineering design standards, construction specifications, and industry best practices
+ Proven ability to prepare detailed inspection reports, compliance documentation, and technical assessments
+ Excellent communication and coordination skills with contractors, installers, and project teams
Preferred Qualifications:
+ Advanced degree (Master's) in Mechanical Engineering or related field
+ Certification in commissioning (CCP) or equivalent professional certification
+ Experience with Building Information Modeling (BIM) and mechanical design software
+ Track record of managing large-scale fit-out projects in commercial or institutional settings
+ Experience mentoring and supervising junior engineers and technical personnel

The Data Architect is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the enterprise data architecture to ensure that data is structured, integrated, governed, secure, reusable, and aligned with business and digital transformation objectives. The role covers current-state assessment, target-state design, enterprise data models, data domains, master and reference data, data integration, lineage, metadata, analytics platforms, and data governance alignment.

**Requirements**

· Develop and maintain the enterprise data architecture in alignment with business strategy and enterprise architecture direction.

· Assess the current data landscape, including data sources, data stores, applications, interfaces, ownership, duplication, and quality issues.

· Define target-state data architecture and transition roadmaps that support enterprise transformation initiatives.

· Establish enterprise data domains and define relationships between domains, business capabilities, applications, and data owners.

· Develop conceptual, logical, and high-level physical data models where required.

· Define master data, reference data, transactional data, analytical data, and metadata architecture.

· Identify and document authoritative data sources and Systems of Record.

· Design data lineage, data flow, and information exchange models across business and technology environments.

· Define application-to-data relationships, CRUD responsibilities, and data ownership dependencies.

· Design enterprise data integration and data-sharing patterns, including APIs, batch integration, event-driven exchange, and data pipelines.

· Support architecture for data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, analytics platforms, and business intelligence environments.

· Define data architecture principles, standards, patterns, and reference architectures.

· Align data architecture with data governance, data quality, metadata management, privacy, security, and retention requirements.

· Support Master Data Management and Reference Data Management initiatives.

· Collaborate with business, data governance, application, integration, security, cloud, and infrastructure teams.

· Participate in architecture governance and solution design reviews to ensure compliance with enterprise data architecture.

· Support technology and platform evaluations related to databases, data integration, analytics, metadata, MDM, and data management platforms.

· Identify data-related risks, gaps, dependencies, duplication, ownership issues, and improvement opportunities.

Required Experience

· Minimum 8-10 years of experience in data management, data engineering, database design, analytics, information architecture, or related disciplines.

· At least 4-5 years of hands-on experience in Data Architecture or a comparable senior data design role.

· Demonstrated experience developing enterprise data models, data domains, lineage, and target-state data architecture.

· Experience with enterprise-scale transformation, data modernization, digital transformation, or data governance initiatives.

· Strong experience working across multiple applications, databases, data platforms, and integration technologies.

· Experience working with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards, technology teams, and senior management.

Core Competencies

· Enterprise Data Architecture

· Conceptual and logical data modeling

· Data domain modeling

· Master and reference data architecture

· Data lineage and information flow modeling

· Metadata architecture and data catalog concepts

· Data integration and interoperability

· Data governance and data ownership alignment

· Data quality architecture

· Data warehouse, data lake, and lakehouse architecture

· Analytics and business intelligence architecture

· Database and data platform architecture

· Architecture governance and assurance

· Stakeholder management and consulting

Preferred Frameworks, Standards & Methods

· DAMA-DMBOK

· TOGAF

· ArchiMate

· UML

· Entity Relationship Modeling

· Data Vault, dimensional modeling, or equivalent data modeling approaches where relevant

· Data governance and metadata management practices

· Cloud data architecture frameworks and well-architected principles

Personal Attributes

Planning & Scheduling

procedure(s).

**Job Description Summary:**

The Civil Engineer is responsible for the review, coordination, and supervision of all civil and structural aspects of AAR's construction projects, ensuring compliance with project requirements, design intent, quality standards, operational needs, and applicable regulations.  
  
Acting on behalf of the Owner, the Civil Engineer provides technical oversight throughout the design, procurement, construction, testing, and handover phases, ensuring that civil and structural works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, project objectives, and contractual requirements.  
  
The role is site-based and works closely with GPP (Aviagen's design and construction supervision consultant), project managers, contractors, suppliers, and site supervision teams to supervise, coordinate, inspect, approve, and resolve technical issues, monitor progress, manage interfaces between disciplines, and support successful project delivery.

**Job Description:**

**Design & Technical Review**

● Review design drawings, shop drawings, material submittals, technical specifications, BOQs, and method statements for civil and structural works.

● Review and approve material selections and technical specifications for façade systems, waterproofing systems, and specialized building components.

● Provide technical recommendations to improve functionality, constructability, maintainability, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness.

  

**Site Supervision & Construction Monitoring**

● Review and supervise civil and structural works to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.

● Monitor construction activities to ensure proper implementation of civil infrastructure, buildings, and site development works.

● Supervise earthworks, roads, drainage systems, utility corridors, concrete and steel works, foundations, and building construction activities.

● Coordinate closely with architectural, mechanical, and electrical engineers to ensure proper integration of all building systems.

  

**Inspection, Testing & Quality Control**

● Track, review, and approve the full inspection cycle: vendor, subcontractor, material, and testing-laboratory approval; verification of materials on delivery; stage-by-stage inspection and acceptance of works; testing, commissioning, operational readiness, and final handover; and support for quantity verification, progress measurement, and payment certification.

● Participate in inspections, snagging activities, punch list reviews, and final handover processes.

● Ensure compliance with quality assurance and quality control requirements.

  

**Coordination & Procurement Support**

● Coordinate with consultants, contractors, suppliers, and site supervisors on all civil and structural matters.

● Support procurement activities through technical evaluation of suppliers, subcontractors, materials, and construction systems.

  

**Reporting & Risk Management**

● Monitor progress against project schedules, identifying risks, delays, and potential technical issues.

● Prepare technical reports, site observations, progress updates, and recommendations for project management and clients.

  

**HSE Compliance**

Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.

# Project Overview:
Expo 2030 Riyadh is a global platform where countries, organizations, and individuals will come together to collaborate. Under the theme “Foresight for Tomorrow,” the Expo promotes sustainable development, innovation, and transformative thinking. The event will be held from October 2030 to March 2031 and is expected to welcome over 40 million visits.
The 6 km² Masterplan outlines a comprehensive framework for participation and infrastructure at the Expo. The exhibition space, totaling 491,100 m² GFA, can accommodate up to 197 participating countries and 29 international organizations. Working collaboratively with our customer, Expo 2030 Riyadh Company (ERC), Bechtel will manage the infrastructure program which comprises early works, utilities, and publicly accessible spaces like streets and parks. Our scope on the six-square-kilometer site will transition into a mixed-use legacy development to serve the community after the six-month event is over. The project’s master plan leverages international sustainability standards for urban afforestation, treated water, and energy sources.

**Job Summary:**

Raytheon Saudi Arabia has an opening for a Principal Specialist Financial Analyst in support of its Saudi Arabia Programs portfolio. This is a seasoned professional contributor role with advanced knowledge of program finance, financial planning and analysis, and indirect cost rate management. The successful candidate will work autonomously with limited oversight and serve as a strategic business partner to program and functional leadership across active in-Kingdom programs.

This position operates at a level that directly impacts operational results within the finance work area. The analyst will coach and review the work of junior finance professionals, influence policies and practices, and take ownership of complex financial deliverables across the full program finance lifecycle — including EAC development, financial metrics analysis, indirect rates analysis, and financial planning.

  

**What You Will Do:**

  

**Program Finance & Controls**

* Lead preparation of weekly and monthly program financial reports and customer financial deliverables
* Own monthly sales, profit, and cash forecasting across assigned program portfolio
* Lead quarterly Estimates at Completion (EAC) development including cost, schedule, risk, and opportunity analysis
* Perform detailed variance analysis to budget baselines and communicate findings clearly to program and finance leadership
* Develop and maintain Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)
* Support preparation of cost CDRLs including Integrated Program Management Reports (IPMRs) and Contractor Funding Summary Reports (CFSRs)
* Support proposal cost development and basis of estimate preparation for new business opportunities

**Indirect Rates Analysis**

* Analyze and monitor indirect cost rates (overhead, G&A, fringe) against budgeted and forecasted pools and bases.
* Support development and maintenance of forward pricing rate estimates and submissions.
* Assess the impact of indirect rate variances on program cost positions and EAC development.
* Partner with accounting and estimating functions to reconcile actual indirect charges against applied rates.
* Identify trends and variances in indirect cost pools and communicate risks and opportunities to leadership.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Coach and review the work of junior finance professionals, providing guidance on deliverables, analytical approach, and professional development
* Serve as a strategic business partner to program managers, contracts, engineering, and operations functions.
* Influence financial policies, practices, and procedures within the finance work area.
* Prepare and present financial analysis to senior program and finance leadership with clarity and confidence.
* Support ad hoc financial investigations, special projects, and senior leadership requests.  
    

  

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Typically requires A University Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field from a recognized Saudi or international university and minimum 5 years of relevant finance or accounting experience, or an advanced degree in a related field with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.
* Demonstrated experience in program financial analysis, EAC development, or cost controls in a project- or contract-based environment.
* Experience with indirect cost rate structures, cost pool analysis, or forward pricing.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SAP or equivalent ERP/financial systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, including experience presenting to senior leadership.

  

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Experience supporting Earned Value Management (EVM) on government or defense contracts.
* Knowledge of government contracting financial requirements.
* Proven ability to manage small projects or processes within area of responsibility with limited oversight.
* Experience coaching or mentoring junior finance staff.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a track record of identifying and implementing process improvements.
* Experience with OneStream, SAP Business Warehouse, or similar financial planning tools.
* Background in aerospace, defense, or government contracting finance.

**Role purpose**

  

Provide operational and technical support for CSG-managed Mobily platforms by monitoring system health, responding to alarms and incidents, performing initial troubleshooting, coordinating escalations, and tracking issues through resolution and closure.

  

**Key responsibilities**

* Monitor application, infrastructure, and service-health dashboards, email alerts, and Microsoft Teams notifications for abnormal conditions and threshold breaches.
* Acknowledge alerts and operational requests from Mobily NOC and other stakeholder teams, collect the required samples or evidence, and provide timely status updates.
* Log and manage incidents according to severity, impact, and operational procedures; ensure that the correct support group is engaged.
* Perform first-level technical triage using logs, monitoring information, system status, and customer-provided examples.
* Investigate and coordinate support for issues involving file-system utilization, high memory usage, database blocking sessions, log growth, downstream connectivity, and degraded Gy/telecom KPIs.
* Escalate complex issues to L2 application teams, DBA, Unix/Linux, Platform Engineering, or other specialist teams with clear problem statements, evidence, timestamps, and business impact.
* Track open incidents, service requests, and planned activities through completion; confirm activity outcomes and communicate closure status to stakeholders.
* Support operational activities for Singleview/New Stack environments, including health checks, database-related investigations, AWR-report coordination, and application-access or environment-support requests.
* Maintain accurate incident, request, and activity records, including actions taken, evidence collected, assigned teams, status updates, and closure information.
* Contribute to SLA and operational reporting, repeat-ticket analysis, service-health reporting, and continuous improvement of monitoring and support procedures.
* Follow established Mobily L1/L2 operating procedures, escalation paths, change controls, and information-security requirements.
* Collaborate with CSG colleagues, Mobily operations, NOC teams, database administrators, platform engineers, and infrastructure support teams across shifts or planned maintenance windows.

  

**Typical day-to-day tasks**

* Review monitoring dashboards and incoming operational emails for new alarms or incidents.
* Validate alerts and identify the affected host, application, environment, KPI, or customer-impacting service.
* Raise or update the relevant incident or service request with severity, impact, technical details, and supporting evidence.
* Check logs, file-system capacity, memory utilization, database symptoms, and connectivity indicators as appropriate to the issue.
* Engage the appropriate resolver group and follow up until the issue is restored or a confirmed next action is agreed.
* Provide progress updates to stakeholders and record the activity outcome.
* Support planned production activities by communicating schedules, monitoring execution, and confirming completion.
* Review recurring incidents and contribute information for SLA, health-check, and repeat-ticket reports.

  

**Key deliverables**

* Timely alert acknowledgement and incident registration.
* Complete and accurate incident/service-request records.
* Evidence-based escalations to resolver teams.
* Regular stakeholder status updates and activity-completion confirmations.
* Accurate operational, SLA, health-check, and repeat-ticket reporting.
* Clear handover information for unresolved or ongoing issues.

  

**Required knowledge and skills**

* Experience in telecom or enterprise IT operations and production support.
* Practical understanding of incident management, severity assessment, escalation, and SLA tracking.
* Working knowledge of Linux/Unix troubleshooting, application logs, file systems, and basic SQL/database concepts.
* Familiarity with monitoring dashboards, alarms, KPI analysis, and operational reporting.
* Ability to investigate issues methodically and communicate concise technical findings.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with application, database, infrastructure, NOC, and customer teams.
* Willingness to work in a shift-based or on-call operational support model, where required.
