job_title: Associate Consultant Intern, Summer 2027 – Saudi Arabia
description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Associate Consultant Intern, Summer 2027 – Saudi Arabia
Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining Why join Mastercard’s internship program?
Mastercard's internship program offers more than hands-on work. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities.
About the team
Mastercard’s Advisors & Consulting Services (A&CS) team helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities.
What you’ll do
As an Associate Consultant Intern, you will collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions. You will immediately create meaningful contributions through ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality, and more.
You will:
Work in small teams to support strategic consulting projects across industries
Collaborate with colleagues across different areas of the organization and gain exposure to business development, account management, and product management
Analyze data, identify trends, and help translate insights into recommendations
Create clear and compelling presentations for internal teams and clients
Support problem solving by structuring challenges and exploring solutions
Build an understanding of how consulting engagements are delivered end to end
Participate in volunteer and team building experiences
Gain exposure to our leadership team through networking sessions and speaker series
Begin to build relationships with clients to understand their business needs, seek strategic solutions and guide impactful decisions
Grow by receiving hands-on mentorship from an experienced management team
Specialization Tracks
We are looking for passionate and talented professionals who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs. We are recruiting five specialization tracks that make up our team. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences.
Business Experimentation
Leverage Mastercard's industry-leading predictive analytics platform, Test & Learn®, and SQL to run data-backed business experiments for our clients. Consultants focus on data science-based solutions to provide insights on various business initiatives, including product launches, marketing campaigns, customer loyalty, and pricing across various industries that touch many Fortune 500 companies. Partner directly with clients to share findings and help determine which ideas are effective, as well as where, when, and how to implement them.
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:
Where should a retailer open new stores to maximize profitability and minimize the cannibalization of nearby omnichannel sales?
What bonus should be provided to someone opening a credit card account to entice them to use the card regularly?
Strategy & Transformation
Guide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms.
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:
How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market?
How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial, and strategic goals?
Performance Analytics
Use quantitative and qualitative skills and enterprise applications (e.g., Business Intelligence Platforms, SQL, Python, and more) to drive data-led consulting solutions for customers. Weave together vast amounts of Mastercard, client & 3rd party data assets to investigate trends, build propensity models, develop data visualizations, and synthesize millions of data points into a cohesive story. Engage with client stakeholders through virtual and in-person meetings, leveraging insights to inform strategic recommendations.
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:
How does a financial institution fraud/authorization metrics fare against competitors, and what are strategies that can help it be best-in-class?
How is a technology customer’s market share changing over time, and are there any segments where the client is relatively under penetrated?
Marketing
Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard.
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:
How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications?
How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer?
How can a large financial institution best execute a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more?
Deploy
Help clients implement, launch, and scale Mastercard products, platforms, and business transformation initiatives. Combine program management, stakeholder engagement, and implementation expertise to guide complex initiatives from strategy into execution.
Work closely with client and Mastercard teams, coordinate cross-functional efforts, manage risks and dependencies, and drive adoption to ensure clients realize value from their investments.
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:
How can a financial institution successfully implement and launch a new payments, fraud, or digital banking solution while minimizing disruption to customers and internal teams?
What governance structure, implementation roadmap, and stakeholder engagement plan will best position a client to deliver a large-scale transformation on time and within scope?
How can a client accelerate adoption and maximize the value of a newly deployed platform, product, or technology investment across its organization?
As an intern, you'll benefit from
Mentorship and coaching from experienced professionals and leaders
Networking opportunities with fellow interns, employees, and senior leaders
Professional development experiences focused on career growth and skill-building
Exposure to innovative technologies and global business challenges
Volunteer, community engagement, and team-building activities
What we’re looking for
Undergraduate or master’s degree with an expected graduation date between Dec 2027-July 2028
Language Proficiency:
Proficiency in English is mandatory
Proficiency in two or more languages is considered a strong plus.
Availability: Must be available to start the internship on June 2027
We recruit for and value the following core competencies:
Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities.
Analytic Excellence: Demonstrates a strong aptitude for structured problem solving, analytical, and quantitative skills. Experience using data analysis or querying tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Excel or Tableau) is an asset (particularly for Performance Analytics or Business Experimentation tracks).
Business Interest: Clear interest in the world of business, and intuition for the way that companies make decisions.
Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities.
Teamwork: Willingness to work within small teams to produce outstanding deliverables, with a will to win attitude.
Integrity: Outstanding record of academic achievement. Commitment to Mastercard's values of honesty and integrity with a willingness to embrace and learn from mistakes.
Diverse Perspective: Brings a unique skillset or approach to the table in every client engagement or internal activity.
Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Many of our interns continue building their careers with Mastercard through full-time opportunities, early career programs, or future internships.
To participate in our job simulation and experience what it’s like to work as a Consultant at Mastercard visit: https://www.theforage.com/simulations/mastercard/advisors-client-services-xvlw
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
+ Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
+ Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
+ Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
+ Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

انضم إلى شبكة مدربي WPO العالمية | كن مدربًا معتمدًا في مجال الصحة النفسية والرفاهية

الموقع: مرن / عن بُعد | فرص عالمية

في Workplace Options (WPO)، نؤمن بأن التواصل الإنساني هو أساس الصحة النفسية والرفاهية. بصفتنا شركة رائدة عالميًا في خدمات الصحة النفسية والرفاهية، نتعاون مع مدربين خبراء لتقديم جلسات تفاعلية مؤثرة تُحفز التغيير الإيجابي في أماكن العمل حول العالم. ستتولى تقديم ندوات عبر الإنترنت، وندوات، وورش عمل حول المرونة، والقيادة، والصحة النفسية، والسلامة النفسية، وغيرها من المواضيع الحيوية المتعلقة بالصحة النفسية والرفاهية في مكان العمل، مما يُمكّن الموظفين من الازدهار في بيئة العمل الديناميكية الحالية.

ما ستفعله
بصفتك مدربًا معتمدًا في WPO، ستتولى المهام التالية:
• تقديم جلسات تفاعلية وجذابة حول مجموعة واسعة من مواضيع الصحة النفسية والرفاهية، مع تكييف أسلوبك ليتناسب مع مختلف الجماهير العالمية.

• تقديم محتوى مُصمم خصيصًا من قِبل WPO، مع تخصيص الأمثلة وطريقة التقديم لتناسب مختلف القطاعات والثقافات والسياقات التنظيمية.

• إنشاء بيئات تعليمية تفاعلية باستخدام المناقشات، واستطلاعات الرأي، والتأملات، وجلسات الأسئلة والأجوبة لتعزيز مشاركة المشاركين واستيعابهم للمعلومات.

• تنفيذ الدورات التدريبية عن بُعد وفي الموقع، مع ضمان سلاسة الإعدادات التقنية وفعالية التجارب.

• التعاون الوثيق مع فرق فعاليات التعلم في WPO قبل كل جلسة - مراجعة المواد، والتوافق مع أهداف العميل، والمشاركة في اجتماعات التحضير.

• الحفاظ على الحساسية الثقافية، والأصالة، والمهنية في أسلوب التيسير.

المؤهلات المطلوبة:
• خبرة لا تقل عن 3 سنوات كمدرب، أو مُيسّر، أو مُوجّه، أو مُتحدث عام، ويُفضّل الإلمام بمواضيع الصحة النفسية أو القيادة.

• عضوية في هيئة تنظيمية مهنية (مثل ICF، EAPA).

• مهارات تواصل وتيسير قوية - ثقة بالنفس، وشخصية جذابة، وقدرة على التفاعل مع مختلف الفئات.

• قدرة مثبتة على تقديم الدورات التدريبية لجمهور صغير وكبير عبر مختلف الوسائل (عن بُعد وحضورياً).

• شهادة ماجستير كحد أدنى أو ما يعادلها محلياً.

• إجادة استخدام المنصات الافتراضية مثل Zoom، وMicrosoft Teams، وWebex، أو ما يُماثلها.

• الالتزام باجتماعات التحضير والتنسيق.

مُفضّل ولكن ليس إلزاميًا
• خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في بيئة سريرية

• خبرة في العمل مع عملاء من شركات متعددة الجنسيات أو شركات كبرى.

• إلمام بمواضيع تشمل الصحة النفسية، والمرونة، والقيادة، والسلامة النفسية، أو ثقافة مكان العمل.

• الاستعداد والقدرة على السفر لحضور جلسات تدريبية في مواقع العمل عند الحاجة (تُغطى نفقات السفر).

• خبرة في المساهمة في تصميم المحتوى، أو تطوير المناهج، أو التصميم التعليمي.

• لماذا تنضم إلى شبكة المدربين العالمية التابعة لـ WPO؟

• تأثير عالمي - تقديم جلسات تدريبية لدعم الموظفين في أكثر من 200 دولة وثقافة.

• مرونة في المشاركة - اختيار جلسات تدريبية تناسب جدولك الزمني وخبرتك.

• دعم مستمر - الوصول إلى مواد عالية الجودة قائمة على أسس علمية وتنسيق متخصص.

• نمو مهني - اكتساب خبرة في التعامل مع عملاء متنوعين وتطوير مهاراتك في التيسير على مستوى العالم.

• مصداقية وهدف - الشراكة مع جهة رائدة موثوقة في مجال الصحة النفسية في مكان العمل على مستوى العالم.

• تعويضات تنافسية - الحصول على مكافأة عادلة مقابل خبرتك والتزامك.

كيفية التقديم

يرجى تقديم طلبك عبر الرابط التالي، والذي سيُوجهك خلال عملية التقديم الإلكترونية، بما في ذلك تقييم قصير للمهارات الإلكترونية حيث يمكنك مناقشة مجالات اهتمامك وخبراتك.

**The role**

As Material Inspector you inspect and verify the materials delivered to and used on site against the approved material submittals and the project specifications, on RCRC's behalf. The role is site-based and reports to the Materials Engineer / Quality Manager. Your inspection records and the test results you compile form part of the quality evidence RCRC relies on when accepting the completed works.

**What you'll do**

·       Inspect materials delivered to site against approved material submittals, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and the project specifications, before they are used in the works.

·       Witness sampling and field tests, and coordinate with the contractor's and third-party testing laboratories on test schedules and results.

·       Compile material test reports and maintain complete, properly archived material-inspection records.

·       Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for non-conforming materials and track corrective actions through to verified close-out.

·       Apply standardised inspection checklists, protocols and reporting templates consistently across sites, and complete inspections to the agreed schedule.

·       Support the Materials Engineer with trend analysis and reporting, flagging recurring material defects early so they can be addressed before they spread across the programme.

·       Support close-out by checking that material warranty certificates meet the contract requirements and that outstanding material inspection items are resolved before handover.

**What you'll need**

·       Diploma or degree in Civil or Materials Engineering.

·       Over 7 years' relevant experience with a degree, or 12 years' relevant experience in lieu of a degree (RCRC staff Category D).

·       Hands-on material inspection, sampling and testing experience on construction or infrastructure works.

·       Working knowledge of site QA/QC: material submittals and approvals, ITPs, inspection checklists, NCRs and test records.

·       Strong written and verbal communication in English and/or Arabic; both is an advantage.

Most of your time will go to major sports and entertainment developments across the Kingdom, shaping the digital and data foundations behind stadiums, arenas, training facilities and fan facing platforms. Required Experience and Skills • At least 7 years in solution or enterprise architecture, ideally on large programmes spanning many systems. • Demonstrated delivery of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), data platforms and API led integrations. • Practical experience connecting physical and digital environments such as IoT, access control, POS, CRM and analytics, b ackground in smart venues, stadiums, retail, hospitality or other large facilities is a strong advantage. • A record of leading client conversations: producing architecture documents, presenting to technical and executive audiences, and defending design choices. • Solid understanding of security, scalability and data governance for high volume,real time workloads such as live event traffic. • Ability to collaborate comfortably with commercially minded industry specialists. • Excellent written and spoken English. • Right to work, and willingness to be based onsite in Riyadh for the length of the engagement. Desirable • Background in sports technology, live entertainment, ticketing or smart venue platforms. • Experience on large scale developments in the Gulf region. • Knowledge of fan engagement products, sports data platforms or venue management systems. • Arabic and/or Spanish language ability. • Consulting or professional services experience. Who This Role Is Not For • Candidates whose experience is limited to infrastructure or DevOps without solution level design. • People who prefer to design alone, away from business and industry stakeholders. • Candidates who need a fully scoped brief before they can begin. Work Arrangement • Onsite in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Relocation is required for the engagement. • Working week follows the Saudi calendar, with flexibility around delivery milestones.

**Client Relationship Management**

·     Become an active part in the care of clients and be wholly familiar with contacts/clients and dealing with basic client queries as appropriate.

·     Manage the production of documents and check returned work produced by the Document Production team/speech recognition for accuracy/formatting before it is passed to the relevant Fee Earner.

·     Liaise with clients and marketing team to provide support for scheduling tender meetings, directory interviews, client training etc.

·     Manage Interaction and ensure new prospects, clients and contacts, activities and business development information are added.

·     Arrange photocopying, printing, organising couriers, sending out letters, faxes etc.

·     Receiving instructions via digital dictation for tasks and acting upon the same.

·     Maintaining LinkedIn profile, updating connections and adding new activity.

·     Arrange travel and accommodation, to prepare and produce and keep track of itineraries.

·     Arrange restaurant bookings for Business Development and Client meetings.

·     Maintain Fee Earner’s mailboxes and electronically file e-mails and documents.

·     Deal with e-mails during Fee Earner’s absence from the office and to take appropriate action.

·     Conduct ad hoc internet research.

·     Update client/contact database on Outlook as well as on InterAction.

·     Cover for other team members when required and capacity allows.

**Communication**

·     Key point of contact for Fee Earners and Clients including coordination with regional and cross-regional counterparts across MEA to maintain relationships and ensure a high level of support is always provided by the team.

·     Liaising with and providing support to immediate colleagues in the department, and where practical across the MEA region as requested by Team Leader. Assisting others where there is spare capacity, or it is evident that a colleague needs assistance with their workload.

·     Minute taking, following up designated actions to ensure completion ahead of the next meeting.

·     Liaison with and taking direction from your Legal Support Manager.

·     Liaise with the Legal Support Manager and Team Leader over any planned absences, arranging cover as necessary and communicating this to the relevant Fee Earners.

**Financial**

·     Assisting Fee Earners with billing related tasks.

·     Reviewing and updating time allocation and disbursements ensuring appropriate matter allocation.

·     Request cheques, bank transfers, and paying in money received, as appropriate.

·     Supporting the co-ordination of the WIP process.

·     Dealing with matter related finance administration to include APRs, BACs, TTs.

·     Processing expenses.

**Processing**

·     Responsible for managing priorities and workloads to ensure deadlines are met. Liaising with Team Leader/Legal Support Managers where challenges arise.

·     Responsible for managing the creation and maintenance of data rooms and client information in accordance with case milestones.

·     Responsible for ensuring client and matter data is maintained and updated within appropriate systems, raising requests with the BAU team globally as appropriate.

·     Ensuring compliance with firm wide/department policies and procedures.

**Customer Service**

·     Arranging and attending team meetings.

·     Liaising with Fee Earners, Team Leaders, and Legal Support Managers locally and across the MEA region to take instruction and liaise on work requirements.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

·     Advanced knowledge of document management/case management systems.

·     An effective communicator with the ability to establish and build client relationships, striving to provide exceptional service at all times.

·     Effective at investigating issues and seeing a problem through to conclusion.

·     Excellent team player, sharing in team goals to provide excellent quality and efficiency of service, with a willingness to take on new responsibilities and challenges.

Description
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.
This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.
This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.
Who Should Apply
We welcome applications from:
- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar. It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.
As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.
You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.
What You Will Do
You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).
In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.
Your day-to-day duties include:
- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians
- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets
- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills
- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance
- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians
- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site
Internship Structure
Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.
Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.
Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity
At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.
From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.
Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.
Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.
Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.
Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.
About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.
You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.
Basic Qualifications
- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar, graduating in 2027 – before the internship´s end date.
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills
Preferred Qualifications
- Basic knowledge of Linux and networking
- Basic knowledge of computer hardware components
- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager.
- An interest in computer sciences and information technology
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Description
Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.
This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.
Who Should Apply
We welcome applications from:
- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.
It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.
About the Role
As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.
You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.
What You Will Do
The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:
- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear
- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)
- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers
- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
- Building automation systems
Your day-to-day duties include:
- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment
- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment
- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows
- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site
Internship Structure
Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.
Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.
Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity
At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.
From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.
Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.
Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.
Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.
Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.
About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.
You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.
Basic Qualifications
- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, graduating in 2027 - before the end of the internship.
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills
- You must have access to your own transport (note: public transit options may be limited)
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in program or project management
- Knowledge of mechanical systems (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning systems, controls)

## Job Description

* Lead complex production planning, menu execution, mise-en-place, and kitchen coordination, ensuring consistent quality and efficient service delivery across all operating periods.
* Provide hands-on culinary leadership, ensuring assigned responsibilities are executed professionally, efficiently, and in accordance with established operational standards.
* Develop and implement structured culinary training, coaching, and knowledge-transfer initiatives to strengthen technical competencies, promote consistency, and support the progression of local culinary talent.

* Build effective working relationships across departments, promoting teamwork, accountability, professional development, and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Uphold the Resort's **"Yes I Can!"** service philosophy through genuine hospitality, professionalism, culinary excellence, and a commitment to exceeding guest expectations.

## Qualifications

* **Demonstrated international culinary exposure** through experience in internationally recognised luxury hospitality environments, with proven ability to apply global culinary standards, diverse cooking techniques, and best practices in high-volume, multi-cuisine operations.
* Advanced technical proficiency in Indian, Asian, Western, and international cuisines, with demonstrated experience in high-volume food production and maintaining consistent culinary standards.
* Proven ability to implement and maintain internationally benchmarked culinary standards, including recipe standardisation, quality assurance, consistent food presentation, and production controls.
* Extensive experience in managing complex culinary production, including menu planning, volume forecasting, yield optimisation, food costing, and inventory management.
* Strong working knowledge of HACCP principles, food safety management systems, hygiene standards, and applicable health and safety regulations.
* Proven track record of leading culinary teams, conducting structured technical training, and transferring specialist culinary knowledge to junior chefs.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain consistent culinary quality across multiple shifts, high-volume service periods, and diverse guest requirements.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organisational, and problem-solving skills, with a hands-on management approach and strong operational presence.
* High standards of personal integrity, professionalism, and accountability, with the ability to perform effectively under pressure and deliver exceptional guest experiences.
* Proficiency in relevant kitchen management systems, inventory applications, and standard computer software.

## Additional Information

**Live the Magic of Hospitality -** Be part of a team that creates **exceptional experiences and memorable moments** every day. Let your **Yes I Can!** spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

# Job Summary:
The Assistant Resident Engineer is assigned to a field construction organization in a supervisory capacity. Responsible for supervising and directing operations within assigned discipline or area. Supervises and directs Contractor’s activities, subordinate superintendents and others, as assigned. Ensures assigned construction operations and subcontractors performance are in compliance with specifications and within schedules and budgets. Performs general functions inherent in all supervisory field positions.
# Major Responsibilities:
+ Responsible for field construction operations within assigned discipline or area.
+ Determines contractor’s workforce requirements. Coordinates established area operational plans.
+ Monitors work activities and ensures the quality of work performed.
+ Ensures the most current design document is used to complete the work and that all design changes are approved prior to implementation.
+ Prepares daily reports and forecasts, including summary of construction progress, contractor personnel forecasts, and expenditures forecast.
+ Monitors tool usage on the site. Review Field Material Requisitions for tools and consumables and ensures that the crafts have the tools they require to be productive.
+ Monitors the activities of subcontractors to ensure compliance with specifications and schedules.
+ Responsible for the implementation of client/project policies, procedures and instructions within assigned operations.
+ Coordinates activities with other disciplines or areas and clients’ resident representatives, as instructed by construction management.
+ Performs employee reviews and identifies training and development opportunities for subordinate personnel.
+ Ensures that client, Bechtel and local/national safety codes, requirements and standards are being complied with within assigned area of responsibility.
+ Ensures the Zero Accident Philosophy is incorporated into every aspect of construction operations. Actively participates in scheduled safety meetings.
+ Implements Six Sigma tools, analysis, and decision making in the execution of duties.
# Education and Experience Requirements:
+ University Degree in Engineering with minimum 8-10 years of experience or 12-14 years of relevant work experience of construction experience.
+ Knowledge of a single or multi-discipline construction operation.
+ Knowledge of the use of contracts, and the contractor and subcontractor’s responsibilities contained in contract documents.
+ Experience working with, supervising and administering subcontractors and/or Direct Hire workforce.
+ Experience providing daily safety and quality inspections of Contractors’ physical works related road, bridge and associated utility and drainage construction.
+ Knowledge of the Project ES&H Handbook, the Supervisors ES&H Manual, the Project Safety Management Plan.
+ Knowledge of Bechtel and client Standard Work Process Procedures (SWPPs).
+ Computer literate in word processing, spreadsheet and database applications in accordance with current Bechtel Standard Application Program (BSAP) standards.
+ Previous Middle East work on mega civil projects and previous work on simultaneous projects.
+ Experience in projects which are Budgeted expenditure driven.
+ Experience reviewing Contractors’ submittals, work method statements, safety plans, quality plans and traffic control plans for compliance with contract documents.
+ Experience reviewing and processing the contractor’s monthly pay applications.
+ Experience reviewing and monitoring the Contractors’ project schedules.
+ Experience writing correspondences to contractors on contractual matters.
+ Experience in dealing with the change management & claims.
# Required Knowledge and Skills:
+ Knowledge of supervisory functions relating to field activities.
+ Ability to communicate effectively with others.
+ Contributes to achievement of team goals; promotes teamwork.
+ Ability to balance work requirements from multiple projects.
+ Serve as a resource for training/mentoring colleagues with less experience
+ Self-motivated individual with good leadership skills and experience and the ability to influence without authority.
+ Demonstrated leadership in a team-based environment.
+ Ability to manage priorities and take on additional evolving responsibilities with demonstrated experience providing direction/supervising a team.
+ Ability to work within an integrated RC/Bechtel/Contractors team at multiple levels in order to achieve safety standards and high quality work.
+ Ability to work within a culturally diverse organization, recognizing and respecting differences.

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.
The Partner Manager owns the health, performance, and strategy of the assigned partners within their territory, with a focus on pipeline development, market expansion, and sales execution. This role translates partner strategy into measurable business outcomes by aligning ServiceNow priorities with field and partner execution.
Working closely with Field Sales, Partners, Marketing, Enablement, Sales Operations, and Technical Partner Advisors (TPAs), the Partner Manager drives co-sell motions, identifies new buying centers, expands into new markets and net new logos, and ensures partners deliver successful customer engagements. This role is not solution- or product-specific and focuses on partner growth, sales effectiveness, and scalable execution across ServiceNow Routes to Market.
Arabic Speaking is essential.
What you get to do in this role:
+ Own end-to-end partner lifecycle management, including strategic partner planning and GTM business plans to drive sales pipeline and growth
+ Drive partner pipeline development, inspection, and assist with deal progression in partnership with field sales
+ Work with partners to generate new business in existing accounts, new markets, and net new logos while ensuring partners deliver successful projects
+ Develop joint GTM plans with Marketing to drive co-sell and demand generation leading to pipeline and revenue
+ Advise partners on market, geographic, and route-to-market expansion, including identification of new buying centers and customer sales motions
+ Collaborate with Technical Partner Advisors (TPAs) and the to align sales plays to Routes to Market and guide partners on how to sell ServiceNow
+ Conduct quarterly and bi-annual business reviews, governance forums, and milestone tracking
+ Coach and enable partners both remotely and face-to-face, building senior-level relationships and managing partner risk
+ Track performance metrics, readiness indicators, and reduce friction by escalating risks as needed
To be successful in this role you have:
+ Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
+ 5 - 10+ years in partner management, alliances, or ecosystem roles
+ This role strengthens partner-led growth by ensuring partners are equipped to generate pipeline, expand into new markets, and execute effective sales motions. Through strategic partner planning, joint GTM execution, and close collaboration with TPAs and field sales, the Partner Manager translates strategy into consistent, scalable outcomes that drive ServiceNow revenue growth.
+ Comfort operating in ambiguity with a bias toward action
+ Executive communication and relationship management skills
+ Ability to influence and operate in a matrixed organization
+ Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving, including using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, or analyzing AI-driven insights
+ Experience developing and executing GTM strategies through partner ecosystems
+ Strong understanding of partner-led and co-sell sales motions
+ Arabic Speaking is essential.

• Performs patient connection and disconnection  
• Performs correct anticoagulation of extracorporeal circuit and administers medication during treatment, in line with patient prescription  
• Monitors patients during treatment and informs physician of changes which need medical attention  
• Properly handle tunnel and non-tunnel central venous catheters  
• Performs patient education with regards to managing their health conditions, e.g. nutrition, hygiene, fistula care, etc

• Performs blood sampling for lab tests  
• Performs emergency interventions and resuscitation procedures  
• Handle (prepare and distribute) meals to patients, if applicable

• Prepares and administers medication and anticoagulation  
Dialysis supplies and disposables:

• Brings dialysis supplies from storage to dialysis treatment room, in line with hygiene and infection control procedures  
• Supervises and/or performs collection of nonmedical and medical waste, in line with hygiene and infection control standards and procedures

Announces Head Nurse or technician of any irregularities in machine functioning

• Sets treatment parameters in line with the medical prescription

• Participates to and supports the PD treatment initiation

English

## **Job Summary**

The Senior BIM Engineer supports the development, coordination, quality assurance, and delivery of architectural Building Information Models for large-scale and mega projects across the project lifecycle.

The role collaborates with project owners, architects, engineers, contractors, subcontractors, and BIM service providers to improve multidisciplinary coordination, identify design conflicts, strengthen project documentation, and support construction efficiency, cost control, scheduling, and effective project delivery.

The position produces coordinated BIM models and drawings, maintains model and revision controls, performs clash detection, derives quantities, supports project-specific BIM guidelines and close-out documentation, and assists project personnel in the effective use of BIM tools and workflows.

## **Job Responsibilities 1**

**BIM Model Development & Documentation**

Develop, update, and manage schematic, detailed-design, construction, and as-built architectural BIM models in accordance with approved project requirements and delivery schedules.

Use Autodesk Revit for architectural modeling, documentation, schedules, sheets, details, families, and other BIM deliverables.

Prepare coordinated BIM models, shop drawings, drawing sets, model views, schedules, and supporting documentation accurately and on time.

Create and maintain project-specific Revit families and library components.

**Model Coordination & Clash Detection**

Coordinate architectural models with structural, MEP, civil, specialist, and construction models.

Use Navisworks for federated model review, clash detection, issue identification, and coordination tracking.

Identify design conflicts, incomplete or ambiguous information, constructability concerns, and coordination risks.

Develop model views and visualizations to illustrate contractor questions, proposed solutions, and sequencing requirements.

**BIM Standards, Quality & Information Management**

The Senior BIM Engineer supports the development, coordination, quality assurance, and delivery of architectural Building Information Models for large-scale and mega projects across the project lifecycle.

The position produces coordinated BIM models and drawings, maintains model and revision controls, performs clash detection, derives quantities, supports project-specific BIM guidelines and close-out documentation, and assists project personnel in the effective use of BIM tools and workflows.

Develop, update, and manage schematic, detailed-design, construction, and as-built architectural BIM models in accordance with approved project requirements and delivery schedules.

Create and maintain project-specific Revit families and library components.

**Model Coordination & Clash Detection**

Coordinate architectural models with structural, MEP, civil, specialist, and construction models.

Use Navisworks for federated model review, clash detection, issue identification, and coordination tracking.

Identify design conflicts, incomplete or ambiguous information, constructability concerns, and coordination risks.

Develop model views and visualizations to illustrate contractor questions, proposed solutions, and sequencing requirements.

Apply BIM Execution Plans, modeling standards, naming conventions, LOD/LOI requirements, and common data environment workflows.

Perform model-quality reviews covering geometry, information completeness, coordinates, model health, documentation consistency, and compliance.

Maintain BIM revision logs, issue registers, model exchange records, and accurate audit trails.

Support project-specific BIM guidelines, templates, checklists, and procedures.

**Project Delivery & Construction Support**

Support construction coordination, scheduling, quantity derivation, and model-based review of planned activities.

Derive and validate material quantities to support estimation, procurement, cost reporting, and forecasting.

Provide model-based inputs for change orders, notices, design revisions, and project-control requirements.

Produce drawing sets and model outputs for reviews, workshops, site coordination, and stakeholder presentations.

Coordinate deliverables with consultants, BIM service providers, subcontractors, and internal project disciplines.

Participate in BIM coordination meetings, design reviews, and clash-resolution sessions, tracking actions through closure.

Assist the BIM Manager in training project personnel on BIM tools, standards, and project-specific requirements.

Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:

+ Grow with personalised guidance and mentoring: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching, while working closely with a dedicated mentor and peer buddy to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme
Click here to learn more about the Finesse Programme (https://jobs.hilton.com/finesse-finance-leadership-programme)
What We’re Looking For
With our major global presence and ambitious growth plans, Hilton is developing a strong team of future finance leaders. We are seeking curious, driven, and flexible individuals who embody the Hilton Values and are ready to grow their careers across borders.
+ A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Hospitality, Business, or a related field (completed by the 1st September 2027)
+ Fluency in English (spoken and written)
+ Eligibility to work in the EMEA region
+ Full mobility across the EMEA region and a willingness to relocate for both placements as required
+ Aspiration to become a future financial leader
+ Commitment to managing a full-time role while studying towards your CIMA qualification
+ Availability to begin full-time employment on 1st September 2027
Selection Process
Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Sunday 13th December 2026 .
Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:
+ Online assessments
+ One-way video interview
+ A competency-based interview with a Hilton Finance Leader
+ A Virtual Assessment Centre (March 2027)
While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.
Due to the high number of applications, our screening process may take a little longer than usual. Every application is carefully reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, without the use of AI. To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to final stages of selection will be issued after applications have closed. Thank you for your patience, we’ll be in touch as soon as there’s an update. Please keep an eye on your inbox and junk folder too, so you don’t miss any messages from us.
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.
Salary is determined by the country of placement. job_title: Technical Director/Associate Director - Development, Planning & Urban Design
description:
Job Description

What if you could shape a career as unique as you?

At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.

The Technical Director/Associate Director - Development, Planning & Urban Design will serve as a senior member of the Development, Planning & Urban Design (DPUD) business across the Middle East
The successful candidate will work closely with the Director and to lead the business, drive sustainable growth, manage key client relationships, oversee project delivery and strengthen leadership capability across the regional practice.
The role combines business development, client leadership, operational management, project direction and people leadership. The role holder will progressively assume broader commercial and leadership responsibilities, act as the Director's delegate when required and help ensure the long-term resilience, continuity and growth of the DPUD practice.

Business Leadership & Practice Development
Support the Director in implementing the strategic vision, annual business plan and growth objectives for the DPUD practice.
Take increasing ownership of the day-to-day operation of the practice, including business performance, resource planning, workload management and coordination of the senior leadership team.
Lead initiatives that improve operational efficiency, delivery performance, profitability and collaboration.
Support preparation of revenue forecasts, pipeline reviews, recruitment plans, capability plans and business performance reporting.
Identify emerging markets, client needs and new service opportunities across the Middle East.
Contribute to succession planning and the development of a resilient, empowered leadership structure.

Client Leadership & Market Positioning
Develop and manage relationships with selected strategic government, semi-government and private sector clients.
Act as Client Account Lead for agreed priority accounts and progressively assume ownership of selected relationships currently led by the Director and Technical Directors.
Represent WSP in executive meetings, presentations, workshops and industry forums.
Build a strong personal profile in the Middle East development, planning and urban design market.
Identify repeat-business and cross-selling opportunities across WSP disciplines and business units.
Support the Director in maintaining the practice's senior market relationships and reputation as a trusted advisor.

Business Development
Lead and support major bids, proposals, frameworks and strategic pursuits.
Build a qualified pipeline across planning, development advisory, spatial strategy, master planning and urban design.
Lead capture planning, bid strategy, go/no-go recommendations, fee development and commercial negotiations for agreed pursuits.
Work with other Advisory and multidisciplinary teams to secure integrated commissions.
Meet agreed sales, pipeline and conversion objectives and share market intelligence across the practice.

Project Leadership
Act as Project Director on major development, planning and urban transformation commissions.
Provide senior oversight of scope, programme, quality, risk, resourcing and commercial performance.
Ensure projects comply with WSP quality, governance and Ways of Working requirements.
Lead project reviews, resolve strategic and commercial challenges and support project managers and technical leads.
Lead key client presentations, steering group engagements and senior stakeholder discussions.
Promote integrated working across planning, urban design, economics, transport, infrastructure, environment and wider advisory disciplines.

Team Leadership & People Management
Provide line management and leadership to senior members of the team.
Coach and mentor project directors, project managers, planners, urban designers and technical specialists.
Identify, develop and retain future leaders and high-potential staff.
Support recruitment, onboarding, performance development and workforce planning.
Create a collaborative, inclusive and accountable culture aligned with WSP values.
Lead capability-building, training, knowledge-sharing and technical community initiatives.

Technical Direction
Maintain strong professional credibility in planning, development and urban transformation.
Provide senior review and challenge for strategies, reports, master plans, presentations and other key deliverables.
Promote innovation, data-informed decision-making and industry best practice.
Contribute to thought leadership, professional events and development of new methodologies, tools and services.
Ensure the right technical specialists are deployed and empowered across projects.

Financial & Commercial Management
Support delivery of annual revenue, margin, utilisation and cash objectives.
Monitor project financial performance, work in progress, aged debt, forecasting and resource demand.
Support contract negotiations, risk reviews and commercial decision-making.
Intervene early where projects require corrective action and ensure commercially responsible delivery.
Progressively assume responsibility for defined elements of practice financial performance.

Authority and Delegation

Act on behalf of the Director during periods of absence or where responsibilities are formally delegated.
Chair practice leadership, operational, pipeline and project review meetings as required.
Make decisions within agreed delegated authority and escalate material, commercial, people, client or reputation matters appropriately.
Represent the DPUD practice in internal leadership forums and with external stakeholders.

Bachelor’s degree in Urban Planning, Urban Design, Architecture or a related field.
A Master’s degree is preferred.
Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) in urban planning, urban design and development, with a strong background in managing large-scale projects – ideally within the Middle East.
In-depth knowledge of urban planning, development, and design processes.
Familiarity with local and international urban design regulations and sustainability principles.
Proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams, senior client relationships and commercial outcomes.
Experience operating within a major consultancy or comparable complex professional-services environment.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?

With us, you can. Apply today.

The **Internal Auditor - Operations** performs independent, risk-based operational audits across the organization in alignment with the Internal Audit Charter, methodology, and IIA Standards (IPPF). The role assesses governance, risk management, internal controls, and policy/regulatory compliance across end-to-end operational activities (hubs, logistics, fleet, gateways, customer service, cash/COD, and technology systems).

### Responsibilities

* **Audit Planning & Preparation:** Research operational areas, map process flows/risks, participate in pre-audit meetings, draft risk-and-control matrices, and establish sampling strategies.
* **Shipment & Process Assurance:** Audit full end-to-end logistics processes (booking, sorting, linehaul, delivery, POD, returns) and evaluate custody, scan sequence, timestamps, and seal controls.
* **Cost, Productivity & Asset Reviews:** Assess operational efficiency drivers (manpower, route/vehicle utilization, fleet maintenance, facility costs) and evaluate vendor/outsourced courier compliance against contracts and SLAs.
* **Cash, COD & Revenue Controls:** Test courier debriefs, COD collection/reconciliation, billing accuracy, and system inputs to prevent revenue leakage, loss, or unsupported write-offs.
* **Data Analytics & Systems Assurance:** Use Excel, Power BI, or analytical software to test 100% data populations, detect anomalies/overrides, and verify core operational system integrity.
* **Safety, Security & Compliance:** Review facility/fleet security, CCTV, safety protocols, regulatory permits, and incident escalations.
* **Testing & Documentation:** Execute testing, maintain evidence-backed working papers, and expand sample sizes when control failures are detected.
* **Reporting & Recommendations:** Draft clear audit observations, establish root causes, assign risk ratings, and propose practical corrective action plans.
* **Action Follow-Up:** Verify and test management closure evidence before signing off on resolved findings.

### Key Role Boundaries & Escalation

* **Independence:** Must remain objective and disclose any conflicts of interest or past operational roles immediately.
* **Immediate Escalation:** Suspected fraud, theft, deliberate control bypass, major shipment/cash loss, or severe safety/regulatory breaches must be escalated immediately.
* **Formal Investigations:** The auditor must **not** conduct formal fraud/misconduct investigations unless explicitly assigned under the formal investigation procedure.

### Decision Rights

**Category Scope May Decide**Day-to-day audit execution, sample selection, evidence requests, routine walkthrough scheduling, and initial working paper drafts. **May Recommend** Scope expansion, control improvements, finding risk ratings, procedure changes, and fraud referrals. **Requires Approval** Audit scope/objective changes, final audit reports/ratings, external disclosures, and formal finding closures. **Must Not Decide** Operational policies, process ownership, control design/operation, risk acceptance, vendor selection, or disciplinary actions.

### 5\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1.  **Audit Delivery (20%):** Complete ≥95% of assigned audit tasks and milestones by scheduled target dates.
2.  **Working-Paper Quality (15%):** Achieve ≥95% compliance with audit documentation standards.
3.  **Finding Evidence (15%):** 100% of reported observations backed by traceable, verified evidence.
4.  **Reporting Timeliness (15%):** Draft observations submitted within agreed engagement deadlines.
5.  **Critical Escalation (10%):** Escalate 100% of validated critical risks/fraud indicators within 1 working day.
6.  **Follow-Up Verification (10%):** Complete ≥95% of assigned management action verifications on schedule.
7.  **Data Analytics Usage (10%):** Apply analytics/data testing in ≥80% of audits with available data.
8.  **Professional Development (5%):** Complete minimum 40 hours of relevant training annually.

**Requirements**

Bachelor’s degree in Internal Auditing, Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or Engineering.

**Certifications:** CIA (or in-progress), CFE, CRMA, CPA/ACCA, or ISO Lead Auditor preferred.

**Experience:** Minimum 3+ years in internal audit, operational audit, risk, or compliance. Experience in logistics, transport, supply chain, or e-commerce is strongly preferred.

**Technical Skills:** Strong proficiency in Excel; experience with Power BI, SQL, or audit management software is an advantage.

**Key Competencies:** Professional scepticism, evidence-based judgment, root-cause analysis, concise report writing, and stakeholder communication.

description:
## **Overview & Responsibilities**

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled **Mechanical Machinery Specialist** to join our team on a **full-time, permanent, remote basis**, with a focus on operations in **Dammam, Saudi Arabia**. **This opportunity is exclusively for Saudi Nationals.** This role is crucial for executing and overseeing the overhaul of various **turbomachinery equipment** (Steam turbines, centrifugal compressors and pumps) during planned turnarounds and outages.

The successful candidate will ensure all maintenance and repair activities meet the highest standards of quality and safety. This remote position requires a professional who can effectively supervise on-site contractors and manage complex projects, while being available for necessary site visits.

## Job Responsibilities:

The Mechanical Machinery Specialist will be expected to perform the following core duties:

* **Turbomachinery Overhaul:** Participate in and support the **full overhaul and maintenance** of a diverse range of **turbomachinery equipment** (e.g., turbines, compressors, pumps) during critical plant turnarounds and outages.
    
* **Contractor Supervision Support:** Provide **assistance and support** in the supervision of third-party contractors and maintenance personnel, helping to ensure all work adheres to scope, technical specifications, and project timelines.
    
* **Quality Assurance:** **Monitor and inspect** repair and maintenance activities to guarantee work quality, compliance with industry best practices, and adherence to company standards.
    
* **Safety Compliance:** Uphold and enforce strict **safety protocols** and procedures for all on-site work, ensuring a safe working environment and full compliance with local regulations.
    
* **Technical Reporting:** Document all maintenance, repair, and overhaul activities, preparing detailed technical reports, findings, and recommendations for future maintenance strategies.
    
* **Remote Management:** Effectively manage and monitor on-site activities and communications remotely, utilizing modern communication and project management tools.
    

## Qualifications:

To be successful in this role, candidates should possess the following:

* **Nationality Requirement:** **Must be a Saudi National.**
    
* **Educational Background:** A **Diploma or Vocational Training Certificate** in a Mechanical discipline (e.g., Mechanical Technology, Industrial Maintenance, or equivalent) is required.
    
* **Experience & Aptitude:**
    
    * We will consider **Fresh Graduates** who demonstrate a strong **mechanical aptitude** and have completed relevant internships or have some foundational experience in industrial maintenance or machinery.
        
    * Candidates with prior experience (1-3 years) in the maintenance, overhaul, or repair of **turbomachinery equipment** are highly encouraged to apply.
        
* **Technical Knowledge:** A solid understanding of mechanical principles, fault diagnostics, and maintenance practices related to rotating equipment.
    
* **Supervisory Potential:** An ability and willingness to learn how to **effectively supervise and manage contractors** and maintenance teams.
    
* **Safety Awareness:** Comprehensive knowledge of industrial safety standards and a commitment to safe work practices.
    
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English are essential for contractor liaison, reporting, and remote management.
    
* **Location/Travel:** Although primarily remote, the candidate must be based in Saudi Arabia (preferably Dammam area) and be willing to travel to site locations as required for turnarounds, outages, and critical inspection points.
    

**Base Location & Work Schedule**

This is a full time permanent position based in Saudi Arabia on remote working basis.

description:
You'll own the online systems that take a catalogue change to a ranked result in front of a shopper: search, retrieval and recommendation serving, the streaming data that keeps them fresh, and the experiments that ship them.

Salla is the leading e-commerce platform in MENA, serving about 68,000+ merchants. Our AI team is building a self-owned discovery stack across our marketplace and merchant stores: hybrid lexical and vector search, Arabic-first query understanding, and learned ranking shared between search and recommendations. Data scientists own the relevance and ranking models. You own the platform that makes them fast, fresh, reliable and shippable.

The work is roughly half online serving, a third streaming data, and the rest integration into product surfaces. You sit on the ML Platform team spending time between search and serving for our recommendation systems and work day to day with search data scientists and the ranking lead

What you'll do

Online serving

* Build and run query and recommendation serving: retrieval, score fusion, filtering, caching.
* Hold tight latency budgets, including double-digit-millisecond p95 for search-as-you-type.
* Design graceful degradation, so serving holds up when a model or vector path is slow or down.
* Build experiment plumbing: shadow traffic, A/B assignment, guardrail metrics, rollback.

Streaming data

* Build change-data-capture from source systems into search indexes and feature stores, with measured freshness.
* Keep embeddings fresh for new and updated items.
* Run zero-downtime reindexing of multi-million-document collections.
* Build feature logging that turns production traffic into training data for ranking models.

Integration

* Ship changes into product teams' backends and clients: new endpoints, cutovers, experiment flags.
* Work with product engineering teams on reviews, release windows and production ownership.

Operability, throughout

* Monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and your share of on-call for what you ship.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years building backend or platform systems in production.
* 2+ years operating a production search engine (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, Typesense, Vespa or similar): index lifecycle, analyzers, reindexing at scale, debugging relevance issues with data scientists.
* Low-latency services under real traffic, and the ability to explain where the p95 goes.
* Streaming ingestion: Kafka, Debezium or similar change-data-capture, plus idempotent backfills.
* Strong Python. Comfortable shipping in TypeScript.
* Shipped changes through A/B tests and staged rollouts.
* Daily use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code. We expect one engineer plus agents to cover what used to take a team.

## Job Description

Reporting to the Outlet Manager, the Assistant Outlet Manager is responsible for supporting and supervising the daily operation of the assigned outlet. The main focus is to ensure smooth operations, maintain service standards, support the team, and follow up on all assigned tasks.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

**1\. Daily Operations**

* Assist the Outlet Manager in managing the daily operation of the outlet.
* Ensure that the outlet is ready before each service, including table setup, buffet presentation, cleanliness, equipment, and staff readiness.
* Supervise the team during service to ensure smooth operations and good guest service.
* Check the outlet regularly before, during, and after service to ensure that all standards are followed.
* Ensure that opening, closing, and shift handover procedures are completed properly.
* Monitor the service flow and support the team whenever needed.
* Ensure that food is replenished on time and that buffet presentation and table maintenance meet the required standards.
* Coordinate with the Kitchen and Stewarding teams to ensure smooth service.
* Identify and solve daily operational issues within the limits of assigned authority.
* Ensure that all instructions from the Outlet Manager are followed and completed.

**2\. Team Supervision and Training**

* Guide and supervise team members in their daily duties.
* Conduct daily briefings as required to communicate operational updates, guest expectations, promotions, and service standards.
* Ensure that employees follow their duty schedules and comply with attendance, uniform, grooming, and hygiene standards.
* Provide on-the-job training and coaching to improve employees' skills and performance.
* Identify employees who need additional training and inform the Outlet Manager.
* Follow up with employees after training to ensure that they apply what they have learned.
* Support new employees during their training and help them understand the outlet's procedures and standards.
* Encourage teamwork, discipline, and professional behavior among all team members.
* Inform the Outlet Manager of any employee performance issues or training needs.

**3\. Guest Experience**

* Ensure that guests receive friendly, professional, and efficient service.
* Communicate with guests during service to check their satisfaction and identify any concerns.
* Handle guest complaints professionally and resolve routine issues within the assigned authority.
* Inform the Outlet Manager about serious complaints or issues that require management attention.
* Follow up on guest complaints and requests to ensure that they are resolved.
* Record and follow up on guest feedback through the hotel's approved systems, including SSM and ALICE where applicable.
* Ensure that guest preferences, special requests, and food allergies are communicated correctly to the relevant team members.
* Support the team in recognizing loyalty program members and providing personalized service.

**4\. Hygiene, Safety, and Quality**

* Ensure that all employees follow the hotel's hygiene, food safety, and safety procedures.
* Check the cleanliness of the outlet, buffet stations, service areas, and equipment.
* Ensure that employees follow personal hygiene and food handling standards.
* Monitor food presentation and replenishment to maintain the required quality.
* Report any equipment problems, maintenance issues, or safety concerns to the relevant department and the Outlet Manager.
* Follow up on maintenance requests and other issues until they are resolved.
* Ensure that any problems identified during inspections are corrected on time.
* Report any failure to follow hotel standards or procedures to the Outlet Manager.

**5\. Cost Control and Equipment**

* Ensure that employees use operating equipment and supplies properly and avoid unnecessary waste or damage.
* Monitor food and beverage wastage and report any unusual losses to the Outlet Manager.
* Ensure that all orders and payments are processed correctly through the POS system.
* Ensure that discounts, complimentary items, and other transactions follow hotel procedures and approval requirements.
* Support the Outlet Manager in managing staff deployment according to business needs.
* Check that the outlet has the necessary equipment and supplies before service.
* Report shortages, breakages, and equipment problems and follow up on the required action.
* Suggest practical ways to improve daily operations and reduce unnecessary waste.

**6\. Follow-Up and Reporting**

* Keep the Outlet Manager informed about daily operations, guest feedback, staffing issues, and other important matters.
* Prepare daily reports and shift handover reports as requested by the Outlet Manager.
* Follow up on assigned tasks and ensure that they are completed within the agreed time.
* Keep track of pending maintenance requests, guest complaints, and other operational issues.
* Coordinate with the relevant departments and follow up until outstanding issues are resolved.
* Ensure that all important information is communicated properly between shifts.
* Follow up on instructions given by the Outlet Manager and report the progress.
* Inform the Outlet Manager about repeated problems and suggest possible solutions.

**7\. Coordination with Other Departments**

* Maintain good communication with the Kitchen, Stewarding, Engineering, Housekeeping, Front Office, and other departments.
* Follow up on guest requests and operational requirements with the relevant departments.
* Support the Outlet Manager in implementing new procedures, service improvements, and operational initiatives.
* Assist with VIP arrangements, special events, and other activities as required.
* Maintain good working relationships with colleagues and other departments.

**8\. Additional Responsibilities**

* Supervise the daily operation of the outlet in the Outlet Manager's absence when assigned.
* Ensure that the team continues to follow all service and operational standards.
* Handle routine operational decisions within the assigned authority.
* Inform the Outlet Manager about any major issue that requires management attention.
* Ensure that all pending tasks are properly handed over to the Outlet Manager.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Outlet Manager or Director of Food & Beverage.

## Qualifications

* Food & Beverage certifications will be an advantage.
* Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in Food & Beverage operations, preferably in a five-star hotel.
* Previous experience in a supervisory role is preferred.
* Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Knowledge of restaurant operations, POS systems, and food safety standards.
* Good communication and leadership skills.
* Ability to train, guide, and support team members.
