description:
### **Job Description**

## Overview

AtkinsRéalis is seeking an experienced Senior Urban and Real Estate Economist to join its Advisory team in the Middle East.

The role will provide economic, demographic and real estate market analysis to support development advisory, urban planning, master planning and infrastructure planning assignments. The successful candidate will translate population, household, employment and sector growth forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements, including:

* Land-use and development demand.
* Real estate asset mix and scale.
* Housing and employment requirements.
* Social infrastructure needs.
* Development capacity and absorption.
* Development and infrastructure phasing.
* Investment priorities.

The candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside development advisors, urban planners, master planners, real estate specialists, infrastructure planners, engineers, transport specialists, GIS professionals and financial advisors.

## Your role

**Urban and Spatial Economics**

* Undertake economic, demographic and socio-economic analysis for regional strategies, city plans, master plans and major development programmes.
* Prepare population, household, employment and economic forecasts at regional, city, district and development levels.
* Translate growth forecasts into spatial requirements for residential, commercial, retail, hospitality, industrial, mixed-use and community development.
* Assess relationships between economic activity, population distribution, employment, accessibility, land use and infrastructure provision.
* Develop and test alternative growth and development scenarios and assess their spatial implications.
* Prepare socio-economic baselines, city and regional benchmarks, economic impact assessments and wider-benefits analysis.
* Translate demographic forecasts into requirements for housing and social infrastructure, including education, healthcare, recreation and community facilities.
* Work with planning and GIS teams to spatially represent population, employment, economic activity and development demand.

**Real Estate Economics**

* Undertake real estate market, demand and supply assessments across relevant asset classes.
* Analyse market drivers, existing and planned supply, occupancy, take-up, pricing, absorption and competing developments.
* Prepare development demand forecasts for residential, office, retail, hospitality, industrial and other real estate uses.
* Provide economic and market inputs into development positioning, land-use mix, scale, density and phasing.
* Assess the market supportability and absorption of proposed development programmes.
* Support highest-and-best-use studies, development strategies, land strategies and master plans.
* Test development scenarios against economic, demographic and real estate market conditions.
* Work with financial advisors to align market assumptions, development programmes and financial feasibility.
* Provide evidence to support development, land-use and investment decisions.

**Development and Infrastructure Planning**

* Translate population, employment and real estate forecasts into high-level infrastructure and service-demand assumptions.
* Support infrastructure planners in understanding how development growth affects transport, utilities, municipal services and social infrastructure.
* Identify development dependencies and infrastructure triggers affecting land release, development sequencing and phasing.
* Support the alignment of real estate absorption, development delivery and infrastructure investment.
* Provide economic and demand inputs into infrastructure strategies, investment plans and business cases.

**Project Delivery**

* Lead defined urban and real estate economics workstreams within multidisciplinary advisory assignments.
* Develop clear methodologies, analytical frameworks, forecast models and evidence bases.
* Gather and analyse quantitative and qualitative information from government, commercial and client sources.
* Prepare high-quality technical reports, presentations, working papers and executive summaries.
* Translate complex analysis into clear findings and practical recommendations for planning, development and investment decisions.
* Present analysis and recommendations to clients and project stakeholders.

**Business and Practice Development**

* Contribute to technical and commercial proposals across development advisory, urban planning, real estate and infrastructure planning.
* Support client engagement and the identification of new business opportunities.
* Develop reusable datasets, forecasting tools, analytical methodologies and templates.
* Contribute to market insights and thought leadership on urban growth, real estate development and regional economic trends.
* Share knowledge and good practice across Advisory and the wider AtkinsRéalis business.
* Support the professional development of junior economists and analysts.
* Champion collaboration, inclusion and high-quality delivery.

## About you

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Real Estate Economics, Urban Economics, Economic Geography, Regional Science, Urban Planning or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree in Urban Economics, Real Estate, Economics, Development Economics, Economic Geography, Urban Planning or a related field is preferred.

  

**Professional Experience / Qualifications**

* Typically +8 years of relevant experience;
* Experience in urban economics, real estate economics, development advisory, socio-economics or a related consulting discipline.
* Demonstrable ability to translate economic and demographic forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements.
* Experience supporting master plans, development strategies, regional plans, regeneration programmes or major real estate developments.
* Experience in real estate market assessment and demand forecasting across one or more asset classes.
* Good understanding of the relationship between economic growth, population, employment, land use, real estate markets and infrastructure.
* Strong quantitative, forecasting and analytical capability.
* Advanced capability in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with GIS, statistical analysis or data-visualisation tools is desirable.
* Experience in the UAE, KSA or wider GCC is strongly preferred.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to move from data and evidence to practical recommendations.
* Ability to connect economic and real estate analysis with physical planning, development and investment decisions.
* Excellent written communication, report-writing and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

As MEP Commissioning Manager, you will lead the delivery and business development of Applus+ MEP testing and commissioning services across Saudi Arabia. The role combines technical leadership in commissioning management, HVAC testing, technical due diligence and condition assessment with responsibility for identifying opportunities, securing contracts and developing profitable client relationships.

Working with Building & Inspection Department Management, you will develop the service offering and delivery team, manage projects from commissioning planning and system readiness through start-up, functional and integrated testing to final handover, and contribute directly to agreed sales, revenue and profitability targets.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Demonstrated experience managing MEP testing and commissioning, HVAC TAB, technical due diligence and condition assessment assignments.
* Proven ability to develop business, build client relationships, prepare competitive proposals and convert opportunities into awarded contracts.
* Strong understanding of commissioning documentation, MEP system interfaces, project delivery, costing and commercial risk.
* Effective leadership, communication, presentation and negotiation skills, with the ability to work independently and travel across Saudi Arabia.  
      
    

**Job Responsibilities:**

1.      Lead business development and project operations for MEP testing and commissioning, technical due diligence and condition assessment services across Saudi Arabia, with responsibility for service line P&L and agreed revenue and profitability targets.

2.      Develop and implement the Department’s business development and origination strategy, identifying opportunities through market research, networking and engagement with developers, asset owners, consultants, contractors and facility operators.

3.      Build and maintain client relationships, organise meetings, follow up commercial opportunities and travel across KSA to secure new contracts and develop repeat business.

4.      Maintain a qualified opportunity pipeline, track tenders and proposals, and report sales forecasts and progress against agreed targets.

5.      Lead RFP and RFQ reviews, client meetings and site assessments to define scope, deliverables, resources, programme, assumptions and exclusions.

6.      Prepare and present technical and commercial proposals, ensuring pricing, margins, quotations and approvals are coordinated with Department Management and the relevant business line heads.

7.      Lead proposal follow-up, tender clarifications and commercial negotiations within delegated authority, coordinating contract finalisation and the transition from award to project mobilisation.

8.      Oversee project operations across KSA, including mobilisation, team deployment, resource allocation and coordination of ongoing assignments, ensuring timely delivery, technical quality, profitability and client satisfaction.

9.      Manage the complete MEP commissioning process, from commissioning planning and readiness reviews through start-up coordination, functional performance testing, integrated systems testing and final handover.

10.  Review commissioning specifications, method statements, test procedures, schedules and records for compliance with project requirements and applicable standards.

11.  Lead and coordinate MEP technical due diligence and condition assessments, providing clear findings, technical opinions and practical recommendations.

12.  Manage project interfaces with clients, consultants, contractors, vendors and specialist subcontractors; monitor site activities, resolve technical issues and track deficiencies through corrective action and retesting.

13.  Conduct site visits and undertake technical assignments as required, verify testing records, and ensure the completeness and quality of commissioning reports and handover documentation.

14.  Manage project budgets, schedules, deadlines and client expectations; monitor costs, margins, variations and invoicing, and support payment follow-up with commercial and finance teams.

15.  Build and develop the local delivery team, training engineers in company procedures, applicable industry practices and safe working methods.

16.  Screen, assess and select specialist subcontractors, coordinate their engagement and monitor their technical performance, quality and delivery commitments.

17.  Improve commissioning methodologies and internal procedures, coordinating with Department senior managers on technical approaches, resources and industry requirements.

Our aim is to shape a better future for our planet through supporting the energy transition, (bio)technology, artificial intelligence, industrial cybersecurity, etc. We are committed to the United Nations sustainable development goals by utilizing our ability to measure and connect.

**About the Team**  
Our 18,000 employees work in over 60 countries with one corporate mission, to "co-innovate tomorrow". We are looking for dynamic colleagues who share our passion for technology and care for our planet. In return, we offer you great career opportunities to grow yourself in a truly global culture where respect, value creation, collaboration, integrity, and gratitude are highly valued and exhibited in everything we do.

**Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities**

  

* **GC Column Preparation & Fabrication**
    * Fabricate, pack, and wind custom packed columns (using stainless steel, SilcoSteel or Sulfinert tubing) according to specified stationary phase/solid support recipes and mesh sizes.
    * Operate column packing equipment (liquid/gas packing rigs, vacuum systems, and mechanical vibrators) to ensure uniform bed density and zero channel formation.
    * Prepare, cut, end-cap, and perform initial thermal bake-out/conditioning of packed and capillary column sets in dedicated conditioning ovens.
    * Maintain precise records of column batches, packing materials, lot numbers, baseline pressure drops, and phase bleed characteristics.

* **Hardware, Electrical & Pneumatic Assembly**
    * Unpack GC Hardware and mount on Testing Racks.
    * Make the necessary Pnuematic and Electrical connections.
    * Move Calibration and/or carrier gases next to the GCs and make the necessary connections.
    * Mount, position, and secure GC columns, analytical valves, and detector units into GC ovens and sub-assemblies according to engineering drawings and schematics.
    * Measure, bend, cut, deburr, and route high-precision stainless steel, SilcoSteel, and fused-silica tubing (1/16", capillary) with ultra-clean handling practices.
    * Make leak-free pneumatic connections using specialized fittings for carrier, fuel, reference, and sample gases.
    * Perform leak testing on all internal flow paths prior to system energization.
    * Assist Tuning Engineers during initial power-up and tuning activities

* **Laboratory Maintenance & Inventory Support**

## Job Description

**Role purpose**

Lead the construction supervision consultant’s health, safety and environmental oversight across civil, MEP, architectural fit-out and specialist installation activities. Monitor contractors’ compliance with project HSE requirements and ensure risks associated with multiple contractors working in shared areas are effectively controlled.

**Key responsibilities**

* Establish the consultant’s HSE monitoring strategy, inspection programme and reporting procedures.
* Lead HSE inspectors and allocate coverage according to site activities and risk levels.
* Review contractors’ HSE plans, risk assessments, emergency procedures and safety provisions within method statements.
* Verify implementation of site inductions, toolbox talks, training and competency checks.
* Monitor permit-to-work arrangements for hot works, confined-space entry, work at height, lifting operations and electrical isolation.
* Conduct inspections and audits, document unsafe conditions and verify timely corrective action.
* Monitor safety interfaces between base building, fit-out, MEP and specialist rides and attraction contractors.
* Review controls for simultaneous activities, shared access, exclusion zones, material storage and movement of workers and equipment.
* Monitor temporary electrical installations, scaffolding, access equipment and work in restricted or concealed spaces.
* Verify fire prevention measures, safe storage of combustible materials, temporary fire protection and clear escape routes.
* Monitor safety arrangements for energisation, pressure testing, equipment start-up and commissioning, including lockout/tagout procedures.
* Verify emergency access, evacuation plans, first-aid provision and emergency drills as site conditions change.
* Review incident investigations and verify corrective actions addressing root causes.
* Monitor environmental controls for waste, dust, noise, chemicals and spill prevention.
* Maintain HSE reports and dashboards covering significant risks, incidents, inspection findings and overdue actions.
* Escalate serious risks immediately and initiate or recommend suspension of unsafe activities within delegated authority and project procedures.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Degree in Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
* NEBOSH General Certificate in Construction Health & Safety (or equivalent recognised qualification)
* Minimum 12 years' experience in construction HSE management, with substantial involvement on large-scale or complex projects
* Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring and managing HSE inspection teams and HSE professionals
* Proven competency in developing and implementing HSE strategies, inspection programmes, monitoring procedures and governance frameworks
* Strong knowledge of UK construction HSE regulations, standards and best practice guidance, with ability to interpret and apply to complex project scenarios
* Extensive experience reviewing, approving and challenging contractors' HSE plans, risk assessments and method statements
* Advanced competency in conducting HSE inspections, audits, incident investigations and root cause analysis
* Comprehensive knowledge of permit-to-work systems for high-risk activities (hot works, confined spaces, work at height, lifting operations)
* Deep understanding of temporary works, scaffolding, access equipment and electrical safety on construction sites
* Experience managing environmental controls including waste, dust, noise and chemical management across multiple work streams
* Proficiency in HSE reporting, data analysis, dashboard development and HSE management software
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to escalate risks effectively to senior stakeholders
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities on complex multi-disciplinary projects
* Experience managing safety interfaces between multiple contractors in shared working areas

**Desirable Qualifications**

* NEBOSH Diploma in Environmental Management or equivalent advanced qualification
* Knowledge of commissioning, energisation and lockout/tagout procedures
* Familiarity with digital HSE reporting tools and emerging HSE technology solutions
* Project management or construction supervision background at senior level
* Experience mentoring and developing HSE professionals

Operations Manager

\_\_

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support engineering activities across projects of varying sizes and complexities under the guidance of senior engineers. You will be responsible for completing assigned tasks in a cost-effective manner while ensuring compliance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies. You will also contribute to the engineering design process by collecting data, performing analyses, and supporting the development of technical solutions.

  
The work model for the role is: hybrid/on-site.

  
This role contributes to the SA-OPC Business Line within the Middle East region based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. The position supports engineering activities and project execution while collaborating with key stakeholders, including Sales, Product Management, and Business Development teams, to deliver customer-focused solutions and achieve business objectives.

  
You will be mainly accountable for:

·       Performs basic survey work, standard automation engineering, analysis, and basic design tasks.

·       Collect data and support engineering design production.

·       Exercises judgement on limited details of work and on application of standard methods & prepare relevant documentation

·       Supporting communication pertaining to specific assignments in meetings.

·       Participate in workshops related to engineering, design, tools and processes.

·       Work in graphic / application engineering development in DCS

·       Program, implement, test and document process control applications.

·       Ability to understand control narratives, P&ID’s.

·       Assists in preparing proposal / presentation of engineering projects / programs (provision of bills of materials, estimated engineering hours, etc.).

  

**What it takes to Run what runs the world**

·       Bachelor's Degree - Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics & communications, Electrical Engineering.

·       Control Systems Experience: 3-5 years of experience with control systems. ABB systems will be an advantage.

·       Must be a team player, self-motivated, quick learner, adaptable and flexible.

·       Willingness to travel & work at sites as and when required.

·       Willingness to travel domestic / overseas based on project need.

**What's in it for you?**  
  
We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.  
  
Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.  
  
Run What Runs the World.  
  
#ABBCareers #RunwithABB  
#Runwhatrunstheworld

Egis Advisory Service Line is at the forefront of managing large-scale developments for some of the most prestigious clients in the region, including giga projects, municipalities, and other significant urban and real estate ventures. With expertise in engineering, architecture, and technology, Egis shapes the future of urban spaces and infrastructure. The position will play a key role in driving these visionary projects forward, focusing on the strategic and technical aspects that lay the foundation for successful developments.

## Job Description

* Own the Project Charter and Project Execution Plan for the full term of the engagement.
* Build and protect the baseline schedule, carrying client dependencies on it alongside Egis activities, and re-baseline only through change control.
* Plan field campaigns and secure site access, permits and escorts ahead of each mobilization.
* Constitute and run the governance forums, from steering committee to weekly workstream sessions, and drive decisions and actions to closure.
* Apply the delegated authority and escalation matrices so decisions are taken at the right level, each escalation carrying options and a recommendation.
* Control the deliverable lifecycle through draft, validation workshop, client comments, response and approval, with internal peer review before every submission.
* Manage stage gates on conditions met rather than actions promised, recording exceptions with an owner and closure date.
* Operate change control end to end and maintain the change log with cumulative impact stated.
* Own the risk and issue register and the information request register, reporting movement and escalating overdue items.
* Maintain document control, the EDMS and a programme dashboard tracking deliverables, approvals and response times.
* Issue monthly reporting on schedule variance, deliverable status, risk movement and decisions required from the client.
* Manage subconsultant performance against flowed down schedules and acceptance criteria.
* Apply ISO 9001 controls to templates, reviews and document issue.

## Qualifications

* Bachelor degree in Engineering. Civil, mechanical or electrical preferred.
* Minimum 8 years in project or programme management, with at least 3 years delivering in Saudi Arabia.
* PMP or equivalent.
* Delivery record on multi site consultancy assignments with heavy field mobilization and subconsultant teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of a project execution plan, change control process and stage gate regime.
* Working knowledge of ISO 9001. Familiarity with ISO 22301 and ISO 31000 is an advantage.
* Familiarity with quantitative schedule risk analysis and Monte Carlo based contingency setting is an advantage.
* Strong stakeholder management with public sector and sovereign clients.
* Fluent English and Arabic.
* Saudi Council of Engineers registration, or eligibility to register.

Jasara Program Management Company (Jasara PMC) is a leading Joint Venture between Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jacobs, and Saudi Aramco, established to deliver world-class program management services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Jasara plays a key role in supporting the realization of Saudi Vision 2030, particularly in delivering giga-projects and large-scale infrastructure developments.

We are seeking an Asset Lifecycle Planning Director to join JASARA PMC. This role will establish the city-wide asset lifecycle planning framework, renewal rules and risk-based prioritization approach, integrating condition, risk, cost and performance data to shape lifecycle plans and renewal pipelines across portfolios.

The Asset Lifecycle Planning & Integration Director is accountable for establishing the city-wide lifecycle planning principles, frameworks, policies, renewal rules and intervention approach for City Asset Management. The role provides city-wide integration so lifecycle decisions across portfolios follow one unified ISO 55001-aligned AM framework, rather than fragmented local practices, and ensures decisions balance cost, risk, performance, service outcomes and whole-life asset value.

The role acts as the bridge between City AM portfolios and City Operations by defining lifecycle principles, intervention thresholds, maintenance policies, renewal criteria and cross-asset prioritization rules. It works with asset leads across the wider City AM team to ensure lifecycle plans reflect asset condition, criticality, hierarchy, service levels, O&M feedback and operational realities. It also works closely with the Enterprise AM Systems / SAP EAMS Director to ensure the AM platform and SAP EAMS produce the data, dashboards and decision-support outputs required to provide one trusted view of asset risk, condition, performance, backlog and lifecycle pressures across the city.

### Key Responsibilities

### 1\. Lifecycle Planning Framework, Principles and Policies

· Establish the city-wide asset lifecycle planning framework, principles, policies and governance approach for City AM, aligned to the AM Policy, AM Strategy and ISO 55001 principles.

· Define lifecycle planning standards that balance cost, risk, performance, service quality, safety, maintainability, resilience and long-term asset value.

· Set the approach for managing assets across their life, including how condition, criticality, hierarchy, risk, service levels and whole-life cost inform planning decisions.

· Develop renewal rules, intervention approaches, planning assumptions and decision criteria for assets across portfolios and districts.

· Set out consistent requirements for lifecycle plans, asset management plans, renewal pipelines, budget inputs and portfolio-level investment recommendations.

· Ensure lifecycle planning reflects agreed asset ownership boundaries, leasing arrangements, cost structures and links to capital and operating budget planning.

· Align lifecycle planning with operational readiness, handover, maintenance policies, SAP EAMS capabilities, AM governance and City Operations monitoring requirements.

### 2\. Renewal Pipeline and Risk-Based Prioritisation

· Develop the city-wide lifecycle and renewal pipeline by joining condition, risk, cost, performance, criticality and maintenance data across portfolios.

· Prioritise assets coming into operation between 2026 and 2028, ensuring renewal needs, early-life risks and lifecycle obligations are visible before handover.

· Set risk-based prioritisation rules that guide when assets are maintained, monitored, refurbished, renewed, replaced or escalated for investment decision.

· Create practical rules for transferring lifecycle planning outputs and prioritisation logic to incoming City Operations resources once recruited.

· Ensure prioritisation decisions are transparent, evidence-based and auditable, supporting whole-life cost and value optimisation.

### 3\. Intervention Thresholds and Maintenance Policy Integration

· Work with asset leads across the wider City AM team to define intervention thresholds, maintenance policies, inspection triggers and asset-specific lifecycle requirements.

· Ensure lifecycle planning reflects portfolio-specific asset behaviour, usage intensity, condition profiles, criticality, service impacts and operational constraints.

· Translate asset class requirements into consistent planning rules for renewals, planned maintenance, condition monitoring, deterioration assumptions and replacement strategies.

· Challenge proposed interventions where cost, risk, performance or lifecycle value are not sufficiently evidenced.

· Ensure maintenance and intervention policies remain aligned with operational readiness, O&M feedback, budget planning and long-term asset management objectives.

### 4\. SAP EAMS and Data Integration for Lifecycle Planning

· Work with the Enterprise AM Systems / SAP EAMS Director to ensure the AM platform and SAP EAMS are ready to support lifecycle planning, renewal forecasting, intervention rules, condition scoring, risk prioritisation and cost-performance analysis.

· Define lifecycle data requirements, including asset hierarchy, classification, condition, criticality, failure modes, replacement value, expected life, maintenance history, cost, risk, performance and renewal information.

· Ensure dashboards and reports provide usable outputs for lifecycle forecasts, renewal pipelines, budget inputs, risk registers, backlog visibility, performance trends and portfolio decision-making.

· Link asset management outputs to financial reporting and work-management systems to support one version of the truth for lifecycle planning and investment decisions.

· Validate that data captured during handover and early operations is sufficient to support lifecycle planning, total cost of ownership, renewal prioritisation and adaptive change management.

· Promote a single source of lifecycle asset information that supports balanced decisions over the full lifespan of each asset.

### 5\. Portfolio and Infrastructure Asset Integration

· Lead integration of lifecycle planning across asset portfolios, ensuring common AM standards while allowing asset-class specific intervention rules and maintenance policies.

· Direct the Asset Lifecycle & Costing Senior Manager to develop lifecycle cost models, renewal forecasts, budget inputs and whole-life cost analysis across asset portfolios.

· Direct the Infrastructure Assets Integration Manager to work with the Infrastructure portfolio lead on lifecycle plans and programmes for roads and car parks.

· Ensure risks, issues and opportunities from O&M are fed back into prioritisation, lifecycle plans, asset management plans and renewal pipelines.

· Coordinate with asset class leads to ensure lifecycle assumptions reflect operational realities, service expectations, deterioration patterns, usage intensity and maintenance strategy.

· Provide a city-wide integrated view of asset risk, performance, backlog and lifecycle pressures to inform capital and Opex planning.

· Support integrated planning across City AM so lifecycle, costing, risk, criticality, operational integration and infrastructure asset priorities are joined up across the city operating model.

### 6\. Lifecycle Costing, Budget Inputs and Investment Planning

· Direct the Asset Lifecycle & Costing Senior Manager to develop lifecycle cost models, renewal forecasts, total cost of ownership analysis and portfolio-level budget inputs.

· Translate lifecycle plans into prioritised renewal programmes, multi-year capital requirements and operating budget implications.

· Ensure investment recommendations are supported by condition, risk, cost, criticality, performance, backlog and service-impact evidence.

· Support capital and Opex planning by identifying short-, medium- and long-term renewal needs, funding risks, deferral impacts and value optimisation options.

· Use KPI and trend reporting, performance monitoring and O&M feedback loops to refine lifecycle assumptions, renewal timing and maintenance strategies.

· Provide leadership reports on lifecycle cost exposure, renewal priorities, affordability constraints, risks, backlog and value-for-money options.

### 7\. Stakeholder Interface and Handover to Operations

· Work closely with City Operations, O&M teams, asset class leads, governance and assurance teams, handover teams and SAP EAMS stakeholders to embed lifecycle requirements before assets become operational.

· Ensure lifecycle planning outputs are transferred into operational ownership, including renewal rules, intervention thresholds, prioritisation logic and known asset risks.

· Support handover to incoming City Operations resources once recruited, ensuring lifecycle planning methods and renewal pipeline ownership are clearly documented.

· Provide expert input into Stage Gate, readiness and handover processes where lifecycle, renewal or whole-life cost implications affect decisions.

· Ensure lifecycle risks, issues and opportunities are visible to leadership and reflected in asset management planning and governance forums.

### 8\. Continuous Improvement and Lifecycle Policy Development

· Develop and continuously improve lifecycle planning policies, frameworks, templates, intervention logic, renewal rules, decision criteria and prioritisation methodologies.

· Use asset performance monitoring, condition data, risk trends, cost data, O&M feedback, lessons learned and SAP EAMS outputs to refine lifecycle assumptions and planning standards.

· Ensure lifecycle planning supports asset monitoring and continuous improvement, including cost, risk and asset health reporting, adaptive change management and lessons learned.

· Benchmark lifecycle planning approaches and promote consistency with ISO 55001-aligned asset management principles and relevant international good practice.

· Ensure lifecycle frameworks remain practical, scalable and usable by asset leads, O&M teams, portfolio teams and future City Operations resources.

· Build lifecycle planning capability across City AM through guidance, workshops, governance routines and clear decision-support tools.

**Requirements**

### Education

· Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Asset Management, Cost and Performance balance, Operations Management, Facilities Management, Business Administration or a related discipline.

· Master's degree in a relevant discipline is preferred.

· Professional certification or membership in asset management, project management, data governance, SAP EAM or information management is desirable.

### Experience

· Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in asset management, lifecycle planning, renewals, maintenance strategy, infrastructure operations, portfolio planning or asset investment planning, including senior leadership experience.

· Proven experience developing lifecycle planning frameworks, intervention policies, renewal rules, asset management plans and risk-based prioritisation approaches.

· Experience joining condition, risk, cost, performance and maintenance data to develop lifecycle forecasts, renewal pipelines and investment recommendations.

· Experience working with asset leads, O&M teams and enterprise asset management systems to define data requirements, intervention thresholds and decision-support outputs.

· Experience leading or directing lifecycle costing, infrastructure asset integration, roads, car parks, utilities, public realm, built environment or city operations portfolios.

· Experience in public sector, infrastructure, city operations, giga-projects, facilities management, transport, real estate or major destination environments is strongly preferred.

### Preferred Background

· Background in lifecycle asset management, infrastructure asset management, maintenance strategy, renewals planning, capital planning, AM policy or portfolio-level asset investment planning.

· Practical exposure to ISO 55001 or ISO 55000-aligned asset management systems, including lifecycle value, risk-based decision-making, stakeholder requirements and continual improvement.

· Experience working across asset data, SAP EAMS/CMMS, O&M, finance, governance, handover and portfolio teams to turn lifecycle policy into operational and investment plans.

### Technical & Functional Expectations

· Lifecycle planning frameworks, renewal rules, intervention thresholds, maintenance policies and asset management planning.

· Risk-based prioritisation, whole-life cost, cost-risk-performance trade-offs, value optimisation and investment planning.

· Condition, risk, cost, criticality, performance and maintenance data integration for lifecycle forecasting and renewal pipelines.

· SAP EAMS/CMMS lifecycle data requirements, dashboards, reports and decision-support outputs.

· Infrastructure asset lifecycle planning, roads, car parks, O&M feedback loops and portfolio integration.

· ISO 55001-aligned asset management principles, lifecycle value, risk management and continual improvement.

description:
## Company Description

**Who we are**

AS&H Clifford Chance provides a market-leading legal offering for Saudi and international clients in the exceptionally dynamic and fast-growing market in Saudi Arabia.

AS&H Clifford Chance helps clients achieve their goals by combining the highest global standards with local expertise. Focusing on the core areas of commercial activity: capital markets; corporate and M&A; finance and banking; real estate; litigation and dispute resolution.

This is an exciting opportunity to join AS&H Clifford Chance at a pivotal stage of its growth in Saudi Arabia, supporting a market-leading practice in one of the firm’s most strategic jurisdictions.

The role sits at the heart of the firm’s ambition to build a more structured, visible and sophisticated Client & Market Development function in Riyadh, moving from reactive activity toward proactive market positioning and client engagement. The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping how the firm presents itself in the market, supports partners in winning work, and differentiates itself in an increasingly competitive legal landscape.  


## Job Description

**The Role**

AS&H Clifford Chance is seeking a Client Development Manager / Senior Manager to support the firm's strategic growth ambitions in Saudi Arabia. Reporting to the Head of Business Development, the role will focus on driving client development initiatives, supporting key client programmes, identifying growth opportunities, and helping partners win and retain business across priority sectors and clients.

The successful candidate will work closely with partners and lawyers to develop client relationship strategies, coordinate business development campaigns, lead the preparation of pitches, proposals and credentials, and manage legal directory submissions. The role will also support selected profile-raising activities, including market-facing events, communications and thought leadership initiatives, ensuring the firm's market-leading position is effectively communicated to clients and the wider market.

In addition to delivering client development initiatives, the successful candidate will be expected to act as a coach, mentor and role model for a talented and ambitious team. The role requires a commitment to developing colleagues, sharing expertise, embedding best practice and helping to build a culture of excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement across the Client & Market Development function.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Development and Relationship Management**

* Support the development and implementation of client development plans for priority clients and key growth targets.
* Work with partners to identify client opportunities, cross-selling initiatives and relationship-building activities.
* Maintain and develop client intelligence, including client profiles, relationship maps and opportunity pipelines.
* Coordinate client feedback and client listening initiatives, identifying trends and opportunities to strengthen relationships.
* Support strategic client accounts and key client programmes, helping drive revenue growth and client retention.
* Monitor market developments, client activity and competitor initiatives to identify opportunities for the firm.
* Support the delivery of targeted client events, roundtables and thought leadership initiatives aligned with strategic client objectives.
* Coordinate selected communications and marketing activities that support client development priorities.
* Measure and report on the effectiveness and return on investment of client-facing initiatives.

**Pitches, Proposals & Winning Work**

* Lead the preparation and coordination of high-quality pitches, proposals, Expressions of Interest (EOIs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and panel submissions.
* Work with partners and lawyers to develop compelling, client-focused value propositions and win strategies.
* Draft and tailor credentials, capability statements and matter summaries for use in proposals and business development opportunities.
* Maintain and enhance the firm's Saudi credentials database, ensuring experience is current and easily accessible.
* Track pitch opportunities, outcomes and lessons learned, producing reporting and insights to improve future success rates.
* Coordinate internal approval processes and ensure compliance with firm standards and procedures.

**Market Intelligence & Strategic Planning**

* Conduct research on clients, markets, sectors and competitors to support business development activities and partner initiatives.
* Produce briefing materials for client meetings, pitches and strategic planning discussions.
* Monitor market trends, regulatory developments and investment activity relevant to the firm's priority sectors.
* Support the identification and tracking of emerging opportunities within Saudi Arabia and the wider region.

**Legal Directories & Rankings**

* Manage submissions to legal directories including Chambers & Partners, Legal 500, IFLR1000 and other relevant rankings.
* Coordinate referee programmes and liaise with partners to maximise participation and client responses.
* Maintain matter records and supporting evidence required for directory submissions.
* Analyse ranking results and competitor performance to identify opportunities for improving market positioning.
* Work closely with practice groups to develop annual directory strategies and submission calendars.

**Internal Collaboration & Operational Excellence**

* Build strong relationships with partners, lawyers and Business Professional teams across the firm.
* Ensure best practice use of CRM systems and business development tools.
* Maintain accurate BD reporting, opportunity tracking and management information.
* Share knowledge and best practices across the Client & Market Development function.
* Act as a trusted adviser, coach and mentor to junior members of the Client & Market Development team, providing guidance, support and constructive feedback to assist their professional development.
* Champion best practice across business development, client development, pitch management, legal directory submissions and CRM usage, helping to raise standards and drive consistency across the team.
* Support the development of team capabilities through knowledge sharing, training and the introduction of innovative approaches, tools and processes.  
    

## Qualifications

**Your experience**

* 7+ years’ experience in business development, marketing or communications, ideally within a law firm or professional services environment.
* Significant experience in running client development programmes  within a leading law firm or professional services environment.
* A strong track record of managing pitches, proposals and competitive tenders.
* Experience preparing legal directory submissions and working with rankings organisations.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills and confidence working with senior partners and clients.
* Strong commercial awareness and the ability to identify growth opportunities.
* Excellent written communication, drafting and project management skills.
* Experience using CRM systems and business development technologies.
* A team player that is also proactive, highly organised and has a results-oriented approach.  
    

## Additional Information

**How we will support you**

From your first day with us, you will have varied opportunities to continuously grow and develop your expertise and knowledge.  From formal training, informal coaching and mentoring through to technical and personal development skills-based training.

**Hybrid working**

This role follows our 'balanced' hybrid working approach and as long as business needs allow, you will be supported to work in a hybrid way in line with the hybrid working policy.

**Equal opportunities**

At Clifford Chance, we forge an inclusive culture, where diverse perspectives are recognised and valued.  It’s a culture where everyone has equal access to opportunities to thrive and succeed. We are guided by our values-based Code, which sets high standards of conduct and has a principle focused on being inclusive.

We comply with the law and regulations in every location where we operate and we are committed to delivering fair and equal access to all applicants and employees irrespective of background.  This applies across all aspects of employment from recruitment and selection to development, progression, and day-to-day working life.

Our global network of affinity, faith and support groups are open to all.  These communities help to create an environment where everyone at the firm can feel they belong and can reach their full potential.

Find out more about our inclusive culture [here](https://www.cliffordchance.com/about_us/inclusion-and-diversity.html).

# Project Overview:
The Ar Rjum Project comprises a green field gold project with three open pit mining operations with associated waste dumps and ore stockpile, a processing plant, tailings management facilities, and supporting infrastructure including water supply, power supply, maintenance facilities, offices, temporary and permanent accommodation village.
The Project is situated within the Central Arabian Gold Region, approximately 200 km north-east of Taif towards Riyadh and about 26 km South of Al Mouwayh, which is a small town situated on the Jeddah - Riyadh highway.
# Role Overview:
The position provides support to establishing, and execution of all Workforce Services systems, processes, and compliance requirements for the Ar Rjum Project located within the Makkah region of Saudi Arabia, approx. 200km to the east of Taif.. With a primary focus on ensuring the welfare and conditions provided to the construction workforce of approx. 5000 employees are consistent with Saudi Arabian regulatory, and project established requirements.
As there will be a significant proportion of Chinese national employees engaged on the project, fluency in Chinese Mandarin whilst not compulsory, will be highly desirable.
# Job Summary:
The Workforce Services Representative Ar Rjum will assist in ensuring consistent, compliant, and effective Workforce Services delivery across the project. On Ar Rjum, the role will focus on subcontractor workforce oversight in an EPCM environment with no direct-hire workforce, ensuring compliance with labour legislation, contractual obligations, workforce welfare standards, accommodation, transportation, and mobilisation requirements. The role works closely with Project Leadership, Regional and Global Workforce Services leadership, subcontractors, and service providers to support schedule reliability, workforce stability, and positive workforce relations.
# Reporting Relationships:
Functional Reporting: Regional Manager Workforce Services (or delegate)
Project Reporting: Ar Rjum Project Workforce Services Manager (day-to-day execution alignment)
# Major Responsibilities:
+ Support establishment, implement, and manage all Workforce Services systems, procedures, and compliance frameworks for the Ar Rjum Project.
+ Provide leadership and direction to the Project Contractors teams in line with approved planning and project phase requirements.
+ Oversee subcontractor workforce compliance with labour laws, contractual obligations, workforce welfare standards, and Project requirements.
+ Support workforce mobilisation, onboarding, access approvals, and demobilisation processes in coordination with subcontractors and Project stakeholders.
+ Maintain, and audit workforce-related documentation, records, and reporting to ensure transparency and compliance.
+ Support positive workforce and labour relations through proactive engagement, issue resolution, and alignment with Workforce Services leadership.
+ Support sub functions of WS on the Project; Camp/Accommodation services, contractor workforce oversight, workforce mobilization, performance management.
+ Coordinate closely with Construction, ES&H, Security, and Project HR to ensure integrated workforce delivery.
# Skills, Knowledge & Experience:
+ Experience in Workforce Services, Industrial Relations, or Employee Relations within large-scale construction or EPC/EPCM projects.
+ Strong understanding of subcontractor-based workforce models and compliance frameworks.
+ Proven ability to operate effectively in remote, camp-based project environments.
+ Strong stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills.
+ Experience working in the Middle East or similar complex regulatory environments is highly desirable.
+ Ability to speak Mandarin Chinese is highly desirable
# Working Conditions:
The position requires residence at the Ar Rjum Project accommodation facility (camp) and periodic regional travel to support projects and business needs.

Job Description: Senior Technical & Business Consultant – FHIR, NPHIES & HIE

Position Title: Senior Technical & Business Consultant – FHIR & NPHIES  
Contract Duration: 4-Month Fixed-Term Contract (Onsite, KSA) (Possibility of contract extension through end of 2027)  
Location: Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Onsite)  
Required Experience: 8–10 Years (Minimum 5 years in HealthTech)  
Language Requirements: English (Fluent) & Arabic (Mandatory)  
Role Overview

The Technical Consultant will serve as a strategic advisor and technical expert supporting the client’s initiatives within the NPHIES ecosystem. This role demands a deep understanding of healthcare interoperability standards, particularly FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources), and the broader Saudi healthcare landscape, including payer-provider systems, financial health services, and digital transformation goals.

The consultant will work closely with cross-functional teams technical, business, and delivery to ensure successful implementation, integration, and optimization of healthcare solutions aligned with NPHIES standards and regulatory frameworks.

The role requires a unique blend of strong business acumen and solid technical expertise. The successful candidate will be involved in a variety of activities, including validating the business requirements of new releases, reviewing technical architecture and data structures, and overseeing the alignment of technical and business operations within the system. knowledge in Revenue Cycle & Payors is required.

Key Responsibilities

Domain Expertise & Advisory:  
Provide expert guidance on FHIR standards, HL7 protocols, and healthcare interoperability.  
Advise on best practices for integrating NPHIES requirements into existing healthcare systems.  
Stay current with regulatory updates and digital health trends in Saudi Arabia.  
Client Engagement & Needs Assessment:  
Collaborate with client stakeholders to understand strategic goals, operational challenges, and technical requirements.  
Conduct gap analysis and recommend tailored solutions for interoperability, data exchange, and financial workflows.  
Solution Architecture & Integration:  
Design and review system architectures that support FHIR-based data exchange and NPHIES compliance.  
Recommend integration strategies for HIS, HIE, payer systems, and provider platforms.  
Process Optimization:  
Identify opportunities to streamline healthcare operations, reduce costs, and improve data accuracy and accessibility.  
Support automation and digitalization of financial health services with a focus on Revenue Cycle & Payors.  
Technology Enablement:  
Recommend tools, platforms, and technologies that support scalable and secure healthcare data management.  
Support adoption of cloud-based solutions, APIs, and microservices architectures.  
Cross-Team Collaboration:  
Work closely with Business Analysts, Developers, QA, and Delivery teams to ensure functional alignment and successful rollout.  
Participate in solution reviews, testing, and validation of new functionalities and release software updates.  
Subject Matter Expertise:  
Act as a trusted SME for NPHIES-related initiatives, providing insights and training to internal and client teams.  
Support documentation, workshops, and knowledge transfer sessions.  
Required Skills & Qualifications

Education: BSc. Degree in Software Engineering, MIS, or Computer Science.  
Total & Industry Experience: 8–10 years experienced, with solid technical background in SQL, HL7, and healthcare. Minimum 5 years experience in Health Tech industry.  
Healthcare IT: Proven experience in healthcare IT systems (HIE, HIS, payer-provider platforms).  
Interoperability Standards: Strong understanding of FHIR, HL7, and healthcare interoperability frameworks.  
Technical Stack & Architecture: Strong background in software development (.NET, Java, backend/frontend technologies) and SQL. Experience with solution architecture, system integration, and enterprise platforms.  
Domain knowledge: Requires knowledge in Revenue Cycle & Payors. Familiarity with NPHIES platform, standards, and operational models is a significant advantage.  
Project & Business Analysis: Solid experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, documentation, project management, and delivery oversight capabilities.  
Client Skills & Languages: Excellent client-facing and stakeholder communication skills. Fluency in English; Arabic is mandatory.

We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help design, scale, and secure our rapidly growing platform infrastructure.  
You will work across all critical systems — from customer-facing applications and APIs to internal platforms and data services — ensuring availability, performance, and cost efficiency at scale.

You’ll be hands-on with Kubernetes, observability, GitOps, automation, and cloud infrastructure, while partnering closely with application, platform, and data teams to deliver a highly reliable and self-healing environment.

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives on complex distributed systems, loves to automate everything, and can balance speed, stability, and cost-efficiency in production.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or **equivalent work experience**.
* Design, deploy, monitor, and maintain production workloads across **Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE)** clusters.
* Build **self-healing, auto-scaling systems** that minimize manual intervention and ensure uptime.
* Design and operate reliable **database and storage platforms** (SQL, NoSQL, and object stores) within Kubernetes environments.
* Implement **backup, disaster recovery, replication, and failover** strategies to meet RPO/RTO targets.
* Troubleshoot and recover **Kubernetes Persistent Volumes (StorageClasses, CSI drivers, PVC issues)**.
* Optimize storage performance and cost through **multi-tier strategies, hot/cold data separation**, and **S3/offloading lifecycle policies**.
* Secure and scale **object storage platforms** (e.g., MinIO/S3-compatible) for **high-throughput data pipelines**.
* Manage **block storage (EBS/io2/gp3)** and **shared file systems (EFS, NFS)** for resilience and cost balance.
* Collaborate with teams to **optimize networking, ingress/egress traffic**, and service mesh for secure communication.

### Platform & Infrastructure Reliability

* Design, deploy, monitor, and maintain production workloads across Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE) clusters.
* Build self-healing, auto-scaling systems that minimize toil and manual intervention.
* Optimize networking, ingress/egress traffic control, and service mesh for secure & performant communication.
* Design and operate reliable database and storage platforms (SQL, NoSQL, and object stores) in Kubernetes environments.
* Own backup, disaster recovery, replication, and failover strategies to meet RPO/RTO targets for critical data services.
* Optimize storage performance and cost through multi-tier strategies, hot/cold data separation, and S3/offloading lifecycle policies.
* Troubleshoot and recover Kubernetes Persistent Volumes confidently during incidents (StorageClasses, CSI drivers, PVC issues).
* Secure and scale object storage platforms (e.g., MinIO/S3-compatible) and integrate with workloads for high-throughput data pipelines.
* Work with block storage (EBS/io2/gp3) and shared file systems (EFS, NFS) to balance performance, resiliency, and cost.

### Automation & Delivery

* Champion GitOps and CI/CD best practices (ArgoCD, Flux, GitHub Actions).  
    Build automation for infrastructure provisioning and upgrades using Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes Operators.
* Reduce release risk through progressive delivery strategies (blue/green, canary, spot instance rolling updates).

### Observability & Incident Response

* Own the monitoring and alerting stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, VictoriaMetrics, OpenSearch).
* Lead incident management and postmortems to prevent recurrence.
* Provide real-time visibility into system health, performance, and cost metrics.

### Security & Compliance

* Implement least-privilege IAM policies, secure service-to-service communication, and network ACLs/firewalls.
* Enforce Kubernetes RBAC, secret management, and secure image supply chain.
* Participate in audit readiness and compliance efforts.

### Performance & Cost Optimization

* Analyze and tune system performance under scale (CPU/memory/IO).
* Partner with product and platform teams to right-size clusters, databases, and storage tiers.

Introduce cost visibility dashboards for engineering leadership.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing mission-critical systems at scale (high traffic, multi-region).
* Proven cost optimization in cloud/K8s environments.
* Familiarity with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) or advanced networking/egress control.
* Experience with data platform components (Airflow, Debezium, ClickHouse, etc.) is a plus but not required.

Strong communication skills and teamworker — able to collaborate across engineering, DevOps, security, and product teams.

**Requirements**

* 8+ years in SRE / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineering roles.
* Deep Kubernetes expertise (multi-cluster, Helm chart development, advanced networking).
* Strong GitOps workflows using ArgoCD/Flux.
* Expertise with AWS (preferred) or Azure/GCP, plus Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation).
* Advanced knowledge of SQL & NoSQL databases (MySQL/Aurora, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).
* Scripting/automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go.
* Solid background in monitoring/observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/Opensearch, VictoriaMetrics).
* Experience with CI/CD at scale and managing production incidents.

* Experience with streaming/messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).  
    

**Benefits**

* Comprehensive Training & Development programs.
* Performance-based Bonus incentives.
* Flexible Work From Home options.

job_title: Senior Project Manager, Credit & Risk Implementations (KSA)
description:
About Synapse Analytics
Synapse Analytics builds AI-powered platforms that help financial institutions make faster, better, more transparent decisions. Konan, our decisioning and workflow platform, digitizes credit decisioning end to end inside banks and lenders. Doxter, our document intelligence platform, turns unstructured client documents into structured, usable data. We implement both inside regulated financial institutions across MENA and LATAM, and Saudi Arabia is one of our most important and fastest-growing markets.

About the Role
As Senior Project Manager for Credit & Risk Implementations in KSA, you will be Synapse's senior delivery lead on the ground in the Kingdom. You will own the end-to-end delivery of Konan and Doxter implementations at Saudi banks, finance companies, and lenders: programmes that digitize credit policy, automate underwriting and decisioning, and operate under the oversight of the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA).
This is not a generic PM role. Our KSA implementations sit at the point where credit and risk policy, regulatory compliance, client IT and InfoSec, and AI-powered software meet. You will need to hold a credible conversation with a Chief Risk Officer about policy and decisioning, with a CISO about outsourcing and data controls, and with our engineers about integration and deployment, and then turn all of it into one plan the client trusts.
You will run a portfolio of concurrent KSA engagements, lead senior client relationships and steering committees, protect scope and commercial boundaries, and act as the delivery authority for the region. As our presence in the Kingdom grows, you will also help build the local delivery team and the playbook it runs on.

Role and Responsibilities
Credit & Risk Implementation Leadership
Lead end-to-end delivery of Konan and Doxter implementations for Saudi financial institutions, from contract handover and project charter through go-live, hypercare, and handover to Customer Success.

Own the credit policy digitization workstream: lead policy discovery workshops with client credit and risk teams, and guide the translation of credit policy, eligibility and knockout rules, scorecards, limits, pricing, and approval matrices into Konan configurations alongside our Konan subject matter experts.

Ensure every configured policy is traceable to the client's approved policy documents, fully tested, and formally signed off by the client's risk owners.

Lead end-to-end lending journey design across retail, SME, and consumer finance products, including loan origination, onboarding, decisioning, and document verification flows.

Coordinate data source and integration workstreams typical of the Saudi market, such as credit bureau, identity verification, income verification, and core banking integrations.

Regulatory, Compliance & InfoSec Readiness
Plan delivery around the client's regulatory obligations, including SAMA outsourcing requirements, cybersecurity and data protection controls, and the approval steps the client must complete before go-live.

job_title: Freelance Industrial Hazard & Risk Subject Matter Expert
description:
About dss+
At dss+, you don’t just deliver projects, you help save lives, improve performance, and build a more sustainable future.
We are a purpose-led global consultancy partnering with organisations in high-risk and asset-intensive industries to solve complex operational challenges across safety, operational excellence, and sustainability.
With a heritage rooted in DuPont’s industrial operations, we combine deep expertise, practical problem-solving, and digital innovation to deliver measurable and lasting impact for our clients.

Why This Role
dss+ is currently developing a proposal for a client in Saudi Arabia to support the creation of a National Industrial Hazard Index (IHI) .
The IHI is intended to provide a consistent methodology for measuring and classifying the inherent hazard level of factories across Saudi industrial cities. It will combine multiple industrial hazard dimensions into a practical, evidence-based and auditable framework, drawing on available information relating to hazards, incidents, hazardous materials, occupancy, machinery and factory characteristics.

More importantly, the IHI is intended to become a risk-based decision-making tool that can help inform:
The frequency and depth of factory inspections

Requirements for specialist inspection expertise

Escalation and intervention protocols

Emergency preparedness priorities

The allocation of regulatory resources

To support this work, we are seeking credible and independent industrial hazard and risk specialists who can bring fresh external perspectives to the proposed methodology.

This opportunity would suit senior experts who remain active within industry, government, regulatory bodies, research institutions, international risk or safety organisations, or other relevant technical institutions. We are particularly interested in specialists who can constructively challenge established thinking and contribute practical insights from outside existing dss+ methodologies and frameworks.

Your Impact at dss+
As an Independent Industrial Hazard & Risk SME, you will provide expert challenge and validation during focused technical workshops with the dss+ project team.
You will review the proposed Industrial Hazard Index through the lens of current industry practice, regulatory experience and technical evidence. Your contribution will help ensure that the resulting methodology is credible, practical, transparent and suitable for application across a diverse industrial landscape.
Depending on your background, you may contribute expertise across one or several of the following areas:
Hazardous Materials

Hazardous-material properties and inventories, including:
Toxicity, flammability and reactivity

Physical state and storage conditions

Inventory volumes and concentration

Applicable hazard thresholds and classifications

2. Process Hazards
Industrial process characteristics and operating conditions, including:
Operating pressure and temperature

Chemical reactions and reactive systems

Toxic services

Batch and continuous manufacturing processes

3. Fire and Explosion Potential
Factors influencing the likelihood and potential severity of fires and explosions, including:
Fuel inventories and ignition potential

Confinement and congestion

Combustible dust

Hazardous-area classification

4. Storage, Handling and Logistics
Loss-of-containment and material-movement risks associated with:
Tank farms and bulk storage

Warehouses

Bulk transfers and loading operations

Material segregation and compatibility

Secondary containment

Internal transportation and logistics

5. Equipment and Energy
Stored, mechanical, thermal and electrical energy associated with:
Pressure systems

Fired equipment

Lifting operations

Molten materials

Rotating machinery

Other energy-intensive industrial equipment

6. Industrial Health and Hygiene
Acute and chronic occupational exposure to hazards such as:
Carcinogens

Silica and metals

Noise and vibration

Heat

Radiation

Biological agents

7. Human Occupancy Density
Workforce and third-party exposure within industrial hazard footprints, including:
Employees and contractors

Visitors

Occupied buildings

The location, concentration and vulnerability of exposed populations

8. Off-site Receptors and Escalation
Potential consequences extending beyond factory boundaries, including effects on:
Surrounding communities

Hospitals and schools

Critical infrastructure

Environmental receptors

Neighbouring industrial facilities

Domino and escalation scenarios
Key Responsibilities
You will:
Participate in focused expert review and validation workshops

Challenge the proposed hazard parameters and assessment criteria

Review the weighting and scoring logic used to combine different hazard dimensions

Assess whether proposed hazard thresholds are technically credible and proportionate

Advise on the evidence required to support hazard classifications

Identify potential gaps, unintended consequences or areas of over- or under-weighting

Consider whether the methodology can be applied consistently across different factory types and industrial sectors

Provide perspectives from current industry, regulatory or institutional practice

Help ensure the methodology is evidence-based, auditable and practical for regulatory decision-making

Contribute targeted technical recommendations within your areas of expertise

We do not necessarily require a separate specialist for each risk area. A strong expert may cover several dimensions where they have credible, demonstrable experience.

Who You Are
You are a recognised specialist with deep practical expertise in industrial hazards, process safety, fire and explosion risk, occupational hygiene, regulatory inspection, emergency preparedness or a closely related discipline.
You bring independent judgement, strong technical credibility and the confidence to challenge proposed approaches constructively. You can distinguish between theoretically robust methods and those that will work in practice across varied industrial environments.

Experience
You are likely to bring:
Significant experience within high-hazard, safety-critical or asset-intensive industrial environments

Deep specialist expertise in one or more of the eight risk areas outlined above

Current or recent practical exposure within industry, government, a regulatory body, an international risk or safety organisation, research, academia or another relevant institution

Experience developing, applying or reviewing risk-assessment, hazard-classification or regulatory methodologies

Knowledge of industrial inspections, major-hazard regulation, emergency planning or risk-based regulatory decision-making

Experience reviewing technical parameters, thresholds, scoring systems or evidence requirements

Exposure to a range of manufacturing, processing or industrial operating environments

Experience contributing to multidisciplinary technical reviews or expert workshops

Experience of industrial regulation or operations within Saudi Arabia, the GCC or comparable international settings would be beneficial but is not essential.

Capabilities
You will be able to:
Apply strong technical and analytical judgement to complex risk questions

Challenge assumptions and methodologies in a constructive, evidence-based manner

Translate specialist knowledge into practical assessment criteria

Evaluate interactions between different industrial hazard dimensions

Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to multidisciplinary stakeholders

Contribute effectively during focused expert workshops

Maintain independence of thought while collaborating with the wider project team

Provide concise and actionable technical recommendations

Education and Professional Standing
You are likely to hold:
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, chemistry, occupational hygiene, fire engineering, safety, risk management or another relevant technical discipline

Relevant professional accreditation, chartership or specialist certification, where applicable

Fluency in English; Arabic language capability would be beneficial

Equivalent senior-level professional and industry experience will also be considered.

Shape the Future of Cybersecurity at Forescout
Every day cyberattacks threaten to disrupt hospitals, power grids, financial systems, and the infrastructure we all depend on. At Forescout, we build defenses that keep civilization running smoothly in an increasingly connected world.
For more than 25 years, Fortune 100 organizations, government agencies, and large enterprises have trusted Forescout as their foundation to manage cyber risk, ensure compliance, and mitigate threats. From power grids and healthcare systems to financial networks and transportation hubs, Forescout protects the critical infrastructure of our modern world.
What You Will Do

You will work closely with Focus Partners to build strong, strategic relationships that enhance partner engagement and maximise sales opportunities.
This role requires a combination of business development, relationship management, and sales execution. You will act as a trusted advisor to your partners, enabling them with the necessary tools, knowledge, and support to successfully position and sell Forescout solutions.
Success in this role will be measured by your ability to increase the percentage of pipeline and revenue generated from the channel, drive deal registration numbers, and ensure a structured and programmatic approach to partner enablement.
This role requires frequent travel within your region, high energy, excellent presentation and communication skills, and the ability to build strong, trusted relationships with partners and internal teams.
Channel Sales & Business Growth

• Manage and grow relationships with assigned channel partners, ensuring Forescout is their preferred cybersecurity vendor.

• Drive pipeline growth and revenue generation through partner-led sales opportunities.

• Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue and MBO targets by developing joint go-to-market plans with partners.

• Work closely with the regional sales teams to ensure effective collaboration between partners and Forescout direct sales.

• Drive deal registration and ensure partners follow a structured sales process.

Partner Recruitment, Enablement & Development

• Ensure partners are trained, certified, and capable of selling and supporting Forescout solutions.

• Develop tailored enablement plans for Focus Partners to drive growth.

• Deliver regular business reviews and joint account planning sessions with key partners.

Strategic Partner Engagement

• Prioritise Focus Partners, ensuring the majority of revenue is driven through engaged and committed channel partners.

• Facilitate executive engagement between key partners and Forescout leadership.

• Develop relationships at all levels within partner organisations, including executive, sales, technical, and marketing teams.

Marketing & Demand Generation

• Ensure partners leverage Forescout’s marketing resources to build awareness and generate pipeline.

• Support regional marketing events and partner-led demand generation activities.

Managed Service Provider (MSP) & Distribution Support

• % of pipeline generated through the channel

• % of total revenue driven through the channel

• Number of deal registrations and active partner opportunities

• Partner engagement and certification levels

• Ensure partners are accountable for business growth and performance expectations.

What You Will Bring To Forescout

• Proven experience in channel sales and partner management, ideally within the cybersecurity or IT industry.

• Strong track record of driving pipeline and revenue growth through channel partners.

• Ability to build, develop, and manage strategic partner relationships at all levels.

• Experience in partner recruitment, enablement, and joint business planning.

• Understanding of distribution and MSP models and how they impact the channel ecosystem.

• Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to travel regularly within the assigned territory to engage with partners.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

• Self-motivated, highly energetic, and driven to succeed.

Success Metrics

## Job Description

Main responsibilities:

* Review and assess architectural shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, technical proposals, and interface details to ensure compliance with design intent and project specifications.
* Coordinate and integrate partitions, ceilings, flooring, wall finishes, joinery, and other architectural elements with structural, MEP, lighting, AV, show, and ride systems to ensure seamless design execution and buildability.

* Monitor all installations for dimensional accuracy, workmanship quality, accessibility compliance, and adherence to approved architectural details and specifications.
* Review material samples and mock-ups for architectural compliance, aesthetic quality, and successful integration with adjoining works and finishes.
* Support comprehensive inspections, snagging activities, corrective actions, and verification of completed works in close coordination with the quality assurance and project management teams.
* Review and validate architectural as-built drawings for accuracy and completeness; support final handover procedures and documentation.
* Provide technical guidance and recommendations on complex architectural challenges, particularly within entertainment venues, immersive environments, and specialised fit-out projects.

## Qualifications

\*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*

* Minimum 12 years of professional architectural experience, with substantial involvement in design coordination, technical review, and site supervision on complex projects
* Recognised architectural qualification (RIBA Part 3 or equivalent professional registration)
* Demonstrated expertise in coordinating architectural elements with structural, MEP, lighting, AV, and specialist systems on large-scale projects
* Proven experience in entertainment venues, immersive environments, or specialised fit-out projects
* Advanced proficiency in architectural drawing and detailing, including shop drawings, technical specifications, and as-built documentation
* Strong track record in quality assurance, snagging coordination, and defect rectification on completed works
* Extensive experience in material selection, mock-up review, and aesthetic quality assessment
* Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve spatial clashes, drawing discrepancies, and site constraints through collaborative problem-solving
* Proficiency with Building Information Modelling (BIM) and relevant architectural software platforms
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with proven ability to coordinate across multiple disciplines and consultant teams

\*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*

* Experience on award-winning or high-profile entertainment or experiential design projects
* Knowledge of accessibility compliance standards and building regulations relevant to specialised venues
* Familiarity with project management methodologies and quality assurance protocols
* Experience mentoring junior architectural staff and providing technical guidance on complex challenges
